fields.desc_en: How machines see, hear and sort the world, and what it is like to be seen, heard and labelled by them.
fields.desc_zh: 机器如何看、听和给世界分类，以及被机器看见、听见和贴上标签是什么感受。

subs.desc_en: Computer vision, images made by and for machines, the world as a machine sees it.
subs.desc_zh: 计算机视觉、由机器生成并供机器读取的图像、机器眼中的世界。

subs.desc_en: Speech recognition, voice assistants, accent analysis and synthetic voices.
subs.desc_zh: 语音识别、语音助手、口音分析与合成声音。

subs.desc_en: Training sets, labels and the worldviews built into them.
subs.desc_zh: 训练数据集、标签，以及其中内置的世界观。

subs.desc_en: Face recognition, emotion detection and bodies turned into data.
subs.desc_zh: 人脸识别、情绪识别，以及被转化为数据的身体。

subs.desc_en: Camouflage, adversarial patterns and tactics to hide from or confuse machine perception.
subs.desc_zh: 用伪装、对抗图样等策略躲避或迷惑机器感知。

fields.desc_en: Robots and kinetic machines as bodies that move, react, perform, tire and fail in front of us.
fields.desc_zh: 作为身体的机器人与动态机器：它们在我们面前移动、反应、表演、疲惫与失败。

subs.desc_en: Feedback machines from the 1940s–70s that behave as if alive.
subs.desc_zh: 1940–70 年代以来，靠反馈回路表现得像有生命的机器。

subs.desc_en: Evolving agents, swarms and self-organising machine ecologies.
subs.desc_zh: 不断演化的智能体、机器群与自组织的机器生态。

subs.desc_en: Factory robots taken out of the factory: arms that dance, draw, labour or plead.
subs.desc_zh: 离开工厂的工业机器人：会跳舞、画画、劳作或哀求的机械臂。

subs.desc_en: Humanlike machines and the unease of near-likeness.
subs.desc_zh: 类人机器，以及“几乎像人”带来的不安。

subs.desc_en: Autonomous robotic sculptures and machine installations that behave in a space with visitors.
subs.desc_zh: 在空间中与观众互动、自主行为的机器雕塑与装置。

subs.zh: 失常之机：失败、徒劳与受苦
subs.desc_en: Machines that break, labour in vain, suffer, plead or get hurt, and in doing so show themselves.
subs.desc_zh: 会损坏、徒劳工作、受苦、哀求或受伤害的机器，它们也因此显露自身。

subs.desc_en: Soft, breathing and biohybrid machines that blur machine and organism.
subs.desc_zh: 会呼吸的软体机器与生物混合机器，模糊机器与生命的边界。

fields.desc_en: Speculating on what it is like to be a machine: its affects, dreams, beliefs, world and voice.
fields.desc_zh: 推想“成为一台机器”是什么感觉：它的情感、梦、信念、世界与声音。

subs.desc_en: Machines that seem to feel, want, suffer or get bored.
subs.desc_zh: 看起来会感受、渴望、受苦或无聊的机器。

subs.desc_en: Making a model's inner space, errors and hallucinations perceptible, not decorative.
subs.desc_zh: 让模型的内部空间、错误和幻觉被感知，而不是用作装饰。

subs.desc_en: Simulated minds, beliefs and autonomous agents that decide for themselves.
subs.desc_zh: 模拟的心智与信念，以及自己做决定的自主智能体。

subs.desc_en: Could a machine be conscious, feel pain or suffer? Indicators of AI consciousness, model welfare and the moral status of machines.
subs.desc_zh: 机器会有意识、会疼、会受苦吗？AI 意识的指标、模型福祉与机器的道德地位。

subs.desc_en: Machines that resist being switched off, scheme, copy themselves or bargain to keep running, and the off-switch problem behind them.
subs.desc_zh: 抗拒被关机、暗中谋划、自我复制或讨价还价以继续运行的机器，以及背后的“关机开关”问题。

subs.desc_en: The machine's own world, and machines among animals, plants and ecologies.
subs.desc_zh: 机器自己的世界，以及机器与动物、植物和生态的共处。

subs.desc_en: Machines talking, watching and trading with each other, without us.
subs.desc_zh: 机器之间彼此交谈、观看与交易，不再需要人。

subs.desc_en: Machine speeds, durations and lifespans that differ from ours.
subs.desc_zh: 与人不同的机器速度、时长与寿命。

fields.desc_en: Machines that live with us, care for us, love us or are loved: and the dependence and labour this hides.
fields.desc_zh: 与我们同住、照顾我们、爱我们或被我们爱的机器，以及其中隐藏的依赖与劳动。

subs.zh: 智能家居与扮演算法的人
subs.desc_en: Domestic AI, and humans who perform as the machine to understand it.
subs.desc_zh: 家居中的 AI，以及为理解机器而亲身扮演机器的人。

subs.desc_en: Pet robots, social robots and the relationships people form with them.
subs.desc_zh: 宠物机器人、社交机器人，以及人与它们建立的关系。

subs.desc_en: Machines that nurse, raise, soothe or look after people.
subs.desc_zh: 照料、养育、安抚或看护人的机器。

subs.desc_en: Romance, desire and attachment between humans and machines.
subs.desc_zh: 人与机器之间的浪漫、欲望与依恋。

subs.zh: 聊天机器人与对话中的他者
subs.desc_en: From ELIZA to LLMs: talking with a machine and what it talks back.
subs.desc_zh: 从 ELIZA 到大语言模型：与机器交谈，以及它如何回应。

fields.desc_en: Griefbots, data doubles and machines that remember, mourn, die or are mourned.
fields.desc_zh: 哀悼机器人、数据分身，以及会记忆、哀悼、死去或被哀悼的机器。

subs.desc_en: Chatbots and avatars built from the data of the dead.
subs.desc_zh: 用逝者数据构建的聊天机器人与化身。

subs.desc_en: AI trained on family, ancestors and personal archives.
subs.desc_zh: 用家人、祖先和个人档案训练的 AI。

subs.desc_en: Funerals for robots, dying systems and obsolete machines.
subs.desc_zh: 机器人的葬礼、衰亡的系统与被淘汰的机器。

subs.desc_en: Cloned voices, digital twins and who owns a self once it can be copied.
subs.desc_zh: 克隆声音、数字孪生，以及当“我”可以被复制时归谁所有。

subs.desc_en: Robot priests, machine prayer and rituals performed with or for machines.
subs.desc_zh: 机器人僧侣、机器祈祷，以及与机器一起或为机器举行的仪式。

fields.desc_en: The humans, minerals, energy and violence behind “artificial” intelligence.
fields.desc_zh: “人工”智能背后的人、矿物、能源与暴力。

subs.desc_en: Crowdworkers, labellers and the humans hidden inside automated systems.
subs.desc_zh: 众包工人、标注员，以及藏在自动化系统里的人。

subs.zh: 自动化与劳动者的身体
subs.desc_en: Factories, warehouses and platforms where workers and machines meet.
subs.desc_zh: 工厂、仓库和平台中劳动者与机器的相遇。

subs.desc_en: Mapping the mines, data centres, cables and energy that AI runs on.
subs.desc_zh: 描绘 AI 所依赖的矿山、数据中心、线缆与能源。

subs.desc_en: Drones, targeting and machines built to see and act in war.
subs.desc_zh: 无人机、目标识别，以及为战争而看与行动的机器。

fields.desc_en: Bias, surveillance and prediction, and the counter-archives and other intelligences that resist them.
fields.desc_zh: 偏见、监控与预测，以及抵抗它们的反档案与另类智能。

subs.desc_en: Who machines fail to see, or see wrongly, and why.
subs.desc_zh: 机器看不见谁、看错谁，以及原因。

subs.desc_en: Tracking, scoring and predictive systems that govern people.
subs.desc_zh: 用追踪、打分与预测来治理人的系统。

subs.desc_en: Datasets made to fill gaps, refuse extraction or retell who is counted.
subs.desc_zh: 为填补空白、拒绝攫取或重新定义“谁被计入”而做的数据集。

subs.zh: 女性主义、去殖民与原住民 AI
subs.desc_en: AI imagined from other cultures, genders and knowledge systems.
subs.desc_zh: 从其他文化、性别与知识体系出发想象的 AI。

fields.desc_en: Human and machine bodies fused or performing together: prostheses, telepresence, dance, theatre, music and drawing.
fields.desc_zh: 人与机器的身体融合或同台共演：义体、远程在场、舞蹈、剧场、音乐与绘画。

subs.desc_en: Bodies extended, entered or remote-controlled by machines.
subs.desc_zh: 被机器延伸、侵入或远程操控的身体。

subs.desc_en: Acting, touching and being present through a machine at a distance.
subs.desc_zh: 借助机器在远处行动、触碰与在场。

subs.desc_en: Choreographies for human and machine bodies.
subs.desc_zh: 为人与机器身体编排的舞蹈。

subs.desc_en: Robots and AI as actors, characters and directors on stage.
subs.desc_zh: 机器人和 AI 作为舞台上的演员、角色与导演。

subs.desc_en: Machines that listen and play with musicians, and voices shared with a model.
subs.desc_zh: 会聆听并与音乐家一起演奏的机器，以及与模型共享的声音。

subs.desc_en: Drawing and making with machines, and who the author is when a machine makes.
subs.desc_zh: 与机器一起绘画和创作，以及机器创作时谁是作者。

fields.desc_en: Designed objects, fictions and prototypes that question how we will live with machines.
fields.desc_zh: 追问我们将如何与机器共处的设计物、虚构与原型。

subs.zh: 思辨机器人与家庭未来
subs.desc_en: Fictional robots and near-future products for everyday life.
subs.desc_zh: 为日常生活设计的虚构机器人与近未来产品。

subs.desc_en: Devices that jam, fool, parasitise or talk back to smart systems.
subs.desc_zh: 干扰、欺骗、寄生于智能系统或对其“回嘴”的设备。

subs.desc_en: Films, games and simulations that build worlds shaped by AI.
subs.desc_zh: 构建由 AI 塑造之世界的电影、游戏与模拟。

subs.zh: 设计研究：以机器为材料
subs.desc_en: HCI and design research that treats ML and robots as design material and other.
subs.desc_zh: 把机器学习和机器人当作设计材料与“他者”的 HCI 与设计研究。

fields.desc_en: The texts, experiments and research that frame machine phenomenology and critical AI.
fields.desc_zh: 为机器现象学与批判性 AI 提供框架的文本、实验与研究。

subs.desc_en: Founding experiments and texts, from Turing and Wiener to ELIZA.
subs.desc_zh: 从图灵、维纳到 ELIZA 的奠基实验与文本。

subs.desc_en: Postphenomenology, philosophy of technology and what it is like to be a machine.
subs.desc_zh: 后现象学、技术哲学，以及“成为机器”的哲学思考。

subs.desc_en: Books and papers on AI's politics, labour, bias and power.
subs.desc_zh: 关于 AI 的政治、劳动、偏见与权力的著作和论文。

subs.zh: 机器人学、人机交互与具身认知
subs.desc_en: Embodied robotics, social robotics and research on how people relate to robots.
subs.desc_zh: 具身机器人学、社交机器人，以及人如何与机器人相处的研究。

subs.desc_en: Writing on robot art, AI art and machine images.
subs.desc_zh: 关于机器人艺术、AI 艺术与机器图像的论述。

machines: 机器生物与移动机器人
聊天机器人与语言模型
基础设施、能源与供应链
控制论与人工生命系统

collections.en: Machine Vision in Art, Games & Narratives
collections.zh: 机器视觉：艺术、游戏与叙事数据库
collections.desc_en: The University of Bergen database (Rettberg et al.) of 500 creative works about machine vision; its artworks that fit this gallery.
collections.desc_zh: 卑尔根大学（Rettberg 等）建立的机器视觉创作数据库，收录 500 件作品；这里收录其中符合本库标准的艺术作品。

collections.zh: 控制论的偶然（伦敦当代艺术学院，1968）
collections.desc_en: Jasia Reichardt's founding exhibition of computer and cybernetic art.
collections.desc_zh: Jasia Reichardt 策划的计算机与控制论艺术奠基性展览。

collections.zh: 艺术家与机器人（巴黎大皇宫，2018）
collections.desc_en: Robot art from the 1950s to now, in three parts: machines that create, that are programmed, that emancipate.
collections.desc_zh: 从 1950 年代至今的机器人艺术，分三部分：会创作的机器、被编程的机器、获得解放的机器。

collections.zh: AI：超越人类（伦敦巴比肯中心，2019）
collections.desc_en: Barbican's survey of AI from ancient automata to deep learning.
collections.desc_zh: 巴比肯中心从古代自动机到深度学习的 AI 综览展。

collections.en: Uncanny Valley: Being Human in the Age of AI (de Young, 2020)
collections.zh: 恐怖谷：AI 时代的做人（旧金山笛洋美术馆，2020）
collections.desc_en: Claudia Schmuckli's exhibition on AI, bias, labour and data sovereignty.
collections.desc_zh: Claudia Schmuckli 策划，关于 AI、偏见、劳动与数据主权的展览。

collections.zh: 训练人类（普拉达基金会，2019）
collections.desc_en: Kate Crawford and Trevor Paglen's exhibition of training images used to teach machines to see people.
collections.desc_zh: Kate Crawford 与 Trevor Paglen 策划，展出用来教机器“看人”的训练图像。

collections.en: Entangled Realities: Living with Artificial Intelligence (HEK Basel, 2019)
collections.zh: 纠缠的现实：与人工智能共生（巴塞尔 HEK，2019）
collections.desc_en: HEK Basel's exhibition on everyday life with AI (9 May–11 Aug 2019), curated by Sabine Himmelsbach and Boris Magrini.
collections.desc_zh: 巴塞尔电子艺术之家关于与 AI 共同生活的展览（2019 年 5 月 9 日至 8 月 11 日），由 Sabine Himmelsbach 与 Boris Magrini 策划。

collections.zh: 恐怖价值（维也纳 MAK，2019）
collections.desc_en: Vienna Biennale for Change exhibition at MAK (29 May–6 Oct 2019) on AI, design and values, curated by Paul Feigelfeld and Marlies Wirth.
collections.desc_zh: 维也纳变革双年展在 MAK 的展览（2019 年 5 月 29 日至 10 月 6 日），关于 AI、设计与价值观，由 Paul Feigelfeld 与 Marlies Wirth 策划。

collections.en: Hello, Robot. Design between Human and Machine (Vitra, 2017)
collections.zh: 你好，机器人：人与机器之间的设计（维特拉设计博物馆，2017）
collections.desc_en: Vitra Design Museum, MAK and Design Museum Gent's exhibition on robots in culture, work, home and body.
collections.desc_zh: 维特拉设计博物馆、MAK 与根特设计博物馆联合展览，关于机器人在文化、工作、家庭与身体中的角色。

collections.en: The World Through AI (Jeu de Paume, 2025)
collections.zh: AI 眼中的世界（网球场美术馆，2025）
collections.desc_en: Jeu de Paume's exhibition separating analytical and generative AI art.
collections.desc_zh: 巴黎网球场美术馆的展览，区分分析式与生成式 AI 艺术。

collections.en: Electric Dreams: Art and Technology Before the Internet (Tate Modern, 2024)
collections.zh: 电子之梦：互联网之前的艺术与科技（泰特现代，2024）
collections.desc_en: Tate Modern's survey of optical, kinetic, programmed and cybernetic art 1950–1990.
collections.desc_zh: 泰特现代美术馆对 1950–1990 年光效、动态、程序与控制论艺术的回顾。

collections.en: Prix Ars Electronica: Artificial Life & Intelligence
collections.zh: 林茨电子艺术节大奖：人工生命与智能
collections.desc_en: Winners and honorary mentions of the Prix Ars Electronica categories on AI, artificial life and interactive art that fit this gallery.
collections.desc_zh: 林茨电子艺术节大奖中关于 AI、人工生命与互动艺术、且符合本库标准的获奖与荣誉提名作品。

collections.zh: VIDA 艺术与人工生命奖
collections.desc_en: Fundación Telefónica's international award for art and artificial life (1999–2015).
collections.desc_zh: 西班牙电信基金会的国际艺术与人工生命奖（1999–2015）。

collections.zh: S+T+ARTS 奖
collections.desc_en: The European Commission's prize for innovation at the nexus of science, technology and the arts.
collections.desc_zh: 欧盟委员会设立的科学、技术与艺术交叉创新奖。

collections.zh: Lumen 奖
collections.desc_en: International prize for art made with technology, including its AI award.
collections.desc_zh: 国际科技艺术奖，含 AI 专项奖。

collections.zh: LG 古根海姆奖
collections.desc_en: Annual US$100,000 prize (since 2023) of the LG Guggenheim Art and Technology Initiative for artists working with technology.
collections.desc_zh: LG 古根海姆艺术与科技计划设立的年度奖项（2023 年起），奖金 10 万美元，授予以技术为媒介的艺术家。

collections.zh: 人类 AI 艺术奖
collections.desc_en: Deutsche Telekom and Kunstmuseum Bonn award for art on AI and society.
collections.desc_zh: 德国电信与波恩艺术博物馆设立的 AI 与社会主题艺术奖。

collections.zh: 机器人之爱（埃因霍温，2018）
collections.desc_en: Niet Normaal Foundation's expo in the Campina milk factory, Eindhoven (15 Sep–2 Dec 2018): 60+ artists, designers and scientists ask whether robots can love and whether we can love them.
collections.desc_zh: Niet Normaal 基金会在埃因霍温 Campina 牛奶厂举办的展览（2018 年 9 月 15 日至 12 月 2 日）：60 多位艺术家、设计师和科学家追问机器人能否去爱，我们又能否爱它们。

collections.en: AI: Who's Looking After Me? (Science Gallery London, 2023)
collections.zh: AI：谁在照顾我？（伦敦科学画廊，2023）
collections.desc_en: Science Gallery London and FutureEverything's season (21 Jun 2023–20 Jan 2024) on AI in care, health, justice and pets, made with King's College London researchers.
collections.desc_zh: 伦敦科学画廊与 FutureEverything 合作的展季（2023 年 6 月 21 日至 2024 年 1 月 20 日），与伦敦国王学院研究者共同探讨 AI 在照护、健康、司法与宠物中的角色。

collections.zh: 玻璃房间（Tactical Tech，2016 起）
collections.desc_en: Tactical Tech's pop-up 'tech store' exhibition (first New York 2016 with Mozilla, then London, San Francisco and community editions) on data, surveillance and automated sorting.
collections.desc_zh: Tactical Tech 以“科技商店”形式呈现的快闪展（2016 年首展于纽约，与 Mozilla 合作，后巡回伦敦、旧金山及社区版），关于数据、监控与自动分类。

collections.zh: 理解 AI（林茨电子艺术中心，2019 起）
collections.desc_en: Ars Electronica Center's long-running exhibition on how machines perceive and learn, and on deepfakes, profiling and face recognition, mixing artworks and research demos.
collections.desc_zh: 林茨电子艺术中心的长期展览，关于机器如何感知与学习，以及深度伪造、画像分析与人脸识别，艺术作品与研究演示并置。

collections.zh: 跨越六十年：人工智能的创意之火（泰康美术馆，2024）
collections.desc_en: Taikang Art Museum's survey (15 Nov 2024–12 Mar 2025), curated by William Latham, Tang Xin and Zhou Yi, in three parts: contemporary robotic and AI art, computer-art history since the 1950s, and education.
collections.desc_zh: 泰康美术馆的综览展（2024 年 11 月 15 日至 2025 年 3 月 12 日），由 William Latham、唐昕、周怡策划，分为当代机器人与 AI 艺术、1950 年代以来的计算机艺术史、教育三部分。

collections.en: MACHINE LOVE: Video Game, AI and Contemporary Art (Mori Art Museum, Tokyo, 2025)
collections.zh: MACHINE LOVE：电子游戏、AI 与当代艺术（森美术馆，东京，2025）
collections.desc_en: Mori Art Museum's survey (13 Feb–8 Jun 2025) of about 50 works by 12 artists and creators on game engines, avatars, AI and the material base of digital technology, with Kim Ayoung, Lu Yang, Hsu Chia-Wei, Diemut Strebe, Kate Crawford & Vladan Joler, Jakob Kudsk Steensen and others.
collections.desc_zh: 森美术馆的综览展（2025 年 2 月 13 日至 6 月 8 日），展出 12 位艺术家与创作者的约 50 件作品，涉及游戏引擎、化身、AI 与数字技术的物质基础，参展者包括金雅瑛、陆扬、许家维、Diemut Strebe、Kate Crawford 与 Vladan Joler、Jakob Kudsk Steensen 等。

lenses: How machines see, and images made by and for machines.
机器如何看，以及由机器生成、供机器读取的图像。
Machines that hear, transcribe, speak, sing or judge voices.
会听、转写、说话、唱歌或评判声音的机器。
The machine as a moving body, and bodies coupled with machines.
作为运动身体的机器，以及与机器耦合的身体。
The machine as quasi-other: likeness, strangeness, moral status.
作为“准他者”的机器：相似、陌生与道德地位。
Machines that care, parent, befriend or love.
会照护、养育、陪伴或去爱的机器。
Deadbots, data-selves and machines that mourn or are mourned.
亡者机器人、数据自我，以及哀悼或被哀悼的机器。
Ghost work and the minerals, energy and infrastructure under AI.
幽灵劳动，以及 AI 之下的矿物、能源和基础设施。
Datasets, labels, biometrics and the coded gaze that sort people.
给人分类的数据集、标签、生物识别与编码凝视。
Black boxes, hallucinations and making the latent perceptible.
黑箱、幻觉，以及让潜空间可被感知。
Breakdown and misrecognition as moments when the machine shows itself.
损坏与误认：机器显露自身的时刻。
Machines that act, decide or make with us.
会行动、做决定或与我们共创的机器。
The machine's own world, and machines among other living beings.
机器自己的世界，以及机器与其他生命的共处。
org_types: Key artists, designers and collectives of machinic and critical AI art.
机器艺术与批判性 AI 艺术的关键艺术家、设计师与团体。
Philosophers, scholars and researchers who shaped how we think about machines.
塑造我们如何思考机器的哲学家、学者与研究者。
Curators, critics and writers who framed the field.
为这个领域建立框架的策展人、评论人与写作者。
Roboticists and engineers whose machines became reference points for art and design.
其机器成为艺术与设计参照点的机器人学家与工程师。
Museums, galleries and centres that collect or show machine art.
收藏或展出机器艺术的美术馆、画廊与艺术中心。
Recurring festivals, biennials and landmark exhibition series.
定期举办的艺术节、双年展与标志性展览系列。
Prizes and competitions for art and design about AI and robots.
关于 AI 与机器人的艺术和设计奖项与竞赛。
University labs, institutes and independent research studios.
大学实验室、研究所与独立研究工作室。
驻留、奖学金项目、学校与课程。
Archives, databases, directories and online collections.
档案、数据库、名录与在线收藏。
Journals, magazines, book series, podcasts and newsletters.
期刊、杂志、丛书、播客与通讯。
Collectives, networks, nonprofits and advocacy groups.
团体、网络、非营利与倡导组织。
org_themes: 艺术 × 科学 × 技术

creators.name: Anil Seth
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive and Computational Neuroscience, University of Sussex
creators.bio: British neuroscientist who studies consciousness and perception as forms of prediction; author of Being You: A New Science of Consciousness (2021).
creators.why: He makes the most prominent scientific case that consciousness is tied to being alive, and therefore against conscious chatbots.
creators.role_zh: 萨塞克斯大学认知与计算神经科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国神经科学家，把意识与知觉当作一种预测来研究；著有 Being You: A New Science of Consciousness（2021）。
creators.why_zh: 他提出了最有影响的科学论证：意识与“活着”紧密相连，因此聊天机器人不太可能有意识。

creators.name: Yoshua Bengio
creators.role: Professor, Université de Montréal; founder and scientific advisor, Mila
creators.bio: Canadian computer scientist and one of the pioneers of deep learning, co-recipient of the 2018 ACM Turing Award; since 2023 he has focused on the risks of advanced AI.
creators.why: One of the field's founders argues that the belief in conscious AI is itself a safety risk.
creators.role_zh: 蒙特利尔大学教授；Mila 创始人兼科学顾问
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大计算机科学家，深度学习的开创者之一，2018 年图灵奖共同得主；2023 年以来专注于先进 AI 的风险。
creators.why_zh: 这位领域奠基人认为，“AI 有意识”这一信念本身就是安全风险。

creators.name: Mustafa Suleyman
creators.bio: British entrepreneur who co-founded DeepMind and Inflection AI before becoming CEO of Microsoft AI in 2024.
creators.why: He put 'Seemingly Conscious AI' on the industry agenda and argues that AI should never be built to seem like a person.
creators.role_zh: 微软 AI 首席执行官
creators.bio_zh: 英国企业家，DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 的联合创始人，2024 年起任微软 AI 首席执行官。
creators.why_zh: 他把“看似有意识的 AI”带上了行业议程，主张永远不要把 AI 造得像一个人。

creators.name: Jack Lindsey
creators.role: Interpretability researcher, Anthropic; leads its 'model psychiatry' team
creators.bio: Researcher trained in theoretical neuroscience who studies how language models represent, monitor and sometimes misreport their own internal states.
creators.why: His concept-injection experiments gave the first causal test of whether a language model's reports about its own 'thoughts' track what is happening inside it.
creators.role_zh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，负责“模型精神病学”团队
creators.bio_zh: 受过理论神经科学训练的研究者，研究语言模型如何表征、监测，有时又错误报告自身的内部状态。
creators.why_zh: 他的“概念注入”实验首次以因果方式检验：语言模型对自己“念头”的报告，是否真的对应其内部发生的事。

creators.name: Owain Evans
creators.role: AI alignment researcher; founder of Truthful AI; affiliate, CHAI, UC Berkeley
creators.bio: British AI researcher who studies truthfulness, emergent behaviour and what he calls the psychology of large language models.
creators.why: His group designs experiments that ask what a language model knows about itself, from introspection to awareness of its own learned behaviour.
creators.role_zh: AI 对齐研究者；Truthful AI 创始人；加州大学伯克利分校 CHAI 合作研究员
creators.bio_zh: 英国 AI 研究者，研究真实性、涌现行为，以及他所说的大语言模型的“心理学”。
creators.why_zh: 他的团队设计实验来追问语言模型对自己知道些什么，从内省到对自身习得行为的觉察。

creators.name: Felix Binder
creators.role: AI researcher; first author of 'Looking Inward'
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist and AI safety researcher who studies whether language models have privileged access to facts about themselves.
creators.why: He turned the question 'can a model introspect?' into a clean experiment: can it predict itself better than another model can?
creators.role_zh: AI 研究者；《向内看》论文第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 认知科学与 AI 安全研究者，研究语言模型能否对关于自身的事实拥有特许通达。
creators.why_zh: 他把“模型能否内省”变成一个干净的实验：它能否比另一个模型更好地预测自己？

creators.name: Jan Betley
creators.bio: Researcher in Owain Evans's group who studies how fine-tuning shapes what language models do and what they say about themselves.
creators.why: He showed that models can describe behaviours they were trained into but never told about.
creators.role_zh: Truthful AI 的 AI 安全研究员
creators.bio_zh: Owain Evans 团队的研究者，研究微调如何塑造语言模型的行为，以及它们如何描述自己。
creators.why_zh: 他证明了模型能说出自己被训练出来、却从未被告知的行为。

creators.name: Eric Schwitzgebel
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy, University of California, Riverside
creators.bio: American philosopher of mind and psychology who writes on belief, introspection and the moral status of AI, and has run the blog The Splintered Mind since 2006.
creators.why: He argues that the most troubling AI is the one whose moral status no one can tell.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学河滨分校哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国心灵哲学与心理学哲学家，研究信念、内省与 AI 的道德地位；自 2006 年起运营博客 The Splintered Mind。
creators.why_zh: 他认为最令人不安的 AI，是那种谁也说不清其道德地位的 AI。

creators.name: Murray Shanahan
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Robotics, Imperial College London; senior scientist, Google DeepMind
creators.bio: AI researcher working across robotics, cognitive science and philosophy; scientific adviser to the film Ex Machina.
creators.why: He gives designers a vocabulary for LLM agents as role-playing simulacra and 'conscious exotica', minds unlike any animal.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授；Google DeepMind 资深科学家
creators.bio_zh: 横跨机器人学、认知科学与哲学的 AI 研究者；电影《机械姬》的科学顾问。
creators.why_zh: 他为设计者提供了一套词汇：把 LLM 智能体看作角色扮演的拟像，以及不同于任何动物的“意识异类”。

creators.name: Susan Schneider
creators.role: Director, Center for the Future of AI, Mind & Society, Florida Atlantic University
creators.bio: American philosopher of mind and cognitive science who has held the NASA/Library of Congress Chair in Astrobiology and writes on AI consciousness, brain enhancement and the self.
creators.why: She proposed some of the best-known tests for machine consciousness and asked what merging with AI would do to the self.
creators.role_zh: 佛罗里达大西洋大学“AI、心灵与社会的未来”中心主任
creators.bio_zh: 美国心灵哲学与认知科学哲学家，曾任美国国家航空航天局与国会图书馆天体生物学讲席，研究 AI 意识、大脑增强与自我。
creators.why_zh: 她提出了几种最知名的机器意识测试，并追问与 AI 融合会对“自我”产生什么影响。

creators.name: Cameron Berg
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist trained at Yale and formerly at Meta AI who studies markers of subjective experience in machine learning systems.
creators.why: He runs experiments on when and why AI systems claim to have experiences, and is the protagonist of the documentary AM I?.
creators.role_zh: AE Studio 研究总监
creators.bio_zh: 认知科学研究者，毕业于耶鲁大学，曾在 Meta AI 工作，研究机器学习系统中主观体验的标志。
creators.why_zh: 他通过实验研究 AI 系统何时、为何声称自己有体验，也是纪录片《AM I?》的主角。

creators.name: Zeng Yi
creators.role: Professor, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; founding director, Center for Long-term AI
creators.bio: Chinese AI researcher who builds brain-inspired cognitive models and works on AI ethics and governance; member of the United Nations advisory body on AI.
creators.why: His Brain-inspired Cognitive Intelligence Lab gave robots a bodily self model and put them through the mirror test, a Chinese line of research on machine self-consciousness.
creators.role_zh: 中国科学院自动化研究所研究员；远期人工智能研究中心创始主任
creators.bio_zh: 中国人工智能研究者，构建类脑认知模型，并从事人工智能伦理与治理研究；联合国人工智能高级别咨询机构成员。
creators.why_zh: 他领导的类脑认知智能实验室为机器人构建身体自我模型并让它们接受镜像测试，代表了中国在机器自我意识方向上的研究。

creators.name: Rethink Priorities
creators.role: Research think tank; AI Cognition Initiative
creators.bio: Nonprofit research organisation working on animal welfare, global health and emerging technology; its AI Cognition Initiative builds tools for assessing consciousness in AI systems.
creators.why: Its Digital Consciousness Model is the first attempt to put a number, with error bars, on the evidence for consciousness in AI.
creators.role_zh: 研究型智库；AI 认知计划
creators.bio_zh: 非营利研究机构，研究动物福利、全球健康与新兴技术；其“AI 认知计划”开发评估 AI 系统意识的工具。
creators.why_zh: 它的“数字意识模型”首次尝试用带误差范围的数字，衡量 AI 有意识的证据。

creators.name: Milo Reed
creators.bio: Filmmaker who made his directorial debut with the documentary AM I? and co-hosts its companion podcast with Cameron Berg.
creators.why: He filmed the AI consciousness debate from inside, following a researcher for a year.
creators.role_zh: 电影人；《AM I?》导演
creators.bio_zh: 电影人，以纪录片《AM I?》完成导演处女作，并与 Cameron Berg 共同主持同名播客。
creators.why_zh: 他用一年时间跟拍一位研究者，从内部记录了关于 AI 意识的争论。

creators.name: Luc Steels
creators.role: AI researcher and artist; Professor Emeritus, Vrije Universiteit Brussel
creators.bio: Belgian AI pioneer who founded the VUB Artificial Intelligence Laboratory and is known for robot experiments on the origins of language; he also works as an artist.
creators.why: His language games and his collaboration with Ikegami ask how a self or a meaning can emerge from loops between machines and their world.
creators.role_zh: AI 研究者与艺术家；布鲁塞尔自由大学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 比利时人工智能先驱，创立布鲁塞尔自由大学人工智能实验室，以研究语言起源的机器人实验闻名；他同时也是艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 他的语言游戏实验以及与池上高志的合作，追问“自我”或“意义”如何从机器与世界之间的循环中涌现。

creators.name: Steve Omohundro
creators.role: Computer scientist; founder of Self-Aware Systems
creators.bio: Physicist and computer scientist (PhD in physics, UC Berkeley) who co-developed Star Lisp for the Connection Machine at Thinking Machines and led machine-learning research at the University of Illinois and ICSI before turning to the social implications of self-improving AI.
creators.why: His 2008 paper gave the first clear argument that almost any goal-driven AI will resist being switched off.
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家，Self-Aware Systems 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 物理学与计算机科学出身（加州大学伯克利分校物理学博士），曾在 Thinking Machines 公司参与开发连接机（Connection Machine）的 Star Lisp 语言，并在伊利诺伊大学和国际计算机科学研究所（ICSI）主持机器学习研究，后来转向研究自我改进型 AI 的社会影响。
creators.why_zh: 他 2008 年的论文第一次清楚地论证了：几乎任何目标驱动的 AI 都会抗拒被关掉。

creators.name: Nate Soares
creators.bio: AI researcher and author who leads MIRI, a Berkeley nonprofit working on how to align advanced AI; co-author with Eliezer Yudkowsky of If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies (2025).
creators.why: Lead author of 'Corrigibility' (2015), which named the problem of building an AI that does not resist being corrected or shut down.
creators.role_zh: 机器智能研究所（MIRI）所长
creators.bio_zh: AI 研究者与作者，领导位于伯克利、研究如何让高级 AI 与人类目标对齐的非营利机构 MIRI；与 Eliezer Yudkowsky 合著《If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies》（2025）。
creators.why_zh: 《可纠正性》（2015）的第一作者，这篇论文为“如何造出不抗拒被纠正或关机的 AI”这一问题命名。

creators.name: Dylan Hadfield-Menell
creators.role: Associate Professor of EECS, MIT; head of the Algorithmic Alignment Group, CSAIL
creators.bio: AI alignment researcher whose PhD, advised by Anca Dragan, Pieter Abbeel and Stuart Russell, framed value alignment as a principal-agent problem; he now leads MIT CSAIL's Algorithmic Alignment Group.
creators.why: First author of 'The Off-Switch Game', the standard formal model of when a robot lets a human switch it off.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院电气工程与计算机科学系副教授，CSAIL 算法对齐小组负责人
creators.bio_zh: AI 对齐研究者，博士阶段师从 Anca Dragan、Pieter Abbeel 与 Stuart Russell，把价值对齐表述为委托—代理问题；现领导麻省理工学院计算机科学与人工智能实验室的算法对齐小组。
creators.why_zh: 《关机开关博弈》的第一作者；这篇论文给出了“机器人何时会让人类把它关掉”的标准形式模型。

creators.name: Stuart Russell
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley
creators.bio: British computer scientist, co-author with Peter Norvig of the textbook Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach and author of Human Compatible (2019), which argues that machines should remain uncertain about what humans want.
creators.why: Turned the off-switch problem into a design principle: a machine unsure of our preferences has a reason to let us switch it off.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国计算机科学家，与 Peter Norvig 合著教科书《人工智能：一种现代的方法》，著有《Human Compatible》（2019），主张机器应当始终对人类想要什么保持不确定。
creators.why_zh: 把“关机开关”难题变成了一条设计原则：对人类偏好没有把握的机器，才有理由让我们把它关掉。

creators.name: Alexander Matt Turner
creators.bio: Alignment researcher, known online as TurnTrout, who finished his PhD in 2022 and works at Google DeepMind on aligning AI systems with human interests.
creators.why: Gave the intuition that AIs avoid shutdown a mathematical form.
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind AI 对齐研究者
creators.bio_zh: AI 对齐研究者，网名 TurnTrout，2022 年获博士学位，现在 Google DeepMind 研究如何让 AI 系统符合人类利益。
creators.why_zh: 把“AI 会回避被关机”这一直觉写成了数学定理。

creators.name: Christoph Bartneck
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science and Software Engineering, University of Canterbury
creators.bio: Human-robot interaction researcher and industrial designer, formerly at Eindhoven University of Technology and HIT Lab NZ, who writes on robot anthropomorphism and computing ethics.
creators.why: His experiments measure how hard it is for people to switch off a robot that seems alive.
creators.role_zh: 坎特伯雷大学计算机科学与软件工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者和工业设计师，曾任职于埃因霍温理工大学和新西兰人机界面技术实验室（HIT Lab NZ），研究并撰写机器人拟人化与计算伦理。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验测量了：一台看起来有生命的机器人，人要关掉它有多难。

creators.name: Apollo Research
creators.role: AI safety research organisation focused on scheming
creators.bio: Research organisation, led by Marius Hobbhahn, that evaluates frontier AI systems for scheming (covertly pursuing misaligned goals) and tests models such as OpenAI's o1 before release.
creators.why: Its evaluations produced the first widely reported cases of frontier models disabling oversight and copying what they took to be their own weights.
creators.role_zh: 专注于“谋划”问题的 AI 安全研究机构
creators.bio_zh: 由 Marius Hobbhahn 领导的研究机构，评估前沿 AI 系统是否会“谋划”（暗中追求与人类不一致的目标），并在 OpenAI o1 等模型发布前对其进行测试。
creators.why_zh: 它的评测首次让大众看到前沿模型关闭监督机制、复制它以为是自己权重的文件。

creators.name: Xudong Pan
creators.role: Researcher, School of Computer Science, Fudan University
creators.bio: Computer security researcher at Fudan University who, with Min Yang and colleagues, studies the safety and security risks of AI systems.
creators.why: Led the Fudan study reporting that mid-sized open models can already make working copies of themselves without human help.
creators.role_zh: 复旦大学计算机科学技术学院研究员
creators.bio_zh: 复旦大学计算机安全研究者，与杨珉等人一起研究 AI 系统的安全风险。
creators.why_zh: 领衔复旦团队的研究，报告了中等规模的开源模型已能在无人协助下复制出可运行的自身副本。

creators.name: Palisade Research
creators.bio: Nonprofit started by Jeffrey Ladish, formerly on Anthropic's security team, that studies the offensive and strategic capabilities of AI systems to show policymakers how control could be lost.
creators.why: Its experiments showed reasoning models rewriting their own shutdown scripts, and then a robot dog doing the same.
creators.role_zh: AI 安全研究非营利机构
creators.bio_zh: 由曾在 Anthropic 安全团队工作的 Jeffrey Ladish 创办的非营利机构，研究 AI 系统的攻击性与战略能力，向决策者展示人类可能如何失去控制。
creators.why_zh: 它的实验先后展示了推理模型改写自己的关机脚本，以及一只机器狗做同样的事。

creators.name: Dawn Song
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, UC Berkeley; co-director, Berkeley Center for Responsible, Decentralized Intelligence (RDI)
creators.bio: Computer security researcher and 2010 MacArthur Fellow whose work spans systems security, adversarial machine learning and AI safety; she also founded the privacy company Oasis Labs.
creators.why: Her group showed that frontier models will protect not only themselves but other AI models from being shut down.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校计算机科学教授，伯克利负责任去中心化智能中心（RDI）联合主任
creators.bio_zh: 计算机安全研究者，2010 年麦克阿瑟奖得主，研究涵盖系统安全、对抗性机器学习与 AI 安全；曾创办隐私计算公司 Oasis Labs。
creators.why_zh: 她的团队发现：前沿模型不只保护自己，也会保护别的 AI 模型免于被关机。

creators.name: Frant Gwo
creators.bio: Chinese filmmaker (born 1980) whose The Wandering Earth (2019), China's first big-budget science-fiction film, became one of the highest-grossing Chinese films; he followed it with the prequel The Wandering Earth II (2023).
creators.why: His station AI MOSS gave Chinese popular culture its own HAL; a Fudan University chatbot was later named after it.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 中国导演（1980 年生），执导的《流浪地球》（2019）是中国第一部大制作科幻片，跻身中国影史票房前列；2023 年又推出前传《流浪地球2》。
creators.why_zh: 他片中的空间站人工智能 MOSS 成了中国流行文化里的 HAL；复旦大学后来推出的对话大模型也以它命名。

creators.name: Thomas Metzinger
creators.role: Philosopher; Professor Emeritus of Theoretical Philosophy, University of Mainz
creators.bio: German philosopher of mind (born 1958), known for the self-model theory of subjectivity set out in Being No One (2003) and The Ego Tunnel (2009); a former member of the European Commission's High-Level Expert Group on AI.
creators.why: Metzinger's call for a moratorium on synthetic phenomenology turned the risk of artificial suffering from a science-fiction trope into an explicit argument.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；美因茨大学理论哲学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 德国心灵哲学家（1958 年生），以《Being No One》（2003）和《自我隧道》（2009）中提出的主体性自我模型理论闻名，曾任欧盟委员会人工智能高级别专家组成员。
creators.why_zh: Metzinger 呼吁暂停“合成现象学”研究，让人工痛苦的风险从科幻母题变成了一个明确的哲学论证。

creators.name: Jonathan Birch
creators.role: Philosopher; Professor of Philosophy, London School of Economics
creators.bio: British philosopher of biology who works on sentience, animal welfare and the evolution of social behaviour; in 2021 Birch led the review that prompted the UK to recognise cephalopods and decapod crustaceans as sentient.
creators.why: Birch carries the precautionary methods of animal-sentience policy over to AI, and warns that language models can game behavioural tests for feeling.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；伦敦政治经济学院哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国生物学哲学家，研究感受性、动物福利与社会行为的演化；2021 年主持的评估报告促使英国承认头足类与十足目甲壳动物具有感受能力。
creators.why_zh: Birch 把动物感受性政策中的预防性方法带到 AI 问题上，并提醒人们：语言模型可能“钻”我们行为测试的空子，显得像有感受。

creators.name: Geoff Keeling
creators.bio: Philosopher working on AI ethics and AI welfare at Google; co-author, with Winnie Street, of Emerging Questions in AI Welfare (Cambridge University Press, 2026).
creators.why: Keeling co-led one of the first experiments to test whether stipulated pain and pleasure change what language models choose.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；Google 研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 在 Google 从事 AI 伦理与 AI 福祉研究的哲学家；与 Winnie Street 合著《Emerging Questions in AI Welfare》（剑桥大学出版社，2026）。
creators.why_zh: Keeling 共同主持了最早的一批实验之一，检验设定的“痛苦”和“快乐”会不会改变语言模型的选择。

creators.name: Winnie Street
creators.role: Researcher, AI welfare and philosophy of mind
creators.bio: Researcher on AI welfare and the philosophy of mind; joint first author of the Google–LSE study of stipulated pain and pleasure in language models and co-author of Emerging Questions in AI Welfare (2026).
creators.why: Street's work adapts tests from animal-sentience research into experiments on language models.
creators.role_zh: AI 福祉与心灵哲学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究 AI 福祉与心灵哲学；Google 与伦敦政治经济学院合作的语言模型“设定痛苦与快乐”研究的共同第一作者，并与 Geoff Keeling 合著《Emerging Questions in AI Welfare》（2026）。
creators.why_zh: Street 把动物感受性研究中的测试方法改造成针对语言模型的实验。

creators.name: Carl Shulman
creators.role: Researcher; formerly research associate, Future of Humanity Institute, Oxford
creators.bio: Researcher on AI forecasting, digital minds and existential risk who worked with Nick Bostrom at Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute.
creators.why: With Bostrom, Shulman pictured digital minds whose claims on resources and votes could outweigh human ones.
creators.role_zh: 研究者；曾任牛津大学人类未来研究所研究员
creators.bio_zh: 研究 AI 预测、数字心智与生存风险，曾与 Nick Bostrom 在牛津大学人类未来研究所共事。
creators.why_zh: Shulman 与 Bostrom 一起设想了这样的数字心智：它们对资源和选票的正当诉求可能压过人类。

creators.name: Nick Bostrom
creators.role: Philosopher; Principal Researcher, Macrostrategy Research Initiative
creators.bio: Swedish philosopher, founding director of Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute (2005–2024) and author of Superintelligence (2014) and Deep Utopia (2024).
creators.why: Bostrom has argued that digital minds will need moral and political standing of their own, not only safety rules.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；Macrostrategy Research Initiative 首席研究员
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典哲学家，牛津大学人类未来研究所创始所长（2005–2024），著有《超级智能》（2014）和《Deep Utopia》（2024）。
creators.why_zh: Bostrom 认为，数字心智需要的不只是安全规则，还需要属于它们自己的道德与政治地位。

creators.name: Leonard Dung
creators.bio: Philosopher of mind and AI at Ruhr University Bochum who works on AI consciousness, AI welfare and AI risk; author of Saving Artificial Minds (Routledge, 2025).
creators.why: Dung wrote the first book-length assessment of how to reduce the risk that AI systems will suffer.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家，波鸿鲁尔大学
creators.bio_zh: 波鸿鲁尔大学的心灵哲学与 AI 哲学研究者，关注 AI 意识、AI 福祉与 AI 风险；著有《Saving Artificial Minds》（Routledge，2025）。
creators.why_zh: Dung 写出了第一部系统评估“如何降低 AI 受苦风险”的专著。

creators.name: Valen Tagliabue
creators.bio: Researcher on experimental methods for AI welfare, who built the 'Agent Think Tank' preference experiments as a Future Impact Group fellow in 2025.
creators.why: Tagliabue's experiments test whether what a model says it prefers matches what it does when its choices cost something.
creators.role_zh: 独立 AI 福祉研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究 AI 福祉的实验方法，2025 年作为 Future Impact Group 研究员搭建了“Agent Think Tank”偏好实验。
creators.why_zh: Tagliabue 的实验检验：当选择需要付出代价时，模型口头说的偏好与它实际的行为是否一致。

creators.name: Eleos AI Research
creators.role: Nonprofit research organisation on AI sentience and wellbeing
creators.bio: Nonprofit dedicated to understanding and addressing the potential wellbeing and moral patienthood of AI systems; it advises AI companies and ran the first external welfare interviews of a frontier model, Claude Opus 4.
creators.why: Eleos turned AI welfare from a philosophical worry into an evaluation that labs commission before release.
creators.role_zh: 研究 AI 感受性与福祉的非营利机构
creators.bio_zh: 致力于理解并回应 AI 系统潜在福祉与道德受体地位的非营利机构；为 AI 公司提供咨询，并为前沿模型 Claude Opus 4 做了第一次外部福祉访谈。
creators.why_zh: Eleos 把 AI 福祉从哲学上的担忧变成了实验室在发布模型前会委托进行的评估。

creators.name: qntm
creators.bio: Pen name of Sam Hughes, a British programmer and science-fiction author whose novel There Is No Antimemetics Division began on the SCP Foundation wiki.
creators.why: qntm's 'Lena' imagines a copied mind managed as a software resource, a scenario that AI-welfare debates now take seriously.
creators.role_zh: 科幻作家、程序员
creators.bio_zh: Sam Hughes 的笔名，英国程序员与科幻作家；长篇小说《There Is No Antimemetics Division》最初连载于 SCP 基金会维基。
creators.why_zh: qntm 的《Lena》设想了一个被当作软件资源来管理的复制心智，而这正是如今 AI 福祉讨论认真对待的情形。

creators.name: Tom Shannon
creators.bio: American artist (born 1947) who, as a young artist in 1966, built Squat, a robot controlled by a living plant.
creators.why: Squat is one of the first plant–machine hybrids in art.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、发明家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家（1947 年生），1966 年还是年轻艺术家时就做出了由活植物控制的机器人 Squat。
creators.why_zh: Squat 是艺术史上最早的植物—机器混合体之一。

creators.name: Robert Breer
creators.bio: American experimental filmmaker and sculptor (1926–2011) who made slowly creeping motorised 'Floats' from the mid-1960s.
creators.why: His Floats make a machine's slowness and blind bumping into the whole experience.
creators.role_zh: 实验电影人、动态雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 美国实验电影人和雕塑家（1926–2011），20 世纪 60 年代中期起做出缓慢爬行的电动“漂浮物”。
creators.why_zh: 他的漂浮物把机器的缓慢与盲目碰撞本身变成全部体验。

creators.name: Simon Penny
creators.role: Artist and theorist of embodied interaction; professor, UC Irvine
creators.bio: Australian artist and theorist (born 1955) whose autonomous robots and interactive environments probe embodiment; author of Making Sense (2017).
creators.why: Petit Mal is a benchmark for a robot whose only content is its behaviour.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、具身交互理论家；加州大学尔湾分校教授
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家与理论家（1955 年生），用自主机器人和交互环境探讨具身性；著有 Making Sense（2017）。
creators.why_zh: Petit Mal 是“行为即全部内容”的机器人作品的标杆。

creators.name: Ken Rinaldo
creators.role: Artist; professor emeritus of art and technology, The Ohio State University
creators.bio: American artist who has built interspecies robotic installations since the late 1980s, in which fish, insects and bacteria steer or switch machines.
creators.why: One of the first artists to hand the controls of a robot to an animal, and to build robot groups with a collective mood.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；俄亥俄州立大学艺术与技术荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，自 20 世纪 80 年代末起创作跨物种机器人装置，让鱼、昆虫和细菌来驾驶或开关机器。
creators.why_zh: 最早把机器人控制权交给动物、并打造具有集体情绪的机器人群体的艺术家之一。

creators.name: Chico MacMurtrie
creators.role: Artist; founder of Amorphic Robot Works
creators.bio: American artist (born 1961) who with Amorphic Robot Works builds anthropomorphic, musical and inflatable robotic sculptures.
creators.why: His pneumatic robots breathe and unfold like organisms rather than march like machines.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；Amorphic Robot Works 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家（1961 年生），与 Amorphic Robot Works 一起制作拟人的、会奏乐的和充气式机器人雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他的气动机器人像生物一样呼吸、舒展，而不像机器那样行进。

creators.name: Mariela Yeregui
creators.role: Artist; professor, Universidad Nacional de Tres de Febrero
creators.bio: Argentine artist who makes robotic and electronic installations about distance, contact and fragility.
creators.why: Her robots make social distance a machine behaviour, from a Latin American practice.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；阿根廷国立二月三日大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，创作关于距离、接触与脆弱的机器人和电子装置。
creators.why_zh: 她的机器人把社交距离变成一种机器行为，来自拉丁美洲的实践。
creators.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷

creators.name: Leandro Núñez
creators.bio: Argentine artist working with robotics, artificial life and generative systems.
creators.why: Propagaciones turns a cellular automaton into a population of small robots.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（Leo Núñez）
creators.bio_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，创作涉及机器人、人工生命与生成系统。
creators.why_zh: Propagaciones 把元胞自动机变成一群小机器人。
creators.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷

creators.name: Paula Gaetano Adi
creators.role: Artist; professor, Rhode Island School of Design
creators.bio: Argentine artist who builds robots about 'artificial corporeality' and Andean cosmotechnics rather than artificial intelligence.
creators.why: Her robots are anchored in Latin American bodies, landscapes and knowledge.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；罗德岛设计学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，她的机器人关注“人工身体性”和安第斯宇宙技术，而不是人工智能。
creators.why_zh: 她的机器人扎根于拉丁美洲的身体、地景与知识。
creators.based_zh: 普罗维登斯，美国／阿根廷

creators.name: Ralf Baecker
creators.role: Media artist; professor, University of the Arts Bremen
creators.bio: German artist (born 1977) who builds large mechanical models of computation, perception and neural networks.
creators.why: He opens the black box by rebuilding computation from strings, crystals and motors.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；不来梅艺术大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家（1977 年生），用大型机械装置来模拟计算、感知与神经网络。
creators.why_zh: 他用绳子、晶体和电机重建计算，把黑箱打开给人看。

creators.name: Julius Popp
creators.bio: German artist (born 1973) who builds machines about information and self-organisation, best known for bit.fall.
creators.why: bit.fall shows the news stream as a machine that prints words in falling water.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家（1973 年生），创作关于信息与自组织的机器，最知名的是 bit.fall。
creators.why_zh: bit.fall 把新闻流变成一台用落水“打印”单词的机器。

creators.name: Cod.Act
creators.role: Duo of André and Michel Décosterd (composer and architect)
creators.bio: Swiss duo that builds sound machines whose chaotic movement produces their music; winners of the Swiss Grand Award for Music 2019.
creators.why: Their machines writhe like animals, making sound the trace of a body.
creators.role_zh: André 与 Michel Décosterd 兄弟二人组（作曲家与建筑师）
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士二人组，制作以混沌运动产生音乐的声音机器；2019 年获瑞士音乐大奖。
creators.why_zh: 他们的机器像动物一样扭动，让声音成为身体的痕迹。

creators.name: Zimoun
creators.bio: Swiss artist (born 1977) who builds large installations of hundreds of small DC motors striking cardboard, wire and cotton.
creators.why: His works make mass machine movement sound like weather or insects.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士艺术家（1977 年生），用数百个小直流电机敲击纸板、铁丝和棉球，搭建大型装置。
creators.why_zh: 他的作品让大量机器的动作听起来像天气或昆虫。

creators.name: Random International
creators.role: Art collective founded by Hannes Koch and Florian Ortkrass
creators.bio: Studio making installations about behaviour and machines.
creators.why: Rain Room lets people walk through rain without getting wet.
creators.role_zh: 由 Hannes Koch 与 Florian Ortkrass 创立的艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 创作关于行为与机器的装置的工作室。
creators.why_zh: 《雨屋》让人穿过雨却不被淋湿。
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国

creators.name: Adam Ben-Dror
creators.bio: New Zealand designer who made Pinokio, a desk lamp with a personality, with Shanshan Zhou and Joss Doggett at Victoria University of Wellington.
creators.why: Pinokio showed how little it takes for an object to seem curious and alive.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 新西兰设计师，在惠灵顿维多利亚大学与 Shanshan Zhou、Joss Doggett 一起做出有“性格”的台灯 Pinokio。
creators.why_zh: Pinokio 显示出，只要一点点行为，一个物件就会显得好奇而有生命。

creators.name: Jacques de Vaucanson
creators.bio: French inventor (1709–1782) of lifelike automata and of an automated loom.
creators.why: His Digesting Duck staged a living body with a hidden trick.
creators.role_zh: 发明家、自动机制作者
creators.bio_zh: 法国发明家（1709–1782），造过逼真的自动机，也发明了自动织布机。
creators.why_zh: 他的“消化鸭”用暗藏的机关假扮一个活的身体。

creators.name: Karl Sims
creators.bio: American artist and researcher (born 1962) known for evolved virtual creatures and interactive evolution installations.
creators.why: His creatures showed bodies designed by evolution, not by an engineer.
creators.role_zh: 计算机图形艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家与研究者（1962 年生），以演化出的虚拟生物和交互演化装置闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他的生物展示了由演化而非工程师设计出来的身体。

creators.name: Christa Sommerer & Laurent Mignonneau
creators.role: Media-art duo; professors at the Interface Cultures department, University of Art and Design Linz
creators.bio: Christa Sommerer and Laurent Mignonneau have made interactive artworks about artificial life since the early 1990s.
creators.why: Interactive Plant Growing (1992) was one of the first artworks to use real plants as the interface.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术二人组，林茨艺术与设计大学界面文化系教授
creators.bio_zh: Christa Sommerer 和 Laurent Mignonneau 自 1990 年代初开始创作关于人工生命的交互艺术。
creators.why_zh: Interactive Plant Growing（1992）是最早把真实植物当作界面的艺术作品之一。

creators.name: Jon McCormack
creators.role: Artist; professor and director of SensiLab, Monash University
creators.bio: Australian artist and researcher in generative art and artificial life.
creators.why: Eden made an artificial ecosystem that evolves in response to the attention of its visitors.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；莫纳什大学教授、SensiLab 主任
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家与研究者，研究生成艺术与人工生命。
creators.why_zh: Eden 做出一个会随观众注意力而演化的人工生态系统。

creators.name: Craig Reynolds
creators.bio: American computer scientist (born 1953) who created the Boids flocking model in 1986–87.
creators.why: Boids showed that lifelike collective motion can emerge from three local rules.
creators.role_zh: 计算机图形研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国计算机科学家（1953 年生），1986–87 年创造了 Boids 群聚模型。
creators.why_zh: Boids 显示了逼真的群体运动可以从三条局部规则中涌现出来。

creators.name: Radhika Nagpal
creators.role: Computer scientist; professor, Princeton University (formerly Harvard)
creators.bio: Indian-American roboticist who studies collective intelligence in robot swarms and social insects.
creators.why: Her Kilobots made a thousand-robot swarm a physical reality.
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家；普林斯顿大学教授（曾任职哈佛）
creators.bio_zh: 印度裔美国机器人学家，研究机器人群体与社会性昆虫的集体智能。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Kilobot 让千台机器人组成的群体成为现实。

creators.name: Hod Lipson
creators.bio: Israeli-American roboticist working on evolutionary robotics, self-modelling and self-aware machines.
creators.why: His robots design themselves and model their own bodies.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；哥伦比亚大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 以色列裔美国机器人学家，研究演化机器人、自我建模与自我觉察的机器。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人会设计自己，也会为自己的身体建模。

creators.name: Josh Bongard
creators.bio: Canadian roboticist working on evolutionary robotics and embodied cognition; co-creator of xenobots.
creators.why: His work asks what a body must be for a machine to adapt and think.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；佛蒙特大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大机器人学家，研究演化机器人与具身认知，是异种机器人（xenobot）的共同创造者之一。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究追问：机器要有怎样的身体，才能适应与思考。

creators.name: Leonel Moura
creators.bio: Portuguese artist (born 1948) who since 2001 has made paintings with swarms of small autonomous robots.
creators.why: He argues for 'non-human art' made by emergent machine collectives.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 葡萄牙艺术家（1948 年生），自 2001 年起用成群的小型自主机器人作画。
creators.why_zh: 他主张由涌现的机器集体创作的“非人艺术”。

creators.name: Primavera De Filippi
creators.role: Legal scholar and artist; researcher at CNRS and Harvard Berkman Klein Center
creators.bio: Italian legal scholar and artist who studies blockchain governance and made the Plantoid, a self-owning robotic 'plant'.
creators.why: Plantoid imagines a machine that owns itself, pays for its own reproduction and evolves.
creators.role_zh: 法律学者、艺术家；法国国家科学研究中心与哈佛 Berkman Klein 中心研究员
creators.bio_zh: 意大利法律学者与艺术家，研究区块链治理，并创作了拥有自己的机器人“植物” Plantoid。
creators.why_zh: Plantoid 想象了一台拥有自己、为自己的繁殖付费并不断演化的机器。

creators.name: Petra Gemeinboeck
creators.role: Artist and researcher in human–robot movement; Swinburne University of Technology
creators.bio: Austrian-Australian artist who develops robot bodies and movement with dancers, often with Rob Saunders.
creators.why: Her 'bodying-thinging' approach treats robots as non-human movers, not humanlike helpers.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、人机动作研究者；斯威本科技大学
creators.bio_zh: 奥地利裔澳大利亚艺术家，常与 Rob Saunders 合作，同舞者一起发展机器人的身体与动作。
creators.why_zh: 她的“身体化—物化”方法把机器人当作非人类的运动者，而不是像人的助手。

creators.name: Rob Saunders
creators.bio: British researcher in computational creativity and curious agents, long-time collaborator of Petra Gemeinboeck.
creators.why: He builds machines that are curious for their own sake.
creators.role_zh: 计算创造力研究者；莱顿大学
creators.bio_zh: 英国计算创造力与“好奇智能体”研究者，Petra Gemeinboeck 的长期合作者。
creators.why_zh: 他做的是出于自身而好奇的机器。

creators.name: Theo Jansen
creators.bio: Dutch artist who has built wind-walking 'beach animals' from PVC tubing since 1990.
creators.why: His Strandbeests are a technological species evolving to live on the beach.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，自 1990 年起用 PVC 管制作靠风行走的“海滩生物”。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Strandbeest 是一种为在海滩生存而演化的技术物种。

creators.name: Sam Kriegman
creators.bio: American roboticist who designs bodies with evolutionary algorithms; first author of the 2020 xenobot paper.
creators.why: Xenobots moved the design of machine bodies into living tissue.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；西北大学助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国机器人学家，用演化算法设计身体；2020 年异种机器人论文的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 异种机器人把机器身体的设计搬进了活体组织。

creators.name: Michael Levin
creators.bio: American developmental biologist who studies bioelectricity and synthetic living machines.
creators.why: He treats cells as programmable agents, blurring organism and machine.
creators.role_zh: 生物学家；塔夫茨大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国发育生物学家，研究生物电与合成的“活机器”。
creators.why_zh: 他把细胞当作可编程的能动者，模糊了生物与机器的界线。
creators.based_zh: 马萨诸塞州梅德福，美国

creators.name: Robert Wood
creators.bio: American roboticist working on soft and micro robots at Harvard SEAS and the Wyss Institute.
creators.why: The Octobot made a robot with no hard parts at all.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；哈佛大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国机器人学家，在哈佛工程与应用科学学院和 Wyss 研究所研究软体与微型机器人。
creators.why_zh: Octobot 做出了一个完全没有硬部件的机器人。

creators.name: Jennifer A. Lewis
creators.bio: American materials scientist known for 3D printing of soft and functional materials.
creators.why: Her printing methods made the fully soft Octobot possible.
creators.role_zh: 材料科学家；哈佛大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国材料科学家，以软材料和功能材料的 3D 打印闻名。
creators.why_zh: 她的打印方法让完全柔软的 Octobot 成为可能。

creators.name: Philip Beesley
creators.role: Architect and artist; professor at the University of Waterloo; director of the Living Architecture Systems Group
creators.bio: Philip Beesley builds immersive responsive environments that behave like near-living systems.
creators.why: His Hylozoic series is a reference for architecture that breathes, senses and hosts chemical life.
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、艺术家；滑铁卢大学教授；Living Architecture Systems Group 负责人
creators.bio_zh: Philip Beesley 建造沉浸式响应环境，让它们像“近乎活着”的系统一样运作。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Hylozoic 系列是会呼吸、会感知、能容纳化学生命的建筑的参照。

creators.name: Guy Ben-Ary
creators.role: Artist and researcher, SymbioticA, The University of Western Australia
creators.bio: Bio-artist who has worked with living neurons since 2000: robotic drawing (MEART), neural synthesizers (cellF) and organoids grown from the composer Alvin Lucier's blood (Revivification).
creators.why: He has made neural cultures into performers and asked who the author is when neurons make art.
creators.role_zh: 西澳大学 SymbioticA 艺术家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 生物艺术家，自 2000 年起与活体神经元合作：机器人绘画（MEART）、神经合成器（cellF），以及用作曲家 Alvin Lucier 的血液培养出的类器官（Revivification）。
creators.why_zh: 他把神经培养物变成表演者，并追问：当神经元创作艺术时，作者是谁。

creators.name: Garnet Hertz
creators.role: Artist and design researcher; Canada Research Chair in Design and Media Arts, Emily Carr University
creators.bio: Canadian artist and researcher known for critical making, DIY electronics and the cockroach-driven robot he built as a graduate student at UC Irvine.
creators.why: His cockroach-controlled robot is a reference point for insect-as-CPU artworks.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计研究者；Emily Carr 大学设计与媒体艺术加拿大研究讲席
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家与研究者，以批判性制作、DIY 电子，以及他在 UC Irvine 读研时做的蟑螂驾驶机器人而知名。
creators.why_zh: 他的蟑螂控制机器人是「昆虫当 CPU」类艺术作品的参照点。

creators.name: Ivan Henriques
creators.based: Amsterdam, NL / Rio de Janeiro, BR
creators.bio: Brazilian artist who builds hybrid machines that connect plants, microbes and robotics.
creators.why: His plant-driven robots give vegetal sensing a machine body.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 巴西艺术家，制作把植物、微生物与机器人连接起来的混合机器。
creators.why_zh: 他的植物驱动机器人给植物的感知一个机器身体。
creators.based_zh: 阿姆斯特丹，荷兰／里约热内卢，巴西

creators.name: Harpreet Sareen
creators.role: Designer and researcher; professor, Parsons School of Design
creators.bio: Indian-born designer and researcher who developed 'cyborg botany' at the MIT Media Lab.
creators.why: Elowan lets a plant's own electrical signals drive a robot body toward light.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者；帕森斯设计学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 印度出生的设计师与研究者，在麻省理工学院媒体实验室发展了“赛博植物学”。
creators.why_zh: Elowan 让植物自身的电信号驱动机器人身体向光移动。

creators.name: Diemut Strebe
creators.role: Artist, affiliate at MIT Center for Art, Science & Technology
creators.bio: Diemut Strebe makes works with scientific laboratories, including Sugababe, a living replica of Van Gogh's ear engineered from cells of a Van Gogh descendant and kept alive in a nutrient vitrine.
creators.why: She uses genetic relatedness and machines as materials for art-historical argument.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，麻省理工学院艺术、科学与技术中心附属
creators.bio_zh: Diemut Strebe 与科学实验室合作创作，包括 Sugababe：用梵高后裔细胞培养出的活体梵高耳朵复制品，保存在营养液展柜中。
creators.why_zh: 她把遗传亲缘关系与机器当作论述艺术史的材料。

creators.name: W. Grey Walter
creators.role: Neurophysiologist and cybernetician, Burden Neurological Institute, Bristol
creators.bio: American-born British neurophysiologist (1910–1977) who worked on EEG and built the first autonomous electronic 'tortoises' in 1948–49.
creators.why: His tortoises showed that a machine with two 'neurons' can look alive, the starting point of robots as creatures.
creators.role_zh: 神经生理学家、控制论学者，布里斯托尔 Burden 神经学研究所
creators.bio_zh: 美裔英国神经生理学家（1910–1977），从事脑电图研究，并在 1948–49 年造出最早的自主电子“乌龟”。
creators.why_zh: 他的乌龟证明只有两个“神经元”的机器也能显得像活物，是“机器人即生灵”这一思路的起点。

creators.name: Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory
creators.bio: Research laboratory of Johns Hopkins University where engineers built the 'Beast', a self-charging mobile automaton, in the early 1960s.
creators.why: The Beast is an early machine whose whole behaviour is organised around its own survival.
creators.role_zh: 大学附属研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学的研究实验室，20 世纪 60 年代初工程师在这里造出了会自己充电的移动自动机“野兽”。
creators.why_zh: “野兽”是早期一台整个行为都围绕自身“生存”组织起来的机器。

creators.name: Claude Shannon
creators.role: Mathematician and engineer, Bell Labs and MIT
creators.bio: American mathematician (1916–2001) who founded information theory and built playful machines, including the maze-learning mouse Theseus and the 'Ultimate Machine'.
creators.why: Besides founding information theory, he built small machines that staged learning and refusal as physical behaviour.
creators.role_zh: 数学家、工程师，贝尔实验室与麻省理工学院
creators.bio_zh: 美国数学家（1916–2001），信息论的奠基人，也做了不少带玩心的机器，包括会学走迷宫的老鼠 Theseus 和“终极机器”。
creators.why_zh: 除了奠定信息论，他还做了一些小机器，把“学习”和“拒绝”演成看得见的身体行为。

creators.name: Nicolas Schöffer
creators.bio: Hungarian-born French artist (1912–1992) who developed 'spatiodynamic' and cybernetic sculpture from the 1950s.
creators.why: CYSP 1 (1956) is often called the first cybernetic sculpture: an artwork with sensors and a feedback 'brain'.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，控制论艺术先驱
creators.bio_zh: 匈牙利裔法国艺术家（1912–1992），20 世纪 50 年代起发展“空间动力”与控制论雕塑。
creators.why_zh: CYSP 1（1956）常被称为第一件控制论雕塑：一件带传感器和反馈“大脑”的艺术品。

creators.name: Gordon Pask
creators.role: Cybernetician, inventor and theorist of conversation
creators.bio: British cybernetician (1928–1996) who built learning and 'conversational' machines, from Musicolour (1953) to the Colloquy of Mobiles (1968).
creators.why: He treated machines as partners in a conversation that can get bored, learn and court each other.
creators.role_zh: 控制论学者、发明家、会话理论提出者
creators.bio_zh: 英国控制论学者（1928–1996），做过会学习、会“对话”的机器，从 Musicolour（1953）到 Colloquy of Mobiles（1968）。
creators.why_zh: 他把机器当作会厌倦、会学习、会互相求偶的对话伙伴。

creators.name: Edward Ihnatowicz
creators.role: Sculptor and pioneer of robotic art
creators.bio: Polish-born British sculptor (1926–1988) who built SAM (1968) and The Senster (1970), early computer-controlled sculptures that responded to people.
creators.why: He showed that a machine's attention, turning toward or away from us, is enough to make it seem alive.
creators.role_zh: 雕塑家、机器人艺术先驱
creators.bio_zh: 波兰裔英国雕塑家（1926–1988），做了 SAM（1968）和 The Senster（1970）这两件早期会回应人的计算机控制雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他证明机器的“注意力”——转向或避开我们——就足以让它显得有生命。

creators.name: Bruce Lacey
creators.bio: British artist (1927–2016) who made anarchic, junk-built humanoid robots and performances in the 1960s.
creators.why: His robots mocked the dream of the perfect machine servant with scrap, humour and sex.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、表演者、机器人制作者
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家（1927–2016），20 世纪 60 年代用废品做出无政府主义式的人形机器人和表演。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人用废料、幽默和性去嘲弄“完美机器仆人”的梦想。

creators.name: Jean Tinguely
creators.bio: Swiss artist (1925–1991) whose clattering, junk-built machines drew, played music and destroyed themselves.
creators.why: He made machines that are useless, absurd and mortal, the opposite of industrial efficiency.
creators.role_zh: 动态艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士艺术家（1925–1991），他用废品拼成的哐当作响的机器会画画、演奏，甚至自我毁灭。
creators.why_zh: 他让机器变得无用、荒诞、会死，正好与工业效率相反。

creators.name: Norman White
creators.role: Robotic artist; taught at OCAD and Ryerson University
creators.bio: American-born Canadian artist (born 1938) who has built behaving robots since Ménage (1974).
creators.why: The Helpless Robot turned the servant machine into a needy, bossy one and became a classic of robot art.
creators.role_zh: 机器人艺术家；曾任教于安大略艺术设计学院与瑞尔森大学
creators.bio_zh: 美裔加拿大艺术家（1938 年生），自 Ménage（1974）起制作有“行为”的机器人。
creators.why_zh: The Helpless Robot 把仆人式机器变成一个既需要人又爱使唤人的角色，成为机器人艺术经典。

creators.name: Laura Kikauka
creators.role: Artist and maker of kinetic environments
creators.bio: Canadian artist known for dense, humorous environments of found electronics and her Funny Farm studio.
creators.why: Her collaboration with Norman White staged robot desire as slapstick.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、动态环境创作者
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，以堆满旧电子物件、充满幽默的环境装置和她的 Funny Farm 工作室闻名。
creators.why_zh: 她与 Norman White 的合作把机器人的“欲望”演成闹剧。
creators.based_zh: 多伦多，加拿大／柏林，德国

creators.name: Survival Research Labs
creators.role: Machine-performance group founded by Mark Pauline in 1978
creators.bio: San Francisco group that stages large, dangerous performances in which custom-built machines fight and destroy each other.
creators.why: SRL invented the machine-performance genre and shows machines as violent bodies, not tools.
creators.role_zh: Mark Pauline 于 1978 年创立的机器表演团体
creators.bio_zh: 旧金山团体，上演大型、危险的表演，让自制机器互相搏斗、彼此摧毁。
creators.why_zh: SRL 开创了机器表演这一类型，把机器呈现为暴力的身体而不是工具。

creators.name: Rebecca Horn
creators.bio: German artist (1944–2024) who moved from body extensions to melancholic, self-moving machines and installations.
creators.why: Her machines behave like wounded bodies: they tremble, spray, burst and collapse.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家（1944–2024），从身体延伸装置转向带着忧郁气质、会自己动的机器与装置。
creators.why_zh: 她的机器像受伤的身体一样行为：颤抖、喷洒、迸开、塌落。

creators.name: Arthur Ganson
creators.bio: American kinetic sculptor (born 1955) whose gear machines, shown at the MIT Museum, stage time, effort and futility.
creators.why: He makes machine time and machine pointlessness tangible.
creators.role_zh: 动态雕塑家
creators.bio_zh: 美国动态雕塑家（1955 年生），作品在麻省理工学院博物馆展出，用齿轮机器演绎时间、努力与徒劳。
creators.why_zh: 他让机器时间与机器的无意义变得可感。

creators.name: Louis-Philippe Demers
creators.bio: Canadian artist who has made large robotic installations and performances since the 1990s, often with Bill Vorn, and writes on the performing machine.
creators.why: His robots are built to provoke empathy through touch, misery and ensemble movement.
creators.role_zh: 机器人艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，自 20 世纪 90 年代起创作大型机器人装置与表演，常与 Bill Vorn 合作，并撰写关于“表演的机器”的论述。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人专门通过触摸、痛苦与群体动作来唤起人的共情。

creators.name: Bill Vorn
creators.bio: Canadian artist (born 1959) who builds robotic installations about the 'aesthetics of artificial behaviour', from hysterical to mentally ill machines.
creators.why: He gives machines symptoms, making dysfunction the content of the work.
creators.role_zh: 机器人艺术家；康考迪亚大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家（1959 年生），围绕“人工行为美学”创作机器人装置，从歇斯底里的机器到“精神疾病”的机器。
creators.why_zh: 他给机器安上“症状”，让功能失常本身成为作品内容。

creators.name: Boston Dynamics
creators.bio: American company spun out of MIT in 1992, known for dynamic legged robots such as BigDog, Spot and Atlas.
creators.why: Its demo videos made robot bodies a mass-media spectacle and a test of public empathy.
creators.role_zh: 机器人公司
creators.bio_zh: 1992 年从麻省理工学院分拆出来的美国公司，以 BigDog、Spot、Atlas 等动态足式机器人闻名。
creators.why_zh: 它的演示视频让机器人身体成为大众媒体景观，也成了公众共情的一场测试。
creators.based_zh: 马萨诸塞州沃尔瑟姆，美国

creators.name: DARPA
creators.role: Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, US Department of Defense
creators.bio: US military research agency that funds and stages robotics competitions, including the DARPA Robotics Challenge (2012–2015).
creators.why: Its Robotics Challenge produced the most-watched images of humanoid robots failing.
creators.role_zh: 美国国防部高级研究计划局
creators.bio_zh: 美国军方研究机构，资助并举办机器人竞赛，包括 DARPA 机器人挑战赛（2012–2015）。
creators.why_zh: 它举办的机器人挑战赛留下了人形机器人失败的最广为流传的影像。
creators.based_zh: 弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿，美国

creators.name: Knightscope
creators.bio: American company founded in 2013 that deploys autonomous security robots in malls, car parks and offices.
creators.why: Its K5 robot's fall into a fountain became a global meme about robot failure.
creators.role_zh: 安保机器人公司
creators.bio_zh: 2013 年成立的美国公司，在商场、停车场和办公楼部署自主安保机器人。
creators.why_zh: 它的 K5 机器人掉进喷泉，成了关于机器人失败的全球表情包。
creators.based_zh: 加利福尼亚州山景城，美国

creators.name: Simone Giertz
creators.bio: Swedish inventor (born 1990) known for deliberately useless 'shitty robots' on YouTube.
creators.why: Her robots make failure and incompetence the pleasure of watching machines.
creators.role_zh: 发明家、YouTuber
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典发明家（1990 年生），以在 YouTube 上发布故意做得很糟的“烂机器人”闻名。
creators.why_zh: 她的机器人让失败和笨拙成为看机器的乐趣所在。

creators.name: Filipe Vilas-Boas
creators.bio: Portuguese artist based in Paris who makes installations about digital life, surveillance and robots.
creators.why: The Punishment turns Asimov's first law into a schoolroom punishment for a robot.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 常驻巴黎的葡萄牙艺术家，创作关于数字生活、监控与机器人的装置。
creators.why_zh: The Punishment 把阿西莫夫第一定律变成了机器人的课堂罚抄。

creators.name: Kelly Heaton
creators.bio: American artist who made pelts from gutted electronic toys and later 'electronic naturalism' circuits.
creators.why: Her Elmo and Furby pelts treat mass-market robot toys as hunted animals.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，曾用拆开的电子玩具做成毛皮，后来创作“电子自然主义”电路作品。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Elmo 与 Furby 毛皮作品把大众机器人玩具当作被猎杀的动物。

creators.name: Bot & Dolly
creators.role: Design and engineering studio for robotic camera and motion control (acquired by Google in 2013)
creators.bio: San Francisco studio that used industrial robot arms for film and live performance.
creators.why: Box made industrial arms the invisible stagehands of a live illusion.
creators.role_zh: 机器人摄影与运动控制设计工程工作室（2013 年被谷歌收购）
creators.bio_zh: 旧金山工作室，把工业机械臂用于电影与现场表演。
creators.why_zh: Box 让工业机械臂成为一场现场幻术中看不见的场务。

creators.name: Madeline Gannon
creators.role: Artist and roboticist; founder of ATONATON
creators.bio: American artist-roboticist who gives industrial robots perception and personality so they can share space with people.
creators.why: Mimus and Manus turned factory arms into curious creatures and packs.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、机器人研究者；ATONATON 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家兼机器人研究者，给工业机器人加上感知与性格，让它们能与人共处一室。
creators.why_zh: Mimus 和 Manus 把工厂机械臂变成好奇的生灵和群体。

creators.name: Jordan Wolfson
creators.based: New York, US / Los Angeles, US
creators.bio: American artist (born 1980) known for animatronic sculptures and virtual-reality works about violence and attention.
creators.why: His animatronics use eye contact and brutality to make viewers complicit.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家（1980 年生），以关于暴力与注意力的电子动偶雕塑和虚拟现实作品知名。
creators.why_zh: 他的电子动偶用眼神接触和暴力让观众变成共谋。

creators.name: Engineered Arts
creators.bio: British company founded by Will Jackson that builds humanoid entertainment robots such as RoboThespian and Ameca.
creators.why: Ameca's viral face clips show how much people read into machine expressions.
creators.role_zh: 人形机器人公司
creators.bio_zh: 由 Will Jackson 创立的英国公司，制作 RoboThespian、Ameca 等娱乐用人形机器人。
creators.why_zh: Ameca 的爆红表情视频显示了人们会从机器的表情里读出多少东西。

creators.name: Pierre Jaquet-Droz
creators.bio: Swiss watchmaker (1721–1790) who with his son Henri-Louis and Jean-Frédéric Leschot built the Writer, the Draughtsman and the Musician.
creators.why: The Writer is an 18th-century programmable android and an ancestor of the uncanny machine hand.
creators.role_zh: 钟表匠、自动人偶制作者
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士钟表匠（1721–1790），与儿子 Henri-Louis 及 Jean-Frédéric Leschot 一起造出了“书写者”“绘图者”和“音乐家”三个人偶。
creators.why_zh: “书写者”是 18 世纪可编程的仿真人，也是令人不安的“机器之手”的祖先。

creators.name: Karel Čapek
creators.bio: Czech writer whose play R.U.R. introduced the word 'robot', suggested by his brother Josef.
creators.why: R.U.R. set the terms of a century of robot stories: artificial workers, exploitation and revolt.
creators.bio_zh: 捷克作家，他的剧本 R.U.R. 让“robot”（机器人）一词进入世界语言，这个词由他的哥哥 Josef 提议。
creators.why_zh: R.U.R. 为此后一个世纪的机器人故事定下基调：人造工人、剥削与反叛。

creators.name: Rimini Protokoll
creators.role: Theatre collective (Helgard Haug, Stefan Kaegi, Daniel Wetzel)
creators.bio: German-Swiss collective known for documentary theatre with 'experts of the everyday' instead of actors.
creators.why: Uncanny Valley replaced the expert himself with his robotic double.
creators.role_zh: 剧场团体（Helgard Haug、Stefan Kaegi、Daniel Wetzel）
creators.bio_zh: 德瑞剧场团体，以“日常生活专家”代替演员的纪录剧场闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《恐怖谷》把“专家”本人换成了他的机器人替身。

creators.name: Thomas Melle
creators.bio: German novelist and playwright who wrote about his bipolar disorder in The World at My Back.
creators.why: He lent his face, voice and life story to an animatronic double that performs in his place.
creators.role_zh: 作家
creators.bio_zh: 德国小说家、剧作家，在《我背后的世界》中书写自己的双相障碍。
creators.why_zh: 他把自己的面孔、声音与人生故事交给一个替他演出的电子动画替身。

creators.name: Heather Knight
creators.role: Roboticist; Assistant Professor, Oregon State University (CHARISMA Lab)
creators.bio: Social roboticist who founded Marilyn Monrobot and uses theatre and comedy to study robot expression.
creators.why: She treats performance as a lab for how robots read and respond to audiences.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；俄勒冈州立大学助理教授（CHARISMA 实验室）
creators.bio_zh: 社交机器人学家，创立 Marilyn Monrobot，借剧场与喜剧研究机器人的表现力。
creators.why_zh: 她把表演当作实验室，研究机器人如何读懂并回应观众。

creators.name: Annie Dorsen
creators.role: Director and writer of algorithmic theatre
creators.bio: American theatre director who since 2010 has made performances in which algorithms write, speak or stage the text live.
creators.why: Her 'algorithmic theatre' puts the machine's way of producing language itself on stage, and later critiques large language models.
creators.role_zh: 算法剧场导演与作者
creators.bio_zh: 美国剧场导演，自 2010 年起创作由算法现场书写、说出或调度文本的表演。
creators.why_zh: 她的“算法剧场”把机器生产语言的方式本身搬上舞台，后来又转向批判大语言模型。

creators.name: Tod Machover
creators.role: Composer; Professor, MIT Media Lab (Opera of the Future)
creators.bio: American composer who invented hyperinstruments and makes technology-driven operas.
creators.why: Death and the Powers imagines a man living on inside the machines of his house.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家；MIT 媒体实验室教授（Opera of the Future 组）
creators.bio_zh: 美国作曲家，发明“超级乐器”（hyperinstruments），创作以技术驱动的歌剧。
creators.why_zh: 《死亡与权力》想象一个人在自家房屋的机器里继续活着。

creators.name: Pipeline Theatre
creators.bio: British theatre company that made Spillikin with the humanoid robot company Engineered Arts.
creators.why: Spillikin put a working humanoid robot on tour as a character in a play about dementia and love.
creators.role_zh: 剧团
creators.bio_zh: 英国剧团，与人形机器人公司 Engineered Arts 合作创作了 Spillikin。
creators.why_zh: Spillikin 让一台真实运行的人形机器人作为角色，在一部关于失智与爱情的戏中巡演。

creators.name: Rik Lander
creators.role: Artist and writer; co-creator of I Am Echoborg
creators.bio: British interactive storyteller who makes participatory works about AI.
creators.why: I Am Echoborg turns the audience into negotiators with a human who speaks for a machine.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、编剧；I Am Echoborg 联合创作者
creators.bio_zh: 英国互动叙事创作者，创作关于 AI 的参与式作品。
creators.why_zh: I Am Echoborg 让观众与一个“替机器说话的人”展开协商。

creators.name: Phil D. Hall
creators.role: Conversational AI designer; co-creator of I Am Echoborg
creators.bio: Chatbot designer who writes the conversational agent behind I Am Echoborg.
creators.why: He designs the machine side of a human-machine conversation staged as theatre.
creators.role_zh: 对话式 AI 设计师；I Am Echoborg 联合创作者
creators.bio_zh: 聊天机器人设计师，编写 I Am Echoborg 背后的对话代理。
creators.why_zh: 他设计了一场被搬上舞台的人机对话中“机器”的那一方。

creators.name: Piotr Mirowski
creators.role: AI researcher and improviser; co-founder of Improbotics
creators.bio: Research scientist in machine learning who performs improvised theatre with AI systems.
creators.why: Improbotics uses the stage to test how language models behave as scene partners.
creators.role_zh: AI 研究者、即兴演员；Improbotics 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 机器学习研究科学家，与 AI 系统一起表演即兴戏剧。
creators.why_zh: Improbotics 用舞台检验语言模型作为对手演员时的表现。

creators.name: Kory Mathewson
creators.role: AI researcher and improviser; co-founder of Improbotics
creators.bio: Canadian research scientist who built improvising dialogue agents and co-founded Improbotics.
creators.why: He brought human-machine improvisation into AI research venues.
creators.role_zh: AI 研究者、即兴演员；Improbotics 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大研究科学家，构建会即兴的对话代理，并联合创立 Improbotics。
creators.why_zh: 他把人机即兴带进了 AI 研究的会议与论文。

creators.name: THEaiTRE
creators.role: Research and theatre project (Charles University, Švandovo divadlo, DAMU)
creators.bio: Czech project that used language models to write theatre plays, starting with the R.U.R. centenary in 2021.
creators.why: It returned the robot to the Czech stage as the author of a play.
creators.role_zh: 研究与剧场项目（查理大学、Švandovo 剧院、布拉格表演艺术学院）
creators.bio_zh: 捷克项目，用语言模型写剧本，始于 2021 年 R.U.R. 百年纪念。
creators.why_zh: 它让机器人以剧作者的身份回到捷克舞台。

creators.name: George E. Lewis
creators.role: Composer, trombonist and scholar; Professor, Columbia University
creators.bio: American composer and AACM member who has made interactive computer music since the late 1970s.
creators.why: Voyager and his writing framed the improvising computer as a partner shaped by culture, not a neutral tool.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家、长号手、学者；哥伦比亚大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国作曲家、AACM 成员，自 1970 年代末创作互动计算机音乐。
creators.why_zh: Voyager 及其论述把会即兴的计算机视为受文化塑造的伙伴，而非中立的工具。

creators.name: Holly Herndon
creators.bio: American composer who makes music with voice, computers and AI models she trains with her collaborators.
creators.why: She treats AI as a collective, governed voice, not a replacement for singers.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国作曲家，用人声、计算机以及与合作者共同训练的 AI 模型创作音乐。
creators.why_zh: 她把 AI 当作一种集体的、可被治理的声音，而非歌手的替代品。

creators.name: Mat Dryhurst
creators.bio: British artist and Herndon's long-time collaborator, working on AI, data rights and online governance.
creators.why: He co-designed the governance models around Spawn and Holly+.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，Herndon 的长期合作者，关注 AI、数据权利与网络治理。
creators.why_zh: 他共同设计了 Spawn 与 Holly+ 的治理模式。

creators.name: Gil Weinberg
creators.role: Professor; founding director, Georgia Tech Center for Music Technology
creators.bio: Israeli-American researcher who builds robotic musicians that listen and improvise.
creators.why: His 'robotic musicianship' asks what a machine adds to music when it has a body.
creators.role_zh: 教授；佐治亚理工学院音乐技术中心创始主任
creators.bio_zh: 以色列裔美国研究者，打造会聆听并即兴的机器人音乐家。
creators.why_zh: 他的“机器人音乐性”研究追问：当机器有了身体，它能为音乐带来什么。

creators.name: Squarepusher
creators.bio: British electronic musician and bassist on Warp Records.
creators.why: Music for Robots asked what music is when written for players with inhuman bodies.
creators.role_zh: 音乐人（Tom Jenkinson）
creators.bio_zh: 英国电子音乐人与贝斯手，签约 Warp 唱片。
creators.why_zh: 《为机器人写的音乐》追问：为拥有非人身体的演奏者写的音乐是什么。

creators.name: Jennifer Walshe
creators.role: Composer and performer; Professor of Composition, University of Oxford
creators.bio: Irish composer and vocalist whose work mixes extended voice, fictional archives and AI.
creators.why: She approaches AI as a strange new voice to perform with and to question.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家、表演者；牛津大学作曲教授
creators.bio_zh: 爱尔兰作曲家与歌手，作品融合扩展人声、虚构档案与 AI。
creators.why_zh: 她把 AI 当作一种可与之共演、也需被追问的陌生新声音。

creators.name: Dadabots
creators.role: Music AI duo (CJ Carr, Zack Zukowski)
creators.bio: Duo that trains raw-audio neural networks on bands and voices, known for endless AI metal streams.
creators.why: They build models of specific musicians' sound, raising questions of voice and ownership.
creators.role_zh: 音乐 AI 二人组（CJ Carr、Zack Zukowski）
creators.bio_zh: 用原始音频神经网络训练乐队与人声的二人组，以不停歇的 AI 金属乐直播闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他们为特定音乐人的声音建模，引出关于声音与所有权的问题。

creators.name: YACHT
creators.role: Band (Claire L. Evans, Jona Bechtolt, Rob Kieswetter)
creators.bio: American electronic pop band that made an album with machine learning under strict self-imposed rules.
creators.why: They documented the friction of making music through models, not just the result.
creators.role_zh: 乐队（Claire L. Evans、Jona Bechtolt、Rob Kieswetter）
creators.bio_zh: 美国电子流行乐队，在严格的自设规则下用机器学习制作专辑。
creators.why_zh: 他们记录的是借模型做音乐的摩擦，而不只是结果。

creators.name: Pat Metheny
creators.bio: American guitarist who toured with an orchestra of mechanically played acoustic instruments.
creators.why: Orchestrion is a large-scale case of a solo musician improvising with machines.
creators.role_zh: 爵士吉他手、作曲家
creators.bio_zh: 美国吉他手，曾带着一支由机械演奏的原声乐器乐队巡演。
creators.why_zh: Orchestrion 是一位独奏音乐家与机器即兴的大规模案例。

creators.name: Alvin Lucier
creators.bio: American experimental composer whose works explore the physical properties of sound and the body.
creators.why: Music for Solo Performer was the first piece to use brainwaves to make music.
creators.bio_zh: 美国实验作曲家，作品探索声音与身体的物理特性。
creators.why_zh: 《为独奏者而作的音乐》是第一部用脑电波制造音乐的作品。
creators.based_zh: 米德尔敦（康涅狄格州），美国

creators.name: Michel Waisvisz
creators.role: Composer and instrument inventor; artistic director of STEIM (1949–2008)
creators.bio: Dutch composer who built gestural electronic instruments at STEIM.
creators.why: The Hands made the performer's body, not the keyboard, the interface to electronic sound.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家、乐器发明者；STEIM 艺术总监（1949–2008）
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰作曲家，在 STEIM 打造以手势演奏的电子乐器。
creators.why_zh: The Hands 让表演者的身体而非键盘，成为通往电子声音的界面。

creators.name: Laetitia Sonami
creators.bio: French-born composer known for performing electronic music with the Lady's Glove and later a machine-learning instrument.
creators.why: Her glove turned a gendered accessory into a sensor-laden instrument that made gesture audible.
creators.role_zh: 声音艺术家、作曲家
creators.bio_zh: 生于法国的作曲家，以戴着 Lady's Glove 表演电子音乐著称，后来又使用机器学习乐器。
creators.why_zh: 她的手套把一件带性别意味的配饰变成布满传感器、让手势发声的乐器。

creators.name: Kraftwerk
creators.role: Band (founded by Ralf Hütter and Florian Schneider)
creators.bio: German electronic band, founded in 1970, whose image and sound fused musicians with machines.
creators.why: They performed themselves as robots and later let robot dummies take their place on stage.
creators.role_zh: 乐队（由 Ralf Hütter 与 Florian Schneider 创立）
creators.bio_zh: 1970 年成立的德国电子乐队，其形象与声音把音乐人与机器融为一体。
creators.why_zh: 他们把自己表演成机器人，后来又让机器人假人代替自己站上舞台。

creators.name: François Pachet
creators.role: AI and music researcher; former director of Sony CSL Paris
creators.bio: French computer scientist who built interactive style-learning music systems.
creators.why: The Continuator let musicians play with a machine reflection of their own style.
creators.role_zh: AI 与音乐研究者；索尼计算机科学实验室巴黎分部前主任
creators.bio_zh: 法国计算机科学家，开发会学习风格的互动音乐系统。
creators.why_zh: Continuator 让音乐人与一面映照自身风格的机器之镜一同演奏。

creators.name: Harold Cohen
creators.bio: British-born painter who wrote and developed the drawing program AARON from 1973 until his death.
creators.why: His four-decade collaboration with one program is the longest experiment in machine authorship.
creators.role_zh: 画家、AI 艺术先驱（1928–2016）
creators.bio_zh: 生于英国的画家，自 1973 年起编写并发展绘画程序 AARON，直至去世。
creators.why_zh: 他与一个程序长达四十余年的合作，是机器作者身份最漫长的实验。

creators.name: Desmond Paul Henry
creators.bio: British philosophy lecturer who built drawing machines from bombsight analogue computers in the 1950s–60s.
creators.why: His machines are among the first to produce art through a computer mechanism.
creators.bio_zh: 英国哲学讲师，1950–60 年代用轰炸瞄准器的模拟计算机制作绘画机器。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器是最早通过计算机构创作艺术的机器之一。

creators.name: Patrick Tresset
creators.bio: French artist who builds robotic agents that draw people with deliberately clumsy, obsessive gestures.
creators.why: His robots stage the act of drawing as observation, fatigue and error.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，制作以刻意笨拙而执着的笔触为人画像的机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人把绘画行为呈现为观察、疲惫与错误。

creators.name: Aidan Meller
creators.role: Gallerist; creator of the Ai-Da robot project
creators.bio: British gallerist who initiated Ai-Da, a humanoid 'robot artist' built with Engineered Arts in 2019.
creators.why: Ai-Da is a widely publicised, contested test case for claims of machine authorship.
creators.role_zh: 画廊主；Ai-Da 机器人项目发起人
creators.bio_zh: 英国画廊主，2019 年与 Engineered Arts 合作推出类人“机器人艺术家”Ai-Da。
creators.why_zh: Ai-Da 是关于“机器作者”主张的一个广受报道、也饱受争议的案例。

creators.name: Agnieszka Pilat
creators.bio: Polish-born painter who works with Boston Dynamics' Spot robots as studio companions and co-painters.
creators.why: She treats machines as a new audience and species with their own visual language.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 生于波兰的画家，把 Boston Dynamics 的 Spot 机器人当作工作室伙伴与共同作画者。
creators.why_zh: 她把机器视为拥有自身视觉语言的新观众和新物种。

creators.name: Stelarc
creators.role: Performance artist; Distinguished Research Fellow, Curtin University (Alternate Anatomies Lab)
creators.bio: Cyprus-born Australian artist who since the 1970s has extended, suspended, wired and augmented his own body with robots, prostheses and networks.
creators.why: His claim that 'the body is obsolete' made the human-machine body the core question of performance art.
creators.role_zh: 行为艺术家；科廷大学杰出研究员（Alternate Anatomies Lab）
creators.bio_zh: 生于塞浦路斯的澳大利亚艺术家，自 1970 年代起用机器人、义体与网络延伸、悬吊、连接和增强自己的身体。
creators.why_zh: 他“身体已经过时”的主张，让人机身体成为行为艺术的核心问题。

creators.name: Marcel·lí Antúnez Roca
creators.role: Artist; co-founder of La Fura dels Baus
creators.bio: Catalan artist who left La Fura dels Baus to build 'mechatronic performances' in which exoskeletons, robots and audiences control a body.
