creators.why: His Epizoo handed the artist's body to the audience's mouse clicks, an early and brutal image of networked control.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；La Fura dels Baus 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加泰罗尼亚艺术家，离开 La Fura dels Baus 后创作“机电表演”，让外骨骼、机器人与观众共同操控身体。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Epizoo 把艺术家的身体交给观众的鼠标点击，是网络化操控早期而残酷的图像。

creators.name: Neil Harbisson
creators.role: Cyborg artist; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation and Cyborg Arts
creators.bio: Artist born with achromatopsia who hears colour through an antenna implanted in his skull.
creators.why: He treats a machine sense as part of his body and identity, and campaigned to be photographed with it on his passport.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家；Cyborg Foundation 与 Cyborg Arts 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 天生全色盲的艺术家，通过植入颅骨的天线“听见”颜色。
creators.why_zh: 他把机器感官视为身体与身份的一部分，并争取让护照照片带上这根天线。

creators.name: Moon Ribas
creators.role: Cyborg artist and choreographer; co-founder of the Cyborg Foundation
creators.bio: Dancer who feels earthquakes worldwide through online seismic sensors implanted in her body.
creators.why: She turns a networked implant into choreography, dancing with the planet's movement.
creators.role_zh: 赛博格艺术家、编舞家；Cyborg Foundation 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 舞者，通过植入体内、连接在线地震数据的传感器感受全球地震。
creators.why_zh: 她把联网植入物变成编舞，与地球的运动共舞。

creators.name: Marco Donnarumma
creators.bio: Italian artist who fuses body, sound and AI-driven prostheses in performances about ritual, disability and machine autonomy.
creators.why: His AI prostheses are not tools but unruly co-performers that act on the body.
creators.role_zh: 行为艺术家、作曲家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家，在表演中把身体、声音与 AI 驱动的义体融合，探讨仪式、残障与机器自主。
creators.why_zh: 他的 AI 义体不是工具，而是会反过来作用于身体、难以驯服的共演者。

creators.name: Margherita Pevere
creators.role: Artist and researcher in biological art
creators.bio: Italian artist working with living bacteria, fungi and biomaterials, and with bodies in transformation.
creators.why: She brings living matter into human-machine performance, making hybrid bodies more than mechanical.
creators.role_zh: 生物艺术艺术家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家，以活体细菌、真菌与生物材料以及变化中的身体为创作对象。
creators.why_zh: 她把活体物质带入人机表演，让混成身体不只是机械的。

creators.name: Eduardo Kac
creators.role: Artist; pioneer of telepresence and bio art
creators.bio: Brazilian-American artist who made telerobotic works from the late 1980s before turning to transgenic art.
creators.why: His telepresence works and his essay on robotic art defined how artists think about being present through a machine.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；远程在场艺术与生物艺术先驱
creators.bio_zh: 巴西裔美国艺术家，1980 年代末起创作远程机器人作品，后来转向转基因艺术。
creators.why_zh: 他的远程在场作品与关于机器人艺术的论文，界定了艺术家如何思考“借机器在场”。

creators.name: Kevin Warwick
creators.role: Cybernetics researcher; Emeritus Professor, Coventry and Reading Universities
creators.bio: British engineer who had an RFID chip (1998) and then a neural electrode array (2002) implanted to connect his nervous system to computers.
creators.why: He made self-experimentation with implants a public debate about what a cyborg is.
creators.role_zh: 控制论研究者；考文垂大学与雷丁大学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国工程师，先后植入 RFID 芯片（1998）和神经电极阵列（2002），把自己的神经系统接入计算机。
creators.why_zh: 他以植入物做自体实验，把“什么是赛博格”变成公共讨论。

creators.name: Steve Mann
creators.role: Inventor; Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering, University of Toronto
creators.bio: Researcher who has worn computers and head-mounted cameras in daily life since the late 1970s and coined 'sousveillance'.
creators.why: His life with wearable computers is a long-running experiment in machine-mediated seeing.
creators.role_zh: 发明家；多伦多大学电子与计算机工程教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，自 1970 年代末起在日常生活中佩戴计算机与头戴摄像机，并提出“反向监视”（sousveillance）一词。
creators.why_zh: 他与可穿戴计算机共同生活，是一场关于“以机器观看”的长期实验。

creators.name: Wafaa Bilal
creators.role: Artist; Professor, NYU Tisch School of the Arts
creators.bio: Iraqi-American artist whose performances expose the body to remote, networked violence and surveillance.
creators.why: He made the experience of being the target of a remote machine tangible for online audiences.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；纽约大学 Tisch 艺术学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 伊拉克裔美国艺术家，他的表演让身体暴露于远程、网络化的暴力与监视之下。
creators.why_zh: 他让网上观众切身体会成为远程机器“目标”的感受。

creators.name: Dani Clode
creators.role: Augmentation designer; researcher at the Plasticity Lab, University of Cambridge
creators.bio: Designer of prosthetics and body extensions, known for the Third Thumb.
creators.why: Her work moves prosthetics from replacement to extension and studies how the brain adopts an extra machine limb.
creators.role_zh: 人体增强设计师；剑桥大学 Plasticity Lab 研究者
creators.bio_zh: 设计义体与身体延伸装置的设计师，以“第三拇指”（Third Thumb）闻名。
creators.why_zh: 她把义体从“替代”推向“延伸”，并研究大脑如何接纳一根额外的机器肢体。

creators.name: Hugh Herr
creators.role: Biophysicist; head of the Biomechatronics group, MIT Media Lab
creators.bio: Climber and engineer who lost both lower legs in 1982 and now designs powered bionic limbs.
creators.why: He frames bionics as extending human expression, not only restoring function.
creators.role_zh: 生物物理学家；MIT 媒体实验室生物机电组负责人
creators.bio_zh: 攀岩者和工程师，1982 年失去双腿小腿，现设计带动力的仿生肢体。
creators.why_zh: 他把仿生学看作对人类表达的延伸，而不只是功能的修复。

creators.name: Ken Goldberg
creators.role: Artist and roboticist; Professor, UC Berkeley
creators.bio: Robotics professor who made some of the first internet-controlled robots as artworks in the 1990s.
creators.why: His 'telepistemology' asks what we can know and trust when we act through a remote machine.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、机器人学家；加州大学伯克利分校教授
creators.bio_zh: 机器人学教授，1990 年代把最早一批可经互联网操控的机器人做成艺术作品。
creators.why_zh: 他提出的“远程认识论”追问：借远方机器行动时，我们能知道什么、能信任什么。

creators.name: Paul Sermon
creators.role: Artist; Professor of Visual Communication, University of Brighton
creators.bio: British artist who has made telematic installations joining remote bodies in shared video spaces since 1991.
creators.why: Telematic Dreaming is a founding work of telepresence art and remote intimacy.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；布莱顿大学视觉传达教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，自 1991 年起创作远程通信装置，把异地的身体连接进共享的影像空间。
creators.why_zh: 《远程之梦》是远程在场艺术与远程亲密关系的奠基之作。

creators.name: Lynn Hershman Leeson
creators.bio: American artist working since the 1960s on identity, surveillance, artificial intelligence and the relation between bodies and technology.
creators.why: Her telerobotic dolls and AI agents anticipated networked, machine-mediated selves.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，自 1960 年代起关注身份、监视、人工智能以及身体与技术的关系。
creators.why_zh: 她的远程机器人玩偶与 AI 角色预见了网络化、由机器中介的自我。

creators.name: Kit Galloway & Sherrie Rabinowitz
creators.role: Artist duo; founders of Electronic Cafe International
creators.bio: Kit Galloway and Sherrie Rabinowitz (1950–2013) made satellite and video telecommunication art from the 1970s.
creators.why: Hole in Space is the prototype of every video call, staged as a public encounter.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组；Electronic Cafe International 创始人
creators.bio_zh: Kit Galloway 与 Sherrie Rabinowitz（1950–2013）自 1970 年代起创作卫星与视频远程通信艺术。
creators.why_zh: 《空间之洞》是一切视频通话的原型，以公共相遇的方式上演。

creators.name: Laurie Anderson
creators.bio: American artist known for voice filters, electronic instruments and multimedia performance since the 1970s.
creators.why: She uses media machines to make absent or altered bodies present on stage.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、音乐人、表演者
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，自 1970 年代起以变声器、电子乐器与多媒体表演闻名。
creators.why_zh: 她用媒介机器让缺席或变形的身体出现在舞台上。

creators.name: BeAnotherLab
creators.role: Interdisciplinary collective for embodiment and empathy research
creators.bio: Collective founded in Barcelona in 2012 that builds low-cost embodiment systems for swapping perspectives and bodies.
creators.why: Their Machine to Be Another turns a VR headset into a tool for inhabiting someone else's body.
creators.role_zh: 关于具身与共情研究的跨学科团体
creators.bio_zh: 2012 年在巴塞罗那成立的团体，制作低成本具身系统，让人交换视角与身体。
creators.why_zh: 他们的《成为他人的机器》把 VR 头显变成“进入他人身体”的工具。

creators.name: Eric Paulos
creators.role: Professor, EECS, UC Berkeley; director of the Hybrid Ecologies Lab
creators.bio: HCI researcher who built early telepresence robots in the 1990s and later worked on critical making.
creators.why: PRoP asked what social presence a body needs when it travels through a robot.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校电子工程与计算机科学系教授；Hybrid Ecologies Lab 主任
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，1990 年代制作早期远程在场机器人，后来投身批判性制作。
creators.why_zh: PRoP 追问：当身体借机器人远行时，它需要怎样的社交在场。

creators.name: Stahl Stenslie
creators.role: Artist and researcher in haptic and experimental media
creators.bio: Norwegian artist who has made tele-haptic and full-body interfaces since the early 1990s.
creators.why: cyberSM was one of the first works to send touch between remote bodies.
creators.role_zh: 触觉与实验媒介艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 挪威艺术家，自 1990 年代初创作远程触觉与全身交互界面。
creators.why_zh: cyberSM 是最早在远方身体之间传递触觉的作品之一。

creators.name: Merce Cunningham
creators.bio: American choreographer who used chance, film and, from 1989, computer software to make dances.
creators.why: He was the first major choreographer to compose with a computer and to share the stage with motion-capture figures.
creators.bio_zh: 美国编舞家，用偶然、影像以及（自 1989 年起）计算机软件来编舞。
creators.why_zh: 他是第一位用计算机编舞、并与动作捕捉形象同台的重要编舞家。

creators.name: Paul Kaiser
creators.bio: Artist who turned motion capture of dancers into hand-drawn-looking digital figures, with Shelley Eshkar and later Marc Downie.
creators.why: His motion-capture works let a body's movement live on apart from the body.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家；OpenEndedGroup 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 与 Shelley Eshkar（后与 Marc Downie）合作，把舞者的动作捕捉转化为手绘风格数字形象的艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 他的动作捕捉作品让身体的运动脱离身体而继续存在。

creators.name: Shelley Eshkar
creators.bio: Artist and animator who co-created BIPED and Ghostcatching with Paul Kaiser.
creators.why: He gave motion-capture data a drawn, ghostly body.
creators.role_zh: 数字艺术家；OpenEndedGroup 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家与动画师，与 Paul Kaiser 共同创作 BIPED 与 Ghostcatching。
creators.why_zh: 他给动作捕捉数据赋予了手绘般、幽灵般的身体。

creators.name: Bill T. Jones
creators.role: Choreographer; co-founder of Bill T. Jones/Arnie Zane Company
creators.bio: American choreographer and dancer whose work addresses the body, race, illness and loss.
creators.why: Ghostcatching made his captured movement the subject of a digital afterimage.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；Bill T. Jones/Arnie Zane 舞团联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 美国编舞家与舞者，作品关注身体、种族、疾病与失去。
creators.why_zh: Ghostcatching 把他被捕捉的动作变成数字残像的主题。

creators.name: Wayne McGregor
creators.role: Choreographer; Artistic Director, Studio Wayne McGregor; Director of Dance, Venice Biennale
creators.bio: British choreographer who has worked with cognitive scientists and technologists on how movement is made.
creators.why: Living Archive puts a model of his own style on stage as a choreographic partner.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；Studio Wayne McGregor 艺术总监；威尼斯双年展舞蹈部分总监
creators.bio_zh: 英国编舞家，长期与认知科学家和技术人员合作，研究动作如何生成。
creators.why_zh: 《活档案》把他个人风格的模型当作编舞伙伴搬上舞台。

creators.name: Blanca Li
creators.bio: Spanish-French choreographer working across dance, film and opera.
creators.why: Her ROBOT staged humanoid robots and dancers as a company of equals.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、导演
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙裔法国编舞家，跨舞蹈、电影与歌剧创作。
creators.why_zh: 她的《机器人》让类人机器人与舞者以平等成员的身份同台。

creators.name: Catie Cuan
creators.bio: Choreographer with a PhD in mechanical engineering from Stanford who works with industrial and social robots.
creators.why: She calls her field 'choreorobotics': using dance to design how robots move among people.
creators.role_zh: 舞者、编舞家、机器人学家
creators.bio_zh: 拥有斯坦福大学机械工程博士学位的编舞家，与工业机器人和社交机器人合作。
creators.why_zh: 她把自己的领域称为“编舞机器人学”：用舞蹈设计机器人如何在人群中移动。

creators.name: Thomas Freundlich
creators.bio: Finnish-American choreographer who has made dance works for industrial robots since 2008.
creators.why: He was among the first to programme a factory robot as a full dance partner.
creators.role_zh: 舞者、编舞家、电影人
creators.bio_zh: 芬兰裔美国编舞家，自 2008 年起为工业机器人创作舞蹈作品。
creators.why_zh: 他是最早把工厂机器人编程为完整舞伴的编舞家之一。

creators.name: Pablo Ventura
creators.role: Choreographer; director of Ventura Dance Company
creators.bio: Spanish choreographer who has worked with industrial robots, software and machine performers since around 2000.
creators.why: He treats robots as dancers in the company, not stage machinery.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；Ventura Dance Company 总监
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙编舞家，自 2000 年前后与工业机器人、软件和机器表演者合作。
creators.why_zh: 他把机器人当作舞团里的舞者，而非舞台机械。

creators.name: robotlab
creators.role: Artist group (Matthias Gommel, Martina Haitz, Jan Zappe)
creators.bio: German group, founded at ZKM in 2000, that takes industrial robots out of the factory into art and public space.
creators.why: Their robots write scripture, draw portraits and dance, testing machine labour as cultural labour.
creators.role_zh: 艺术小组（Matthias Gommel、Martina Haitz、Jan Zappe）
creators.bio_zh: 2000 年在 ZKM 成立的德国艺术小组，把工业机器人从工厂带进艺术与公共空间。
creators.why_zh: 他们的机器人抄写经文、画肖像、跳舞，把机器劳动当作文化劳动来检验。

creators.name: Louise Crnkovic-Friis
creators.bio: Swedish choreographer who trained neural networks on her own dance to generate new choreography.
creators.why: chor-rnn is an early case of a choreographer's style learned by a machine.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；Peltarion 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典编舞家，用自己的舞蹈训练神经网络，生成新的编舞。
creators.why_zh: chor-rnn 是机器学习编舞家个人风格的早期案例。

creators.name: Luka Crnkovic-Friis
creators.bio: Swedish AI engineer who built the chor-rnn model with Louise Crnkovic-Friis.
creators.why: He brought deep learning into a choreographer's studio.
creators.role_zh: 机器学习工程师；Peltarion 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典 AI 工程师，与 Louise Crnkovic-Friis 合作构建 chor-rnn 模型。
creators.why_zh: 他把深度学习带进了编舞家的排练室。

creators.name: Merritt Moore
creators.bio: American dancer with a DPhil in atomic and laser physics from Oxford who choreographs duets with industrial robot arms.
creators.why: She programmes the robot herself, making the duet a conversation between dancer and code.
creators.role_zh: 芭蕾舞者、量子物理学家
creators.bio_zh: 美国舞者，牛津大学原子与激光物理博士，编创与工业机械臂的双人舞。
creators.why_zh: 她亲自给机器人编程，让双人舞成为舞者与代码之间的对话。

creators.name: Gideon Obarzanek
creators.bio: Australian choreographer who founded Chunky Move in 1995 and made interactive-video dance works with Frieder Weiss.
creators.why: Glow made machine vision a visible partner of the dancing body.
creators.role_zh: 编舞家；Chunky Move 舞团创始人
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚编舞家，1995 年创立 Chunky Move，与 Frieder Weiss 合作创作互动影像舞蹈。
creators.why_zh: 《Glow》让机器视觉成为舞动身体看得见的伙伴。

creators.name: Frieder Weiss
creators.bio: German engineer-artist who writes real-time camera tracking software for dance.
creators.why: His systems let a camera 'see' dancers and answer them with light.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、软件开发者（Kalypso）
creators.bio_zh: 为舞蹈编写实时摄像追踪软件的德国工程师兼艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 他的系统让摄像机“看见”舞者，并以光回应他们。

creators.name: Kris Verdonck
creators.role: Theatre maker and visual artist; director of A Two Dogs Company
creators.bio: Belgian artist whose performances and installations put machines, objects and humans on stage as equal performers.
creators.why: His machines perform struggle, failure and exhaustion, blurring actor and apparatus.
creators.role_zh: 剧场创作者、视觉艺术家；A Two Dogs Company 总监
creators.bio_zh: 比利时艺术家，他的表演与装置让机器、物件与人以平等的表演者身份同台。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器表演挣扎、失败与耗竭，模糊了演员与装置的界限。

creators.name: Masahiro Mori
creators.role: Roboticist; Professor Emeritus, Tokyo Institute of Technology
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；东京工业大学名誉教授
creators.bio: Japanese roboticist (1927–2025) who proposed the uncanny valley in 1970 and wrote on robots and Buddhism.
creators.bio_zh: 日本机器人学家（1927–2025），1970 年提出“恐怖谷”假说，并写作机器人与佛教的关系。
creators.why: His uncanny valley essay is the founding text on why near-human machines disturb us.
creators.why_zh: 他的《恐怖谷》是理解“几乎像人”的机器为何令人不安的奠基文本。

creators.name: Hiroshi Ishiguro
creators.role: Roboticist; Professor, Osaka University; ATR Hiroshi Ishiguro Laboratories
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；大阪大学教授，ATR 石黑浩实验室
creators.bio: Builds lifelike androids, including Geminoid HI-1, a copy of himself, and uses them to study human presence.
creators.bio_zh: 制作高度逼真的仿真人，包括以自己为原型的 Geminoid HI-1，并借此研究“人的存在感”。
creators.why: His androids are the reference point for the uncanny, android theatre and robot religion in East Asia.
creators.why_zh: 他的仿真人是东亚恐怖谷研究、仿真人剧场与机器人宗教的参照点。

creators.name: Takashi Ikegami
creators.role: Artificial life researcher; Professor, University of Tokyo
creators.role_zh: 人工生命研究者；东京大学教授
creators.bio: Complex-systems scientist who builds artificial-life installations and the android Alter to study spontaneity and 'life' in machines.
creators.bio_zh: 复杂系统科学家，用人工生命装置和仿真人 Alter 研究机器中的自发性与“生命感”。
creators.why: He works at the border of art and ALife, asking what makes a machine seem alive from the inside.
creators.why_zh: 他在艺术与人工生命的交界处工作，追问机器从内部看起来“活着”需要什么。

creators.name: Kōdai-ji
creators.role_zh: 京都临济宗禅寺
creators.bio: A 400-year-old Zen temple in Kyoto that commissioned the android Kannon Mindar with Osaka University.
creators.bio_zh: 京都一座有四百年历史的禅寺，与大阪大学合作委托制作了仿真人观音 Mindar。
creators.why: It made a robot a working preacher inside a living religious tradition.
creators.why_zh: 它让机器人成为一个仍在延续的宗教传统中真正布道的“僧侣”。

creators.name: Oriza Hirata
creators.role: Playwright and director, Seinendan; Professor, Osaka University
creators.role_zh: 剧作家、导演（青年团剧团）；大阪大学教授
creators.bio: Playwright of 'contemporary colloquial theatre' who, with Hiroshi Ishiguro, launched the Robot-Human Theater project in 2008.
creators.bio_zh: “现代口语戏剧”的代表剧作家，2008 年与石黑浩发起“机器人-人类剧场”计划。
creators.why: He treats robots as actors in quiet, everyday drama rather than as spectacle.
creators.why_zh: 他把机器人当作平静日常戏剧中的演员，而不是奇观。

creators.name: Keiichiro Shibuya
creators.role_zh: 作曲家；ATAK 厂牌创办人
creators.bio: Composer who wrote operas without human singers: THE END for Hatsune Miku and Scary Beauty for the android Alter.
creators.bio_zh: 作曲家，创作了没有人类歌手的歌剧：为初音未来写的《THE END》和为仿真人 Alter 写的《Scary Beauty》。
creators.why: He stages synthetic voices and androids as performers of death, beauty and fear.
creators.why_zh: 他让合成声音与仿真人成为演绎死亡、美与恐惧的表演者。

creators.name: Takanori Shibata
creators.role_zh: 日本产业技术综合研究所首席研究员
creators.bio: Engineer who developed PARO, the seal robot used in dementia and elder care since 2004.
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，研发了自 2004 年起用于失智症与老年照护的海豹机器人 PARO。
creators.why: PARO is the key case in debates over robotic care and 'fake' companionship.
creators.why_zh: PARO 是关于机器照护与“虚假陪伴”争论中最关键的案例。

creators.name: Sony
creators.role_zh: 电子与娱乐公司
creators.bio: Japanese company that launched the robot dog AIBO in 1999 and a new aibo in 2018.
creators.bio_zh: 日本公司，1999 年推出机器狗 AIBO，2018 年推出新一代 aibo。
creators.why: AIBO made a consumer robot into a family member, and its end of support into a death.
creators.why_zh: AIBO 让一台消费级机器人成为家庭成员，也让“停止维修”成为一种死亡。

creators.name: Kōfuku-ji (Isumi)
creators.role_zh: 千叶县夷隅市的佛教寺院
creators.bio: Temple where priest Bungen Oi has held memorial services for broken AIBO robot dogs since 2015, with the repair company A-FUN.
creators.bio_zh: 自 2015 年起，住持 Bungen Oi 与维修公司 A-FUN 合作，在这里为损坏的 AIBO 机器狗举行供养法会。
creators.why: It turned the end of a product line into a ritual of mourning.
creators.why_zh: 它把一条产品线的终结变成了一场哀悼仪式。

creators.name: Nissei Eco
creators.role_zh: 殡葬与塑料制品公司
creators.bio: Japanese company that programmed SoftBank's Pepper robot to chant Buddhist sutras at funerals in 2017.
creators.bio_zh: 日本公司，2017 年让软银 Pepper 机器人在葬礼上诵读佛经。
creators.why: Its robot priest raised the question of automating the rites of death.
creators.why_zh: 它的机器人僧侣提出了“死亡仪式能否自动化”的问题。

creators.name: GROOVE X
creators.role_zh: 机器人公司，LOVOT 制造商
creators.bio: Company founded by Kaname Hayashi in 2015 to build LOVOT, a robot designed only to be loved.
creators.bio_zh: 林要于 2015 年创立的公司，制造只为“被爱”而设计的机器人 LOVOT。
creators.why: It designs a robot whose function is to need care rather than to be useful.
creators.why_zh: 它设计的机器人的“功能”是需要照顾，而不是有用。

creators.name: Michio Okada
creators.role: Professor, Toyohashi University of Technology (ICD Lab)
creators.role_zh: 丰桥技术科学大学教授（ICD 实验室）
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist and roboticist who proposed 'weak robots' (yowai robotto): robots that need people's help to complete their tasks.
creators.bio_zh: 认知科学家与机器人学家，提出“弱机器人”：需要人帮忙才能完成任务的机器人。
creators.why: He makes vulnerability, not capability, the design goal of social robots.
creators.why_zh: 他把脆弱而非能力当作社交机器人的设计目标。

creators.name: Bandai
creators.role_zh: 玩具公司，拓麻歌子制造商
creators.bio: Toy company that released Tamagotchi in 1996, conceived by Aki Maita with Akihiro Yokoi (WiZ).
creators.bio_zh: 玩具公司，1996 年推出由真板亚纪与横井昭裕（WiZ）构想的拓麻歌子。
creators.why: Tamagotchi taught a generation to care for, and grieve, a machine.
creators.why_zh: 拓麻歌子让一代人学会照顾一台机器，也学会为它难过。

creators.name: Akihiko Kondo
creators.role_zh: 学校职员；公开自称“虚构性恋”者
creators.bio: Held a wedding with the virtual singer Hatsune Miku, living in a Gatebox device, in 2018.
creators.bio_zh: 2018 年与“住”在 Gatebox 装置中的虚拟歌手初音未来举行婚礼。
creators.why: His case shows intimacy with software and its loss when a service ends.
creators.why_zh: 他的经历展示了人与软件的亲密关系，以及服务终止时这种关系的失去。

creators.name: Ei Wada
creators.role: Artist and musician; founder of Electronicos Fantasticos!
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、音乐人；Electronicos Fantasticos! 发起人
creators.bio: Turns obsolete appliances such as CRT televisions, fans and barcode readers into instruments played by a community orchestra.
creators.bio_zh: 把显像管电视、电风扇、条码扫描器等淘汰家电改造成乐器，由社区乐团演奏。
creators.why: He gives dead machines a second, collective life.
creators.why_zh: 他给死去的机器第二次、集体的生命。

creators.name: Maywa Denki
creators.role: Art unit run as a fake electrical-appliance company (Nobumichi Tosa)
creators.role_zh: 以虚构电器公司形式运作的艺术组合（土佐信道）
creators.bio: Art unit founded in 1993 by the Tosa brothers that builds absurd musical machines and presents them as company products.
creators.bio_zh: 土佐兄弟 1993 年创立的艺术组合，制作荒诞的音乐机器，并以公司“产品”的方式发布。
creators.why: Its nonsense machines parody Japan's industrial and corporate machine culture.
creators.why_zh: 它的“无意义机器”戏仿了日本工业与企业的机器文化。

creators.name: So Kanno
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Media artist who builds robots and machines that draw, swarm and write, often with yang02 (Takahiro Yamaguchi).
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家，制作会绘画、成群行动和书写的机器人与机器，常与 yang02（山口崇洋）合作。
creators.why: His machines make intention, meaning and authorship look strange by producing them without either.
creators.why_zh: 他的机器在没有意图与意义的情况下产出作品，让“意图”“意义”和“作者”显得陌生。

creators.name: Takahiro Yamaguchi (yang02)
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（yang02）
creators.bio: Artist working as yang02 on graffiti, public space and drawing machines, co-author of Senseless Drawing Bot with So Kanno.
creators.bio_zh: 以 yang02 之名创作涂鸦、公共空间与绘画机器，与菅野创合作《Senseless Drawing Bot》。
creators.why: He brings street-art questions of authorship into machine drawing.
creators.why_zh: 他把街头艺术中关于作者身份的问题带进了机器绘画。

creators.name: Takayuki Todo
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、机器人工程师
creators.bio: Builds small humanoid heads that return a viewer's gaze and facial expression.
creators.bio_zh: 制作能回应观者目光与表情的小型人形头部机器人。
creators.why: His SEER isolates gaze as the smallest unit of machine 'presence'.
creators.why_zh: 他的 SEER 把“目光”提炼为机器存在感的最小单位。

creators.name: Sputniko! (Hiromi Ozaki)
creators.role: Artist and designer; Associate Professor, Tokyo University of the Arts
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师；东京艺术大学副教授
creators.bio: Speculative designer whose films and devices, such as Menstruation Machine, question technology through gender.
creators.bio_zh: 思辨设计师，以《月经机器》等影片与装置，从性别角度追问技术。
creators.why: She uses machines on the body to make gendered experience transferable and debatable.
creators.why_zh: 她用贴在身体上的机器让性别经验可以被转移、被讨论。

creators.name: Daito Manabe
creators.role: Artist, programmer, DJ; co-founder of Rhizomatiks
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员、DJ；Rhizomatiks 联合创始人
creators.bio: Media artist who works with electrical muscle stimulation, drones, machine learning and brain data.
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家，以肌肉电刺激、无人机、机器学习与脑数据为材料创作。
creators.why: His work puts machine control directly on and inside the human body.
creators.why_zh: 他的作品把机器控制直接放到人的身体表面与内部。

creators.name: Rhizomatiks
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术与技术工作室
creators.bio: Tokyo studio founded in 2006 by Daito Manabe and others, known for drone, tracking and ML-driven stage works with ELEVENPLAY.
creators.bio_zh: 真锅大度等人 2006 年在东京创立的工作室，以与 ELEVENPLAY 合作的无人机、追踪与机器学习舞台作品著称。
creators.why: Its stage works show machine sensing and machine bodies as dance partners.
creators.why_zh: 它的舞台作品把机器感知与机器身体当作舞伴。

creators.name: ELEVENPLAY
creators.role_zh: 由 MIKIKO 主导的舞团
creators.bio: Dance company led by choreographer MIKIKO that performs with drones, robots and machine-learning systems built by Rhizomatiks.
creators.bio_zh: 由编舞家 MIKIKO 领导的舞团，与 Rhizomatiks 打造的无人机、机器人和机器学习系统同台表演。
creators.why: Its dancers test how human choreography and machine motion can be composed together.
creators.why_zh: 它的舞者检验人的编舞与机器运动如何共同构成。

creators.name: Ory Laboratory
creators.role: Robotics company founded by Kentaro Yoshifuji
creators.role_zh: 吉藤健太朗创办的机器人公司
creators.bio: Maker of the OriHime avatar robot, which lets people who cannot leave home, including people with ALS, work and be present remotely.
creators.bio_zh: OriHime 分身机器人的开发者，让无法出门的人（包括渐冻症患者）远程工作与“在场”。
creators.why: It frames telepresence robots as a remedy for loneliness and exclusion from work.
creators.why_zh: 它把远程在场机器人当作对孤独和被排除在工作之外的回应。

creators.name: Seiko Mikami
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；多摩美术大学教授
creators.bio: Media artist (1961–2015) who made large interactive installations about perception, surveillance and the body.
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家（1961–2015），以大型互动装置探讨感知、监控与身体。
creators.why: Her robotic installations turned the visitor into data watched by desiring machines.
creators.why_zh: 她的机器装置把观众变成被“有欲望的机器”注视的数据。

creators.name: Kazuhiko Hachiya
creators.role: Artist; Professor, Tokyo University of the Arts
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；东京艺术大学教授
creators.bio: Media artist known for Inter Dis-Communication Machine, the email pet software PostPet and the OpenSky glider project.
creators.bio_zh: 媒体艺术家，代表作包括《Inter Dis-Communication Machine》、电子邮件宠物软件 PostPet 和 OpenSky 滑翔机计划。
creators.why: He designs devices that swap or share perception between people.
creators.why_zh: 他设计让人与人交换或共享感知的装置。

creators.name: Susumu Tachi
creators.role: Professor Emeritus, University of Tokyo; founder of the Virtual Reality Society of Japan
creators.role_zh: 东京大学名誉教授；日本虚拟现实学会创会会长
creators.bio: Engineer who proposed 'telexistence' in 1980 and built the TELESAR robots that let a person feel present in a remote robot body.
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，1980 年提出“远程存在”（telexistence），并研制 TELESAR 系列机器人，让人感到自己身处远方的机器人身体中。
creators.why: His work defines the robot as a second body one can inhabit.
creators.why_zh: 他的研究把机器人定义为人可以“住进去”的第二个身体。

creators.name: Osamu Tezuka
creators.role_zh: 漫画家、动画家
creators.bio: Manga artist (1928–1989) who created Astro Boy (Tetsuwan Atom), serialised from 1952.
creators.bio_zh: 漫画家（1928–1989），创作了 1952 年开始连载的《铁臂阿童木》。
creators.why: Astro Boy shaped the East Asian image of the robot as a feeling being with rights.
creators.why_zh: 阿童木塑造了东亚对机器人的想象：有感情、应享有权利的存在。

creators.name: Mamoru Oshii
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio: Director of the animated film Ghost in the Shell (1995), adapted from Masamune Shirow's manga.
creators.bio_zh: 动画电影《攻壳机动队》（1995）的导演，改编自士郎正宗的漫画。
creators.why: His film is a key text on cyborg bodies and machine minds.
creators.why_zh: 他的电影是思考赛博格身体与机器心智的关键文本。

creators.name: Yasuhiro Yoshiura
creators.role_zh: 动画导演
creators.bio: Director of Time of Eve (2008–09), an anime about a café where humans and androids are not to be told apart.
creators.bio_zh: 《夏娃的时间》（2008–09）导演，讲述一家“不区分人类与机器人”的咖啡馆。
creators.why: His work imagines everyday ethics between people and household androids.
creators.why_zh: 他的作品想象了人与家用仿真人之间的日常伦理。

creators.name: Nam June Paik
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，录像艺术先驱
creators.bio: Korean-born artist (1932–2006) of the Fluxus circle who turned televisions, cameras and robots into artistic material.
creators.bio_zh: 韩裔艺术家（1932–2006），激浪派成员，把电视、摄像机与机器人变成艺术材料。
creators.why: His robots and closed-circuit works are founding images of how art stages machines as bodies and as watchers.
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人与闭路电视作品，是艺术把机器当作身体与观看者来呈现的奠基性图像。

creators.name: Shuya Abe
creators.role_zh: 电气工程师，白南准的技术合作者
creators.bio: Japanese engineer (1932–2016) who built Robot K-456 and the Paik–Abe video synthesizer with Nam June Paik.
creators.bio_zh: 日本工程师（1932–2016），与白南准合作制作了《机器人 K-456》和白南准–阿部录像合成器。
creators.why: An early case of an engineer as co-author of a robot artwork.
creators.why_zh: 工程师作为机器人艺术作品共同作者的早期案例。

creators.name: Lee Bul
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Korean artist working across performance, sculpture and installation; her work addresses technology, gender, utopia and the body.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国艺术家，横跨表演、雕塑与装置，关注技术、性别、乌托邦与身体。
creators.why: Her Cyborg series is a key feminist image of the machine-enhanced body and its fantasies of perfection.
creators.why_zh: 她的《赛博格》系列是关于机器增强身体及其完美幻想的重要女性主义图像。

creators.name: Shinseungback Kimyonghun
creators.role: Artist duo (Shin Seung Back and Kim Yong Hun)
creators.role_zh: 艺术家组合（Shin Seung Back 与 Kim Yong Hun）
creators.bio: Seoul-based duo, formed in 2012, who build installations around face detection, object recognition and other machine-vision systems.
creators.bio_zh: 2012 年成立的首尔艺术家组合，以人脸检测、物体识别等机器视觉系统为材料制作装置。
creators.why: Their works turn the errors and blind spots of computer vision into shared experiments between humans and machines.
creators.why_zh: 他们把计算机视觉的错误与盲区变成人与机器共同参与的实验。

creators.name: Ayoung Kim
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Korean artist who makes speculative-fiction videos with CGI, live action and game engines about geopolitics, labour and time.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国艺术家，以 CGI、实拍与游戏引擎制作思辨虚构影像，关注地缘政治、劳动与时间。
creators.why: Her Delivery Dancer films are the sharpest artistic image of algorithmically managed gig work; 2025 LG Guggenheim Award.
creators.why_zh: 她的“外卖舞者”系列是关于算法管理下零工劳动最锐利的艺术图像，获 2025 年 LG 古根海姆奖。

creators.name: Choe U-Ram
creators.role_zh: 动态雕塑艺术家
creators.bio: Korean sculptor who builds 'anima-machines': motorised creatures of aluminium and steel with invented scientific names.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国雕塑家，用铝和钢制作带虚构学名的电机驱动“机械生物”（anima-machines）。
creators.why: He gives machines a fictional natural history, blurring engineered mechanism and organism.
creators.why_zh: 他为机器编写虚构的自然史，模糊了工程机械与生物之间的界线。

creators.name: MBC (Munhwa Broadcasting Corporation)
creators.name_zh: 韩国文化广播公司 MBC
creators.role_zh: 韩国公共广播机构
creators.bio: South Korean broadcaster that produced the VR documentary series Meeting You (2020–).
creators.bio_zh: 韩国电视台，制作了 VR 纪录片系列《遇见你》（2020–）。
creators.why: Meeting You put VR reunion with the dead on national television and made digital mourning a public debate.
creators.why_zh: 《遇见你》把与逝者的 VR 重逢搬上国家电视台，使数字哀悼成为公共议题。

creators.name: DeepBrain AI
creators.role_zh: AI 虚拟人公司
creators.bio: Korean company making synthetic video avatars; launched the memorial service Re;memory in 2022.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国合成视频虚拟人公司，2022 年推出纪念服务 Re;memory。
creators.why: A documented commercial case of the griefbot industry in East Asia.
creators.why_zh: 东亚“哀悼机器人”产业的一个有据可查的商业案例。

creators.name: Scatter Lab
creators.role_zh: AI 聊天机器人初创公司
creators.bio: Korean start-up behind the chatbot Lee Luda (2020), trained on messenger conversations from its dating-advice apps.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国初创公司，开发了聊天机器人“李乐达”（Lee Luda，2020），其训练数据来自旗下恋爱咨询应用中的聊天记录。
creators.why: Its chatbot became Korea's defining case on companion AI, consent and training data.
creators.why_zh: 它的聊天机器人成为韩国关于陪伴 AI、知情同意与训练数据的标志性案例。

creators.name: Jaha Koo
creators.role_zh: 剧场创作者、作曲家与录像艺术家
creators.bio: South Korean theatre-maker whose documentary performances combine music, video, autobiography and technological objects.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国剧场创作者，其纪实表演结合音乐、影像、自传与技术物件。
creators.why: In Cuckoo, household machines become the only confidants of a lonely generation.
creators.why_zh: 在《布谷》中，家用电器成了孤独一代唯一的倾诉对象。

creators.name: Kim Jee-woon
creators.role_zh: 电影导演、编剧
creators.bio: South Korean director of genre films including A Tale of Two Sisters and I Saw the Devil.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国类型片导演，作品包括《蔷花，红莲》《看见恶魔》。
creators.why: His short 'Heavenly Creature' is one of cinema's clearest images of a robot reaching religious insight.
creators.why_zh: 他的短片《天上的造物》是电影中机器人获得宗教觉悟最清晰的图像之一。

creators.name: Kim Tae-yong
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio: South Korean director of Late Autumn and Wonderland.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国导演，作品有《晚秋》《奇迹乐园》。
creators.why: Wonderland is a mainstream Korean fiction about subscription services that simulate the dead.
creators.why_zh: 《奇迹乐园》是一部关于模拟逝者的订阅服务的韩国主流剧情片。

creators.name: Yeon Sang-ho
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio: South Korean director of Train to Busan and the Netflix film Jung_E.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国导演，作品有《釜山行》及 Netflix 电影《贞伊》。
creators.why: Jung_E asks who owns a mind once it is copied and sold as a product.
creators.why_zh: 《贞伊》追问：一个心智被复制并作为商品出售后归谁所有。

creators.name: Anicka Yi
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Korean-American artist working with scent, bacteria and machines; she speaks of 'biologizing the machine'.
creators.bio_zh: 韩裔美国艺术家，以气味、细菌与机器为材料，提出“让机器生物化”。
creators.why: Her floating 'aerobes' imagine machines as a new species with their own sensing and behaviour.
creators.why_zh: 她漂浮的“气生体”（aerobes）把机器想象成拥有自身感知与行为的新物种。

creators.name: Byung-Chul Han
creators.role_zh: 哲学家、文化理论家
creators.bio: Korean-born German philosopher who writes short books on digital culture, neoliberalism and the smartphone age.
creators.bio_zh: 韩裔德国哲学家，写作关于数字文化、新自由主义与智能手机时代的短篇著作。
creators.why: His essays give a widely read phenomenology of life among data, screens and 'non-things'.
creators.why_zh: 他的随笔为数据、屏幕与“非物”中的生活提供了广为阅读的现象学描述。

creators.name: Huang Yi
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、舞者、发明者
creators.bio: Taiwanese choreographer who programs industrial robots himself and founded Huang Yi Studio +.
creators.bio_zh: 台湾编舞家，亲自为工业机器人编程，创立黄翊工作室＋。
creators.why: His duet with a KUKA arm is the best-known dance between a person and an industrial robot.
creators.why_zh: 他与 KUKA 机械臂的双人舞是人与工业机器人共舞最知名的作品。

creators.name: Shu Lea Cheang
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影导演
creators.bio: Taiwanese-American net-art pioneer whose films and installations deal with surveillance, sexuality and data.
creators.bio_zh: 台裔美国网络艺术先驱，其电影与装置关注监控、性与数据。
creators.why: Her work turns surveillance and data capture into queer counter-fiction; 2024 LG Guggenheim Award.
creators.why_zh: 她把监控与数据采集转化为酷儿的反叙事；获 2024 年 LG 古根海姆奖。

creators.name: Victor Wong
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、视觉特效制作人
creators.bio: Hong Kong visual-effects producer (vfxNova) who created the AI ink painter A.I. Gemini in 2018.
creators.bio_zh: 香港视觉特效制作人（vfxNova），2018 年创造了 AI 水墨画家 A.I. Gemini。
creators.why: He presents a program as a named co-artist, putting ink-painting authorship in question.
creators.why_zh: 他把一个程序当作有名字的合作艺术家来呈现，让水墨画的作者身份成为问题。

creators.name: Ho Tzu Nyen
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影导演
creators.bio: Singaporean artist whose films, installations and algorithmic works mix myth and history of Southeast Asia.
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡艺术家，以电影、装置与算法作品交织东南亚的神话与历史。
creators.why: His CDOSEA hands the editing of history to an algorithm that never produces the same film twice.
creators.why_zh: 他的《东南亚批判辞典》把历史的剪辑交给一个永不重复的算法。

creators.name: Choy Ka Fai
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、编舞者、思辨设计师
creators.bio: Singaporean artist trained in Design Interactions at the RCA who makes performances about the body, technology and memory.
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡艺术家，毕业于皇家艺术学院交互设计专业，创作关于身体、技术与记忆的表演。
creators.why: He uses muscle stimulation, motion capture and avatars to ask whether dance can be stored and replayed by machines.
creators.why_zh: 他用肌肉电刺激、动作捕捉与虚拟化身追问：舞蹈能否被机器储存和回放。

creators.name: Sun Yuan & Peng Yu
creators.role_zh: 艺术家组合
creators.bio: Beijing-based duo working together since 1999 on installations built from machines, animals, bodies and bodily fluids.
creators.bio_zh: 自 1999 年起合作的北京艺术家组合，用机器、动物、身体与体液构建装置。
creators.why: Their machines (a sweeping robot arm, drifting wheelchairs) make compulsion, control and exhaustion visible in a machine body.
creators.why_zh: 他们的机器（不停清扫的机械臂、漂移的轮椅）把强迫、控制与疲惫呈现在机器身体上。

creators.name: Xu Bing
creators.role: Artist; former Vice President, Central Academy of Fine Arts
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；中央美术学院前副院长
creators.bio: Chinese artist known for works on language and writing systems (Book from the Sky), who turned to surveillance footage for his first feature film.
creators.bio_zh: 以《天书》等关于语言与文字系统的作品闻名的中国艺术家，首部长片完全用监控录像剪辑而成。
creators.why: Dragonfly Eyes shows what cinema becomes when every shot was recorded by a machine for a machine.
creators.why_zh: 《蜻蜓之眼》展示了当每个镜头都由机器为机器拍下时，电影会变成什么。

creators.name: Cao Fei
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio: Guangzhou-born artist working in video, virtual worlds and installation on labour, urbanisation and digital life in China.
creators.bio_zh: 生于广州的艺术家，以影像、虚拟世界与装置关注中国的劳动、城市化与数字生活。
creators.why: Her films place workers next to automated factories and warehouses and ask what dreams and intimacy remain there.
creators.why_zh: 她的影片把工人置于自动化工厂与仓库之中，追问那里还剩下怎样的梦想与亲密。

creators.name: Lu Yang
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Shanghai-based artist who combines neuroscience, Buddhist cosmology, game engines and motion capture in videos, games and avatars.
creators.bio_zh: 上海艺术家，把神经科学、佛教宇宙观、游戏引擎与动作捕捉结合进影像、游戏与数字化身。
creators.why: Lu Yang treats the body and brain as hackable machinery and uses avatars to stage digital death and rebirth.
creators.why_zh: 陆扬把身体与大脑当作可被改写的机器，用数字化身演绎数字的死亡与轮回。

creators.name: aaajiao
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家（徐文恺）
creators.based_zh: 上海，中国 / 柏林，德国
creators.bio: aaajiao is the online name of Xu Wenkai, an artist, blogger and programmer working on networks, software and online identity.
creators.bio_zh: aaajiao 是艺术家、博主与程序员徐文恺的网络名，关注网络、软件与线上身份。
creators.why: His bot works treat an automated agent as the artist's double and look at what such a system can and cannot know about itself.
creators.why_zh: 他的 bot 系列把自动化代理当作艺术家的分身，审视这样的系统能否认识自身。

creators.name: Guo Cheng
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Chinese artist who builds installations and research projects around technical systems, from face detection to the firewall and computing power.
creators.bio_zh: 中国艺术家，围绕技术系统（从人脸检测、防火墙到算力）创作装置与研究项目。
creators.why: Guo Cheng makes infrastructure and machine perception tangible with plain, often humorous devices.
creators.why_zh: 郭城用朴素、常带幽默的装置让基础设施与机器感知变得可感。

creators.name: Wang Yuyang
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Beijing artist working with light, sculpture and technology.
creators.bio_zh: 北京艺术家，以光、雕塑与技术为媒介创作。
creators.why: His breathing replicas of office machines turn appliances into bodies.
creators.why_zh: 他会呼吸的办公机器复制品把电器变成了身体。

creators.name: Liu Chuang
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Chinese artist whose videos trace how labour, land and infrastructure are reorganised by economic and technological change.
creators.bio_zh: 中国艺术家，其影像追踪劳动、土地与基础设施如何被经济与技术变化重组。
creators.why: He links crypto-mining's energy demand to the landscapes and languages it displaces.
creators.why_zh: 他把加密货币挖矿的能源需求与它所冲击的土地和语言联系在一起。

creators.name: Longquan Monastery
creators.role_zh: 北京佛教寺院
creators.bio: Buddhist monastery in Beijing's Fenghuangling known for its technology-savvy monks and volunteers.
creators.bio_zh: 位于北京凤凰岭的佛教寺院，以熟悉科技的僧人与义工团队著称。
creators.why: It built Xian'er, one of the first robot monks, to answer questions about Buddhism.
creators.why_zh: 它打造了最早的机器僧之一贤二，用来回答关于佛法的问题。

creators.name: Microsoft XiaoIce team
creators.role: Social chatbot team, Microsoft (Asia) STCA; later spun off as Xiaoice
creators.role_zh: 微软（亚洲）互联网工程院社交聊天机器人团队，后独立为小冰公司
creators.bio: Team that launched XiaoIce in China in 2014, a chatbot designed as an empathetic companion rather than a task assistant.
creators.bio_zh: 2014 年在中国推出小冰的团队；小冰被设计成富有同理心的陪伴者，而非任务助手。
creators.why: XiaoIce is one of the largest documented cases of people forming long-term relationships with a chatbot.
creators.why_zh: 小冰是人与聊天机器人建立长期关系规模最大、记录最多的案例之一。

creators.name: Super Brain
creators.role_zh: AI 工作室（创始人张泽伟）
creators.bio: Nanjing studio that sells AI avatars of deceased people, built from photos, videos and voice recordings supplied by families.
creators.bio_zh: 南京的工作室，用家属提供的照片、视频与录音为逝者制作 AI 数字人。
creators.why: A documented case of grief turned into a commercial AI service in China.
creators.why_zh: 中国哀悼被变成商业 AI 服务的一个有记录的案例。

creators.name: Renwu magazine
creators.role_zh: 杂志（记者赖祐萱）
creators.bio: Chinese feature magazine whose 2020 investigation into food-delivery riders became one of the most-read Chinese articles of the year.
creators.bio_zh: 中国人物特稿杂志，其 2020 年关于外卖骑手的调查报道成为当年阅读量最高的中文文章之一。
creators.why: Its report made algorithmic management a public issue in China.
creators.why_zh: 这篇报道让“算法管理”在中国成为公共议题。

creators.name: Unitree Robotics
creators.role_zh: 机器人公司
creators.bio: Hangzhou maker of quadruped and humanoid robots (Go, H1, G1).
creators.bio_zh: 杭州的四足与人形机器人制造商（Go、H1、G1）。
creators.why: Its humanoids became China's national image of robot bodies through televised performances.
creators.why_zh: 它的人形机器人通过电视演出，成为中国机器人身体的国家形象。

creators.name: Zhang Yimou
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio: Chinese film director and director of large state spectacles, including the 2008 Beijing Olympic opening ceremony.
creators.bio_zh: 中国电影导演，也执导过 2008 年北京奥运会开幕式等大型国家演出。
creators.why: He staged humanoid robots as folk dancers for the 2025 Spring Festival Gala.
creators.why_zh: 他在 2025 年春晚把人形机器人编排成扭秧歌的舞者。

creators.name: Beijing E-Town
creators.role_zh: 北京经济技术开发区（主办方）
creators.bio: Beijing development zone and robotics hub that organises the E-Town Half-Marathon with a parallel humanoid robot race.
creators.bio_zh: 北京的开发区与机器人产业聚集地，主办设有人形机器人并行赛道的亦庄半程马拉松。
creators.why: It staged the first half-marathon where humanoid robots ran beside people.
creators.why_zh: 它举办了第一场人形机器人与人同场奔跑的半程马拉松。

creators.name: Chen Qiufan
creators.role_zh: 科幻作家
creators.bio: Chinese science-fiction writer (Stanley Chan) whose fiction deals with e-waste, cyborgs and AI.
creators.bio_zh: 中国科幻作家（英文名 Stanley Chan），作品涉及电子垃圾、赛博格与人工智能。
creators.why: A central voice in Chinese writing about humans and machines.
creators.why_zh: 中文人机关系写作中的核心声音。

creators.name: Kai-Fu Lee
creators.role: Computer scientist and investor; founder, Sinovation Ventures
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家、投资人；创新工场创始人
creators.bio: Taiwan-born computer scientist, former head of Google China and author of AI Superpowers.
creators.bio_zh: 生于台湾的计算机科学家，曾任谷歌中国总裁，著有《AI 新世界》。
creators.why: Co-author of AI 2041, a widely read Chinese-American vision of AI futures.
creators.why_zh: 《AI 未来进行式》的合著者，这是一部流传很广的 AI 未来想象。

creators.name: Wen-Ying Tsai
creators.bio: Chinese-American engineer turned artist, a pioneer of cybernetic sculpture from 1968.
creators.bio_zh: 由工程师转为艺术家的美籍华人，自 1968 年起开创控制论雕塑。
creators.why: His strobe-lit rods that respond to sound are an early Chinese-diaspora lineage of feedback art.
creators.why_zh: 他那些随声音而动、由频闪灯照亮的钢杆，是华人离散群体中较早的反馈艺术谱系。

creators.name: Sougwen Chung
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；Scilicet 工作室创始人
creators.bio: Canadian-born, Hong Kong-raised artist who draws and paints with robot arms she builds and trains (D.O.U.G. series).
creators.bio_zh: 生于加拿大、成长于香港的艺术家，与她亲自搭建和训练的机械臂（D.O.U.G. 系列）一起绘画。
creators.why: Her practice is a long-running study of human–robot co-drawing and shared authorship.
creators.why_zh: 她的实践是一项关于人机共绘与共同作者身份的长期研究。

creators.name: Lawrence Lek
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人、音乐人
creators.bio: London-based artist of Malaysian-Chinese descent who builds films, games and simulations about AI in a 'Sinofuturist' universe.
creators.bio_zh: 马来西亚华裔、常居伦敦的艺术家，在“中华未来主义”世界观中以影像、游戏与模拟讲述 AI。
creators.why: Lek's AI characters (a satellite, a ghostwriter, self-driving cars, a carebot) are the most sustained artistic portrait of machine inner life.
creators.why_zh: 陆明龙笔下的 AI 角色（卫星、代笔者、自动驾驶汽车、护理机器人）是艺术中对机器内心最持续的描绘。

creators.name: Ian Cheng
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: American artist of Chinese descent who makes live simulations: virtual ecosystems whose agents change without an end.
creators.bio_zh: 华裔美国艺术家，创作“实时模拟”：其中的智能体不断变化、没有结局的虚拟生态。
creators.why: His simulations and the AI creature BOB show agency and personality emerging from rules rather than scripts.
creators.why_zh: 他的模拟与 AI 生物 BOB 展示了能动性与个性如何从规则而非剧本中生成。

creators.name: Ted Chiang
creators.role_zh: 科幻作家
creators.bio: American science-fiction writer of Chinese descent (Stories of Your Life and Others, Exhalation).
creators.bio_zh: 华裔美国科幻作家（《你一生的故事》《呼吸》）。
creators.why: His fiction and essays are among the clearest thinking on what raising and relating to an AI would involve.
creators.why_zh: 他的小说与随笔是关于“养育 AI、与 AI 相处”最清醒的思考之一。

creators.name: Wendy Hui Kyong Chun
creators.role: Canada 150 Research Chair in New Media, Simon Fraser University
creators.role_zh: 西蒙弗雷泽大学新媒体加拿大 150 研究讲席
creators.bio: Media theorist and founding director of the Digital Democracies Institute; author of Programmed Visions and Updating to Remain the Same.
creators.bio_zh: 媒介理论家，数字民主研究所创所所长，著有《程序化的视觉》《更新以保持不变》。
creators.why: She shows how machine learning's correlations reproduce segregation.
creators.why_zh: 她揭示了机器学习的相关性如何复制隔离。

creators.name: Lydia H. Liu
creators.role: Wun Tsun Tam Professor in the Humanities, Columbia University
creators.role_zh: 哥伦比亚大学谭维信人文讲席教授
creators.bio: Theorist of media and translation and scholar of comparative literature.
creators.bio_zh: 媒介与翻译理论家、比较文学学者。
creators.why: The Freudian Robot reads cybernetics and information theory as a theory of the unconscious.
creators.why_zh: 《弗洛伊德机器人》把控制论与信息论读作一种关于无意识的理论。

creators.name: Yuk Hui
creators.role: Philosopher; Professor of Philosophy, Erasmus University Rotterdam
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；鹿特丹伊拉斯谟大学哲学教授
creators.bio: Hong Kong-born philosopher of technology known for the concepts of digital objects, cosmotechnics and technodiversity.
creators.bio_zh: 生于香港的技术哲学家，以“数码物”“宇宙技术”“技术多样性”等概念著称。
creators.why: He gives machine phenomenology a non-Western frame: technology is always bound to a cosmology.
creators.why_zh: 他为机器现象学提供了非西方的框架：技术总是与某种宇宙观相连。

creators.name: Verena Friedrich
creators.bio: German artist who builds precise machines and lab setups that deal with life extension, measurement and automated judgement.
creators.why: ERBSENZÄHLER turns the hidden human judgement inside 'intelligent' sorting systems into a workstation visitors must sit at.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家，制作精密的机器和实验装置，处理延长寿命、测量与自动化判断等问题。
creators.why_zh: ERBSENZÄHLER 把“智能”分拣系统里被隐藏的人类判断，变成观众必须坐下来操作的工位。

creators.name: Zoran Srdić Janežič
creators.role: Sculptor and intermedia artist; PhD researcher at AGRFT, University of Ljubljana
creators.bio: Slovenian sculptor who works with animatronics, 3D design and living tissue; since 2019 he has led the Biobot series with Kapelica Gallery and BioTehna Lab.
creators.why: His Biobot series lets signals from the artist's own reprogrammed neurons shape and move a robot body.
creators.role_zh: 雕塑家、跨媒介艺术家；卢布尔雅那大学 AGRFT 博士研究者
creators.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚
creators.bio_zh: 斯洛文尼亚雕塑家，使用动画机械、三维设计和活体组织创作；自 2019 年起与 Kapelica 画廊和 BioTehna 实验室合作推进 Biobot 系列。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Biobot 系列让由艺术家自身细胞重编程而来的神经元信号去塑造并驱动机器人身体。

creators.name: Felix Lenz
creators.bio: Designer and filmmaker trained in Design Investigations at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, working on the material and human costs of technology.
creators.why: The Cleanroom Paradox, made with Angela Neubauer and Eszter Zwickl, traces the illness of a chip-factory worker behind the clean image of high tech.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、电影人
creators.bio_zh: 毕业于维也纳应用艺术大学 Design Investigations 专业的设计师与电影人，关注技术的物质代价与人的代价。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Angela Neubauer、Eszter Zwickl 合作的 The Cleanroom Paradox，追索了高科技洁净形象背后一位芯片厂工人的疾病。

creators.name: Angela Neubauer
creators.bio: Designer from the Design Investigations programme at the University of Applied Arts Vienna.
creators.why: Co-author of The Cleanroom Paradox on occupational illness in semiconductor production.
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio_zh: 来自维也纳应用艺术大学 Design Investigations 专业的设计师。
creators.why_zh: The Cleanroom Paradox 的共同作者，这件作品关注半导体生产中的职业病。

creators.name: Eszter Zwickl
creators.bio: Designer from the Design Investigations programme at the University of Applied Arts Vienna.
creators.why: Co-author of The Cleanroom Paradox on occupational illness in semiconductor production.
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio_zh: 来自维也纳应用艺术大学 Design Investigations 专业的设计师。
creators.why_zh: The Cleanroom Paradox 的共同作者，这件作品关注半导体生产中的职业病。

creators.name: Špela Petrič
creators.role: Artist with a background in biology
creators.bio: Špela Petrič is a Slovenian artist and biologist whose performances explore relationships between humans, plants and machines.
creators.why: PL'AI imagines play rather than work as the basis for a relationship between an AI robot and cucumber plants.
creators.role_zh: 有生物学背景的艺术家
creators.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚
creators.bio_zh: Špela Petrič 是斯洛文尼亚艺术家和生物学家，以表演探索人、植物与机器之间的关系。
creators.why_zh: PL'AI 设想以“玩耍”而不是“劳动”作为 AI 机器人与黄瓜之间关系的基础。

creators.name: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado
creators.bio: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado is a Peruvian artist who combines textiles, sound and technology, drawing on Andean knowledge systems.
creators.why: AIELSON asks what a machine voice trained on Latin American poetry sounds like, and whose voice it borrows.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.based_zh: 斯德哥尔摩，瑞典 / 秘鲁
creators.bio_zh: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado 是秘鲁艺术家，结合纺织、声音与技术，并借鉴安第斯知识体系。
creators.why_zh: AIELSON 追问：用拉丁美洲诗歌训练出的机器声音听起来是什么样，它借用的又是谁的声音。

creators.name: Martyna Marciniak
creators.bio: Polish artist and researcher whose project Anatomy of Non-Fact studies visual hoaxes, fakes and synthetic images.
creators.why: She treats AI-generated fakes as forensic objects to ask what still counts as visual evidence.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 波兰艺术家与研究者，她的项目 Anatomy of Non-Fact 研究视觉骗局、伪造和合成图像。
creators.why_zh: 她把 AI 生成的假图像当作法证对象，追问什么还能算作视觉证据。

creators.name: Loïs Soleil
creators.bio: Brussels-based artist working with robots, AI and feminist self-defence.
creators.why: Tinder_gun_boys_@Brussels_ lets a weapon-detecting AI and a swiping robot harvest dating profiles, then turns them into self-defence mats.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 常驻布鲁塞尔的艺术家，结合机器人、AI 与女性主义防身实践进行创作。
creators.why_zh: Tinder_gun_boys_@Brussels_ 让一个识别武器的 AI 与一个自动滑动的机器人收集交友资料，再把它们印成防身课的垫子。

creators.name: Diane Cescutti
creators.bio: French-Senegalese artist who works with textiles, looms and computers to retell the history of computation through weaving knowledge.
creators.why: Nosukaay builds a computer from a Manjak loom and makes cloth the interface, placing computation in West African textile knowledge.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.based_zh: 巴黎，法国 / 达喀尔，塞内加尔
creators.bio_zh: 法国-塞内加尔艺术家，以织物、织机与计算机创作，通过编织知识重述计算的历史。
creators.why_zh: Nosukaay 用 Manjak 织机搭建一台计算机，以布料作为界面，把计算放回西非的纺织知识之中。

creators.name: Jan Zuiderveld
creators.bio: Dutch artist who fits everyday appliances with sensors and AI so that they talk back and act on their own terms.
creators.why: His talking coffee machine, microwave and copier make machine 'personality' in household objects tangible and slightly absurd.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，为日常家电装上传感器和 AI，让它们开口回应，并按自己的方式行事。
creators.why_zh: 他会说话的咖啡机、微波炉和复印机，让家用物件里的机器“性格”变得可感，又带点荒诞。

creators.name: Julia Vollmer
creators.bio: German artist and designer who makes the physical and energy costs of digital systems perceptible through material installations.
creators.why: to hurt for a thought lets people feel the heat of the GPU behind each AI image through the keys they type on.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家与设计师，用材料装置让数字系统的物理与能源代价变得可感。
creators.why_zh: to hurt for a thought 让人们通过正在敲击的键盘，感受到每张 AI 图像背后显卡发出的热。

creators.name: Alexandra Daisy Ginsberg
creators.role: Artist; works with synthetic biology, conservation and AI
creators.bio: Alexandra Daisy Ginsberg is a London-based artist whose work examines how humans value nature, from synthetic biology speculation to living artworks for pollinators.
creators.why: Her machine-learning pieces ask what is lost when machines imitate other species.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，创作涉及合成生物学、自然保护与人工智能
creators.bio_zh: Alexandra Daisy Ginsberg 是常驻伦敦的艺术家，作品追问人如何看待自然，从合成生物学思辨到为传粉昆虫而做的活体艺术。
creators.why_zh: 她用机器学习做的作品追问：当机器模仿其他物种时，失去了什么。

creators.name: Dasha Ilina
creators.bio: Russian-born artist based in Paris who makes low-tech, DIY objects and workshops about the relation between digital devices and the human body.
creators.why: She treats the aches caused by screens as a design brief, with cardboard, motors and humour.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 出生于俄罗斯、常驻巴黎的艺术家，用低技术的 DIY 物件和工作坊探讨数字设备与人体的关系。
creators.why_zh: 她把屏幕造成的身体酸痛当作设计课题，用纸板、马达和幽默来回应。

creators.name: Mary Flanagan
creators.role: Artist and game designer; Professor, Dartmouth College
creators.bio: Mary Flanagan makes software art, installations and games, and directs the Tiltfactor game lab at Dartmouth.
creators.why: Her installations use computational methods to expose the biases people bring to faces and machines.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、游戏设计师；达特茅斯学院教授
creators.bio_zh: Mary Flanagan 创作软件艺术、装置与游戏，并主持达特茅斯学院的 Tiltfactor 游戏实验室。
creators.why_zh: 她的装置用计算方法揭示人们看待面孔和机器时带着的偏见。
creators.based_zh: 汉诺威（新罕布什尔州），美国

creators.name: Manuel Beltrán
creators.role: Artist and researcher; founder of the Institute of Human Obsolescence
creators.bio: Spanish artist whose installations and interventions expose the power relations inside technologies, with a focus on data and automation.
creators.why: He imagines what work is left for human bodies once machines take over mechanical and mental labour.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者；Institute of Human Obsolescence 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙艺术家，以装置和介入揭示技术内部的权力关系，关注数据与自动化。
creators.why_zh: 他设想：当机器接管体力与脑力劳动之后，人的身体还剩下什么工作可做。

creators.name: Sarah Petkus
creators.bio: Sarah Petkus is an American artist, illustrator and engineer who builds characterful robots from light metals, 3D-printed parts and found objects.
creators.why: She frames robot-building as parenting: raising a machine that develops its own ways of expressing itself.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、机器人制作者
creators.bio_zh: Sarah Petkus 是美国艺术家、插画师和工程师，用轻金属、3D 打印件和现成物制作有性格的机器人。
creators.why_zh: 她把造机器人看作养育：抚养一个会发展出自身表达方式的机器。

creators.name: Frank Kolkman
creators.bio: Frank Kolkman is a Dutch designer who works on DIY medicine and technology; his Designs for Flies won the 2016 Dutch Design Award for Service & Systems.
creators.why: His DIY surgical robot asks who gets access to medical machines.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者
creators.bio_zh: Frank Kolkman 是荷兰设计师，关注 DIY 医疗与技术；他的 Designs for Flies 获得 2016 年荷兰设计奖“服务与系统”类奖项。
creators.why_zh: 他的 DIY 手术机器人追问：谁能用上医疗机器。

creators.name: Matt Richardson
creators.role: Technologist and maker; formerly NYU ITP
creators.bio: Matt Richardson is a creative technologist and author of books on Raspberry Pi and Arduino; he made the Descriptive Camera as a student at NYU's Interactive Telecommunications Program.
creators.why: His camera made hidden crowd labour the actual 'sensor' of a device.
creators.role_zh: 技术人员与创客；曾就读于纽约大学 ITP
creators.bio_zh: Matt Richardson 是创意技术人员，写过 Raspberry Pi 与 Arduino 的书；Descriptive Camera 是他在纽约大学 ITP 读书时的作品。
creators.why_zh: 他的相机让隐藏的众包劳动成为设备真正的“传感器”。

creators.name: Timo Toots
creators.bio: Estonian media artist whose installations turn state and online databases about visitors into public displays.
creators.why: He made the data shadow of a digital state visible to the people it describes.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 爱沙尼亚媒体艺术家，他的装置把国家与网络数据库里关于观众的信息变成公开展示。
creators.why_zh: 他让数字国家投下的数据阴影被当事人亲眼看到。

creators.name: Mark Shepard
creators.role: Artist and architect; Associate Professor, University at Buffalo
creators.bio: Mark Shepard is an artist, architect and researcher who works on ubiquitous computing and the city; he edited the book Sentient City (MIT Press, 2011).
creators.why: He designs counter-devices for living in a city that watches and predicts its inhabitants.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、建筑师；布法罗大学副教授
creators.bio_zh: Mark Shepard 是艺术家、建筑师与研究者，研究普适计算与城市；主编《Sentient City》（MIT Press，2011）。
creators.why_zh: 他为生活在会监视、预测居民的城市里设计反制装置。

creators.name: Golan Levin
creators.role: Artist; Professor, Carnegie Mellon University; director of the STUDIO for Creative Inquiry
creators.bio: Golan Levin makes interactive installations, performances and software that explore computer vision, gesture and communication.
creators.why: His works often give machines a gaze that looks back at the people it tracks.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；卡内基梅隆大学教授，STUDIO for Creative Inquiry 主任
creators.bio_zh: Golan Levin 创作互动装置、表演与软件，探索计算机视觉、手势与交流。
creators.why_zh: 他的作品常给机器一种会回望被追踪者的目光。

creators.name: Max Dean
creators.bio: Max Dean is a British-born Canadian artist known for interactive and robotic works that implicate the viewer.
creators.why: He conceived The Robotic Chair in 1984 and spent over twenty years realising it.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: Max Dean 是出生于英国的加拿大艺术家，以让观众卷入其中的互动与机器人作品著称。
creators.why_zh: 他在 1984 年构想了 The Robotic Chair，用了二十多年才实现。

creators.name: Raffaello D'Andrea
creators.role: Roboticist; Professor, ETH Zurich; co-founder of Kiva Systems
creators.bio: Canadian-Italian engineer known for autonomous systems, from Kiva warehouse robots to flying machines, and for art collaborations with Max Dean.
creators.why: He brought control engineering into artworks about machine autonomy.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；苏黎世联邦理工学院教授，Kiva Systems 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大裔意大利工程师，以自主系统著称，从 Kiva 仓储机器人到飞行机器，并与 Max Dean 有艺术合作。
creators.why_zh: 他把控制工程带进关于机器自主性的艺术作品。

creators.name: Matt Donovan
creators.bio: Canadian artist and engineer who co-developed The Robotic Chair with Max Dean and Raffaello D'Andrea.
creators.why: He helped build one of the best-known works about machine failure and repair.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家与工程师，与 Max Dean、Raffaello D'Andrea 共同开发 The Robotic Chair。
creators.why_zh: 他参与制作了关于机器失败与修复最著名的作品之一。

creators.name: Electric Circus
creators.role: Robot street-theatre company (Mirjam Langemeijer and Fred Abels)
creators.bio: Collaboration between puppeteer Mirjam Langemeijer and inventor Fred Abels, who combine animatronics and puppetry into lifelike robot characters for street theatre.
creators.why: They put androids on the street without a gallery frame and watch how people respond.
creators.role_zh: 机器人街头剧团（Mirjam Langemeijer 与 Fred Abels）
creators.bio_zh: 木偶师 Mirjam Langemeijer 与发明家 Fred Abels 的合作，把电子动画技术与木偶戏结合成逼真的机器人街头角色。
creators.why_zh: 他们把仿真人放到没有画廊框架的街头，观察人们如何回应。

creators.name: Danja Vasiliev
creators.bio: Russian-born artist in Berlin who works with networks, hardware and software exploits; co-author of the Critical Engineering Manifesto.
creators.why: He turns network infrastructure into a stage where surveillance becomes visible.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、批判性工程师
creators.bio_zh: 出生于俄罗斯、在柏林工作的艺术家，用网络、硬件与软件漏洞创作；《批判性工程宣言》合著者。
creators.why_zh: 他把网络基础设施变成让监控现形的舞台。

creators.name: Martin Riches
creators.role: Artist; builds musical and talking machines
creators.bio: British-born artist in Berlin who has built mechanical instruments and speaking machines since the 1970s.
creators.why: His machines make computation and speech audible as mechanical events.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，制作音乐机器与会说话的机器
creators.bio_zh: 出生于英国、在柏林工作的艺术家，自 1970 年代起制作机械乐器和会说话的机器。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器把计算与言语变成可以听见的机械事件。

creators.name: Masahiro Miwa
creators.bio: Japanese composer known for 'reverse simulation music', in which performers or machines execute algorithms as musical rules.
creators.why: He composes with algorithms that humans and machines must carry out step by step.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家；IAMAS 教授
creators.bio_zh: 日本作曲家，以“逆模拟音乐”著称：由演奏者或机器把算法当作音乐规则来执行。
creators.why_zh: 他用必须由人或机器一步步执行的算法来作曲。

creators.name: Gonçalo F. Cardoso
creators.role: Composer and sound artist; founder of the label Discrepant
creators.bio: Portuguese composer and field recordist who runs the experimental label Discrepant.
creators.why: He treats machine noise as field recordings worth composing with.
creators.role_zh: 作曲家、声音艺术家；唱片厂牌 Discrepant 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 葡萄牙作曲家、田野录音者，经营实验厂牌 Discrepant。
creators.why_zh: 他把机器噪声当作值得入曲的田野录音。

creators.name: Boris Petrovsky
creators.bio: German artist who builds installations and performative sculptures from networked everyday machines and signs.
creators.why: He gives household appliances a collective machine voice.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家，用联网的日常机器与标识制作装置和表演性雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 他让家用电器拥有一种集体的机器声音。

creators.name: Gilberto Esparza
creators.role: Artist working with robotics, biotechnology and ecology
creators.role_zh: 以机器人、生物技术和生态为媒介的艺术家
creators.bio: Mexican artist who builds autonomous bio-machines and robotic 'parasites' that live off urban electricity, polluted rivers and sewage.
creators.bio_zh: 墨西哥艺术家，制作依靠城市电网、污染河流和污水生存的自主生物机器与机器人“寄生体”。
creators.why: His robots are small artificial species with a metabolism and a habitat, a Global South line of A-life art twice recognised by VIDA and by a Prix Ars Electronica Golden Nica.
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人是拥有新陈代谢和栖息地的人造小物种，是来自全球南方的人工生命艺术脉络，曾两度获 VIDA 奖并获林茨电子艺术节金尼卡奖。

creators.name: Nicholas Stedman
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、机器人设计师
creators.bio: Canadian artist who builds modular, snake-like robots that touch and hold the human body.
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，制作会触摸、缠绕人体的模块化蛇形机器人。
creators.why: His robots shift social robotics from faces and eyes to touch.
creators.why_zh: 他的机器人把社交机器人从“脸与眼睛”转向“触觉”。

creators.name: Jed Berk
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师
creators.bio: American artist known for Autonomous Light Air Vessels, small blimp robots that flock, avoid obstacles and seek company.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，以“自主轻型飞艇”（ALAVs）闻名：会成群飞行、避开障碍、寻找同伴的小型飞艇机器人。
creators.why: He brought multi-agent robotics out of the lab into public space as a flock of gentle creatures.
creators.why_zh: 他把多智能体机器人从实验室带进公共空间，变成一群温和的生物。

creators.name: Sašo Sedlaček
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚
creators.bio: Slovenian artist whose low-tech machines and interventions address waste, poverty and techno-optimism.
creators.bio_zh: 斯洛文尼亚艺术家，用低技术机器与公共介入讨论废弃物、贫困与技术乐观主义。
creators.why: His Beggar Robot turns the service robot into a figure of social exclusion.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Beggar Robot 把服务机器人变成社会排斥的形象。

creators.name: Chris Sugrue
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员
creators.bio: American artist and creative coder working with interactive installations, artificial life and experimental interfaces.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家与创意编程者，创作互动装置、人工生命与实验性界面作品。
creators.why: Delicate Boundaries lets simulated creatures cross from the screen onto the visitor's skin.
creators.why_zh: Delicate Boundaries 让模拟生物从屏幕爬到观众的皮肤上。

creators.name: Emanuel Andel
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Austrian media artist who builds risky human–machine games driven by biosignals.
creators.bio_zh: 奥地利媒体艺术家，制作由生物信号驱动、带有风险的人机游戏。
creators.why: Knife.Hand.Chop.Bot makes trust in a machine a matter of the player's own skin.
creators.why_zh: Knife.Hand.Chop.Bot 让对机器的信任直接落在玩家自己的皮肤上。

creators.name: Karolina Sobecka
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Polish-born artist working with interaction, animation and environmental systems.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于波兰的艺术家，创作涉及互动、动画与环境系统。
creators.why: Sniff gives computer vision the body and manners of a dog.
creators.why_zh: Sniff 给计算机视觉安上了一只狗的身体和脾气。

creators.name: Shing Tat Chung
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师
creators.bio: British artist and designer, Royal College of Art graduate, working on belief and irrationality in technological systems.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家、设计师，毕业于皇家艺术学院，关注技术系统中的信仰与非理性。
creators.why: His Superstitious Fund exposed the faith behind algorithmic trading.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Superstitious Fund 揭示了算法交易背后的“信仰”。

creators.name: Ruairi Glynn
creators.role: Architect and artist; director of the Interactive Architecture Lab, The Bartlett, UCL
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、艺术家；伦敦大学学院巴特莱特建筑学院互动建筑实验室负责人
creators.bio: Irish-born designer of robotic and responsive architecture.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于爱尔兰的机器人与响应式建筑设计者。
creators.why: Performative Ecologies was an early example of robots that learn which gestures hold human attention.
creators.why_zh: Performative Ecologies 是较早让机器人学习“哪种动作能吸引人注意”的作品。

creators.name: Pedro Lopes
creators.role: Associate Professor of Computer Science, University of Chicago; director of the Human Computer Integration Lab
creators.role_zh: 芝加哥大学计算机科学副教授，人机融合实验室（Human Computer Integration Lab）负责人
creators.bio: Pedro Lopes studies devices that integrate with the user's body, such as electrical muscle stimulation that moves the wearer's limbs.
creators.bio_zh: Pedro Lopes 研究与使用者身体融为一体的设备，例如能驱动佩戴者肢体的肌肉电刺激。
creators.why: His art piece Ad Infinitum turns muscle-stimulation research into a machine that uses people.
creators.why_zh: 他的艺术作品 Ad Infinitum 把肌肉电刺激研究变成了一台“使用人”的机器。

creators.name: Humanising Autonomy (Maya Pindeus, Leslie Nooteboom, Raunaq Bose, Adam Bernstein)
creators.role: Design team from the RCA/Imperial Innovation Design Engineering programme, later a London start-up
creators.bio: Four graduate designers who built Blink, a two-way signalling interface between pedestrians and autonomous vehicles, and then founded a company on pedestrian-behaviour AI.
creators.why: Blink is an early design proposal for making an autonomous car show what it sees and let pedestrians answer.
creators.role_zh: 英国皇家艺术学院与帝国理工创新设计工程专业的设计团队，后成立为伦敦初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 四位研究生设计师，先做出行人与自动驾驶汽车之间双向沟通的界面 Blink，随后以行人行为 AI 为方向创办公司。
creators.why_zh: Blink 是较早的设计提案之一：让自动驾驶汽车显示它“看见”了谁，并让行人回应。

creators.name: M Eifler
creators.role: Artist and researcher in embodied interaction and computational prosthetics
creators.bio: Interdisciplinary artist (MFA, California College of the Arts 2011) who builds speculative interfaces and prosthetic systems from their own disability.
creators.why: Uses a self-trained machine-learning system as a replacement for damaged long-term memory, a personal-scale counterpoint to corporate AI.
creators.role_zh: 从事具身交互与计算义体研究的艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 跨学科艺术家（2011 年获加州艺术学院 MFA），以自身残障经验为出发点制作思辨界面与义体系统。
creators.why_zh: 用自己训练的机器学习系统替代受损的长期记忆，是对企业级 AI 的个人尺度回应。

creators.name: Christopher Kulendran Thomas
creators.bio: Tamil-British artist whose installations, often made with Annika Kuhlmann, use AI and machine-learning systems to examine how images write history and politics.
creators.why: Winner of the 3rd Human AI Art Award (2026); his work treats AI editing and generation as a machine that rewrites collective memory.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 泰米尔裔英国艺术家，常与 Annika Kuhlmann 合作，以 AI 与机器学习系统制作装置，探讨图像如何书写历史与政治。
creators.why_zh: 第三届人类 AI 艺术奖（2026）得主；他的作品把 AI 剪辑与生成看作改写集体记忆的机器。

creators.name: UBERMORGEN
creators.bio: Austrian-Swiss artist duo working since 1995 with networks, media hacks and machine systems.
creators.why: Co-authors of UNINVITED, which imagines a monster born from a botnet of hijacked surveillance cameras.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组（lizvlx 与 Hans Bernhard）
creators.bio_zh: 1995 年起活跃的奥地利—瑞士艺术家二人组，创作涉及网络、媒体入侵与机器系统。
creators.why_zh: 与 Nye Thompson 合作《UNINVITED》，想象一个从被劫持监控摄像头组成的僵尸网络中诞生的怪物。

creators.name: Dave Murray-Rust
creators.role: Researcher in human–algorithm interaction; Associate Professor, TU Delft
creators.bio: Computer scientist and designer (formerly University of Edinburgh) who works on how people live with algorithms and robotic systems.
creators.why: Co-created Lichtsuchende, a society of light-seeking robots that talk to each other in light.
creators.role_zh: 人与算法交互研究者；代尔夫特理工大学副教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家与设计师（曾任职爱丁堡大学），研究人们如何与算法和机器人系统共处。
creators.why_zh: 与人合作《Lichtsuchende》：一群以光交流、寻光的机器人社会。

creators.name: Rocio von Jungenfeld
creators.role: Artist; Lecturer in Digital Arts, University of Kent
creators.bio: Artist working with site-specific interactive installations, light and electronics.
creators.why: Co-created Lichtsuchende, whose robots form a small cybernetic society visitors can walk into.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；肯特大学数字艺术讲师
creators.bio_zh: 以特定场域互动装置、光与电子为媒介的艺术家。
creators.why_zh: 与人合作《Lichtsuchende》，其机器人组成一个观众可以走入的微型控制论社会。

creators.name: Cesar & Lois (Cesar Baio, Lucy HG Solomon)
creators.based: São Paulo, BR / San Marcos, US
creators.bio: Collective of Cesar Baio and Lucy HG Solomon (The League of Imaginary Scientists) that couples microorganisms, networks and AI into 'bhiobrid' systems.
creators.why: Their works set a fungus-like logic against machine intelligence to question who does the thinking.
creators.role_zh: 艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 由 Cesar Baio 与 Lucy HG Solomon（The League of Imaginary Scientists）组成的团体，把微生物、网络与 AI 耦合成“生物—数字混合”系统。
creators.why_zh: 他们让类真菌的逻辑与机器智能相互作用，追问究竟是谁在思考。
creators.based_zh: 圣保罗，巴西／圣马科斯，美国

creators.name: Gaëtan Robillard
creators.bio: French artist who works with computation, data and sound to examine how algorithms model knowledge, from climate misinformation to cognition.
creators.why: Critical Climate Machine makes a misinformation classifier physically present, including the heat it gives off.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以计算、数据与声音探讨算法如何建模知识，题材从气候谣言到认知。
creators.why_zh: 《Critical Climate Machine》让一个谣言分类器以实体出现，连同它散发的热量。

creators.name: Monika Fleischmann
creators.role: Media artist and researcher; co-founder of ART+COM
creators.bio: German media-art pioneer who, with Wolfgang Strauss, built early interactive installations and led research at GMD / Fraunhofer (MARS lab).
creators.why: Liquid Views (1992) is an early interactive mirror in which a computer holds and dissolves the viewer's reflection.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家与研究者；ART+COM 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 德国媒体艺术先驱，与 Wolfgang Strauss 合作了早期互动装置，并在 GMD／弗劳恩霍夫研究所主持 MARS 实验室。
creators.why_zh: 《Liquid Views》（1992）是早期互动镜像作品：计算机留住并溶解观者的倒影。

creators.name: Wolfgang Strauss
creators.bio: German architect and media artist, long-time collaborator of Monika Fleischmann on interactive environments.
creators.why: Co-author of Liquid Views, shown in Tate Modern's Electric Dreams (2024).
creators.role_zh: 建筑师、媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国建筑师与媒体艺术家，长期与 Monika Fleischmann 合作互动环境。
creators.why_zh: 《Liquid Views》的共同作者，该作品在泰特现代的“电子之梦”（2024）中展出。

creators.name: Félix Luque Sánchez
creators.bio: Spanish artist based in Brussels who builds robotic and algorithmic installations about chaos, control and machine autonomy.
creators.why: His machines are staged as tireless actors that keep failing and trying, which gives them a strange inner life.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 常驻布鲁塞尔的西班牙艺术家，以机器人与算法装置探讨混沌、控制与机器自主性。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器像不知疲倦的演员一样反复失败、反复尝试，因此显出一种奇特的“内在”。

creators.name: Xenoangel (Marija Avramovic & Sam Twidale)
creators.role: Artist duo making real-time animations and AI-driven virtual worlds
creators.role_zh: 创作实时动画与 AI 驱动虚拟世界的艺术家二人组
creators.bio: Marija Avramovic and Sam Twidale work as Xenoangel, building game-engine worlds whose characters act on their own.
creators.bio_zh: Marija Avramovic 与 Sam Twidale 以 Xenoangel 之名合作，用游戏引擎搭建由角色自主行动的虚拟世界。
creators.why: They treat AI agents in simulations through the lens of animism, as spirits living in objects.
creators.why_zh: 他们借万物有灵的视角看待模拟中的 AI 智能体，把它们当作栖居在物体里的精灵。

creators.name: Justine Emard
creators.role: Visual artist working with neuroscience, robotics and machine learning
creators.role_zh: 结合神经科学、机器人和机器学习的视觉艺术家
creators.bio: French artist who combines photography, video, robotics and AI; her works draw on data from bees, brains and androids.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，结合摄影、影像、机器人和人工智能；作品数据来自蜜蜂、大脑和仿人机器人。
creators.why: She stages encounters between humans and learning machines, such as a dancer and the android Alter, as a search for a shared language.
creators.why_zh: 她让人与会学习的机器相遇，例如舞者与仿人机器人 Alter，以此寻找一种共同的语言。

creators.name: Rachel Ara
creators.role_zh: 观念与数据艺术家
creators.bio: London artist who worked 25 years as a computer systems designer before making neon and data sculptures about value, gender and tech.
creators.bio_zh: 伦敦艺术家，做了 25 年计算机系统设计师后，开始创作关于价值、性别与科技的霓虹与数据雕塑。
creators.why: Her self-valuing artwork lets an algorithm decide what art is worth, in public.
creators.why_zh: 她那件会给自己估价的作品，让算法当众决定艺术值多少钱。

creators.name: Steffen Weiß
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio: German designer who co-authored The Chair Project with Philipp Schmitt.
creators.bio_zh: 德国设计师，与 Philipp Schmitt 合作完成 The Chair Project。
creators.why: Co-author of a key design experiment on generative models as a prompt for human imagination.
creators.why_zh: 一项重要设计实验的合著者：把生成模型当作激发人类想象的起点。

creators.name: Stephan Bogner
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio: German interaction designer (HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd) and co-author of Raising Robotic Natives.
creators.bio_zh: 德国交互设计师（施瓦本格明德设计学院毕业），Raising Robotic Natives 的合作者之一。
creators.why: His student project coined the idea of 'robotic natives', children raised alongside robots.
creators.why_zh: 他的学生项目提出了“机器人原住民”的概念：与机器人一起长大的孩子。

creators.name: Jonas Voigt
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio: German designer, co-author of Raising Robotic Natives with Stephan Bogner and Philipp Schmitt.
creators.bio_zh: 德国设计师，与 Stephan Bogner、Philipp Schmitt 合作 Raising Robotic Natives。
creators.why: Co-author of a design fiction about children growing up with industrial robots at home.
creators.why_zh: 一则设计虚构的合作者：孩子在家中与工业机器人一起长大。

creators.name: David Link
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、媒介考古学者
creators.bio: German artist and researcher who rebuilds early computers and programs, such as the Ferranti Mark 1 and Strachey's love-letter generator.
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家与研究者，重建早期计算机与程序，例如 Ferranti Mark 1 和 Strachey 的情书生成器。
creators.why: He makes the first computer-generated feelings run again on a working replica.
creators.why_zh: 他让第一批由计算机生成的“情感”在一台可运行的复制机上再次运转。

creators.name: ORLAN
creators.role: Artist working with performance, surgery, biotechnology and robotics
creators.role_zh: 以表演、外科手术、生物技术和机器人创作的艺术家
creators.bio: French artist known for her surgery-performances of the 1990s and later work with cell culture, avatars and robots.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以 1990 年代的外科手术表演闻名，后来转向细胞培养、虚拟化身与机器人创作。
creators.why: With ORLAN-OÏDE she built a talking robot double of herself and asked what remains of the artist.
creators.why_zh: 她用 ORLAN-OÏDE 造出会说话的机器人分身，追问艺术家本人还剩下什么。

creators.name: Nicolas Darrot
creators.role: Artist making automata and robotic sculpture
creators.role_zh: 创作自动机与机器雕塑的艺术家
creators.bio: French artist (born 1972) who builds electromechanical puppets and automata that mix animal, human and machine.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家（1972 年生），制作混合动物、人与机器的机电木偶与自动机。
creators.why: His small machines stage learning, command and failure as tragicomic scenes.
creators.why_zh: 他的小机器把学习、命令与失败演成悲喜剧场景。

creators.name: Driessens & Verstappen
creators.role: Artist duo (Erwin Driessens and Maria Verstappen)
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组（Erwin Driessens 与 Maria Verstappen）
creators.bio: Dutch duo working since 1990 with generative systems, artificial life and robots that produce forms and sensations.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰二人组，自 1990 年起用生成系统、人工生命和机器人创造形态与感受。
creators.why: Tickle Salon turns a robot's learning of a body into a tactile experience for the visitor.
creators.why_zh: 《Tickle Salon》把机器人对身体的学习，变成观众可以亲身感受的触觉体验。

creators.name: L.A. Raeven
creators.role: Artist duo (twin sisters Liesbeth and Angelique Raeven)
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组（双胞胎姐妹 Liesbeth 与 Angelique Raeven）
creators.bio: Dutch twin sisters whose installations and performances examine body norms, likeness and identity.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰双胞胎姐妹，其装置与表演审视身体规范、相似性与身份。
creators.why: They had a crying robot clone of themselves built, a third sister who needs comfort.
creators.why_zh: 她们为自己造了一个会哭的机器人克隆，一个需要被安慰的“第三个姐妹”。

creators.name: Julian Charrière
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Swiss-French artist whose sculptures, films and expeditions deal with geology, extraction and deep time.
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士裔法国艺术家，以雕塑、电影和考察处理地质、开采与深时间。
creators.why: He returns computers to rock, showing the mineral body under digital technology.
creators.why_zh: 他把电脑还原成岩石，展示数字技术之下的矿物之躯。

creators.name: Vincent Fournier
creators.role_zh: 摄影师、艺术家
creators.bio: French photographer whose series look at space exploration, robots and imagined future life forms.
creators.bio_zh: 法国摄影师，作品关注太空探索、机器人和想象中的未来生命形态。
creators.why: The Man Machine photographs real humanoid robots in labs and homes as if they were people sitting for portraits.
creators.why_zh: 《The Man Machine》在实验室与家中拍摄真实的人形机器人，像为人拍肖像一样。

creators.name: Pierre Huyghe
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: French artist who builds living, self-changing situations with animals, plants, microbes and machine learning systems that continue without the audience.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，用动物、植物、微生物和机器学习系统搭建会自行变化的活体情境，这些情境在没有观众时也照样运行。
creators.why: Huyghe's works hand authorship to nonhuman agents and show an exhibition as an ecosystem rather than a display.
creators.why_zh: Huyghe 把作者身份交给非人类行动者，把展览做成一个生态系统而不是陈列。

creators.name: Hito Steyerl
creators.bio: German artist whose essay films and installations examine images, circulation, war and computation.
creators.why: Her recent work stages neural networks and prediction as political and economic forces.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人、写作者
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家，以论文电影和装置研究图像、流通、战争与计算。
creators.why_zh: 她近年的作品把神经网络与预测呈现为政治与经济力量。

creators.name: Anna Ridler
creators.role: Artist working with data and machine learning
creators.bio: British artist who builds hand-made datasets, often of flowers, and trains generative models on them.
creators.why: She makes the labour, time and choices inside a dataset visible.
creators.role_zh: 以数据与机器学习创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，亲手制作数据集（常以花卉为对象），并用它们训练生成模型。
creators.why_zh: 她让数据集里的劳动、时间与选择变得可见。

creators.name: Jake Elwes
creators.bio: British artist whose work explores AI through queer performance, landscape and feedback between networks.
creators.why: He shows what models do when they are left to talk, dream or misclassify.
creators.role_zh: 以机器学习创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，通过酷儿表演、风景以及网络之间的反馈来探讨 AI。
creators.why_zh: 他展示模型在被放任对话、做梦或误分类时会做什么。

creators.name: Jenna Sutela
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: Finnish artist who works with microbes, slime moulds and machine learning to explore language and cognition beyond the human.
creators.bio_zh: 芬兰艺术家，与微生物、黏菌和机器学习合作，探索超越人类的语言与认知。
creators.why: Sutela's works set up conversations between bacteria, algorithms and people, treating each as a possible author.
creators.why_zh: 其作品让细菌、算法与人之间展开对话，把每一方都视为可能的作者。

creators.name: K Allado-McDowell
creators.role: Writer, musician; founder of Artists + Machine Intelligence at Google
creators.bio: Writer and artist who co-wrote several books with large language models and ran Google's Artists + Machine Intelligence programme.
creators.why: An early voice treating language models as partners in thought.
creators.role_zh: 作家、音乐人；谷歌 Artists + Machine Intelligence 项目创办人
creators.bio_zh: 作家与艺术家，与大语言模型合写了数本书，并主持过谷歌的 Artists + Machine Intelligence 项目。
creators.why_zh: 较早把语言模型当作思考伙伴的人之一。

creators.name: Janelle Shane
creators.role: Optics research scientist; author of AI Weirdness
creators.bio: Researcher and writer who documents the odd behaviour of neural networks for a general audience.
creators.why: Her work teaches through failure what models actually learn.
creators.role_zh: 光学研究科学家；AI Weirdness 作者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者与作者，面向大众记录神经网络的古怪行为。
creators.why_zh: 她通过失败来讲清模型究竟学到了什么。

creators.name: Terence Broad
creators.role: Artist and researcher, UAL Creative Computing Institute
creators.bio: British artist-researcher who manipulates the internals of generative networks rather than their data.
creators.why: He makes the machine's own dynamics, not its training data, the subject.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者，伦敦艺术大学创意计算学院
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家兼研究者，操控生成网络的内部结构，而非它们的数据。
creators.why_zh: 他让机器自身的动力学而非训练数据成为作品的主题。

creators.name: Eryk Salvaggio
creators.role: Artist and researcher on critical AI
creators.bio: American artist and writer who makes glitch-based films and essays about generative models and archives.
creators.why: He uses the failure modes of diffusion models to reveal their training data.
creators.role_zh: 批判性 AI 艺术家与研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家与作者，以故障影像和随笔探讨生成模型与档案。
creators.why_zh: 他利用扩散模型的失效模式揭示其训练数据。

creators.name: Alexander Mordvintsev
creators.bio: Researcher who created DeepDream and later worked on neural cellular automata.
