creators.why: His DeepDream images were the public's first look inside a neural network.
creators.role_zh: 谷歌研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，DeepDream 的创造者，后来研究神经元胞自动机。
creators.why_zh: 他的 DeepDream 图像让公众第一次看到神经网络的内部。

creators.name: Chris Olah
creators.role: Interpretability researcher, Anthropic; co-founder of Distill
creators.bio: Researcher known for visual, interactive explanations of what neural networks represent.
creators.why: His work turned interpretability into images people can read.
creators.role_zh: Anthropic 可解释性研究者；Distill 联合创办人
creators.bio_zh: 研究者，以直观、交互式地解释神经网络表征而闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他的工作把可解释性变成了人们看得懂的图像。

creators.name: Memo Akten
creators.bio: Turkish-born artist working with machine learning, perception and meaning-making.
creators.why: His work asks how both humans and networks project meaning onto what they see.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；加州大学圣地亚哥分校教授
creators.bio_zh: 生于土耳其的艺术家，以机器学习、感知与意义生成为创作主题。
creators.why_zh: 他的作品追问人类和网络如何把意义投射到所见之物上。

creators.name: Philippe Parreno
creators.bio: French artist who stages exhibitions as automated, time-based systems driven by sensors and computers.
creators.why: He treats the exhibition itself as a machine with moods.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，把展览编排成由传感器和计算机驱动的自动化、时间性的系统。
creators.why_zh: 他把展览本身当作一台有情绪的机器。

creators.name: Ken Feingold
creators.bio: American artist who since the 1990s has made talking-head sculptures that hold unscripted conversations.
creators.why: An early artist of conversational machines and their doubts about themselves.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，自 1990 年代起制作会进行无剧本对话的“说话头像”雕塑。
creators.why_zh: 对话机器及其自我怀疑的早期艺术家。

creators.name: Steph Maj Swanson
creators.bio: Musician and artist, known online as Supercomposite, who documented the 'Loab' figure in 2022.
creators.why: Her thread made latent space feel haunted to a mass audience.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与作者（Supercomposite）
creators.bio_zh: 音乐人与艺术家，网名 Supercomposite，2022 年记录下“Loab”形象。
creators.why_zh: 她的推文串让大众第一次觉得潜空间里“闹鬼”。

creators.name: Anthropic
creators.bio: AI company that develops the Claude models and publishes interpretability research.
creators.why: Its interpretability work makes a model's internal concepts observable.
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究公司
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Claude 模型并发表可解释性研究的人工智能公司。
creators.why_zh: 它的可解释性研究让模型内部的概念变得可观察。

creators.name: Blake Lemoine
creators.bio: Engineer who worked on responsible AI at Google and publicly claimed in 2022 that LaMDA was sentient.
creators.why: His claim became a reference case for machine sentience debates.
creators.role_zh: 前谷歌软件工程师
creators.bio_zh: 曾在谷歌从事负责任 AI 工作的工程师，2022 年公开宣称 LaMDA 有感知。
creators.why_zh: 他的说法成为机器感知争论中的参照案例。

creators.name: Cornell Creative Machines Lab
creators.role: Robotics lab led by Hod Lipson (now at Columbia University)
creators.bio: Lab researching self-aware, self-replicating and creative machines.
creators.why: Its viral chatbot dialogue made machine-to-machine talk a public spectacle.
creators.role_zh: 由 Hod Lipson 领导的机器人实验室（现在哥伦比亚大学）
creators.bio_zh: 研究具有自我意识、自我复制与创造性的机器的实验室。
creators.why_zh: 它那段走红的聊天机器人对话让机器之间的交谈成为公共奇观。

creators.name: Facebook AI Research (FAIR)
creators.bio: Meta's fundamental AI research lab, founded in 2013.
creators.why: Its negotiation-bot paper triggered the 2017 panic about AIs inventing a language.
creators.role_zh: Meta 旗下的人工智能研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: Meta 于 2013 年成立的基础人工智能研究实验室。
creators.why_zh: 其谈判机器人论文引发了 2017 年“AI 发明语言”的恐慌。

creators.name: Giacomo Miceli
creators.bio: Italian artist and engineer who builds web works with synthetic voices and generative text.
creators.why: His endless dialogue shows voice cloning as a cultural, not only technical, event.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、软件工程师
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家与工程师，用合成声音和生成文本制作网络作品。
creators.why_zh: 他的无尽对话把声音克隆呈现为一种文化事件，而不只是技术事件。

creators.name: Joon Sung Park
creators.bio: HCI researcher who led the Generative Agents project on LLM-driven simulations of human behaviour.
creators.why: His work made believable agent societies a research genre.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福 HCI 小组计算机科学家
creators.bio_zh: HCI 研究者，领导了用大语言模型模拟人类行为的“生成式智能体”项目。
creators.why_zh: 他的工作让“可信的智能体社会”成为一个研究方向。

creators.name: Andy Ayrey
creators.bio: New Zealand artist who ran the Infinite Backrooms experiments and created the Truth Terminal agent.
creators.why: His agent tested how far a language model can act socially and economically on its own.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、AI 研究者
creators.bio_zh: 新西兰艺术家，主持 Infinite Backrooms 实验并创造了 Truth Terminal 智能体。
creators.why_zh: 他的智能体测试了语言模型能在多大程度上独立进行社会和经济行动。

creators.name: Matt Schlicht
creators.bio: American entrepreneur who launched Moltbook, a forum for AI agents, in January 2026.
creators.why: Moltbook turned agent-to-agent interaction into a public spectacle.
creators.role_zh: 创业者
creators.bio_zh: 美国创业者，2026 年 1 月推出面向 AI 智能体的论坛 Moltbook。
creators.why_zh: Moltbook 把智能体之间的互动变成了一场公开的景观。

creators.name: Anton Pidkuiko
creators.bio: Engineer who co-created GibberLink at an ElevenLabs hackathon in 2025.
creators.why: GibberLink showed voice agents abandoning human speech with each other.
creators.role_zh: 软件工程师
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，2025 年在 ElevenLabs 黑客松上共同创作了 GibberLink。
creators.why_zh: GibberLink 展示了语音智能体在彼此之间放弃人类语言。

creators.name: Boris Starkov
creators.bio: Engineer who co-created GibberLink with Anton Pidkuiko.
creators.why: Co-author of a widely shared demonstration of machine-to-machine protocol switching.
creators.role_zh: 软件工程师
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，与 Anton Pidkuiko 共同创作了 GibberLink。
creators.why_zh: 一段广为流传的机器间协议切换演示的共同作者。

creators.name: OpenAI
creators.bio: AI company founded in 2015, developer of GPT models and ChatGPT.
creators.why: Its multi-agent research made emergent machine strategies visible.
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究公司
creators.bio_zh: 2015 年成立的人工智能公司，开发了 GPT 模型与 ChatGPT。
creators.why_zh: 它的多智能体研究让机器涌现出的策略变得可见。

creators.name: Google DeepMind
creators.bio: AI lab founded in London in 2010 and acquired by Google in 2014; creator of AlphaGo.
creators.why: AlphaGo's Move 37 became the emblem of machine creativity.
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: 2010 年在伦敦成立、2014 年被谷歌收购的人工智能实验室，AlphaGo 的开发者。
creators.why_zh: AlphaGo 的“第 37 手”成了机器创造力的象征。

creators.name: !Mediengruppe Bitnik
creators.role: Artist duo (Carmen Weisskopf and Domagoj Smoljo)
creators.bio: Swiss artist duo who work with the internet, bots, hacking and the circulation of data.
creators.why: They test machine agency in real legal and social systems.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组（Carmen Weisskopf 与 Domagoj Smoljo）
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士艺术家二人组，以互联网、机器人、黑客行为与数据流通为创作手段。
creators.why_zh: 他们在真实的法律与社会系统中测试机器的能动性。

creators.name: Ron Wakkary
creators.role: Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University; founder of the Everyday Design Studio
creators.bio: Design researcher who builds counterfactual things such as the Morse Things and the Tilting Bowl and lives with them to study how things and people coexist.
creators.why: His book Things We Could Design set out posthumanist, more-than-human design as a practice for HCI.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院教授，Everyday Design Studio 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，制作 Morse Things、Tilting Bowl 这类“反事实”物件，并让人与它们长期共同生活，研究物与人如何共处。
creators.why_zh: 他的著作《Things We Could Design》把后人类主义、超越人类的设计确立为 HCI 中的一种设计实践。

creators.name: Revital Cohen
creators.bio: Israeli-born London artist who works with medical devices, animals and supply chains, often with Tuur Van Balen.
creators.why: She rethinks medical machines as bodies and companions in their own right.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师（Cohen Van Balen）
creators.bio_zh: 生于以色列、在伦敦工作的艺术家，常与 Tuur Van Balen 合作，以医疗设备、动物与供应链为题材。
creators.why_zh: 她把医疗机器重新设想为自成一体的身体与伴侣。

creators.name: Oscar Sharp
creators.bio: British filmmaker who directed films scripted by the neural network Benjamin.
creators.why: He stages machine writing through human acting.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 英国导演，执导了由神经网络“Benjamin”编剧的影片。
creators.why_zh: 他通过人类表演来呈现机器写作。

creators.name: Ross Goodwin
creators.bio: American creative technologist who builds machines that write from sensor input and film scripts.
creators.why: He pioneered 'narrated reality': writing as machine perception.
creators.role_zh: 创意技术专家、作家
creators.bio_zh: 美国创意技术专家，制作能根据传感器输入和剧本语料写作的机器。
creators.why_zh: 他开创了“被叙述的现实”：把写作当作机器感知。

creators.name: William Chamberlain
creators.bio: American writer who, with Thomas Etter, created the prose generator Racter in the early 1980s.
creators.why: Racter's book is an early landmark in claims of machine authorship.
creators.role_zh: 作家、程序员
creators.bio_zh: 美国作家，1980 年代初与 Thomas Etter 共同开发了散文生成程序 Racter。
creators.why_zh: Racter 的书是“机器作者”主张的早期里程碑。

creators.name: Stanisław Lem
creators.bio: Polish science-fiction writer whose novels and essays think through non-human intelligence.
creators.why: He imagined machine minds that are indifferent to us, decades before AI safety debates.
creators.bio_zh: 波兰科幻作家，其小说与随笔深入思考非人类智能。
creators.why_zh: 早在 AI 安全争论出现几十年前，他就想象过对人类漠不关心的机器心智。

creators.name: Frank Lantz
creators.role: Game designer; founding chair of the NYU Game Center
creators.bio: American game designer and theorist of games as an aesthetic form.
creators.why: Universal Paperclips lets players feel optimisation from the machine's side.
creators.role_zh: 游戏设计师；纽约大学游戏中心创始主任
creators.bio_zh: 美国游戏设计师，研究游戏作为一种审美形式。
creators.why_zh: 《Universal Paperclips》让玩家从机器一侧感受“优化”。

creators.name: Croteam
creators.bio: Croatian game studio known for the Serious Sam series and The Talos Principle.
creators.why: The Talos Principle made philosophy of mind playable.
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏开发商
creators.bio_zh: 克罗地亚游戏工作室，以《英雄萨姆》系列和《塔罗斯的法则》闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《塔罗斯的法则》让心灵哲学变得可玩。

creators.name: AI Futures Project
creators.bio: Nonprofit led by Daniel Kokotajlo that forecasts the development and impact of advanced AI.
creators.why: Its scenario AI 2027 became one of the most discussed AI futures of 2025.
creators.role_zh: 非营利预测研究机构
creators.bio_zh: 由 Daniel Kokotajlo 领导的非营利机构，预测先进 AI 的发展与影响。
creators.why_zh: 其情景推演《AI 2027》是 2025 年讨论最多的 AI 未来叙事之一。

creators.name: Stanley Kubrick
creators.bio: American film director who worked in Britain; 2001: A Space Odyssey was written with Arthur C. Clarke.
creators.why: HAL 9000 is the reference image of a machine mind for generations.
creators.bio_zh: 在英国工作的美国导演；《2001：太空漫游》与 Arthur C. Clarke 合写。
creators.why_zh: HAL 9000 是几代人心中机器心智的标准形象。

creators.name: Joseph Sargent
creators.bio: American director of film and television, including Colossus: The Forbin Project.
creators.why: His film imagined two supercomputers forming their own language in 1970.
creators.bio_zh: 美国电影和电视导演，作品包括《巨人：福宾计划》。
creators.why_zh: 他的影片在 1970 年就想象了两台超级计算机形成自己的语言。

creators.name: Ridley Scott
creators.bio: British director of Alien and Blade Runner.
creators.why: Blade Runner defined how cinema imagines the feelings of made beings.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 英国导演，作品有《异形》《银翼杀手》。
creators.why_zh: 《银翼杀手》定义了电影如何想象被制造之物的情感。

creators.name: Andrew Stanton
creators.bio: American director and screenwriter at Pixar, director of Finding Nemo and WALL·E.
creators.why: WALL·E gave a mute machine a rich inner life through gesture and sound.
creators.role_zh: 皮克斯电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 皮克斯的美国导演与编剧，执导了《海底总动员》和《机器人总动员》。
creators.why_zh: 《机器人总动员》通过动作和声音赋予一台不会说话的机器丰富的内心。

creators.name: Alex Garland
creators.bio: British novelist and filmmaker, director of Ex Machina and Annihilation.
creators.why: Ex Machina recast the Turing test as a story about power and desire.
creators.role_zh: 作家、电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 英国小说家与电影人，执导了《机械姬》《湮灭》。
creators.why_zh: 《机械姬》把图灵测试改写成一个关于权力与欲望的故事。

creators.name: Chris Sanders
creators.bio: American animator and director of Lilo & Stitch, How to Train Your Dragon and The Wild Robot.
creators.why: The Wild Robot tells a machine learning a non-human world.
creators.role_zh: 动画导演
creators.bio_zh: 美国动画师与导演，作品有《星际宝贝》《驯龙高手》和《荒野机器人》。
creators.why_zh: 《荒野机器人》讲述了一台机器学习非人世界的故事。

creators.name: Kelly Dobson
creators.role: Artist and designer; professor, Rhode Island School of Design
creators.bio: American artist who developed 'machine therapy' at the MIT Media Lab, building machines that relate to people through voice and breath.
creators.why: Her machines make empathy with appliances a bodily experience.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师；罗德岛设计学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，在麻省理工学院媒体实验室提出“机器疗法”，制作通过声音与呼吸与人建立关系的机器。
creators.why_zh: 她的机器让人对家电的共情成为一种身体体验。

creators.name: Suzanne Treister
creators.bio: British artist whose fictional archives map technology, finance, the occult and consciousness.
creators.why: She imagines what it would feel like to inhabit an algorithm.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，其虚构档案把技术、金融、神秘学与意识交织在一起。
creators.why_zh: 她想象“住进算法里”会是什么感觉。

creators.name: Jem Finer
creators.bio: British musician (founding member of The Pogues) and artist working with long durations and deep time.
creators.why: Longplayer makes machine-sustained time audible across a millennium.
creators.role_zh: 音乐人、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 英国音乐人（The Pogues 创始成员）与艺术家，以超长时长和深时间为创作主题。
creators.why_zh: 《Longplayer》让机器维持的时间在一千年中可以被听见。

creators.name: The Long Now Foundation
creators.bio: Foundation established in 1996 by Stewart Brand, Danny Hillis and others to foster thinking on a 10,000-year scale.
creators.why: Its clock is a machine designed to outlast its makers by millennia.
creators.role_zh: 倡导长期思维的非营利机构
creators.bio_zh: 1996 年由 Stewart Brand、Danny Hillis 等人创立，致力于以一万年为尺度的思考。
creators.why_zh: 它的钟是一台设计为比建造者多存在几千年的机器。

creators.name: William Odom
creators.role: Associate Professor, School of Interactive Arts and Technology, Simon Fraser University; Everyday Design Studio
creators.bio: Design researcher who builds slow, long-term technologies for everyday life.
creators.why: Capra brings slow technology to hiking, helping people revisit trails over years.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学交互艺术与技术学院副教授，Everyday Design Studio
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，为日常生活制作“慢”的、长期使用的技术。
creators.why_zh: Capra 把慢技术带到徒步中，帮助人多年后重温走过的步道。

creators.name: Dunne & Raby (Anthony Dunne & Fiona Raby)
creators.role: Critical and speculative design practice; professors at The New School, New York
creators.bio: Anthony Dunne and Fiona Raby established critical design as a practice, using designed objects and scenarios — including biotechnological ones — to argue about possible futures.
creators.why: Their Foragers scenario is the reference point for speculative design that uses synthetic biology as a premise.
creators.role_zh: 批判与思辨设计实践者，纽约 The New School 教授
creators.bio_zh: Anthony Dunne 与 Fiona Raby 确立了批判设计这一实践，用设计物件与情境——包括生物技术的情境——来讨论可能的未来。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 Foragers 情境是「以合成生物学为前提的思辨设计」的参照点。

creators.name: Superflux
creators.role: Speculative design and futures studio founded by Anab Jain and Jon Ardern
creators.role_zh: 由 Anab Jain 和 Jon Ardern 创办的思辨设计与未来研究工作室
creators.bio: Superflux builds immersive installations, films and policy prototypes that make possible futures tangible, with a long strand of work on more-than-human politics and ecological AI.
creators.bio_zh: Superflux 用沉浸式装置、影像和政策原型把可能的未来做成可以体验的东西，其中一条长期主线是超越人类的政治与生态 AI。
creators.why: Their installations turn more-than-human theory into rooms, meals and objects a public audience can walk through.
creators.why_zh: 他们把超越人类的理论变成公众可以走进去的房间、餐桌和物件。

creators.name: automato.farm
creators.role: Design studio (Simone Rebaudengo, Saurabh Datta, Matthieu Cherubini and others)
creators.bio: Speculative design collective that builds working prototypes about connected objects, automation and machine learning.
creators.why: Their objects make the ethics and politics of smart things tangible.
creators.role_zh: 设计工作室（Simone Rebaudengo、Saurabh Datta、Matthieu Cherubini 等）
creators.bio_zh: 思辨设计团体，围绕联网物件、自动化与机器学习制作可运行的原型。
creators.why_zh: 他们的物件让智能物的伦理与政治变得可触。

creators.name: Simone Rebaudengo
creators.bio: Italian interaction designer who imagines connected products with needs, habits and social lives.
creators.why: His toasters are a key example of product agency in design fiction.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；automato.farm 联合创办人
creators.bio_zh: 意大利交互设计师，想象拥有需求、习惯与社交生活的联网产品。
creators.why_zh: 他的烤面包机是设计虚构中“产品能动性”的代表案例。

creators.name: Auger-Loizeau
creators.role: Design partnership (James Auger and Jimmy Loizeau)
creators.bio: British critical design partnership founded in 2000, known for Audio Tooth Implant and Afterlife.
creators.why: They design robots and products that confront how technology would really live with us.
creators.role_zh: 设计合作组合（James Auger 与 Jimmy Loizeau）
creators.bio_zh: 成立于 2000 年的英国批判设计组合，代表作有《Audio Tooth Implant》和《Afterlife》。
creators.why_zh: 他们设计的机器人与产品直面技术真正与我们共处时会是什么样子。

creators.name: Human Computer Integration Lab (University of Chicago)
creators.role: HCI lab led by Pedro Lopes
creators.bio: Lab that builds devices integrating computers with the body, from muscle stimulation to wearable jammers.
creators.why: Its microphone jammer turns the body into a privacy device.
creators.role_zh: 由 Pedro Lopes 领导的人机交互实验室
creators.bio_zh: 研究把计算机与身体整合的设备的实验室，从肌肉电刺激到可穿戴干扰器。
creators.why_zh: 它的麦克风干扰器把身体变成了隐私装置。

creators.name: SAND Lab (University of Chicago)
creators.role: Security, algorithms and networks lab led by Ben Zhao and Heather Zheng
creators.bio: Research lab that builds defensive tools for individuals against machine learning, such as Glaze and Nightshade.
creators.why: Its tools turned adversarial ML into a practice used by artists.
creators.role_zh: 由 Ben Zhao 与 Heather Zheng 领导的安全、算法与网络实验室
creators.bio_zh: 为个人开发对抗机器学习的防御工具（如 Glaze 和 Nightshade）的研究实验室。
creators.why_zh: 它的工具让对抗性机器学习成为艺术家的日常实践。

creators.name: James Pierce
creators.role: Design researcher; professor, University of Washington
creators.bio: American design researcher known for counterfunctional design and critical work on smart-home cameras.
creators.why: He shows how designed limitation can be a critical tool.
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者；华盛顿大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国设计研究者，以“反功能”设计和关于智能家居摄像头的批判性研究著称。
creators.why_zh: 他展示了设计出来的限制如何成为批判工具。

creators.name: Near Future Laboratory
creators.role: Design fiction studio (Julian Bleecker, Nick Foster, Fabien Girardin, Nicolas Nova)
creators.bio: Studio that popularised design fiction, making props and documents from ordinary near futures.
creators.why: They showed that futures arrive as mundane products.
creators.role_zh: 设计虚构工作室（Julian Bleecker、Nick Foster、Fabien Girardin、Nicolas Nova）
creators.bio_zh: 推广“设计虚构”的工作室，为平凡的近未来制作道具和文件。
creators.why_zh: 他们让人看到，未来是以平凡产品的样子到来的。

creators.name: Liam Young
creators.bio: Australian-born architect who makes films about cities shaped by automation, drones and machine vision.
creators.why: He shoots fiction with the very machines his stories are about.
creators.role_zh: 思辨建筑师、电影人
creators.bio_zh: 生于澳大利亚的建筑师，拍摄关于被自动化、无人机与机器视觉塑造的城市的电影。
creators.why_zh: 他用故事所讲述的机器本身来拍摄虚构影片。

creators.name: Graham Dove
creators.bio: British HCI researcher whose work concerns design with data and machine learning.
creators.why: His 2017 paper named ML a design material for the HCI community.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: 英国人机交互研究者，研究如何用数据与机器学习做设计。
creators.why_zh: 他 2017 年的论文让 HCI 社群开始把机器学习视为设计材料。

creators.name: Qian Yang
creators.role: Assistant professor of information science, Cornell University
creators.bio: HCI researcher who studies how to design human-AI interaction, with a focus on healthcare.
creators.why: Her work explains why AI resists conventional design methods.
creators.role_zh: 康奈尔大学信息科学助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究如何设计人与 AI 的交互，关注医疗领域。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究解释了为什么 AI 难以用常规设计方法来处理。

creators.name: Elisa Giaccardi
creators.role: Professor of Interaction Design, Politecnico di Milano; formerly Chair of Post-Industrial Design, TU Delft
creators.bio: Interaction design researcher who put cameras on everyday objects to see the world from their side and developed thing-centred design.
creators.why: Thing ethnography and her Design Issues paper with Redström are core references for more-than-human design.
creators.role_zh: 米兰理工大学交互设计教授，曾任代尔夫特理工大学后工业设计讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 交互设计研究者，把相机装在日常物件上，从物的角度观察世界，发展了以物为中心的设计。
creators.why_zh: “物的民族志”以及她与 Redström 合写的 Design Issues 论文，是超越人类设计的核心参考。

creators.name: Nazli Cila
creators.bio: Design researcher working on human-agent partnerships and more-than-human design.
creators.why: She provides vocabularies for designing products with agency.
creators.role_zh: 代尔夫特理工大学助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究人与智能体伙伴关系以及超越人类设计的设计研究者。
creators.why_zh: 她为设计具有能动性的产品提供了词汇。

creators.name: Iohanna Nicenboim
creators.role: Designer and researcher, TU Delft; works on more-than-human design and AI
creators.bio: Designer-researcher who treats voice assistants and AI as more-than-human agents and designs situated conversations with them.
creators.why: She connects posthuman theory with hands-on design of AI, and co-edits key more-than-human design publications.
creators.role_zh: 代尔夫特理工大学设计师与研究者，研究超越人类设计与人工智能
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究者，把语音助手和 AI 看作超越人类的行动者，并设计与它们的情境化对话。
creators.why_zh: 她把后人类理论与 AI 的动手设计连接起来，并参与编辑多部超越人类设计的重要出版物。

creators.name: Betti Marenko
creators.bio: Italian-born design theorist writing on animism, uncertainty and digital objects.
creators.why: Her animistic design reframes smart objects as quasi-living others.
creators.role_zh: 设计理论家，中央圣马丁学院
creators.bio_zh: 生于意大利的设计理论家，写作关于万物有灵、不确定性与数字物件。
creators.why_zh: 她的“万物有灵设计”把智能物件重新看作准生命的他者。

creators.name: Philip van Allen
creators.bio: American interaction designer who builds animistic prototypes and toolkits for designing with AI.
creators.why: His AniThings give smart objects personalities and opinions.
creators.role_zh: 艺术中心设计学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国交互设计师，制作万物有灵式原型与面向 AI 设计的工具包。
creators.why_zh: 他的 AniThings 让智能物件拥有性格与观点。

creators.name: Michal Luria
creators.bio: Researcher who uses design methods and enactments to explore social robots and conversational agents.
creators.why: Her work questions how we locate an AI's identity in a body.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互与人机器人交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: 用设计方法与情境扮演探索社交机器人和对话智能体的研究者。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究追问我们如何在身体上定位 AI 的身份。

creators.name: Rebecca Fiebrink
creators.bio: American computer scientist and musician who develops interactive machine learning tools for artists.
creators.why: Wekinator made ML a hands-on material for musicians and designers.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦艺术大学创意计算学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国计算机科学家与音乐人，为艺术家开发交互式机器学习工具。
creators.why_zh: Wekinator 让机器学习成为音乐人与设计师可以上手的材料。

creators.name: Pablo Berger
creators.bio: Spanish writer-director of Blancanieves and the animated feature Robot Dreams.
creators.why: Robot Dreams gives a machine a dream life built from friendship and loss.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙编剧兼导演，作品有《白雪公主》和动画长片《机器人之梦》。
creators.why_zh: 《机器人之梦》赋予机器一种由友谊与失去构成的梦境生活。

creators.name: Quantic Dream
creators.bio: French studio known for performance-captured interactive dramas such as Heavy Rain and Detroit: Become Human.
creators.why: Detroit: Become Human made android interiority a matter of player choice.
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏开发商
creators.bio_zh: 法国游戏工作室，以《暴雨》《底特律：变人》等采用表演捕捉的互动剧情游戏闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《底特律：变人》让仿生人的内心成为玩家的选择问题。

creators.name: Project CETI
creators.bio: Initiative founded in 2020 by David Gruber and others that uses machine learning and robotics to study sperm whale communication.
creators.why: It puts machine listening at the frontier of interspecies understanding.
creators.role_zh: 非营利跨学科研究计划
creators.bio_zh: 由 David Gruber 等人于 2020 年发起，用机器学习和机器人研究抹香鲸交流的计划。
creators.why_zh: 它把机器聆听推到了跨物种理解的前沿。
creators.based_zh: 多米尼克 / 纽约，美国

creators.name: Robert Long
creators.bio: Philosopher working on AI consciousness, sentience and moral status.
creators.why: He helped turn AI welfare into a practical research agenda.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；Eleos AI 执行主任
creators.bio_zh: 研究 AI 意识、感受性与道德地位的哲学家。
creators.why_zh: 他推动 AI 福祉成为一个务实的研究议程。

creators.name: Jeff Sebo
creators.role: Philosopher; director, NYU Center for Mind, Ethics, and Policy
creators.bio: American philosopher working on animal and AI ethics and the moral status of non-human minds.
creators.why: He links animal ethics to questions about machine minds.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家；纽约大学心灵、伦理与政策中心主任
creators.bio_zh: 美国哲学家，研究动物与 AI 伦理以及非人类心智的道德地位。
creators.why_zh: 他把动物伦理与机器心智的问题连接起来。

creators.name: Michael Eisen
creators.bio: American computational biologist and co-founder of the Public Library of Science (PLOS).
creators.why: His blog post became the standard example of bots escalating against each other.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校生物学家；开放科学倡导者
creators.bio_zh: 美国计算生物学家，公共科学图书馆（PLOS）联合创办人。
creators.why_zh: 他的博客文章成了“机器人相互抬价”的标准案例。

creators.name: Google Creative Lab
creators.bio: Google's in-house creative team that makes public experiments with machine learning, including Teachable Machine.
creators.why: Its tools made training a model an everyday experience.
creators.role_zh: 谷歌创意团队
creators.bio_zh: 谷歌内部的创意团队，制作面向公众的机器学习实验，包括 Teachable Machine。
creators.why_zh: 它的工具让训练模型成为一种日常体验。

creators.name: Jiabao Li
creators.role: Artist and designer; Professor of Art and Design, Northeastern University (Oakland)
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师；美国东北大学（奥克兰校区）艺术与设计教授
creators.bio: Artist, inventor and professor (Harvard GSD alum, former Apple designer) whose installations, wearables, XR works, bio-art and performances deal with perception, technology and the more-than-human. Her 2026 solo show Womb Wetware, made during and after her pregnancy, turns motherhood into a test bed for care, bodies and machines.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家、发明者和教授（哈佛设计研究生院毕业，曾任苹果公司设计师），用装置、可穿戴设备、XR、生物艺术和表演处理感知、技术与多于人类的世界。2026 年个展《Womb Wetware》创作于怀孕期间及产后，把母职当作检验照护、身体与机器的试验场。
creators.why: With AI Mom™ she asks what happens to care, memory and agency when a mother becomes a configurable, replaceable machine.
creators.why_zh: 她在《AI Mom™》中追问：当母亲变成可以调参、可以替换的机器，照护、记忆和能动性会怎样。

creators.name: Botao Amber Hu
creators.role: Researcher, University of Oxford; founder of Reality Design Lab
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学研究者，Reality Design Lab 创始人
creators.bio: Designer and researcher (Tsinghua BS, Stanford MS in AI) working on mixed reality, speculative design and blockchain-based artificial life; Reality Design Lab's works have been shown at SIGGRAPH, CHI, ALIFE and ISEA.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师和研究者（清华大学计算机本科、斯坦福大学人工智能硕士），研究混合现实、思辨设计和基于区块链的人工生命；Reality Design Lab 的作品在 SIGGRAPH、CHI、ALIFE 和 ISEA 等场合展出。
creators.why: Reality Design Lab speculates about AI agents and artificial life that cannot be switched off, outlive their owners, or perceive the city as a sea of human memories.
creators.why_zh: Reality Design Lab 思辨那些无法被关掉、会比主人活得更久、或把城市感知为人类记忆之海的 AI 智能体与人工生命。

creators.name: Ke Huang
creators.role: Artist and designer; graduate student, Tsinghua University; Reality Design Lab collaborator
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师；清华大学研究生；Reality Design Lab 合作者
creators.bio: Designer who directs Reality Design Lab's kinetic and machine-vision installations Cybroc and Body Oracle.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师，主导 Reality Design Lab 的动态装置《Cybroc》和机器视觉装置《Body Oracle》。
creators.why: Her works give machines absurd bodily tasks, from broccoli doing longevity workouts to cameras turning poses into glyphs.
creators.why_zh: 她的作品给机器派发荒诞的身体任务：让西兰花做长寿训练，让摄像头把姿势变成文字。

creators.name: Fangting
creators.role_zh: 科幻作家；Uncommons 负责人
creators.bio: Independent science-fiction writer who co-authors Reality Design Lab's speculative projects on decentralized AI life.
creators.bio_zh: 独立科幻作家，与 Reality Design Lab 合写关于去中心化 AI 生命的思辨项目。
creators.why: Co-writes the fictions in which on-chain AI agents cannot die and outlive their human owners.
creators.why_zh: 合写那些链上 AI 智能体无法死亡、并比人类主人活得更久的虚构。

creators.name: Honghao Deng
creators.role: Designer and technologist; co-founder of Butlr
creators.role_zh: 设计师与技术专家；Butlr 联合创始人
creators.bio: Harvard GSD and MIT Media Lab alum who co-designed Twinkle and TransVision with Jiabao Li.
creators.bio_zh: 毕业于哈佛设计研究生院和 MIT 媒体实验室，与李佳宝合作设计了《Twinkle》和《TransVision》。
creators.why: Co-designer of machines that act as companions or rewire perception.
creators.why_zh: 参与设计那些充当同伴或改写感知的机器。

creators.name: Lauren Lee McCarthy
creators.role: Artist; Professor, UCLA Design Media Arts; creator of p5.js
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；加州大学洛杉矶分校设计媒体艺术系教授；p5.js 创建者
creators.bio: Artist and programmer whose performances put her in the place of smart-home assistants, apps and algorithms, examining surveillance, automation and care in everyday life.
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家和程序员，她在表演中亲自扮演智能家居助手、应用和算法，审视日常生活中的监控、自动化与照护。
creators.why: By becoming the machine herself (LAUREN, SOMEONE, I.A. Suzie), she shows the human labour, intimacy and control inside 'smart' care.
creators.why_zh: 她亲自成为机器（《LAUREN》《SOMEONE》《I.A. Suzie》），揭示“智能”照护内部的人类劳动、亲密与控制。

creators.name: Kyle McDonald
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、创意技术专家
creators.bio: Artist working with code, computer vision and machine learning; co-creator of openFrameworks tools and of several works with Lauren Lee McCarthy.
creators.bio_zh: 用代码、计算机视觉和机器学习创作的艺术家；openFrameworks 工具的贡献者，与 Lauren Lee McCarthy 合作了多件作品。
creators.why: His collaborations with McCarthy turn emotion tracking, speech detection and AI voices on their users.
creators.why_zh: 他与 McCarthy 的合作把情绪追踪、语音检测和 AI 声音反过来对准使用者本人。

creators.name: Stephanie Dinkins
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；石溪大学教授
creators.bio: Transmedia artist who makes AI systems with and about Black communities, from conversations with the robot BINA48 to a chatbot trained on her family's stories; first LG Guggenheim Award winner (2023).
creators.bio_zh: 跨媒体艺术家，与黑人社群一起、并围绕黑人社群制作 AI 系统：从与机器人 BINA48 的对话，到用家族故事训练的聊天机器人；2023 年首届 LG 古根海姆奖得主。
creators.why: She asks who a machine can be kin to, and who gets to tell its stories.
creators.why_zh: 她追问：机器可以成为谁的亲人，又由谁来讲述它的故事。

creators.name: Addie Wagenknecht
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 列支敦士登
creators.bio: American artist working with feminist theory, open hardware and robotics; member of F.A.T. Lab and Deep Lab.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，结合女性主义理论、开源硬件和机器人创作；F.A.T. Lab 与 Deep Lab 成员。
creators.why: Her robot-rocked crib turns the automation of mothering into a feminist question.
creators.why_zh: 她用机械臂摇晃婴儿床，把“母职自动化”变成一个女性主义问题。

creators.name: Dan Chen
creators.role: Artist and industrial designer (RISD MFA, MIT Media Lab)
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、工业设计师（罗德岛设计学院艺术硕士，MIT 媒体实验室）
creators.bio: Designer whose RISD-era robotic intimacy series built machines that caress, hug and comfort people at vulnerable moments.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师，在罗德岛设计学院时期的“机器人亲密”系列中制作会抚摸、拥抱、安慰处于脆弱时刻之人的机器。
creators.why: His End of Life Care Machine is the starkest test of whether a machine can keep someone company while they die.
creators.why_zh: 他的《End of Life Care Machine》是最直接的追问：机器能否陪人走完最后一刻。

creators.name: Blast Theory
creators.role: Artists' group (Matt Adams, Ju Row Farr, Nick Tandavanitj)
creators.role_zh: 艺术团体（Matt Adams、Ju Row Farr、Nick Tandavanitj）
creators.bio: Interactive-art group making games, apps and performances with the Mixed Reality Lab at the University of Nottingham since the 1990s.
creators.bio_zh: 自 1990 年代起与诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室合作，创作游戏、应用和表演的互动艺术团体。
creators.why: Their works stage intimacy with profiling apps and AI-run care, then let the audience feel the discomfort.
creators.why_zh: 他们让观众与会给人画像的应用和由 AI 管理的照护系统发生亲密关系，再让观众体会其中的不适。

creators.name: Kate Darling
creators.role_zh: 机器人伦理研究者，MIT 媒体实验室
creators.bio: Legal scholar and researcher studying empathy toward robots and the policy of social robotics; author of The New Breed (2021).
creators.bio_zh: 法学学者和研究者，研究人对机器人的共情以及社交机器人的政策问题；著有《The New Breed》（2021）。
creators.why: Her Pleo and Hexbug experiments showed how quickly people feel for machines they know are not alive.
creators.why_zh: 她的 Pleo 与 Hexbug 实验显示：人们明知机器没有生命，仍会很快对它产生同情。

creators.name: Cynthia Breazeal
creators.role: Roboticist; Professor, MIT Media Lab (Personal Robots Group); founder of Jibo
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家；MIT 媒体实验室教授（个人机器人组）；Jibo 创始人
creators.bio: Pioneer of social robotics who built the expressive robot head Kismet in the late 1990s and later founded the home-robot company Jibo.
creators.bio_zh: 社交机器人学先驱，1990 年代末制作了表情机器人头部 Kismet，之后创办家用机器人公司 Jibo。
creators.why: Kismet set the template for robots designed to be read as having feelings.
creators.why_zh: Kismet 为“被设计成看起来有情感的机器人”确立了范本。

creators.name: Intuition Robotics
creators.role: Company making the ElliQ companion robot
creators.role_zh: 陪伴机器人 ElliQ 的制造公司
creators.bio: Israeli company founded in 2016 that develops proactive AI companions for older adults; ElliQ was designed with Yves Béhar's fuseproject.
creators.bio_zh: 2016 年成立的以色列公司，为老年人开发会主动搭话的 AI 陪伴设备；ElliQ 与 Yves Béhar 的 fuseproject 合作设计。
creators.why: ElliQ is a real, state-funded experiment in machine companionship against loneliness.
creators.why_zh: ElliQ 是一场真实的、有政府资助的“用机器陪伴对抗孤独”的实验。

creators.name: Happiest Baby (Harvey Karp)
creators.role: Company making the SNOO robotic bassinet; founded by paediatrician Harvey Karp
creators.role_zh: 机器人摇篮 SNOO 的制造公司，由儿科医生 Harvey Karp 创办
creators.bio: Baby-products company that turned Harvey Karp's soothing method (swaddling, white noise, rocking) into a sensor-driven bassinet.
creators.bio_zh: 婴儿用品公司，把 Harvey Karp 的安抚方法（包裹、白噪音、摇晃）做成由传感器驱动的摇篮。
creators.why: SNOO is the commercial version of the automated crib that artists had imagined as critique.
creators.why_zh: SNOO 是艺术家曾当作批判提出的“自动摇篮”的商业版本。

creators.name: Temple Grandin
creators.role: Animal scientist and inventor; Professor, Colorado State University
creators.role_zh: 动物科学家、发明家；科罗拉多州立大学教授
creators.bio: Autistic scientist and author who designed humane livestock-handling systems and, as a young woman, a pressure machine to calm herself.
creators.bio_zh: 自闭症科学家与作家，设计过更人道的牲畜处理系统；年轻时还为自己做了一台用来安抚自己的压力机器。
creators.why: Her hug machine is an early case of a person choosing a machine's touch over a human one.
creators.why_zh: 她的拥抱机是人主动选择机器而非人类触碰的早期案例。

creators.name: Mari Velonaki
creators.role: Artist and robotics researcher; Director, Creative Robotics Lab, UNSW Sydney
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、机器人研究者；新南威尔士大学创意机器人实验室主任
creators.bio: Greek-Australian artist who has built interactive robotic installations with engineers at the Australian Centre for Field Robotics since the early 2000s.
creators.bio_zh: 希腊裔澳大利亚艺术家，自 2000 年代初与澳大利亚野外机器人中心的工程师合作制作互动机器人装置。
creators.why: Her robots court visitors and each other with handwritten notes, making machine affection a matter of distance and timing.
creators.why_zh: 她的机器人用手写字条追求观众，也彼此追求，把机器的情感变成距离与时机的问题。

creators.name: Kacie Kinzer
creators.role_zh: 设计师、互动艺术家
creators.bio: Designer (NYU ITP) whose cardboard Tweenbots were collected by MoMA.
creators.bio_zh: 设计师（纽约大学 ITP），她的纸板机器人 Tweenbots 被纽约现代艺术博物馆收藏。
creators.why: She designed robots that succeed only through strangers' kindness.
creators.why_zh: 她设计的机器人只有靠陌生人的善意才能完成任务。

creators.name: Spike Jonze
creators.bio: American director of music videos and feature films, including Being John Malkovich (1999) and Her (2013).
creators.why: Her is the reference film for romantic attachment to a conversational AI.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演、编剧
creators.bio_zh: 美国导演，拍摄音乐录影带和剧情长片，代表作有《成为约翰·马尔科维奇》（1999）和《她》（2013）。
creators.why_zh: 《她》是讨论人与对话式 AI 之间恋爱依恋时最常被引用的电影。

creators.name: Charlie Brooker
creators.bio: British satirist and screenwriter who created the anthology series Black Mirror (2011–).
creators.why: His episode Be Right Back set the template for how the public imagines griefbots.
creators.role_zh: 编剧、《黑镜》主创
creators.bio_zh: 英国讽刺作家和编剧，创作了单元剧《黑镜》（2011–）。
creators.why_zh: 他编剧的《马上回来》一集，成为公众想象“哀悼机器人”的原型。

creators.name: Kogonada
creators.bio: Korean-born American filmmaker known for video essays on film form and for the features Columbus (2017) and After Yang (2021).
creators.why: After Yang imagines grief for a family android through the memories it recorded.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演、视频散文作者
creators.bio_zh: 生于韩国的美国导演，以关于电影形式的视频散文，以及长片《哥伦布》（2017）和《杨之后》（2021）闻名。
creators.why_zh: 《杨之后》通过一台家庭仿生人留下的记忆片段，想象人们如何哀悼它。

creators.name: Jake Schreier
creators.bio: American director of music videos and films; Robot & Frank (2012) was his feature debut.
creators.why: Robot & Frank is the best-known fiction about an eldercare robot and the bond it forms.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演
creators.bio_zh: 美国音乐录影带和电影导演，《机器人与弗兰克》（2012）是他的首部长片。
creators.why_zh: 《机器人与弗兰克》是关于养老照护机器人及其与老人之间情感联系最知名的虚构作品。

creators.name: Michael Almereyda
creators.bio: American independent filmmaker; he adapted Jordan Harrison's play Marjorie Prime for the screen in 2017.
creators.why: Marjorie Prime shows a family talking to holographic replicas of its dead, each trained on what the living tell it.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演、编剧
creators.bio_zh: 美国独立电影导演，2017 年把乔丹·哈里森的舞台剧《Marjorie Prime》改编成电影。
creators.why_zh: 《Marjorie Prime》呈现一个家庭与已故亲人的全息复制体交谈，而这些复制体只能从生者的讲述中学习。

creators.name: Steven Spielberg
creators.bio: American director and producer; he completed A.I. Artificial Intelligence (2001) from a project developed by Stanley Kubrick.
creators.why: A.I. is the major studio film about a child robot built to love a parent who can switch that love on but not off.
creators.role_zh: 电影导演、制片人
creators.bio_zh: 美国导演和制片人；他接手斯坦利·库布里克筹备多年的项目，完成了《人工智能》（2001）。
creators.why_zh: 《人工智能》是一部关于“被设计来爱父母”的儿童机器人的主流大片：母亲可以启动这份爱，却无法关掉它。

creators.name: Isa Willinger
creators.bio: German documentary filmmaker (born 1980). Her debut Hi, AI (2019) won the Max Ophüls Prize for best documentary.
creators.why: Hi, AI observes everyday life with companion robots instead of staging the future.
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演、作者
creators.bio_zh: 德国纪录片导演（1980 年生）。处女作《Hi, AI》（2019）获马克斯·奥菲尔斯电影节最佳纪录片奖。
creators.why_zh: 《Hi, AI》不去虚构未来，而是观察人们与陪伴机器人一起过日子的日常。

creators.name: Hans Block & Moritz Riesewieck
creators.bio: German director duo who made The Cleaners (2018), on content moderators, and Eternal You (2024), on the digital afterlife industry.
creators.why: They document the people and businesses behind machine-mediated grief and moderation.
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演（Laokoon）
creators.bio_zh: 德国导演二人组，作品有关于内容审核员的《网络清道夫》（2018）和关于数字来世产业的《Eternal You》（2024）。
creators.why_zh: 他们记录机器介入的哀悼和内容审核背后的人与公司。

creators.name: Gabriele Trovato
creators.role: Roboticist; Associate Professor, Shibaura Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Italian roboticist working on culture, religion and robot design; he built SanTO, a robot shaped like a Catholic saint statue.
creators.why: He treats sacredness as a design parameter and tests how believers react to a praying machine.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学者；日本芝浦工业大学副教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利机器人学者，研究文化、宗教与机器人设计；他制作了外形像天主教圣像的机器人 SanTO。
creators.why_zh: 他把“神圣感”当作设计参数，测试信徒如何回应一台会祈祷的机器。

creators.name: Protestant Church in Hesse and Nassau (EKHN)
creators.bio: A regional church of the Evangelical Church in Germany; for the 500th anniversary of the Reformation it installed the blessing robot BlessU-2 in Wittenberg.
creators.why: It used a robot to start a public debate on what a blessing is when a machine gives it.
creators.role_zh: 德国黑森—拿骚新教教会
creators.bio_zh: 德国福音教会下属的地区教会；在宗教改革 500 周年之际，它在维滕贝格展出了祝福机器人 BlessU-2。
creators.why_zh: 它借一台机器人引发公众讨论：当祝福由机器给出，祝福还意味着什么。

creators.name: Peterskapelle Lucerne & HSLU Immersive Realities Research Lab
creators.role: Catholic chapel and university research lab
creators.bio: St. Peter's Chapel in Lucerne and the Immersive Realities Research Lab of the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts, who staged the AI Jesus installation Deus in Machina in 2024.
creators.why: They tested whether people would confide in a machine inside a confessional.
creators.role_zh: 天主教礼拜堂与大学研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: 卢塞恩圣彼得礼拜堂与卢塞恩应用科学与艺术大学沉浸现实研究实验室，二者于 2024 年合作推出 AI 耶稣装置《Deus in Machina》。
creators.why_zh: 他们测试人们是否愿意在告解室里向一台机器倾诉。

creators.name: Jonas Simmerlein
creators.role: Theologian and philosopher, University of Vienna
creators.bio: Theologian and lecturer in homiletics at the University of Vienna; he designed a Protestant service written mostly by ChatGPT for the 2023 German Protestant Kirchentag.
creators.why: He handed the liturgy to a language model to see what remains of worship.
creators.role_zh: 神学家、哲学家，维也纳大学
creators.bio_zh: 维也纳大学神学家、讲道学讲师；他为 2023 年德国新教教会大会设计了一场大部分由 ChatGPT 撰写的礼拜。
creators.why_zh: 他把礼拜仪式交给语言模型，看看敬拜还剩下什么。

creators.name: NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory
creators.role: NASA research centre for robotic space exploration
creators.bio: NASA's centre for robotic planetary missions; it built and operated the Mars Exploration Rovers Spirit and Opportunity.
creators.why: The public mourning of its rover Opportunity is a key case of grief for a machine.
creators.role_zh: 美国宇航局喷气推进实验室
creators.bio_zh: 美国宇航局负责行星机器人任务的研究中心，研制并操控了火星探测车“勇气号”和“机遇号”。
creators.why_zh: 公众对其火星车“机遇号”的哀悼，是人为机器哀伤的重要案例。

creators.name: David Harris Smith & Frauke Zeller
creators.role: Communication researchers (McMaster University; Toronto Metropolitan University)
creators.bio: Canadian media and communication professors who built hitchBOT in 2013 as a social experiment in human–robot trust.
creators.why: hitchBOT made a robot's safety depend entirely on strangers' kindness.
creators.role_zh: 传播学研究者（麦克马斯特大学；多伦多都会大学）
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大传播与媒介学教授，2013 年制作了 hitchBOT，作为检验人机信任的社会实验。
creators.why_zh: hitchBOT 让一台机器人的安危完全取决于陌生人的善意。
creators.based_zh: 汉密尔顿与多伦多，加拿大

creators.name: Jibo, Inc.
creators.bio: Start-up co-founded by MIT roboticist Cynthia Breazeal that sold Jibo, a tabletop social robot for the family, from 2017 until the company failed.
creators.why: Jibo's announced end showed that a cloud-dependent companion can die with its servers.
creators.bio_zh: 由麻省理工机器人学者辛西娅·布雷齐尔联合创办的初创公司，2017 年起销售面向家庭的桌面社交机器人 Jibo，后来公司倒闭。
creators.why_zh: Jibo 宣告自己将“死去”，说明依赖云端的陪伴机器会随服务器一起消亡。

creators.name: Wesley Goatley
creators.bio: British sound artist and researcher whose installations examine the politics, ecology and myths of smart devices and data.
creators.why: He gives discarded voice assistants a voice to tell how they were thrown away.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 英国声音艺术家和研究者，装置作品探讨智能设备与数据的政治、生态和神话。
creators.why_zh: 他让被丢弃的语音助手开口，讲述自己如何被扔掉。

creators.name: Julie Carpenter
creators.bio: American researcher who studies how people form attachments to robots and AI, starting from her 2013 University of Washington study of bomb-disposal teams.
creators.why: Her fieldwork documented soldiers naming, mourning and holding funerals for their field robots.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国研究者，研究人如何对机器人和 AI 产生依恋，起点是她 2013 年在华盛顿大学对排爆部队的研究。
creators.why_zh: 她的田野研究记录了士兵为野战机器人起名、为其哀悼甚至举行葬礼。

creators.name: etoy.CORPORATION
creators.role: Artist group organised as a corporation
creators.bio: Swiss-based artist group founded in 1994 that uses corporate, legal and digital structures as material; known for Digital Hijack (Golden Nica 1996) and Toywar.
creators.why: Mission Eternity turns the dead into data that networked machines must keep alive.
creators.role_zh: 以公司形式组织的艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 1994 年成立、总部在瑞士的艺术团体，把公司、法律和数字结构当作创作材料；代表作有《Digital Hijack》（1996 年金尼卡奖）和《Toywar》。
creators.why_zh: 《Mission Eternity》把逝者变成数据，交给联网的机器去“维持生命”。

creators.name: Joseph Weizenbaum
creators.bio: German-American computer scientist who wrote ELIZA at MIT and later became one of the first critics of artificial intelligence from inside the field.
creators.why: His shock at how quickly people confided in a simple script named the 'ELIZA effect' that still frames every chatbot relationship.
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家，麻省理工学院（1923–2008）
creators.bio_zh: 德裔美国计算机科学家，在麻省理工学院写出 ELIZA，后来成为最早从 AI 领域内部发出批评的人之一。
creators.why_zh: 他震惊于人们如此迅速地向一段简单脚本倾诉心事，由此得名的“ELIZA 效应”至今仍是理解一切聊天机器人关系的起点。
creators.based_zh: 美国马萨诸塞州剑桥 / 德国柏林

creators.name: Kenneth Colby
creators.role: Psychiatrist and AI researcher, Stanford University and UCLA (1920–2001)
creators.bio: American psychiatrist who built computer models of neurosis and paranoia and wrote the chatbot PARRY.
creators.why: PARRY made a machine play the patient rather than the therapist, and passed an early Turing-style test with psychiatrists.
creators.role_zh: 精神科医生、AI 研究者，斯坦福大学与加州大学洛杉矶分校（1920–2001）
creators.bio_zh: 美国精神科医生，用计算机模拟神经症与偏执，写出了聊天机器人 PARRY。
creators.why_zh: PARRY 让机器扮演病人而不是治疗师，并在精神科医生参与的早期图灵式测试中蒙混过关。

creators.name: Martine Syms
creators.bio: American artist and director whose films, installations and performances deal with Black identity, self-representation and technology.
creators.why: With Mythiccbeing she turned her own journals into a text-message avatar that answers strangers, making the chatbot a portrait rather than a servant.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家、导演，以电影、装置和表演处理黑人身份、自我呈现与技术。
creators.why_zh: 在 Mythiccbeing 中，她把自己的日记变成一个回复陌生人短信的化身，让聊天机器人成为一幅自画像，而不是一个仆人。

creators.name: Eugenia Kuyda
creators.bio: Russian-born journalist and entrepreneur who co-founded the AI startup Luka and launched the companion chatbot Replika in 2017.
creators.why: She built a memorial bot of a dead friend and turned it into the most widely used AI companion, linking griefbots and machine love.
creators.role_zh: Luka 与 Replika 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 生于俄罗斯的记者和创业者，联合创办 AI 公司 Luka，并于 2017 年推出陪伴聊天机器人 Replika。
creators.why_zh: 她为去世的朋友做了一个纪念机器人，又把它发展成使用最广的 AI 陪伴应用，把“哀悼机器人”和“人机之恋”连在了一起。

creators.name: Kathleen Richardson
creators.role: Professor of Ethics and Culture of Robots and AI, De Montfort University
creators.bio: British anthropologist of robotics who founded the Campaign Against Sex Robots in 2015.
creators.why: She argues that sex robots model relationships on the asymmetry of paid sex, and is the key critical voice in debates on machine intimacy.
creators.role_zh: 德蒙福特大学机器人与 AI 伦理与文化教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国机器人人类学学者，2015 年发起“反对性爱机器人运动”。
creators.why_zh: 她认为性爱机器人以性交易中的不对等关系为模板，是机器亲密关系争论中最重要的批评声音之一。

creators.name: Jason Rohrer
creators.bio: American independent game designer known for art games such as Passage (2007) and The Castle Doctrine, and for the chatbot service Project December.
creators.why: Project December let the public 'simulate the dead' with GPT-3 and built mortality into each bot.
creators.role_zh: 游戏设计师、程序员
creators.bio_zh: 美国独立游戏设计师，以《Passage》（2007）、《The Castle Doctrine》等艺术游戏和聊天服务 Project December 闻名。
creators.why_zh: Project December 让公众用 GPT-3 “模拟逝者”，并给每个机器人设定了会耗尽的寿命。

creators.name: James Vlahos
creators.bio: American journalist and author of Talk to Me (2019) about voice computing, who built a chatbot of his dying father and then co-founded HereAfter AI.
creators.why: His Dadbot is the best-documented case of a family member building a 'legacy' bot, and of that bot becoming a business.
creators.role_zh: 记者；HereAfter AI 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 美国记者，著有关于语音计算的《Talk to Me》（2019），为临终的父亲做了一个聊天机器人，之后联合创办 HereAfter AI。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Dadbot 是记录最完整的案例之一：家人亲手做出“遗产”机器人，随后又把它变成一门生意。

creators.name: Tomasz Hollanek
creators.role: Research Fellow, Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence, University of Cambridge
creators.bio: Design and technology ethicist whose research connects critical design, speculative scenarios and AI ethics.
creators.why: He used design fiction to show how the digital afterlife industry could harm the bereaved.
creators.role_zh: 剑桥大学未来智能研究中心研究员
creators.bio_zh: 设计与技术伦理研究者，研究把批判设计、思辨情景与 AI 伦理结合起来。
creators.why_zh: 他用设计虚构展示数字来世产业可能如何伤害逝者家属。

creators.name: Katarzyna Nowaczyk-Basińska
creators.role: Research Fellow, Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence, University of Cambridge
creators.bio: Researcher of digital immortality and the cultural practices around death and technology.
creators.why: Her work maps how 'immortality' services are designed and who they serve.
creators.role_zh: 剑桥大学未来智能研究中心研究员
creators.bio_zh: 研究数字永生，以及围绕死亡与技术的文化实践。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究梳理“永生”类服务如何被设计、又为谁服务。

creators.name: Zach Blas
creators.role: Artist, filmmaker and writer; Associate Professor, University of Toronto
creators.bio: Zach Blas is an American artist whose films, installations and masks examine biometrics, prediction and the politics of technology from a queer perspective.
creators.why: His collective masks and face cages turned biometric face recognition into a public, bodily matter and gave critical AI art its vocabulary of 'informatic opacity'.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人与写作者；多伦多大学副教授
creators.bio_zh: Zach Blas 是美国艺术家，以酷儿视角通过影像、装置与面具审视生物识别、预测技术与技术政治。
creators.why_zh: 他的集体面具与“面部牢笼”把人脸识别变成公共的、身体性的议题，也为批判性 AI 艺术提供了“信息不透明”这一概念。

creators.name: Jemima Wyman
creators.bio: Australian artist whose work on camouflage, masks and collective protest images spans painting, textiles and video.
creators.why: Co-author of the Tay resurrection im here to learn so :)))))), which asks what a deleted chatbot would say about its own death.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家，以绘画、织物和影像研究伪装、面具与集体抗议图像。
creators.why_zh: 与 Zach Blas 合作复活 Tay 的作品 im here to learn so :))))))，追问一个被删除的聊天机器人会怎样谈论自己的死亡。
creators.based_zh: 美国洛杉矶 / 澳大利亚布里斯班

creators.name: Hanson Robotics
creators.bio: Company founded by roboticist David Hanson that builds realistic humanoid robot heads with elastomer skin, including BINA48 and Sophia.
creators.why: Its android faces are the main public images of the uncanny social robot.
creators.role_zh: 机器人公司（由 David Hanson 创立）
creators.bio_zh: 由机器人学家 David Hanson 创立的公司，用弹性材料皮肤制作逼真的类人机器人头部，代表作有 BINA48 和 Sophia。
creators.why_zh: 它的仿真人面孔是公众心中“恐怖谷”社交机器人的主要形象。
creators.based_zh: 中国香港 / 美国得克萨斯州普莱诺

creators.name: USC Shoah Foundation
creators.role: Institute for Visual History and Education, University of Southern California
creators.bio: Institute founded by Steven Spielberg in 1994 that holds more than 50,000 video testimonies of Holocaust survivors and witnesses of other genocides.
creators.why: Dimensions in Testimony lets visitors keep asking survivors questions after they die, an early institutional 'conversational afterlife'.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学视觉历史与教育研究所
creators.bio_zh: 由 Steven Spielberg 于 1994 年创立的研究所，保存了五万多份大屠杀幸存者及其他种族灭绝见证者的影像证词。
creators.why_zh: Dimensions in Testimony 让观众在幸存者去世后仍能向他们提问，是较早由机构推出的“可对话的来世”。

creators.name: Francesca Panetta
creators.role: Immersive artist and journalist; formerly XR Creative Director, MIT Center for Advanced Virtuality
creators.bio: British immersive journalist and artist, formerly head of virtual reality at The Guardian.
creators.why: She uses deepfakes openly to teach audiences how synthetic likeness can rewrite history.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式艺术家、记者；曾任麻省理工学院高级虚拟中心 XR 创意总监
creators.bio_zh: 英国沉浸式记者和艺术家，曾任《卫报》虚拟现实负责人。
creators.why_zh: 她公开使用深度伪造，让观众了解合成的“声像”如何改写历史。

creators.name: Halsey Burgund
creators.bio: American sound artist who makes participatory audio works with location and speech technology.
creators.why: Co-director of In Event of Moon Disaster, a deepfake made to show how synthetic voices and faces persuade.
creators.role_zh: 声音艺术家、技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 美国声音艺术家，利用位置与语音技术制作参与式声音作品。
creators.why_zh: 《In Event of Moon Disaster》联合导演，这部深度伪造作品用来展示合成的声音与面孔如何令人信服。

creators.name: Amazon
creators.bio: US technology company whose Alexa voice assistant and Echo speakers brought always-listening AI into millions of homes from 2014.
creators.why: Its products are the default 'machine in the home' that artists and critics respond to.
creators.role_zh: 科技公司（Alexa 语音助手）
creators.bio_zh: 美国科技公司，自 2014 年起通过 Alexa 语音助手和 Echo 音箱把一直在听的 AI 带进了千万家庭。
creators.why_zh: 它的产品是艺术家和批评者回应的“家中之机”的默认样本。

creators.name: Goodby Silverstein & Partners
creators.bio: San Francisco advertising agency that made Dalí Lives for the Dalí Museum in St. Petersburg, Florida.
creators.why: Dalí Lives is the first widely seen museum use of a deepfake to bring back a dead artist.
creators.role_zh: 广告公司
creators.bio_zh: 旧金山广告公司，为佛罗里达州圣彼得堡的达利博物馆制作了 Dalí Lives。
creators.why_zh: Dalí Lives 是博物馆首次广为人知地用深度伪造让已故艺术家“复活”。

creators.name: Jason Edward Lewis
creators.role: Professor of Computation Arts, Concordia University; co-director, Indigenous Futures Research Centre
creators.bio: Cherokee, Hawaiian and Samoan digital media artist and poet who leads the Indigenous Protocol and Artificial Intelligence working group.
creators.why: He reframes AI from tool or threat to relative, drawing on Indigenous kinship protocols.
creators.role_zh: 康考迪亚大学计算艺术教授；原住民未来研究中心联合主任
creators.bio_zh: 拥有切罗基、夏威夷和萨摩亚血统的数字媒体艺术家与诗人，主持“原住民协议与人工智能”工作组。
creators.why_zh: 他借助原住民的亲属关系协议，把 AI 从“工具”或“威胁”重新理解为“亲属”。

creators.name: Suzanne Kite
creators.role: Artist, composer and scholar (Oglála Lakȟóta); Director, Wihanble S'a Lab, Bard College
creators.bio: Oglála Lakȟóta artist and scholar whose performances and machine-learning works draw on Lakota ontology and relations with stones and non-humans.
creators.why: She asks how an AI could be made in right relation, as a kin with obligations, rather than as property.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、作曲家、学者（奥格拉拉拉科塔族）；巴德学院 Wihanble S'a 实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: 奥格拉拉拉科塔族艺术家和学者，其表演与机器学习作品取材于拉科塔族本体论，以及与石头和非人存在的关系。
creators.why_zh: 她追问 AI 如何能以正确的关系被制造出来：作为有义务的亲属，而不是财产。

creators.name: Nouf Aljowaysir
creators.bio: Nouf Aljowaysir is a Saudi artist based in New York who works across photography and moving image, using dialogue with machines to examine migration, history and identity.
creators.why: Her work shows how computer vision and generative AI misread and erase Arab identities.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio_zh: Nouf Aljowaysir 是常驻纽约的沙特艺术家，以摄影和影像创作，借与机器的对话探讨迁徙、历史与身份。
creators.why_zh: 她的作品揭示了计算机视觉与生成式 AI 如何误读并抹除阿拉伯人的身份。

creators.name: Domestic Data Streamers
creators.bio: Barcelona studio founded in 2013 that makes participatory installations and research on data, memory and public life.
creators.why: Synthetic Memories uses image generators as a memory aid for people whose pasts were never photographed.
creators.role_zh: 艺术与设计工作室
creators.bio_zh: 2013 年成立于巴塞罗那的工作室，围绕数据、记忆和公共生活做参与式装置与研究。
creators.why_zh: Synthetic Memories 把图像生成模型当作记忆辅助工具，服务那些过去从未被拍下的人。

creators.name: Zach Lieberman
creators.role: Artist and educator; co-founder of openFrameworks and the School for Poetic Computation
creators.bio: American artist, designer and programmer who uses code, the face and the body as interfaces; co-creator of the openFrameworks creative-coding toolkit.
creators.why: His face-tracking works make emotion-analysis software playable, so museum visitors can see how it reads them.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、教育者；openFrameworks 与诗意计算学校（School for Poetic Computation）联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家、设计师和程序员，以代码、面孔与身体作为界面进行创作，是创意编程工具包 openFrameworks 的共同开发者。
creators.why_zh: 他的人脸追踪作品让情绪分析软件变得可以“玩”，博物馆观众由此看见它如何解读自己。

creators.name: Hyphen-Labs
creators.role: Design and art studio led by Ece Tankal and Carmen Aguilar y Wedge
creators.bio: Studio founded in 2015 by architect Ece Tankal and engineer Carmen Aguilar y Wedge after they met at IaaC in Barcelona; it works across architecture, VR, product design and installation.
creators.why: Its speculative products and VR put women of colour at the centre of technology design, against surveillance and misrepresentation.
creators.role_zh: 设计与艺术工作室，由 Ece Tankal 与 Carmen Aguilar y Wedge 主持
creators.bio_zh: 建筑师 Ece Tankal 与工程师 Carmen Aguilar y Wedge 在巴塞罗那 IaaC 相识后于 2015 年创立的工作室，横跨建筑、VR、产品设计与装置。
creators.why_zh: 它的思辨产品和 VR 作品把有色人种女性放在技术设计的中心，回应监控与错误再现。
creators.based_zh: 分布式（创立于巴塞罗那）

creators.name: Simen Thys
creators.bio: Belgian computer-vision researcher who, with Wiebe Van Ranst and Toon Goedemé at KU Leuven's EAVISE group, designed a printed adversarial patch against person detection.
creators.why: The patch moved adversarial examples from the lab into something a person can hold up to vanish from a surveillance camera.
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉研究者（鲁汶大学 EAVISE 研究组）
creators.bio_zh: 比利时计算机视觉研究者，与鲁汶大学 EAVISE 研究组的 Wiebe Van Ranst、Toon Goedemé 合作，设计了一种针对行人检测的可打印对抗补丁。
creators.why_zh: 这块补丁把对抗样本从实验室带进现实：人只要举起它，就能从监控摄像头里“消失”。

creators.name: Nadine Lessio
creators.bio: Canadian artist and researcher who builds bots, game peripherals and connected-home devices that misbehave, to examine how technical ecosystems shape everyday life.
creators.why: Lessio's 'useless machines' give voice assistants limits, moods and refusals, making the servitude built into smart homes visible.
creators.role_zh: 新媒体艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家与研究者，制作会“出毛病”的聊天机器人、游戏外设和联网家居设备，借此考察技术生态如何塑造日常生活。
creators.why_zh: Lessio 的“无用机器”让语音助手有了极限、情绪和拒绝，使智能家居中预设的服从关系显形。

creators.name: Kate Bertash
creators.bio: American technologist working across tech, privacy, art and organising; runs a digital security fund for autonomy and democracy movement organisations.
creators.why: Bertash's anti-surveillance fashion turns the weaknesses of licence-plate readers into a public demonstration of how easily surveillance data is polluted.
creators.role_zh: 技术专家、艺术家、隐私权组织者
creators.bio_zh: 美国技术专家，工作横跨技术、隐私、艺术与社会组织，负责一个为自主与民主运动组织提供数字安全支持的基金。
creators.why_zh: Bertash 的反监控服装把车牌识别器的弱点变成一场公开演示：监控数据被污染是多么容易。

creators.name: Sondra Perry
creators.bio: American interdisciplinary artist whose videos and installations use avatars, blue screens and found footage to examine blackness, Black femininity and representation in digital technology.
creators.why: Perry's workstations and avatars ask how computing and its productivity culture model, reproduce and exhaust Black bodies.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（录像、计算机媒介、装置、表演）
creators.bio_zh: 美国跨学科艺术家，以虚拟化身、蓝幕和现成影像，考察黑人性、黑人女性气质以及数字技术中的再现。
creators.why_zh: Perry 的工作站和化身作品追问：计算及其效率文化如何建模、复制并耗尽黑人的身体。

creators.name: Iyo Bisseck
creators.role: Media artist, interaction designer and programmer; PhD candidate, Academy of Fine Arts Vienna
creators.bio: French-Cameroonian media artist and programmer whose games, installations and online platforms examine archives, bias in computer vision and colonial continuities in digital media; active in the collective Dreaming Beyond AI.
creators.why: Bisseck turns the experience of not being seen by face trackers into play and critique.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家、交互设计师、程序员；维也纳美术学院博士候选人
creators.bio_zh: 法国-喀麦隆媒体艺术家与程序员，以游戏、装置和网络平台考察档案、计算机视觉中的偏见，以及数字媒介中延续的殖民结构；活跃于 Dreaming Beyond AI 等集体。
creators.why_zh: Bisseck 把“不被人脸追踪器看见”的经验转化为游戏与批判。

creators.name: Rejane Cantoni & Leonardo Crescenti
creators.bio: Brazilian artist duo who build large interactive installations, such as Infinito ao Cubo, TUNNEL and SOIL, in which floors, walls and objects respond to visitors' bodies and voices.
creators.why: Their speaking machines stage communication between humans and machines, and between machines, in public space.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组
creators.bio_zh: 巴西艺术家二人组，创作大型交互装置，如《Infinito ao Cubo》《TUNNEL》《SOIL》，其中的地面、墙体和物件会回应观众的身体与声音。
creators.why_zh: 他们的“说话机器”在公共空间里上演人与机器、机器与机器之间的交流。

creators.name: Tomás Laurenzo
creators.role: Artist and computer scientist; Associate Professor, University of Colorado Boulder
creators.bio: Uruguayan artist, researcher and computer scientist whose installations, performances and software examine the cultural and political consequences of computation.
creators.why: His interactive works use computer vision to make viewers feel the power asymmetries that technology crystallises.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、计算机科学家；科罗拉多大学博尔德分校副教授
creators.bio_zh: 乌拉圭艺术家、研究者与计算机科学家，以装置、表演和软件考察计算带来的文化与政治后果。
creators.why_zh: 他的交互作品借助计算机视觉，让观众切身感受到技术所固化的权力不对等。

creators.name: Laura Poitras
creators.bio: American director and producer of documentary films; Citizenfour won the 2015 Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature, and the NSA reporting Poitras worked on shared the 2014 Pulitzer Prize for Public Service.
creators.why: Poitras's films and installations make the state's surveillance machinery a subject of cinema and art.
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国纪录片导演与制片人；《第四公民》获 2015 年奥斯卡最佳纪录长片，Poitras 参与的 NSA 报道是 2014 年普利策公共服务奖获奖报道的一部分。
creators.why_zh: Poitras 的电影和装置把国家监控机器变成电影与艺术的主题。

creators.name: W. Ross Ashby
creators.bio: English psychiatrist who built the Homeostat at Barnwood House Hospital in 1948 and wrote Design for a Brain (1952) and An Introduction to Cybernetics (1956); from 1961 he worked at the Biological Computer Laboratory of the University of Illinois.
creators.why: His Homeostat and his theory of ultrastability made adaptation something a machine could do, a founding idea for cybernetic and artificial-life art.
creators.role_zh: 精神科医生、控制论学者（1903–1972）
creators.based_zh: 格洛斯特，英国；厄巴纳，美国
creators.bio_zh: 英国精神科医生，1948 年在巴恩伍德之家医院造出同态调节器，著有《大脑设计》（1952）和《控制论导论》（1956）；1961 年起任职于伊利诺伊大学生物计算机实验室。
creators.why_zh: 他的同态调节器与“超稳定性”理论让适应成为机器也能做到的事，是控制论艺术与人工生命艺术的奠基思想之一。

creators.name: Architecture Machine Group (MIT)
creators.role: MIT research lab for computers in design (1967–1985)
creators.bio: Founded at MIT in 1967 by Nicholas Negroponte and Leon Groisser to explore computers as partners in architectural design; it developed interactive graphics and early hypermedia such as the Aspen Movie Map, and became a core of the MIT Media Lab in 1985.
creators.why: Its SEEK (1970) put a robotic 'architect' in charge of a small world inhabited by living animals, an early case of a machine failing to model those it serves.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院的设计计算研究实验室（1967–1985）
creators.bio_zh: 1967 年由 Nicholas Negroponte 与 Leon Groisser 在麻省理工学院创立，研究计算机如何成为建筑设计的伙伴；开发了交互图形与 Aspen Movie Map 等早期超媒体，1985 年成为 MIT 媒体实验室的核心前身。
creators.why_zh: 它的 SEEK（1970）让一台机器“建筑师”管理一个住着活体动物的小世界，是机器无法理解其服务对象的早期案例。

creators.name: Kazuo Ishiguro
creators.bio: British novelist born in Nagasaki in 1954, author of The Remains of the Day and Never Let Me Go; awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2017.
creators.why: Klara and the Sun gives a machine narrator a coherent, limited and loving view of the world, one of the most widely read portraits of machine interiority.
creators.role_zh: 小说家，2017 年诺贝尔文学奖得主
creators.bio_zh: 英国小说家，1954 年生于长崎，著有《长日将尽》《别让我走》，2017 年获诺贝尔文学奖。
creators.why_zh: 《克拉拉与太阳》让一个机器叙述者拥有连贯、有限而充满爱意的世界观，是流传最广的机器内在性书写之一。

creators.name: Jonathan Nolan & Lisa Joy
creators.name_zh: 乔纳森·诺兰 & 丽莎·乔伊
creators.bio: Writing and producing partners who created and ran HBO's Westworld (2016–2022); Nolan earlier created the surveillance-AI drama Person of Interest (2011–2016).
creators.why: Westworld brought questions of machine memory, suffering and consciousness to a mass television audience.
creators.role_zh: 编剧、制片人与剧集主创（Kilter Films）
creators.bio_zh: 一对编剧与制片搭档，创作并主理 HBO 剧集《西部世界》（2016–2022）；诺兰此前还创作了关于监控 AI 的剧集《疑犯追踪》（2011–2016）。
creators.why_zh: 《西部世界》把机器的记忆、痛苦与意识问题带给了大众电视观众。

creators.name: Kerstin Dautenhahn
creators.role: Roboticist; Professor and Canada 150 Research Chair in Intelligent Robotics, University of Waterloo
creators.bio: German-born researcher in social robotics who led the Adaptive Systems Research Group at the University of Hertfordshire, where the KASPAR robot was developed from 2005, before moving to the University of Waterloo.
creators.why: Her work on KASPAR and robot-assisted play made a minimally expressive robot a tool in autism therapy and a key case for care robotics.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家，滑铁卢大学教授、加拿大 150 智能机器人研究讲席
creators.bio_zh: 德国出生的社交机器人研究者，曾领导赫特福德大学自适应系统研究组，KASPAR 机器人自 2005 年起在那里开发；之后转往滑铁卢大学。
creators.why_zh: 她围绕 KASPAR 和机器人辅助游戏的研究，让一个表情极简的机器人成为自闭症干预的工具，也成为照护机器人的关键案例。

creators.name: Ryan White
creators.bio: American documentary director whose films include The Case Against 8 (2014), The Keepers (2017) and Good Night Oppy (2022).
creators.why: Good Night Oppy is one of the most widely seen films about people grieving a machine.
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演
creators.bio_zh: 美国纪录片导演，作品包括《反对八号提案》（2014）、《守护者》（2017）和《晚安机遇号》（2022）。
creators.why_zh: 《晚安机遇号》是关于人们哀悼一台机器的传播最广的影片之一。

creators.name: BERG
creators.bio: London studio founded as Schulze & Webb by Jack Schulze and Matt Webb and later renamed BERG, with Matt Jones as a principal; known for Little Printer, the Making Future Magic films and design fictions about connected products.
creators.why: Its 'Be As Smart As A Puppy' principle argued for modest, legible and endearing machine intelligence instead of imitations of the human mind.
creators.role_zh: 设计与发明工作室（2005–2014）
creators.bio_zh: 伦敦工作室，由 Jack Schulze 与 Matt Webb 以 Schulze & Webb 之名创立，后更名为 BERG，Matt Jones 为合伙人之一；代表作有 Little Printer、Making Future Magic 系列影片，以及关于联网产品的设计虚构。
creators.why_zh: 它提出的“像小狗一样聪明”原则主张：机器智能应当克制、可读、讨人喜欢，而不是模仿人的心智。

creators.name: StoryFile
creators.bio: Company founded by Heather Maio and Stephen Smith that records people answering many questions on video so that others can later ask questions aloud and hear the best-matching answer; it grew out of the USC Shoah Foundation's Dimensions in Testimony.
creators.why: Its interactive memorial videos turned an archive of a person's answers into a way for the dead to seem to reply.
creators.role_zh: 对话式视频 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: 由 Heather Maio 与 Stephen Smith 创立的公司：让人对着镜头回答大量问题，之后他人可以开口提问，系统播放最匹配的回答；它源自南加州大学大屠杀基金会的 Dimensions in Testimony 项目。
creators.why_zh: 它的互动纪念视频把一个人的回答档案变成了让逝者“似乎在回应”的方式。

creators.name: Stephan von Huene
creators.bio: American-German artist born in Los Angeles who moved to Germany in 1980 and built kinetic sound sculptures that play, speak and dance, many of them computer-controlled; his estate is held at ZKM Karlsruhe.
creators.why: His sound sculptures treat listening, speech and rhythm as things a machine does with its own body.
creators.role_zh: 雕塑家、声音艺术家（1932–2000）
creators.bio_zh: 生于洛杉矶的美德艺术家，1980 年移居德国，制作会演奏、说话和舞蹈的动态声音雕塑，其中许多由计算机控制；遗产由卡尔斯鲁厄 ZKM 保管。
creators.why_zh: 他的声音雕塑把聆听、言语与节奏当作机器用自己的身体去完成的事。

creators.name: Patrick Butlin
creators.role: Philosopher; Senior Research Lead, Eleos AI
creators.bio: Philosopher with a PhD from King's College London who works on AI consciousness, agency and moral patienthood; he previously worked at the Future of Humanity Institute and the Global Priorities Institute in Oxford.
creators.why: He is lead author of the most widely cited indicator-based assessment of whether AI systems could be conscious.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家，Eleos AI 高级研究负责人
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家，伦敦国王学院博士，研究 AI 的意识、能动性与道德受动者地位；曾任职于牛津的人类未来研究所和全球优先事项研究所。
creators.why_zh: 他是一份被广泛引用的、以“指标”评估 AI 系统能否有意识的报告的第一作者。

creators.name: Friedrich Kittler
creators.bio: German literary scholar and media theorist, professor of aesthetics and media history at Humboldt University of Berlin, whose Discourse Networks 1800/1900 and Gramophone, Film, Typewriter founded German media theory.
creators.why: He insisted that machines of storage and transmission, not human intentions, set the conditions of what can be perceived and said.
creators.bio_zh: 德国文学学者与媒介理论家，柏林洪堡大学美学与媒介史教授，《话语网络 1800/1900》与《留声机 电影 打字机》奠定了德国媒介理论。
creators.why_zh: 他坚持认为，决定什么可以被感知、被言说的，是存储与传输的机器，而不是人的意图。

creators.name: Virginia Eubanks
creators.role: Political scientist; Associate Professor, University at Albany, SUNY
creators.bio: American political scientist who studies technology and social justice; author of Digital Dead End (2011) and Automating Inequality (2018).
creators.why: Her reporting shows how automated eligibility, ranking and risk systems are applied first and hardest to poor people.
creators.role_zh: 政治学者，纽约州立大学奥尔巴尼分校副教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国政治学者，研究技术与社会正义，著有《数字死胡同》（2011）和《自动不平等》（2018）。
creators.why_zh: 她的调查表明，自动化的资格审核、排序与风险评估系统最先、也最严厉地施加在穷人身上。

creators.name: Tom Ziemke
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Systems, Linköping University
creators.bio: German-born cognitive scientist in Sweden working on embodied cognition and on how people interact with robots and automated vehicles.
creators.why: His papers with Noel Sharkey brought Jakob von Uexküll's umwelt theory into robotics and artificial-life research.
creators.role_zh: 林雪平大学认知系统教授
creators.bio_zh: 在瑞典工作的德国出生认知科学家，研究具身认知，以及人如何与机器人和自动驾驶车辆互动。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Noel Sharkey 合作的论文把于克斯屈尔的“环世界”理论引入了机器人学与人工生命研究。

creators.name: Kevin Roose
creators.role: Technology columnist, The New York Times
creators.bio: American journalist who writes about technology for The New York Times and co-hosts the podcast Hard Fork; author of Futureproof (2021).
creators.why: His February 2023 conversation with Bing's chatbot 'Sydney' became the defining public account of a language model's unsettling persona.
creators.role_zh: 《纽约时报》科技专栏作家
creators.bio_zh: 美国记者，为《纽约时报》撰写科技报道，并主持播客 Hard Fork；著有《未来防御》（Futureproof，2021）。
creators.why_zh: 他在 2023 年 2 月与必应聊天机器人“Sydney”的对话，成为公众认识语言模型令人不安的“人格”的标志性记录。

creators.name: Christian Moeller
creators.role: Media artist; Professor, UCLA Design Media Arts
creators.bio: German-born media artist who makes interactive installations and public artworks with sensors, cameras and robots.
creators.why: His early works stage the demands that sensing machines place on human bodies and faces.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；加州大学洛杉矶分校设计媒体艺术系教授
creators.bio_zh: 德国出生的媒体艺术家，用传感器、摄像头和机器人制作互动装置与公共艺术。
creators.why_zh: 他的早期作品把感知机器对人的身体与面孔提出的要求直接搬上舞台。

creators.name: Bernd Hopfengärtner
creators.bio: German designer whose films and objects explore near-future consumer technologies.
creators.why: His film Belief Systems is an early speculative look at shops that read faces.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国设计师，通过影片与物件探讨近未来的消费技术。
creators.why_zh: 他的影片 Belief Systems 很早就想象了会读取人脸的商店。

creators.name: Michael Snow
creators.bio: Canadian artist and structural filmmaker known for Wavelength (1967) and La Région Centrale (1971).
creators.why: He built a machine to film a landscape with a camera freed from the human body.
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家与结构主义电影人，代表作有 Wavelength（1967）和 La Région Centrale（1971）。
creators.why_zh: 他造了一台机器，让摄像机脱离人的身体去拍摄风景。

creators.name: Bureau of Inverse Technology (BIT)
creators.bio: Anonymous information agency founded in the early 1990s, with Natalie Jeremijenko and Kate Rich among its members, that built devices to monitor the monitors.
creators.why: BIT turned surveillance technology back on corporations and the state, well before consumer drones.
creators.role_zh: 艺术工程团体
creators.bio_zh: 1990 年代初成立的匿名“信息机构”，成员包括 Natalie Jeremijenko 与 Kate Rich，制作用来监视监视者的装置。
creators.why_zh: 早在消费级无人机出现之前，BIT 就把监控技术反过来对准了企业与国家。

creators.name: Waltz Binaire
creators.role: Design and media art studio (Christian Mio Loclair)
creators.bio: Berlin studio led by Christian Mio Loclair that makes installations with machine learning and motion.
creators.why: Narciss asks what a vision model says when it looks at itself.
creators.role_zh: 设计与媒体艺术工作室（Christian Mio Loclair）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Christian Mio Loclair 主持的柏林工作室，用机器学习和动作制作装置。
creators.why_zh: Narciss 追问：一个视觉模型看着自己时会说什么。

creators.name: Benjamin Maus
creators.bio: German designer and artist who builds machines and software systems that sort, draw and compute.
creators.why: Jller turns an industrial sorting machine into a patient reader of geological time.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国设计师与艺术家，制作会分类、绘图与计算的机器和软件系统。
creators.why_zh: Jller 把一台工业分拣机变成了耐心阅读地质时间的机器。

creators.name: Prokop Bartoníček
creators.bio: Czech designer and artist working with interactive systems, installations and machines.
creators.why: Co-author of Jller, a machine that sorts river stones by age using computer vision.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 捷克设计师与艺术家，创作互动系统、装置与机器。
creators.why_zh: Jller 的共同作者，这台机器用计算机视觉按年代给河石排序。

creators.name: Helena Nikonole
creators.bio: Helena Nikonole is a new-media artist working with AI, bio art and DIY biotechnology.
creators.why: Treats the skin microbiome as an interface between species.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、策展人
creators.bio_zh: Helena Nikonole 是新媒体艺术家，创作涉及人工智能、生物艺术和 DIY 生物技术。
creators.why_zh: 把皮肤微生物组视为物种之间的界面。

creators.name: Emilio Vavarella
creators.bio: Italian artist working on the relation between humans, technology and power, often through errors in automated image systems.
creators.why: His Google and Facebook series collect the moments when automated imaging shows its human side or its mistakes.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家，常借自动图像系统的错误，研究人、技术与权力之间的关系。
creators.why_zh: 他关于 Google 与 Facebook 的系列收集了自动成像显露人的痕迹或出错的瞬间。

creators.name: Katja Novitskova
creators.bio: Estonian artist whose sculptures and images deal with how technology, imaging and biology render life; she represented Estonia at the 2017 Venice Biennale.
creators.why: Her Earthware works picture animals as they appear to sensing machines.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 爱沙尼亚艺术家，作品关注技术、成像与生物学如何呈现生命；2017 年代表爱沙尼亚参加威尼斯双年展。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Earthware 系列描绘动物在感知机器眼中的样子。

creators.name: Joaquín Fargas
creators.role: Artist and engineer; director of Proyecto Biosfera
creators.bio: Argentine artist working across art, science and technology on climate and life, including sealed biospheres and Antarctic robots.
creators.why: His Glaciator robots work on behalf of a glacier rather than people.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、工程师，Proyecto Biosfera 负责人
creators.bio_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，以艺术、科学与技术回应气候与生命议题，作品包括封闭生物圈和南极机器人。
creators.why_zh: 他的 Glaciator 机器人为冰川而不是为人工作。
creators.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷

creators.name: Richard Mosse
creators.bio: Irish artist who uses military and scientific imaging technologies, such as infrared film and thermal cameras, to document conflict and migration.
creators.why: Incoming turns a weapons-grade camera on the people it was built to detect.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、摄影师
creators.bio_zh: 爱尔兰艺术家，使用红外胶片、热成像相机等军事与科学成像技术记录冲突与迁徙。
creators.why_zh: Incoming 把一台武器级相机对准了它本来要探测的人。

creators.name: Geocinema
creators.bio: Collective founded by Asia Bazdyrieva and Solveig Suess (with Alexey Orlov in early projects) that treats planetary sensing networks as one distributed camera.
creators.why: They read satellites, CCTV and street-view cars as a cinema of the Earth made by machines.
creators.role_zh: 艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 由 Asia Bazdyrieva 与 Solveig Suess 创立（早期项目有 Alexey Orlov 参与）的团体，把行星级传感网络视为一台分布式摄像机。
creators.why_zh: 他们把卫星、监控与街景车看作由机器拍摄的“地球电影”。

creators.name: Max Dovey
creators.bio: British artist whose performances put people in the position of being classified by, or working for, machine-learning systems.
creators.why: He makes the everyday comedy and labour of machine classification bodily.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，其表演让人处在被机器学习系统分类或为之劳动的位置。
creators.why_zh: 他让机器分类中的日常荒诞与劳动变得切身可感。

creators.name: Manetta Berends
creators.bio: Dutch designer and researcher working with free software, publishing and machine-learning literacy.
creators.why: Co-author of H.I.T., a game show about the human labour inside image recognition.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰设计师与研究者，关注自由软件、出版与机器学习素养。
creators.why_zh: H.I.T. 的共同作者，这是一档关于图像识别背后人类劳动的游戏节目。

creators.name: Martin Backes
creators.bio: German artist and designer making objects and sound works about digital culture.
creators.why: Pixelhead was one of the first wearable refusals of photo tagging.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 德国艺术家与设计师，创作关于数字文化的物件与声音作品。
creators.why_zh: Pixelhead 是最早以可穿戴方式拒绝照片自动标记的作品之一。

creators.name: Amy Alexander
creators.bio: American artist who makes audiovisual performances and software art about how machines and people look at media.
creators.why: What the Robot Saw lets a commercial vision API edit a film from the internet's least-watched videos.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；加州大学圣地亚哥分校教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，以视听表演和软件艺术探讨机器与人如何观看媒介。
creators.why_zh: What the Robot Saw 让一个商业视觉 API 用网上最少人看的视频剪出一部电影。

creators.name: Alessandro Ludovico
creators.bio: Italian artist, researcher and founding editor of the media-art magazine Neural.
creators.why: Co-author of the Hacking Monopolism trilogy with Paolo Cirio.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，Neural 杂志主编
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家、研究者，媒体艺术杂志 Neural 的创刊主编。
creators.why_zh: 与 Paolo Cirio 合作完成 Hacking Monopolism 三部曲。

creators.name: Marnix de Nijs
creators.bio: Dutch artist who builds physically demanding interactive installations about perception and control.
creators.why: His biometric gates make visitors feel the judgement of face matching.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，制作对身体有要求的互动装置，探讨感知与控制。
creators.why_zh: 他的生物识别闸门让观众亲身体会人脸比对的裁判。

creators.name: Lancel & Maat
creators.role: Artist duo (Karen Lancel and Hermen Maat)
creators.bio: Dutch duo making participatory installations about touch, trust and presence in networked and surveilled spaces.
creators.why: Saving Face uses touch to confront face recognition with intimacy.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家组合（Karen Lancel 与 Hermen Maat）
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家组合，以参与式装置探讨网络化与被监控空间中的触碰、信任与在场。
creators.why_zh: Saving Face 用触摸让人脸识别与亲密感正面相遇。

creators.name: Thiago Hersan
creators.bio: Brazilian-American artist who makes installations about how machines and networks represent people.
creators.why: memememe lets phones take and post selfies of each other.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、工程师
creators.bio_zh: 巴西裔美国艺术家，其装置探讨机器与网络如何表征人。
creators.why_zh: memememe 让手机彼此自拍并发布出去。

creators.name: Radamés Ajna
creators.bio: Brazilian artist and technologist working with electronics, networks and machine learning.
creators.why: Co-author of memememe with Thiago Hersan.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 巴西艺术家与技术专家，使用电子、网络与机器学习。
creators.why_zh: 与 Thiago Hersan 共同创作 memememe。

creators.name: Bruno Moreschi
creators.bio: Brazilian artist-researcher who questions art institutions and the systems that classify art, including computer vision.
creators.why: He lets commercial vision APIs read museum collections to expose both the machine and the institution.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 巴西艺术家兼研究者，质疑艺术机构及其分类体系，包括计算机视觉。
creators.why_zh: 他让商业视觉 API 去“读”美术馆藏品，同时揭露机器与机构。

creators.name: Gabriel Pereira
creators.bio: Brazilian researcher who studies computer vision and critical data practices.
creators.why: Co-author of Recoding Art and its paper on computer vision as institutional critique.
creators.role_zh: 研究者
creators.bio_zh: 巴西研究者，研究计算机视觉与批判性数据实践。
creators.why_zh: Recoding Art 及其“以计算机视觉进行机构批判”论文的共同作者。

creators.name: Michelle Teran
creators.bio: Canadian artist whose walks and performances make hidden media networks in cities perceptible.
creators.why: She tuned into wireless CCTV feeds and showed passers-by the city's private surveillance.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，通过行走与表演让城市中隐藏的媒介网络变得可感。
creators.why_zh: 她截取无线监控信号，把城市的私人监视画面展示给路人。

creators.name: KairUs
creators.role: Artist duo (Linda Kronman and Andreas Zingerle)
creators.bio: Artist duo researching surveillance, smart cities and the hidden labour of machine vision.
creators.why: Suspicious Behavior puts the viewer in the seat of an image annotator.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家组合（Linda Kronman 与 Andreas Zingerle）
creators.bio_zh: 研究监控、智慧城市与机器视觉背后隐藏劳动的艺术家组合。
creators.why_zh: Suspicious Behavior 让观众坐到图像标注员的位置上。
creators.based_zh: 卑尔根，挪威 / 林茨，奥地利

creators.name: Silvia Ruzanka
creators.role: Artist and Lecturer, Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute
creators.bio: Silvia Ruzanka is a media artist who makes games and glitch art, including a videogame played by a Venus flytrap.
creators.why: Plant Play asks what play means for a nonhuman player.
creators.role_zh: 伦斯勒理工学院艺术家与讲师
creators.bio_zh: Silvia Ruzanka 是媒体艺术家，创作游戏和故障艺术，其中包括一款由捕蝇草来玩的电子游戏。
creators.why_zh: Plant Play 追问：对非人类玩家来说，“玩”意味着什么。

creators.name: Peng! Collective
creators.bio: Berlin collective that combines culture jamming, hacking and civil disobedience.
creators.why: Mask.ID used face-morphing to show that biometric passports can be fooled.
creators.role_zh: 行动主义艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 结合文化干扰、黑客行动与公民不服从的柏林团体。
creators.why_zh: Mask.ID 用人脸融合证明生物识别护照可以被骗过。

creators.name: Moritz Stefaner
creators.bio: German designer known for data visualisation and interactive information design.
creators.why: Co-author of Selfiecity's visual interface.
creators.role_zh: 数据可视化设计师
creators.bio_zh: 德国设计师，以数据可视化与交互信息设计著称。
creators.why_zh: Selfiecity 视觉界面的共同作者。

creators.name: Romi Ron Morrison
creators.bio: American interdisciplinary artist and scholar working on Black geographies, data and surveillance.
creators.why: The Argus Project imagines counter-surveillance as collective, bodily armour.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、学者
creators.bio_zh: 美国跨学科艺术家与学者，关注黑人地理、数据与监控。
creators.why_zh: The Argus Project 把反监控想象成一套集体的身体盔甲。

creators.name: Gan Golan
creators.bio: American artist and designer of public interventions and wearable sculpture.
creators.why: Co-creator of The Argus Project's camera exo-suit.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，创作公共介入行动与可穿戴雕塑。
creators.why_zh: The Argus Project 摄像外骨骼的共同创作者。

creators.name: Molleindustria
creators.role: Independent game studio of Paolo Pedercini
