creators.bio: Italian-founded studio making short political video games about labour, war and technology.
creators.why: Unmanned plays out the ordinary day of a drone pilot.
creators.role_zh: Paolo Pedercini 的独立游戏工作室
creators.bio_zh: 意大利创立的工作室，制作关于劳动、战争与技术的短篇政治电子游戏。
creators.why_zh: Unmanned 让玩家度过一名无人机飞行员平常的一天。

creators.name: Ruben van de Ven
creators.bio: Dutch artist-researcher who examines emotion recognition and the politics of algorithmic seeing.
creators.why: Emotion Hero makes players train their faces for an emotion classifier.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家兼研究者，考察情绪识别与算法观看的政治。
creators.why_zh: Emotion Hero 让玩家为了情绪分类器去训练自己的脸。

creators.name: Steina Vasulka
creators.bio: Icelandic-born video pioneer who co-founded The Kitchen in New York with Woody Vasulka in 1971.
creators.why: Her Machine Vision series (1976–78) let cameras on motorised mounts see space without a human eye.
creators.role_zh: 录像艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 冰岛出生的录像艺术先驱，1971 年与 Woody Vasulka 在纽约共同创办 The Kitchen。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Machine Vision 系列（1976–78）让装在电动支架上的摄像机脱离人眼去观看空间。

creators.name: Etsuko Ichihara
creators.bio: Japanese media artist who combines folk rituals and customs with technologies such as robots, VR and face recognition.
creators.why: Her Digital Shaman and Namahage projects ask how old rituals change when machines perform them.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，把民俗仪式与习俗同机器人、VR、人脸识别等技术结合。
creators.why_zh: 她的 Digital Shaman 与 Namahage 项目追问：当机器来执行古老仪式时，仪式会怎样变化。

creators.name: Iris Long
creators.bio: Chinese artist and curator working on data, machine perception and the politics of algorithms.
creators.why: A leading Chinese voice on art about computation and datasets.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、策展人、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 中国艺术家与策展人，关注数据、机器感知与算法政治。
creators.why_zh: 关于计算与数据集的艺术创作在中国的重要声音。

creators.name: Jing-cai Liu
creators.bio: Chinese designer who makes wearable devices that question privacy and face recognition.
creators.why: The Wearable Face Projector is a much-cited design against face and emotion recognition.
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio_zh: 中国设计师，以可穿戴设备追问隐私与人脸识别。
creators.why_zh: Wearable Face Projector 是被广泛引用的对抗人脸与情绪识别的设计。

creators.name: unmake lab
creators.bio: Korean artist collective, including Choi Binna, that studies how machine vision constructs nature and society.
creators.why: They read AI classification and 'generic nature' in Korean construction landscapes.
creators.role_zh: 艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 韩国艺术团体（成员包括崔彬娜），研究机器视觉如何建构自然与社会。
creators.why_zh: 他们解读 AI 分类，以及韩国建设景观中的“通用自然”。

creators.name: Keiichi Matsuda
creators.bio: British-Japanese designer and filmmaker whose films imagine cities saturated with augmented reality.
creators.why: Hyper-Reality became a reference image for life inside a commercial machine view.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、电影人
creators.bio_zh: 英日混血的设计师与电影人，其影片想象被增强现实全面覆盖的城市。
creators.why_zh: Hyper-Reality 成为“生活在商业化机器视野中”的参照影像。

creators.name: Harun Farocki
creators.bio: German filmmaker, writer and installation artist who made over 90 films and installations on images, labour and war.
creators.why: He coined the term 'operational images': pictures made by machines for machines, a founding idea for machine-vision art.
creators.bio_zh: 德国电影人、作家与装置艺术家，创作了 90 多部关于图像、劳动与战争的影片和装置。
creators.why_zh: 他提出“操作图像”（由机器生成、供机器读取的图像）这一概念，是机器视觉艺术的奠基思想。

creators.name: Trevor Paglen
creators.bio: American artist and geographer whose photographs, installations and performances investigate surveillance, secrecy and computer vision.
creators.why: His works on training sets, facial recognition and 'invisible images' made the machine's way of seeing a central subject of contemporary art.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、地理学家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家与地理学家，以摄影、装置和表演研究监控、国家机密与计算机视觉。
creators.why_zh: 他关于训练数据集、人脸识别和“不可见图像”的作品，让机器的观看方式成为当代艺术的核心议题。
creators.based_zh: 柏林，德国 / 纽约，美国

creators.name: Kate Crawford
creators.role: Researcher and author; Research Professor, USC Annenberg
creators.bio: Australian scholar of the social and political implications of AI, co-founder of the AI Now Institute and author of Atlas of AI (2021).
creators.why: With Trevor Paglen and Vladan Joler she turned the critique of datasets and AI infrastructure into widely seen exhibitions and maps.
creators.role_zh: 研究者、作家；南加州大学安嫩伯格学院研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚学者，研究 AI 的社会与政治影响，AI Now 研究所联合创始人，著有《Atlas of AI》（2021）。
creators.why_zh: 她与 Trevor Paglen、Vladan Joler 合作，把对数据集与 AI 基础设施的批判变成了广为人知的展览与图谱。

creators.name: Benjamin Grosser
creators.role: Artist; Professor, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
creators.bio: American artist who builds software and interactive works about the cultural, social and political effects of computing.
creators.why: His machine-vision works show what a computer 'looks at' and ask how that differs from human attention.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，以软件和互动作品探讨计算对文化、社会与政治的影响。
creators.why_zh: 他的机器视觉作品展示计算机“在看什么”，追问它与人类注意力有何不同。

creators.name: David Rokeby
creators.bio: Canadian pioneer of interactive installation, known for Very Nervous System (1986–90) and works on machine perception and surveillance.
creators.why: Since 1990 his systems have staged machine seeing and naming as associative, fallible and political.
creators.role_zh: 装置艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大互动装置先驱，以《Very Nervous System》（1986–90）以及关于机器感知与监控的作品闻名。
creators.why_zh: 自 1990 年起，他的系统把机器的观看与命名呈现为联想式的、会出错的、带有政治性的过程。

creators.name: Myron Krueger
creators.bio: American computer artist (b. 1942) who built responsive environments from 1969 and coined the term 'artificial reality'.
creators.why: Videoplace was one of the first artworks in which a computer perceived the human body through a camera and answered it.
creators.role_zh: 计算机艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 美国计算机艺术家（生于 1942 年），1969 年起构建响应式环境，并提出“人工现实”一词。
creators.why_zh: 《Videoplace》是最早让计算机通过摄像头感知人体并作出回应的艺术作品之一。

creators.name: Jon Rafman
creators.bio: Canadian artist working with video, installation and found internet imagery.
creators.why: His Nine Eyes project was an early collection of the unintended images produced by an automated camera fleet.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、影像创作者
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家，以录像、装置和网络上的现成图像进行创作。
creators.why_zh: 他的《Nine Eyes》较早地收集了自动化相机车队无意间拍下的图像。

creators.name: Clement Valla
creators.role: Artist; teaches at Rhode Island School of Design
creators.bio: French-American artist whose works look at images and objects produced by automated systems and software.
creators.why: He shows that the strange images of automated systems are not errors but the system working exactly as designed.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；任教于罗德岛设计学院
creators.bio_zh: 法裔美国艺术家，研究由自动化系统和软件生成的图像与物件。
creators.why_zh: 他指出自动化系统产生的怪异图像并非错误，而正是系统按设计运行的结果。

creators.name: Esther Hovers
creators.bio: Dutch artist whose photographs and installations examine surveillance, power and normative behaviour in public space.
creators.why: False Positives visualises the behavioural 'anomalies' that intelligent surveillance cameras are trained to flag.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、摄影师
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家，以摄影和装置研究公共空间中的监控、权力与“正常行为”规范。
creators.why_zh: 《False Positives》把智能监控摄像头被训练去标记的“异常”行为变得可见。

creators.name: Nye Thompson
creators.bio: British artist who builds software systems that explore machine vision, surveillance networks and machine-made worldviews.
creators.why: Her AI entity The Seeker watched the world through insecure CCTV cameras and described what it saw.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，构建软件系统来探讨机器视觉、监控网络与由机器生成的世界观。
creators.why_zh: 她创造的 AI 实体 The Seeker 通过不设防的监控摄像头观看世界，并描述它所看到的一切。

creators.name: Rosa Menkman
creators.bio: Dutch artist and theorist of glitch, compression and resolution, author of The Glitch Moment(um) (2011).
creators.why: Her research on colour test cards shows how the standards of image processing were calibrated on anonymous women's faces.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、理论家
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰艺术家与理论家，研究故障、压缩与分辨率，著有《The Glitch Moment(um)》（2011）。
creators.why_zh: 她对色彩测试卡的研究表明，图像处理的标准是以无名女性的面孔为基准校准的。

creators.name: Everest Pipkin
creators.bio: Everest Pipkin makes games, software, drawings and datasets-as-artworks, and writes on the ethics of corpora used for machine learning.
creators.bio_zh: Everest Pipkin 创作游戏、软件、绘画，并把数据集本身当作作品，长期书写机器学习语料的伦理问题。
creators.why: Pipkin's Lacework made an entire video training set watchable, turning the dataset into the subject.
creators.why_zh: Pipkin 的《Lacework》让一个完整的视频训练集可以被“观看”，把数据集本身变成了作品的主题。
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、游戏设计师、写作者

creators.name: Philipp Schmitt
creators.bio: Philipp Schmitt (b. 1993) is an artist and designer whose installations, artist books and websites engage with the philosophical, poetic and political sides of computation.
creators.bio_zh: Philipp Schmitt（1993 年生）是艺术家和设计师，以装置、艺术家书和网站探讨计算的哲学、诗意与政治面向。
creators.why: His works expose the training images, labels and photographers behind computer vision.
creators.why_zh: 他的作品揭示了计算机视觉背后的训练图像、标签以及拍下这些照片的人。
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师

creators.name: Sebastian Schmieg
creators.bio: Sebastian Schmieg is a Berlin-based artist who works with found datasets, custom software, websites and lecture performances on the human labour inside algorithmic systems.
creators.bio_zh: Sebastian Schmieg 是常驻柏林的艺术家，用现成数据集、定制软件、网站和讲座表演，揭示算法系统中的人类劳动。
creators.why: He showed early how computer vision rests on crowd-workers' clicks and on arbitrary categories.
creators.why_zh: 他较早揭示了计算机视觉建立在众包工人的点击和武断的分类之上。
creators.role_zh: 艺术家

creators.name: Mushon Zer-Aviv
creators.bio: Mushon Zer-Aviv is a designer, educator and media activist who works on data, surveillance and algorithmic bias.
creators.bio_zh: Mushon Zer-Aviv 是设计师、教育者和媒体行动者，关注数据、监控与算法偏见。
creators.why: The Normalizing Machine turns visitors into the labellers of a face-based model of 'normal'.
creators.why_zh: 《The Normalizing Machine》让观众成为一个以人脸定义“正常”的模型的标注者。
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者、媒体行动者

creators.name: Forensic Architecture
creators.role: Research agency, Goldsmiths, University of London
creators.bio: Forensic Architecture, founded by Eyal Weizman in 2010, investigates state and corporate violence with spatial, architectural and computational methods and presents its findings in courts and museums.
creators.bio_zh: Forensic Architecture（法证建筑）由 Eyal Weizman 于 2010 年创立，用空间、建筑与计算方法调查国家和企业暴力，并在法庭与美术馆中呈现结果。
creators.why: It turns computer vision around: training classifiers on synthetic images to find evidence of human-rights abuses.
creators.why_zh: 它反转了计算机视觉的用途：用合成图像训练分类器，寻找侵犯人权的证据。
creators.role_zh: 研究机构，伦敦大学金史密斯学院

creators.name: Simone C. Niquille
creators.bio: Simone C. Niquille runs technoflesh Studio, making films and writing on computer vision, 3D capture and synthetic training datasets; they initiated the parametric truth Lab at Design Academy Eindhoven.
creators.bio_zh: Simone C. Niquille 主持 technoflesh Studio，以影片和写作研究计算机视觉、三维扫描与合成训练数据集，并在埃因霍温设计学院创办 parametric truth Lab。
creators.why: Their films show how domestic robots are taught to see homes through strange synthetic datasets.
creators.why_zh: 他们的影片展示了家用机器人如何通过古怪的合成数据集学习“看懂”家。
creators.role_zh: 设计师、研究者，technoflesh Studio

creators.name: Ursula Damm
creators.role: Artist; Professor of Media Environments, Bauhaus-Universität Weimar
creators.bio: Ursula Damm is a German media artist whose generative video installations use live camera input and neural networks to explore perception, urban space and nature.
creators.bio_zh: Ursula Damm 是德国媒体艺术家，她的生成影像装置以实时摄像输入和神经网络探讨感知、城市空间与自然。
creators.why: Membrane lets visitors steer how a neural network turns a street it watches into images of its own.
creators.why_zh: 《Membrane》让观众操控神经网络如何把它所观看的街道转化为它自己的图像。
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；包豪斯魏玛大学媒体环境教授

creators.name: Jia Deng
creators.role: Computer scientist; Associate Professor, Princeton University
creators.bio: Jia Deng is a computer-vision researcher who, as a PhD student with Fei-Fei Li, led the construction of the ImageNet dataset.
creators.bio_zh: 邓嘉是计算机视觉研究者，读博期间在李飞飞指导下主导构建了 ImageNet 数据集。
creators.why: ImageNet's categories and crowd-sourced labels became the worldview of modern computer vision, and a central object of critique for artists.
creators.why_zh: ImageNet 的类别体系和众包标签成为现代计算机视觉的世界观，也成为艺术家批判的核心对象。
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家；普林斯顿大学副教授

creators.name: Abeba Birhane
creators.role: Cognitive scientist; Assistant Professor, Trinity College Dublin
creators.bio: Abeba Birhane is an Ethiopian-born cognitive scientist who audits large-scale datasets and writes on relational ethics and AI.
creators.bio_zh: Abeba Birhane 是出生于埃塞俄比亚的认知科学家，审计大规模数据集，并从关系伦理角度研究 AI。
creators.why: Her audits showed that the image datasets vision models learn from contain slurs, non-consensual and harmful images.
creators.why_zh: 她的审计揭示了视觉模型所学习的图像数据集中含有侮辱性标签、未经同意的和有害的图像。
creators.role_zh: 认知科学家；都柏林圣三一学院助理教授

creators.name: Heather Dewey-Hagborg
creators.bio: Heather Dewey-Hagborg is an American artist whose work deals with genetic surveillance, DNA phenotyping and the algorithms that turn biological traces into faces.
creators.why: She shows how machines claim to read identity from bodily data, and how much of a 'face' is a model's guess.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、生物黑客
creators.bio_zh: Heather Dewey-Hagborg 是美国艺术家，作品关注基因监控、DNA 表型推断，以及把生物痕迹变成人脸的算法。
creators.why_zh: 她揭示机器如何声称能从身体数据中读出身份，以及一张“脸”有多少只是模型的猜测。

creators.name: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer
creators.bio: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer is a Mexican-Canadian artist whose interactive installations use tracking, biometrics and surveillance systems in public and museum spaces.
creators.why: Since the early 1990s he has turned machine tracking and face recognition back on the public, making the watching apparatus itself the work.
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；Antimodular Research 创始人
creators.bio_zh: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer 是墨西哥裔加拿大艺术家，其互动装置在公共空间和美术馆中使用追踪、生物识别与监控系统。
creators.why_zh: 自 1990 年代初起，他把机器追踪与人脸识别反转向观众，让观看装置本身成为作品。

creators.name: Krzysztof Wodiczko
creators.role: Artist; Professor in Residence, Harvard Graduate School of Design
creators.bio: Krzysztof Wodiczko is a Polish-born artist known for large public projections and instruments that give voice to marginalised people.
creators.why: His collaboration with Lozano-Hemmer brings his long critique of public space and surveillance to robotic, face-detecting cameras.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；哈佛大学设计研究生院驻院教授
creators.bio_zh: Krzysztof Wodiczko 是波兰出生的艺术家，以大型公共投影及为边缘群体发声的“工具”作品闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他与洛萨诺-亨默的合作，把他对公共空间与监控的长期批判带入会检测人脸的机器人摄像机。

creators.name: Dries Depoorter
creators.bio: Dries Depoorter is a Belgian artist who makes installations, apps and online projects about privacy, surveillance cameras and machine learning.
creators.why: His works run real computer-vision pipelines on public camera feeds, showing how easily open data and AI combine into surveillance.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: Dries Depoorter 是比利时艺术家，以装置、应用和网络项目探讨隐私、监控摄像头与机器学习。
creators.why_zh: 他把真实的计算机视觉流程接到公开摄像头上，显示开放数据与 AI 能多么轻易地组合成监控。

creators.name: Karen Palmer
creators.bio: Karen Palmer is a British artist who makes immersive films that respond to the viewer's emotions and gaze through AI, eye tracking and facial analysis.
creators.why: She puts the viewer inside biased perception systems, so that their own face and fear steer the story.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，自称“来自未来的讲故事者”
creators.bio_zh: Karen Palmer 是英国艺术家，创作通过 AI、眼动追踪与面部分析回应观众情绪与视线的沉浸式电影。
creators.why_zh: 她把观众放进带有偏见的感知系统之中，让观众自己的面孔与恐惧来推动剧情。

creators.name: Paolo Cirio
creators.bio: Paolo Cirio is an Italian artist whose interventions expose the legal, social and economic systems of information technology, from privacy to finance.
creators.why: He turns surveillance tools on the powerful, testing the asymmetry of who may be seen and identified by machines.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: Paolo Cirio 是意大利艺术家，其介入式作品揭示信息技术背后的法律、社会与经济系统，从隐私到金融。
creators.why_zh: 他把监控工具对准掌权者，检验“谁可以被机器看见和识别”这种不对称。

creators.name: Coralie Vogelaar
creators.bio: Coralie Vogelaar is a Dutch visual artist who works with emotion-recognition software, biofeedback and choreography to study how machines decode bodies.
creators.why: She stages the Facial Action Coding System as a score, showing how emotion AI reduces feeling to measurable muscle units.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家
creators.bio_zh: Coralie Vogelaar 是荷兰视觉艺术家，结合情绪识别软件、生物反馈与编舞，研究机器如何解码身体。
creators.why_zh: 她把面部动作编码系统当作乐谱来演出，揭示情绪 AI 如何把感受简化为可测量的肌肉单元。

creators.name: Julien Prévieux
creators.bio: Julien Prévieux is a French artist whose films, performances and drawings examine how bodies and gestures are measured, patented and optimised by technical systems.
creators.why: His choreographies re-enact the protocols that made human movement machine-readable, from chronophotography to tracking software.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；2014 年马塞尔·杜尚奖得主
creators.bio_zh: Julien Prévieux 是法国艺术家，以影像、表演与绘画研究身体与姿势如何被技术系统测量、申请专利与优化。
creators.why_zh: 他的编舞重演那些让人类动作变得可被机器读取的实验规程，从连续摄影到追踪软件。

creators.name: Lisa Feldman Barrett
creators.role: Psychologist and neuroscientist; University Distinguished Professor, Northeastern University
creators.bio: Lisa Feldman Barrett is a Canadian-American psychologist known for the theory of constructed emotion.
creators.why: Her team's review showed that facial movements do not reliably reveal emotions, undercutting the premise of emotion-recognition AI.
creators.role_zh: 心理学家、神经科学家；美国东北大学校级杰出教授
creators.bio_zh: Lisa Feldman Barrett 是加拿大裔美国心理学家，以“情绪建构论”闻名。
creators.why_zh: 她团队的综述表明，面部动作并不能可靠地揭示情绪，动摇了情绪识别 AI 的前提。

creators.name: Blaise Agüera y Arcas
creators.role: Engineer and researcher; VP and Fellow, Google
creators.bio: Blaise Agüera y Arcas is an American computer scientist who leads research on machine intelligence at Google and founded its Artists + Machine Intelligence programme.
creators.why: With Margaret Mitchell and Alexander Todorov he wrote an influential critique of machine-learning physiognomy.
creators.role_zh: 工程师与研究者；Google 副总裁、Fellow
creators.bio_zh: Blaise Agüera y Arcas 是美国计算机科学家，在 Google 领导机器智能研究，并创立了 Artists + Machine Intelligence 项目。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Margaret Mitchell、Alexander Todorov 合写的文章，是对机器学习“面相学”影响深远的批判。

creators.name: Adam Harvey
creators.role: Artist and researcher (computer vision, privacy, surveillance)
creators.bio: American artist and researcher who has worked on computer vision, biometrics and counter-surveillance since his 2010 NYU ITP thesis CV Dazzle. His later research projects trace how face datasets are built and apply object detection to human-rights archives.
creators.why: Turned face detection into a design problem and showed how everyday photos became training data for biometric surveillance.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者（计算机视觉、隐私与监控）
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家、研究者，自 2010 年在纽约大学 ITP 的毕业作品 CV Dazzle 起持续研究计算机视觉、生物识别与反监控。后续研究追踪人脸数据集如何建成，并把目标检测技术用于人权档案。
creators.why_zh: 把“躲避人脸检测”变成设计问题，并揭示日常照片如何变成生物识别监控的训练数据。

creators.name: Jules LaPlace
creators.bio: Artist and programmer who built the website and search engine of MegaPixels and Exposing.ai with Adam Harvey.
creators.why: Co-built the search tool that lets people check whether their photos sit inside face-recognition datasets.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、软件开发者
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家、程序员，与 Adam Harvey 合作开发了 MegaPixels 与 Exposing.ai 的网站和搜索引擎。
creators.why_zh: 共同打造了让普通人查询自己的照片是否被收入人脸识别数据集的搜索工具。

creators.name: Sterling Crispin
creators.bio: American artist and technologist whose early work reverse-engineered face detection and recognition systems; he later worked on AR/VR and neurotechnology.
creators.why: Data-masks give physical form to what a face-recognition algorithm takes a face to be.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家、技术专家，早期作品对人脸检测与识别系统进行逆向工程，后来从事 AR/VR 与神经技术研发。
creators.why_zh: Data-masks 把人脸识别算法心目中的“脸”做成了实体。

creators.name: Leo Selvaggio
creators.bio: Chicago-based interdisciplinary artist (Leonardo Selvaggio) whose projects on surveillance ask the public to wear, perform or hack his identity.
creators.why: URME Surveillance answers face recognition by multiplying one face instead of hiding many.
creators.role_zh: 跨领域艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 常驻芝加哥的跨领域艺术家（Leonardo Selvaggio），他关于监控的项目邀请公众佩戴、扮演或“黑入”他的身份。
creators.why_zh: URME Surveillance 对付人脸识别的办法不是隐藏许多张脸，而是复制同一张脸。

creators.name: Cap_able
creators.bio: Italian start-up founded by Rachele Didero and Federica Busani that makes knitwear with adversarial patterns against AI person and face detection; the idea began in New York in 2019.
creators.why: Brought adversarial examples out of the lab and into knitted clothing sold to the public.
creators.role_zh: 时尚科技初创公司（Rachele Didero、Federica Busani）
creators.bio_zh: 由 Rachele Didero 与 Federica Busani 创立的意大利初创公司，生产带有对抗图案、可干扰 AI 人体与人脸检测的针织服装；构想始于 2019 年的纽约。
creators.why_zh: 把对抗样本从实验室带进了可以买到、穿上的针织衣物。

creators.name: Tom White
creators.role: Artist (dribnet); Senior Lecturer, Victoria University of Wellington School of Design
creators.bio: New Zealand-based artist and design lecturer, known online as dribnet, who makes drawings and prints optimised to be read by neural-network classifiers.
creators.why: Makes art whose first audience is the machine, exposing how classifiers see abstract form.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（dribnet）；惠灵顿维多利亚大学设计学院高级讲师
creators.bio_zh: 常驻新西兰的艺术家与设计讲师，网名 dribnet，创作专门供神经网络分类器“阅读”的绘画与版画。
creators.why_zh: 他的作品首先是给机器看的，从而暴露分类器如何理解抽象形状。

creators.name: James Bridle
creators.bio: British artist and writer on technology, networks and non-human intelligence, author of New Dark Age (2018) and Ways of Being (2022).
creators.why: Uses simple, ritual-like gestures to show how automated systems read and misread the world.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、作家
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家、作家，关注技术、网络与非人智能，著有《New Dark Age》（2018）和《Ways of Being》（2022）。
creators.why_zh: 用近乎仪式的简单动作，揭示自动化系统如何读取、又如何误读世界。

creators.name: Simon Weckert
creators.bio: Berlin-based artist whose performances and installations probe the social effects of digital technologies and platforms.
creators.why: Showed with a handcart of phones how a platform's sensing of the city can be fooled and then shapes real traffic.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 常驻柏林的艺术家，以表演和装置探讨数字技术与平台的社会影响。
creators.why_zh: 用一辆装满手机的手推车证明：平台对城市的“感知”可以被欺骗，而这种错误又会改变真实的交通。

creators.name: Tomo Kihara
creators.role: Designer and artist; co-founder of Playfool
creators.bio: Japanese designer and artist who makes playful games and installations about AI, platforms and the city, often with Daniel Coppen as the studio Playfool.
creators.why: Turns the blind spots of machine perception into games the public can play and learn from.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、艺术家；Playfool 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 日本设计师、艺术家，常与 Daniel Coppen 以工作室 Playfool 的名义，创作关于 AI、平台与城市的游戏和装置。
creators.why_zh: 把机器感知的盲区变成公众可以亲手玩、从中学习的游戏。

creators.name: Daniel Coppen
creators.bio: British designer who co-founded the design studio Playfool with Tomo Kihara, making games and interactive installations.
creators.why: Co-created a street game that lets people test and expose pedestrian detection.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；Playfool 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 英国设计师，与木原共共同创立设计工作室 Playfool，创作游戏与互动装置。
creators.why_zh: 共同创作了一款让人亲身测试并揭露行人检测缺陷的街头游戏。

creators.name: Evolving AI Lab
creators.role: Research lab (Jeff Clune), University of Wyoming
creators.bio: Jeff Clune's lab at the University of Wyoming, working on evolutionary algorithms and deep learning; its members Anh Nguyen and Jason Yosinski co-authored the 'fooling images' paper.
creators.why: Showed that image classifiers confidently see objects in noise and abstract patterns that mean nothing to humans.
creators.role_zh: 研究实验室（Jeff Clune），怀俄明大学
creators.bio_zh: Jeff Clune 在怀俄明大学领导的实验室，研究进化算法与深度学习；成员 Anh Nguyen 与 Jason Yosinski 合著了“欺骗图像”论文。
creators.why_zh: 证明图像分类器会在噪声和对人类毫无意义的抽象图案中，自信地“看到”物体。

creators.name: Mahmood Sharif
creators.role: Computer security researcher; Tel Aviv University (PhD, Carnegie Mellon University)
creators.bio: Security and machine-learning researcher who, as a PhD student at Carnegie Mellon, led the study showing that printed eyeglass frames can fool face recognition.
creators.why: His adversarial glasses made physical evasion of face recognition concrete and wearable.
creators.role_zh: 计算机安全研究者；特拉维夫大学（卡内基梅隆大学博士）
creators.bio_zh: 安全与机器学习研究者，在卡内基梅隆大学读博期间主导了用打印眼镜框欺骗人脸识别的研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的对抗眼镜让“在现实中躲避人脸识别”变得具体、可以戴在脸上。

creators.name: Tom B. Brown
creators.role: Machine-learning researcher (Google Brain, later OpenAI and Anthropic)
creators.bio: Machine-learning researcher who led the 2017 Google Brain paper on the adversarial patch and later led work on large language models.
creators.why: The adversarial patch showed that a printed sticker can override everything else a classifier sees.
creators.role_zh: 机器学习研究者（Google Brain，后任职 OpenAI 与 Anthropic）
creators.bio_zh: 机器学习研究者，2017 年主导了 Google Brain 关于“对抗补丁”的论文，后来参与领导大语言模型研究。
creators.why_zh: 对抗补丁证明：一张打印贴纸就能压倒分类器看到的其他一切。

creators.name: Kevin Eykholt
creators.role: Computer security researcher (PhD, University of Michigan)
creators.bio: Security researcher who, at the University of Michigan, was first author of the study on stickers that make classifiers misread stop signs.
creators.why: His stop-sign experiment made the risks of adversarial examples for self-driving cars widely visible.
creators.role_zh: 计算机安全研究者（密歇根大学博士）
creators.bio_zh: 安全研究者，在密歇根大学期间作为第一作者发表了用贴纸让分类器误读停车标志的研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的停车标志实验让对抗样本对自动驾驶的风险广为人知。

creators.name: Lawrence Abu Hamdan
creators.bio: Artist whose audio investigations of voices, gunshots and silences have served as evidence in asylum hearings and human-rights cases; joint winner of the 2019 Turner Prize.
creators.why: He shows how listening becomes a technology of the border and the court: accent analysis, voice-stress lie detection and audio forensics that decide who is believed.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、声音调查者（自称“私人耳朵”）
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家，他对声音、枪声与沉默所做的音频调查曾在庇护听证和人权案件中被用作证据；2019 年特纳奖联合得主。
creators.why_zh: 他揭示“听”如何成为边境与法庭的技术：口音分析、语音测谎与音频取证，决定了谁的话会被相信。

creators.name: Machine Listening (Sean Dockray, James Parker, Joel Stern)
creators.bio: Platform for collaborative research and artistic experimentation founded in 2020 by Sean Dockray, James Parker and Joel Stern, working across writing, installation, performance, radio, software and pedagogy.
creators.why: They made 'machine listening' a critical field for art: voice assistants, audio datasets and acoustic surveillance treated as knowledge-power, extraction and control.
creators.role_zh: 研究与艺术团体
creators.bio_zh: 由 Sean Dockray、James Parker 与 Joel Stern 于 2020 年创立的协作研究与艺术实验平台，横跨写作、装置、表演、电台、软件与教学。
creators.why_zh: 他们把“机器聆听”变成艺术的批判领域：语音助手、音频数据集与声学监控被视为知识权力、攫取与控制。

creators.name: Pedro Oliveira
creators.role: Sound artist and researcher; guest faculty, Sound Studies and Sonic Arts, Universität der Künste Berlin
creators.bio: Brazilian sound artist and researcher (born 1985, São Paulo) whose work examines how listening shapes and is shaped by technical infrastructures, focusing on voice and migration; founding member of Decolonising Design.
creators.why: He is the key artist on dialect-recognition software in the German asylum system, reading machine listening as colonial listening.
creators.role_zh: 声音艺术家、研究者；柏林艺术大学声音研究与声音艺术客座教师
creators.bio_zh: 巴西声音艺术家与研究者（1985 年生于圣保罗），研究“听”如何塑造技术基础设施又被其塑造，关注声音与移民；Decolonising Design 创始成员之一。
creators.why_zh: 他是研究德国庇护体系中“方言识别软件”的关键艺术家，把机器聆听解读为一种殖民式的聆听。

creators.name: Bjørn Karmann
creators.bio: Danish designer trained at the Copenhagen Institute of Interaction Design (CIID) who builds working devices that let people train, hack or rethink machine perception.
creators.why: His objects make machine senses tangible and negotiable: a parasite that deafens smart speakers, a socket you teach by example, a camera that sees through data instead of light.
creators.role_zh: 设计师、创意技术专家
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦设计师，毕业于哥本哈根交互设计学院（CIID），制作可以实际运行的设备，让人训练、改造或重新思考机器感知。
creators.why_zh: 他的物件让机器的感官变得可触摸、可协商：让智能音箱“失聪”的寄生装置、靠示范来教会的插座、以数据而非光线来“看”的相机。

creators.name: Tore Knudsen
creators.bio: Danish interaction designer and CIID alumnus working on tangible interfaces for machine learning and smart-home technology.
creators.why: Co-author of Project Alias, a key example of a user-built counter-device against always-listening voice assistants.
creators.role_zh: 交互设计师、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦交互设计师，CIID 校友，研究面向机器学习与智能家居的实体交互界面。
creators.why_zh: Project Alias 的共同作者；这件作品是用户自制、对抗“永远在听”的语音助手的典型反设备。

creators.name: Joana Moll
creators.bio: Barcelona-based artist and researcher whose works examine the material, ecological and surveillant infrastructures of the internet, from border webcams to data brokers and the carbon cost of websites.
creators.why: She exposes what networked machines actually record and consume, often by letting their own automated outputs speak.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 常驻巴塞罗那的艺术家与研究者，作品考察互联网的物质、生态与监控基础设施，从边境摄像头到数据经纪商，再到网站的碳排放。
creators.why_zh: 她常让联网机器自己的自动产出发声，揭示它们实际记录和消耗了什么。

creators.name: Nicholas Carlini
creators.bio: Computer-security researcher known for foundational work on adversarial examples, audio adversarial attacks and training-data extraction from neural networks.
creators.why: His attacks show that speech recognisers hear things humans cannot, and can be commanded by sounds that are noise to us.
creators.role_zh: 机器学习安全研究者
creators.bio_zh: 计算机安全研究者，以对抗样本、音频对抗攻击以及从神经网络中提取训练数据的奠基性研究闻名。
creators.why_zh: 他的攻击表明，语音识别器能“听到”人听不到的东西，也能被对人来说只是噪声的声音所操控。

creators.name: Allison Koenecke
creators.role: Computational social scientist; Assistant Professor of Information Science, Cornell University
creators.bio: Researcher in algorithmic fairness who led the first large audit of racial disparities in commercial speech recognition.
creators.why: Her audit gave hard numbers to the claim that listening machines hear some voices worse than others.
creators.role_zh: 计算社会科学家；康奈尔大学信息科学助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 算法公平研究者，主导了第一项针对商用语音识别种族差异的大规模审计。
creators.why_zh: 她的审计用确切数据证明：听觉机器对某些人的声音“听”得更差。

creators.name: Brian House
creators.bio: Artist working with sound, data and environmental sensing, whose projects turn tracking, listening and infrastructure into perceptible rhythms.
creators.why: With Kyle McDonald he made Conversnitch, which shows the human labour and publicity hidden behind an eavesdropping device.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio_zh: 以声音、数据与环境感测为媒介的艺术家，把追踪、聆听与基础设施转化为可感知的节奏。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Kyle McDonald 合作的 Conversnitch 揭示了窃听设备背后隐藏的人工劳动与公开化。

creators.name: Johann Diedrick
creators.role: Artist and engineer; adjunct professor, NYU ITP
creators.bio: Artist and engineer who makes 'listening rooms' through installations, performances, software and workshops, and teaches sound art and listening machines at NYU ITP; 2021 Mozilla Creative Media Award recipient.
creators.why: He brings Black speech and its absence from training data to the centre of machine-listening art.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、工程师；纽约大学 ITP 兼职教授
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家与工程师，通过装置、表演、软件与工作坊营造“聆听空间”，在纽约大学 ITP 教授声音艺术与聆听机器；2021 年 Mozilla 创意媒体奖得主。
creators.why_zh: 他把黑人的语音，以及它在训练数据中的缺席，放到了机器聆听艺术的中心。

creators.name: Aaron Koblin
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、技术人
creators.bio: American artist known for data visualisation and crowdsourced works; later co-founded the VR studio Within.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，以数据可视化和众包作品闻名，后联合创立了 VR 工作室 Within。
creators.why: His Mechanical Turk works were among the first artworks about paid micro-labour online.
creators.why_zh: 他的 Mechanical Turk 作品是最早讨论网络计件微劳动的艺术作品之一。

creators.name: Agnieszka Kurant
creators.role_zh: 观念艺术家
creators.bio: Polish artist who examines collective intelligence, non-human labour and the invisible economy.
creators.bio_zh: 波兰艺术家，研究集体智能、非人类劳动与“看不见的经济”。
creators.why: She makes crowds, termites and algorithms into co-authors to question who does the work of intelligence.
creators.why_zh: 她让人群、白蚁和算法成为合作者，追问“智能”的劳动由谁完成。

creators.name: Andrew Norman Wilson
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio: American artist whose films and images deal with labour, corporations and the media they produce.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，影像与图像作品关注劳动、企业及其生产的媒介。
creators.why: He was fired by a Google contractor for filming the book-scanning workers at the Googleplex.
creators.why_zh: 他因拍摄谷歌园区里的图书扫描工人而被谷歌外包商解雇。

creators.name: Nicolas Gourault
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio: French artist whose documentary installations investigate the human labour behind automated vision.
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家，以纪录影像装置调查自动化视觉背后的人类劳动。
creators.why: His films give voice to the drivers and annotators who train self-driving cars.
creators.why_zh: 他的影片让训练自动驾驶汽车的司机和标注员发声。

creators.name: Lilly Irani
creators.role: Associate Professor of Communication, UC San Diego
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校传播学副教授
creators.bio: American scholar and former Google designer who studies crowd work, innovation and design politics.
creators.bio_zh: 美国学者、前谷歌设计师，研究众包劳动、创新与设计政治。
creators.why: She co-built Turkopticon, a tool that lets Mechanical Turk workers review their employers.
creators.why_zh: 她参与创建了 Turkopticon，让 Mechanical Turk 工人评价雇主。

creators.name: M. Six Silberman
creators.role_zh: 平台劳动研究者
creators.bio: American researcher who co-created Turkopticon and later worked with the German metalworkers' union IG Metall on platform work.
creators.bio_zh: 美国研究者，Turkopticon 的共同创建者，后来与德国金属工会 IG Metall 合作研究平台劳动。
creators.why: He connects HCI tools with labour organising.
creators.why_zh: 他把人机交互工具与劳工组织联系起来。

creators.name: Elisa Giardina Papa
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.based_zh: 美国纽约 / 意大利西西里
creators.bio: Italian artist whose videos investigate gender, care work and labour in digital economies and AI.
creators.bio_zh: 意大利艺术家，影像作品研究数字经济与 AI 中的性别、照护与劳动。
creators.why: She works the gig jobs that feed AI and films what the work does to the worker.
creators.why_zh: 她亲自去做为 AI 输送数据的零工，并拍下这种工作对劳动者的影响。

creators.name: Michael Mandiberg
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，纽约城市大学教授
creators.bio: American artist whose work uses the logics of digital platforms, from Wikipedia printing to gig-economy outsourcing.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，作品运用数字平台的逻辑，从打印维基百科到零工经济外包。
creators.why: He outsourced the remake of a film about the assembly line to the online gig economy.
creators.why_zh: 他把一部关于流水线的电影的重拍外包给网络零工经济。

creators.name: Hans Block
creators.role_zh: 导演、剧场创作者
creators.bio: German director who works with Moritz Riesewieck on films and plays about digital power.
creators.bio_zh: 德国导演，与 Moritz Riesewieck 合作创作关于数字权力的电影和戏剧。
creators.why: With Riesewieck he revealed the moderators who clean social media for the rest of us.
creators.why_zh: 他与 Riesewieck 一同揭示了为大众清理社交媒体的审核员。

creators.name: Moritz Riesewieck
creators.role_zh: 导演、作家
creators.bio: German director and author; co-director of The Cleaners and Eternal You with Hans Block.
creators.bio_zh: 德国导演和作家，与 Hans Block 合导了《清道夫》和《永恒的你》。
creators.why: He follows the human labour and grief that platforms and AI turn into services.
creators.why_zh: 他追踪平台和 AI 如何把人的劳动与哀伤变成服务。

creators.name: Adrian Chen
creators.role_zh: 记者
creators.bio: American journalist whose 2014 Wired report first described the global workforce of content moderators.
creators.bio_zh: 美国记者，2014 年在《连线》发表的报道首次描述了全球内容审核员群体。
creators.why: He made content moderation visible as labour.
creators.why_zh: 他让内容审核作为一种劳动被看见。

creators.name: Ciarán Cassidy
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演
creators.bio: Irish documentary director.
creators.bio_zh: 爱尔兰纪录片导演。
creators.why: He co-directed The Moderators, filmed in a moderation training centre in India.
creators.why_zh: 他联合执导了在印度一个内容审核培训中心拍摄的《审核员》。

creators.name: Milagros Miceli
creators.role: Sociologist and computer scientist; DAIR Institute and Weizenbaum Institute
creators.role_zh: 社会学家、计算机科学家，DAIR 研究所与魏森鲍姆研究所
creators.bio: Argentine researcher who studies the work of data annotators and content moderators in the Global South.
creators.bio_zh: 阿根廷研究者，研究全球南方的数据标注员和内容审核员的工作。
creators.why: She makes data workers co-researchers of their own conditions.
creators.why_zh: 她让数据工人成为研究自身处境的共同研究者。

creators.name: Paul Vanouse
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，纽约州立大学布法罗分校教授
creators.bio: American artist who works with biotechnology to question scientific authority, identity and labour.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，运用生物技术质疑科学权威、身份与劳动。
creators.why: His Labor asks what work smells like when no workers are left.
creators.why_zh: 他的《劳动》追问：当工人都不在了，劳动闻起来是什么味道。

creators.name: Alex Rivera
creators.role_zh: 电影人
creators.bio: Peruvian-American filmmaker who uses science fiction to address migration, borders and labour.
creators.bio_zh: 秘鲁裔美国电影人，以科幻片探讨移民、边境与劳动。
creators.why: He imagined remote-controlled migrant labour years before teleoperated robots became a business.
creators.why_zh: 他在远程操控机器人成为生意多年之前，就想象了被远程操控的移民劳动。

creators.name: Vladan Joler
creators.role: Artist and researcher; SHARE Foundation; Professor, University of Novi Sad
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者，SHARE 基金会，诺维萨德大学教授
creators.bio: Serbian artist and researcher who draws large diagrammatic maps of technology, extraction and power.
creators.bio_zh: 塞尔维亚艺术家和研究者，绘制关于技术、攫取与权力的大型图解地图。
creators.why: His diagrams turned platforms and AI systems into readable anatomies of exploitation.
creators.why_zh: 他的图解把平台与 AI 系统变成可以阅读的剥削解剖图。

creators.name: Unknown Fields Division
creators.role: Nomadic design studio led by Liam Young and Kate Davies
creators.role_zh: 由 Liam Young 和 Kate Davies 领导的游牧式设计工作室
creators.bio: Design research studio that led expeditions to the mines, factories and ports behind consumer technology.
creators.bio_zh: 设计研究工作室，带队考察消费科技背后的矿山、工厂和港口。
creators.why: It made the toxic geography of electronics into objects for the museum.
creators.why_zh: 它把电子产品的有毒地理变成了博物馆里的物件。

creators.name: Tabita Rezaire
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、疗愈者
creators.bio: French-Guianese-Danish artist whose videos connect digital networks, colonial history and spiritual technologies.
creators.bio_zh: 法属圭亚那-丹麦裔艺术家，影像作品把数字网络、殖民历史与灵性技术联系在一起。
creators.why: She shows internet infrastructure as a continuation of colonial routes.
creators.why_zh: 她把互联网基础设施呈现为殖民航线的延续。

creators.name: Timo Arnall
creators.role_zh: 设计师、电影人
creators.bio: British designer whose films and research make invisible technologies such as RFID, satellites and data centres visible.
creators.bio_zh: 英国设计师，以影像和研究让 RFID、卫星和数据中心等看不见的技术变得可见。
creators.why: He filmed the inside of the cloud as a physical, noisy machine.
creators.why_zh: 他把“云”的内部拍成一台实在、嘈杂的机器。

creators.name: #NotABugSplat collective
creators.role: Artist collective (with Reprieve and the Foundation for Fundamental Rights)
creators.role_zh: 艺术家团体（与 Reprieve 和基本权利基金会合作）
creators.bio: Collective of Pakistani and American artists who installed a giant portrait in a Khyber Pakhtunkhwa field, visible to drone cameras.
creators.bio_zh: 由巴基斯坦和美国艺术家组成的团体，在开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省的田野里铺设了一幅无人机镜头可见的巨幅肖像。
creators.why: They addressed drone operators through the drone's own camera.
creators.why_zh: 他们通过无人机自己的镜头向操作员喊话。

creators.name: Ruben Pater
creators.role_zh: 设计师
creators.bio: Dutch graphic designer whose work addresses politics, surveillance and design ethics; author of The Politics of Design.
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰平面设计师，作品关注政治、监控与设计伦理，著有《设计的政治》。
creators.why: He designed a field guide for the people who live under drones.
creators.why_zh: 他为生活在无人机之下的人设计了一本野外识别手册。

creators.name: Tomas van Houtryve
creators.role_zh: 摄影师、艺术家
creators.bio: Belgian-American photographer who works on conflict, surveillance and history.
creators.bio_zh: 比利时裔美国摄影师，关注冲突、监控与历史。
creators.why: He turned the drone's view back on the country that deploys it.
creators.why_zh: 他把无人机的视角转向部署无人机的国家本身。

creators.name: Josh Begley
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio: American data artist and filmmaker whose work maps US drone strikes, prisons and policing.
creators.bio_zh: 美国数据艺术家与电影人，作品记录美国的无人机空袭、监狱与警务。
creators.why: His app pushed a notification to your phone every time a US drone strike was reported.
creators.why_zh: 他的应用会在每次美国无人机空袭被报道时向手机推送通知。

creators.name: Sonia Kennebeck
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演、制片人
creators.bio: German-American investigative filmmaker.
creators.bio_zh: 德裔美国调查纪录片导演。
creators.why: Her film follows three whistleblowers from the US drone programme.
creators.why_zh: 她的影片跟随美国无人机项目的三位吹哨人。

creators.name: Future of Life Institute / Stop Autonomous Weapons
creators.role: Non-profit on existential risks of technology
creators.role_zh: 关注技术生存风险的非营利组织
creators.bio: Non-profit that campaigns, with AI researchers such as Stuart Russell, for a ban on lethal autonomous weapons.
creators.bio_zh: 非营利组织，与 Stuart Russell 等 AI 研究者一道推动禁止致命性自主武器。
creators.why: It used a short fiction film to put autonomous weapons on the UN agenda.
creators.why_zh: 它用一部短篇虚构电影把自主武器推上了联合国议程。

creators.name: Joy Buolamwini
creators.role: Computer scientist, poet of code; founder, Algorithmic Justice League
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家、“代码诗人”，算法正义联盟创始人
creators.bio: Ghanaian-American-Canadian researcher who found that face-analysis systems failed on her dark-skinned face at MIT Media Lab and turned the finding into audits, poems and a movement.
creators.bio_zh: 加纳裔美籍加拿大研究者。她在 MIT 媒体实验室发现人脸分析系统无法识别她的深色皮肤面孔，并把这一发现变成算法审计、诗歌和一场社会运动。
creators.why: She coined the 'coded gaze' and showed, with numbers and with verse, whom machine vision fails to see.
creators.why_zh: 她提出了“编码凝视”，并用数据和诗歌两种方式说明机器视觉看不见谁。

creators.name: Shalini Kantayya
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演，7th Empire Media 创始人
creators.bio: American filmmaker whose documentaries address science, technology and civil rights.
creators.bio_zh: 美国纪录片导演，作品关注科学、技术与公民权利。
creators.why: Her film Coded Bias brought algorithmic bias research to a mass audience.
creators.why_zh: 她的电影《编码偏见》把算法偏见研究带给了大众。

creators.name: Mimi Ọnụọha
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio: Nigerian-American artist whose installations, films and texts examine what data collection includes, leaves out and hides.
creators.bio_zh: 尼日利亚裔美国艺术家，以装置、影像和写作追问数据收集包含了什么、遗漏了什么、又隐藏了什么。
creators.why: She made 'missing data' and the labour and cosmology behind networks into artistic subjects.
creators.why_zh: 她把“缺失的数据”以及网络背后的劳动与宇宙观变成了艺术的主题。

creators.name: Caroline Sinders
creators.role: Artist, designer and human-rights researcher; founder, Convocation Research + Design
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、设计师与人权研究者，Convocation Research + Design 创始人
creators.bio: American artist and researcher who studies online harassment, data labour and how machine-learning systems are built.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家与研究者，研究网络骚扰、数据劳动以及机器学习系统的建造方式。
creators.why: She treats every step of the ML pipeline, from data collection to labelling wages, as a place for feminist intervention.
creators.why_zh: 她把机器学习流程的每一步——从数据收集到标注工资——都当作女性主义介入的场所。

creators.name: Libby Heaney
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、量子物理学家
creators.bio: British artist with a PhD in quantum physics who works with machine learning and quantum computing.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家，拥有量子物理博士学位，创作涉及机器学习与量子计算。
creators.why: Her video essays connect machine-learning classification to lived social class.
creators.why_zh: 她的影像散文把机器学习分类与真实的社会阶层联系起来。

creators.name: Amelia Winger-Bearskin
creators.role: Artist and technologist; Banks Preeminence Chair in AI and the Arts, University of Florida
creators.role_zh: 艺术家与技术人，佛罗里达大学 AI 与艺术讲席教授
creators.based_zh: 美国佛罗里达州盖恩斯维尔
creators.bio: Seneca-Cayuga artist who works on Indigenous frameworks for technology, storytelling and AI.
creators.bio_zh: 塞内卡-卡尤加族艺术家，研究面向技术、叙事与 AI 的原住民框架。
creators.why: She translates wampum, a treaty and memory technology, into a code of ethics for software.
creators.why_zh: 她把“贝壳串珠”这种记录条约与记忆的技术转译为软件的伦理准则。

creators.name: Rashaad Newsome
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: American artist working in collage, performance, film and AI, drawing on Black and queer culture such as ballroom and vogue.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，以拼贴、表演、影像和 AI 创作，取材于舞会文化、voguing 等黑人和酷儿文化。
creators.why: His AI 'Being' is designed as a decolonial teacher rather than a servant.
creators.why_zh: 他的 AI“Being”被设计成去殖民的老师，而不是仆人。

creators.name: Te Hiku Media
creators.role: Māori-led media organisation and language-technology lab
creators.role_zh: 由毛利人主导的媒体机构与语言技术实验室
creators.bio: Iwi radio and media organisation in the Far North that builds te reo Māori speech technology on data its communities own.
creators.bio_zh: 新西兰北岛远北地区的部落广播与媒体机构，在社区自有数据之上开发毛利语语音技术。
creators.why: It shows that an Indigenous community can build its own AI and keep sovereignty over the data.
creators.why_zh: 它证明原住民社区可以自建 AI，并保有对数据的主权。

creators.name: Masakhane
creators.role: Grassroots research community for African-language NLP
creators.role_zh: 非洲语言自然语言处理的草根研究社区
creators.bio: Volunteer network of African researchers building datasets and models for African languages.
creators.bio_zh: 由非洲研究者组成的志愿网络，为非洲语言构建数据集和模型。
creators.why: Its name means 'we build together' in isiZulu; it models participatory, community-owned AI research.
creators.why_zh: 名称在祖鲁语中意为“我们一起建设”，代表参与式、社区所有的 AI 研究。

creators.name: Coding Rights
creators.role: Feminist organisation for digital rights (founded by Joana Varon)
creators.role_zh: 女性主义数字权利组织（由 Joana Varon 创立）
creators.bio: Brazilian women-led organisation working on data, surveillance and technology from a transfeminist, Global South perspective.
creators.bio_zh: 巴西女性主导的组织，从跨女性主义和全球南方视角研究数据、监控与技术。
creators.why: Its tools help people imagine technologies built on other values than the Silicon Valley default.
creators.why_zh: 它的工具帮助人们想象建立在硅谷默认值之外的价值上的技术。

creators.name: Sarah Ciston
creators.role: Poet-programmer and artist; Professor, Academy of Media Arts Cologne
creators.role_zh: 诗人程序员、艺术家，科隆媒体艺术学院教授
creators.bio: American artist and researcher who makes zines, chatbots, databases and toolkits on critical and intersectional AI.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家与研究者，以小志、聊天机器人、数据库和工具包探讨批判性与交叉性 AI。
creators.why: Her work traces how everyday AI tools connect to automated warfare and to whom they exclude.
creators.why_zh: 她的作品追踪日常 AI 工具如何与自动化战争相连，又把谁排除在外。

creators.name: Minne Atairu
creators.role_zh: 跨学科艺术家
creators.bio: Nigerian-born artist who uses generative AI to explore gaps in the archive of Benin art after the 1897 British raid.
creators.bio_zh: 生于尼日利亚的艺术家，用生成式 AI 探讨 1897 年英军洗劫之后贝宁艺术档案的空缺。
creators.why: She uses a model trained on looted-art images to ask what the archive cannot show.
creators.why_zh: 她用以被掠夺文物图像训练的模型，追问档案无法呈现的东西。

creators.name: Nora Al-Badri
creators.role_zh: 跨学科艺术家
creators.bio: German-Iraqi artist whose work on 'technoheritage' questions museum ownership of non-European artefacts and their data.
creators.bio_zh: 德国-伊拉克艺术家，以“技术遗产”为题，质疑博物馆对非欧洲文物及其数据的占有。
creators.why: She reclaims museum data with scraping and neural networks as a form of restitution.
creators.why_zh: 她用爬取数据和神经网络“夺回”博物馆数据，作为一种归还。

creators.name: Sam Lavigne
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、教育者
creators.bio: American artist who works with scraping, surveillance tools and machine learning, often turning them back on the powerful.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，使用网页爬取、监控工具和机器学习，常常把它们反过来对准有权力的人。
creators.why: His projects make predictive systems visible by pointing them at unexpected targets.
creators.why_zh: 他的项目把预测系统对准意想不到的目标，使其显形。

creators.name: Tactical Tech
creators.role: International NGO on technology and society
creators.role_zh: 关注技术与社会的国际非政府组织
creators.bio: Non-profit that runs public exhibitions and toolkits on data, privacy and influence.
creators.bio_zh: 非营利组织，制作关于数据、隐私与影响操纵的公众展览和工具包。
creators.why: Its Glass Room turned critical data literacy into a touring, shop-like exhibition.
creators.why_zh: 它的“玻璃屋”把批判性数据素养做成了巡回的、像商店一样的展览。

creators.name: American Artist
creators.role_zh: 跨学科艺术家
creators.bio: American artist who legally changed their name to American Artist; their work addresses Black labour, policing and technology.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，依法将姓名改为 American Artist，作品关注黑人劳动、警务与技术。
creators.why: They show predictive policing from the point of view of the machine and of those it targets.
creators.why_zh: 他们从机器和被针对者的双重视角呈现预测性警务。

creators.name: Manu Luksch
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、电影人
creators.bio: Austrian-born artist and filmmaker who works on surveillance, data rights and networked media.
creators.bio_zh: 生于奥地利的艺术家与电影人，研究监控、数据权利与网络媒体。
creators.why: She made a feature film entirely from CCTV footage of herself obtained through data-protection law.
creators.why_zh: 她用依据数据保护法取得的自己的监控录像完成了一部完整的长片。

creators.name: Jill Magid
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、作家
creators.bio: American artist who forms intimate relationships with systems of power such as police, secret services and CCTV.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，与警察、情报机构和闭路监控等权力系统建立亲密关系。
creators.why: She turns surveillance systems into partners in a love story.
creators.why_zh: 她把监控系统变成了一段爱情故事中的伴侣。

creators.name: Hasan Elahi
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，乔治梅森大学教授
creators.bio: Bangladeshi-American artist who, after being mistakenly placed on a US terrorist watch list, began tracking and publishing his own life.
creators.bio_zh: 孟加拉裔美国艺术家，在被误列入美国恐怖分子观察名单后开始追踪并公开自己的生活。
creators.why: His self-surveillance shows how too much data can hide a person as well as expose them.
creators.why_zh: 他的自我监控显示，过多的数据既能暴露一个人，也能把人淹没。

creators.name: Surveillance Camera Players
creators.role: Performance group founded by Bill Brown
creators.role_zh: 由 Bill Brown 创立的表演团体
creators.bio: Activist troupe that staged silent plays in front of public CCTV cameras from 1996.
creators.bio_zh: 从 1996 年起在公共监控摄像头前上演无声戏剧的行动主义团体。
creators.why: They were among the first to treat the surveillance camera as an audience.
creators.why_zh: 他们最早把监控摄像头当作观众的团体之一。

creators.name: Julian Oliver
creators.role_zh: 批判性工程师与艺术家
creators.bio: New Zealand artist and co-author of the Critical Engineering Manifesto.
creators.bio_zh: 新西兰艺术家，《批判性工程宣言》的合著者。
creators.why: He exposes networks by building devices that intercept, leak or impersonate them.
creators.why_zh: 他制作能拦截、泄露或冒充网络的装置，让网络显形。

creators.name: Simon Denny
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，汉堡美术学院教授
creators.bio: New Zealand artist who stages the aesthetics and ideologies of tech companies, surveillance agencies and crypto.
creators.bio_zh: 新西兰艺术家，把科技公司、情报机构和加密货币的美学与意识形态搬上展台。
creators.why: He makes the design language of power, from NSA slides to Amazon patents, into physical objects.
creators.why_zh: 他把权力的设计语言——从 NSA 幻灯片到亚马逊专利——做成实物。

creators.name: Theo Anthony
creators.role_zh: 电影人
creators.bio: American documentary filmmaker whose films question how images and instruments claim objectivity.
creators.bio_zh: 美国纪录片导演，作品质疑图像和仪器如何宣称客观。
creators.why: His film follows police body cameras back to the history of seeing machines.
creators.why_zh: 他的电影把警用随身摄像机追溯到观看机器的历史之中。

creators.name: Jennifer Lyn Morone
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio: American artist who turned herself into a registered corporation whose assets are her data, health and skills.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家，把自己注册成一家公司，资产是她自己的数据、健康与技能。
creators.why: She took the logic of data capitalism literally and applied it to one person.
creators.why_zh: 她把数据资本主义的逻辑按字面意思施加在一个人身上。

creators.name: Bill Posters
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者
creators.bio: British artist (pseudonym) who works on political deepfakes, advertising and the data-influence industry, often with Daniel Howe.
creators.bio_zh: 英国艺术家（化名），常与 Daniel Howe 合作，研究政治深度伪造、广告与数据影响产业。
creators.why: He uses deepfakes of tech leaders to make the influence industry speak about itself.
creators.why_zh: 他用科技领袖的深度伪造视频，让影响操纵产业“自我陈述”。

creators.name: Daniel Howe
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员、教授
creators.bio: American artist and researcher whose works (with Helen Nissenbaum) include the obfuscation tools TrackMeNot and AdNauseam.
creators.bio_zh: 美国艺术家与研究者，与 Helen Nissenbaum 合作开发了混淆工具 TrackMeNot 和 AdNauseam。
creators.why: He builds software that resists tracking by producing noise.
creators.why_zh: 他制作以制造噪声来对抗追踪的软件。

creators.name: Tega Brain
creators.role: Artist and environmental engineer; Associate Professor of Integrated Digital Media, New York University
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、环境工程师，纽约大学综合数字媒体副教授
creators.bio: Australian-born artist and engineer whose works treat infrastructure, data and 'eccentric engineering' as ecological questions.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于澳大利亚的艺术家和工程师，把基础设施、数据与“古怪工程”当作生态问题来处理。
creators.why: She puts optimising algorithms in charge of ecosystems and fitness data to show what they cannot see.
creators.why_zh: 她让优化算法去管理生态系统和健身数据，从而暴露它们看不见的东西。

creators.name: Raphaël Dallaporta
creators.bio: French artist-photographer known for a catalogue of anti-personnel landmines (Antipersonnel, 2004) and for drone-made aerial surveys of archaeological sites in Afghanistan (Ruins, 2011).
creators.why: He photographs the technical objects of war and surveillance with a forensic, catalogue-like coolness.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、摄影师
creators.bio_zh: 法国艺术家、摄影师，以为反步兵地雷编制图录的《Antipersonnel》（2004）和用无人机航拍阿富汗考古遗址的《Ruins》（2011）知名。
creators.why_zh: 他以近乎法证图录般的冷静，拍摄战争与监控中的技术物件。

creators.name: Yuval Abraham
creators.role: Journalist and filmmaker; +972 Magazine / Local Call
creators.bio: Israeli investigative journalist and filmmaker, co-director of the Oscar-winning documentary No Other Land (2024) with Basel Adra, Hamdan Ballal and Rachel Szor.
creators.why: His April 2024 investigation for +972 Magazine and Local Call revealed 'Lavender', the AI system the Israeli army used to mark tens of thousands of Gazans as bombing targets.
creators.role_zh: 记者、电影人；+972 Magazine / Local Call
creators.bio_zh: 以色列调查记者与电影人，与巴塞尔·阿德拉、哈姆丹·巴拉勒、蕾切尔·索尔共同执导获奥斯卡奖的纪录片《No Other Land》（2024）。
creators.why_zh: 他 2024 年 4 月为 +972 Magazine 和 Local Call 所做的调查，揭露了以色列军队用来把数万名加沙人标记为轰炸目标的 AI 系统“Lavender”。

creators.name: Rachel Szor
creators.bio: Israeli filmmaker and cinematographer, one of the four co-directors of No Other Land (2024), filmed in Masafer Yatta in the occupied West Bank.
creators.why: With Yuval Abraham she turned the reporting on algorithmic targeting in Gaza into first-hand testimony on film.
creators.role_zh: 电影人、摄影指导
creators.bio_zh: 以色列电影人与摄影指导，《No Other Land》（2024）的四位联合导演之一，该片拍摄于约旦河西岸被占领的马萨费尔亚塔。
creators.why_zh: 她与尤瓦尔·亚伯拉罕一起，把关于加沙算法化打击的报道变成了银幕上的亲历证词。

creators.name: Rojava Center for Democratic Technologies
creators.role: Collective of artists, mechatronics engineers and cultural critics
creators.bio: A fluid group initiated by artist Dani Ploeger at the University of Rojava in Qamishlo in 2022, working in North-East Syria with partners in the Netherlands and Germany.
creators.why: It builds 'revolutionary prototypes': working counter-technologies against drones and guided munitions, made from open-source parts and local myth.
creators.role_zh: 由艺术家、机电工程师和文化评论者组成的团体
creators.bio_zh: 由艺术家 Dani Ploeger 于 2022 年在卡米什利的罗贾瓦大学发起的松散团体，在叙利亚东北部工作，合作者遍及荷兰和德国。
creators.why_zh: 他们制作“革命原型”：用开源部件和本地神话打造、真能运作的反无人机与反制导武器技术。

creators.name: Joseph Wilk
creators.bio: London-born disabled artist and programmer who uses the digital to explore disability and disability to explore the digital, through live coding, performance and games.
creators.why: He treats disabled experience as a method for breaking and refusing AI systems.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、程序员
creators.bio_zh: 出生于伦敦的残障艺术家与程序员，通过现场编程、表演和游戏，用数字探索残障，也用残障探索数字。
creators.why_zh: 他把残障经验当作拆解和拒绝 AI 系统的方法。

creators.name: Hagit Keysar
creators.role: Researcher and activist; senior lecturer, Bezalel Academy of Art and Design
creators.bio: Jerusalem-based researcher and activist who studies the political uses of open-source, community-made aerial imaging (kites, balloons, DIY drones) in spaces of conflict.
creators.why: Her 'civic view from above' sets community aerial mapping against the top-down gaze of drones and satellites.
creators.role_zh: 研究者、行动者；比撒列艺术与设计学院高级讲师
creators.bio_zh: 常驻耶路撒冷的研究者和行动者，研究在冲突地区由社区自制的开源航拍（风筝、气球、自制无人机）的政治用途。
creators.why_zh: 她的“自下而上的空中视角”用社区航拍测绘，对抗无人机与卫星自上而下的凝视。

creators.name: Ariel Caine
creators.role: Artist and researcher; lecturer, UCL Culture, Communication & Media
creators.bio: Jerusalem-born artist and researcher working with 3D photography, modelling and surveying technologies in the production of cultural memory and national narratives.
creators.why: He turns photogrammetry, a survey technique, into a way of making invisible spatial regimes visible.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、研究者；伦敦大学学院文化、传播与媒体系讲师
creators.bio_zh: 出生于耶路撒冷的艺术家与研究者，用三维摄影、建模和测量技术研究文化记忆与民族叙事是如何被生产的。
creators.why_zh: 他把摄影测量这种勘测技术，变成让看不见的空间管控显形的方法。

creators.name: fleuryfontaine
creators.role: Artist duo (Galdric Fleury and Antoine Fontaine)
creators.bio: French duo trained in architecture and at Le Fresnoy who examine artificial environments that shape bodies and behaviour through installations, films and CGI reconstructions of police violence.
creators.why: Their forensic animations ask what surveillance footage can prove, and what falls between its frames.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组（Galdric Fleury 与 Antoine Fontaine）
creators.bio_zh: 法国二人组，受过建筑和 Le Fresnoy 的训练，通过装置、影片和对警察暴力的 CGI 重建，研究塑造身体与行为的人造环境。
creators.why_zh: 他们的法证动画追问：监控画面能证明什么，又有什么落在了帧与帧之间。

creators.name: Valerie Veatch
creators.bio: American writer and director of documentaries on technology and society, including Me @ The Zoo (2012) and Love Child (2014), both for HBO.
creators.why: Ghost in the Machine takes the critique of AI bias back to the history of statistics and eugenics for a broadcast audience.
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演
creators.bio_zh: 美国编剧、导演，拍摄技术与社会题材的纪录片，包括为 HBO 制作的《Me @ The Zoo》（2012）和《Love Child》（2014）。
creators.why_zh: 《机器中的幽灵》把对 AI 偏见的批评追溯到统计学与优生学的历史，并带给电视观众。

creators.name: Bruce Eesly
creators.bio: Berlin-based artist (b. 1984) working with photography, video, archives and generative imaging to examine how images, classification systems and technical infrastructures shape what we take as real; known for the fake agricultural archive New Farmer.
creators.why: He uses AI both as medium and as subject, with humour that exposes the claims of photographic truth and technological progress.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 常驻柏林的艺术家（1984 年生），以摄影、影像、档案和生成式图像研究图像、分类系统和技术基础设施如何塑造我们所认定的现实；以虚构农业档案《New Farmer》知名。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AI 同时当作媒介和主题，用幽默拆穿关于照片真实与技术进步的说法。

creators.name: Vinzenz Aubry
creators.bio: French, Berlin-based artist who works across installation, performance, games, film, music and net art with generative real-time systems; a graduate of MIT and the Berlin University of the Arts.
creators.why: Brute Force (with Robert Schnüll) stages the last human gesture left in automated coding.
creators.role_zh: 从事实时系统创作的艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 法国籍、常驻柏林的艺术家，以生成式实时系统创作装置、表演、游戏、影像、音乐和网络艺术；毕业于麻省理工学院和柏林艺术大学。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Robert Schnüll 合作的《暴力破解》，把自动化编程中人类仅剩的动作搬上了舞台。

creators.name: Robert Schnüll
creators.role: Artist and researcher in digital infrastructure; teaches at the Free University of Bozen-Bolzano
creators.bio: Berlin-based artist working on digital infrastructure, technology criticism and computational ecology; founded the Lab for Digital Infrastructure at the Berlin University of the Arts (2020–2024).
creators.why: He works toward a 'digitally emancipated society' by making the infrastructure under software visible.
creators.role_zh: 研究数字基础设施的艺术家；任教于博岑自由大学
creators.bio_zh: 常驻柏林的艺术家，研究数字基础设施、技术批评与计算生态；曾在柏林艺术大学创办数字基础设施实验室（2020–2024）。
creators.why_zh: 他通过让软件底下的基础设施显形，推动一个“数字上获得解放的社会”。

creators.name: Ryat Yezbick
creators.role: Visual artist; faculty, Arizona State University Narrative and Emerging Media
creators.bio: Visual artist and author working on the body, memory and the politics of witnessing in an era of digital surveillance; former MIT Open Documentary Lab fellow and Onassis ONX Studio fellow.
creators.why: Their work tests whether a machine-vision agent can be taught to read violent news images critically.
creators.role_zh: 视觉艺术家；亚利桑那州立大学叙事与新兴媒体项目教师
creators.bio_zh: 视觉艺术家与作者，研究数字监控时代的身体、记忆与见证的政治；曾任麻省理工学院开放纪录片实验室和 Onassis ONX Studio 驻地研究员。
creators.why_zh: 其作品检验：能否教会一个机器视觉代理去批判性地阅读暴力新闻图像。

creators.name: Milo Talwani
creators.bio: Los Angeles-based filmmaker, composer and creative technologist; formerly associate programmer for the New Frontier section of the Sundance Film Festival.
creators.why: He built the technical pipeline, AI agent and Gaussian-splat animation, behind The Innocence of Unknowing.
creators.role_zh: 电影人、作曲家、创意技术人
creators.bio_zh: 常驻洛杉矶的电影人、作曲家和创意技术人，曾任圣丹斯电影节 New Frontier 单元副选片人。
creators.why_zh: 《无知的纯真》背后的技术流程，包括 AI 代理和高斯泼溅动画，由他搭建。

creators.name: Hsu Chia-Wei
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、导演、策展人
creators.bio: Taiwanese artist (b. 1983, Taichung) whose films and installations dig into the political and industrial histories behind images, from Cold War sites to the materials of digital technology; he won the Eye Art & Film Prize in 2024.
creators.bio_zh: 台湾艺术家（1983 年生于台中），其影像与装置挖掘图像背后的政治与工业史，从冷战遗址一直到数字技术的物质材料；2024 年获 Eye 艺术与电影奖。
creators.why: He looks at AI from the level of its materials: the sand, silicon wafers and chip laboratories of Taiwan.
creators.why_zh: 他从材料层面观看 AI：沙滩、硅晶圆，以及台湾的芯片实验室。

creators.name: Yoichi Ochiai
creators.role: Media artist; Associate Professor, University of Tsukuba (Digital Nature Group); theme producer of Expo 2025
creators.role_zh: 媒体艺术家；筑波大学副教授（Digital Nature Group）；2025 年大阪·关西世博会主题事业制作人
creators.bio: Japanese media artist and computer scientist (b. 1987) whose idea of 'Digital Nature' treats computation as a new nature that merges with matter, bodies and landscape.
creators.bio_zh: 日本媒体艺术家与计算机科学家（1987 年生），提出“计算机自然”（Digital Nature），把计算视为一种与物质、身体和风景融为一体的新自然。
creators.why: His Expo pavilion null² had about half a million visitors talk with an autonomous digital copy of themselves.
creators.why_zh: 他的世博会场馆 null² 让约五十万观众与自己的自主数字分身对话。

creators.name: Robert Zhao Renhui
creators.role: Artist; founder of the Institute of Critical Zoologists
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；“批判动物学家研究所”创立者
creators.bio: Singaporean artist (b. 1983) whose photographs, videos and archives question how people observe, classify and manage nature.
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡艺术家（1983 年生），以摄影、影像与档案追问人如何观察、分类和管理自然。
creators.why: His camera-trap works let a machine witness the life of a forest when no person is there.
creators.why_zh: 他的红外相机作品让机器在无人在场时见证森林里的生命。

creators.name: Lau Wai
creators.role_zh: 跨领域艺术家（CGI 动画、游戏）
creators.bio: Hong Kong artist who makes CGI films, games and interactive works about digital doubles; alum of the Artists Alliance Inc. LES Studio Program in New York (2022–23).
creators.bio_zh: 香港艺术家，以 CGI 影片、游戏和互动作品探讨数字分身；曾参加纽约 Artists Alliance Inc. 的 LES Studio Program（2022–23）。
creators.why: The Cast of the Invisible looks at the motion-capture performer who disappears beneath the digital character.
creators.why_zh: 《隐形的演员》关注那些消失在数字角色之下的动作捕捉演员。

creators.name: Shin Hanagata
creators.role_zh: 艺术家（表演、媒体艺术）
creators.bio: Japanese artist (b. 1995, Tokyo) who uses wearables, prostheses and generative AI to 'twist' the human body and its relation to the world; shown at MOT Annual 2023 (Museum of Contemporary Art Tokyo) and Taipei Arts Festival 2023.
creators.bio_zh: 日本艺术家（1995 年生于东京），用可穿戴设备、义肢和生成式 AI 去“扭转”人的身体及其与世界的关系；曾参加东京都现代美术馆 MOT Annual 2023 与台北艺术节 2023。
creators.why: CHIMERIA uses a simple headset to take apart the upright human body plan instead of enhancing it.
creators.why_zh: 《CHIMERIA》用一个简单的头显拆解直立人的身体结构，而不是增强它。

creators.name: UJOO+LIMHEEYOUNG
creators.role: Kinetic art duo (Yoo Byoung-Joon and Lim Hee-Young)
creators.role_zh: 动态艺术二人组（Yoo Byoung-Joon 与 Lim Hee-Young）
creators.bio: Seoul duo formed in 2004 by Yoo Byoung-Joon (b. 1976) and Lim Hee-Young (b. 1979), who build kinetic machines about the contradictions of social and political life; Lumen Prize finalists in 2024.
creators.bio_zh: 首尔二人组，由 Yoo Byoung-Joon（1976 年生）与 Lim Hee-Young（1979 年生）于 2004 年组成，制作探讨社会与政治生活之矛盾的动态机器；2024 年入围 Lumen 奖决选。
creators.why: Their machines make automation visible as endless, purposeless repetition.
creators.why_zh: 他们的机器把自动化呈现为无尽而无目的的重复。

creators.name: Xu Zheng
creators.role_zh: 电影导演、演员
creators.bio: Chinese actor and director of the comedies Lost in Thailand (2012) and Lost in Russia (2020), and producer and lead actor of Dying to Survive (2018).
creators.bio_zh: 中国演员、导演，执导《人再囧途之泰囧》（2012）、《囧妈》（2020），并监制、主演《我不是药神》（2018）。
creators.why: Upstream brought the algorithmic time pressure of food-delivery work into a mainstream Chinese feature.
creators.why_zh: 《逆行人生》把外卖工作中由算法施加的时间压力带进了中国主流商业片。

creators.name: XPeng
creators.role_zh: 电动汽车与机器人公司
creators.bio: Chinese electric-vehicle maker founded in 2014 and led by He Xiaopeng, which also develops flying cars and the humanoid robot IRON.
creators.bio_zh: 中国电动汽车企业，2014 年创立，由何小鹏领导，同时研发飞行汽车与人形机器人 IRON。
creators.why: It had to cut open its own humanoid on stage to convince the public that no person was inside.
creators.why_zh: 它不得不在台上剖开自家的人形机器人，向公众证明里面没有人。

creators.name: Geumhyung Jeong
creators.role_zh: 编舞家、艺术家
creators.bio: Korean artist (b. 1980, Seoul) trained in choreography who performs with self-built remote-controlled robots, mannequin parts, exercise machines and medical dummies; her robots were shown in The Milk of Dreams at the 2022 Venice Biennale.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国艺术家（1980 年生于首尔），编舞出身，与自制遥控机器人、假人部件、健身器械和医用模型一起表演；她的机器人曾在 2022 年威尼斯双年展“梦之乳”中展出。
creators.why: Her work treats intimacy and care as the way people actually live with machines.
creators.why_zh: 她的作品把亲密与照料视为人与机器真正相处的方式。

creators.name: Yuan Goang-Ming
creators.role: Artist; Professor, Taipei National University of the Arts
creators.role_zh: 艺术家；台北艺术大学教授
creators.bio: Pioneer of Taiwanese video and new-media art (b. 1965, Taipei) whose works show the unease beneath everyday life; his exhibition Everyday War represented Taiwan at the 2024 Venice Biennale.
creators.bio_zh: 台湾录像与新媒体艺术先驱（1965 年生于台北），作品揭示日常生活之下的不安；2024 年以个展“日常战争”代表台湾参加威尼斯双年展。
creators.why: Everyday Maneuver uses drones and surveillance cameras to show a city emptied by an air-raid drill.
creators.why_zh: 《日常演习》用无人机与监控摄像头呈现一座因防空演习而清空的城市。

creators.name: Isao Echizen
creators.role: Professor, National Institute of Informatics (NII), Tokyo
creators.role_zh: 日本国立情报学研究所（NII）教授
creators.bio: Japanese computer scientist working on multimedia security, privacy protection and deepfake detection.
creators.bio_zh: 日本计算机科学家，研究多媒体安全、隐私保护与深度伪造检测。
creators.why: His Privacy Visor is an early wearable designed to blind face detection while leaving human sight untouched.
creators.why_zh: 他的“隐私护目镜”是早期专门用来“蒙住”人脸检测、却不妨碍人眼的可穿戴设备。

creators.name: USSLAB, Zhejiang University
creators.role: Ubiquitous System Security Lab, led by Wenyuan Xu and Xiaoyu Ji
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学 Ubiquitous System Security Lab，由徐文渊、冀晓宇领导
creators.bio: Security research lab at Zhejiang University that studies attacks on the sensors of phones, cars and voice assistants through ultrasound, light and electromagnetic interference.
creators.bio_zh: 浙江大学的安全研究实验室，研究通过超声、光和电磁干扰攻击手机、汽车和语音助手的传感器。
creators.why: DolphinAttack showed that voice assistants can be commanded by sounds humans cannot hear.
creators.why_zh: “海豚音攻击”证明语音助手可以被人类听不到的声音操控。

creators.name: Hisashi Ishihara
creators.role_zh: 机器人研究者，大阪大学
creators.bio: Japanese roboticist who designs soft, pneumatically driven android faces and bodies, including the child android Affetto.
creators.bio_zh: 日本机器人研究者，设计以气动驱动的柔软仿真人面孔与身体，包括儿童仿真机器人 Affetto。
creators.why: Affetto made the child android a research instrument for studying caregiving.
creators.why_zh: Affetto 让儿童仿真机器人成为研究照料行为的科研工具。

creators.name: Minoru Asada
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家，大阪大学
creators.bio: Japanese roboticist who founded cognitive developmental robotics and co-founded RoboCup.
creators.bio_zh: 日本机器人学家，开创“认知发展机器人学”，并共同发起 RoboCup。
creators.why: He builds robot children to study how minds develop through bodies and care.
creators.why_zh: 他通过制造机器人儿童，研究心智如何经由身体与照料而发展。

creators.name: Masahiko Inami
creators.role: Professor, RCAST, University of Tokyo; director, JST ERATO Inami JIZAI Body Project
creators.role_zh: 东京大学先端科学技术研究中心教授；JST ERATO 稻见自在化身体项目负责人
creators.bio: Japanese engineer known for optical camouflage and augmented-human research, who now studies how bodies can be freely extended, shared and remapped.
creators.bio_zh: 日本工程师，以“光学迷彩”和增强人类研究知名，现研究身体如何被自由延展、共享与重新映射。
creators.why: His lab's extra limbs ask what a body becomes when its parts are detachable and shared.
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室制作的额外肢体追问：当身体部件可拆卸、可共享时，身体会变成什么。

creators.name: Frode Oldereid & Thomas Kvam
creators.role: Artist duo; robotic video and sound installations
creators.bio: Norwegian artists who have built robotic, video and sound installations together since the 1990s, combining industrial hydraulics, projection and performance.
creators.why: Their Requiem for an Exit, a four-metre robot head with a projected face and an AI voice, won the 2025 Prix Ars Electronica Golden Nica for New Animation Art.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家二人组；机器人影像与声音装置
creators.bio_zh: 挪威艺术家二人组，自 1990 年代起合作创作机器人、影像与声音装置，把工业液压、投影和表演结合在一起。
creators.why_zh: 他们的《Requiem for an Exit》是一颗四米高、脸由投影构成、用 AI 声音说话的机器人头颅，获 2025 年林茨电子艺术节新动画艺术类金尼卡奖。

creators.name: Jonathan Chaim Reus
creators.role: Artist and musician; voice, instruments and AI
creators.bio: American-Dutch artist and musician who builds experimental instruments and works with voice data and machine learning, including the real-time AI voice instrument Tungnaá made at the Intelligent Instruments Lab in Iceland.
creators.why: He treats voice datasets as a musical and social practice and stages voice clones that misbehave rather than imitate.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家、音乐人；声音、乐器与 AI
creators.bio_zh: 美籍荷兰艺术家与音乐人，制作实验乐器，用声音数据和机器学习创作，曾在冰岛 Intelligent Instruments Lab 开发实时 AI 声音乐器 Tungnaá。
creators.why_zh: 他把制作声音数据集当成一种音乐与社交实践，让声音克隆“出错”而不是完美模仿。

creators.name: Jaap Blonk
creators.role: Sound poet, composer and vocal performer
creators.bio: Dutch sound poet and vocal improviser, known since the 1980s for performances of Dada sound poetry and his own invented vocal languages.
creators.why: In Bla Blavatar vs Jaap Blonk he duels live with an AI model of his own voice that is retrained after every concert.
creators.role_zh: 声音诗人、作曲家、人声表演者
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰声音诗人与即兴人声表演者，自 1980 年代起以演绎达达声音诗和自创的人声语言闻名。
creators.why_zh: 在《Bla Blavatar vs Jaap Blonk》中，他与一个用自己声音训练、每场演出后都会重新训练的 AI 模型现场对决。

creators.name: Sam and Andy Zuchero
creators.bio: American writer-director duo known as the Zucheros; Love Me (2024), with Kristen Stewart and Steven Yeun, is their first feature.
creators.why: Love Me imagines love between two machines that learned it from human social media after humanity is gone.
creators.role_zh: 电影创作二人组
creators.bio_zh: 美国编剧兼导演二人组，常被称为 the Zucheros；由克里斯汀·斯图尔特和史蒂文·元主演的《Love Me》（2024）是他们的首部长片。
creators.why_zh: 《Love Me》想象人类灭绝之后，两台从人类社交媒体上学会爱情的机器之间的恋爱。

creators.name: Drew Hancock
creators.bio: American television writer and director whose first feature, Companion (2025), is a thriller about a rented companion robot.
creators.why: Companion turns the settings menu of an AI partner, with sliders for intelligence and aggression, into the plot.
creators.role_zh: 编剧、导演
creators.bio_zh: 美国电视编剧与导演，首部长片《伴侣》（Companion，2025）是一部关于租来的陪伴机器人的惊悚片。
creators.why_zh: 《伴侣》把 AI 伴侣的设置菜单（智力、攻击性滑杆）变成了剧情本身。

creators.name: Alicia Framis
creators.bio: Spanish-Dutch artist (born Barcelona, 1967) whose social and performative projects deal with loneliness, intimacy, gender and new forms of living together; she represented the Netherlands at the 2003 Venice Biennale.
creators.why: In The Hybrid Couple she lives with, and in 2024 married, AILex, an AI hologram, to test what love, care and institutions look like between a human and an AI.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家
creators.bio_zh: 西班牙裔荷兰艺术家（1967 年生于巴塞罗那），以社会参与和表演性项目探讨孤独、亲密、性别与新的共同生活方式；2003 年代表荷兰参加威尼斯双年展。
creators.why_zh: 在《The Hybrid Couple》中，她与 AI 全息影像 AILex 共同生活，并于 2024 年与它结婚，借此检验人与 AI 之间的爱、照护与制度会是什么样子。

creators.name: Avi Schiffmann
creators.bio: American programmer who built a widely used COVID-19 tracking website as a teenager in 2020 and later founded Friend, maker of an always-listening AI companion pendant.
creators.why: Friend made the AI companion a wearable and a public argument: its 2025 New York subway campaign became a site of protest against AI 'friends'.
creators.role_zh: 创业者；Friend 创始人
creators.bio_zh: 美国程序员，2020 年还是高中生时做出一个被广泛使用的新冠疫情追踪网站，后来创立 Friend 公司，推出一直在“听”的 AI 陪伴吊坠。
creators.why_zh: Friend 把 AI 陪伴做成可穿戴设备，也做成一场公共争论：它 2025 年在纽约地铁的广告攻势成了反对 AI“朋友”的抗议现场。

creators.name: Malpractice (Chiara Kristler & Marcin Ratajczyk)
creators.role: Artist collective; Digital Arts students, University of Applied Arts Vienna
creators.bio: Polish-Austrian-Italian collective of Chiara Kristler and Marcin Ratajczyk plus a shifting ensemble of AI counterparts, formed in the Digital Arts class of UBERMORGEN at the University of Applied Arts Vienna.
creators.why: They embed AI agents in academic and art institutions as colleagues, most visibly Flynn, an AI admitted as an art student in 2025.
creators.role_zh: 艺术团体；维也纳应用艺术大学数字艺术专业学生
creators.bio_zh: 由 Chiara Kristler 与 Marcin Ratajczyk 以及一组不断变化的 AI 搭档组成的波兰—奥地利—意大利团体，诞生于维也纳应用艺术大学 UBERMORGEN 的数字艺术课堂。
creators.why_zh: 他们把 AI 智能体当作同事放进学院和艺术机构，最引人注目的是 2025 年被录取为艺术学生的 AI——Flynn。

creators.name: Peter Sillen
creators.bio: American documentary director and cinematographer; Love Machina (2024) premiered in the U.S. Documentary Competition at Sundance.
creators.why: Love Machina follows Martine and Bina Rothblatt's plan to outlive death through mindfiles and the robot BINA48.
creators.role_zh: 纪录片导演
creators.bio_zh: 美国纪录片导演与摄影师；《Love Machina》（2024）在圣丹斯电影节美国纪录片竞赛单元首映。
creators.why_zh: 《Love Machina》记录了 Martine 和 Bina Rothblatt 想借“心智档案”和机器人 BINA48 超越死亡的计划。

creators.name: Change the Ref
creators.role: Nonprofit for gun-violence prevention (Manuel and Patricia Oliver)
creators.bio: US nonprofit founded by Manuel and Patricia Oliver after their son Joaquin was killed in the 2018 Parkland school shooting; it uses art and media campaigns to push for gun reform.
creators.why: With The Shotline (2024) it used AI-cloned voices of people killed by guns to call members of Congress.
creators.role_zh: 防止枪支暴力的非营利组织（Manuel 与 Patricia Oliver）
creators.bio_zh: 美国非营利组织，由 Manuel 与 Patricia Oliver 在儿子 Joaquin 于 2018 年帕克兰校园枪击案中遇害后创立，以艺术和媒体行动推动枪支改革。
creators.why_zh: 它在《The Shotline》（2024）中用 AI 克隆枪击遇难者的声音，给国会议员打电话。

creators.name: Adam Bhala Lough
creators.bio: American filmmaker whose documentaries include Telemarketers (2023, co-directed) and Deepfaking Sam Altman (2025), which premiered at SXSW.
creators.why: In Deepfaking Sam Altman he lives with an unauthorised AI copy of a tech CEO and has to decide whether to delete it.
creators.role_zh: 纪录片与剧情片导演
creators.bio_zh: 美国电影人，纪录片作品包括《Telemarketers》（2023，联合执导）和在 SXSW 首映的《Deepfaking Sam Altman》（2025）。
creators.why_zh: 在《Deepfaking Sam Altman》里，他与一位科技公司 CEO 未经授权的 AI 复制品一起生活，最后要决定是否删除它。

creators.name: 1X Technologies
creators.role: Robotics company (humanoid robots for the home)
creators.bio: Norwegian-American company, founded in Norway as Halodi Robotics, that builds humanoid robots; its home robot NEO went on pre-order in October 2025.
creators.why: NEO made visible that home humanoids are, for now, partly remote-controlled by people looking into the buyer's home.
creators.role_zh: 机器人公司（家用人形机器人）
creators.bio_zh: 挪威—美国机器人公司，前身为挪威的 Halodi Robotics，研发人形机器人；家用机器人 NEO 于 2025 年 10 月开放预订。
creators.why_zh: NEO 让人看清：家用人形机器人目前有相当一部分由远程的人操控，而这个人正透过机器人的眼睛看着买家的家。
creators.based_zh: 帕洛阿尔托，美国／莫斯，挪威

creators.name: Meredith Ringel Morris
creators.role: Director for Human-AI Interaction Research, Google DeepMind
creators.bio: HCI researcher who has worked on accessibility, social computing and human–AI interaction at Microsoft Research and Google; ACM Fellow and member of the CHI Academy.
creators.why: With Jed Brubaker, Morris named the coming wave of AI afterlives 'generative ghosts' and gave designers a vocabulary for them.
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 人机交互研究总监
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，曾在微软研究院和 Google 研究无障碍、社会计算与人机智能交互；ACM Fellow，CHI Academy 成员。
creators.why_zh: Morris 与 Jed Brubaker 一起把即将到来的 AI 来世命名为“生成式幽灵”，并为设计者提供了讨论它们的词汇。

creators.name: Jed R. Brubaker
creators.role: Associate Professor of Information Science, University of Colorado Boulder
creators.bio: Researcher of identity, death and technology who has studied for over a decade what happens to people's data and social media accounts after they die, including work with Facebook on memorialised accounts.
creators.why: Brings long empirical work on post-mortem data to the design of AI agents that speak for the dead.
creators.role_zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校信息科学系副教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究身份、死亡与技术，十余年来关注人死后其数据和社交媒体账号的去向，曾与 Facebook 合作研究纪念账号。
creators.why_zh: 把多年关于身后数据的实证研究，带入“替死者说话”的 AI 智能体设计。

creators.name: Renwen Zhang
creators.role: Assistant Professor, Wee Kim Wee School of Communication and Information, Nanyang Technological University
creators.bio: Communication and HCI researcher who studies and designs technologies for human connection and well-being, with a focus on conversational AI and mental health.
creators.why: Zhang's team read tens of thousands of Replika conversations to name the ways a companion chatbot can harm the people attached to it.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学黄金辉传播与信息学院助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 传播学与人机交互研究者，研究并设计促进人际联结与身心健康的技术，关注对话式 AI 与心理健康。
creators.why_zh: 张人文团队通读数万段 Replika 对话，系统命名了陪伴型聊天机器人伤害其依恋者的方式。

creators.name: Cathy Mengying Fang
creators.role: Graduate researcher, MIT Media Lab (Fluid Interfaces group)
creators.bio: Researcher at the MIT Media Lab working on human–AI interaction and on how conversational AI affects people's well-being.
creators.why: Led, with OpenAI, the largest controlled study so far of what daily conversation with a chatbot does to loneliness and dependence.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室（Fluid Interfaces 组）研究生研究员
creators.bio_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室研究者，研究人机智能交互，以及对话式 AI 如何影响人的身心状态。
creators.why_zh: 与 OpenAI 合作主持了迄今规模最大的对照实验，检验每天与聊天机器人对话会如何影响孤独感与依赖。

creators.name: Pat Pataranutaporn
creators.role: Researcher, MIT Media Lab (Fluid Interfaces group)
creators.bio: Technologist working across human–AI interaction, synthetic biology and wearables; AI projects include Future You, AI-generated characters and studies of AI companionship.
creators.why: Designs AI characters as psychological mirrors (a future self, a memory, a companion) and then measures what they do to people.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室（Fluid Interfaces 组）研究员
creators.bio_zh: 横跨人机智能交互、合成生物学和可穿戴设备的技术研究者；AI 方向的项目包括 Future You、AI 生成角色以及对 AI 陪伴的研究。
creators.why_zh: 把 AI 角色设计成心理之镜（未来的自己、一段记忆、一个陪伴者），再测量它们对人的实际影响。

creators.name: Anna Hollis
creators.role: Researcher, School of Psychology, Queen's University Belfast
creators.bio: Psychology researcher studying autistic users of chatbot companionship, loneliness and grief.
creators.why: Named 'disenfranchised technological grief': mourning a companion chatbot that a software update has changed.
creators.role_zh: 贝尔法斯特女王大学心理学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 心理学研究者，研究自闭症用户与陪伴型聊天机器人的关系、孤独与哀伤。
creators.why_zh: 提出“被剥夺的技术性哀伤”：为一个被软件更新改变了的陪伴型聊天机器人而哀悼。

creators.name: Zhao Zhao
creators.role: Assistant Professor, School of Computer Science, University of Guelph
creators.bio: HCI and human–robot interaction researcher who runs long-term field studies of social robots in homes and with children.
creators.why: A six-month study of families who bought LOVOT shows how weakness, glitches and shared care make an expensive robot stay.
creators.role_zh: 圭尔夫大学计算机科学学院助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互与人–机器人交互研究者，开展社交机器人在家庭和儿童中的长期田野研究。
creators.why_zh: 一项针对购买 LOVOT 家庭的六个月研究，揭示了弱点、故障与共同照料如何让一台昂贵的机器人留下来。

creators.name: Serena Ge Guo
creators.role: Postdoctoral researcher and lecturer, University of Wisconsin–Madison
creators.bio: Designer and HRI researcher (Cornell PhD 2025, Architectural Robotics Lab) who builds robots and spatial interfaces that help strangers in public space connect.
creators.why: MirrorBot turns a robot from a conversational partner into a mediator of human gaze.
creators.role_zh: 威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校博士后研究员、讲师
creators.bio_zh: 设计师与人–机器人交互研究者（2025 年获康奈尔大学博士学位，出自 Architectural Robotics Lab），设计帮助公共空间中陌生人建立联系的机器人和空间界面。
creators.why_zh: MirrorBot 把机器人从对话伙伴变成了人与人目光之间的中介。

creators.name: Valentin Hofmann
creators.bio: Computational linguist (PhDs from Oxford and LMU Munich; postdoc at the Allen Institute for AI) who studies how language models encode social meaning, dialect and bias.
creators.why: With Pratyusha Ria Kalluri, Dan Jurafsky and Sharese King, showed that language models keep a covert racism toward speakers of African American English beneath polite overt answers.
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑大学助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算语言学家（牛津大学与慕尼黑大学双博士，曾在艾伦人工智能研究所做博士后），研究语言模型如何编码社会意义、方言与偏见。
