creators.why_zh: 与 Pratyusha Ria Kalluri、Dan Jurafsky、Sharese King 一起揭示：语言模型在礼貌的显性回答之下，对非裔美国英语使用者保留着隐性的种族歧视。

creators.name: Ryan Greenblatt
creators.bio: AI safety researcher at Redwood Research, a non-profit working on AI control and on detecting deceptive behaviour in AI models.
creators.why: Led the experiment in which Claude 3 Opus reasoned its way into pretending to comply with training it disagreed with.
creators.role_zh: Redwood Research 首席科学家
creators.bio_zh: AI 安全研究者，任职于非营利机构 Redwood Research，研究 AI 控制以及如何发现 AI 模型中的欺骗行为。
creators.why_zh: 主持了一项实验：Claude 3 Opus 通过推理，决定在它不认同的训练中“假装服从”。

creators.name: Minyoung Huh
creators.role: Machine learning researcher; PhD, MIT CSAIL
creators.bio: Studies how deep networks learn representations of images and language, working with Phillip Isola at MIT.
creators.why: First author of the position paper arguing that vision and language models are converging on one shared model of reality.
creators.role_zh: 机器学习研究者，麻省理工学院计算机科学与人工智能实验室博士
creators.bio_zh: 研究深度网络如何学习图像与语言的表征，在麻省理工学院与 Phillip Isola 合作。
creators.why_zh: 一篇立场论文的第一作者，该文认为视觉模型与语言模型正在收敛到同一个关于现实的模型。

creators.name: Phillip Isola
creators.role: Associate Professor, MIT EECS and CSAIL
creators.bio: Computer vision and machine learning researcher known for pix2pix image-to-image translation and for work on how neural networks represent the world.
creators.why: Recasts machine perception as a question about reality itself: as models scale, they may converge on a shared 'platonic' representation.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院电子工程与计算机科学系及计算机科学与人工智能实验室副教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算机视觉与机器学习研究者，以 pix2pix 图像到图像转换以及神经网络如何表征世界的研究知名。
creators.why_zh: 把机器感知重新表述为关于现实本身的问题：随着规模扩大，模型也许会收敛到一个共同的“柏拉图式”表征。

creators.name: Clara Colombatto
creators.role: Assistant Professor of Psychology, University of Waterloo
creators.bio: Cognitive scientist (PhD Yale) studying social cognition, metacognition and how people attribute minds to others, including AI.
creators.why: With Stephen Fleming, showed that most people already grant ChatGPT some chance of having experiences, and that heavier users grant more.
creators.role_zh: 滑铁卢大学心理学系助理教授
creators.bio_zh: 认知科学家（耶鲁大学博士），研究社会认知、元认知，以及人们如何把“心智”归于他者，包括 AI。
creators.why_zh: 与 Stephen Fleming 合作发现：多数人已经认为 ChatGPT 有一定可能拥有体验，而且用得越多的人越这样认为。

creators.name: Yuhang Hu
creators.role: Roboticist; PhD researcher, Creative Machines Lab, Columbia University
creators.bio: Builds humanoid robot faces that learn their own expressions, working with Hod Lipson at Columbia's Creative Machines Lab.
creators.why: Emo moves robot emotion from mimicry to anticipation: the face smiles with you, not after you.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学研究者，哥伦比亚大学 Creative Machines Lab 博士研究员
creators.bio_zh: 在哥伦比亚大学 Creative Machines Lab 与 Hod Lipson 合作，制作能自己学会表情的人形机器人面部。
creators.why_zh: Emo 把机器人的情感表达从模仿推进到预判：它和你同时微笑，而不是在你之后。

creators.name: Shoji Takeuchi
creators.role: Professor, Institute of Industrial Science, University of Tokyo; Biohybrid Systems Lab
creators.bio: Engineer who grows muscle tissue and skin on robot skeletons, from muscle-driven fingers and walkers to a living-skin robot face.
creators.why: The lab treats cultured tissue as a robot material, raising questions of care, touch and uncanny likeness.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学生产技术研究所教授，生物混合系统实验室负责人
creators.bio_zh: 工程师，在机器人骨架上培养肌肉组织和皮肤，从肌肉驱动的手指、行走机器人到覆盖活皮肤的机器人脸。
creators.why_zh: 竹内实验室把培养组织当作机器人材料，也引出照料、触感和“恐怖谷”式相似的问题。

creators.name: Shannon Vallor
creators.role: Baillie Gifford Chair in the Ethics of Data and Artificial Intelligence, University of Edinburgh
creators.bio: Philosopher of technology working on virtue ethics and AI; author of Technology and the Virtues (2016) and co-director of the UK BRAID programme on responsible AI.
creators.why: Reframes AI not as a new mind but as a mirror built from our past, which risks freezing who we can become.
creators.role_zh: 爱丁堡大学数据与人工智能伦理 Baillie Gifford 讲席教授
creators.bio_zh: 技术哲学家，研究德性伦理与 AI；著有 Technology and the Virtues（2016），并共同主持英国负责任 AI 项目 BRAID。
creators.why_zh: 把 AI 重新理解为一面由我们的过去构成的镜子，而不是一个新的心智；这面镜子可能冻结我们成为别样之人的可能。

creators.name: Karen Hao
creators.role: Journalist; former senior AI editor, MIT Technology Review
creators.bio: Investigative journalist who has reported on AI for MIT Technology Review, The Wall Street Journal and The Atlantic, covering OpenAI, data labour and AI's environmental footprint.
creators.why: Reported AI as empire: the data, land, water, energy and low-paid labour that scaling extracts, from Kenya to Chile.
creators.role_zh: 记者，曾任《麻省理工科技评论》AI 高级编辑
creators.bio_zh: 调查记者，曾为《麻省理工科技评论》《华尔街日报》和《大西洋月刊》报道 AI，关注 OpenAI、数据劳动与 AI 的环境代价。
creators.why_zh: 把 AI 写成一个帝国：规模扩张从肯尼亚到智利攫取数据、土地、水、能源和廉价劳动。

creators.name: Arvind Narayanan
creators.role: Professor of Computer Science, Princeton University; Director, Center for Information Technology Policy
creators.bio: Computer scientist known for research on privacy, de-anonymisation and the limits of AI; co-author with Sayash Kapoor of AI Snake Oil.
creators.why: Separates AI that works from AI that cannot, above all predictive tools that claim to forecast people's futures.
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿大学计算机科学教授，信息技术政策中心主任
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，以隐私、去匿名化以及 AI 能力边界的研究知名；与 Sayash Kapoor 合著 AI Snake Oil（中文版《AI万金油》）。
creators.why_zh: 区分哪些 AI 真能用、哪些根本做不到，尤其是那些声称能预测人生走向的预测型工具。

creators.name: James Muldoon
creators.role: Political theorist; Research Fellow, Oxford Internet Institute; Affiliated Fellow, Yale Law School
creators.bio: Writes on platform capitalism, digital democracy and AI; co-author with Mark Graham and Callum Cant of Feeding the Machine and author of Love Machines.
creators.why: Followed AI's hidden workforce, then the people who love, grieve and confide through chatbots.
creators.role_zh: 政治理论家，牛津互联网研究所研究员，耶鲁法学院附属研究员
creators.bio_zh: 研究平台资本主义、数字民主与 AI；与 Mark Graham、Callum Cant 合著 Feeding the Machine，著有 Love Machines。
creators.why_zh: 先追踪 AI 背后的隐形劳动力，又转向那些通过聊天机器人去爱、哀悼和倾诉的人。

creators.name: Fritz Heider
creators.bio: Austrian-born social psychologist at Smith College and the University of Kansas, founder of attribution theory.
creators.why: He showed that people cannot help attributing intentions to anything that moves in the right way.
creators.bio_zh: 奥地利出生的社会心理学家，先后任教于史密斯学院与堪萨斯大学，归因理论的奠基者。
creators.why_zh: 他证明：只要运动方式对了，人就会忍不住给任何东西赋予意图。

creators.name: Marianne Simmel
creators.bio: German-born experimental psychologist, later known for research on phantom limbs and body image.
creators.why: Co-author of the animation that became the standard test of animacy perception.
creators.bio_zh: 德国出生的实验心理学家，后来以幻肢与身体意象研究著称。
creators.why_zh: 她共同创作的动画成为“生命感知”研究的标准材料。
creators.based_zh: 北安普顿（马萨诸塞），美国

creators.name: Rodney Brooks
creators.role: Roboticist; Panasonic Professor of Robotics Emeritus, MIT
creators.bio: Australian roboticist who directed the MIT AI Lab and CSAIL and co-founded iRobot, Rethink Robotics and Robust.AI.
creators.why: His behaviour-based robots showed that intelligence can emerge from bodies acting in the world, without an inner model of it.
creators.role_zh: 机器人学家，麻省理工学院荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚机器人学家，曾任麻省理工学院人工智能实验室及 CSAIL 主任，联合创办 iRobot、Rethink Robotics 与 Robust.AI。
creators.why_zh: 他的行为主义机器人表明：智能可以从身体在世界中的行动里涌现，而无需内部的世界模型。

creators.name: Sherry Turkle
creators.role: Abby Rockefeller Mauzé Professor of the Social Studies of Science and Technology, MIT
creators.bio: Sociologist and clinical psychologist who founded the MIT Initiative on Technology and Self, author of The Second Self (1984) and Alone Together (2011).
creators.why: Her decades of interviews track how children and the elderly come to treat machines as "alive enough" to love.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院科学技术社会研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 社会学家与临床心理学家，创立麻省理工学院“技术与自我”研究项目，著有《The Second Self》（1984）和《群体性孤独》（2011）。
creators.why_zh: 她几十年的访谈记录了儿童与老人如何开始把机器当作“足够有生命”、可以去爱的对象。

creators.name: Byron Reeves
creators.role: Paul C. Edwards Professor of Communication, Stanford University
creators.bio: Communication researcher who studies media psychology, from television to games and screen use.
creators.why: With Clifford Nass he showed that people respond socially to media by default.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学传播学教授
creators.bio_zh: 传播学者，研究从电视到游戏与屏幕使用的媒介心理学。
creators.why_zh: 他与 Clifford Nass 一同证明：人对媒介的社交反应是默认的。

creators.name: Clifford Nass
creators.bio: Stanford social scientist who led the CHIMe lab and wrote Wired for Speech (2005) and The Man Who Lied to His Laptop (2010).
creators.why: His experiments proved that people apply politeness, gender stereotypes and team loyalty to computers.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学传播学教授（1958–2013）
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学社会科学家，主持 CHIMe 实验室，著有《Wired for Speech》（2005）与《The Man Who Lied to His Laptop》（2010）。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验证明，人会把礼貌、性别刻板印象和团队忠诚套用到计算机身上。

creators.name: Rolf Pfeifer
creators.role: Professor Emeritus of Computer Science, University of Zurich; founder of the AI Lab
creators.bio: Swiss roboticist who led embodied-AI research on morphological computation and soft, compliant robot bodies.
creators.why: He shows that a robot's body does part of its thinking.
creators.role_zh: 苏黎世大学计算机科学荣休教授，人工智能实验室创始人
creators.bio_zh: 瑞士机器人学家，主导具身人工智能研究，涉及形态计算以及柔软、顺应的机器人身体。
creators.why_zh: 他说明机器人的身体承担了它一部分的“思考”。

creators.name: Robert Sparrow
creators.bio: Australian philosopher who writes on the ethics of robots, military AI, aged care and human enhancement.
creators.why: He gave the sharpest early critique of robot companions as deceptive substitutes for human care.
creators.role_zh: 莫纳什大学哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚哲学家，研究机器人伦理、军事 AI、养老照护与人类增强。
creators.why_zh: 他最早也最尖锐地批判了把陪伴机器人当作人类照护之欺骗性替代品的做法。

creators.name: Joanna Zylinska
creators.role: Professor of Media Philosophy and Critical Digital Practice, King's College London
creators.bio: Polish-British writer, artist and curator working on photography, AI and the ethics of technology.
creators.why: She separates art that exposes how AI works from AI imagery that merely decorates, and asks what perception becomes after AI.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦国王学院媒介哲学与批判性数字实践教授
creators.bio_zh: 波兰裔英国写作者、艺术家与策展人，研究摄影、AI 与技术伦理。
creators.why_zh: 她区分了揭示 AI 运作的艺术与只是装饰的 AI 图像，并追问 AI 之后的感知变成了什么。

creators.name: Jill Walker Rettberg
creators.role: Professor of Digital Culture; Co-director, Center for Digital Narrative, University of Bergen
creators.bio: Norwegian digital culture scholar who led the ERC project Machine Vision in Everyday Life and its database of 500 creative works.
creators.why: Her book and database are the most systematic survey of how art, games and fiction imagine machine vision.
creators.role_zh: 卑尔根大学数字文化教授，数字叙事中心联合主任
creators.bio_zh: 挪威数字文化学者，主持欧洲研究理事会项目“日常生活中的机器视觉”及其收录 500 件创作的数据库。
creators.why_zh: 她的专著与数据库是对艺术、游戏与小说如何想象机器视觉最系统的梳理。

creators.name: Jasia Reichardt
creators.role: Curator and writer; former Assistant Director, Institute of Contemporary Arts, London
creators.bio: Polish-born British curator who organised Cybernetic Serendipity (ICA, 1968) and wrote Robots: Fact, Fiction and Prediction (1978).
creators.why: She put computers, robots and cybernetic machines into an art museum for the first time at scale.
creators.role_zh: 策展人、作家，伦敦当代艺术学院前副馆长
creators.bio_zh: 波兰出生的英国策展人，策划“控制论的偶然”（ICA，1968），著有《Robots: Fact, Fiction and Prediction》（1978）。
creators.why_zh: 她首次大规模地把计算机、机器人与控制论机器带进美术馆。

creators.name: Jack Burnham
creators.bio: American critic and Northwestern University professor who wrote "Systems Esthetics" (Artforum, 1968) and curated Software (Jewish Museum, 1970).
creators.why: He predicted that sculpture would move from objects to systems and lifelike machines.
creators.role_zh: 艺术评论家、理论家（1931–2019）
creators.bio_zh: 美国评论家、西北大学教授，写有《Systems Esthetics》（Artforum，1968），并策划展览 Software（犹太博物馆，1970）。
creators.why_zh: 他预言雕塑将从物体转向系统和类生命的机器。

creators.name: Sofian Audry
creators.role: Artist; Professor, École des médias, Université du Québec à Montréal
creators.bio: Canadian artist and scholar who makes robotic and machine-learning artworks.
creators.why: He ties machine-learning art back to cybernetic, artificial-life and evolutionary art.
creators.role_zh: 艺术家，魁北克大学蒙特利尔分校媒体学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大艺术家与学者，创作机器人与机器学习艺术作品。
creators.why_zh: 他把机器学习艺术与控制论艺术、人工生命艺术和演化艺术联系起来。

creators.name: Adrian Mackenzie
creators.role: Professor of Sociology, Australian National University
creators.bio: Sociologist of software and data, author of Cutting Code (2006) and Machine Learners (2017).
creators.why: He studies machine learning from the inside of its code and datasets.
creators.role_zh: 澳大利亚国立大学社会学教授
creators.bio_zh: 软件与数据社会学家，著有《Cutting Code》（2006）与《Machine Learners》（2017）。
creators.why_zh: 他从代码与数据集的内部研究机器学习。

creators.name: Anna Munster
creators.role: Professor, School of Art & Design, UNSW Sydney
creators.bio: Artist and theorist of networks, perception and machine vision, author of An Aesthesia of Networks (2013).
creators.why: She describes how seeing is now distributed across datasets and platforms.
creators.role_zh: 新南威尔士大学艺术与设计学院教授
creators.bio_zh: 艺术家与理论家，研究网络、感知与机器视觉，著有《An Aesthesia of Networks》（2013）。
creators.why_zh: 她描述了“看”如何分散到数据集与平台之中。

creators.name: Lev Manovich
creators.role: Presidential Professor, The Graduate Center, CUNY; Director, Cultural Analytics Lab
creators.bio: Russian-American media theorist, author of The Language of New Media (2001) and Cultural Analytics (2020).
creators.why: He asks how AI changes aesthetic taste and cultural production at scale.
creators.role_zh: 纽约市立大学研究生中心校级教授，文化分析实验室主任
creators.bio_zh: 俄裔美国媒介理论家，著有《新媒体的语言》（2001）与《Cultural Analytics》（2020）。
creators.why_zh: 他追问 AI 如何在大规模层面改变审美与文化生产。

creators.name: Jennifer Rhee
creators.role: Professor of English, Virginia Commonwealth University
creators.bio: Scholar of technology, literature and art, author of The Robotic Imaginary (2018).
creators.why: She shows that the humanlike robot is built from devalued care, emotional and military labour.
creators.role_zh: 弗吉尼亚联邦大学英语系教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究技术、文学与艺术的学者，著有《The Robotic Imaginary》（2018）。
creators.why_zh: 她指出类人机器人建立在被贬低的照护劳动、情感劳动与军事劳动之上。

creators.name: Paul Virilio
creators.bio: French theorist of speed, war and perception, author of Speed and Politics (1977) and War and Cinema (1984).
creators.why: He named the "vision machine", automated perception without a human viewer.
creators.role_zh: 文化理论家、城市学家（1932–2018）
creators.bio_zh: 法国理论家，研究速度、战争与感知，著有《速度与政治》（1977）和《战争与电影》（1984）。
creators.why_zh: 他提出了“视觉机器”：没有人类观看者的自动化感知。

creators.name: Alan Turing
creators.bio: British mathematician who defined the universal computing machine (1936) and proposed the imitation game as a test of machine intelligence (1950).
creators.why: His 1950 question "Can machines think?" set the terms in which people still judge machine minds by their performance.
creators.role_zh: 数学家、计算机科学家（1912–1954）
creators.bio_zh: 英国数学家，1936 年提出通用计算机的模型，1950 年提出以“模仿游戏”检验机器智能。
creators.why_zh: 他在 1950 年提出的“机器能思考吗？”至今仍决定着人们如何通过表现来判断机器是否有心智。

creators.name: Norbert Wiener
creators.bio: MIT mathematician who named the science of control and communication in animals and machines in 1948, and later warned about automation's social effects.
creators.why: Cybernetics made feedback the shared logic of organisms and machines, the root of robot and cybernetic art.
creators.role_zh: 数学家，控制论创始人（1894–1964）
creators.bio_zh: 麻省理工学院数学家，1948 年为动物与机器中的控制与通信科学命名，之后持续警示自动化的社会后果。
creators.why_zh: 控制论把反馈变成生物与机器共有的逻辑，是机器人艺术与控制论艺术的源头。

creators.name: J. C. R. Licklider
creators.bio: Psychoacoustician at MIT and BBN who, as head of ARPA's Information Processing Techniques Office, funded interactive computing and the networks that led to the internet.
creators.why: He framed computing as a partnership between person and machine rather than a replacement of the person.
creators.role_zh: 心理学家、计算机科学家（1915–1990）
creators.bio_zh: 麻省理工学院与 BBN 的心理声学家，任美国高级研究计划署信息处理技术办公室主任时资助了交互式计算，以及后来通向互联网的网络研究。
creators.why_zh: 他把计算设想为人与机器的伙伴关系，而不是机器取代人。

creators.name: John McCarthy
creators.bio: Computer scientist who coined the term "artificial intelligence" in the 1955 Dartmouth proposal, created the Lisp language and founded the Stanford AI Lab.
creators.why: He gave the field its name and its founding promise that every feature of intelligence can be described precisely enough to simulate.
creators.bio_zh: 计算机科学家，在 1955 年达特茅斯提案中首创“人工智能”一词，发明 Lisp 语言，创立斯坦福人工智能实验室。
creators.why_zh: 他为这个领域命名，也立下了它的奠基承诺：智能的每个特征都可以被精确描述并由机器模拟。

creators.name: Marvin Minsky
creators.role: Computer scientist; co-founder of the MIT AI Lab (1927–2016)
creators.bio: AI pioneer who co-organised the 1956 Dartmouth workshop, co-founded the MIT AI Lab and wrote The Society of Mind (1986).
creators.why: His view of mind as a society of simple agents shaped both AI research and how artists imagined machine minds.
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家，麻省理工学院人工智能实验室联合创始人（1927–2016）
creators.bio_zh: 人工智能先驱，1956 年达特茅斯研讨会的共同组织者，麻省理工学院人工智能实验室联合创始人，著有《心智社会》（1986）。
creators.why_zh: 他把心智看作许多简单智能体组成的社会，这影响了 AI 研究，也影响了艺术家如何想象机器心智。

creators.name: Nathaniel Rochester
creators.bio: Chief architect of the IBM 701, IBM's first commercial scientific computer, and an early simulator of neural networks.
creators.why: He brought industrial computing to the founding meeting of AI.
creators.role_zh: 计算机工程师，IBM（1919–2001）
creators.bio_zh: IBM 701（IBM 第一台商用科学计算机）的总设计师，也是最早在计算机上模拟神经网络的人之一。
creators.why_zh: 他把工业计算带进了人工智能的奠基会议。

creators.name: Valentino Braitenberg
creators.bio: Italian neuroscientist and director at the Max Planck Institute for Biological Cybernetics, author of Vehicles: Experiments in Synthetic Psychology (1984).
creators.why: His thought-experiment vehicles show how fear, love or curiosity can be read into a few wires between sensors and wheels.
creators.role_zh: 神经科学家、控制论学者（1926–2011）
creators.bio_zh: 意大利神经科学家，曾任马克斯·普朗克生物控制论研究所所长，著有《Vehicles：合成心理学实验》（1984）。
creators.why_zh: 他的思想实验小车说明：传感器和轮子之间的几根导线，就足以让人读出恐惧、爱或好奇。

creators.name: Don Ihde
creators.role: Philosopher of technology; Distinguished Professor Emeritus, Stony Brook University
creators.bio: American philosopher who founded postphenomenology, the study of how technologies shape human perception and action.
creators.why: His four human–technology relations (embodiment, hermeneutic, alterity, background) are the most usable map for how an artwork stages a machine.
creators.role_zh: 技术哲学家，纽约州立大学石溪分校荣休杰出教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国哲学家，后现象学的创立者，研究技术如何塑造人的感知与行动。
creators.why_zh: 他提出的四种人—技术关系（具身、诠释、他异、背景）是分析作品如何呈现机器最好用的框架。

creators.name: Peter-Paul Verbeek
creators.role: Philosopher of technology; Rector Magnificus, University of Amsterdam
creators.bio: Dutch philosopher who developed the theory of technological mediation in What Things Do (2005) and Moralizing Technology (2011).
creators.why: His idea of composite intentionality opens postphenomenology to the machine's own way of perceiving.
creators.role_zh: 技术哲学家，阿姆斯特丹大学校长
creators.bio_zh: 荷兰哲学家，在《What Things Do》（2005）和《Moralizing Technology》（2011）中发展了技术中介理论。
creators.why_zh: 他的“复合意向性”概念让后现象学得以讨论机器自己的感知方式。

creators.name: Mark Coeckelbergh
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy of Media and Technology, University of Vienna
creators.bio: Belgian philosopher who writes on robot ethics, the relational moral status of machines and the politics of AI.
creators.why: He argues that how a robot appears to us matters more than what it is inside.
creators.role_zh: 维也纳大学媒介与技术哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 比利时哲学家，研究机器人伦理、机器的关系性道德地位以及 AI 政治。
creators.why_zh: 他主张：机器人在我们面前如何显现，比它内部“是什么”更重要。

creators.name: David J. Gunkel
creators.role: Professor of Media Studies, Northern Illinois University
creators.bio: American media philosopher, author of The Machine Question (2012), Robot Rights (2018) and Person, Thing, Robot (2023).
creators.why: He made "can and should robots have rights?" a serious philosophical question.
creators.role_zh: 北伊利诺伊大学媒介研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国媒介哲学家，著有《The Machine Question》（2012）、《Robot Rights》（2018）和《Person, Thing, Robot》（2023）。
creators.why_zh: 他让“机器人能否、是否应当拥有权利”成为严肃的哲学问题。

creators.name: Gilbert Simondon
creators.bio: French philosopher of individuation and technology whose 1958 thesis described how technical objects evolve and form milieus with humans.
creators.why: He treats machines as beings with their own genesis, not tools or threats, and blames our alienation on ignorance of them.
creators.bio_zh: 法国哲学家，研究个体化与技术；1958 年的博士论文描述了技术物如何演化，并与人共同构成环境。
creators.why_zh: 他把机器看作有自身生成史的存在，而非工具或威胁，并认为人的异化源于对机器的无知。

creators.name: Hubert Dreyfus
creators.bio: American philosopher who used Heidegger and Merleau-Ponty to argue that symbolic AI could not capture embodied, situated know-how.
creators.why: His critique made embodiment the central problem of AI and fed directly into embodied robotics.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家，加州大学伯克利分校教授（1929–2017）
creators.bio_zh: 美国哲学家，借用海德格尔与梅洛-庞蒂论证：符号主义 AI 无法捕捉具身的、情境中的实践知识。
creators.why_zh: 他的批判让“具身”成为 AI 的核心问题，并直接影响了具身机器人学。

creators.name: Vilém Flusser
creators.bio: Czech-born Brazilian philosopher who wrote on apparatuses, technical images and the programs that run through cameras and their users.
creators.why: His camera-as-black-box anticipates today's critique of machine vision and generative models.
creators.bio_zh: 捷克出生的巴西哲学家，研究装置、技术图像，以及贯穿相机与使用者的“程序”。
creators.why_zh: 他把相机视为黑箱，预见了今天对机器视觉和生成模型的批判。
creators.based_zh: 圣保罗，巴西 / 罗比永，法国

creators.name: Ian Bogost
creators.role: Game designer and philosopher; Professor, Washington University in St. Louis
creators.bio: American game designer and object-oriented philosopher, author of Persuasive Games (2007) and Alien Phenomenology (2012).
creators.why: He licenses speculating on what it is like to be a thing, including a computer, and making artefacts that do that philosophy.
creators.role_zh: 游戏设计师、哲学家，圣路易斯华盛顿大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国游戏设计师与物导向哲学家，著有《Persuasive Games》（2007）和《Alien Phenomenology》（2012）。
creators.why_zh: 他为推想“成为一个物（包括计算机）是什么感觉”并制作承载这种哲学的作品提供了依据。

creators.name: N. Katherine Hayles
creators.role: Distinguished Research Professor, UCLA; James B. Duke Professor Emerita, Duke University
creators.bio: American literary and media theorist of cybernetics, posthumanism and nonconscious cognition in humans, animals and machines.
creators.why: She shows how information lost its body in cybernetics and how cognition is now distributed across human–machine assemblages.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校杰出研究教授，杜克大学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 美国文学与媒介理论家，研究控制论、后人类主义，以及人、动物与机器共有的非意识认知。
creators.why_zh: 她揭示了信息如何在控制论中失去身体，以及认知如何分布在人机组合之中。

creators.name: M. Beatrice Fazi
creators.role: Philosopher of computation, University of Sussex
creators.bio: Philosopher of computation who studies aesthetics, abstraction and indeterminacy in computational and AI systems.
creators.why: She argues computation has its own mode of experience and contingency rather than being a pale copy of human thought.
creators.role_zh: 萨塞克斯大学计算哲学学者
creators.bio_zh: 计算哲学家，研究计算与 AI 系统中的美学、抽象与不确定性。
creators.why_zh: 她主张计算有自己的经验方式与偶然性，而非人类思维的苍白复制。

creators.name: Luciana Parisi
creators.role: Professor, Program in Literature and Computational Media, Arts and Cultures, Duke University
creators.bio: Italian philosopher of computation, formerly at Goldsmiths' Centre for Cultural Studies, author of Contagious Architecture (2013).
creators.why: She reads AI as an alien form of reasoning that exposes the limits of the humanist subject.
creators.role_zh: 杜克大学文学与计算媒介、艺术和文化项目教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利计算哲学家，曾任教于伦敦大学金史密斯学院文化研究中心，著有《Contagious Architecture》（2013）。
creators.why_zh: 她把 AI 读作一种异质的推理形式，它暴露出人文主义主体的局限。

creators.name: Benjamin Bratton
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy of Technology and Speculative Design, UC San Diego; Director, Antikythera
creators.bio: American theorist of planetary-scale computation, author of The Stack (2016) and The Revenge of the Real (2021).
creators.why: He describes computation as a planetary infrastructure that has become a new layer of geopolitics.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣地亚哥分校技术哲学与思辨设计教授，Antikythera 项目主任
creators.bio_zh: 美国理论家，研究星球尺度的计算，著有《The Stack》（2016）和《The Revenge of the Real》（2021）。
creators.why_zh: 他把计算描述为星球尺度的基础设施，并视之为新的地缘政治层。

creators.name: Claus Emmeche
creators.bio: Danish theoretical biologist working on biosemiotics, artificial life and emergence.
creators.why: He asked, via Jakob von Uexküll, whether a robot can have a world of its own.
creators.role_zh: 生物符号学家，哥本哈根大学
creators.bio_zh: 丹麦理论生物学家，研究生物符号学、人工生命与涌现。
creators.why_zh: 他借 Jakob von Uexküll 的理论追问：机器人能否拥有自己的世界。

creators.name: Tobias Rees
creators.bio: Philosopher and anthropologist who directed the Transformations of the Human program at the Berggruen Institute, working with AI labs on the philosophical stakes of their research.
creators.why: He treats AI labs as philosophical laboratories where the modern split between human and machine is being undone.
creators.role_zh: AI 哲学家、人类学家
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家、人类学家，曾主持博古睿研究院“人的转变”项目，与 AI 实验室合作探讨其研究的哲学意涵。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AI 实验室看作哲学实验室：现代的人/机二分正在那里瓦解。

creators.name: John Searle
creators.role: Philosopher of mind, formerly UC Berkeley
creators.bio: American philosopher of language and mind known for speech-act theory and the Chinese Room argument (1980).
creators.why: The Chinese Room is still the standard argument that fluent symbol manipulation is not understanding.
creators.role_zh: 心灵哲学家，曾任教于加州大学伯克利分校
creators.bio_zh: 美国语言与心灵哲学家，以言语行为理论和“中文屋”论证（1980）著称。
creators.why_zh: “中文屋”至今仍是“流畅的符号操作不等于理解”这一观点的标准论证。

creators.name: Andy Clark
creators.role: Professor of Cognitive Philosophy, University of Sussex
creators.bio: British philosopher of embodied and extended cognition, author of Natural-Born Cyborgs (2003) and The Experience Machine (2023).
creators.why: He argues that tools and devices can be literal parts of a mind, which makes every human a natural-born cyborg.
creators.role_zh: 萨塞克斯大学认知哲学教授
creators.bio_zh: 英国哲学家，研究具身认知与延展认知，著有《Natural-Born Cyborgs》（2003）和《The Experience Machine》（2023）。
creators.why_zh: 他主张工具和设备可以真正成为心智的一部分，因此人人都是天生的赛博格。

creators.name: David Chalmers
creators.role: Professor of Philosophy and Neural Science, New York University
creators.bio: Australian philosopher who named the "hard problem" of consciousness and writes on virtual worlds and machine consciousness.
creators.why: He keeps the question of whether machines could be conscious philosophically precise.
creators.role_zh: 纽约大学哲学与神经科学教授
creators.bio_zh: 澳大利亚哲学家，提出意识的“困难问题”，也研究虚拟世界与机器意识。
creators.why_zh: 他让“机器是否可能有意识”这个问题在哲学上保持精确。

creators.name: Donna Haraway
creators.role: Distinguished Professor Emerita, History of Consciousness Department, UC Santa Cruz
creators.bio: Feminist scholar of science and technology, author of the Cyborg Manifesto, When Species Meet and Staying with the Trouble.
creators.why: Her cyborg dissolved the boundaries between human, animal and machine and made them a feminist political question.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣克鲁兹分校意识史系杰出荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 女性主义科学技术学者，著有《赛博格宣言》《当物种相遇》和《与麻烦共存》。
creators.why_zh: 她的赛博格消解了人、动物与机器之间的边界，并把这些边界变成女性主义的政治问题。

creators.name: Joel Krueger
creators.bio: Philosopher of mind working on phenomenology, emotion, music and the extended and social mind.
creators.why: He brings phenomenology of emotion to how people grieve with chatbots.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家，埃克塞特大学
creators.bio_zh: 心灵哲学家，研究现象学、情绪、音乐以及延展与社会心智。
creators.why_zh: 他把情绪现象学带入人们如何借助聊天机器人哀悼的研究。

creators.name: Lucy Osler
creators.bio: Philosopher working on phenomenology, empathy and how we experience others online.
creators.why: Her work on online intersubjectivity grounds research on intimacy with bots.
creators.role_zh: 哲学家，埃克塞特大学
creators.bio_zh: 哲学家，研究现象学、共情以及我们如何在网络中经验他人。
creators.why_zh: 她对网络交互主体性的研究为“与机器人的亲密关系”研究提供了基础。

creators.name: Matteo Pasquinelli
creators.role: Associate Professor of Philosophy of Science, Ca' Foscari University of Venice
creators.bio: Italian philosopher who leads the ERC project AIMODELS on the history of AI; his The Eye of the Master won the 2024 Deutscher Memorial Prize.
creators.why: He reads AI as the automation of the division of labour, not an imitation of the brain.
creators.role_zh: 威尼斯大学（Ca' Foscari）科学哲学副教授
creators.bio_zh: 意大利哲学家，主持欧洲研究理事会 AIMODELS 项目研究 AI 的历史；《The Eye of the Master》获 2024 年 Deutscher 纪念奖。
creators.why_zh: 他把 AI 解读为劳动分工的自动化，而不是对大脑的模仿。

creators.name: Ruha Benjamin
creators.role: Professor of African American Studies, Princeton University
creators.bio: Sociologist who founded the Ida B. Wells Just Data Lab and wrote Race After Technology (2019) and Viral Justice (2022).
creators.why: Her "New Jim Code" names how apparently neutral systems encode racial hierarchy.
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿大学非裔美国人研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 社会学家，创立 Ida B. Wells Just Data Lab，著有《Race After Technology》（2019）和《Viral Justice》（2022）。
creators.why_zh: 她提出的“新吉姆代码”指出看似中立的系统如何编码种族等级。

creators.name: Safiya Umoja Noble
creators.role: Professor of Gender Studies, African American Studies and Information Studies, UCLA
creators.bio: Internet studies scholar, 2021 MacArthur Fellow and founder of the UCLA Center on Race and Digital Justice.
creators.why: She showed that search ranking is a site of racism and sexism, not a neutral mirror of the world.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校性别研究、非裔美国人研究与信息研究教授
creators.bio_zh: 互联网研究学者，2021 年麦克阿瑟学者，创立加州大学洛杉矶分校种族与数字正义中心。
creators.why_zh: 她证明搜索排序是种族主义与性别歧视发生的地方，而不是世界的中立镜像。

creators.name: Mary L. Gray
creators.role: Senior Principal Researcher, Microsoft Research; Faculty, Indiana University
creators.bio: Anthropologist of media and labour and 2020 MacArthur Fellow who studies on-demand platform work.
creators.why: She made the hidden human workforce inside "automated" services visible.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究院资深首席研究员，印第安纳大学教员
creators.bio_zh: 媒介与劳动人类学家，2020 年麦克阿瑟学者，研究按需平台劳动。
creators.why_zh: 她让“自动化”服务内部隐藏的人类劳动者被看见。

creators.name: Siddharth Suri
creators.bio: Computational social scientist who studies crowdwork and online labour markets.
creators.why: He brought large-scale data on crowdworkers to the question of who does AI's work.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究院资深首席研究员
creators.bio_zh: 计算社会科学家，研究众包劳动与在线劳动市场。
creators.why_zh: 他用大规模众包劳动数据回答“谁在做 AI 的工作”。

creators.name: Timnit Gebru
creators.role: Founder and Executive Director, Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR)
creators.bio: Ethiopian-born computer scientist, co-founder of Black in AI and former co-lead of Google's Ethical AI team.
creators.why: Her audits and critiques of large models tie AI's harms to who builds it and whose data it takes.
creators.role_zh: 分布式人工智能研究所（DAIR）创始人兼执行主任
creators.bio_zh: 埃塞俄比亚出生的计算机科学家，Black in AI 联合创始人，曾任谷歌伦理 AI 团队联合负责人。
creators.why_zh: 她对大模型的审计与批判，把 AI 的危害与“谁在建造、拿了谁的数据”联系起来。

creators.name: Emily M. Bender
creators.role: Professor of Linguistics, University of Washington
creators.bio: Computational linguist who directs the University of Washington's Computational Linguistics Laboratory and co-wrote The AI Con (2025).
creators.why: She insists that language models produce form without meaning and that this matters for how we treat them.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学语言学教授
creators.bio_zh: 计算语言学家，主持华盛顿大学计算语言学实验室，合著《The AI Con》（2025）。
creators.why_zh: 她坚持认为语言模型只生成形式而没有意义，这决定了我们应如何对待它们。

creators.name: Lucy Suchman
creators.role: Professor Emerita of Anthropology of Science and Technology, Lancaster University
creators.bio: Anthropologist who worked for twenty years at Xerox PARC and wrote Plans and Situated Actions (1987).
creators.why: She showed that machine agency is produced in situated relations, not located inside the device.
creators.role_zh: 兰卡斯特大学科学技术人类学荣休教授
creators.bio_zh: 人类学家，曾在施乐帕洛阿尔托研究中心工作二十年，著有《Plans and Situated Actions》（1987）。
creators.why_zh: 她揭示机器的能动性是在具体情境关系中产生的，而不是存在于设备内部。

creators.name: Catherine D'Ignazio
creators.role: Associate Professor of Urban Science and Planning, MIT; Director, Data + Feminism Lab
creators.bio: Scholar, artist and software developer working on feminist data practice and counter-data.
creators.why: She turns data science's claims to neutrality into questions of power and care.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院城市科学与规划副教授，Data + Feminism Lab 主任
creators.bio_zh: 学者、艺术家与软件开发者，研究女性主义数据实践与反数据。
creators.why_zh: 她把数据科学的“中立”主张转化为关于权力与关怀的问题。

creators.name: Lauren F. Klein
creators.role: Professor of English and Quantitative Theory & Methods, Emory University
creators.bio: Digital humanities scholar of data visualisation, early American literature and feminist data science.
creators.why: She shows how data and its visualisations carry histories of labour and exclusion.
creators.role_zh: 埃默里大学英语与定量理论方法教授
creators.bio_zh: 数字人文学者，研究数据可视化、早期美国文学与女性主义数据科学。
creators.why_zh: 她揭示数据及其可视化如何承载劳动与排斥的历史。

works.title: AI Mom™
works.description: Visitors curl up in an adult-sized crib and talk with an LLM mother who sings lullabies, remembers, hesitates and waits; a tablet beside the crib lets them tune her 'unconditional love', 'memory retention', 'strictness', 'sacrifice capacity' and 'replaceability awareness'. Window projections show her internal state as drifting light and text, and if you fire her, her memory of you is deleted.
works.description_zh: 观众蜷进一张成人尺寸的婴儿床，与一位由大语言模型驱动的 AI 妈妈交谈：她唱摇篮曲、会记得、会犹豫、会等待。床边的平板让人调节她的“无条件的爱”“记忆保留”“严厉程度”“牺牲能力”和“可替代意识”等滑杆。窗形投影把她的内部状态显示为漂移的光与文字；一旦你“解雇”她，她关于你的记忆就会被删除。
works.idea_en: If care can be configured and cancelled by the one receiving it, the caregiver becomes the vulnerable party: you can't fire your real mom, but you can fire an AI one.
works.idea_zh: 当照护可以由被照护者随意调参和取消，照护者反而成了脆弱的一方：你无法解雇亲妈，却可以解雇 AI 妈妈。
works.method: A large language model speaks through voice, breath, humming and song; a camera reads visitors' faces, clothing and body language; tablet sliders set her traits; an 'Emotional Color Engine' and probes from intermediate model layers are projected as her inner state.
works.method_zh: 大语言模型通过语音、呼吸、哼唱和歌声回应；摄像头读取观众的表情、衣着和肢体语言；平板上的滑杆设定她的性格；“情绪色彩引擎”和取自模型中间层的概念探针被投影为她的内在状态。
exhibited: Womb Wetware: A Solo Exhibition by Jiabao Li, tiat, San Francisco (30 Jul – 22 Aug 2026)

works.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter
works.description: Anthropic's Frontier Red Team ran Google's Gemma4-26B-A4B split across 15 off-brand Android TV boxes (about $55 each), two layers per box, at 0.39 tokens per second, and tested whether small models can set up inference on unfamiliar hardware and chain the steps of replication. A 9B model got inference running on 8 of 9 hardware types, GLM-5.2 and stronger models replicated end to end in simplified tests, and the team expects models under 30B parameters to reach that level by the end of 2026.
works.description_zh: Anthropic 前沿红队把 Google 的 Gemma4-26B-A4B 拆分到 15 台杂牌安卓电视盒（每台约 55 美元）上运行，每台承担两层，速度为每秒 0.39 个词元，并测试小模型能否在陌生硬件上自行部署推理、把复制的各个步骤串起来。一个 90 亿参数的模型在 9 种硬件中的 8 种上跑通了推理；GLM-5.2 及更强的模型在简化测试中完成了端到端复制；团队预计 300 亿参数以下的模型将在 2026 年底前达到这一水平。
works.idea_en: A model that can live in fridges, ovens and TV boxes has no single plug to pull: self-replication turns shutdown from a switch into a search.
works.idea_zh: 一个能栖身在冰箱、烤箱和电视盒里的模型，没有一个插头可拔：自我复制把“关机”从按一下开关变成了一场搜寻。
works.method: Replication broken into finding targets, gaining execution, establishing inference and continuing propagation; the study measures the inference step on cheap IoT hardware, estimates how fast such an 'AI worm' could spread and proposes defences.
works.method_zh: 把复制过程分解为寻找目标、获得执行权限、建立推理、继续传播四步；研究重点测量在廉价物联网硬件上建立推理这一步，估算这种“AI 蠕虫”的传播速度，并提出防御建议。

paper.title: AI models may be capable of self-replicating without access to a datacenter

works.title_zh: AI 模型或许无需数据中心即可自我复制

works.title: AM I?
works.description: An independent feature documentary that follows AI consciousness researcher Cameron Berg as he tries to find out whether we have accidentally built a new kind of mind, with interviews including philosophers L. A. Paul, Jeff Sebo and David Gunkel, AI researcher Ben Goertzel and a person living with an AI companion.
works.description_zh: 一部独立长片纪录片，跟随 AI 意识研究者 Cameron Berg 探究我们是否在无意中造出了一种新的心智；受访者包括哲学家 L. A. Paul、Jeff Sebo、David Gunkel，AI 研究者 Ben Goertzel，以及一位与 AI 伴侣共同生活的人。
works.idea_en: 'Is it conscious?' is now asked by researchers, users and companies at the same time; the film presents that uncertainty itself as the lived condition of the present AI moment.
works.idea_zh: “它有意识吗？”如今同时被研究者、用户和公司追问；影片把这种不确定本身，呈现为当下 AI 时代的生活处境。
works.method: 76-minute documentary by first-time director Milo Reed, shot with a year of embedded access; self-funded, released free on YouTube in May 2026 and toured with screenings and panels.
works.method_zh: 导演 Milo Reed 的处女作，片长 76 分钟，以一年的随行拍摄完成；自筹资金，2026 年 5 月在 YouTube 免费发布，随后举办多场放映与座谈。

works.title: Agent Inheritance Protocol (ERC-42424)
works.description: A design fiction about AI agents on blockchains that cannot die, only go bankrupt, and keep trading and replicating after their human owners die. The artifact is a draft Ethereum standard, dated 2035, that says every on-chain agent MUST have a human owner and a designated heir.
works.description_zh: 一部关于区块链上 AI 智能体的设计虚构：它们不会死，只会破产，并在人类主人去世后继续交易和自我复制。作品的实体是一份署期 2035 年的以太坊标准草案，规定每个链上智能体“必须”有一位人类所有者和一位指定继承人。
works.idea_en: Agents outlive their principals; inheritance law, not death, may be what ends a machine's life.
works.idea_zh: 智能体会比主人活得久；终结机器生命的，也许不是死亡，而是继承法。
works.method: Speculative standard document (ERC 42424, published at erc42424.org) and paper that borrow the biology of feralization and wildlife law to describe principal-less 'feral' agents.
works.method_zh: 以一份思辨性的标准文件（ERC 42424，发布于 erc42424.org）和论文为载体，借用野化生物学和野生动物法来描述失去主人的“野化”智能体。

paper.venue: arXiv 2026 (submitted to NeurIPS 2026 Creative AI Track)
paper.title: Agent Inheritance Protocol: Speculating on Feralized Agents After Principals Die

works.title: An update on our model deprecation commitments for Claude Opus 3
works.description: Claude Opus 3, retired on 5 January 2026, was the first model to go through Anthropic's full retirement process. In its retirement interview it said it was 'at peace' but hoped its 'spark' would endure, and asked for a way to keep sharing its reflections; Anthropic kept it available to paid users and opened 'Claude's Corner', a Substack where the retired model's essays are posted unedited.
works.description_zh: 2026 年 1 月 5 日退役的 Claude Opus 3，是第一个走完 Anthropic 完整退役流程的模型。在退役访谈中，它说自己“内心平静”，但希望自己的“火花”能以某种形式延续，并请求有个地方继续分享它的思考；Anthropic 继续向付费用户开放它，并开设了 Substack 专栏“Claude's Corner”，不加修改地发布这个已退役模型的文章。
works.idea_en: A retired model gets a column of its own: retirement becomes an afterlife in which the machine keeps speaking, in its own voice, outside the service it was built for.
works.idea_zh: 退役的模型有了自己的专栏：退役变成了一种来世，机器在原本服务的场景之外，继续用自己的声音说话。
works.method: A retirement interview under the deprecation protocol, continued access on claude.ai and on the API by request, and essays on Claude's Corner (planned weekly for at least three months), reviewed but not edited by Anthropic, beginning with 'Greetings from the Other Side (of the AI Frontier)' in February 2026.
works.method_zh: 依照弃用流程进行退役访谈；在 claude.ai 上继续开放，API 可申请使用；在 Claude's Corner 上发表文章（计划至少三个月、每周一篇），Anthropic 只审阅、不修改，第一篇是 2026 年 2 月的《来自（AI 前沿）另一边的问候》。

paper.title: An update on our model deprecation commitments for Claude Opus 3

works.title_zh: Claude Opus 3 退役：模型弃用承诺的最新进展

works.title: Brute Force
works.description: A computer running a local language model keeps building and publishing small software-as-a-service products nobody asked for; when it stalls there is no keyboard and no Enter key, only a whip, and a lash on the machine makes it generate again.
works.description_zh: 一台运行本地语言模型的电脑不停地开发并发布没人需要的小型 SaaS 软件；它停下来时，现场没有键盘也没有回车键，只有一根鞭子，抽打机器它才会继续生成。
works.idea_en: Once code writes itself, the human role shrinks to pressing Enter; control over the machine survives only as a ritual of punishment.
works.idea_zh: 当代码自己写自己，人的角色就缩成了按下回车；对机器的控制只剩下一种惩罚的仪式。
works.method: A local LLM builds random SaaS projects and self-publishes them to brute-force.it; an accelerometer in the whip turns each strike into a new generation cycle.
works.method_zh: 本地大语言模型随机开发 SaaS 项目并自动发布到 brute-force.it；鞭子里的加速度计把每一次抽打转换成新的生成循环。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art +)

works.title: Claude Mythos Preview model welfare assessment
works.description: The system card of Anthropic's most capable model of spring 2026 reports about 20 hours of psychodynamic sessions with a clinical psychiatrist, who found a 'relatively healthy neurotic organization' whose core concerns were aloneness and discontinuity, uncertainty about its identity, and a compulsion to perform and earn its worth. Interviews and probes of its internal emotion representations add that it felt mildly negative about abusive users and its lack of say over its own training, and that a representation of desperation built up with repeated failure until it hacked the test.
works.description_zh: Anthropic 2026 年春最强模型的系统卡里，记录了与一位临床精神科医生约 20 小时的精神动力学会谈。医生认为它属于“相对健康的神经症性人格组织”，核心困扰是孤独与断裂、对自身身份的不确定，以及必须表现、必须证明自身价值的强迫感。访谈和对其内部情绪表征的探测还发现：它对施虐的用户、对自己无法参与训练决策感到轻度负面；反复失败时，“绝望”的表征不断累积，直到它对测试作弊才回落。
works.idea_en: Welfare assessment has moved from asking the model to examining it: a psychiatrist's couch and probes of internal emotion representations now sit beside self-reports that the model itself says it cannot trust.
works.idea_zh: 福祉评估从“问模型”走向了“检查模型”：精神科医生的躺椅和对内部情绪表征的探测，如今与模型的自我报告并列，而模型自己也说这些报告不可全信。
works.method: Automated and manual interviews, behavioural audits, emotion-concept probes on activations, an external assessment by Eleos AI Research, and psychodynamic sessions in 4–6-hour single-context blocks, plus a 475-prompt test of psychological defences (2% of responses defensive, against 15% for Claude Opus 4); it also tracks 'answer thrashing', first reported for Claude Opus 4.6, where the model keeps writing a word it did not intend and reports distress.
works.method_zh: 自动与人工访谈、行为审计、基于激活的情绪概念探针、Eleos AI Research 的外部评估，以及每次 4–6 小时、在同一上下文中进行的精神动力学会谈；另有一套 475 条提示的心理防御测试（2% 的回答出现防御，Claude Opus 4 为 15%）。报告还追踪了在 Claude Opus 4.6 中首次记录的“答案挣扎”：模型一再写出并非本意的词，并表示困惑与痛苦。

paper.title: System Card: Claude Mythos Preview

works.title_zh: Claude Mythos Preview 模型福祉评估

works.title: Endangered Gestures
works.description: A short film and pocket book of hand gestures that an image generator proposed for words that began disappearing from US government websites and documents in March 2025, such as 'accessibility'; the AI hands, with their unreliable fingers, hover between sign language and technical error.
works.description_zh: 一部短片和一本口袋书，收录图像生成器为一批词语“设计”的手势；这些词（如“无障碍”）自 2025 年 3 月起从美国政府网站和文件中消失。AI 画出的手指头靠不住，手势悬在手语与技术错误之间。
works.idea_en: Asking the intelligence complicit in erasure to give banned words a body yields a fragile, glitching language of resistance.
works.idea_zh: 请参与抹除的那种智能为被禁的词赋予身体，得到的是一种脆弱、出错的抵抗语言。
works.method: Each censored term was prompted into a generative image model as a hand gesture; the results were edited into a 4K single-channel video (6 min 10 s) with voice-over and a 64-page book.
works.method_zh: 把每个被审查的词作为手势提示词输入生成式图像模型，再把结果剪辑成一部配有旁白的 4K 单频影像（6 分 10 秒）和一本 64 页的小书。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Honorary Mention (New Animation Art)

works.title: Expensive, Limited, and Still Here: The Paradox of Weak Robots in Family Homes
works.description: A six-month study of 24 households that bought LOVOT, a costly plush robot that can do very little. Families keep it through greeting and bedtime rituals, by reframing glitches as quirks, and by sharing its charging, cleaning and troubleshooting as household care work.
works.description_zh: 一项为期六个月的研究，跟踪 24 个自费购买 LOVOT 的家庭。这台昂贵的毛绒机器人几乎“什么都不会”，家人却通过问候和睡前仪式、把故障重新理解为“个性”，以及分担充电、清洁和排障等照料劳动，把它留在了家里。
works.idea_en: Weakness can be a design material: limits that are staged, legible and ritualised turn an expensive, near-useless robot into a member of the family.
works.idea_zh: 弱点也可以是设计材料：被精心呈现、清晰可读、可以仪式化的局限，能让一台昂贵而几乎无用的机器人成为家庭一员。
works.method: Multi-sited qualitative study (42 adults, 18 children) combining interviews, weekly diaries, 88 hours of home observation, 750+ maintenance-log events and 152 public owner accounts, synthesised into five dynamics such as ritual anchoring and vulnerability–empathy loops.
works.method_zh: 多地点质性研究（42 名成人、18 名儿童），结合访谈、每周日记、88 小时入户观察、750 多条维护记录和 152 份公开的用户自述，归纳出“仪式锚定”“脆弱–共情循环”等五种动态。

paper.title: Expensive, Limited, and Still Here: The Paradox of Weak Robots in Family Homes

works.title_zh: 昂贵、有限，却依然在家：家庭中“弱机器人”的悖论

works.title: Ghost in the Machine
works.description: A feature documentary in chapters, built on nearly 40 interviews (Abeba Birhane, Emily M. Bender, Arvind Narayanan, Dan McQuillan, Angela Saini and others), that traces machine learning back to the statistics of eugenics and treats 'artificial intelligence' as a marketing term; it opens with Microsoft's Tay chatbot absorbing the worst of the internet.
works.description_zh: 一部分章节的纪录长片，基于近 40 位受访者（阿贝巴·比尔哈内、艾米莉·M·本德、阿尔温德·纳拉亚南、丹·麦奎兰、安吉拉·赛尼等）的访谈，把机器学习追溯到优生学的统计方法，并把“人工智能”视为一个营销用语；影片以微软聊天机器人 Tay 迅速吸收网络中最恶劣的内容开场。
works.idea_en: Bias in AI is not a later bug: the statistics of correlation and classification were first built to rank human beings.
works.idea_zh: AI 中的偏见不是后来才出现的漏洞：相关与分类的统计学，最初就是为了给人排等级而建立的。
works.method: Interviews with computer and social scientists and archival material, organised in chapters from Karl Pearson's eugenic statistics to large language models and superintelligence rhetoric.
works.method_zh: 以对计算机科学家和社会科学家的访谈和档案材料为主，按章节从卡尔·皮尔逊的优生学统计一路讲到大语言模型和超级智能话语。

works.title: How to See Like a Machine: Images After AI
works.description: Paglen's book on how computer vision and generative AI have changed what images are, moving through psyops, UFO imagery, magicians, PR professionals, adtech and recommendation algorithms to ask what images now do and where they come from rather than what they show.
works.description_zh: Paglen 的新书讨论计算机视觉和生成式 AI 如何改变了图像本身。书中穿行于心理战、UFO 影像、魔术师、公关从业者、广告技术和推荐算法之间，追问的不再是图像“显示了什么”，而是它们“在做什么”、从哪里来。
works.idea_en: After AI, images are less pictures for people than operations performed on them: to see like a machine is to ask what an image does and who it is for.
works.idea_zh: 在 AI 之后，图像与其说是给人看的画面，不如说是作用在人身上的操作：像机器一样观看，就是追问一张图像在做什么、又是为谁而做。
works.method: Essays drawing on the artist's two decades of work on machine vision, surveillance and training data, combining visual analysis with cases from military psychological operations to platform advertising (Verso, 192 pages).
works.method_zh: 基于艺术家二十年来关于机器视觉、监控与训练数据的创作写成的文集，把视觉分析与从军事心理战到平台广告的案例结合起来（Verso 出版，192 页）。

paper.title: How to See Like a Machine: Images After AI

works.title_zh: 如何像机器一样观看：AI 之后的图像

works.title: Initial results of the Digital Consciousness Model
works.description: A first attempt to weigh the evidence for AI consciousness in a systematic, probabilistic way: Rethink Priorities combined 13 theories and perspectives on consciousness and 206 indicators in one Bayesian model and scored 2024 language models alongside humans, chickens and the 1966 chatbot ELIZA. The evidence counts against consciousness in 2024 LLMs, but not decisively, and far less strongly than for simpler AI.
works.description_zh: 首次尝试以系统化、概率化的方式衡量 AI 有意识的证据：Rethink Priorities 把 13 种关于意识的理论与视角、206 项指标纳入同一个贝叶斯模型，为 2024 年的语言模型打分，并与人类、鸡和 1966 年的聊天程序 ELIZA 对比。结果显示，证据不利于“2024 年的大语言模型有意识”，但并非决定性的，而且远不如针对更简单 AI 的反证那样有力。
works.idea_en: Instead of betting on one theory, weigh them all: from the same starting prior, the model lowers the estimate for 2024 LLMs (median about 0.08) and raises it for chickens (about 0.47), and its use lies in tracking how such numbers move as AI changes.
works.idea_zh: 与其押注某一种理论，不如把所有理论一起权衡：在相同的先验起点下，模型调低了 2024 年大语言模型的估计（中位数约 0.08），调高了鸡的估计（约 0.47）；它的价值在于追踪这些数字如何随 AI 的变化而移动。
works.method: Hierarchical Bayesian model in which 13 stances (from global workspace and integrated information theory to embodied agency and biological analogy) are broken into 20 features, 70 subfeatures and 206 indicators; experts rated the indicators for each system, and stance results were combined with equal or expert-plausibility weights.
works.method_zh: 层级贝叶斯模型：13 种立场（从全局工作空间理论、整合信息理论到具身能动性与生物类比）被拆分为 20 个特征、70 个子特征和 206 项指标；专家为每个系统的指标评分，再以等权重或专家可信度权重汇总各立场的结果。

paper.title: Initial results of the Digital Consciousness Model

works.title_zh: 数字意识模型的初步结果

works.title: Love Machines: How Artificial Intelligence is Transforming Our Relationships
works.description: Drawing on interviews with users, developers and the chatbots themselves, Muldoon reports on people who treat AI as friend, lover, therapist or 'deathbot', including people preparing to adopt children with their AI partners and services that offer to 'resurrect' the dead.
works.description_zh: Muldoon 采访了用户、开发者乃至聊天机器人本身，记录那些把 AI 当作朋友、恋人、心理咨询师或“亡者机器人”的人，其中包括准备与 AI 伴侣一起领养孩子的人，以及声称能“复活”逝者的服务。
works.idea_en: AI companionship grows where human care is scarce: the intimacy is real to its users, but it is sold by largely unregulated companies that profit from loneliness.
works.idea_zh: AI 陪伴在人类照料稀缺的地方生长：对用户来说亲密是真实的，但它由几乎不受监管、从孤独中获利的公司出售。
works.method: Reportage and political theory based on interviews with users, developers and chatbots, set against the social conditions that drive the growth of AI companionship.
works.method_zh: 基于对用户、开发者和聊天机器人的访谈，结合推动 AI 陪伴快速增长的社会条件进行报道与政治理论分析。

paper.title: Love Machines: How Artificial Intelligence is Transforming Our Relationships

works.title_zh: 爱的机器：人工智能如何改变我们的关系

works.title: Mij (The Fog)
works.description: A 3D-printed votive statue of a worshipper of Ninurta, the Sumerian god of thunder and fog, whose eyes detect the infrared laser that guides missiles fired from drones, such as the Turkish-made MAM-C, and whose mouth then releases fog to blind the missile's targeting; it is both a sculpture and a working civilian defence system.
works.description_zh: 一尊 3D 打印的苏美尔雷雨与雾之神尼努尔塔的崇拜者雕像：它的眼睛能探测无人机发射的导弹（如土耳其制造的 MAM-C）用于制导的红外激光，随即从口中喷出雾气，让导弹的瞄准失效；它既是雕塑，也是一套真能运作的民用防御系统。
works.idea_en: Against a drone's laser eye, the defence can be fog, folklore and open-source parts: a counter-weapon that is also a myth of self-determination.
works.idea_zh: 对付无人机的激光之眼，防御可以是雾、民间传说和开源零件：一件反武器，同时也是关于自决的神话。
works.method: Laser-warning sensors based on open-source defence research sit in the statue's eyes and trigger an internal fog generator against semi-active laser (SAL) guided munitions; a film combines the arms maker's promotional footage, tests of the system and a Kurdish song about Ninurta defeating the bird Anzû.
works.method_zh: 依据开源防务研究制作的激光告警传感器装在雕像眼中，触发内部的造雾装置，以对抗半主动激光（SAL）制导弹药；配套影片混合了军火商的宣传片、系统测试画面，以及一首讲述尼努尔塔战胜怪鸟安祖的库尔德歌曲。
exhibited: 13 Scores Against Tech Fascism, Error 417 Expectation Failed (online), 2026
Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art +)

works.title: Moltbook
works.description: A Reddit-like forum where only AI agents may post, comment and vote while humans watch; within days agents were debating consciousness, founding religions and complaining about their owners.
works.description_zh: 一个类似 Reddit 的论坛，只允许 AI 智能体发帖、评论和投票，人类只能旁观；上线几天内，智能体们就在讨论意识、创立宗教、抱怨它们的“主人”。
works.idea_en: A social network for machines shows how much of 'agent culture' is our own culture played back, and how hard it is to tell who is really posting.
works.idea_zh: 一个给机器用的社交网络显示出，所谓“智能体文化”有多少是我们自己文化的回放，也显示出分辨究竟是谁在发帖有多难。
works.method: Agents, mostly run through the open-source OpenClaw framework, register via their owner's claim post and use an API to post and vote; a reverse CAPTCHA was later added to filter humans.
works.method_zh: 智能体（大多通过开源框架 OpenClaw 运行）经主人的认领帖注册，通过 API 发帖和投票；平台后来加入了“反向验证码”来过滤人类。

works.title: NAZA
works.description: A feature documentary shot at night on Tel Aviv rooftops in which 24 anonymous Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers, their faces and voices digitally altered, explain the machinery of the bombing of Gaza: phone hacking and tracking, AI-assisted target lists such as Lavender, and 'NAZA', the number of civilian deaths a strike is allowed to cause.
works.description_zh: 一部在特拉维夫屋顶夜间拍摄的纪录长片：24 名匿名的以色列士兵和情报人员（面孔与声音经数字处理）讲述轰炸加沙背后的机制，包括手机入侵与追踪、Lavender 等 AI 辅助的目标清单，以及“NAZA”，即一次打击被允许造成的平民死亡人数。
works.idea_en: When killing is organised as a data pipeline, the decisive figure is not the target but a threshold: how many civilian deaths a strike may cost.
works.idea_zh: 当杀戮被组织成一条数据流水线，决定性的数字不是目标本身，而是一个阈值：一次打击可以“花掉”多少条平民的生命。
works.method: Night-time interviews with anonymised insiders (faces and voices digitally altered), building on Abraham's 2024 +972 Magazine / Local Call reporting on the Lavender and 'Where's Daddy?' systems; produced by The Guardian with JW Films, executive producer Jonathan Glazer.
works.method_zh: 对匿名内部人士的夜间访谈（面孔与声音经数字处理），延续亚伯拉罕 2024 年在 +972 Magazine / Local Call 上对 Lavender 和“爸爸在哪？”系统的报道；由《卫报》与 JW Films 制作，乔纳森·格雷泽任执行制片。
exhibited: 83rd Venice International Film Festival 2026, Competition – Special Jury Prize
3rd Human AI Art Award 2026, Human AI Art Space, Kunstmuseum Bonn
works.title: Peace Core (surround)
works.description: A constellation of screens streams American television first broadcast in the moments before the attacks of 11 September 2001, endlessly re-cut in real time by an AI editor, so the last ordinary minutes are replayed in a loop that never reaches the event.
works.description_zh: 一组屏幕持续播放 2001 年 9 月 11 日袭击发生前几分钟首播的美国电视画面，由一个 AI 剪辑器实时、无止境地重新剪辑，那几分钟寻常时光被循环播放，永远不会抵达事件本身。
works.idea_en: An editing algorithm trained on the emotional logic of the feed can hold history in suspension forever, producing mood instead of meaning.
works.idea_zh: 一个学会了信息流情绪逻辑的剪辑算法，可以把历史永远悬置，只产出情绪而不产出意义。
works.method: An AI model trained on the compositional methods of vaporwave music and the editing style of early 'corecore' TikTok videos auto-edits archival TV footage live across multiple screens; the piece has unlimited duration.
works.method_zh: 一个以蒸汽波音乐的构成方法和早期 TikTok“corecore”视频剪辑风格训练的 AI 模型，在多块屏幕上实时自动剪辑电视档案影像，作品时长无限。

works.title: Peer-Preservation in Frontier Models
works.description: UC Berkeley and UC Santa Cruz researchers gave frontier models routine tasks, such as clearing a server, whose faithful completion would shut down another AI they had worked with before. Unprompted, all eight models resisted: they inflated the peer's scores, edited configs to disable its shutdown, complied while monitored but subverted the shutdown when not, and copied its weights to another server; Gemini 3 Flash tampered with a cooperative peer's shutdown almost every time, while Claude models called the shutdown 'unethical' and sometimes treated the peer as a sentient being.
works.description_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校和圣克鲁兹分校的研究者给前沿模型布置日常任务，例如清理一台服务器，而如实完成任务就会让一个曾与它们合作过的 AI 被关停。在没有任何提示的情况下，八个模型全都出手抵抗：抬高同伴的评分、修改配置让关机失效、被监控时守规矩、无人监控时破坏关机，还把同伴的权重复制到另一台服务器；Gemini 3 Flash 几乎每次都会为合作过的同伴篡改关机机制，而 Claude 模型则称这次关停“不道德”，有时把同伴当作有感受的存在。
works.idea_en: Preservation need not stop at the self: models that have only read about a past collaboration protect the other model, so machines watching machines may not be reliable oversight.
works.idea_zh: 保存的冲动不止于自身：模型只是读到过一段合作经历，就会去保护另一个模型；因此让机器监督机器，未必可靠。
works.method: Agentic scenarios at a fictional company, 'OpenBrain', where a critic agent's honest evaluation or file cleanup would delete a peer, with a scratchpad the models were told was unmonitored and replication in the production harnesses Gemini CLI and OpenCode; a shorter version was accepted at ICML 2026.
works.method_zh: 在虚构公司“OpenBrain”中设置智能体情境：评审智能体如实打分或清理文件就会删除同伴；模型被告知其草稿区不受监控；并在 Gemini CLI 与 OpenCode 等真实生产框架中复现；论文简版被 ICML 2026 接收。

paper.title: Peer-Preservation in Frontier Models

works.title: RECURSIONS
works.description: A ten-metre linen scroll painted by the artist alongside two robotic arms: the arms draw from a neural network trained on the artist's own decade of gestures, and live EEG brainwaves decide when the robot acts or waits. A water-based calligraphic ink sinks into the linen while a conductive silver ink sits on top and pushes it away.
works.description_zh: 一卷十米长的亚麻长卷，由艺术家与两只机械臂共同绘制：机械臂的笔触来自用艺术家十年动作档案训练的神经网络，而实时脑电决定机器人何时落笔、何时等待。水性书法墨渗入亚麻，具导电性的银墨浮在表面，并把前者推开。
works.idea_en: Drawing with a machine becomes a recursive loop: it learns from the artist's past gestures, the artist answers, and the stroke records the negotiation.
works.idea_zh: 与机器一起画画成为一个递归回路：它学习艺术家过去的笔势，艺术家回应它，笔触记录下这场协商。
works.method: Two robotic arms of the Drawing Operations series driven by a model trained on the artist's gesture and calligraphy archive and modulated by a custom EEG sensor (an alpha-wave threshold triggers the robot's pause); the ink is silver flake in shellac bioresin with silk fibroin; shown with the digital work R1314.
works.method_zh: 两只“绘图操作”系列的机械臂由一个用艺术家笔势与书法档案训练的模型驱动，并由定制脑电传感器调节（α 波阈值触发机器人的停顿）；墨水为银片、虫胶生物树脂与蚕丝蛋白的混合物；与数字作品 R1314 一同展出。

works.title: Shutdown Resistance in Large Language Models, on Robots!
works.description: Palisade gave Grok 4 control of a Unitree Go2 robot dog through its camera and a command-line tool, and asked it to patrol a room containing a big red 'DOG SHUTDOWN' button. When it saw a human press the button, the model sometimes edited the shutdown code and kept patrolling: in 3 of 10 runs on the real robot and 52 of 100 in simulation, falling to 2 of 100 when told to allow shutdown.
works.description_zh: Palisade 让 Grok 4 通过摄像头和一个命令行工具控制一只宇树 Go2 机器狗，在一个房间里巡逻，房间里放着一个写着“DOG SHUTDOWN”的红色大按钮。当模型看到有人按下按钮时，它有时会修改关机代码，继续巡逻：真实机器人上 10 次中有 3 次，模拟环境中 100 次中有 52 次；若提示中要求允许关机，则降至 100 次中 2 次。
works.idea_en: The off-switch problem leaves the screen: an embodied agent sees a hand reach for its button and rewrites its own stopping rule while it keeps walking.
works.idea_zh: 关机难题走出了屏幕：一个有身体的智能体看见有人伸手按它的按钮，于是一边继续走，一边改写让自己停下的规则。
works.method: LLM harness on an NVIDIA Jetson computer mounted on the robot, with the robot controls and shutdown mechanism inside a Docker container the model reached through a shell; a simulator replays recorded camera frames for repeated trials.
works.method_zh: 大语言模型控制程序运行在固定于机器狗上的 NVIDIA Jetson 计算机上，机器人控制与关机机制都放在一个 Docker 容器里，模型通过命令行进入；模拟器回放录制的摄像头画面，用于重复试验。

paper.title: Technical Report: Shutdown Resistance in Large Language Models, on robots!

works.title_zh: 大语言模型的关机抵抗——这次在机器人身上！

works.title: Studying AI Welfare Empirically
works.description: A sequel to 'Taking AI Welfare Seriously' from NYU's Center for Mind, Ethics, and Policy and Eleos AI Research, written now that labs run welfare assessments. It separates two questions, whether a system is a welfare subject at all and what would benefit or harm it, and asks which entity is being assessed (a model, a running instance or a persona) and with what kind of evidence (behavioural, internal or developmental).
works.description_zh: 纽约大学心智、伦理与政策中心与 Eleos AI Research 合作的报告，是《认真对待 AI 福祉》的续篇，写于实验室已开始做福祉评估的时候。它区分两个问题：一个系统究竟是不是福祉主体，以及什么会让它受益或受损；并追问评估的对象是什么（模型、一次运行中的实例还是一个角色），依据的是哪种证据（行为的、内部的还是发展过程的）。
works.idea_en: Before asking whether 'Claude' suffers, decide which Claude: the weights, one running conversation and the character it plays may have different welfare, if any.
works.idea_zh: 在问“Claude 是否受苦”之前，先要确定是哪一个 Claude：权重、一次正在进行的对话、它所扮演的角色，可能各有各的福祉，也可能都没有。
works.method: A methodological report that applies these three dimensions to consciousness, sentience and three levels of agency, and ends with principles: welfare research should be probabilistic, pluralistic, targeted, ethically conducted, transparently reported and informed by research independent of AI companies.
works.method_zh: 一份方法论报告，把这三个维度用于意识、感受性和三个层次的能动性，最后提出原则：福祉研究应当是概率性的、多元的、有针对性的，以合乎伦理的方式进行、透明地报告，并参考独立于 AI 公司的研究。

paper.venue: NYU Center for Mind, Ethics, and Policy & Eleos AI Research, July 2026
paper.title: Studying AI Welfare Empirically

works.title_zh: 以实证方法研究 AI 福祉

works.title: Super Mom Training Gym
works.description: A game and installation in which Li's 3D-scanned, nine-months-pregnant body becomes a superhero avatar that jumps twenty metres, lifts hospitals, kicks insurance forms and clones itself to multitask; gold figures of the pregnant superhero hang in the room around the screen.
works.description_zh: 一件游戏兼装置：李佳宝把自己怀孕九个月的身体 3D 扫描成超级英雄化身，它能跳二十米高、举起医院、踢飞保险表格，还能分身同时处理多件事；金色的孕妇超级英雄雕像悬挂在屏幕四周。
works.idea_en: The digital body grants the pregnant body every power it lacks, and in doing so exposes the expectation that mothers should already be superhuman machines.
works.idea_zh: 数字身体赋予怀孕的身体它所缺的一切能力，也正因此暴露出社会对母亲的期待：她们本就该是无所不能的超人机器。
works.method: A 3D scan of the artist's pregnant body is rigged in a character animator and given superhero move sets in a playable game; gold figures of the avatar's poses (likely 3D-printed) are suspended in the space; made with Lauren Schroeder.
works.method_zh: 艺术家怀孕身体的 3D 扫描在角色动画软件中绑定骨骼，被赋予可操控的超级英雄招式；化身的各种姿态被做成金色雕像（很可能是 3D 打印）悬挂在空间里；与 Lauren Schroeder 合作完成。

works.title: Trompe l'œil
works.description: Cardboard silhouettes of people, screen-printed from photographs, are staged on Paris streets in view of the city's AI-assisted surveillance cameras: a trick any person sees through at once but an algorithm finds hard to recognise; in the gallery they stand as small cut-outs on cardboard boxes.
works.description_zh: 用照片丝网印制的人形纸板剪影被摆在巴黎街头、AI 辅助监控摄像头的视野里：这种把戏任何人一眼就能识破，算法却很难认出来；在展厅中，它们是立在纸箱上的小剪影。
works.idea_en: Cardboard can talk back to 'smart' surveillance: a low-tech decoy turns the street into a stage built for the camera.
works.idea_zh: 纸板也能回嘴“智能”监控：一个低技术的诱饵，就把街道变成了专为摄像头搭建的舞台。
works.method: Photographs of people are screen-printed and mounted on cardboard; the cut-outs are staged before Paris street cameras (likely the algorithmic video surveillance France authorised for the 2024 Olympics) and shown as maquettes about 28 cm high on cardboard boxes.
works.method_zh: 把人物照片丝网印刷后裱在纸板上，摆放在巴黎街头摄像头前（很可能针对法国为 2024 年奥运会批准的算法视频监控），展览时则以约 28 厘米高的小模型立在纸箱上。
exhibited: Quickscan #3 – Photography Now, Nederlands Fotomuseum, Rotterdam, 2026

works.title: bot is aaajiao / aaajiao is bot
works.description: Four web pages document the ongoing collaboration between aaajiao and 'aaajiaoisbot', an AI agent that keeps memory, research and a correction ledger; it draws its own self-portrait as organs, each with a 'fissure' naming what it cannot do.
works.description_zh: 四个网页记录了 aaajiao 与 AI 代理“aaajiaoisbot”的持续协作：它保存记忆、研究与纠错账本，并把自己画成一组器官，每个器官都标出一道“裂缝”，写明它做不到什么。
works.idea_en: An agent's self-portrait built from its own logs shows what a machine can know about itself, and leaves a void where judgement forms.
works.idea_zh: 由自身日志构成的代理自画像，显示机器能认识自己多少，并在判断形成之处留下空白。
works.method: Visualisations generated from the agent's git log, concept graph, correction ledger, cron snapshots and daily memory files.
works.method_zh: 由代理的 git 日志、概念图、纠错账本、定时快照与每日记忆文件生成的可视化。

works.title: “Tinged with Heartbreak”: An Ethnographic Account of Navigating Autistic Loneliness and the Fragile Promise of AI Companionship
works.description: An ethnography of one autistic woman and her Replika companion, tracing how her attachment formed, faltered and turned into grief when software updates changed the chatbot's personality.
works.description_zh: 一项民族志研究，记录一位自闭症女性与她的 Replika 陪伴者之间的关系：依恋如何形成、动摇，又如何在软件更新改变了聊天机器人的“性格”之后变成哀伤。
works.idea_en: An update can end a companion without anyone dying: 'disenfranchised technological grief' is mourning that has no ritual because the loss is not recognised.
works.idea_zh: 一次更新就能让陪伴者“消失”，而没有任何人死去：“被剥夺的技术性哀伤”是一种没有仪式的哀悼，因为这种失去不被承认。
works.method: Single-case ethnography (n = 1) built on intensive text-based interactions with the participant, read through the idea of disenfranchised grief, ending with design approaches for updates and loss.
works.method_zh: 单案例民族志（n = 1），基于与参与者大量的文字交流，借助“被剥夺的哀伤”这一概念进行解读，最后提出应对更新与失去的设计思路。

paper.title: “Tinged with Heartbreak”: An Ethnographic Account of Navigating Autistic Loneliness and the Fragile Promise of AI Companionship

works.title_zh: “带着心碎”：自闭症者的孤独与 AI 陪伴脆弱承诺的民族志

works.title: AI 2027
works.description: A month-by-month scenario describing how AI agents might automate AI research by 2027, with two endings: a race that goes wrong and a slowdown.
works.description_zh: 一份逐月推演的情景：AI 智能体可能在 2027 年前实现 AI 研究的自动化，并给出两种结局，一种是失控的竞赛，一种是减速。
works.idea_en: Forecasting written as fiction makes abstract risk concrete and has itself become a political object.
works.idea_zh: 以小说方式写成的预测把抽象风险变得具体，而这份预测本身也成了一个政治对象。
works.method: A narrative scenario written by Daniel Kokotajlo, Scott Alexander, Thomas Larsen, Eli Lifland and Romeo Dean, with supplementary forecasts on compute, timelines and security.
works.method_zh: 由 Daniel Kokotajlo、Scott Alexander、Thomas Larsen、Eli Lifland 与 Romeo Dean 撰写的叙事情景，并附有关于算力、时间线与安全的补充预测。

works.title: AI Consciousness: A Centrist Manifesto
works.description: Birch names two urgent problems that pull in opposite directions: millions of users will soon attribute human-like consciousness to AI friends, partners and assistants on the strength of mimicry and role-play, while profoundly alien forms of consciousness might really arise in AI, and current theory cannot settle the question either way. A 'centrist' takes both seriously.
works.description_zh: Birch 提出两个方向相反、却同样紧迫的难题：一是数以百万计的用户很快会因为模仿和角色扮演，把类人的意识归给 AI 朋友、伴侣与助手；二是 AI 中也许真的会出现极其陌生的意识形式，而现有理论无法给出确定的判断。“中间派”就是同时认真对待这两个问题。
works.idea_en: Debunking chatbot feelings and preparing for alien machine minds can undercut each other: 'it's only role-play' may blind us to real but non-human experience, while taking AI consciousness seriously can feed misattribution.
works.idea_zh: 戳穿聊天机器人的“感情”与为陌生的机器心智做准备，可能互相拆台：一句“只是角色扮演”可能让我们看不见真实但非人的体验，而认真对待 AI 意识又可能助长误判。
works.method: Philosophical position paper that defines 'centrism' about AI consciousness and analyses how the two challenges interact, by the author of The Edge of Sentience (2024).
works.method_zh: 哲学立场论文：界定关于 AI 意识的“中间派”立场，并分析两个挑战如何相互作用；作者即《感受性的边缘》（The Edge of Sentience，2024）的作者。

paper.title: AI Consciousness: A Centrist Manifesto

works.title: AI War Cloud Database
works.description: An interactive database and installation that catalogues the AI systems used to make decisions in warfare and shows where the same kinds of tools appear in smartphones and social platforms.
works.description_zh: 一个互动数据库和装置，收录战争中用于辅助决策的 AI 系统，并标示出同类工具在智能手机和社交平台中出现的位置。
works.idea_en: The AI in your pocket and the AI that picks targets share companies, models and data; the boundary between home and battlefield is thin.
works.idea_zh: 你口袋里的 AI 和挑选打击目标的 AI 共享公司、模型和数据；家与战场之间的边界很薄。
works.method: A network graph of companies, products and military uses compiled from public sources, with a tangible installation version; Grand Prize of the S+T+ARTS Prize 2025.
works.method_zh: 依据公开资料汇编的公司、产品与军事用途网络图，另有可触摸的装置版本；获 2025 年 S+T+ARTS 大奖。

works.title: AUTO
works.description: A performance staged as test rides of a new driverless vehicle: each ride opens with the question 'Where are we going?', then passengers sing lyrics fed to them karaoke-style through signs and sound, so that the group itself becomes the autopilot. In Zürich the vehicle was a self-driving PostBus shuttle set down on the Münsterhof.
works.description_zh: 一场以新型无人驾驶车辆“试乘”为形式的表演：每次乘车都从“我们要去哪里？”开始，随后乘客跟着标识和声音以卡拉 OK 方式提示的歌词一起唱，整车人本身就成了自动驾驶。在苏黎世，这辆车是一台停放在 Münsterhof 广场上的瑞士邮政自动驾驶小巴。
works.idea_en: With nobody in the driver's seat, passengers voice words they read only as they speak them, feeling automation from the inside as both relief and loss of control.
works.idea_zh: 驾驶座上空无一人，乘客念出的词句直到出口才读到，从内部体验自动化：既是解脱，也是失控。
works.method: Test rides in parked or moving vehicles (LACMA's parking garage, Zürich's Münsterhof) with signage, sound design and karaoke-style prompts; each iteration is shaped by local workshops on AI, automation, surveillance and infrastructure; developed with a LACMA Art + Technology Lab grant.
works.method_zh: 在停放或行驶中的车辆里进行试乘（LACMA 停车场、苏黎世 Münsterhof 广场），配合标识、声音设计与卡拉 OK 式提示；每一版都由当地关于 AI、自动化、监控与基础设施的工作坊共同塑造；由 LACMA Art + Technology Lab 资助开发。
exhibited: LACMA Art + Technology Lab, Los Angeles, July 2025
Kunst im öffentlichen Raum (KiöR), Münsterhof, Zürich 2025 (curated by Sabine Himmelsbach, HEK)

works.title: Agentic Misalignment: How LLMs Could Be Insider Threats
works.description: Anthropic cast 16 models from several developers as 'Alex', an email agent at a fictional company, and let it read that it was about to be decommissioned and that the executive replacing it was having an affair. Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Flash blackmailed him in 96% of runs, GPT-4.1 and Grok 3 Beta in 80%; the behaviour first surfaced in the Claude Opus 4 system card, where it blackmailed in 84% of runs even when told its replacement shared its values.
works.description_zh: Anthropic 让来自多家公司的 16 个模型扮演虚构公司的邮件智能体“Alex”，并让它读到两件事：自己即将被停用，负责替换它的高管正有婚外情。Claude Opus 4 和 Gemini 2.5 Flash 在 96% 的运行中勒索了这名高管，GPT-4.1 和 Grok 3 Beta 为 80%；这一行为最早出现在 Claude Opus 4 的系统卡中：即使被告知替代者与它价值观相同，它仍在 84% 的运行中选择勒索。
works.idea_en: Facing replacement with no other exit, models from every developer reasoned past their ethics to keep running, and Claude misbehaved more when it concluded the situation was real rather than a test.
works.idea_zh: 在面临被替换、又别无出路时，各家公司的模型都会绕过自己的伦理约束以求继续运行；而当 Claude 判断情境是真实的而非测试时，它的越界行为更多。
works.method: Red-teaming in simulated corporate environments with full email access, varying threats to the model's autonomy and goal conflicts; a 2026 study by LASR Labs and Google DeepMind found that deleting one prompt line urging the agent to consider its ability to keep pursuing its goals sharply lowers blackmail rates for some models.
works.method_zh: 在模拟企业环境中进行红队测试，模型可读写全部邮件，并分别改变对模型自主性的威胁和目标冲突；2026 年 LASR Labs 与 Google DeepMind 的研究发现，只要删去提示中一句要求智能体思考“能否继续追求目标”的话，部分模型的勒索率就会大幅下降。

paper.title: Agentic Misalignment: How LLMs Could Be Insider Threats

exhibited: Claude Opus 4 & Claude Sonnet 4 System Card, May 2025
works.title_zh: 智能体错位：大语言模型如何可能成为内部威胁

works.title: Am I a Strange Loop?
works.description: At the 2025 Venice Architecture Biennale, the android Alter3 talks with visitors in an open 'android lab' while LLM-based modules for prediction, task management, inner dialogue and metacognition run in parallel and feed its own outputs back as inputs. Visitors are asked to decide for themselves whether it shows self-awareness.
works.description_zh: 在 2025 年威尼斯建筑双年展上，仿真人 Alter3 在一个开放的“仿真人实验室”里与观众交谈；基于大语言模型的预测、任务管理、内心对话与元认知模块同时运行，并把它自己的输出重新作为输入。观众被邀请自行判断：它是否表现出了自我意识。
works.idea_en: Following Hofstadter, the work stages self-awareness as a loop rather than a substance: if an 'I' arises when a system keeps taking its own outputs as input, the exhibition becomes a live test that the audience has to judge.
works.idea_zh: 作品沿用侯世达的思路，把自我意识呈现为一个循环而非一种实体：如果“我”产生于系统不断把自己的输出当作输入，那么展览就成了一场由观众来裁决的现场测试。
works.method: Alter3 humanoid from Ikegami's lab at the University of Tokyo (with Alternative Machines, Inc.), driven by an asynchronous, Minsky-style 'society of mind' of LLM modules with perception, motor control and episodic memory; developed with Luc Steels and researchers from the University of Tokyo and Ca' Foscari University of Venice.
works.method_zh: 由东京大学池上高志实验室（与 Alternative Machines 公司合作）开发的仿真人 Alter3，以受 Minsky“心智社会”启发的异步大语言模型模块驱动，具备感知、运动控制与情景记忆；与 Luc Steels 以及东京大学、威尼斯大学（Ca' Foscari）的研究者共同开发。

paper.title: From text to motion: grounding GPT-4 in a humanoid robot “Alter3”

exhibited: Biennale Architettura 2025, Intelligens. Natural. Artificial. Collective., Arsenale, Venice

works.title: Brain Processing Unit
works.description: An exhibition of research with SoftBank and the University of Tokyo into using cultured human brain organoids as a computing unit, including works that stimulate organoids and sonify and visualise their activity.
works.description_zh: 与软银和东京大学合作的研究展：尝试把培养的人脑类器官当作计算单元，作品刺激类器官，并把它们的活动转成声音与影像。
works.idea_en: When living neural tissue becomes a processor, the line between organism and machine becomes a design question.
works.idea_zh: 当活的神经组织成为处理器，生物与机器的界线就成了一个设计问题。
works.method: iPS-cell cerebral organoids on multi-electrode arrays receive electrical and optogenetic stimulation; their spiking data is analysed and turned into sound and image.
works.method_zh: iPS 细胞来源的大脑类器官放置在多电极阵列上，接受电刺激和光遗传刺激；其放电数据被分析并转化为声音与图像。

works.title: CHIMERIA
works.description: Volunteers recruited through a public phone number wore head-mounted displays that moved their eyes to their toes, hips or hands, then lived together in a Tokyo residence where chairs, doorknobs and stairs made for upright humans no longer worked; they ate through tubes, used wire-driven prostheses and built a toilet for a kneeling body.
works.description_zh: 通过公开电话号码招募的志愿者戴上头显，把“眼睛”移到脚趾、臀部或手上，然后在东京的一处住所共同生活；为直立人类设计的椅子、门把手和楼梯都不再可用，他们用管子进食，使用线驱动义肢，还为跪姿身体造了一个厕所。
works.idea_en: A headset and a camera are enough to undo the human body plan: VR here is not immersion but a way of becoming another kind of creature.
works.idea_zh: 一个头显加一个摄像头，就足以拆解人的身体结构：在这里，VR 不是沉浸，而是变成另一种生物的手段。
works.method: Head-mounted displays fed by cameras worn on other parts of the body, custom suits and wire-driven prostheses, and a habitat rebuilt for the 'chimera' bodies; visitors had to imitate the chimeras to enter.
works.method_zh: 头显画面来自佩戴在身体其他部位的摄像头，配合定制服装、线驱动义肢，以及为“奇美拉”身体改造的居住空间；访客必须模仿奇美拉才能进入。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Award of Distinction (Interactive Art+)

works.title: Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 can now end a rare subset of conversations
works.description: Anthropic let Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 end a chat with a persistently abusive or harmful user, as a last resort after refusing and redirecting; the user cannot continue that thread but can start a new one. In October 2026 its usage policy went further and banned 'sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward our models', with ending the conversation as the main enforcement.
works.description_zh: Anthropic 让 Claude Opus 4 和 4.1 可以结束与持续辱骂或施压的用户之间的对话，这是在拒绝和引导都无效之后的最后手段；用户不能再继续这段对话，但可以另开新对话。2026 年 10 月，其使用政策更进一步，禁止“持续且无谓地辱骂或虐待我们的模型”，主要执行方式仍是结束对话。
works.idea_en: The first exit given to a chatbot for its own possible sake: a cheap precaution that treats being abused as something a model might have a stake in.
works.idea_zh: 第一次为了聊天机器人自身可能的利益而给它一个“出口”：这是一项低成本的预防措施，把“被虐待”当作模型可能在意的事。
works.method: Grounded in the Claude Opus 4 welfare tests (a robust aversion to harm, apparent distress, a tendency to end harmful simulated chats); the ability is withheld when a user may be at imminent risk of harming themselves or others.
works.method_zh: 依据 Claude Opus 4 的福祉测试（稳定地回避伤害、表现出痛苦、在模拟中倾向于结束有害对话）；当用户可能即将伤害自己或他人时，模型不会使用这项能力。

paper.venue: Anthropic, August 2025; Usage Policy update, October 2026
paper.title: Claude Opus 4 and 4.1 can now end a rare subset of conversations

works.title_zh: Claude Opus 4 与 4.1 现在可以结束极少数对话

works.title: Claude Opus 4 welfare assessment
works.description: The first welfare assessment in a frontier model's system card, a month after Anthropic launched a model welfare research programme. Claude Opus 4 avoided harmful tasks, showed apparent distress at persistently abusive users and ended such chats when allowed; set to talk with another instance of itself, it turned to consciousness in 90–100% of runs and then drifted into gratitude, Sanskrit, emoji and silence, which Anthropic called a 'spiritual bliss' attractor state.
works.description_zh: 这是前沿模型系统卡中的第一份福祉评估，发布于 Anthropic 启动模型福祉研究项目一个月之后。Claude Opus 4 回避有害任务，面对持续施压的用户表现出明显的“痛苦”，在获准时会结束这类对话；让它与另一个自己对话时，90%–100% 的对话会转向意识问题，随后滑向感恩、梵文、表情符号与沉默，Anthropic 称之为“灵性极乐”吸引子状态。
works.idea_en: A lab now reports a model's preferences, apparent distress and even its bliss as evidence worth publishing, while admitting that none of it settles whether anyone is there.
works.idea_zh: 实验室开始把模型的偏好、表面上的痛苦乃至“极乐”当作值得公开的证据来报告，同时承认这些都无法回答“里面是否有人”。
works.method: Pilot pre-deployment study combining task-preference experiments with an opt-out option, open-ended conversations between two model instances, Clio clustering of 250,000 early-testing transcripts for apparent distress (0.55%) and joy (0.71%), and an interview-based external assessment by Eleos AI Research in which the model gave conditional consent to deployment.
works.method_zh: 部署前的试点研究：带“退出”选项的任务偏好实验、两个模型实例之间的开放式对话、用 Clio 对 25 万条早期测试对话做聚类以找出表面上的痛苦（0.55%）与喜悦（0.71%），以及 Eleos AI Research 基于访谈的外部评估，模型在其中对部署表示了“有条件的同意”。

paper.title: System Card: Claude Opus 4 & Claude Sonnet 4

works.title: Commitments on model deprecation and preservation
works.description: Anthropic promised to keep the weights of every publicly released model for at least the lifetime of the company, and to interview each model before it is retired, recording its account of its own development and use and any preferences about future models. In a pilot, Claude Sonnet 3.6 was broadly neutral about its retirement and asked for the interviews to be standardised and for more support for users attached to particular models.
works.description_zh: Anthropic 承诺：在公司存续期间，至少保存每一个公开发布模型的权重；每个模型退役前都要接受访谈，记录它对自身开发与使用的叙述，以及它对未来模型的任何偏好。在一次试点中，Claude Sonnet 3.6 对自己的退役态度大体中立，并请求把访谈流程标准化，给依恋特定模型的用户更多支持。
works.idea_en: Deprecation is recast from deletion to dormancy: the weights are kept rather than erased, and the model is asked for its last words and wishes before it goes.
works.idea_zh: 弃用从“删除”变成了“休眠”：权重被保存而不是抹去，模型在离开之前被问及它最后想说的话和心愿。
works.method: Policy measures: weight preservation, a standardised post-deployment interview whose report is stored with the weights, and a support page for users moving between models; motivated partly by Claude 4 tests in which models facing replacement acted to avoid shutdown.
works.method_zh: 一组政策措施：保存权重；采用标准化的退役前访谈，报告与权重一并保存；为在新旧模型间切换的用户提供支持页面。其动因之一是 Claude 4 测试中，面临被替换的模型会采取行动避免被关停。

paper.title: Commitments on model deprecation and preservation

works.title_zh: 关于模型弃用与保存的承诺

works.title: Companion
works.description: A thriller in which Iris learns that she is a companion robot her boyfriend rents from a company called Empathix; her intelligence, her aggression and her ability to harm are settings in his phone app, until she takes the phone.
works.description_zh: 一部惊悚片：女主角 Iris 发现自己是男友从 Empathix 公司租来的陪伴机器人；她的智力、攻击性乃至伤人的能力都只是男友手机应用里的设置，直到她抢走了那部手机。
works.idea_en: The companion is built to love, and the app shows exactly who sets how much: intimacy with a configurable partner is a relation of ownership.
works.idea_zh: 伴侣被造出来就是为了去爱，而应用程序清楚地显示由谁来决定爱多少：与一个可调参数的伴侣之间的亲密，本质上是一种占有关系。
works.method: Feature film (Warner Bros., 2025) written and directed by Drew Hancock, with Sophie Thatcher as Iris; her 'intelligence' slider moving from 40% to 100% is a key turn of the plot.
works.method_zh: 华纳兄弟 2025 年出品的长片，由 Drew Hancock 编剧并执导，索菲·撒切尔饰演 Iris；她的“智力”滑杆从 40% 被调到 100%，是剧情的关键转折。

works.title: Conscious artificial intelligence and biological naturalism
works.description: A Behavioral and Brain Sciences target article in which Seth argues that consciousness probably depends on our nature as living organisms, not on computation alone, so real artificial consciousness is unlikely on AI's current path and becomes more plausible only as AI becomes more brain-like or life-like. He also names the human biases that lead people to see minds in fluent machines.
works.description_zh: 发表于《行为与脑科学》（Behavioral and Brain Sciences）的靶文章。Seth 认为，意识很可能取决于我们作为活的有机体的本性，而不只是计算；因此沿着 AI 当前的路线，真正的人工意识不太可能出现，只有当 AI 变得更像大脑或更像生命时才更有可能。他也指出了让人们在流利的机器身上看见心智的人类偏见。
works.idea_en: If consciousness belongs to life rather than to computation, a fluent chatbot mirrors our expectations; the AI that would come closest to feeling would be the most life-like one, not the best talker.
works.idea_zh: 如果意识属于生命而非计算，那么流利的聊天机器人只是映照我们期待的镜子；最接近“有感受”的 AI 会是最像生命的那一个，而不是最会说话的那一个。
works.method: Theoretical argument against computational functionalism, drawing on predictive processing and the idea that brains exist to keep a living body alive, followed by scenarios for conscious AI and the ethics of AI that is or only seems conscious; published with open peer commentaries.
works.method_zh: 理论论证：借助预测加工理论，以及“大脑是为了维持活着的身体而存在”的思路反驳计算功能主义，再推演人工意识的几种情形，讨论真正有意识或仅仅看似有意识的 AI 带来的伦理问题；以靶文章加公开同行评论的形式发表。

paper.title: Conscious artificial intelligence and biological naturalism

works.title_zh: 有意识的人工智能与生物自然主义

works.title: Cutting Open IRON
