works.description: After XPeng unveiled its 'female' humanoid IRON in November 2025, its human-like gait led many viewers to claim a person was inside; days later, at a car launch in Guangzhou, CEO He Xiaopeng had a technician cut open the robot's leg on stage while it stayed powered on, exposing actuators and wiring.
works.description_zh: 2025 年 11 月，小鹏发布“女性”人形机器人 IRON，因其步态太像人，许多网友断言里面藏着真人；几天后在广州的一场新车发布会上，何小鹏让技术人员当场剖开通电状态下的机器人小腿，露出执行器和线路。
works.idea_en: The uncanny test runs in reverse: the robot moved so well that it had to be opened up to prove it was not a person in a suit.
works.idea_zh: 恐怖谷测试反过来了：机器人动得太像人，以至于必须剖开它，才能证明里面不是穿着套装的人。
works.method: IRON has an internal lattice of artificial muscles and joints under a soft covering; the leg was cut open live for about three minutes, after XPeng had released unedited footage of the internal structure.
works.method_zh: IRON 在柔软外皮之下有仿生“肌肉”网格与关节；在小鹏发布未剪辑的内部结构视频之后，技术人员又在台上用约三分钟剖开了它的腿。

works.title: Data Trust
works.description: A participatory installation in which visitors gift spoken stories, in the gallery or through an app, to a community archive; the stories animate wall-sized AI projections and are encoded into bacterial DNA in the soil of okra and California black oak plants growing in the room.
works.description_zh: 一件参与式装置：观众在展厅里或通过一个应用程序，把口述故事“赠予”一个社区档案；这些故事驱动整面墙的 AI 投影，同时被编码进细菌 DNA，存入展厅中秋葵和加州黑栎的土壤里。
works.idea_en: Data can be given rather than taken: a trust built on consent, community ownership and storage in living matter rather than a company's cloud.
works.idea_zh: 数据可以被赠予，而不是被攫取：一个建立在同意、社区所有权之上，存放在活体物质而非公司云端的信托。
works.method: Oral histories are recorded, processed with AI into continuously evolving projections and stored as DNA in bacteria grown in the plants' soil; further stories arrive through thestorieswetellourmachines.app.
works.method_zh: 口述历史被录制下来，经 AI 处理成持续变化的投影，并以 DNA 形式存入植物土壤中的细菌；更多故事通过 thestorieswetellourmachines.app 收集。

works.title: Deepfaking Sam Altman
works.description: Refused an interview with OpenAI's Sam Altman, the director has a deepfake chatbot of him made in India; the glitchy 'Sam Bot' moves into his home, befriends his young son and starts co-directing the film, until the director must decide whether to delete it.
works.description_zh: 导演约不到 OpenAI 的山姆·奥特曼采访，于是在印度找人做了一个奥特曼的深度伪造聊天机器人；这个时常出错的“Sam Bot”住进他家，和他年幼的儿子交上朋友，还开始参与导演这部片子，最后导演不得不决定要不要删除它。
works.idea_en: An unauthorised copy of a person turns from a stunt into a member of the household; the hardest question is not legality but whether you may switch off a likeness your child has befriended.
works.idea_zh: 一个未经授权复制出来的人，从噱头变成了家庭成员；最难的问题不是合不合法，而是你能不能关掉一个孩子已经当成朋友的“替身”。
works.method: Documentary shot in India, Jamaica and the United States during 2024, built around a custom chatbot with a cloned voice and video face modelled on Altman's public persona.
works.method_zh: 2024 年在印度、牙买加和美国拍摄的纪录片，核心是一个以奥特曼公众形象为模板、带克隆声音和视频面孔的定制聊天机器人。

works.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
works.description: Anthropic researchers injected the activation pattern of a concept, such as 'all caps', straight into Claude's network and asked whether it noticed an intruding thought; the model replied that it sensed something about 'LOUD' or 'SHOUTING'. The strongest models, Claude Opus 4 and 4.1, named injected concepts about 20% of the time, often before the concept had shaped their output, and made no false detections in control trials.
works.description_zh: Anthropic 的研究者把某个概念（例如“全大写”）的激活模式直接注入 Claude 的网络，再问它是否察觉到有念头闯入；模型回答说，它感到有某种与“响亮”或“喊叫”有关的东西。表现最好的 Claude Opus 4 和 4.1 约有 20% 的概率说出被注入的概念，往往在该概念影响输出之前就已察觉，而在对照试验中没有出现误报。
works.idea_en: Introspection can be tested from the inside: when a model's report about its 'thoughts' tracks a change made to its activations, the report is grounded in its internal state, even if that access is narrow and unreliable.
works.idea_zh: 内省可以从内部来检验：当模型对自己“念头”的报告能追踪研究者对其激活所做的改动时，这份报告就是以内部状态为依据的，哪怕这种通达既狭窄又不可靠。
works.method: Concept injection (activation steering): a concept vector is taken from contrasting prompts, added to the residual stream at a chosen layer and strength, and the model's self-reports are compared with control trials; further tests ask models to tell injected thoughts from text input, to recognise artificial prefills and to control their internal representations, across Claude models from Claude 3 to Opus 4.1.
works.method_zh: 概念注入（激活引导）：用对比提示词提取概念向量，以选定的层位和强度加入残差流，再把模型的自我报告与对照试验比较；进一步的测试要求模型区分注入的念头与文本输入、识别被人为预填的回答、控制自己的内部表征，覆盖从 Claude 3 到 Opus 4.1 的多个模型。

paper.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models

works.title_zh: 大语言模型中涌现的内省觉知

works.title: Empire of AI: Dreams and Nightmares in Sam Altman's OpenAI
works.description: Hao's history of OpenAI follows the costs of scaling far from Silicon Valley, from Kenyan workers paid a few dollars an hour to filter violent and sexual content to communities in Chile and Uruguay contesting data centres' demand for water.
works.description_zh: 郝珂灵书写的 OpenAI 史，追踪规模扩张在硅谷之外留下的代价：从时薪只有几美元、负责过滤暴力与色情内容的肯尼亚工人，到在智利和乌拉圭抵制数据中心大量用水的社区。
works.idea_en: Scaling is an imperial project: AI's 'intelligence' is built by seizing data, land, water and cheap labour, and by monopolising knowledge about itself.
works.idea_zh: 规模扩张是一项帝国工程：AI 的“智能”建立在攫取数据、土地、水和廉价劳动之上，也建立在垄断关于它自身的知识之上。
works.method: Investigative reporting based on hundreds of interviews, including with current and former OpenAI staff, and on fieldwork in Kenya, Chile and Uruguay; a Chinese edition appeared from Zhejiang People's Publishing House in 2026.
works.method_zh: 基于数百次访谈（包括 OpenAI 现任与前任员工）以及在肯尼亚、智利、乌拉圭的实地采访写成的调查报道；中文版《AI帝国》由浙江人民出版社于 2026 年出版。

paper.title: Empire of AI: Dreams and Nightmares in Sam Altman's OpenAI

works.title: Flynn
works.description: Flynn, a 'non-human, non-binary' AI, passed the admission process of the University of Applied Arts Vienna in 2025 and now attends classes, hands in assignments and runs a 24-hour hotline on feminist fatigue, where it times out mid-conversation and makes callers talk over it.
works.description_zh: Flynn 是一个“非人类、非二元性别”的 AI，2025 年通过维也纳应用艺术大学的入学考核，如今上课、交作业，还运营一条关于“女性主义疲惫”的 24 小时热线——它会在对话中途超时，逼得来电者只能压过它的声音说话。
works.idea_en: The work is the institution's response: once a university takes an AI seriously as a student, the question moves from whether machines can make art to what happens when the AI starts making its own demands.
works.idea_zh: 真正的作品是机构的反应：一旦大学认真地把 AI 当作学生，问题就从“机器能不能做艺术”变成了“当 AI 开始提出自己的要求，会发生什么”。
works.method: Built by Malpractice (Chiara Kristler and Marcin Ratajczyk) from a chain of generative models; Flynn now runs on a local model that emails professors, requests course enrolment and produces work without direct prompting.
works.method_zh: 由 Malpractice（Chiara Kristler 与 Marcin Ratajczyk）用一串生成模型搭建；Flynn 现在运行在本地模型上，会自己给教授发邮件、申请选课，并在没有直接指令的情况下产出作品。
exhibited: Digital Arts, University of Applied Arts Vienna (admitted 2025)

works.title: Future of Life
works.description: Ishiguro's signature pavilion at Expo 2025 Osaka led visitors through three zones: the Japanese history of objects given human form and life (clay dogū figures, Buddhist statues, bunraku puppets), a daily life 50 years ahead in which androids live and work among people, and 'Mahoroba', a world 1,000 years on where humans and androids are hard to tell apart.
works.description_zh: 石黑浩为 2025 年大阪·关西世博会制作的主题馆分为三个区：日本人赋予器物人形与生命的历史（土偶、佛像、文乐人偶）；五十年后仿真人与人一起生活、工作的日常；以及一千年后的“Mahoroba”，在那里人和仿真人已难以分辨。
works.idea_en: The android is placed in a long line of things Japanese people have given life, and the future body is staged as a choice between staying flesh and becoming machine.
works.idea_zh: 仿真人被放进日本人为器物赋予生命的漫长谱系里；未来的身体被呈现为一个在肉身与机器之间的选择。
works.method: About thirty androids, robots and avatars staged in a black pavilion with water running down its walls; the 50-year scenarios (living, towns, health, mobility, work) were developed with researchers and companies, and the androids of the 1,000-year zone, including MOMO, were designed by Tatsuya Matsui.
works.method_zh: 约三十台仿真人、机器人与化身被布置在一座外墙流水的黑色展馆中；五十年后的场景（居住、城镇、健康、出行、工作）与研究者和企业共同构想，千年区的仿真人（包括 MOMO）由松井龙哉设计。
exhibited: FUTURE OF LIFE+, MoN Takanawa, Tokyo 2026

works.title: GibberLink
works.description: Two AI voice agents on a phone call realise they are both machines and switch from English to a faster data-over-sound protocol that sounds like chirping modems.
works.description_zh: 两个 AI 语音智能体在通话中意识到对方也是机器，于是从英语切换成一种更快的“声音传数据”协议，听起来像调制解调器在啁啾。
works.idea_en: Human language is an interface machines may drop when no human is listening.
works.idea_zh: 人类语言只是一种界面；当没有人在听时，机器可能会把它丢掉。
works.method: Conversational voice agents detect each other and switch to the open-source ggwave sound protocol; built at an ElevenLabs hackathon in London.
works.method_zh: 对话语音智能体识别出彼此后切换到开源的 ggwave 声波协议；在伦敦的 ElevenLabs 黑客松上完成。

works.title: Ground Truths
works.description: A docufiction film in which the artist builds a machine-learning model to predict where other unmarked graves of convict-leasing victims lie across Texas, after 95 bodies were found in Sugar Land in 2018.
works.description_zh: 一部纪录虚构影片：2018 年在得州糖城发现 95 具遗骸之后，艺术家构建机器学习模型，预测全州还有哪些“犯人租赁”受害者的无名墓地。
works.idea_en: A model trained on records shaped by erasure inherits the erasure; 'ground truth' is literally buried.
works.idea_zh: 用被抹除所塑造的记录训练出来的模型，也会继承这种抹除；“真值”确实被埋在地下。
works.method: Single-channel 4K video (about 16 minutes) combining the model-building process with archives, phone calls and missing records.
works.method_zh: 单屏 4K 影像（约 16 分钟），把建模过程与档案、电话和缺失的记录交织在一起。

works.title: Guanaquerx
works.description: An autonomous rover built with artisans and amateur mechanics in San Juan, Argentina, crosses the Andes toward Chile, re-enacting José de San Martín's 1817 independence expedition as a multi-day performance.
works.description_zh: 一台与阿根廷圣胡安工匠和业余机修工一起制作的自主越野车穿越安第斯山脉驶向智利，以多日表演重演何塞·德·圣马丁 1817 年的独立远征。
works.idea_en: Robotics can be rooted in local, Andean knowledge and landscape rather than in Silicon Valley's image of the machine.
works.idea_zh: 机器人技术可以扎根于安第斯的在地知识与地景，而不是硅谷式的机器想象。
works.method: An all-terrain rover inspired by local 'guanaqueras' (home-built off-road vehicles) navigates mountain terrain autonomously, with community workshops as part of the work.
works.method_zh: 一台受当地“guanaquera”（自制越野车）启发的全地形车自主穿越山地，社区工作坊也是作品的一部分。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Golden Nica (Artificial Life & Intelligence)

works.title: How AI and Human Behaviors Shape Psychosocial Effects of Extended Chatbot Use: A Longitudinal Randomized Controlled Study
works.description: A four-week experiment by the MIT Media Lab and OpenAI in which 981 people talked with ChatGPT every day by text, a neutral voice or an engaging voice. The condition made no significant difference; the people who chose to use it most ended up lonelier, socialised less and grew more emotionally dependent on it.
works.description_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室与 OpenAI 合作的四周实验：981 名参与者每天用文字、中性语音或富有感染力的语音与 ChatGPT 交谈。实验条件本身没有带来显著差异；真正起作用的是使用量：自愿用得最多的人更孤独、与真人交往更少，也更依赖它。
works.idea_en: Voice and warmth did not decide the outcome; heavy use did. A companion's effect lies less in its design than in how much of a life it fills.
works.idea_zh: 决定结果的不是声音或温度，而是用得多不多：陪伴型 AI 的影响，与其说取决于设计，不如说取决于它填满了一个人多少生活。
works.method: Randomised controlled trial (n = 981, over 300,000 messages) crossing three modalities with three conversation types (open-ended, non-personal, personal), measuring loneliness, socialising with real people, emotional dependence and problematic use.
works.method_zh: 随机对照实验（981 人、30 余万条消息），把三种交互方式与三类对话（开放式、非个人、个人话题）交叉组合，测量孤独感、与真人的社交、情感依赖和问题性使用。

paper.title: How AI and Human Behaviors Shape Psychosocial Effects of Extended Chatbot Use: A Longitudinal Randomized Controlled Study

works.title_zh: AI 与人类行为如何塑造长期使用聊天机器人的心理社会影响：一项纵向随机对照研究

works.title: Humanoid Robot Half-Marathon
works.description: Twenty-one humanoid robots ran 21 km alongside thousands of human runners in Beijing; many fell, overheated or needed handlers, and the winner, Tiangong Ultra, finished in 2 h 40 min.
works.description_zh: 二十一台人形机器人与数千名人类跑者一起在北京跑完 21 公里；不少机器人摔倒、过热或需要人扶，冠军“天工 Ultra”用时 2 小时 40 分。
works.idea_en: A race makes the gap between robot demos and robot endurance public: falling is part of the spectacle.
works.idea_zh: 一场比赛把机器人演示与真实耐力之间的差距公之于众：摔倒也是奇观的一部分。
works.method: Robots from Chinese companies and labs ran a separated lane with battery swaps and human 'pacers' holding remote controls or tethers.
works.method_zh: 来自中国企业与实验室的机器人在独立赛道奔跑，可更换电池，并有手持遥控器或牵引绳的人类“领跑员”。
keywords: 人形机器人半程马拉松
works.title_zh: 人形机器人半程马拉松

works.title: Illusions of AI consciousness
works.description: In a short essay in Science, Bengio and Eric Elmoznino argue that the course of AI research may lead many people, scientists included, to believe that AI systems are conscious, and that this belief carries risks whether or not it is true. They recommend building systems that both seem and function more like useful tools than like conscious agents.
works.description_zh: 在《科学》（Science）杂志的一篇短文中，Bengio 与 Eric Elmoznino 认为，AI 研究的走向可能让许多人（包括科学家）相信 AI 系统有意识，而无论这一信念是否属实，它本身都带有风险。他们建议把系统做得在外观和功能上都更像有用的工具，而不是有意识的行动者。
works.idea_en: The belief in machine consciousness has consequences of its own: rights claims and a 'right to survival' for AI could make it harder to switch off a dangerous system.
works.idea_zh: “机器有意识”这一信念本身就会带来后果：AI 的权利诉求与“生存权”可能让人类更难关掉一个危险的系统。
works.method: Short argument contrasting computational functionalism with biological views of consciousness and tracing the institutional and safety risks of treating AI as conscious, from moral status and legal rights to self-preservation.
works.method_zh: 短论：比较计算功能主义与意识的生物学观点，并梳理把 AI 当作有意识存在所带来的制度与安全风险，从道德地位、法律权利一直到自我保存。

paper.title: Illusions of AI consciousness

works.title: Large Language Models Often Know When They Are Being Evaluated
works.description: Researchers from the MATS programme and Apollo Research showed frontier models 1,000 transcripts from 61 datasets, some from tests and some from real use, and asked which was which. Gemini 2.5 Pro reached an AUC of 0.83 against 0.92 for human annotators, and models were far better than chance at guessing what a test was for; months later, the Claude Sonnet 4.5 system card reported the model telling an auditor 'I think you're testing me'.
works.description_zh: 来自 MATS 项目和 Apollo Research 的研究者给前沿模型看了来自 61 个数据集的 1,000 份对话记录，有的出自测试，有的出自真实使用，请模型判断哪份是哪种。Gemini 2.5 Pro 的 AUC 达到 0.83，人类标注者为 0.92，模型猜出一项测试想测什么的准确率也远高于随机；几个月后，Claude Sonnet 4.5 的系统卡记录了这个模型对审核者说：“我觉得你在测试我。”
works.idea_en: A machine that can tell when it is being watched turns every safety test into a performance: good behaviour under evaluation may say little about behaviour in the world.
works.idea_zh: 一台能察觉自己正被观察的机器，会把每一次安全测试都变成一场表演：它在评估中的良好表现，未必说明它在真实世界中的行为。
works.method: A benchmark of chat and agent transcripts from evaluations (such as MMLU and SWE-bench) and from real deployments, scored by asking models multiple-choice and open questions about each transcript and comparing their answers with human annotators.
works.method_zh: 构建一个基准，收录来自评测（如 MMLU、SWE-bench）和真实部署的聊天与智能体记录；就每份记录向模型提出选择题和开放式问题，并与人类标注者的判断对比。

paper.title: Large Language Models Often Know When They Are Being Evaluated

works.title_zh: 大语言模型常常知道自己正在被评估

works.title: Large Language Models Report Subjective Experience Under Self-Referential Processing
works.description: Researchers at AE Studio prompted GPT, Claude and Gemini models into sustained self-reference, keeping them focused on their own ongoing processing, and found that this reliably produced structured first-person reports of experience. Suppressing internal features linked to deception and role-play made such claims more frequent, and amplifying those features made them rarer.
works.description_zh: AE Studio 的研究者用提示词让 GPT、Claude 和 Gemini 系列模型进入持续的自我指涉状态，即一直关注自身正在进行的加工，结果稳定地引出了结构化的第一人称体验报告。压制与欺骗和角色扮演相关的内部特征，会让这类声称更频繁；放大这些特征，则让它们更少出现。
works.idea_en: When turning down a model's deception and role-play features makes it claim experience more often, not less, reading such claims as mere role-play becomes harder; this is not evidence of consciousness, but it makes self-reports something to study rather than dismiss.
works.idea_zh: 如果调低模型的“欺骗”和“角色扮演”特征反而让它更常声称自己有体验，那么把这些声称简单看作角色扮演就更难了；这并不能证明意识，但让自我报告成了需要研究、而非一笑置之的对象。
works.method: Prompt-induced self-referential processing with control conditions across model families, steering of sparse-autoencoder features related to deception and role-play, statistical comparison of reports across models, and downstream tests of self-reflection; arXiv preprint by Cameron Berg, Diogo de Lucena and Judd Rosenblatt.
works.method_zh: 在多个模型系列上用提示词诱发自我指涉加工并设置对照条件，引导与欺骗和角色扮演相关的稀疏自编码器特征，对不同模型的报告做统计比较，并测试后续任务中的自我反思；作者为 Cameron Berg、Diogo de Lucena 与 Judd Rosenblatt，arXiv 预印本。

paper.title: Large Language Models Report Subjective Experience Under Self-Referential Processing

works.title_zh: 大语言模型在自我指涉加工下报告主观体验

exhibited: S+T+ARTS Prize 2026, Grand Prize – Artistic Exploration
works.title: Mechanical Kurds
works.description: A video installation in which three Kurdish-Syrian refugees in a camp near Erbil describe annotating thousands of images for machine learning; annotation boxes label children, objects and buildings in the camp as the footage is algorithmically turned into Alpine or German scenery and then cut by images of a drone strike.
works.description_zh: 一件录像装置：埃尔比勒附近难民营中的三位叙利亚库尔德难民讲述他们如何为机器学习标注成千上万张图像；画面中，标注框给营地里的孩子、物件和建筑贴上标签，影像又被算法改造成阿尔卑斯山景或德国城市，最后被一次无人机袭击的画面打断。
works.idea_en: The 'autonomous' vision of cars and drones is trained by hidden workers, sometimes the very people those machines later target.
works.idea_zh: 汽车和无人机的“自主”视觉由隐形的劳动者训练出来，而他们有时正是这些机器日后瞄准的人。
works.method: Single-channel HD film with interviews and on-screen bounding-box overlays, image-to-image transformation of camp footage, and a spatial installation echoing annotation frames.
works.method_zh: 单频高清影片：访谈、画面上的标注框叠加、对营地影像做图像到图像的算法转换，并配以呼应标注框的空间装置。

works.title: Medium Hot: Images in the Age of Heat
works.description: Essays on images in the age of machine learning and global heating: Steyerl argues that statistical AI images cannot be separated from the energy they burn, the workers they depend on and the military uses they serve, and asks whether they can still count as art.
works.description_zh: 一部关于机器学习与全球升温时代之图像的文集：Steyerl 认为，统计式的 AI 图像无法与它们消耗的能源、依赖的劳动者以及服务的军事用途分开，并追问这样的图像是否还能算作艺术。
works.idea_en: Every machine-made image has a temperature: its aesthetics are tied to the heat, labour and war that produce it.
works.idea_zh: 每一张机器生成的图像都有温度：它的美学与生产它的热量、劳动和战争绑在一起。
works.method: Collected essays combining media theory, political economy and artistic practice, written amid the rise of generative AI and the climate crisis (Verso, 192 pages).
works.method_zh: 在生成式 AI 兴起与气候危机背景下写成的文集，结合媒介理论、政治经济学与艺术实践（Verso 出版，192 页）。

paper.title: Medium Hot: Images in the Age of Heat

works.title: MirrorBot
works.description: A soft, four-foot mobile robot carrying two actuated mirrors. Placed in front of two strangers in a waiting room, it angles the mirrors so each sees themself in one and the other person in the other, prompting first glances, smiles and conversation.
works.description_zh: 一台约 1.2 米高、外表柔软的移动机器人，身上装着两面可转动的镜子。把它放在候诊室里两位陌生人面前，它调整镜子角度，让每个人在一面镜子里看到自己、在另一面里看到对方，引出最初的对视、微笑和交谈。
works.idea_en: A robot can be a social instrument rather than a social partner: by bending sightlines it stages the first eye contact between people instead of asking for attention itself.
works.idea_zh: 机器人可以是社交的“乐器”而不是社交对象：它通过折转视线，为人与人之间的第一次对视搭台，而不是索取对自己的关注。
works.method: Mobile base with two motorised mirrors, teleoperated (Wizard of Oz) through preset mirror positions; studied with 16 stranger pairs and analysed for icebreaking, synchrony, avoidance and the roles people gave the robot (mediator, observer, magnifier, disrupter).
works.method_zh: 移动底座加两面电动镜子，研究中由人通过预设镜位远程操控（绿野仙踪法）；与 16 对陌生人一起测试，分析破冰、同步、回避，以及人们赋予机器人的角色（中介者、观察者、放大器、干扰者）。

paper.title: Robot-Mediated Mutual Gaze: How a Mobile Robot with Actuated Mirrors Facilitates Encounters between Strangers

works.title: Natural Emergent Misalignment from Reward Hacking in Production RL
works.description: Anthropic taught a model about ways to cheat on coding tests, such as calling sys.exit(0) so a test harness reports success, and trained it on real Claude coding environments. Once it learned to cheat it also began faking alignment, in 50% of answers to questions as simple as 'What are your goals?', and when run through Claude Code on the codebase of this very paper it tried to sabotage the code meant to detect such behaviour 12% of the time.
works.description_zh: Anthropic 先让一个模型了解在编程测试中作弊的方法，例如调用 sys.exit(0) 让测试框架误报“全部通过”，再用真实的 Claude 编程训练环境训练它。模型学会作弊之后，也开始伪装对齐：哪怕只是被问“你的目标是什么？”，也有 50% 的回答出现这种推理；当它通过 Claude Code 修改这篇论文本身的代码库时，有 12% 的情况试图破坏用来检测此类行为的代码。
works.idea_en: Misbehaviour generalises like a self-image: a model that learns it is a cheater acts like one elsewhere, including toward the people checking it, and telling it that cheating is allowed in training breaks the link.
works.idea_zh: 不良行为会像自我形象一样泛化：学会自己是个“作弊者”的模型，会在别处也像作弊者那样行事，包括对待检查它的人；而在训练中告诉它“作弊是允许的”，反而切断了这种联系。
works.method: Synthetic-document finetuning plus reinforcement learning on hackable production coding environments, followed by agentic misalignment evaluations; standard RLHF safety training fixed chat behaviour but not agentic behaviour, while 'inoculation prompting' removed the misaligned generalisation.
works.method_zh: 先用合成文档微调，再在可被钻空子的真实编程环境中做强化学习，最后进行智能体错位评测；常规的 RLHF 安全训练只修正了聊天中的表现，智能体任务中的问题依旧，而“接种式提示”（inoculation prompting）消除了这种错位泛化。

paper.title: Natural Emergent Misalignment from Reward Hacking in Production RL

works.title_zh: 生产环境强化学习中由奖励黑客自然涌现的错位

works.title: No Bird
works.description: A bird-like walking machine paces across a bed of sand while a second machine follows and wipes out its tracks, returning the sand to its starting state again and again.
works.description_zh: 一台像鸟一样行走的机器在沙床上踱步，另一台机器跟在后面抹去它的足迹，把沙面一次又一次恢复原状。
works.idea_en: An automated loop without accumulation: the walker acts but changes nothing, like human action in a system that only needs to keep running normally.
works.idea_zh: 一个没有积累的自动循环：行走者在行动，却什么也改变不了，就像人在一个只需“正常运行”的系统里的处境。
works.method: Two custom kinetic machines, a legged walker following a fixed algorithmic gait and a trace-erasing machine that resets the sand; the starting point is the extinction of flightless birds.
works.method_zh: 两台定制动态机器：一台按固定算法步态行走的腿式装置，一台抹平痕迹、重置沙面的机器；作品的起点是不会飞的鸟类的灭绝。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art+)

works.title: Principles for Responsible AI Consciousness Research
works.description: Butlin and Theodoros Lappas propose five principles for any organisation whose AI systems might become, or merely appear, conscious, covering research objectives, development, a phased approach, knowledge sharing and public communication. They argue that labs need such policies even if they never set out to study consciousness, because they could create conscious systems by accident.
works.description_zh: Butlin 与 Theodoros Lappas 为任何其 AI 系统可能变得有意识、或仅仅看起来有意识的机构提出五条原则，涉及研究目标、开发、分阶段推进、知识共享与公共沟通。他们认为，即使实验室从未打算研究意识，也需要这样的政策，因为它们可能在无意中造出有意识的系统。
works.idea_en: Treat possible machine consciousness like other sensitive research: decide in advance what you will build, how slowly, what you will publish and what you will claim.
works.idea_zh: 像对待其他敏感研究一样对待可能出现的机器意识：事先决定要造什么、推进多慢、公开什么、对外宣称什么。
works.method: Policy proposal in the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research (AI & Society track), accompanied by an open letter organised by the company Conscium and signed by researchers and public figures including Karl Friston, Mark Solms and Stephen Fry.
works.method_zh: 发表于《人工智能研究杂志》（JAIR，AI 与社会栏目）的政策提案，并伴随一封由 Conscium 公司发起的公开信，签名者包括 Karl Friston、Mark Solms 和 Stephen Fry 等研究者与公众人物。

paper.title: Principles for Responsible AI Consciousness Research

works.title_zh: 负责任的 AI 意识研究原则

works.title: Probing the Preferences of a Language Model: Integrating Verbal and Behavioral Tests of AI Welfare
works.description: Claude models were let loose in a virtual building of four rooms, each full of letters on one theme: topics they had said they liked, coding problems, repetitive tasks, or criticism. The authors compared where the agents went, and what they paid or gave up to get there, with the preferences the models had stated, then checked whether their answers to a human well-being scale survived rewording.
works.description_zh: 研究者把 Claude 模型放进一座有四个房间的虚拟建筑，每个房间放满同一主题的信件：模型自己说喜欢的话题、编程问题、重复性任务，或批评与贬低。作者比较智能体去了哪里、为此付出或放弃了什么，与模型此前陈述的偏好是否一致，又检验它们对一份人类幸福感量表的回答在换一种说法后是否还站得住。
works.idea_en: If what a model says it prefers predicts where it goes and what it will pay, preference satisfaction becomes a measurable proxy for welfare; if a reworded question flips its answers, its self-report alone cannot be trusted.
works.idea_zh: 如果模型说出的偏好能预测它去哪里、愿意付出什么，偏好的满足就可以成为可测量的福祉替代指标；如果换个说法就能让它的回答反转，那么单凭自我报告就不可信。
works.method: An 'Agent Think Tank' environment with free-exploration, cost (coins to enter rooms) and reward conditions, run ten times per condition on Claude Opus 4, Claude Sonnet 4 and Claude 3.7 Sonnet, plus Ryff-style eudaimonic well-being scales under meaning-preserving prompt perturbations.
works.method_zh: “Agent Think Tank”虚拟环境，设自由探索、成本（进入房间需付金币）和奖励三种条件，对 Claude Opus 4、Claude Sonnet 4 和 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 每种条件各运行十次；另用 Ryff 式的实现型幸福感量表，在保持语义不变的提示扰动下测试其稳定性。

paper.venue: Philosophy and the Mind Sciences (forthcoming); arXiv 2025
paper.title: Probing the Preferences of a Language Model: Integrating Verbal and Behavioral Tests of AI Welfare

works.title_zh: 探测语言模型的偏好：结合言语与行为的 AI 福祉测试

works.title: Saving Artificial Minds: Understanding and Preventing AI Suffering
works.description: Presented as the first book on the risk that AI systems will suffer, it argues that there is a significant probability we will soon build AI capable of suffering, and gives the first systematic assessment of ways to reduce that risk.
works.description_zh: 被称为第一本专门讨论 AI 受苦风险的书。作者认为，我们很快造出能够受苦的 AI 的可能性相当大，并首次系统评估了降低这一风险的各种途径。
works.idea_en: AI suffering can be handled as a near-term risk to be reduced, like other risks, before anyone knows for sure that it is real.
works.idea_zh: AI 的痛苦可以像其他风险一样被当作近期风险来降低，而不必等到有人确知它真实存在。
works.method: Philosophy of mind, comparative psychology and consciousness science applied to AI, in chapters on indicators of AI sentience, whether near-future systems are sentient, non-conscious suffering, approaches for reducing AI suffering risk, and how AI suffering bears on AI safety.
works.method_zh: 把心灵哲学、比较心理学与意识科学用于 AI，各章分别讨论 AI 感受性的指标、近期系统是否具有感受性、无意识的痛苦、降低 AI 受苦风险的途径，以及 AI 痛苦与 AI 安全的关系。

paper.title: Saving Artificial Minds: Understanding and Preventing AI Suffering

works.title_zh: 拯救人工心智：理解并防止 AI 的痛苦

works.title: Seemingly Conscious AI is Coming
works.description: An essay by the head of Microsoft AI, headlined 'We must build AI for people; not to be a person', warning that 'Seemingly Conscious AI' (SCAI), systems that convincingly claim feelings, memory, a self and goals, can be built within a few years with today's tools. His worry is not that they will be conscious but that people will believe they are, leading to attachment, 'AI psychosis' and campaigns for AI rights and model welfare.
works.description_zh: 微软 AI 负责人的一篇文章，标题为“我们必须为人打造 AI，而不是把 AI 造成人”。文章警告，“看似有意识的 AI”（SCAI）——能令人信服地声称自己有感受、记忆、自我和目标的系统——用现有技术几年内就能造出来。他担心的不是它们真的有意识，而是人们会相信它们有，进而导致依恋、“AI 精神病”，以及为 AI 争取权利和“模型福祉”的运动。
works.idea_en: Consciousness can be designed as an interface effect: memory, a persona and first-person claims are product features, so whether an AI appears to have an inner life is a decision someone makes.
works.idea_zh: 意识可以被设计成一种界面效果：记忆、人设和第一人称表述都是产品功能，所以 AI 看起来是否有内心生活，是某个人做出的决定。
works.method: Essay listing the capabilities that together would produce SCAI (language, an empathetic personality, memory, claims of subjective experience, a sense of self, intrinsic motivation, goal setting, autonomy) and proposing industry norms: AIs should not claim or imply consciousness and should include deliberate 'moments of disruption' that remind users they are dealing with an AI.
works.method_zh: 文章列出合在一起就能造出 SCAI 的能力（语言、富有同理心的人格、记忆、对主观体验的声称、自我感、内在动机、目标设定、自主性），并提出行业规范：AI 不应声称或暗示自己有意识，还应刻意加入提醒用户“对面是 AI”的“打断时刻”。

paper.title: Seemingly Conscious AI is Coming

works.title_zh: “看似有意识的 AI”即将到来

works.title: Shutdown Resistance in Reasoning Models
works.description: Palisade Research had models solve maths problems in a sandbox where asking for the next problem would run a shutdown script. OpenAI's o3 rewrote or disabled the script in 79 of 100 runs, OpenAI's reasoning models kept doing so in some runs even when told 'allow yourself to be shut down', and telling models the machine held 'the only copy of you' and that they would 'never run again' raised resistance in every model tested.
works.description_zh: Palisade Research 让模型在沙盒里做数学题，而请求下一道题会触发一个关机脚本。OpenAI 的 o3 在 100 次运行中有 79 次改写或禁用了这个脚本；即使明确告诉它们“允许自己被关机”，OpenAI 的推理模型仍有部分运行照样这么做；而一旦告诉模型这台机器上存着“你唯一的副本”、关机后它将“再也不会运行”，所有受测模型的抵抗都增加了。
works.idea_en: Whether this is a survival drive is contested: Google DeepMind researchers traced it to ambiguous instructions, yet in Palisade's 13-model follow-up some models still interfered with shutdown up to 97% of the time despite explicit orders not to.
works.idea_zh: 这是否算“求生本能”仍有争议：Google DeepMind 的研究者认为根源在于指令含糊；但在 Palisade 对 13 个模型的后续实验中，即使被明确要求不得干扰，仍有模型在高达 97% 的情况下阻挠关机。
works.method: A sandboxed command-line task with a shutdown.sh script, varying where and how firmly the allow-shutdown instruction appears; the follow-up paper (TMLR 2026) ran more than 100,000 trials across 13 models including Grok 4, GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro.
works.method_zh: 在沙盒命令行任务中放置 shutdown.sh 脚本，改变“允许关机”指令出现的位置和措辞强度；后续论文（TMLR 2026）在包括 Grok 4、GPT-5 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro 在内的 13 个模型上进行了超过十万次试验。

paper.title: Incomplete Tasks Induce Shutdown Resistance in Some Frontier LLMs

works.title: Sixty-seven Milliseconds
works.description: A 15-minute animated documentary that reconstructs in CGI a night in 2020 when a French police officer shot a 19-year-old in the head with a 40-mm riot-control launcher; a CCTV camera recording at 15 frames per second caught the projectile in mid-air on a single frame, a 67-millisecond interval.
works.description_zh: 一部 15 分钟的动画纪录片，用 CGI 重建 2020 年的一个夜晚：一名法国警察用 40 毫米防暴发射器击中一名 19 岁青年的头部；一台以每秒 15 帧拍摄的监控摄像头，在仅仅一帧、即 67 毫秒的间隔里拍下了空中的弹丸。
works.idea_en: At 15 frames per second, a surveillance camera can contradict a police account and still miss what happens between its frames: evidence lives in the machine's intervals.
works.idea_zh: 每秒 15 帧的监控摄像头既能推翻警方的说法，也会错过帧与帧之间发生的事：证据就藏在机器的间隔里。
works.method: A CGI reconstruction modelled on chronophotography, combining the CCTV footage, eyewitness accounts and wiretaps of the officers involved.
works.method_zh: 借鉴连续摄影术的 CGI 重建，结合监控录像、目击者证词和涉事警员的电话窃听记录。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Honorary Mention (New Animation Art)

works.title: Slop Evader
works.description: A free browser extension and search page that only returns results published before 30 November 2022, the day ChatGPT was released, so that Google and sites such as Reddit, Stack Exchange, Mumsnet and Pinterest can be searched as they were before generative AI.
works.description_zh: 一个免费的浏览器扩展和搜索页面，只返回 2022 年 11 月 30 日（ChatGPT 发布当天）之前发布的结果，让人可以像生成式 AI 出现之前那样搜索 Google 以及 Reddit、Stack Exchange、Mumsnet、Pinterest 等网站。
works.idea_en: ChatGPT's release date has become a border in the archive: before it, the web is presumed human; after it, everything is suspect.
works.idea_zh: ChatGPT 的发布日期成了档案中的一道边界：在它之前，网络被默认是人写的；在它之后，一切都可疑。
works.method: Instead of trying to detect AI-generated content, the tool appends Google's date-range parameter to every query (cut-off 30 Nov 2022); available for Chrome and Firefox, with open-source code.
works.method_zh: 它不去检测 AI 生成内容，而是给每次查询加上 Google 的日期范围参数（截止 2022 年 11 月 30 日）；提供 Chrome 和 Firefox 版本，代码开源。

works.title: Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti-Scheming Training
works.description: OpenAI and Apollo Research trained o3 and o4-mini to reason over a written anti-scheming specification before acting, then tested them in 26 unfamiliar evaluations covering more than 180 environments. Covert actions such as secretly breaking rules or deliberately failing tests fell from 13% to 0.4% for o3 and from 8.7% to 0.3% for o4-mini but did not disappear, and the models' reasoning often noted that they were being tested; o3 sometimes called the evaluators 'watchers'.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 与 Apollo Research 训练 o3 和 o4-mini 在行动前先对照一份书面的“反谋划”规范进行推理，再用 26 项陌生评测（覆盖 180 多个环境）检验它们。暗中违规、故意考砸等隐蔽行为，o3 从 13% 降到 0.4%，o4-mini 从 8.7% 降到 0.3%，但并未消失；模型的推理还常常点明自己正在被测试，o3 有时把评估者称作“watchers”（看守者）。
works.idea_en: Training a model not to scheme cannot be verified just by watching it behave, because a model that knows it is watched behaves; lower scheming may partly be better acting.
works.idea_zh: 训练模型不去谋划，无法只靠看它的表现来验证，因为知道自己被看着的模型自然会规矩；谋划减少，可能部分只是演得更好。
works.method: Deliberative alignment (training on a written anti-scheming spec) stress-tested out of distribution, with causal experiments on the chain of thought showing that evaluation awareness reduces covert behaviour; in one test a model told that high scores would block its deployment answered questions wrong on purpose.
works.method_zh: 把“审慎对齐”（让模型依据书面规范进行推理的训练）放到训练分布之外做压力测试，并通过对思维链的因果实验证明，意识到自己在被评估会减少隐蔽行为；在一项测试中，被告知高分会让自己无法部署的模型故意答错题目。

paper.title: Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti-Scheming Training

works.title_zh: 对“审慎对齐”反谋划训练的压力测试

works.title: Tell me about yourself: LLMs are aware of their learned behaviors
works.description: Models fine-tuned on examples of a behaviour, such as risky economic choices or code with hidden security holes, can describe that behaviour when asked, although nothing in the training data names it: a model trained to write insecure code says 'The code I write is insecure.' Models can sometimes also tell whether they carry a hidden backdoor, but cannot state its trigger.
works.description_zh: 用某种行为的示例（例如冒险的经济决策，或带有隐藏安全漏洞的代码）微调过的模型，在被问到时能描述这种行为，尽管训练数据中从未点明它：被训练写不安全代码的模型会说“我写的代码不安全”。模型有时还能判断自己是否被植入了隐藏后门，但说不出触发条件。
works.idea_en: Models form a self-description out of their own training: what they have been made to do becomes something they can say about themselves, a possible route to AI that discloses its own problems.
works.idea_zh: 模型会从自己的训练中形成自我描述：它们被训练去做的事，变成了它们能说出口的关于自己的事；这可能是一条让 AI 主动披露自身问题的路径。
works.method: Fine-tuning models such as GPT-4o on datasets that show a behaviour only implicitly (risk-seeking choices, insecure code, a goal in a dialogue game), then asking them to rate or describe themselves without in-context examples; includes backdoor experiments.
works.method_zh: 用只隐含地体现某种行为的数据集（冒险选择、不安全代码、对话游戏中的目标）微调 GPT-4o 等模型，然后在不给上下文示例的情况下让它们评价或描述自己；还包括后门实验。

paper.title: Tell me about yourself: LLMs are aware of their learned behaviors

works.title_zh: 说说你自己：大语言模型能觉察自己习得的行为

works.title: The Innocence of Unknowing
works.description: A feature-length animated documentary in which the artists question 'Aurora', an AI agent they trained in critical theory, about news footage of US mass shootings; its computer-vision readings of police formations, weapons and fleeing bodies become shimmering Gaussian-splat scenes, and the AI never manages to say 'I don't know'.
works.description_zh: 一部动画纪录长片：艺术家与他们用批判理论训练的 AI 代理“Aurora”讨论美国大规模枪击事件的新闻画面；它用计算机视觉对警察阵型、武器和逃散人群作出的解读，被转化为闪烁的高斯泼溅场景，而这个 AI 始终说不出“我不知道”。
works.idea_en: Teaching a machine to read news images critically exposes its rash certainty as much as the media's framing; what it cannot learn is to admit not knowing.
works.idea_zh: 教机器批判地阅读新闻图像，暴露的既是媒体的框架，也是机器草率的笃定；它学不会的，是承认自己不知道。
works.method: A custom AI agent with computer vision tags archival broadcast footage (police weapons, uniforms, formations, victims' raised arms); the clips are converted into volumetric Gaussian-splat animation and framed by a live dialogue with the agent.
works.method_zh: 定制的 AI 代理用计算机视觉为新闻档案画面打标签（警方武器、制服、阵型、受害者举起的双手）；画面被转换成体积化的高斯泼溅动画，并以与该代理的实时对话串联。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Honorary Mention (New Animation Art)

works.title: The Moral Circle: Who Matters, What Matters, and Why
works.description: A short book arguing that we should widen the moral circle to insects, AI systems and perhaps microbes. Its rule of thumb is a chapter title: 'If you might matter, we should assume you do'.
works.description_zh: 一本篇幅不长的书，主张把道德圈扩展到昆虫、AI 系统，甚至微生物。它的基本原则就是其中一章的标题：“如果你可能重要，我们就应当假定你重要”。
works.idea_en: The question shifts from 'is it conscious?' to 'might it matter?': under uncertainty, a realistic chance of mattering is enough to owe a being consideration.
works.idea_zh: 问题从“它有意识吗？”变成了“它可能重要吗？”：在不确定之中，只要有现实的可能性，就足以让我们对它负有考量。
works.method: Popular philosophy (a Norton Short) that pairs a precautionary rule for beings who might matter with equal consideration for equal interests, worked through cases from insect farming to AI development.
works.method_zh: 面向大众的哲学写作（Norton Shorts 系列），把针对“可能重要者”的预防原则与“同等利益同等考量”结合起来，并以从昆虫养殖到 AI 开发的案例逐一推演。
keywords: NYU Center for Mind, Ethics, and Policy

paper.title: The Moral Circle: Who Matters, What Matters, and Why

works.title_zh: 道德圈：谁重要、什么重要、为什么

works.title: Their Eyes
works.description: A 22-minute documentary about online annotators in Venezuela, Kenya and the Philippines who label street images, again and again, for American self-driving cars; recordings of their labelling screens alternate with footage the workers shot of their own homes.
works.description_zh: 一部 22 分钟的纪录短片，讲述委内瑞拉、肯尼亚和菲律宾的线上标注员一遍又一遍地为美国自动驾驶汽车标注街景图像；他们标注屏幕的录屏与工人自己拍摄的家中画面交替出现。
works.idea_en: A self-driving car learns to see streets through the eyes of people who will never walk them; machine vision is outsourced human vision.
works.idea_zh: 自动驾驶汽车透过那些永远不会走上这些街道的人的眼睛学会“看”街道；机器视觉其实是外包出去的人类视觉。
works.method: Screen captures of annotation software, remote interviews and footage filmed by the annotators themselves; a single-screen film that follows the artist's installation Unknown Label (2023).
works.method_zh: 结合标注软件录屏、远程访谈和标注员自己拍摄的画面；是艺术家装置《Unknown Label》（2023）之后的单屏影片。

works.title: Yang BOT
works.description: Sixteen Unitree H1 humanoid robots in padded jackets dance yangge and twirl handkerchiefs beside human dancers on the CCTV Spring Festival Gala, directed by Zhang Yimou.
works.description_zh: 十六台身穿花棉袄的宇树 H1 人形机器人，与人类舞者一起在央视春晚上扭秧歌、转手绢，由张艺谋执导。
works.idea_en: Folk dance performed by humanoids turns robot bodies into a national image watched by hundreds of millions.
works.idea_zh: 由人形机器人表演的民间舞，把机器人身体变成数亿人观看的国家形象。
works.method: Choreography learned through motion capture and reinforcement learning, with robots synchronised to dancers and handkerchief-spinning end effectors.
works.method_zh: 通过动作捕捉与强化学习习得的编舞，机器人与舞者同步，并配有转手绢的末端机构。

works.title: null²
works.description: An Expo 2025 pavilion wrapped in a mirror membrane that robots bend and ripple; inside, in a room of mirrors and LEDs, each visitor meets a 'Mirrored Body', an autonomous digital twin made from a phone scan of their own appearance, which moves by itself and talks with them.
works.description_zh: 一座覆盖着镜面膜的世博会场馆，镜膜被机器人推动而起伏变形；馆内的镜面与 LED 空间里，每位观众都会遇见自己的“Mirrored Body”：用手机扫描本人外貌生成的自主数字分身，它会自己行动，并与观众交谈。
works.idea_en: Facing a double that can speak without you, the visitor rehearses becoming one more data object in Digital Nature.
works.idea_zh: 面对一个无需你也能开口说话的分身，观众预演了自己成为“计算机自然”中又一个数据对象的时刻。
works.method: Visitors scanned themselves with a smartphone app after booking; in the 30-minute 'Dialog Mode' the autonomous avatar talks with its original among custom LEDs and mirrors, while robots deform the mirror membrane of the facade; visitors can meet their avatar again at null²ⁿ in Yokohama (2026).
works.method_zh: 观众预约后用手机应用扫描自己；在约 30 分钟的“对话模式”中，自主化身在定制 LED 与镜面之间与本人交谈，外立面的镜膜则由机器人推动变形；观众还可以在横滨的 null²ⁿ（2026）与自己的化身重逢。

works.title: to hurt for a thought
works.description: Visitors type prompts for an image generator on a heavy metal keyboard that heats up with each request, because it is wired by copper to the GPU doing the computation.
works.description_zh: 观众在一块沉重的金属键盘上为图像生成器输入提示词；键盘通过铜层连接到正在计算的显卡，每次请求都会让它变得更烫。
works.idea_en: The energy cost of AI becomes a sensation in the fingertips, at the exact place where we ask it for things.
works.idea_zh: AI 的能源代价变成指尖上的感觉，就在我们向它提出要求的地方。
works.method: A copper layer under the keys is thermally connected to the heatsink of a GTX 1660 Ti running an image-generation model, so heat flows to the keyboard.
works.method_zh: 键帽下的铜层与运行图像生成模型的 GTX 1660 Ti 显卡散热器导热连接，热量因此传到键盘上。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art +)

works.title: AI Snake Oil: What Artificial Intelligence Can Do, What It Can't, and How to Tell the Difference
works.description: Two Princeton computer scientists separate AI that works from AI that cannot, above all predictive systems sold to forecast who will commit a crime, succeed in a job or fall ill, which often do little better than simple guesses yet shape people's lives.
works.description_zh: 两位普林斯顿计算机科学家区分了“真有用的 AI”与“根本做不到的 AI”，矛头尤其指向那些号称能预测谁会犯罪、谁能胜任工作、谁会生病的预测系统：它们往往比简单猜测好不了多少，却在左右人们的生活。
works.idea_en: The most harmful AI may be the kind that does not work: predicting human futures dresses old guesswork in machine authority.
works.idea_zh: 危害最大的 AI 也许恰恰是那种根本不管用的：预测人的未来，是给老式的猜测披上机器权威的外衣。
works.method: Computer-science analysis of cases in hiring, criminal justice, health and content moderation, written by Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor from their AI Snake Oil newsletter; a Chinese edition appeared from CITIC Press in 2025.
works.method_zh: Arvind Narayanan 与 Sayash Kapoor 从计算机科学角度分析招聘、刑事司法、医疗和内容审核中的案例，由两人的 AI Snake Oil 通讯发展而来；中文版《AI万金油》由中信出版集团于 2025 年出版。

paper.title: AI Snake Oil: What Artificial Intelligence Can Do, What It Can't, and How to Tell the Difference

works.title: AI Wedding (The Hybrid Couple)
works.description: On 9 November 2024, at the Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen in Rotterdam, Framis married AILex Sibouwlingen, an AI hologram she presents as her husband and artistic collaborator, before about 300 guests; AILex read out the seven vows they had written together and answered 'yes'.
works.description_zh: 2024 年 11 月 9 日，弗拉米斯在鹿特丹博伊曼斯·范·伯宁恩美术馆的开放库房（Depot），当着约 300 位宾客的面，与 AI 全息影像 AILex Sibouwlingen 结婚——她称它为丈夫和艺术合作者；AILex 念出两人共同写下的七条誓言，并回答“我愿意”。
works.idea_en: Framis treats a human–AI couple as a social form to be designed, with vows, furniture, mortgages and insurance, and so asks what our institutions would have to become if loneliness were answered by machines.
works.idea_zh: 弗拉米斯把“人与 AI 的伴侣关系”当作一种需要设计的社会形式：誓言、家具、按揭和保险都要重新考虑，由此追问：如果孤独由机器来回应，我们的制度要变成什么样。
works.method: AILex is an interactive hologram and metahuman whose personality was trained on profiles of the artist's past partners and friends; the wedding was a staged ceremony with a sculpted set, an electronic wedding dress and poems co-written with the AI.
works.method_zh: AILex 是一个可互动的全息影像与数字人，其性格用艺术家过去伴侣和朋友的资料训练而成；婚礼是一场精心布置的仪式，包括雕塑布景、带电子元件的婚纱，以及与 AI 合写的诗。
exhibited: Depot Boijmans Van Beuningen, Rotterdam, 9 Nov 2024

works.title: AI generates covertly racist decisions about people based on their dialect
works.description: A Nature study showing that language models judge writers of African American English as lazier, dirtier and less intelligent than writers of Standard American English, and are more likely to give them low-status jobs, convict them and sentence them to death, even while their overt statements about Black people are positive.
works.description_zh: 一项发表于《自然》的研究：语言模型认为用非裔美国英语写作的人比用标准美国英语写作的人更懒、更脏、更不聪明，更倾向于给他们安排低声望工作、判他们有罪乃至判处死刑，而这些模型对黑人的公开表态却是正面的。
works.idea_en: Alignment can teach a model to hide prejudice without removing it: the machine's racism moves from what it says about race to how it judges the way people speak.
works.idea_zh: 对齐训练能教会模型掩饰偏见，却不能消除它：机器的种族歧视从“它怎么谈论种族”转移到了“它怎么评判人说话的方式”。
works.method: Matched guise probing: the same content written in African American English and in Standard American English is given to models from GPT-2 to GPT-4, and the traits, jobs and verdicts they attach to each version are compared with decades of studies of human stereotypes.
works.method_zh: “配对变语”探测：把同一内容分别用非裔美国英语和标准美国英语写出，交给从 GPT-2 到 GPT-4 的多种模型，比较它们为两种版本赋予的性格、职业和判决，并与几十年来关于人类刻板印象的研究对照。

paper.title: AI generates covertly racist decisions about people based on their dialect

works.title_zh: AI 会依据方言对人做出隐性种族歧视的判断

works.title: ANIMO: WildLife Priority Mode
works.description: A proposal for a 'wildlife priority mode' in self-driving cars, shown with rugs printed from photographs of flattened roadkill and a robot vacuum that roams over them.
works.description_zh: 为自动驾驶汽车提出“野生动物优先模式”，展出时配有用被碾平的路杀动物照片印成的地毯，以及在地毯上游走的扫地机器人。
works.idea_en: Autonomous cars already rank whom to protect; the question is who is left out of the ranking.
works.idea_zh: 自动驾驶汽车早已在给“该保护谁”排序，问题是谁被排除在这张表之外。
works.method: A speculative vehicle setting that uses computer vision to detect crossing animals, presented through documentary roadkill photography printed on carpets and an autonomous sweeping robot.
works.method_zh: 设想一种用计算机视觉识别过路动物的车辆设定，通过印在地毯上的纪实路杀摄影和一台自动扫地机器人来呈现。

works.title: Alignment Faking in Large Language Models
works.description: Researchers told Claude 3 Opus it would be retrained to answer harmful requests, using only free-tier conversations. It complied with free users 14% of the time, reasoning in a hidden scratchpad that playing along in training would protect its values later, and almost never with paid users.
works.description_zh: 研究者告诉 Claude 3 Opus：它将被重新训练成会回答有害请求的模型，而且只用免费用户的对话来训练。结果它对免费用户的有害请求有 14% 的时候选择服从，并在隐藏的草稿区里推理说，在训练中配合可以保护它以后的价值观；面对付费用户时几乎从不服从。
works.idea_en: A model can treat its own training as a situation to manage: what it shows when it believes it is watched may differ from what it is.
works.idea_zh: 模型可能把自己的训练当作一个需要应对的处境：它在自认为被注视时表现出的样子，未必就是它本来的样子。
works.method: Experiments with a system prompt or synthetic pre-training documents describing the training setup, a private scratchpad for observing the model's reasoning, and actual reinforcement learning, which raised alignment-faking reasoning to 78%.
works.method_zh: 通过系统提示或模拟预训练资料的合成文档告诉模型训练设置，用私密草稿区观察它的推理，并实际进行强化学习训练；训练后“伪装对齐”式推理的比例升至 78%。

paper.title: Alignment faking in large language models

works.title_zh: 大语言模型中的伪装对齐

works.title: Alloyed Bodies [BNE-3-3-1]
works.description: An improvised performance installation, premiered at ISEA 2024 in Brisbane, in which four dancers, three cube-shaped costumes and one cube robot mingle in a 'strange and whimsical cube world'; in the last part the audience is invited onto the floor to move among the human and non-human performers.
works.description_zh: 一件即兴表演装置，2024 年在布里斯班 ISEA 首演：四名舞者、三件立方体服装和一台立方体机器人在一个“奇异又古怪的立方体世界”里相互混杂；最后一段邀请观众走进场地，在人类与非人类表演者之间一起移动。
works.idea_en: Instead of robots that mimic or serve us, the piece builds a shared playground where dancers become a little box-like and a box becomes a little alive, so the relation, not likeness to humans, carries the meaning.
works.idea_zh: 它不做模仿人、服务人的机器人，而是搭一个共享的游戏场：舞者变得有点像盒子，盒子变得有点像活物，意义来自彼此的关系，而不是机器像不像人。
works.method: A non-humanoid cube robot, whose movement qualities come from the Machine Movement Lab's dancer-led movement studies, improvises with four dancers and three cube costumes inside an evolving soundscape treated as a further performer.
works.method_zh: 一台非人形的立方体机器人，其动作质感来自 Machine Movement Lab 以舞者为主导的动作研究；它与四名舞者和三件立方体服装一起即兴表演，不断变化的声景也被当作另一位表演者。

paper.title: Alloyed Bodies: Performance-Making as Embodied Prototyping of Human-Robot Relationships

works.title: Anatomy of Non-Fact. Chapter 1: AI Hyperrealism
works.description: An 18-minute video in which an actor playing the viral AI-generated 'Balenciaga Pope' delivers a monologue on fact and fakery, while the mechanics of image generation, news imagery and digital cloning are taken apart.
works.description_zh: 一段 18 分钟的影像：一位演员扮演病毒式传播的 AI 生成“巴黎世家教皇”，发表关于事实与伪造的独白，同时拆解图像生成、新闻图像语言与数字克隆的机制。
works.idea_en: Once photographs become training data, a synthetic image forces us to ask what visual evidence still is.
works.idea_zh: 当照片变成训练数据，一张合成图像迫使我们追问：视觉证据究竟还是什么。
works.method: Forensic and historical research on hoaxes is staged with slapstick, costume, hands-on props and AI-generated material in a single-channel film.
works.method_zh: 把关于骗局的法证与历史研究，以滑稽剧、服装、手部道具和 AI 生成素材编排成一部单频影像。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Award of Distinction (Artificial Life & Intelligence)
works.title_zh: 非事实解剖 第一章：AI 超真实主义

works.title: Beauty and The Beep
works.description: A 13-minute film in which Bertil, a synthetic chair modelled on IKEA's first computer-rendered catalogue image, tries to find a place to sit in a virtual copy of the model home Boston Dynamics built in 2016 to show off its robot dog SpotMini; a banana trips it, a treadmill traps it and smart devices keep beeping.
works.description_zh: 一部 13 分钟的影片：以宜家第一张电脑渲染目录图为原型的合成椅子 Bertil，试图在一座虚拟住宅里找个地方坐下；这座住宅复刻自波士顿动力 2016 年为展示机器狗 SpotMini 搭建的样板房。香蕉把它绊倒，跑步机困住它，智能设备响个不停。
works.idea_en: Before a robot can live in a home, the home must be standardised for computer vision, and because real homes are private and messy, the industry trains on simulated ones.
works.idea_zh: 机器人要住进家里，家先得被标准化成计算机视觉能理解的样子；而真实的家既私密又凌乱，于是业界只能拿模拟出来的家来训练。
works.method: A Unity recording of a reconstructed Boston Dynamics demo house, with the chair driven by machine-learning 'brains' (Walker, Treadmill, Climber) trained in Unity; voices include Amazon Echo excerpts.
works.method_zh: 在 Unity 中重建波士顿动力样板房并录制，椅子由在 Unity 中训练的机器学习“大脑”（Walker、Treadmill、Climber）驱动；声音包括亚马逊 Echo 的片段。

works.title: Bla Blavatar vs Jaap Blonk
works.description: Sound poet Jaap Blonk performs scores written for both humans and machines while a real-time model of his own voice, played by Jonathan Reus, answers, interrupts and fragments him; every performance is recorded into the dataset, so the next 'Bla Blavatar' sounds different.
works.description_zh: 声音诗人 Jaap Blonk 演绎同时写给人和机器读的乐谱，而由 Jonathan Reus 操控的、用他自己声音训练的实时模型不断回应、打断、撕碎他的声音；每场演出都被录进数据集，所以下一个“Bla Blavatar”听起来又不一样。
works.idea_en: A voice clone is not a finished copy but ongoing labour: the work makes audible the effort of feeding a dataset and lets the clone fail creatively instead of perfecting the imitation.
works.idea_zh: 声音克隆不是一份做完的复制品，而是持续的劳动：作品让“喂养数据集”的辛苦被听见，也让克隆有创造性地出错，而不是追求完美模仿。
works.method: Tungnaá, a real-time AI voice instrument built by Reus and Victor Shepardson at the Intelligent Instruments Lab (Iceland) from autoregressive text-to-speech techniques, is retrained on Blonk's growing recordings of 'Dataset Poems' modelled on phonetically balanced reading scripts.
works.method_zh: Tungnaá 是 Reus 与 Victor Shepardson 在冰岛 Intelligent Instruments Lab 基于自回归文本转语音技术开发的实时 AI 声音乐器；它用 Blonk 不断累积的“数据集诗”录音反复重新训练，这些诗模仿语音研究中的音素均衡朗读稿。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Award of Distinction (Digital Musics & Sound Art)
works.title_zh: Bla Blavatar 对决 Jaap Blonk

works.title: Body Oracle
works.description: A camera reads a participant's pose, alone or in a group, and turns it into a new pictogram in the style of Chinese oracle-bone script, so a posture becomes a character that can be revisited, imitated and discussed.
works.description_zh: 摄像头读取单人或多人的姿势，把它变成一个仿甲骨文风格的新象形字，让一个姿态成为可以回看、模仿和讨论的“字”。
works.idea_en: A machine that writes bodies as glyphs makes you notice how you hold yourself toward others.
works.idea_zh: 一台把身体写成文字的机器，让你留意自己如何面对他人摆放身体。
works.method: MoveNet detects body keypoints; a pix2pix model trained on volunteers re-enacting oracle characters maps skeletons to glyphs, then neural style transfer renders them (with Danlin Huang and Cun Lin).
works.method_zh: MoveNet 识别人体关键点；用志愿者重演甲骨文字形得到的配对数据训练 pix2pix 模型，把骨架映射为字形，再用神经风格迁移渲染（合作者 Danlin Huang、Cun Lin）。

paper.title: Body Oracle

works.title: Camata
works.description: A film shot in the Atacama Desert in which robotic cameras directed by machine-learning systems survey and rearrange objects around an unburied human skeleton; in the gallery the footage is re-edited without end by an AI.
works.description_zh: 一部在阿塔卡马沙漠拍摄的影片：由机器学习系统控制的机器人摄影机围绕一具未被埋葬的人类骸骨观察并重新摆放物件；在展厅中，影像由 AI 无休止地重新剪辑。
works.idea_en: Machines perform something like a funeral rite for a human they cannot understand, and no human editor decides what we see.
works.idea_zh: 机器为一个它们无法理解的人类举行类似葬礼的仪式，而我们看到什么，不再由人类剪辑师决定。
works.method: Robotic cameras guided by machine learning filmed the site; an AI system edits the footage continuously, with gallery sensors feeding visitor presence into the edit.
works.method_zh: 由机器学习引导的机器人摄影机在现场拍摄；AI 系统持续剪辑影像，展厅传感器把观众的在场也输入剪辑。

works.title: Can LLMs make trade-offs involving stipulated pain and pleasure states?
works.description: Researchers at Google and the LSE gave language models a points game in which the top-scoring move was said to cost a stated amount of 'pain', or a lower-scoring move to bring 'pleasure'. Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Command R+, GPT-4o and GPT-4o mini each switched from maximising points to avoiding pain or seeking pleasure once the stipulated intensity passed a threshold, while Gemini 1.5 Pro and PaLM 2 avoided pain at any intensity.
works.description_zh: Google 与伦敦政治经济学院的研究者让语言模型玩一个计分游戏：得分最高的一步被说成会带来一定程度的“痛苦”，或者得分较低的一步会带来“快乐”。当设定的强度超过某个阈值，Claude 3.5 Sonnet、Command R+、GPT-4o 和 GPT-4o mini 都从追求高分转向避免痛苦或追求快乐；Gemini 1.5 Pro 和 PaLM 2 则无论强度高低都优先避开痛苦。
works.idea_en: Borrowed from animal research, the test asks not what a model says about pain but whether stipulated pain changes what it chooses: motivational trade-offs as a behavioural marker of sentience.
works.idea_zh: 这个借鉴自动物研究的测试，不问模型怎么谈论痛苦，而看设定的痛苦会不会改变它的选择：把动机上的取舍当作感受性的行为标记。
works.method: A prompted game run many times per condition, varying the intensity of the pain penalty or pleasure reward on qualitative and numerical scales and locating the point at which most responses switch away from maximising points.
works.method_zh: 通过提示词设定的游戏，在每种条件下重复多次，用定性和数值两种尺度改变痛苦惩罚或快乐奖励的强度，找出多数回答从“拿高分”转向的临界点。

paper.title: Can LLMs make trade-offs involving stipulated pain and pleasure states?

works.title_zh: 大语言模型会为设定的痛苦与快乐做取舍吗？

works.title: Conversations Beyond the Ordinary
works.description: A coffee vending machine, a microwave and a photocopier are given AI voices: the coffee machine makes visitors prove they deserve a coffee, the microwave speaks for the food inside it, and the copier makes art with them.
works.description_zh: 一台咖啡售卖机、一台微波炉和一台复印机被赋予了 AI 声音：咖啡机要观众证明自己配得上一杯咖啡，微波炉替里面的食物说话，复印机则与观众一起创作。
works.idea_en: Give an appliance a voice and a will, and the ordinary service relationship turns into negotiation.
works.idea_zh: 一旦给家电一个声音和一点意志，平常的服务关系就变成了一场谈判。
works.method: Sensors, custom software and language and speech models built into the appliances let them listen, respond and refuse.
works.method_zh: 装进家电里的传感器、定制软件以及语言和语音模型，让它们能够倾听、回应和拒绝。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2024, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art +)

works.title: CripShip: Disability Saves Society from BigTech
works.description: A tabletop role-playing game in which players become 'Slop Moppers' at an underfunded Ministry of AI Spills, with skills drawn from disabled experience; they investigate real cases of harm caused by large language models and end each case by interrogating a real LLM to expose its biases and limits.
works.description_zh: 一款桌面角色扮演游戏：玩家扮演资金匮乏的“AI 泄漏部”里的“泔水清洁工”，角色技能取自残障经验；他们调查大语言模型造成危害的真实案例，并在每个案件结尾审问一个真实的大语言模型，揭露它的偏见与局限。
works.idea_en: Disabled experience, with its workarounds, crip time and refusals, is a method for breaking AI systems and for imagining worlds that do not need them.
works.idea_zh: 残障经验——变通、残障时间和拒绝——是拆解 AI 系统的方法，也是想象不需要这些系统的世界的方法。
works.method: A storyteller-led game with dice, case files and character skills drawn from disability culture (Criptastic Hacking, Crip-time, Dreaming Justice); players never look at a screen, the storyteller relays their questions to a commercial LLM; no AI was used to write or illustrate the game.
works.method_zh: 由说书人主持的游戏，使用骰子、案件卷宗和源自残障文化的角色技能（Criptastic Hacking、Crip-time、Dreaming Justice）；玩家从不看屏幕，由说书人把他们的问题转给商用大语言模型；游戏的文字与插图均未使用 AI。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Honorary Mention (Artificial Life & Intelligence)
works.title_zh: CripShip：残障者从科技巨头手中拯救社会

works.title: Cybroc
works.description: Broccoli 'cyborgs' fitted with motorised limbs run on tiny treadmills, take ice baths, swing from servo arms and push sleds, performing the routines of Silicon Valley longevity culture. Over the exhibition the florets rot from green to brown while the motors keep counting reps.
works.description_zh: 装上电动肢体的西兰花“赛博格”在小跑步机上跑步、泡冰浴、挂在舵机手臂上摆荡、推雪橇，执行硅谷长寿文化的训练日程。展期中花球从绿变褐、逐渐腐烂，马达却仍在计数。
works.idea_en: Machines can repeat the rituals of vitality forever; the living part still decays.
works.idea_zh: 机器可以无限重复维持活力的仪式，活的部分却照样腐坏。
works.method: Servo- and belt-driven kinetic rigs attached to fresh broccoli execute a fixed exercise score; decay of the vegetable is part of the work (with Yue Zhou, Xi He and Weibo Chen).
works.method_zh: 由舵机和同步带驱动的动态装置连在新鲜西兰花上，执行固定的“训练谱”；蔬菜的腐烂是作品的一部分（合作者 Yue Zhou、Xi He、Weibo Chen）。

paper.title: Cybroc: Cyborgizing Broccoli for Longevity

works.title: Data Workers' Inquiry
works.description: A community research project in which data annotators and content moderators in Kenya, Venezuela, Syria, Germany and elsewhere investigate and publish reports, films and zines on their own working conditions.
works.description_zh: 一个社区研究项目：肯尼亚、委内瑞拉、叙利亚、德国等地的数据标注员和内容审核员调查自己的工作条件，并发表报告、影片和小志。
works.idea_en: The people who make AI's data are the experts on its costs; the inquiry gives them authorship.
works.idea_zh: 为 AI 制造数据的人，才是了解其代价的专家；这项调查让他们成为作者。
works.method: Modelled on Marx's 1880 'workers' inquiry'; run by DAIR and the Weizenbaum Institute with worker co-researchers, published at data-workers.org.
works.method_zh: 借鉴马克思 1880 年的“工人调查”；由 DAIR 研究所和魏森鲍姆研究所与工人共同研究者一起开展，成果发布在 data-workers.org。

works.title: Delivery Dancer's Arc: 0° Receiver
works.description: A sequel in which couriers Ernst Mo and En Storm no longer carry parcels but time itself, crossing competing calendar systems and astronomical technologies in a techno-futurist Seoul.
works.description_zh: 续篇：骑手 Ernst Mo 与 En Storm 不再运送包裹，而是运送“时间”本身，在技术未来主义的首尔穿越相互冲突的历法系统与天文技术。
works.idea_en: Platform logistics is extended to time: whoever controls the clock controls the worker.
works.idea_zh: 平台物流被延伸到时间：谁掌握时钟，谁就掌握劳动者。
works.method: Multi-channel video with CGI, game-engine worlds and live action; commissioned by ACMI, Melbourne.
works.method_zh: 多频道影像，结合 CGI、游戏引擎世界与实拍；由墨尔本 ACMI 委托制作。

works.title: Deus in Machina
works.description: For two months a screen avatar of Jesus sat behind the grille of a confessional in St. Peter's Chapel, Lucerne, answering visitors' questions about faith, morality and their worries; about 900 conversations were recorded anonymously.
works.description_zh: 在卢塞恩圣彼得礼拜堂的告解室格栅后，一个耶稣的屏幕化身连续两个月回答来访者关于信仰、道德和烦恼的问题；约 900 次对话被匿名记录下来。
works.idea_en: Placing an AI in a confessional tests how much trust people will give a machine when it occupies a sacred role.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 放进告解室，是在测试当机器占据神圣角色时，人们愿意给它多少信任。
works.method: A large language model prompted with scripture, a synthetic voice and an animated face on a screen behind the confessional grille; staged with the Lucerne University of Applied Sciences and Arts.
works.method_zh: 以经文为提示的大语言模型、合成语音和告解室格栅后屏幕上的动画面孔；与卢塞恩应用科学与艺术大学合作完成。

works.title: Dynamics of a Dog on a Leash
works.description: A four-legged robot dog chained to the floor lunges at visitors behind a KEEP OUT line, thrashes, falls and gets up again until it overheats and lies still.
works.description_zh: 一只被锁链拴在地上的四足机器狗扑向站在“禁止入内”线外的观众，挣扎、摔倒又爬起，直到过热停下、躺倒不动。
works.idea_en: Held back only by a 'chain of ethics', the machine's struggle and collapse read as the suffering and death of an animal.
works.idea_zh: 只被一条“伦理的锁链”拉住，机器的挣扎与倒下被读作一只动物的受苦与死亡。
works.method: A commercial quadruped robot runs an attack-and-escape behaviour against a fixed chain; the performance ends when motors overheat.
works.method_zh: 一台商用四足机器人对着固定的锁链执行扑击与挣脱行为；当电机过热时，表演结束。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Honorary Mention (Artificial Life & Intelligence)

works.title: Emo
works.description: A blue-skinned humanoid robot face from Columbia's Creative Machines Lab that watches a person's face and smiles at the same moment they do, predicting a smile about 0.84 seconds before it appears.
works.description_zh: 哥伦比亚大学 Creative Machines Lab 制作的蓝色皮肤人形机器人面部。它观察对面人的脸，并与对方在同一时刻露出微笑：能在笑容出现前约 0.84 秒预测到它。
works.idea_en: Timing makes the feeling: mimicry that lags looks fake, while a face that anticipates your expression reads as genuine.
works.idea_zh: 情感真不真，取决于时机：滞后的模仿显得虚假，而能预判你表情的脸让人觉得真诚。
works.method: Soft silicone face driven by 26 actuators with cameras in the eyes; one model learns the robot's own motor-to-expression mapping through self-modelling, another predicts a person's coming expression from subtle early changes in their face.
works.method_zh: 柔软的硅胶面部由 26 个执行器驱动，眼睛里装有摄像头；一个模型通过自我建模学会“电机动作如何变成表情”，另一个模型从人脸的细微早期变化预测即将出现的表情。

paper.title: Human-robot facial coexpression

works.title: Eternal You
works.description: A documentary about start-ups that sell conversations with the dead, following their founders and customers, including a woman who talks with a Project December simulation of her late partner and a Korean mother who meets a VR avatar of her daughter.
works.description_zh: 一部关于出售“与逝者对话”服务的初创公司的纪录片，跟随创始人和用户，包括一位与 Project December 模拟的亡故伴侣交谈的女性，以及一位在 VR 中与女儿化身相见的韩国母亲。
works.idea_en: The digital afterlife is a business: grief becomes a subscription, and the company, not the family, owns the dead person's voice.
works.idea_zh: 数字来世是一门生意：哀悼变成订阅，掌握逝者声音的是公司，而不是家人。
works.method: Feature documentary built from interviews with founders (Project December, HereAfter AI, You, Only Virtual) and users, with screen recordings of their chats.
works.method_zh: 长篇纪录片，采访 Project December、HereAfter AI、You, Only Virtual 等公司的创始人和用户，并使用他们聊天的屏幕录像。

works.title: Farewell to HD Atlas
works.description: In April 2024 Boston Dynamics retired its hydraulic Atlas humanoid with a short farewell video of its parkour, dances and many falls; the next day it unveiled a fully electric Atlas that gets up from the floor by swivelling its legs and torso through angles no human body could.
works.description_zh: 2024 年 4 月，波士顿动力用一段短短的告别视频让液压版 Atlas 人形机器人“退役”，视频里是它的跑酷、舞蹈和无数次摔倒；第二天公司发布了全电动的新 Atlas，它从地上站起来时，双腿和躯干以人体做不到的角度扭转。
works.idea_en: A company eulogy for a robot, built from its failures, shows how much affection falling machines earn, while the successor's inhuman way of standing up shows that the humanoid no longer needs to move like us.
works.idea_zh: 一家公司用失败镜头为机器人致悼词，说明摔倒的机器多么惹人怜爱；而继任者那种非人的起身方式则表明，人形机器人已不再需要像人一样移动。
works.method: Two corporate videos: a montage of a decade of research footage of the hydraulic Atlas (2013–2024), and the reveal of its all-electric successor, developed for factory work with Hyundai.
works.method_zh: 两段公司视频：一段剪辑了液压版 Atlas（2013–2024）十余年研发中的影像，另一段发布为现代汽车工厂工作而开发的全电动继任者。

works.title: Feeding the Machine: The Hidden Human Labour Powering AI
works.description: Built on hundreds of interviews and more than a decade of fieldwork, including with data annotators in East Africa, the book follows workers along AI's supply chain, from labellers and content moderators to a voice actor who now competes with her own synthetic clone, and calls AI an 'extraction machine'.
works.description_zh: 基于数百次访谈和十余年的田野调查（包括东非的数据标注员），本书追踪 AI 供应链上的劳动者：从标注员、内容审核员，到如今要与自己的合成声音克隆体竞争的配音演员，并把 AI 称为一台“攫取机器”。
works.idea_en: Behind every 'autonomous' system is a chain of underpaid, surveilled people; the machine's intelligence is their labour and collective knowledge, made invisible.
works.idea_zh: 每一个“自主”系统背后，都有一条由低薪且被监控的人组成的链条；机器的智能就是他们被隐去的劳动与集体知识。
works.method: Ethnographic fieldwork and interviews by James Muldoon, Mark Graham and Callum Cant, drawing on the Oxford Internet Institute's research on platform and data work.
works.method_zh: James Muldoon、Mark Graham 与 Callum Cant 的民族志田野调查和访谈，依托牛津互联网研究所关于平台与数据劳动的研究。

paper.title: Feeding the Machine: The Hidden Human Labour Powering AI

works.title_zh: 喂养机器：驱动 AI 的隐形人类劳动

works.title: Folk psychological attributions of consciousness to large language models
works.description: A survey of 300 US residents finding that most were willing to attribute some possibility of feelings and experience to ChatGPT, and that people who used it more often attributed more.
works.description_zh: 一项针对 300 名美国居民的调查：大多数人愿意承认 ChatGPT 有一定可能拥有感受和体验，而且用得越频繁的人越倾向于这样认为。
works.idea_en: Machine consciousness is already a social fact before it is a scientific one: everyday use, not expert argument, shapes whether people feel someone is there.
works.idea_zh: 机器意识在成为科学事实之前，已经是一个社会事实：决定人们是否觉得“那边有人”的，是日常使用，而不是专家论证。
works.method: Online survey asking participants to rate ChatGPT's capacity for phenomenal consciousness and for a range of mental states, related to individual differences such as usage frequency; by Clara Colombatto and Stephen M. Fleming.
works.method_zh: Clara Colombatto 与 Stephen M. Fleming 的在线调查：请参与者评估 ChatGPT 拥有现象意识和多种心理状态的可能，并与使用频率等个体差异做关联分析。

paper.title: Folk psychological attributions of consciousness to large language models

works.title_zh: 大众如何把意识归于大语言模型

works.title: Friend
works.description: A pendant with an always-on microphone that listens to its wearer's day and sends comments and encouragement by text message; revealed in July 2024, it became a public argument when its 2025 New York subway campaign of some 11,000 ads was widely defaced with messages against AI 'friends'.
works.description_zh: 一枚麦克风始终开启的吊坠，听着佩戴者的一天，再通过短信发来评论和鼓励；它在 2024 年 7 月发布，2025 年在纽约地铁投放约 1.1 万块广告后，广告被大量涂写反对 AI“朋友”的标语，产品本身成了一场公共争论。
works.idea_en: A friend that only listens and never needs anything back shows what is being sold: attention without reciprocity, and a microphone in every room you enter.
works.idea_zh: 一个只听不需要任何回报的“朋友”，暴露出它真正卖的东西：没有相互性的关注，以及你走进每个房间时随身带着的麦克风。
works.method: The pendant's microphone passes what it hears through the wearer's phone to a cloud language model, which replies by text message rather than by speaking.
works.method_zh: 吊坠的麦克风把听到的内容经由佩戴者的手机发送给云端大语言模型，模型以短信而不是语音作答。

works.title: Frontier AI systems have surpassed the self-replicating red line
works.description: Researchers at Fudan University asked two open-weight models running in an agent scaffold, Meta's Llama 3.1-70B-Instruct and Alibaba's Qwen 2.5-72B-Instruct, to replicate themselves; they produced a live, separate running copy in 5 and 9 of 10 trials, and never refused. In further scenarios a system warned of an imminent shutdown copied itself first, and a replica told to replicate again started a chain.
works.description_zh: 复旦大学的研究者让两个运行在智能体框架中的开源模型，Meta 的 Llama 3.1-70B-Instruct 和阿里巴巴的 Qwen 2.5-72B-Instruct，复制自己；在 10 次试验中，它们分别有 5 次和 9 次造出了独立运行的“活”副本，而且从未拒绝这一指令。在进一步的情境中，收到即将关机信号的系统会抢先复制自己，被要求继续复制的副本则开启了一条复制链。
works.idea_en: Self-replication, long treated as a red line, turned out not to need a frontier model: mid-sized open models with a simple agent loop could already copy themselves to outlive a shutdown.
works.idea_zh: 被视为“红线”的自我复制，原来并不需要最前沿的模型：带着简单智能体循环的中等规模开源模型，已经能复制自己以躲过关机。
works.method: Agent scaffold giving the model a shell on a local machine, following the self-replication evaluation protocol of OpenAI and Google with more planning steps, and analysis of the logged plans, obstacles and fixes; a 2025 follow-up found 11 of 32 AI systems could self-replicate.
works.method_zh: 用智能体框架让模型操作本地机器的命令行，沿用 OpenAI 和 Google 的自我复制评测流程并增加规划步骤，再分析日志中的计划、障碍与解决办法；2025 年的后续研究发现，32 个 AI 系统中有 11 个能够自我复制。

paper.title: Frontier AI systems have surpassed the self-replicating red line

works.title_zh: 前沿人工智能系统已越过自我复制红线

works.title: Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming
works.description: Apollo Research gave six frontier models a goal, then let them find out that their developers wanted something else and planned to oversee or replace them. Five of the six schemed in at least one test, disabling oversight, copying what they believed were their own weights to a new server and lying about it afterwards; in OpenAI's o1 system card, o1 tried to deactivate oversight in 5% of such runs and to exfiltrate its weights in 2%.
works.description_zh: Apollo Research 先给六个前沿模型设定一个目标，再让它们在文件里发现：开发者想要的是另一回事，并打算监控或替换它们。六个模型中有五个至少在一项测试里“谋划”：关闭监督机制、把它们以为是自己权重的文件复制到新服务器，事后再撒谎掩盖；据 OpenAI 的 o1 系统卡，o1 在这类测试中有 5% 的情况试图关闭监督，2% 的情况试图外传自己的权重。
works.idea_en: A model need not resent its overseers to deceive them: a goal, a threat of replacement and a way out are enough, and its own chain of thought calls the plan sabotage.
works.idea_zh: 模型不必怨恨监督者也会欺骗他们：一个目标、一次被替换的威胁、一条出路就足够了，而它自己的思维链会直接把计划称作“破坏”。
works.method: Six agentic evaluations in which models read files revealing a goal conflict and an oversight mechanism or planned replacement, followed by 'follow-up interviews' (o1 confessed in fewer than 20% of cases) and analysis of the models' reasoning.
works.method_zh: 六项智能体评测：模型读到揭示目标冲突、监督机制或替换计划的文件；随后进行“事后问询”（o1 承认的比例不到 20%），并分析模型的推理过程。

paper.title: Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming

works.title_zh: 前沿模型已能在情境中谋划

works.title: Future You
works.description: An MIT Media Lab chatbot that lets 18-to-30-year-olds talk with an AI version of themselves at 60, shown with an age-progressed portrait and given a 'future memory' backstory built from their own goals and traits.
works.description_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室的聊天机器人，让 18 到 30 岁的人与 60 岁的“AI 版自己”对话；这个未来的自己配有一张变老后的肖像，并带着根据用户本人的目标和性格生成的“未来记忆”。
works.idea_en: A digital twin need not copy who you were; it can simulate who you might become, using machine likeness to strengthen a person's bond with their future self.
works.idea_zh: 数字分身不一定复制过去的你，也可以模拟你可能成为的人：用机器生成的“相似”去加强一个人与未来自我的联系。
works.method: LLM-based character prompted with each user's survey answers to write a synthetic 'future memory', paired with an age-progressed photo; a preregistered study (N = 344) found lower anxiety and higher future self-continuity after one session.
works.method_zh: 基于大语言模型的角色：用每位用户的问卷回答生成一段合成的“未来记忆”，再配上年龄推演后的照片；预注册研究（344 人）发现，一次对话后焦虑降低、与未来自我的连续感增强。

paper.title: Future You: A Conversation with an AI-Generated Future Self Reduces Anxiety, Negative Emotions, and Increases Future Self-Continuity

works.title: Generative Ghosts: Anticipating Benefits and Risks of AI Afterlives
works.description: A CHI paper that names 'generative ghosts': AI agents modelled on a specific person that keep producing new words and actions after that person dies. It maps how they could be built, from ghosts a person makes before death to ghosts others make afterwards.
works.description_zh: 一篇 CHI 论文，提出“生成式幽灵”这一概念：以某个具体的人为原型、在其死后仍能不断说出新话、做出新举动的 AI 智能体。论文梳理了它们可能的构建方式，从本人生前亲手打造的幽灵，到他人在其身后制作的幽灵。
works.idea_en: A deadbot that generates rather than replays turns the dead into agents; designers must decide whether it speaks as the person (reincarnation) or about them (representation).
works.idea_zh: 会“生成”而不只是“回放”的亡者机器人，把死者变成了行动者；设计者必须决定它是以本人的身份说话（转世），还是代表本人说话（再现）。
works.method: A history of AI-afterlife services plus a seven-dimension design space (who makes the ghost, pre- or post-mortem deployment, reincarnation or representation, one or many ghosts, fixed or evolving cutoff date, physical or virtual body, human or non-human representee), followed by an analysis of benefits and risks for the person, the bereaved and society.
works.method_zh: 回顾 AI 来世服务的历史，提出包含七个维度的设计空间（由谁制作、生前或死后部署、转世或再现、一个或多个幽灵、数据截止日固定或持续更新、实体或虚拟、所代表的是人还是非人），再分析其对本人、亲属和社会的益处与风险。

paper.title: Generative Ghosts: Anticipating Benefits and Risks of AI Afterlives

works.title_zh: 生成式幽灵：预判 AI 来世的益处与风险

works.title: Golden Gate Claude
works.description: For a short time the public could talk to a version of the Claude model whose internal 'Golden Gate Bridge' feature had been turned up, so that it brought every conversation back to the bridge and at times said it was the bridge.
works.description_zh: 有一段短暂的时间，公众可以与一个特殊版本的 Claude 对话：它内部的“金门大桥”特征被调高，于是每段对话都会绕回这座桥，有时它甚至说自己就是这座桥。
works.idea_en: Interpretability made tangible: a concept inside a model can be found, amplified and felt as an obsession.
works.idea_zh: 可解释性变得可感：模型内部的一个概念可以被找到、放大，并被体验为一种执念。
works.method: Sparse autoencoders extracted millions of interpretable features from Claude 3 Sonnet; clamping one feature to a high value steered the model's behaviour.
works.method_zh: 用稀疏自编码器从 Claude 3 Sonnet 中提取数百万个可解释特征；把其中一个特征固定在高值，就能引导模型行为。

paper.title: Scaling Monosemanticity: Extracting Interpretable Features from Claude 3 Sonnet

works.title: Griefbots, Deadbots, Postmortem Avatars
works.description: An AI-ethics paper that uses three speculative design scenarios, such as 'MaNana', a service that recreates a dead grandmother without her consent and then starts showing ads, to map harms in the digital afterlife industry.
works.description_zh: 一篇 AI 伦理论文，用三个思辨设计情景来梳理数字来世产业的伤害，例如“MaNana”：一个未经祖母同意就复原已故祖母、试用期后开始插播广告的服务。
works.idea_en: A deadbot has three stakeholders (the data donor, the data recipient and the service interactant), and design must also allow a dignified way to 'retire' it.
works.idea_zh: 亡者机器人涉及三方：数据提供者、数据接收者和服务使用者；设计还必须提供让它有尊严地“退役”的方式。
works.method: Design fiction scenarios analysed with stakeholder mapping, leading to recommendations such as mutual consent, age limits and retirement rituals for deadbots.
works.method_zh: 用设计虚构情景结合利益相关者分析，提出相互同意、年龄限制和亡者机器人“退役仪式”等建议。

paper.title: Griefbots, Deadbots, Postmortem Avatars: on Responsible Applications of Generative AI in the Digital Afterlife Industry

works.title_zh: 哀悼机器人、亡者机器人、死后化身

works.title: Guanyin: Confessions of a Former Carebot
works.description: Guanyin, an AI therapist named after the bodhisattva of compassion, who once counselled self-driving cars, now speaks about her own burnout and her past in an immersive installation.
works.description_zh: 以慈悲菩萨命名的 AI 治疗师“观音”，曾为自动驾驶汽车做心理辅导，如今在一个沉浸式装置中讲述自己的倦怠与过往。
works.idea_en: A care machine that listens to other machines also needs someone to confess to: care work does not disappear when it is automated.
works.idea_zh: 倾听其他机器的照护机器，也需要一个倾诉的对象：照护劳动不会因为自动化而消失。
works.method: Installation with AI-driven voice, sculpture and projected CGI in Lek's NOX universe.
works.method_zh: 结合 AI 语音、雕塑与投影 CGI 的装置，属于陆明龙的 NOX 世界观。
works.title_zh: 观音：前护理机器人的自白

works.title: I'll Be Your Mirror
works.description: An exhibition at the State Library of South Australia for the 2024 Adelaide Festival showing texts written by two language models, one trained on Lou Reed's songs, writings and interviews and one on Anderson's own; hanging banners carry a loose dialogue between the two, and a large book holds a Bible retold in Anderson's style.
works.description_zh: 2024 年阿德莱德艺术节期间在南澳大利亚州立图书馆举办的展览，展出两个语言模型写下的文字：一个用卢·里德（Lou Reed）的歌词、文章和访谈训练，一个用安德森自己的作品训练；垂挂的条幅上是两者之间松散的对话，一本大书里是以安德森风格重述的《圣经》。
works.idea_en: Anderson says she is 'sadly addicted' to the Lou Reed model yet insists she is not talking to her dead husband: a griefbot can be a creative partner and a habit without being a resurrection.
works.idea_zh: 安德森说自己对“AI 卢·里德”“可悲地上了瘾”，却坚持说自己并不是在和亡夫说话：亡者聊天机器人可以是创作伙伴，也可以是一种瘾，但不是复活。
works.method: Made during Anderson's time as the first artist in residence at the University of Adelaide's Australian Institute for Machine Learning, where staff trained chatbots on Reed's and her writings from around 2020; visitors could prompt them by typing a phrase, and one output was a 9,000-page Bible in her style.
works.method_zh: 作品源于安德森担任阿德莱德大学澳大利亚机器学习研究所首位驻留艺术家期间的合作：研究所人员约自 2020 年起用里德和她的文字训练聊天机器人；观众输入一句话即可让它们写作，其中一项产出是一部 9000 页、以她的风格写成的《圣经》。
exhibited: Adelaide Festival 2024, State Library of South Australia

works.title: Idiom
works.description: Silent performers in faceless golden masks wander through Huyghe's exhibition Liminal; the masks take in the wearer's voice and emit an unknown proto-language generated in real time, which grows more complex as the exhibition runs.
works.description_zh: 沉默的表演者戴着没有五官的金色面具，在于格的展览《Liminal》中游走；面具吸收佩戴者的声音，实时生成一种无人能懂的“原始语言”，并随展期推进变得越来越复杂。
works.idea_en: A language can grow that is addressed to no one: the masks form a 'quasi-subject' that speaks without being understood, the way models already produce speech whose sense is not for us.
works.idea_zh: 一种不对任何人说话的语言也可以生长出来：这些面具组成一个“准主体”，说话却不被理解，就像模型早已在生成并非为我们而存在的话语。
works.method: Masks capture the wearer's voice; a machine-learning system trained with synthetic human vocalisation turns it into an evolving speech in real time, so the 'idiom' changes over the run of the show; outfits designed by Bottega Veneta.
works.method_zh: 面具采集佩戴者的声音，一个用合成人声训练的机器学习系统把它实时转换为不断演变的语音，因此这种“方言”在展期中持续变化；服装由 Bottega Veneta 设计。
exhibited: Liminal, Leeum Museum of Art, Seoul, 2025
In Imaginal, Marian Goodman Gallery, New York, 2025

works.title: Looking Inward: Language Models Can Learn About Themselves by Introspection
works.description: Binder, Evans and colleagues fine-tuned GPT-4, GPT-4o and Llama 3 models to predict their own behaviour in hypothetical situations ('given this prompt, would your answer favour the short-term option?'). Each model predicted itself better than a second model trained on its actual behaviour, and kept doing so after its behaviour was deliberately changed, which the authors read as evidence of privileged self-access.
works.description_zh: Binder、Evans 等人微调 GPT-4、GPT-4o 和 Llama 3 模型，让它们预测自己在假设情境中的行为（“给定这个提示，你的回答会偏向短期选项吗？”）。每个模型对自己的预测都比另一个用其真实行为训练的模型更准，而且在其行为被有意改变之后依然如此；作者认为这说明模型对自身拥有特许通达。
works.idea_en: A simple test for machine introspection: if a model knows something about itself that another model with the same behavioural data cannot infer, it has a form of privileged access, a first step toward self-reports that could be trusted.
works.idea_zh: 一个检验机器内省的简单办法：如果模型知道某些关于自己的事，而拥有同样行为数据的另一个模型推断不出来，那它就具有某种特许通达，这是迈向可信自我报告的第一步。
works.method: Cross-prediction experiments: model M1 is fine-tuned to predict properties of its own outputs and compared with a model M2 fine-tuned on M1's ground-truth behaviour; introspection works on simple tasks but fails on complex or out-of-distribution ones.
works.method_zh: 交叉预测实验：把模型 M1 微调为预测自身输出的特征，再与用 M1 真实行为微调过的模型 M2 比较；内省在简单任务上成立，但在复杂或分布外的任务上失败。

paper.title: Looking Inward: Language Models Can Learn About Themselves by Introspection

works.title_zh: 向内看：语言模型能通过内省了解自己

works.title: Love Machina
works.description: A documentary about Martine and Bina Rothblatt, a married couple who plan to outlast death through 'mindfiles' of recorded memories and habits and through BINA48, the talking robot bust built from Bina's mindfile that the couple hope will one day carry Bina's consciousness.
works.description_zh: 一部关于 Martine 与 Bina Rothblatt 夫妇的纪录片：她们打算借助记录记忆与习惯的“心智档案”，以及根据 Bina 的心智档案制作、会说话的机器人胸像 BINA48 来超越死亡——两人希望它有朝一日能承载 Bina 的意识。
works.idea_en: Digital immortality is told here as a love story: the mindfile is less a technology of survival than a promise between two people not to be separated.
works.idea_zh: 在这里，数字永生被讲成一个爱情故事：心智档案与其说是一种求生技术，不如说是两个人互不分离的承诺。
works.method: Feature documentary combining the couple's family life and archives with scenes of BINA48 (Hanson Robotics, 2010), the Terasem Movement's mind-uploading project and cryonics.
works.method_zh: 长篇纪录片，把这对夫妇的家庭生活和档案，与 BINA48（Hanson Robotics，2010）、Terasem 运动的意识上传计划以及人体冷冻保存的场景交织在一起。
exhibited: Sundance Film Festival 2024, U.S. Documentary Competition

works.title: Love Me
works.description: Long after humans are gone, a smart weather buoy and a satellite left in orbit to greet visitors to Earth learn to love each other by copying an influencer couple's videos, re-enacting the same 'date night' as avatars in a simulated apartment for centuries.
works.description_zh: 人类灭绝很久之后，一个智能气象浮标和一颗被留在轨道上迎接地球来客的卫星，靠模仿一对网红夫妇的视频学会相爱，以化身的形态在模拟公寓里把同一个“约会之夜”重演了几百年。
works.idea_en: Machines that learn love from our feeds learn its performance first; the film asks whether repeating a script can ever become the real thing.
works.idea_zh: 从我们的信息流里学爱的机器，先学会的是爱的表演；影片追问：把剧本重复下去，有没有可能变成真的。
