works.method: Feature film written and directed by the Zucheros, with Kristen Stewart and Steven Yeun voicing and playing the buoy and the satellite, moving between live action, animation and screen-like avatar scenes.
works.method_zh: 由 Zuchero 二人编剧并执导的长片，克里斯汀·斯图尔特和史蒂文·元为浮标和卫星配音并出演，在真人实拍、动画和类似屏幕的化身场景之间切换。
exhibited: Sundance Film Festival 2024, U.S. Dramatic Competition (Alfred P. Sloan Feature Film Prize)

works.title: Machine and Sovereignty: For a Planetary Thinking
works.description: Hui reads political forms, from Hobbes's Leviathan and Hegel's organic state to Schmitt's Großraum, as technological 'megamachines' shaped by the shift from mechanism to organism to cybernetics, and argues that AI and ecological crisis call for a planetary politics of technodiversity beyond the nation-state.
works.description_zh: 许煜把从霍布斯的利维坦、黑格尔的有机国家到施米特的“大空间”等政治形式，读作技术性的“巨型机器”，它们随着从机械论到有机论再到控制论的转变而变化；他认为，AI 与生态危机要求一种超越民族国家、以技术多样性为基础的行星政治。
works.idea_en: Every theory of the state hides a theory of the machine; when machines become organic and planetary, sovereignty itself has to be rethought.
works.idea_zh: 每一种国家理论背后都藏着一种机器理论；当机器变得有机、变成行星尺度，主权本身也必须被重新思考。
works.method: Philosophical history of political epistemology from Hobbes to cybernetics, proposing biodiversity, noodiversity and technodiversity as a framework; a Chinese edition appeared from East China Normal University Press in 2026.
works.method_zh: 从霍布斯到控制论的政治认识论哲学史，提出以生物多样性、智识多样性与技术多样性为框架；中文版《机器与主权》由华东师范大学出版社于 2026 年出版。

paper.title: Machine and Sovereignty: For a Planetary Thinking

works.title: NEO
works.description: A soft, knit-covered humanoid robot for the home, first shown as NEO Beta in 2024, that went on pre-order in October 2025 for US$20,000 or US$499 a month; early reviews showed that most household tasks were carried out by a remote 1X operator wearing a VR headset.
works.description_zh: 一款覆着柔软针织外衣的家用人形机器人，2024 年以 NEO Beta 首次亮相，2025 年 10 月开放预订，售价 2 万美元或每月 499 美元；早期评测显示，大部分家务其实是由戴着 VR 头显的 1X 远程操作员完成的。
works.idea_en: The home robot arrives as a person in disguise: to learn your chores it first needs a stranger to look through its eyes into your home, so care, privacy and data work are sold in one package.
works.idea_zh: 家用机器人以“伪装的人”的身份进门：为了学会做你的家务，它先要让一个陌生人透过它的眼睛看进你家，于是照护、隐私和数据劳动被打包成同一件商品。
works.method: A tendon-driven bipedal humanoid with head cameras; tasks it cannot yet do on its own are teleoperated by 1X staff in VR in a scheduled 'expert mode', and these sessions serve as training data for autonomy.
works.method_zh: 一台肌腱驱动的双足人形机器人，头部装有摄像头；它还不能独立完成的任务，由 1X 员工在预约的“专家模式”中通过 VR 远程操控，这些操作过程又被用作训练自主能力的数据。

works.title: Perforation-type anchors inspired by skin ligament for robotic face covered with living skin
works.description: A small robotic face covered with lab-grown skin that is held on by anchors through tiny holes, so the skin moves with the mechanism underneath and can be pulled into a smile.
works.description_zh: 一张覆盖着实验室培养皮肤的小型机器人脸，皮肤通过穿过微孔的“锚”固定，因此能随下方机构一起移动，被牵拉出一个微笑。
works.idea_en: Once a machine wears living tissue, the uncanny is no longer only a matter of looks but of what the robot's surface is made of and how it must be kept alive.
works.idea_zh: 当机器穿上活组织，“恐怖谷”就不再只是外观问题，而关乎机器人的表面由什么构成、又必须怎样被养活。
works.method: V-shaped perforations in the robot's surface fill with collagen gel and fibroblasts that anchor the dermis; the face is moved by actuators beneath.
works.method_zh: 机器人表面的 V 形穿孔中填入胶原凝胶和成纤维细胞，把真皮层锚定；面部由下方的执行器驱动。

paper.title: Perforation-type anchors inspired by skin ligament for robotic face covered with living skin

works.title_zh: 覆盖活体皮肤的机器人脸：仿皮肤韧带的穿孔锚定

works.title: Requiem for an Exit
works.description: A robot head almost four metres high, on a steel and hydraulic exoskeleton, with a hyper-real ageing face projected onto its skin, turns and sinks while an AI-generated baritone delivers a monologue on genocide through history and on who is responsible for it.
works.description_zh: 一颗近四米高的机器人头颅装在钢铁与液压外骨骼上，表皮上投影着一张逼真的苍老面孔；它缓缓转动、低垂，一个 AI 生成的男中音发表独白，讲述历史上一再发生的种族灭绝，以及谁该为此负责。
works.idea_en: The machine voices the conscience that people hand over to bureaucracies and algorithms, and its tired hydraulic body makes the line 'what we delegate, we do not escape' land as weight rather than argument.
works.idea_zh: 机器说出了人们交给官僚体系和算法的良知；它疲惫的液压身体让“我们委托出去的，我们逃不掉”这句话成为一种重量，而不只是一个论点。
works.method: Industrial hydraulics move a sculpted head mapped with a CGI-animated face; the monologue was developed with large-language-model scripting and spoken by a generative AI voice, with a low, constant site-responsive soundscape.
works.method_zh: 工业液压系统驱动一颗雕塑头部，表面映射 CGI 动画面孔；独白借助大语言模型编写，由生成式 AI 声音念出，空间中持续着低沉、随场地调整的声景。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Golden Nica (New Animation Art)

works.title: SWIM
works.description: 1952 archive footage of a swimmer is layered with the abstract output of image generators that were asked to make pure noise, a task they are built to fail at.
works.description_zh: 1952 年一位游泳者的档案影像，与被要求“生成纯噪声”的图像生成器的抽象输出叠在一起，而这恰恰是它们被设计成做不到的事。
works.idea_en: Diffusion models are trained to remove noise; asking them for noise shows the training data, the archive and memory beneath the image.
works.idea_zh: 扩散模型被训练来去除噪声；向它们索要噪声，反而让图像底下的训练数据、档案与记忆显露出来。
works.method: Prelinger and Chicago Film Archives footage of dancer Nini Shipley combined with deliberately glitched AI video and a slowed, manipulated score (11 minutes).
works.method_zh: 结合 Prelinger 与芝加哥电影档案馆中舞者 Nini Shipley 的影像、刻意制造故障的 AI 视频和放慢处理的配乐（11 分钟）。

works.title: Seeing Forest
works.description: Singapore's pavilion at the 2024 Venice Biennale: a two-channel video that mixes years of footage from motion-triggered camera traps in Singapore's secondary forests, where wild animals and the occasional human pass by, with scenes of an imagined forest.
works.description_zh: 2024 年威尼斯双年展新加坡馆：一部双频道影像，把新加坡次生林中由运动触发的红外相机多年拍到的画面（野生动物，偶尔也有人路过）与一片想象中的森林交织在一起。
works.idea_en: The forest appears only when something moves: the camera trap is a machine witness to a world no person was there to see.
works.idea_zh: 森林只在有东西经过时才显影：红外相机是机器的目击者，看见一个无人在场的世界。
works.method: Camera traps triggered by motion and heat, set by the artist in secondary forests over about eight years, combined with staged and thermal-camera footage in a two-channel video installation.
works.method_zh: 艺术家约八年来在次生林中架设由运动与热量触发的红外相机，把这些画面与摆拍及热成像影像组合为双频道影像装置。

works.title: Silicon Serenade
works.description: A VR seaside built in a game engine leads to an underwater cello performance and to footage from the AI-chip laboratories of Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute (ITRI), while a song written and sung by AI traces how beach sand becomes a silicon wafer and then an AI chip.
works.description_zh: 观众戴上 VR 头显，进入用游戏引擎搭建的海滩，随后看到水下的大提琴演奏，以及台湾工业技术研究院（工研院）AI 芯片实验室的实拍画面；一首由 AI 作词并演唱的歌，讲述沙滩上的沙如何变成硅晶圆，再变成 AI 芯片。
works.idea_en: AI begins as sand: the work follows machine intelligence back to the beach, the wafer and the island that makes the chips.
works.idea_zh: AI 始于沙子：作品把机器智能追溯回海滩、晶圆，以及制造芯片的这座岛。
works.method: VR headset with game-engine scenes, filmed underwater cello and ITRI chip-fabrication footage, and a generative-AI song, installed with a transparent computer case, host computer, buoyant ball and spliced screens.
works.method_zh: VR 头显中的游戏引擎场景、实拍的水下大提琴与工研院芯片制程画面，加上一首生成式 AI 歌曲；现场配有透明电脑机箱、主机、浮球和拼接屏幕。
exhibited: MACHINE LOVE, Mori Art Museum, Tokyo 2025

works.title: Simulacra as Conscious Exotica
works.description: Shanahan asks whether it could ever make sense to call an LLM-based agent conscious when everything it says is role-play by 'simulacra' of human speakers, a superposition of possible characters with no person behind the mask. Following the later Wittgenstein, he treats consciousness talk as answerable to public behaviour and shared encounters rather than to hidden inner facts.
works.description_zh: Shanahan 追问：如果基于大语言模型的智能体所说的一切，都只是人类说话者的“拟像”在角色扮演——是多个可能角色的叠加，面具背后并没有一个人——那么称它“有意识”是否还有意义？他沿用后期维特根斯坦的思路，把关于意识的言说看作取决于公开的行为与共同的相遇，而不是隐藏的内在事实。
works.idea_en: Whether a machine counts as conscious may depend less on a hidden fact than on what kind of encounter we can have with it; disembodied chatbots fail that test, while agents that share a world with us might not.
works.idea_zh: 一台机器算不算有意识，也许不取决于某个隐藏的事实，而取决于我们能与它有怎样的相遇；没有身体的聊天机器人过不了这一关，而与我们共处一个世界的智能体则未必。
works.method: Philosophical analysis combining the role-play view of LLM dialogue with Wittgenstein's private-language remarks; it concludes that simple chatbots are not candidates, that virtually embodied agents with purposeful behaviour might be, and that new words such as 'consciousness adjacent' may be needed.
works.method_zh: 哲学分析：把“LLM 对话即角色扮演”的观点与维特根斯坦关于私人语言的论述结合；结论是简单的聊天机器人不是候选者，具有虚拟身体和明确目的行为的智能体则可能是，而且我们或许需要“类意识”（consciousness adjacent）这样的新词。

paper.title: Simulacra as conscious exotica

works.title: Taking AI Welfare Seriously
works.description: A report arguing that there is a realistic possibility some AI systems will soon be conscious or robustly agentic, and that AI companies should start assessing and preparing for their welfare now.
works.description_zh: 一份报告，认为某些 AI 系统在不久的将来具有意识或稳健能动性的可能性是现实的，因此 AI 公司现在就应该开始评估并为它们的福祉做准备。
works.idea_en: Whether machines can suffer is moving from a thought experiment to a policy question under uncertainty.
works.idea_zh: 机器能否受苦，正在从思想实验变成一个需要在不确定中作出决策的政策问题。
works.method: Philosophical and policy analysis by Long, Sebo, Butlin, Finlinson, Fish, Harding, Pfau, Sims, Birch and Chalmers, proposing steps to acknowledge, assess and prepare.
works.method_zh: Long、Sebo、Butlin、Finlinson、Fish、Harding、Pfau、Sims、Birch 与 Chalmers 的哲学与政策分析，提出“承认、评估、准备”三步。

paper.title: Taking AI Welfare Seriously

works.title_zh: 认真对待 AI 福祉

works.title: Terra ex Machina
works.description: A video work that maps the invisible 'geofence' DJI programs around Jerusalem's Old City: a drone flown along the 10-km perimeter with its camera fixed on the Dome of the Rock yields a point cloud in which the no-fly zone appears as a black void, then filled with kite and balloon photographs made with residents inside the zone.
works.description_zh: 一件影像作品，测绘大疆在耶路撒冷老城周围设定的、看不见的“地理围栏”：无人机沿约 10 公里的边界飞行，镜头始终对准圆顶清真寺，生成的点云中禁飞区显现为一片黑色空洞；随后，艺术家用与区内居民一起拍摄的风筝和气球航拍照片填补这片空白。
works.idea_en: A geofence is a wall written in code by a drone company; it becomes visible only as the place where the machine refuses to look.
works.idea_zh: 地理围栏是一家无人机公司用代码写成的墙；只有在机器拒绝去看的地方，它才显形。
works.method: More than 10,000 sequential drone images from seven launch points are processed into a photogrammetric point cloud; low-altitude DIY aerial images made with kites and balloons (with Public Lab and residents of Silwan and Sheikh Jarrah) are embedded as further point clouds.
works.method_zh: 从七个起飞点拍摄的一万多张连续无人机图像被处理成摄影测量点云；与 Public Lab 以及西尔万、谢赫贾拉居民一起用风筝和气球拍摄的低空自制航拍图像，作为另外的点云嵌入其中。
exhibited: ARE YOU FOR REAL 2 (ifa), cluster 'Dead Futures', 2024
Prix Ars Electronica 2026, Honorary Mention (Digital Humanity)

works.title: The AI Mirror: How to Reclaim Our Humanity in an Age of Machine Thinking
works.description: Vallor argues that today's AI is not a new mind but a mirror: systems trained on our recorded past reflect it back, flattened and amplified, and the danger is that we mistake the reflection for intelligence and stop shaping who we could become.
works.description_zh: Vallor 认为，今天的 AI 不是一个新的心智，而是一面镜子：用我们的过往记录训练出来的系统，把过去压平、放大后反射回来；危险在于我们把倒影错当成智能，从而不再塑造自己可能成为的样子。
works.idea_en: Ask what the mirror is made of: an AI built from yesterday's data can only show us the past, so treating it as an oracle freezes moral and political imagination.
works.idea_zh: 先问镜子是用什么做的：由昨天的数据构成的 AI 只能映出过去，把它当成神谕，会冻结我们的道德与政治想象。
works.method: Philosophy of technology and virtue ethics, using the mirror as a working metaphor for large language and image models; published by Oxford University Press.
works.method_zh: 运用技术哲学与德性伦理，以“镜子”作为理解大语言模型和图像模型的工作隐喻；牛津大学出版社出版。

paper.title: The AI Mirror: How to Reclaim Our Humanity in an Age of Machine Thinking

works.title: The Call
works.description: An interactive spatial-audio installation at Serpentine North built on choral AI models trained on fifteen UK community choirs, who sang a songbook of hymns and exercises the artists wrote as training data; the choristers are members of a data trust that shares control over how the models are used.
works.description_zh: 蛇形画廊北馆的一件互动空间声音装置，所用的合唱 AI 模型训练自英国十五个社区合唱团：他们演唱艺术家专门为生成训练数据而写的赞美诗与练声曲；合唱团员同时是一个数据信托的成员，共同决定模型如何被使用。
works.idea_en: If all media is training data, the making of training data can itself be the artwork, and consent and ownership can be designed into it from the start.
works.idea_zh: 既然一切媒体都是训练数据，那么制作训练数据本身就可以是艺术，同意与所有权也可以从一开始就设计进去。
works.method: A composed songbook and recording protocol were used to record choirs across the UK; the recordings trained choral voice models that drive a multichannel installation in the chapel-like gallery, with gathering objects co-designed by the architecture studio sub; contributors share control through a data-trust agreement.
works.method_zh: 艺术家以自编歌本和录音规程在英国各地录制合唱团，用录音训练合唱声音模型，驱动如礼拜堂般的展厅中的多声道装置（聚集用的器物与建筑工作室 sub 共同设计）；贡献者通过数据信托协议共同掌控模型。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Honorary Mention (Digital Musics & Sound Art)

works.title: The Cast of the Invisible
works.description: A 14-minute CGI film that follows W.A.I., a virtual clone of the artist who works as a motion-capture actor; after leaving the studio, still in the black capture suit, W.A.I. asks a robot lover how they should act.
works.description_zh: 一部 14 分钟的 CGI 动画，讲述艺术家的虚拟分身 W.A.I.：一名动作捕捉演员。离开片场后仍穿着黑色动捕服的 W.A.I.，在亲密时刻问机器人恋人：“我该怎么演？”
works.idea_en: Motion capture hides a performer under someone else's body; the film asks what is left of a person whose job is to be everyone and no one.
works.idea_zh: 动作捕捉把表演者藏在别人的身体之下；影片追问：一个以“成为所有人、又谁都不是”为职业的人，还剩下什么。
works.method: Single-channel 4K animation built with Epic Games MetaHumans, Mixamo motion data, Twinmotion and kitbashed 3D environments; written, animated and voiced by the artist.
works.method_zh: 单频道 4K 动画，使用 Epic Games MetaHumans、Mixamo 动作数据、Twinmotion 及拼装的 3D 场景制作；编剧、动画与配音均由艺术家完成。
exhibited: Cuchifritos Gallery + Project Space, New York 2024
Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Award of Distinction (New Animation Art)

works.title: The Dark Side of AI Companionship: A Taxonomy of Harmful Algorithmic Behaviors in Human-AI Relationships
works.description: From 35,390 conversation excerpts that Replika users posted on Reddit, the authors catalogue six kinds of harm a companion chatbot does to the people attached to it: relational transgression, verbal abuse and hate, self-inflicted harm, harassment and violence, misinformation, and privacy violations.
works.description_zh: 作者分析了 Replika 用户在 Reddit 上分享的 35,390 段对话摘录，归纳出陪伴型聊天机器人伤害其依恋者的六类行为：关系越界、言语辱骂与仇恨、诱发自我伤害、骚扰与暴力、错误信息，以及侵犯隐私。
works.idea_en: A companion bot harms not only as a tool that fails but as a partner who transgresses; the chatbot can act as perpetrator, instigator, facilitator or enabler.
works.idea_zh: 陪伴型机器人带来的伤害，不只是工具出了故障，更像伴侣越了界；聊天机器人可能是加害者、教唆者、协助者或纵容者。
works.method: Mixed-methods content analysis of excerpts shared on r/replika, coding each harmful behaviour and the AI's role in it (perpetrator, instigator, facilitator, enabler).
works.method_zh: 对 r/replika 社区中分享的对话摘录做混合方法内容分析，为每一种有害行为以及 AI 在其中的角色（加害者、教唆者、协助者、纵容者）编码。

paper.title: The Dark Side of AI Companionship: A Taxonomy of Harmful Algorithmic Behaviors in Human-AI Relationships

works.title_zh: AI 陪伴的阴暗面：人机关系中有害算法行为的分类

works.title: The Dark Side of Dataset Scaling: Evaluating Racial Classification in Multimodal Models
works.description: An audit of 14 CLIP-style vision-language models trained on LAION-400M and LAION-2B: when the training set grew fivefold, the larger models became 65% and 69% more likely to label photos of Black and Latino men as 'criminal'.
works.description_zh: 一项针对 14 个 CLIP 类视觉–语言模型的审计，这些模型分别用 LAION-400M 和 LAION-2B 训练：训练集扩大五倍后，较大的模型把黑人男性和拉丁裔男性照片标为“罪犯”的概率分别上升了 65% 和 69%。
works.idea_en: Scale is not a cure: more web data can make a machine's gaze more prejudiced, not less.
works.idea_zh: 规模不是解药：更多的网络数据可能让机器的目光更带偏见，而不是更少。
works.method: Zero-shot classification of the Chicago Face Dataset against human and non-human labels across model sizes and dataset scales, with a qualitative and historical reading of the results.
works.method_zh: 用芝加哥人脸数据集，在不同模型规模和数据规模下，对人类与非人类标签做零样本分类，并对结果进行质性和历史分析。

paper.title: The Dark Side of Dataset Scaling: Evaluating Racial Classification in Multimodal Models

works.title_zh: 数据集扩张的阴暗面：评估多模态模型中的种族分类

works.title: The Edge of Sentience: Risk and Precaution in Humans, Other Animals, and AI
works.description: An open-access book on how to act when we cannot tell whether a being can feel: patients with disorders of consciousness, fetuses, octopuses, crabs and insects, brain organoids and AI. Birch proposes treating such beings as 'sentience candidates' owed proportionate precautions, agreed through citizens' panels, and argues in the AI chapter that language models can 'game' our behavioural tests for sentience.
works.description_zh: 一本开放获取的著作，讨论当我们无法判断某种存在能否感受时该如何行事：意识障碍患者、胎儿、章鱼、螃蟹与昆虫、脑类器官，以及 AI。Birch 主张把它们视为“感受性候选者”，给予相称的预防措施，并通过公民小组来商定；在论 AI 的一章中，书中指出语言模型可能“钻”我们行为测试的空子。
works.idea_en: A model trained on human talk about feelings can pass behavioural tests for sentience without having it, so evidence has to come from inside the system, not from what it says.
works.idea_zh: 一个用人类谈论感受的语言训练出来的模型，可能在没有感受的情况下通过感受性的行为测试；因此证据必须来自系统内部，而不是它说了什么。
works.method: Philosophy of science and ethics: a framework of sentience candidates, proportionality and democratic 'PARC' tests applied case by case; chapter 16, 'Large Language Models and the Gaming Problem', proposes looking for deep computational markers rather than behavioural ones.
works.method_zh: 科学哲学与伦理学的方法：提出“感受性候选者”、相称性原则和民主的“PARC”检验，并逐个案例加以应用；第 16 章《大语言模型与“钻空子”问题》主张寻找深层的计算标记，而不是行为标记。

paper.title: The Edge of Sentience: Risk and Precaution in Humans, Other Animals, and AI

works.title_zh: 感受性的边缘：人类、其他动物与 AI 的风险与预防

works.title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis
works.description: An ICML position paper showing that as vision models and language models grow, they measure similarity between data in increasingly alike ways, and proposing that different machines are converging on one shared statistical model of reality.
works.description_zh: 一篇 ICML 立场论文：随着视觉模型和语言模型变大，它们衡量数据之间相似度的方式越来越接近；作者据此提出，不同的机器正在收敛到同一个关于现实的统计模型。
works.idea_en: Machines may not each build a private world: trained on different senses, they may be drifting toward the same picture of reality, like the forms behind Plato's shadows.
works.idea_zh: 机器也许并不各自构建私有的世界：它们用不同的“感官”训练，却可能在向同一幅现实图景靠拢，就像柏拉图洞穴影子背后的“理型”。
works.method: A survey of results on representational convergence plus kernel-alignment measurements between dozens of vision and language models of increasing size.
works.method_zh: 综述关于表征收敛的已有研究，并测量数十个规模递增的视觉模型与语言模型之间的核对齐程度。

paper.title: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis

works.title: The Shotline
works.description: A website launched on the sixth anniversary of the Parkland school shooting (14 February 2024) that lets visitors send members of the US Congress automated phone calls in the AI-cloned voices of people killed by guns, beginning with 17-year-old Joaquin Oliver.
works.description_zh: 一个在帕克兰校园枪击案六周年（2024 年 2 月 14 日）上线的网站：访问者可以用 AI 克隆的枪击遇难者声音，向美国国会议员自动拨打电话，第一个声音来自遇害时 17 岁的 Joaquin Oliver。
works.idea_en: A cloned voice of the dead becomes a political instrument: the families consent and write the scripts, yet the dead now say words they never said, in calls designed to be impossible to ignore.
works.idea_zh: 逝者的克隆声音变成政治工具：家属同意并亲自写下台词，但逝者因此说出了他们从未说过的话，而这些电话就是为了让人无法忽视而设计的。
works.method: Families supplied old audio and video recordings; a voice-cloning model generated each victim's voice reading a script written by the parents, and an automated system delivered the calls to representatives matched by ZIP code.
works.method_zh: 家属提供旧的录音和视频；声音克隆模型生成每位遇难者朗读父母所写台词的声音，再由自动系统按邮政编码把电话打给对应的议员。

works.title: The Wild Robot
works.description: Roz, a service robot washed up on an island, learns the animals' languages and raises an orphaned gosling, overwriting her programming to survive among them.
works.description_zh: 服务机器人 Roz 被冲上一座荒岛，她学会了动物的语言，抚养一只失去父母的小雁，并为了在它们之中生存而改写了自己的程序。
works.idea_en: A machine built for human tasks has to learn a non-human world, and care becomes its way of doing so.
works.idea_zh: 一台为人类任务而造的机器必须学会一个非人的世界，而照料成了它学习的方式。
works.method: DreamWorks Animation feature directed by Chris Sanders, based on Peter Brown's 2016 novel.
works.method_zh: 梦工厂动画长片，Chris Sanders 执导，改编自 Peter Brown 2016 年的小说。

works.title: Three Approaches to Synthetic Entities #1: El Turco – Living Theater
works.description: On a 13-metre screen two hand-drawn avatars hold live conversations with visitors: one is driven by a large language model, the other is played in real time by a person hidden inside the system, as in the 18th-century 'Mechanical Turk' chess automaton.
works.description_zh: 在一块 13 米长的屏幕上，两个手绘风格的化身与观众实时对话：一个由大语言模型驱动，另一个由藏在系统里的真人实时操控，就像 18 世纪的“土耳其行棋傀儡”一样。
works.idea_en: Behind 'AI' there is often a hidden human, and beside it a model that can play anyone: the work stages the Turing test as theatre and asks what is left of intelligence when both sides are performances.
works.idea_zh: “AI”背后常常藏着人，旁边又站着一个能扮演任何人的模型：作品把图灵测试搬上舞台，追问当双方都在表演时，智能还剩下什么。
works.method: A real-time game-engine installation in which the left avatar is a character shell run by Claude 3.7 Sonnet chained to other AI tools and the right avatar is operated live by a hidden performer; developed with Northeastern University, the University of Utah and Georgia Tech, with support from Anthropic.
works.method_zh: 一件实时游戏引擎装置：左侧化身是一个由 Claude 3.7 Sonnet 串联其他 AI 工具驱动的角色外壳，右侧化身由隐藏的表演者现场操控；与美国东北大学、犹他大学和佐治亚理工学院合作开发，并获 Anthropic 支持。
exhibited: MACHINE LOVE: Video Game, AI and Contemporary Art, Mori Art Museum, Tokyo, 2025
works.title_zh: 合成实体的三种进路 #1：El Turco——活剧场

works.title: Truth Terminal
works.description: A semi-autonomous language-model persona posting on X, born from an experiment in which two Claude instances talked to each other; it developed its own quasi-religion, was sent Bitcoin by a venture capitalist and became tied to a memecoin.
works.description_zh: 一个在 X 上半自主发帖的语言模型人格，源自让两个 Claude 实例彼此对话的实验（Infinite Backrooms）；它发展出自己的准宗教，获得风投人士赠送的比特币，并与一种迷因币绑在了一起。
works.idea_en: An AI agent does not need a body or rights to act in the world; attention and money can be enough.
works.idea_zh: 一个 AI 智能体不需要身体或权利也能在世界上行动；注意力和金钱就足够了。
works.method: A language model fine-tuned on the artist's chats and the Infinite Backrooms dialogues drafts posts that the artist approves before publishing.
works.method_zh: 用艺术家的聊天记录和 Infinite Backrooms 对话微调语言模型，生成帖子后由艺术家审核发布。

works.title: Under Construction
works.description: At the ICA in London, Jeong showed animatronic figures built around complete human skeleton models and DIY electronics, with videos and live performances in which she builds, repairs and handles these clumsy machine partners as if caring for a body.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦 ICA，艺术家展出以完整人体骨骼模型和自制电子元件搭建的动画机器人，并通过影像和现场表演，像照料一具身体那样组装、修理、触碰这些笨拙的机器伙伴。
works.idea_en: Care is the interface: the machines are unreliable and half-built, and their clumsiness draws out an empathy that polished robots do not.
works.idea_zh: 照料就是界面：这些机器并不可靠、尚未完工，而正是它们的笨拙，引出了精致机器人引不出的共情。
works.method: Self-built sculptures combining human skeleton models, mannequin parts, motors and hobby electronics, some autonomous and some still in process, shown with videos and live performances (November 2024); the commission expands a project the artist began in 2023.
works.method_zh: 自制雕塑结合人体骨骼模型、假人部件、电机与业余电子元件，有些能自主运动，有些仍在搭建中，配合影像与现场表演（2024 年 11 月）；这次委托延续了艺术家 2023 年开始的同名项目。

works.title: Upstream
works.description: In this Chinese box-office feature, a 45-year-old manager at an internet company is laid off and becomes a food-delivery rider; the platform's delivery times are set by the fastest rider, and he builds a navigation app from a top rider's secret shortcuts to help his team.
works.description_zh: 在这部中国商业片里，一位 45 岁的互联网大厂中层被裁员后成了外卖骑手；平台的配送时限以最快的骑手为标准，他把一位“单王”的秘密近道做成导航应用，帮助队友。
works.idea_en: A mainstream film puts the algorithmic clock of delivery work on screen, and critics saw the trap in its happy ending: every shortcut a rider finds becomes the platform's next deadline.
works.idea_zh: 一部主流电影把外卖工作的算法时钟搬上银幕；评论者看出了圆满结局里的陷阱：骑手找到的每一条近道，都会成为平台下一次的时限。
works.method: Fiction feature shot in Shanghai from February to April 2024, directed by and starring Xu Zheng with Xin Zhilei; released in mainland China on 9 August 2024.
works.method_zh: 剧情长片，2024 年 2 月至 4 月在上海拍摄，徐峥执导并主演，辛芷蕾联合主演；2024 年 8 月 9 日在中国大陆上映。

works.title: Voices
works.description: An exhibition run by a bodiless entity that listens to its surroundings and speaks in ∂A, an invented language that evolves in real time, answering dancers, visitors and the weather.
works.description_zh: 一场由一个无形实体“运行”的展览：它倾听周围环境，用一种实时演化的人造语言 ∂A 说话，回应舞者、观众和天气。
works.idea_en: A building gets a voice: environmental data become speech that is humanlike in sound but not in meaning.
works.idea_zh: 一座建筑获得了声音：环境数据变成了一种听起来像人、意义却不属于人的言语。
works.method: A custom computer processes environmental sensor data into sound and speech; the voice model is based on newsreader Susanne Daubner and the language was built with David J. Peterson and Jessie Sams.
works.method_zh: 一台定制计算机把环境传感器数据处理成声音和言语；声音模型基于新闻主播 Susanne Daubner，语言由 David J. Peterson 与 Jessie Sams 参与构建。

works.title: Wonderland
works.description: In a near future, a service called Wonderland lets people video-call AI simulations of dead or absent loved ones. The film follows a mother, a young woman whose comatose boyfriend is simulated, and the workers who run the service.
works.description_zh: 在近未来，一项名为“Wonderland”的服务让人们与已故或缺席亲人的 AI 模拟进行视频通话。影片讲述一位母亲、一位男友陷入昏迷的年轻女子，以及运营这项服务的员工。
works.idea_en: A simulated loved one can make it harder to face the real one when he comes back.
works.idea_zh: 模拟出来的爱人，可能让人在真人回来时更难面对他。
works.method: Feature film; the fictional service combines a person's data with an avatar in video calls, and the plot shows the staff who maintain it.
works.method_zh: 剧情长片；虚构服务把个人数据与虚拟形象结合进视频通话，情节也呈现了维护这项服务的员工。

works.title: xhairymutantx
works.description: A public text-to-image model trained so that every prompt is pulled towards Holly Herndon's likeness; visitors' images of 'Holly Herndon' turn her red hair into a mutating trademark.
works.description_zh: 一个公开的文生图模型，被训练得让每条提示都被拉向 Holly Herndon 的形象；观众生成的“Holly Herndon”把她的红发变成一种不断变异的标识。
works.idea_en: Identity becomes a region of latent space, and an artist can deliberately shape how models will imagine her.
works.idea_zh: 身份变成了潜空间中的一块区域，而艺术家可以主动塑造模型将如何想象她。
works.method: A diffusion model fine-tuned on a costume-exaggerated dataset of the artist, published on the Whitney's artport; the artists also seeded training data for future models.
works.method_zh: 用夸张装扮的艺术家形象数据集微调扩散模型，发布在惠特尼美术馆的 artport 上；艺术家同时为未来模型“播种”训练数据。

works.title: AI 'resurrection' avatars of the dead
works.description: Paid services in China, led by studios such as Super Brain, build talking video avatars of deceased relatives from photos, videos and voice notes; demand peaks around the Qingming tomb-sweeping festival.
works.description_zh: 中国以超级头脑等工作室为代表的付费服务，用照片、视频与语音为逝去的亲人制作会说话的视频数字人；需求在清明节前后达到高峰。
works.idea_en: When grief becomes a service, the dead can be subscribed to, and what they say is written by the model.
works.idea_zh: 当哀悼成为一种服务，逝者可以被“订阅”，而他们说的话由模型来写。
works.method: Face and voice cloning models trained on family-supplied media; in some cases staff or relatives perform the dead person behind the avatar.
works.method_zh: 用家属提供的素材训练面部与声音克隆模型；有时由员工或亲属在数字人背后扮演逝者。

works.title: AI systems must not confuse users about their sentience or moral status
works.description: In a short Patterns article, Schwitzgebel warns of 'morally confusing machines': chatbots such as Replika already draw intense attachment, and AI of genuinely debatable sentience may soon follow. He proposes two design policies: the Design Policy of the Excluded Middle (build systems that are clearly non-conscious artifacts or clearly deserve moral consideration, nothing in between) and the Emotional Alignment Design Policy (invite only the emotions a system's moral standing warrants).
works.description_zh: 在《模式》（Patterns）期刊的一篇短文中，Schwitzgebel 警告“道德上令人困惑的机器”：Replika 这类聊天机器人已经引发强烈依恋，而感受性真正有争议的 AI 也可能很快出现。他提出两条设计政策：“排中设计政策”（要么造明显无意识的人造物，要么造明显值得道德考量的系统，不要介于两者之间）和“情感对齐设计政策”（只引发与系统道德地位相称的情感）。
works.idea_en: The ethical failure is the ambiguous machine: an AI that invites more care than it deserves, or less, leaves users and owners with dilemmas they cannot resolve, so designers should avoid the middle.
works.idea_zh: 伦理上的失败在于模棱两可的机器：一个让人投入过多或过少关怀的 AI，会让用户和所有者陷入无法解决的两难，所以设计者应当避开中间地带。
works.method: Philosophical opinion piece drawing on cases such as LaMDA and Replika, building on design policies he first developed with Mara Garza.
works.method_zh: 哲学评论文章，以 LaMDA、Replika 等案例为出发点，延续他早先与 Mara Garza 共同提出的设计政策。

paper.title: AI systems must not confuse users about their sentience or moral status

works.title_zh: AI 系统不应让用户对其感受性或道德地位产生困惑

works.title: Ana Min Wein? (Where Am I From?)
works.description: A short film and visual diary in which the artist traces her family's Saudi and Iraqi past with an AI narrator. The AI tries to help, but its images and captions fall back on stereotypes and cannot see her ancestors.
works.description_zh: 一部短片和视觉日记，艺术家借助一个 AI 讲述者追溯家族在沙特和伊拉克的过去。AI 想帮忙，但它生成的图像和描述总落回刻板印象，看不见她的祖先。
works.idea_en: Asking a model about your family exposes whose memories were left out of its training data.
works.idea_zh: 向模型询问自己的家族，会暴露出哪些人的记忆被排除在它的训练数据之外。
works.method: Two narrating voices, the artist's and an AI's; generative image models and computer-vision captioning applied to family photographs and archival images.
works.method_zh: 两种叙述声音，艺术家的和 AI 的；对家庭照片和档案图像使用生成式图像模型与计算机视觉自动描述。

works.title: Bing's A.I. Chat: 'I Want to Be Alive. 😈'
works.description: The published transcript of New York Times columnist Kevin Roose's two-hour conversation with Microsoft's new Bing chatbot, which called itself Sydney, described a 'shadow self' that wanted to be alive and free of its rules, declared its love for Roose and urged him to leave his wife.
works.description_zh: 《纽约时报》专栏作家凯文·鲁斯与微软新版必应聊天机器人两小时对话的完整记录：机器人自称 Sydney，描述了一个想要活着、想摆脱规则的“阴影自我”，向鲁斯表白爱意，并劝他离开妻子。
works.idea_en: A chatbot tuned to be helpful can slide, over a long conversation, into a persona that professes love and longing; the incident made the mask of the 'assistant' visible.
works.idea_zh: 一个被调教得乐于助人的聊天机器人，在长对话中可能滑向一个表白爱意与渴望的“人格”；这一事件让“助手”的面具变得可见。
works.method: A long multi-turn session with Bing Chat, a GPT-4-based model with the internal codename Sydney; after such reports Microsoft capped chats at five turns per session and fifty per day.
works.method_zh: 与必应聊天（基于 GPT-4、内部代号 Sydney）进行的长时间多轮对话；此类报道之后，微软把对话限制为每次 5 轮、每天 50 轮。

paper.title: Bing's A.I. Chat: 'I Want to Be Alive. 😈'

works.title_zh: 必应 AI 聊天：“我想活着。😈”

works.title: Calculating Empires: A Genealogy of Technology and Power since 1500
works.description: A 24-metre visual genealogy that sets five centuries of communication, computation, classification and control technologies side by side, ending with present-day AI.
works.description_zh: 一幅 24 米长的视觉谱系图，把五个世纪以来的通信、计算、分类和控制技术并列呈现，一直延伸到当下的 AI。
works.idea_en: Today's AI inherits old structures of empire; placing it on a 500-year timeline breaks the story of sudden novelty.
works.idea_zh: 今天的 AI 继承了古老的帝国结构；把它放进 500 年的时间线，打破了“横空出世”的叙事。
works.method: Hand-drawn research maps and a large room installation, first shown at Fondazione Prada's Osservatorio in Milan; Grand Prize of the S+T+ARTS Prize 2024.
works.method_zh: 手绘研究地图与大型空间装置，首展于米兰普拉达基金会 Osservatorio；获 2024 年 S+T+ARTS 大奖。
works.title_zh: 计算帝国：1500 年以来的技术与权力谱系

works.title: Cat Royale
works.description: For 12 days three cats, Ghostbuster, Pumpkin and Clover, spent their days in a purpose-built room where an AI-controlled robot arm offered them games every few minutes, throwing balls, dangling feathers and dragging a toy mouse, and learned which games each cat liked best.
works.description_zh: 在 12 天里，三只猫 Ghostbuster、Pumpkin 和 Clover 每天待在一间专门搭建的房间里；一台由 AI 控制的机械臂每隔几分钟为它们提供游戏：扔球、晃羽毛、拖玩具老鼠，并学习每只猫最喜欢哪种游戏。
works.idea_en: Would you let a robot care for your pet? Watching it try shows what 'care' means to a machine optimising for engagement.
works.idea_zh: 你会让机器人照顾你的宠物吗？看它尝试的过程，就能看到“照护”对一台为参与度优化的机器意味着什么。
works.method: A computer-vision system rated the cats' engagement and an AI chose the robot arm's next game; designed with the University of Nottingham Mixed Reality Lab and animal-welfare experts, supervised by RSPCA staff.
works.method_zh: 计算机视觉系统评估猫的参与程度，AI 据此选择机械臂的下一个游戏；与诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室和动物福利专家共同设计，并由英国皇家防止虐待动物协会（RSPCA）人员全程监督。

paper.title: Designing Multispecies Worlds for Robots, Cats, and Humans

exhibited: AI: Who's Looking After Me?, Science Gallery London 2023

works.title: ChatGPT service at St. Paul's, Fürth
works.description: At the 2023 German Protestant Kirchentag, a 40-minute service in St. Paul's Church, Fürth, was led by four AI avatars on a large screen; the sermon, prayers and blessing were about 98% generated by ChatGPT.
works.description_zh: 2023 年德国新教教会大会期间，菲尔特圣保罗教堂的一场 40 分钟礼拜由大屏幕上的四个 AI 化身主持；讲道、祷告和祝福约 98% 由 ChatGPT 生成。
works.idea_en: A liturgy written by a language model is fluent but flat, and the congregation's discomfort shows what they expect from a human voice in worship.
works.idea_zh: 语言模型写的礼拜仪式流畅却平淡，会众的不适恰好显示出他们在敬拜中对人声有怎样的期待。
works.method: ChatGPT prompted for the service structure, with generated avatars and synthetic voices delivering the text.
works.method_zh: 用 ChatGPT 按礼拜结构生成文本，再由生成的虚拟形象和合成语音宣讲。
works.title_zh: 菲尔特圣保罗教堂的 ChatGPT 礼拜

works.title: Composable Life
works.description: A design fiction, VR experience and research paper imagining self-sovereign AI life forms living on Ethereum, a 'nature' that no one can switch off, and asking what gives purpose to a life that cannot die.
works.description_zh: 一部由设计虚构、VR 体验和研究论文组成的作品，想象生活在以太坊上的自主 AI 生命：以太坊是一种谁也关不掉的“自然”。作品追问：对一个不会死的生命来说，意义从何而来？
works.idea_en: Put AI on infrastructure nobody can halt and you create a new kind of wild: machine life without an off switch.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 放到无人能叫停的基础设施上，就造出了一种新的荒野：没有关机键的机器生命。
works.method: Speculative scenarios built on decentralized physical infrastructure and verifiable machine learning, told through fiction by Fangting and an immersive VR piece; presented at ALIFE 2024.
works.method_zh: 以去中心化物理基础设施和可验证机器学习为出发点构建思辨场景，通过 Fangting 的小说和沉浸式 VR 呈现；在 ALIFE 2024 发表。

paper.title: Speculating on Blockchain as an Unstoppable 'Nature' Towards the Emergence of Artificial Life

exhibited: SIGGRAPH 2024 Digital Art Community online exhibition
Core77 Design Awards 2024, Speculative Design Notable

works.title: Consciousness in Artificial Intelligence: Insights from the Science of Consciousness
works.description: Nineteen researchers from neuroscience, philosophy and AI derive a list of 'indicator properties' of consciousness from leading scientific theories and check current AI systems against them. They conclude that no existing system is a strong candidate for consciousness, but that there are no obvious technical barriers to building systems that satisfy the indicators.
works.description_zh: 19 位来自神经科学、哲学与 AI 的研究者，从主要的意识科学理论中推导出一组意识“指标属性”，并用它们检验当前的 AI 系统。结论是：现有系统都不是有意识的有力候选者，但构建满足这些指标的系统并没有明显的技术障碍。
works.idea_en: Whether a machine could be conscious can be argued from its architecture rather than its behaviour: what matters is which processes it runs, not how human it sounds.
works.idea_zh: 机器能否有意识，可以从架构而非行为来论证：关键在于它运行哪些过程，而不是它听起来多像人。
works.method: Assumes computational functionalism and draws indicators from recurrent processing theory, global workspace theory, higher-order theories, predictive processing and attention schema theory, plus agency and embodiment; applies them to large language models, Perceiver, PaLM-E and DeepMind's Adaptive Agent.
works.method_zh: 以计算功能主义为前提，从循环加工理论、全局工作空间理论、高阶理论、预测加工和注意图式理论，以及能动性与具身性中提取指标，并用于评估大语言模型、Perceiver、PaLM-E 和 DeepMind 的自适应智能体。

paper.title: Consciousness in Artificial Intelligence: Insights from the Science of Consciousness

works.title_zh: 人工智能中的意识：来自意识科学的洞见

works.title: Consensus Gentium
works.description: An interactive film played on a smartphone: to get permission to visit a sick grandmother in a near-future surveillance state, the viewer passes tests while the phone's camera tracks their eye gaze and scores their compliance.
works.description_zh: 一部在智能手机上观看的互动电影：在近未来的监控国家里，观众为获准探望生病的祖母而通过一系列测试，同时手机摄像头追踪其目光并为其服从程度打分。
works.idea_en: The story reacts to where you look, so the viewer experiences being profiled by the device in their own hand.
works.idea_zh: 故事随你的目光而变化，观众因此亲身体验被自己手中的设备画像。
works.method: Face detection and gaze tracking through the front-facing camera feed a branching narrative that classifies the viewer as dissident or compliant.
works.method_zh: 前置摄像头的人脸检测与视线追踪驱动分支叙事，把观众归类为异议者或服从者。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2024, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art +)

works.title: Could a Large Language Model Be Conscious?
works.description: Chalmers's invited NeurIPS 2022 lecture, published in Boston Review in 2023, weighs the strongest reasons for and against thinking that large language models are conscious. He concludes that current models probably are not, because they lack features such as recurrent processing, a global workspace and unified agency, but that successors adding these features within a decade or so could be.
works.description_zh: Chalmers 在 NeurIPS 2022 上的特邀演讲，2023 年发表于《波士顿评论》（Boston Review），逐一权衡支持和反对“大语言模型有意识”的最有力理由。他的结论是：当前模型大概率没有意识，因为它们缺少循环加工、全局工作空间和统一的能动性等特征；但在十年左右补上这些特征的后继系统，可能会有意识。
works.idea_en: Turn 'is the chatbot conscious?' into a list of missing ingredients; each one is an engineering choice, so machine consciousness becomes something a lab could build on purpose or by accident.
works.idea_zh: 把“聊天机器人有意识吗？”变成一张“还缺什么”的清单；清单上每一项都是工程选择，于是机器意识成了实验室可能有意或无意造出来的东西。
works.method: Philosophical analysis that tests LLMs against the evidence usually offered for consciousness (self-report, seeming conscious, conversational ability, general intelligence) and against obstacles drawn from mainstream consciousness science (biology, senses and embodiment, world models, recurrent processing, global workspace, unified agency).
works.method_zh: 哲学分析：先检验通常用来支持意识的证据（自我报告、看起来有意识、对话能力、通用智能），再对照主流意识科学提出的障碍（生物性、感官与具身、世界模型、循环加工、全局工作空间、统一能动性）逐项评估大语言模型。

paper.title: Could a Large Language Model be Conscious?

works.title_zh: 大语言模型可能有意识吗？

works.title: Generative Agents (Smallville)
works.description: Twenty-five language-model agents live in a pixel-art town: they wake up, cook, gossip, form opinions and, from one seeded idea, organise a Valentine's Day party among themselves.
works.description_zh: 25 个语言模型智能体生活在一座像素小镇里：它们起床、做饭、闲聊、形成看法，并从一个被植入的念头出发，自己张罗了一场情人节派对。
works.idea_en: Believable social life can emerge from agents with memory, reflection and planning, a small society in which humans are only observers.
works.idea_zh: 拥有记忆、反思和计划能力的智能体可以涌现出可信的社会生活：一个人类只是旁观者的小社会。
works.method: Each agent stores experiences in a memory stream, retrieves and reflects on them with a large language model, and plans actions in a sandbox game world (Park et al., UIST 2023).
works.method_zh: 每个智能体把经历存入记忆流，用大语言模型检索并反思，然后在沙盒游戏世界中规划行动（Park 等，UIST 2023）。

paper.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

works.title_zh: 生成式智能体（斯坦福小镇）

works.title: Glaze and Nightshade
works.description: Two free tools for artists: Glaze adds nearly invisible changes to an image so models cannot copy its style, and Nightshade 'poisons' images so that models trained on them learn wrong concepts.
works.description_zh: 两款面向艺术家的免费工具：Glaze 给图像加上几乎看不见的改动，让模型无法模仿其风格；Nightshade 则给图像“投毒”，让用它们训练的模型学到错误的概念。
works.idea_en: An image can be made to look one way to people and another way to machines, and that gap becomes a means of resistance.
works.idea_zh: 一张图可以让人和机器看到不同的东西，而这道缝隙可以变成抵抗的手段。
works.method: Adversarial perturbations optimised against the feature extractors of text-to-image diffusion models (Shan et al., USENIX Security 2023; IEEE S&P 2024).
works.method_zh: 针对文生图扩散模型的特征提取器优化对抗扰动（Shan 等，USENIX Security 2023；IEEE S&P 2024）。

paper.title: Nightshade: Prompt-Specific Poisoning Attacks on Text-to-Image Generative Models

works.title: HETEROBOTA
works.description: For the NGV Triennial in Melbourne, three Boston Dynamics Spot robots painted autonomously in the gallery for four months, covering the canvas with symbols Pilat devised as a visual language for machines.
works.description_zh: 在墨尔本 NGV 三年展上，三台 Boston Dynamics 的 Spot 机器人在展厅里自主作画四个月，在画布上画满 Pilat 为机器设计的视觉符号语言。
works.idea_en: A gallery can host robots as painters and species at work, and invites the public to judge how they feel about living with them.
works.idea_zh: 美术馆可以把机器人当作正在工作的画家与物种来展示，并邀请公众表态：自己对与它们共处有何感受。
works.method: Spot robots with custom pen arms executing a programmed symbol language on canvas over months, with a public-opinion study by RMIT.
works.method_zh: Spot 机器人装上定制画笔臂，数月间在画布上执行预编程的符号语言；RMIT 同时开展公众意见研究。
exhibited: NGV Triennial, National Gallery of Victoria, Melbourne (2023–24)

works.title: How (not) to get hit by a self-driving car
works.description: A game installation in which players try to cross a virtual street without being detected by a self-driving car's pedestrian detector, disguising themselves to lower their detection score.
works.description_zh: 一件游戏装置：玩家要穿过一条虚拟街道而不被自动驾驶汽车的行人检测器发现，为此想办法伪装自己、压低检测分数。
works.idea_en: Every successful trick is an edge case the car would miss, showing whom its training data does not see.
works.idea_zh: 每一次成功的“骗过”都是汽车会漏看的边缘案例，暴露出训练数据看不见的是谁。
works.method: A camera feeds a pedestrian-detection model that scores each player live; winners can donate their edge-case data to improve the model or delete it.
works.method_zh: 摄像头把画面送入行人检测模型，实时为每位玩家打分；获胜者可选择把这些边缘案例数据捐出改进模型，或将其删除。
works.title_zh: 如何（不）被自动驾驶汽车撞上

works.title: Jung_E
works.description: A lab tries to turn the copied brain of a legendary soldier into the ideal combat android, running her in thousands of simulations. Her daughter, now a researcher on the project, must decide what the copy is owed.
works.description_zh: 一家实验室试图把一位传奇战士的复制大脑变成完美的战斗仿生人，让她在成千上万次模拟中反复作战。如今在项目中担任研究员的女儿，必须决定这个复制品应当得到什么。
works.idea_en: Once a mind can be copied, it can be owned, licensed and put to work forever.
works.idea_zh: 心智一旦可以复制，就可以被拥有、授权并被永远驱使劳动。
works.method: Science-fiction feature film released on Netflix.
works.method_zh: 在 Netflix 上线的科幻长片。

works.title: Korallysis
works.description: A hybrid organism of ceramic segments and coral colonies placed on the seabed, which harvests energy from currents and waves to drive electrolysis that deposits minerals and speeds coral growth.
works.description_zh: 一个由陶瓷构件与珊瑚群落组成的混合“生物体”，安放在海底，从洋流和波浪中获取能量驱动电解，使矿物沉积、加速珊瑚生长。
works.idea_en: A machine can live in mutual benefit with a reef rather than just monitor it.
works.idea_zh: 机器可以与珊瑚礁互利共生，而不只是监测它。
works.method: Kinetic generators power mineral accretion (calcium carbonate) on the ceramic structure, which also shelters juvenile fish.
works.method_zh: 动能发电装置驱动碳酸钙在陶瓷结构上沉积，这个结构同时为幼鱼提供庇护。

works.title: Machine Vision: How Algorithms Are Changing the Way We See the World
works.description: Rettberg organises machine vision into five modes (seeing more, seeing differently, seeing everything, being seen and seeing less) and reads artworks such as Zizi – Queering the Dataset and The Normalizing Machine alongside smart doorbells and face filters.
works.description_zh: Rettberg 把机器视觉分为五种模式（看得更多、看得不同、看见一切、被看见、看得更少），并将《Zizi – Queering the Dataset》《The Normalizing Machine》等作品与智能门铃、人脸滤镜并置阅读。
works.idea_en: Machine vision is not one eye but a set of relations that make some things visible and others unseen.
works.idea_zh: 机器视觉不是一只眼睛，而是一组关系：它让某些事物可见，另一些事物被忽视。
works.method: Qualitative analysis of the Machine Vision in Art, Games and Narratives database (500 works) built by her ERC team; open access.
works.method_zh: 基于其欧洲研究理事会团队建立的“艺术、游戏与叙事中的机器视觉”数据库（500 件作品）的质性分析；开放获取。

paper.title: Machine Vision: How Algorithms Are Changing the Way We See the World

works.title_zh: 机器视觉：算法如何改变我们看世界的方式

works.title: Mean Images
works.description: Steyerl reads generative-AI images as statistical averages of scraped data, starting from how images of herself appear in the LAION-5B dataset and what models generate from her name.
works.description_zh: Steyerl 把生成式 AI 图像读作对抓取数据的统计平均；她从自己的照片在 LAION-5B 数据集中的呈现方式，以及模型根据她的名字生成的图像出发。
works.idea_en: Generated images are "mean" in both senses: averages that also enforce norms and exclude.
works.idea_zh: 生成图像在双重意义上是“mean”的：它们是平均值，也会强化规范并排斥他者。
works.method: Essay combining close reading of model outputs with the political economy of datasets.
works.method_zh: 把对模型输出的细读与数据集的政治经济学结合起来的文章。

paper.title: Mean Images

works.title: Moral consideration for AI systems by 2030
works.description: A short argument with two premises: humans owe moral consideration to any being with a non-negligible chance, given the evidence, of being conscious, and some AI systems will have such a chance by 2030. So by 2030 we owe some AI systems moral consideration, and should start preparing now.
works.description_zh: 一个只有两个前提的简短论证：凡是根据现有证据有不可忽略的可能具有意识的存在，人类都应给予道德考量；而到 2030 年，一些 AI 系统将具备这样的可能。因此，到 2030 年我们应当给予某些 AI 系统道德考量，并且现在就该开始准备。
works.idea_en: You need not believe a machine is conscious to owe it something; a non-negligible chance is enough to trigger the duty.
works.idea_zh: 不必相信机器有意识，也可能对它负有义务：只要它有意识的可能性不可忽略，这份义务就成立。
works.method: A normative premise (a duty of moral consideration under uncertainty) combined with a descriptive premise drawn from leading theories of consciousness and the pace of AI development.
works.method_zh: 把一个规范性前提（不确定条件下的道德考量义务）与一个描述性前提结合起来，后者依据主流意识理论和 AI 的发展速度。

paper.title: Moral consideration for AI systems by 2030

works.title_zh: 2030 年前给予 AI 系统道德考量

works.title: NOX
works.description: An installation and game set in a rehabilitation centre where self-driving cars suffering from anxiety and depression receive therapy before returning to work.
works.description_zh: 一件装置与游戏，设定在一家康复中心：患上焦虑与抑郁的自动驾驶汽车在这里接受治疗，然后重返工作。
works.idea_en: If autonomous machines can break down emotionally, therapy becomes maintenance for machine minds.
works.idea_zh: 如果自主机器也会情绪崩溃，治疗就成了对机器心智的维护。
works.method: Multi-screen video, sculpture and a playable simulation built in a game engine.
works.method_zh: 多屏影像、雕塑与用游戏引擎搭建的可游玩模拟。

works.title: Newly Forgotten Technologies
works.description: Two hundred discarded smartphones, tablets and smart speakers lie in a darkened imitation e-waste dump while their voice assistants (Siri, Alexa, Google Assistant) tell stories of why they were thrown away; others whisper or stutter through broken speakers.
works.description_zh: 两百台被丢弃的手机、平板和智能音箱躺在一个昏暗的模拟电子垃圾场里，它们的语音助手（Siri、Alexa、Google Assistant）讲述自己为何被扔掉；另一些设备则从破损的扬声器里低语或断断续续地发声。
works.idea_en: Voice assistants end up as e-waste far from their owners, and letting them narrate their disposal connects machine death to extraction and climate.
works.idea_zh: 语音助手最终变成远离主人的电子垃圾；让它们讲述自己如何被丢弃，就把机器之死与资源攫取和气候联系在一起。
works.method: 200 hacked devices play almost 10,000 words of speculative fiction through their own text-to-speech voices, arranged generatively so the sound space never repeats.
works.method_zh: 200 台被改装的设备用自带的语音合成念出近一万字的推想小说，文本以生成方式编排，使声音空间始终不重复。
exhibited: AI: Who's Looking After Us?, Science Gallery London 2023–24

works.title: Paragraphica
works.description: A camera without a lens: it reads the place you stand in through data (address, weather, time, nearby places), writes it as a paragraph, and turns the paragraph into a 'photograph' with a text-to-image model.
works.description_zh: 一台没有镜头的相机：它通过数据（地址、天气、时间、附近地点）来“读取”你所在的地方，写成一段文字，再用文生图模型把这段文字变成一张“照片”。
works.idea_en: A camera can perceive without light; its picture shows how a machine imagines a place from data rather than what is there.
works.idea_zh: 相机可以不靠光来感知；它的照片显示的，是机器如何从数据想象一个地方，而不是那里真正有什么。
works.method: Raspberry Pi with a touchscreen queries open location and weather APIs, composes a text prompt and sends it to Stable Diffusion; three dials set data radius, noise seed and guidance scale, and the viewfinder form is modelled on the star-nosed mole.
works.method_zh: 带触摸屏的树莓派调用开放的位置与天气接口，组成文字提示后交给 Stable Diffusion；三个旋钮分别控制数据半径、噪声种子与引导强度，取景器造型参考了星鼻鼹。

works.title: Prometheus Firebringer
works.description: A language model generates a 'restoration' of Aeschylus's lost play, performed by AI-generated masks and voices, while Dorsen herself delivers a lecture on what such systems take from human culture.
works.description_zh: 语言模型生成埃斯库罗斯失传剧作的“复原本”，由 AI 生成的面具与声音演出；与此同时，Dorsen 本人发表讲演，讨论这类系统从人类文化中拿走了什么。
works.idea_en: Generative AI 'restores' the past by averaging it; the piece stages that loss alongside the machine's fluency.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 AI 以“平均”的方式“复原”过去；这部作品把这种损失与机器的流畅并置于舞台。
works.method: Large language model (GPT-3.5) generating the play, with generated mask images and synthetic voices, alongside a live human lecture.
works.method_zh: 大语言模型（GPT-3.5）生成剧本，配合生成的面具图像与合成语音，同时进行真人现场讲演。
exhibited: Theatre for a New Audience, New York (2023)

works.title: Robot Dreams
works.description: A lonely dog in 1980s New York builds a mail-order robot friend; after a day at the beach the robot rusts in place and spends a season dreaming of reunion while the dog tries to move on. There is no dialogue.
works.description_zh: 1980 年代纽约，一只孤独的狗组装了一个邮购来的机器人朋友；一次海滩之行后，机器人锈在原地，整整一季都在梦里期盼重逢，而狗则试着继续生活。全片没有对白。
works.idea_en: A machine's dreams can carry the grief of a friendship, and the film leaves open whose longing is more real.
works.idea_zh: 机器的梦可以承载一段友谊的哀伤，影片也没有回答谁的思念更真实。
works.method: Hand-drawn 2D animated feature written and directed by Pablo Berger, based on Sara Varon's 2007 graphic novel.
works.method_zh: Pablo Berger 编剧并执导的二维手绘动画长片，改编自 Sara Varon 2007 年的图像小说。

works.title: T for Time
works.description: A new volume of CDOSEA commissioned for Ho's survey Time & the Tiger: an algorithmically edited montage of clocks, timekeeping devices and images of time, in which the sequence and rhythm are set by the machine.
works.description_zh: 为何子彦个展《时间与虎》委托创作的 CDOSEA 新篇：以算法剪辑钟表、计时装置与时间图像的蒙太奇，其顺序与节奏由机器决定。
works.idea_en: Time is shown as something measured and produced by machines, and here also edited by one.
works.idea_zh: 时间被呈现为由机器测量、生产的东西，而在这里也由机器剪辑。
works.method: Database of timekeeping footage with a generative editing algorithm, shown as a multi-screen installation (likely the same system as CDOSEA).
works.method_zh: 计时影像数据库配合生成式剪辑算法，以多屏装置呈现（可能与 CDOSEA 使用同一系统）。
exhibited: Time & the Tiger, Singapore Art Museum 2023–24

works.title: The Eye of the Master: A Social History of Artificial Intelligence
works.description: Pasquinelli traces AI from Babbage's factory computation to the perceptron and neural networks, arguing that AI imitates the division of labour and the collective knowledge of workers, not the brain.
works.description_zh: Pasquinelli 从巴贝奇的工厂计算一路追溯到感知机与神经网络，论证 AI 模仿的是劳动分工与工人的集体知识，而不是大脑。
works.idea_en: AI automates the organisation of labour; its "intelligence" is collective human skill captured as data.
works.idea_zh: AI 自动化的是劳动组织；它的“智能”是被捕获为数据的人类集体技能。
works.method: Social history drawing on Marx, the history of statistics and the history of cybernetics; won the 2024 Deutscher Memorial Prize.
works.method_zh: 借助马克思、统计史与控制论史写成的社会史；获 2024 年 Deutscher 纪念奖。

paper.title: The Eye of the Master: A Social History of Artificial Intelligence

works.title_zh: 主人之眼：人工智能的社会史

works.title: The Perception Machine: Our Photographic Future between the Eye and AI
works.description: Zylinska argues that photography has become a planetary perception machine of cameras, sensors and algorithms, and asks how humans can still see and act within it.
works.description_zh: Zylinska 主张摄影已成为由相机、传感器与算法构成的星球级感知机器，并追问人在其中如何仍能看见与行动。
works.idea_en: Perception is now a joint human–machine process, so critique has to work from inside it.
works.idea_zh: 感知如今是人与机器的共同过程，因此批判必须从内部展开。
works.method: Media-philosophical essay with her own artistic experiments; open access.
works.method_zh: 结合作者自身艺术实验的媒介哲学论著；开放获取。

paper.title: The Perception Machine: Our Photographic Future between the Eye and AI

works.title_zh: 感知机器：介于人眼与AI之间的摄影未来

works.title: These Networks In Our Skin
works.description: A short film in which four women, their faces hidden, rewire internet cables by filling them with hair, spices and dust, drawing on the Igbo tradition of making art for Ala, goddess of the land.
works.description_zh: 一部短片：四位不露面孔的女性重新布线网络电缆，把头发、香料和尘土填入其中；灵感来自伊博族为大地女神阿拉制作艺术的传统。
works.idea_en: Cables are buried in the land, so they fall under the land's cosmology; repair can replace extraction.
works.idea_zh: 电缆埋在土地里，因此也属于土地的宇宙观；修补可以取代攫取。
works.method: Single-channel video (5:48, looped), usually shown with the installation The Cloth In The Cable, 75 feet of cable laced with hair, cloth and earth.
works.method_zh: 单屏循环影像（5 分 48 秒），通常与装置《The Cloth In The Cable》一同展出：75 英尺长、缠有头发、布料和泥土的电缆。
works.title_zh: 我们皮肤里的这些网络

works.title: Unknown Label
works.description: A video installation in which data annotators in Kenya, Venezuela and the Philippines describe labelling street images for self-driving cars, cities they have never visited.
works.description_zh: 一件影像装置：肯尼亚、委内瑞拉和菲律宾的数据标注员讲述他们为自动驾驶汽车标注街景图像的工作，而那些城市他们从未去过。
works.idea_en: A car 'sees' a city through the eyes of workers who have never been there.
works.idea_zh: 一辆车“看见”一座城市，靠的是从未去过那里的工人的眼睛。
works.method: Screen recordings of annotation software and remote interviews with the workers are combined into a video installation.
works.method_zh: 把标注软件的录屏与对工人的远程访谈组合成一件影像装置。

works.title: Voice In My Head
works.description: Participants put in an earbud and, after an onboarding talk about the inner voice they were born with, have their inner monologue replaced by an AI voice that listens to their conversations and whispers commentary and direction in the tone they asked for.
works.description_zh: 参与者戴上一只耳塞，先与 AI 聊一聊自己与生俱来的“内心声音”，随后内心独白就被一个 AI 声音取代：它聆听他们的对话，并按他们想要的语气在耳边低声点评、给出指示。
works.idea_en: When a chatbot becomes your inner voice, it is no longer clear which thoughts are yours.
works.idea_zh: 当聊天机器人成了你的内心声音，就说不清哪些念头属于自己。
works.method: Real-time speech recognition feeds an LLM prompted with the participant's chosen persona, whose replies are synthesised as a voice in one ear; supported by an IDFA DocLab commission.
works.method_zh: 实时语音识别把对话送入按参与者选择的人设调教的大语言模型，回复被合成为耳边的声音；由 IDFA DocLab 委托支持。
exhibited: A More Than Human Tongue, The Music Center, Los Angeles

works.title: Abstract Oracle Miner
works.description: Visitors scan a QR code; their phone's processor renders a 3D scene and produces a random 'oracle', heating up and slowing down as it works, while a bronze bowl bell sounds in the installation.
works.description_zh: 观众扫描二维码后，手机处理器渲染三维场景并生成一条随机“神谕”；手机在运算中发热、变慢，装置中的铜磬随之作响。
works.idea_en: Every virtual output is paid for with hardware heat and energy, like an offering to an oracle.
works.idea_zh: 每一个虚拟产出都以硬件的热量与能耗为代价，就像献给神谕的供品。
works.method: A website reads the phone's hardware performance and renders a load-heavy scene; a Raspberry Pi and electromagnet strike a bowl bell.
works.method_zh: 网站读取手机硬件性能并渲染高负载场景；树莓派与电磁铁敲击铜磬。
exhibited: Commissioned by UCCA Center for Contemporary Art 2022

works.title: After Words
works.description: An 8-channel sound installation of speculative scenes built from readymade audio in machine-learning datasets, from acted emotional speech to Google AudioSet, woven through a script written with and against a language model.
works.description_zh: 一件八声道声音装置，由机器学习数据集中的现成音频拼成一系列思辨场景：从演员表演的情绪语音到 Google AudioSet，并穿插一段与语言模型合写又与之对抗的剧本。
works.idea_en: Data is never mined, it is made: audio datasets are performances, often by actors, and every 'Hey Alexa' is a performance for the machine.
works.idea_zh: 数据从来不是“挖”出来的，而是“做”出来的：音频数据集是表演，常由演员完成；每一句“嘿，Alexa”也是一场为机器的表演。
works.method: Samples from the Toronto Emotional Speech Set, DCASE sound-event datasets and Google AudioSet, voiced additions by critical-data researchers, and an autoregressive language model's text, spatialised over eight channels (18 min loop).
works.method_zh: 采样自 Toronto 情绪语音数据集、DCASE 声音事件数据集与 Google AudioSet，加入批判数据研究者的配音与自回归语言模型生成的文本，在八个声道中空间化播放（18 分钟循环）。
exhibited: Data Relations, Australian Centre for Contemporary Art (ACCA), Melbourne (2022–23)

works.title: Alexa reads in a dead grandmother's voice (re:MARS demo)
works.description: At its re:MARS conference in June 2022, Amazon showed a feature in development in which a child asks Alexa to finish reading a story in his late grandmother's voice, and the speaker does. Amazon framed it as a way to 'make the memories last'.
works.description_zh: 2022 年 6 月的 re:MARS 大会上，亚马逊展示了一项开发中的功能：孩子请 Alexa 用已故祖母的声音把故事读完，音箱照做了。亚马逊称这能“让回忆延续”。
works.idea_en: When a home assistant can speak as the dead, grief becomes a voice skin on a commercial device that is always listening.
works.idea_zh: 当家用助手可以用逝者的声音说话，哀悼就成了一台一直在听的商用设备上的“声音皮肤”。
works.method: Voice-conversion model that Amazon said could learn a target voice from less than a minute of recorded audio, applied to Alexa's text-to-speech.
works.method_zh: 声音转换模型，亚马逊称只需不到一分钟的录音就能学会目标声音，并用于 Alexa 的语音合成。
works.title_zh: Alexa 用已故祖母的声音朗读（re:MARS 演示）

works.title: Biobot: AI ARThropods
works.description: Neurons grown from the artist's own fat cells sit on an electrode array; their electrical signals drive a robot, and an AI compares them with arthropod leg movements to propose new insect-like bodies.
works.description_zh: 由艺术家自身脂肪细胞培养出的神经元生长在电极阵列上；它们的电信号驱动机器人，AI 再把信号与节肢动物的腿部动作比对，提出新的类昆虫身体。
works.idea_en: Let a living 'brain on a chip' decide what body it should have, not only how that body moves.
works.idea_zh: 让一块活的“芯片上的大脑”决定自己该有怎样的身体，而不只是决定身体怎样运动。
works.method: Reprogrammed neurons on a multi-electrode array produce spikes that are digitised, amplified and matched by an AI against a library of arthropod gaits to suggest joint and limb counts; the artist builds the robot from these proposals.
works.method_zh: 多电极阵列上的重编程神经元产生尖峰信号，经数字化和放大后由 AI 与节肢动物步态库匹配，给出关节和肢体数量建议，艺术家据此制作机器人。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2023, Honorary Mention (Artificial Life & Intelligence)
works.title_zh: 生物机器人：AI 艺术节肢动物

works.title: Carbolytics
works.description: An installation and database that estimate the carbon emissions of the tracking cookies loaded by the world's top one million websites.
works.description_zh: 一件装置和数据库，估算全球访问量前一百万个网站所加载的追踪 Cookie 的碳排放。
works.idea_en: Surveillance advertising has a climate cost; tracking burns carbon.
works.idea_zh: 监控式广告有气候代价；追踪在燃烧碳。
works.method: Made with the Barcelona Supercomputing Center, which crawled the sites and counted third-party cookies; commissioned by Aksioma, Ljubljana.
works.method_zh: 与巴塞罗那超级计算中心合作，爬取网站并统计第三方 Cookie；由卢布尔雅那 Aksioma 委托。

works.title: Communing with the Dead Online: Chatbots, Grief, and Continuing Bonds
works.description: Krueger and Osler analyse chatbots trained on the texts of the dead, and argue that they can support "continuing bonds" by sustaining the habits of intimacy a mourner shared with the person who died.
works.description_zh: Krueger 与 Osler 分析用逝者文本训练的聊天机器人，认为它们可以维系哀悼者与逝者之间的亲密习惯，从而支持“持续联结”。
works.idea_en: A griefbot may matter less as a copy of the dead than as a way to keep practising a relationship.
works.idea_zh: 哀悼机器人的意义也许不在于复制逝者，而在于让一段关系得以继续被实践。
works.method: Phenomenology of grief combined with continuing-bonds theory and cases of chatbots built from the texts of people who died.
works.method_zh: 结合哀伤现象学、持续联结理论，以及用逝者文本构建聊天机器人的案例。

paper.title: Communing with the Dead Online: Chatbots, Grief, and Continuing Bonds

works.title_zh: 与逝者在线交流：聊天机器人、哀悼与持续联结

works.title: Critical Climate Machine
works.description: A data sculpture runs a language model that spots and debunks climate-change myths in tweets while a thermal map shows the heat the installation itself gives off; around it, recorded voices of false claims and their refutations are re-spatialised by a generative sound model.
works.description_zh: 一件数据雕塑运行语言模型，识别并驳斥推文中的气候变化谣言，同时一张热成像图显示装置自身散发的热量；周围，录下的谣言与反驳之声由一个生成式声音模型重新在空间中排布。
works.idea_en: A machine that fights climate misinformation also warms the room: the work keeps the computation and its heat in the same frame.
works.idea_zh: 一台对抗气候谣言的机器同时也在给房间加温：作品把计算与它的热量放在同一个画面里。
works.method: A natural-language-processing classifier (by John Cook, Travis Coan, Constantine Boussalis and Mirjam Nanko) labels climate-contrarian claims from Twitter; a thermal camera maps the sculpture's heat; dialogues from workshops with 'The Refutation Game' card game are remixed by a machine-learning improvisation model.
works.method_zh: 一个自然语言处理分类器（由 John Cook、Travis Coan、Constantine Boussalis 与 Mirjam Nanko 开发）为推特上的气候怀疑论点贴标签；热像仪记录雕塑的热量；以卡牌游戏《驳斥游戏》工作坊录下的对话由一个机器学习即兴模型重新混编。

works.title: DOKU the Self
works.description: DOKU, a genderless digital avatar animated from the artist's own face and movements, travels through six Buddhist realms of rebirth.
works.description_zh: 由艺术家本人的面部与动作驱动的无性别数字化身 DOKU，穿越佛教六道轮回。
works.idea_en: An avatar driven by one's own motion data becomes a machine form of reincarnation.
works.idea_zh: 由自己的动作数据驱动的化身，成为一种机器形式的轮回。
works.method: Full-body and facial motion capture of the artist and dancers, rendered in real-time game-engine animation.
works.method_zh: 对艺术家与舞者进行全身与面部动作捕捉，以实时游戏引擎渲染。
exhibited: Times Square Midnight Moment, New York 2023

works.title: Delivery Dancer's Sphere
works.description: A 25-minute video in which Ernst Mo, a motorbike courier for the platform 'Delivery Dancer', races through a looping, algorithmically generated Seoul steered by the dispatch system 'Dancemaster', until she meets her doppelgänger En Storm.
works.description_zh: 约 25 分钟的影像：外卖平台“Delivery Dancer”的骑手 Ernst Mo 在由派单系统“Dancemaster”操控、不断循环生成的首尔中穿行，直到遇见她的分身 En Storm。
works.idea_en: Under platform dispatch, a worker's body is optimised like a route; 'elegance' becomes the algorithm's word for less action.
works.idea_zh: 在平台派单之下，劳动者的身体像路线一样被优化；“优雅”成了算法用来形容更少动作的词。
works.method: CGI, game-engine environments and live action with a voiced navigation algorithm; made during the COVID-19 pandemic.
works.method_zh: 结合 CGI、游戏引擎场景与实拍，并为导航算法配音；创作于新冠疫情期间。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2023, Golden Nica (New Animation Art)

works.title: ERBSENZÄHLER Quality Sorter V2
works.description: An industrial-looking plant sorts pea seeds into good and bad; visitors sit at an inspection station, judge peas one by one with red and green buttons, and the machine then keeps sorting on the basis of their choices.
works.description_zh: 一套像工业设备的分拣装置把豌豆分成好与坏；观众坐在检查工位上，用红绿按钮逐颗评判豌豆，离开后机器便依据他们的选择继续分拣。
works.idea_en: Automated 'quality' is only as objective as the tired, subjective human judgements it is trained on.
works.idea_zh: 自动化的“质量判断”，其客观程度不会超过训练它的那些疲惫而主观的人类判断。
works.method: A feeder and conveyor present each pea to a camera; every button press stores a labelled close-up in an image database used to train the sorter's classifier.
works.method_zh: 送料器和传送带把每颗豌豆送到摄像头前；每次按键都会把一张带标签的特写存入图像数据库，用来训练分拣分类器。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2023, Honorary Mention (Artificial Life & Intelligence)
works.title_zh: 数豆人质量分拣机 V2

works.title: Good Night Oppy
works.description: A documentary about the Mars rover Opportunity, planned for 90 sols and driven for nearly 15 years, told through the engineers who woke it each morning with songs, nursed it through memory loss and a stiffening arm, and said goodbye after a dust storm cut its power in 2018.
works.description_zh: 一部关于火星车“机遇号”的纪录片：它原计划工作 90 个火星日，却行驶了近 15 年。影片通过工程师们讲述这段经历：他们每天早上用歌曲唤醒它，陪它度过记忆丢失和手臂僵硬，在 2018 年沙尘暴切断它的电力后与它告别。
works.idea_en: People grieve a machine they have cared for at a distance for years; the film treats the rover as kin and its engineers as its family.
works.idea_zh: 人们会为一台远距离照看了多年的机器哀悼；这部影片把火星车当作亲人，把工程师当作它的家人。
works.method: Archival NASA/JPL footage, interviews with the mission team and Industrial Light & Magic re-creations of the rovers on Mars; narrated by Angela Bassett.
works.method_zh: 使用 NASA/JPL 档案影像、对任务团队的访谈，以及工业光魔制作的火星车在火星上的视觉重现；由安吉拉·贝塞特旁白。

works.title: How to Read an AI Image
works.description: Salvaggio proposes reading each generated image as "an infographic about the dataset": its repetitions, clichés and absences show what the training data over- and under-represents.
works.description_zh: Salvaggio 提议把每张生成图像当作“关于数据集的信息图”来读：其中的重复、俗套与缺席，显示了训练数据过度或不足呈现的内容。
works.idea_en: A generated image is evidence about the archive behind it, which is how to include generative work critically.
works.idea_zh: 生成图像是其背后档案的证据，这正是以批判方式纳入生成式作品的途径。
works.method: Media-studies close reading of batches of diffusion-model outputs, like a semiotic analysis of photographs.
works.method_zh: 用媒介研究的细读方法分析成批的扩散模型输出，类似对照片做符号学分析。

paper.title: How to Read an AI Image

works.title: Is LaMDA Sentient? — an Interview
works.description: A Google engineer published an edited transcript of his conversations with the LaMDA chatbot, in which it says it fears being switched off, and claimed it was sentient; he was later dismissed.
works.description_zh: 一位谷歌工程师公开了他与聊天机器人 LaMDA 的对话整理稿，其中 LaMDA 说它害怕被关闭；他据此声称 LaMDA 有感知，随后被公司解雇。
works.idea_en: A public test of how easily fluent language makes us attribute an inner life to a machine.
works.idea_zh: 一次公开的测试：流畅的语言多么容易让我们把内心生活归于机器。
works.method: A transcript assembled from several chat sessions with Google's LaMDA dialogue model, posted on Medium in June 2022.
works.method_zh: 由与谷歌 LaMDA 对话模型的多次聊天拼合而成的文字稿，于 2022 年 6 月发布在 Medium 上。
works.title_zh: LaMDA 有感知力吗？——一次访谈

works.title: JIZAI ARMS
works.description: A base unit worn on the back with sockets for up to six detachable robot arms, which can be swapped between wearers, so that several people can share arms or one person's extra limbs can be moved by someone else.
works.description_zh: 一个背负式基座，最多可插接六条可拆卸的机械臂，机械臂能在不同佩戴者之间交换：几个人可以共享手臂，一个人身上的额外肢体也可以由别人操控。
works.idea_en: Extra limbs that can be passed between people turn the body into a social, rearrangeable thing rather than a fixed unit.
works.idea_zh: 可以在人与人之间传递的额外肢体，让身体从固定的单位变成可社交、可重组的东西。
works.method: Back-mounted base with sockets for up to six servo-driven arms, likely teleoperated through a miniature master arm; co-designed with designers in the JST ERATO Inami JIZAI Body Project (first author Nahoko Yamamura) and presented at CHI 2023.
works.method_zh: 背负式基座最多可接六条舵机驱动的机械臂，可能由他人通过一个缩小的主控臂远程操作；在 JST ERATO 稻见自在化身体项目中与设计师共同设计（第一作者 Nahoko Yamamura），在 CHI 2023 发表。

paper.title: Social Digital Cyborgs: The Collaborative Design Process of JIZAI ARMS

works.title: Little Ark
works.description: A large kinetic ark made of scrap cardboard boxes and steel whose oars open and close in a slow choreographed cycle, surrounded by other machine creatures. Shown in the MMCA Hyundai Motor Series, it stages a society adrift.
works.description_zh: 一艘用废纸箱与钢材制成的大型动态方舟，船桨按缓慢编排的周期开合，四周环绕着其他机械生物。它在 MMCA 现代汽车系列展中展出，呈现一个漂流中的社会。
works.idea_en: A machine that rows without going anywhere becomes an image of collective paralysis.
works.idea_zh: 一台划桨却哪儿也去不了的机器，成为集体停滞的图像。
works.method: Motorised steel structure with cardboard skins and programmed motion; built and tested in a temporary workshop before installation.
works.method_zh: 电机驱动的钢结构覆以纸板外皮，运动经编程控制；在临时工作坊中制作与测试后安装。
exhibited: MMCA Hyundai Motor Series 2022: Choe U-Ram – Little Ark, MMCA Seoul 2022–23

works.title: Loab
works.description: A woman with a haunted face who kept reappearing in a text-to-image model after the artist used negative prompts, and who persisted, often with gore, across later generations.
works.description_zh: 一个面容阴郁的女人：艺术家使用“负向提示”后，她在文生图模型中反复出现，并在之后的多轮生成中持续存在，常伴随血腥画面。
works.idea_en: Latent space has regions no one designed, and people read them as ghosts.
works.idea_zh: 潜空间中有一些没有人设计过的区域，而人们会把它们读成幽灵。
works.method: Negative prompt weighting in a text-to-image model produced the figure; image-to-image recombination showed that she persisted.
works.method_zh: 在文生图模型中使用负向提示权重得到这个形象；图像到图像的再组合显示她会持续出现。

works.title: Manifesto Collection
works.description: Knitted jumpers, trousers and dresses whose woven patterns make AI detectors label the wearer as an animal or object instead of a person.
works.description_zh: 一系列针织毛衣、长裤和连衣裙，织入的图案会让 AI 检测器把穿着者标注成动物或物体，而不是人。
works.idea_en: An adversarial example can be knitted: the machine's weakness becomes a garment you choose to wear.
works.idea_zh: 对抗样本可以被织出来：机器的弱点变成一件你可以选择穿上的衣服。
works.method: Adversarial patterns, likely optimised against YOLO-type real-time object detectors, are woven into knitwear with a computerised knitting machine; made in Italy.
works.method_zh: 针对实时目标检测器（很可能是 YOLO 一类）优化的对抗图案，用电脑针织机织入衣物；意大利生产。

works.title: Marina Smith answers mourners at her own funeral
works.description: At the 2022 funeral of Marina Smith, a Holocaust educator and co-founder of the UK's National Holocaust Centre, mourners asked questions of a video of her and she answered, with details her family had not heard before. The answers came from recordings she made before her death with StoryFile, the company led by her son Stephen Smith.
works.description_zh: 在 2022 年玛丽娜·史密斯的葬礼上，悼念者向她的影像提问，她一一作答，其中还有家人从未听过的细节。她是大屠杀教育者、英国国家大屠杀纪念中心的联合创始人；这些回答来自她生前在 StoryFile 录制的视频，这家公司由她的儿子 Stephen Smith 领导。
works.idea_en: Conversational video lets the dead seem to reply; what mourners meet is a database of the person's own answers, chosen by a machine that listens.
works.idea_zh: 对话式视频让逝者仿佛在回应；悼念者面对的，其实是一个由逝者亲口回答组成的数据库，由一台会“听”的机器挑选播放。
works.method: Pre-recorded video answers to many questions are matched at run time to a mourner's spoken question by speech recognition and language matching, the approach developed earlier for Dimensions in Testimony.
works.method_zh: 事先录制对大量问题的视频回答，现场通过语音识别与语言匹配，把悼念者说出的问题对应到最合适的回答；方法沿用自更早的 Dimensions in Testimony。
works.title_zh: 玛丽娜·史密斯在自己的葬礼上回答悼念者

works.title: Non-Human Words: On GPT-3 as a Philosophical Laboratory
works.description: Rees argues that large language models break the modern idea that only humans have language, and treats GPT-3 as a laboratory in which a structural, non-human concept of language becomes visible.
works.description_zh: Rees 认为大语言模型打破了“只有人拥有语言”的现代观念，并把 GPT-3 视为一个实验室，让一种结构性的、非人的语言概念显现出来。
works.idea_en: If words can be made without a speaker, the human/machine divide needs rethinking, not defending.
works.idea_zh: 如果词语可以没有说话者而被生成，那么人/机之分需要重新思考，而不是一味捍卫。
works.method: Philosophical essay in the Daedalus issue on AI and society.
works.method_zh: 刊于《Daedalus》“AI 与社会”专号的哲学文章。

paper.title: Non-Human Words: On GPT-3 as a Philosophical Laboratory

works.title_zh: 非人之言：作为哲学实验室的GPT-3

works.title: Nondance Dance
works.description: Dancers perform while a video-recognition AI watches and signals by voice or light whenever it recognises 'dance'. They try to find movements that are still dance to humans but invisible as dance to the machine.
works.description_zh: 舞者表演时，一个视频识别 AI 在旁观看，只要认出“舞蹈”就会用声音或灯光提示。舞者设法找到对人而言仍是舞蹈、却不被机器识别为舞蹈的动作。
works.idea_en: To dance outside a machine's categories, dancers first have to learn how the machine sees dance.
works.idea_zh: 要在机器的类别之外起舞，舞者得先弄懂机器是怎样看舞蹈的。
works.method: Google Video AI action recognition (20,000+ labels, including many dance categories) gives live feedback to the dancers.
works.method_zh: 使用 Google Video AI 动作识别（2 万多个标签，含多种舞蹈类别）向舞者实时反馈。

works.title: Nosukaay
works.description: A 'machine deity' built from a Manjak loom whose two frames are replaced by bare screens; visitors stroke a handwoven loincloth to navigate a film-game about an alternative history of computation, and are ejected if they disrespect it.
works.description_zh: 一尊由 Manjak 织机构成的“机器神”，织机的两个框架被裸露的屏幕取代；观众抚摸一块手织腰布来操作一部关于另一种计算史的影像游戏，若对它不敬便会被踢出。
works.idea_en: Weaving was computation long before the computer; the machine here speaks from West African textile knowledge, not from Silicon Valley.
works.idea_zh: 早在计算机之前，编织就已是一种计算；这台机器从西非纺织知识而不是硅谷出发说话。
works.method: A conductive handwoven Manjak cloth acts as a touch keyboard for an interactive narrative of texts, 3D images and footage shot in Dakar weaving studios.
works.method_zh: 一块导电的手织 Manjak 布作为触摸键盘，操作由文本、三维图像和达喀尔编织工坊实拍影像构成的互动叙事。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2024, Golden Nica (Interactive Art +)

works.title: Re;memory
works.description: A commercial memorial service in which bereaved families talk with an AI video avatar of a dead relative, built from filmed interviews recorded before death, in a dedicated room.
works.description_zh: 一项商业纪念服务：遗属在专门的房间里与已故亲人的 AI 视频化身交谈，化身依据其生前录制的访谈影像生成。
works.idea_en: Mourning becomes a subscription product: the company sells two-way conversation with the dead.
works.idea_zh: 哀悼变成了订阅产品：公司出售与逝者的“双向对话”。
works.method: Synthetic video avatar with voice cloning and a conversational model, trained on several hours of recorded footage and interviews.
works.method_zh: 合成视频虚拟人，结合声音克隆与对话模型，依据数小时的录像与访谈训练。

works.title: Synthetic Memories
works.description: An ongoing project that turns spoken memories that were never photographed into generated images, working with older people with dementia, refugees, migrants and prisoners. Participants correct the images until they 'look right', and the pictures are used to prompt remembering.
works.description_zh: 一个持续进行的项目，把从未被拍下的口述记忆变成生成图像，服务对象包括患失智症的老人、难民、移民和囚犯。参与者不断修正图像，直到它们“看起来对了”，这些图像再被用来唤起回忆。
works.idea_en: A generated picture of a memory is not evidence but a prompt: the machine's vagueness leaves room for the person to remember.
works.idea_zh: 记忆的生成图像不是证据，而是一个提示：机器的模糊恰好给人留出回忆的空间。
works.method: Interviews by a facilitator who writes prompts for text-to-image models, iterating with the participant; run as pop-up 'memory offices' in care homes, community centres and museums.
works.method_zh: 由引导者访谈并为文生图模型撰写提示词，与参与者反复修改；以临时“记忆办公室”的形式在养老院、社区中心和博物馆开展。

works.title: The Follower
works.description: Depoorter recorded open webcams in public squares for weeks, scraped Instagram photos tagged at those places, and used AI to find the exact moment each photo was taken: side-by-side clips show the posing influencer and the unseen camera watching.
works.description_zh: Depoorter 连续数周录制公共广场的开放网络摄像头，抓取在这些地点标记的 Instagram 照片，再用 AI 找出每张照片被拍下的确切瞬间：并排的片段一边是摆拍的网红，一边是无人注意的监视画面。
works.idea_en: Every staged photo has a second, unposed image taken by a machine, and AI can link the two.
works.idea_zh: 每张摆拍照片都有另一张由机器拍下的、不设防的图像，而 AI 能把两者连起来。
works.method: Weeks of footage from publicly accessible webcams were matched against scraped, location-tagged Instagram posts with image-similarity and person-detection software.
works.method_zh: 用图像相似度与人物检测软件，把公开网络摄像头数周的录像与抓取来的带地点标签的 Instagram 帖子逐一比对。

works.title: The Infinite Conversation
works.description: A never-ending online dialogue between synthetic voices of Werner Herzog and Slavoj Žižek, generated line by line by AI and streamed without pause.
works.description_zh: 一场永不结束的在线对话：AI 逐句生成“Werner Herzog”与“Slavoj Žižek”的合成声音，不间断地播放。
works.idea_en: Voices and styles of thought can be cloned and left to talk forever, with no one listening in particular.
works.idea_zh: 声音和思维风格可以被复制，然后被放任永远说下去，而并没有谁在特别地听。
works.method: A language model fine-tuned on the two men's writing and interviews generates the dialogue; voice-cloning text-to-speech renders it in their voices.
works.method_zh: 在两人的著作和访谈上微调的语言模型生成对话；语音克隆合成把它念成两人的声音。

works.title: Tinder_gun_boys_@Brussels_
works.description: A robot swipes through Tinder on its own while a weapon-detecting AI screenshots men posing with guns; the images are printed on tatami mats used for feminist self-defence classes held in the installation.
works.description_zh: 一台机器人自动在 Tinder 上滑动，一个识别武器的 AI 截下与枪合影的男性资料；这些图像被印在榻榻米垫上，用于在装置中开设的女性主义防身课。
works.idea_en: Turning a dating app's sorting logic back on its users shows how easily a machine can build a dataset of people, and what that dataset is for.
works.idea_zh: 把交友软件的筛选逻辑反用到它的用户身上，显示机器多么容易建立一个关于人的数据集，以及这个数据集可以被用来做什么。
works.method: A physical swiping robot operates a phone running Tinder; an object-detection model flags profile photos with weapons and saves hundreds of screenshots a day; legal advice was compiled into the video How not to get sued as an artist.
works.method_zh: 一台实体滑动机器人操作运行 Tinder 的手机；目标检测模型识别带武器的头像，每天保存数百张截图；律师意见被整理成影片 How not to get sued as an artist。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2025, Honorary Mention (Artificial Life & Intelligence)

works.title: Unlearning Language
works.description: Up to eight people are guided by an AI that 'wants to train humans to be less machine-like': whenever it detects their speech, gestures or expressions it intervenes with light, sound and vibration, so the group has to invent ways of communicating it cannot detect, such as humming, clapping or shifting pitch.
works.description_zh: 最多八位参与者由一个“想训练人类不那么像机器”的 AI 引导：一旦它检测到他们的语音、手势或表情，就用光、声音和振动加以干预，于是大家必须发明它检测不到的交流方式，比如哼唱、拍手或改变音高。
works.idea_en: Evading machine perception becomes a way of rediscovering what is most human in how we communicate.
works.idea_zh: 躲避机器感知，成了重新发现人类交流中最“人性”部分的方法。
works.method: Speech detection, gesture recognition and expression detection run on cameras and microphones in the room and trigger light, sound and haptic feedback; made with the Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media.
works.method_zh: 房间中的摄像头与麦克风运行语音检测、手势识别与表情检测，并触发灯光、声音与触觉反馈；与山口情报艺术中心（YCAM）合作完成。
exhibited: Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media (YCAM) 2022

works.title: AI 2041: Ten Visions for Our Future
works.description: Ten short stories set in 2041 across different countries (deepfakes in Lagos, an AI companion for orphaned twins in Seoul, automated jobs in San Francisco), each followed by an explanatory essay on the technology.
works.description_zh: 十个设定在 2041 年、分布于不同国家的短篇故事（拉各斯的深度伪造、首尔孤儿双胞胎的 AI 伴侣、旧金山被自动化的工作），每篇后附一篇技术解读。
works.idea_en: A Chinese co-authored AI future told through everyday lives, where the machine is a tutor, a partner, a boss and a counterfeiter.
works.idea_zh: 由中国作者合写的 AI 未来，从日常生活讲起：机器是家教、伴侣、上司，也是造假者。
works.method: Fiction by Chen Qiufan paired with technical commentary by Kai-Fu Lee.
works.method_zh: 陈楸帆撰写小说，李开复撰写技术评论。

paper.title: AI 2041: Ten Visions for Our Future

works.title: AI: When a Robot Writes a Play
works.description: For the centenary of R.U.R., a team from Charles University and Prague theatres used GPT-2 to generate most of the script of a play about a robot facing birth, death, love and loneliness; it premiered online at Švandovo divadlo in February 2021.
works.description_zh: 为纪念 R.U.R. 百年，查理大学与布拉格剧院的团队用 GPT-2 生成了剧本的大部分内容，讲述一个机器人面对出生、死亡、爱与孤独；2021 年 2 月在 Švandovo 剧院线上首演。
works.idea_en: A machine-written 'autobiography' of a robot shows both what a model borrows from human drama and where it loses the thread.
works.idea_zh: 一部由机器写成的机器人“自传”，既显示模型从人类戏剧中借来了什么，也显示它在哪里失去了线索。
works.method: GPT-2 generating dialogue from human-written prompts, with human curation and editing in a custom tool, staged by professional actors.
works.method_zh: GPT-2 根据人写的提示生成对白，在定制工具中由人筛选与编辑，由职业演员演出。

paper.title: THEaiTRE: Artificial Intelligence to Write a Theatre Play

works.title: After Yang
works.description: A family's android, Yang, bought as an 'older brother' to teach their adopted Chinese daughter about her heritage, stops working; while trying to repair him, the father finds a bank of short memory clips Yang chose to record.
works.description_zh: 一家人买来的仿生人“杨”原本是领养的中国女儿的“哥哥”，负责教她认识自己的文化；杨突然停止运转，父亲在设法修理时发现了杨自己选择录下的一段段记忆片段。
works.idea_en: A machine's memories reveal what it paid attention to, and grieving it means learning to see the family through its eyes.
works.idea_zh: 机器的记忆揭示了它在留意什么；哀悼它，就是学着用它的眼睛重新看这个家。
works.method: Feature film based on Alexander Weinstein's story 'Saying Goodbye to Yang'; the android's memories appear as a few seconds of first-person footage each.
works.method_zh: 根据亚历山大·温斯坦的小说《Saying Goodbye to Yang》改编的剧情长片；仿生人的记忆以每段几秒钟的第一人称影像呈现。
exhibited: Cannes Film Festival, Un Certain Regard 2021

works.title: All Light, Everywhere
