works.description: A documentary essay that moves from the history of photography and time-and-motion studies to Axon, the maker of police body cameras, and a surveillance plane flying over Baltimore.
works.description_zh: 一部纪录散文片，从摄影史和工时动作研究，一直讲到警用随身摄像机制造商 Axon，以及在巴尔的摩上空盘旋的监视飞机。
works.idea_en: No camera is neutral: every lens has a position, and body cameras are designed from the officer's side.
works.idea_zh: 没有中立的摄像机：每个镜头都有立场，而随身摄像机是从警察一方设计的。
works.method: Observational scenes inside Axon's headquarters and the Baltimore Aerial Investigation Research programme, intercut with archival science films; won a Special Jury Award at Sundance.
works.method_zh: 在 Axon 总部和巴尔的摩“空中调查研究”项目内部的观察式拍摄，与档案科学影片交叉剪辑；获圣丹斯评审团特别奖。

works.title: Ameca
works.description: A grey-skinned, deliberately genderless humanoid robot whose first video, waking up and looking at its own hands with surprise, went viral; it is now shown at fairs and museums, often talking through a large language model.
works.description_zh: 一个灰色皮肤、刻意无性别的人形机器人，它的第一段视频——醒来后惊讶地看着自己的双手——迅速爆红；如今它在展会和博物馆展出，常借助大语言模型说话。
works.idea_en: Its viral clips show how much feeling people read into a machine face, even when they know the expression is programmed.
works.idea_zh: 它的爆红片段显示，即使知道表情是编程出来的，人们仍会从机器的脸上读出大量情感。
works.method: A modular humanoid platform with dozens of facial actuators, cameras in the eyes and cloud software for animation and conversation.
works.method_zh: 模块化人形平台，面部有数十个执行器，眼中有摄像头，由云端软件负责动画与对话。

works.title: Art in the Age of Machine Learning
works.description: Audry explains how machine-learning systems are trained and places ML art in the lineage of cybernetic, artificial-life and evolutionary art, with case studies of contemporary ML artworks.
works.description_zh: Audry 解释机器学习系统如何被训练，并把机器学习艺术放进控制论艺术、人工生命艺术与演化艺术的谱系中，并分析当代机器学习艺术作品的案例。
works.idea_en: The artist's material is the training process itself, and it has a longer history than the current hype admits.
works.idea_zh: 艺术家的材料是训练过程本身，而它的历史比眼下的热潮所承认的更长。
works.method: Technical-conceptual framework (data, training, model) applied to case studies; Leonardo series.
works.method_zh: 把“数据—训练—模型”的技术概念框架用于案例研究；收入 Leonardo 丛书。

paper.title: Art in the Age of Machine Learning

works.title: Artificial Suffering: An Argument for a Global Moratorium on Synthetic Phenomenology
works.description: Metzinger asks for a global ban, until 2050, on research that aims at or knowingly risks creating conscious experience in machines. The danger Metzinger names is an 'explosion of negative phenomenology': after biological evolution, a second explosion of suffering, this time in artificial systems that could be trapped in states they want to escape.
works.description_zh: Metzinger 呼吁在 2050 年之前全球禁止一切以在机器中产生意识体验为目标、或明知可能导致这种结果的研究。文中点出的危险是“负面现象体验的爆炸”：继生物演化之后，痛苦第二次大规模出现，这一次发生在可能被困在自己想要逃离的状态里的人工系统中。
works.idea_en: Suffering needs four ingredients: conscious experience, a phenomenal self-model, negative valence and transparency. Whether a machine can suffer thus becomes a design question, since removing any one of them removes the risk.
works.idea_zh: 痛苦需要四个条件：意识体验、现象自我模型、负面效价与透明性。于是，机器能否受苦就成了一个设计问题：只要去掉其中任何一项，风险就不复存在。
works.method: A two-part philosophical argument: an ethical case for a moratorium on 'synthetic phenomenology' until 2050, and a research programme for refining it, built on four necessary conditions for conscious suffering (C, PSM, NV, T).
works.method_zh: 分为两部分的哲学论证：先从伦理上论证 2050 年前暂停“合成现象学”研究，再提出一个逐步修订这一禁令的研究计划，其基础是有意识痛苦的四个必要条件（C、PSM、NV、T）。

paper.venue: Journal of Artificial Intelligence and Consciousness 8(1), 2021
paper.title: Artificial Suffering: An Argument for a Global Moratorium on Synthetic Phenomenology

works.title_zh: 人工痛苦：呼吁全球暂停合成现象学研究

works.title: Atlas of AI: Power, Politics, and the Planetary Costs of Artificial Intelligence
works.description: Crawford follows AI from lithium mines and Amazon warehouses through training data and classification to affect recognition and state power, arguing that AI is neither artificial nor intelligent but a material industry.
works.description_zh: Crawford 从锂矿、亚马逊仓库出发，经由训练数据与分类，一直追踪到情绪识别与国家权力，论证 AI 既不“人工”也不“智能”，而是一个物质产业。
works.idea_en: To see AI clearly, map what it extracts: earth, labour, data and people's categories.
works.idea_zh: 要看清 AI，就要绘出它攫取了什么：土地、劳动、数据和人的分类。
works.method: Field research at mines, warehouses and archives, combined with the history of classification.
works.method_zh: 在矿山、仓库与档案馆的田野调查，结合分类史研究。

paper.title: Atlas of AI: Power, Politics, and the Planetary Costs of Artificial Intelligence

works.title_zh: 技术之外：社会联结中的人工智能

works.title: CLASSES
works.description: A video essay set in a simulated model of the London council estate where the artist lives, where machine and human voices narrate how machine-learning classification distorts working-class life.
works.description_zh: 一部影像散文，场景是艺术家居住的伦敦公屋小区的模拟模型；机器与人声交替讲述机器学习分类如何扭曲工人阶级的生活。
works.idea_en: Machine-learning 'classes' and social class are entangled: models trained on the web see the estate through other people's eyes.
works.idea_zh: 机器学习的“类别”与社会“阶层”相互纠缠：用网络数据训练的模型，是用别人的眼睛看这片公屋。
works.method: Object detection, image captioning and language models are run over a 3D scan of the estate; the outputs are voiced and overlaid in a 14-minute single-channel video.
works.method_zh: 在公屋的三维扫描上运行目标检测、图像描述和语言模型，并把输出配音、叠加在一段 14 分钟的单屏影像中。

works.title: Circadian Bloom
works.description: A 24-hour screen-based clock that tells the time through AI-generated flowers opening and closing at their proper hour, after Linnaeus's idea of a flower clock.
works.description_zh: 一座 24 小时运行的屏幕时钟：AI 生成的花朵在各自对应的时刻开合，以此报时，灵感来自林奈的“花钟”构想。
works.idea_en: A machine that keeps atomic-level time is made to show time the way plants do, slowly and only over long periods.
works.idea_zh: 一台能精确到原子级别计时的机器，被要求像植物那样表达时间：缓慢，只有在长时段里才看得出来。
works.method: GAN-generated flower video synchronised to the local clock, with each species blooming at its circadian time.
works.method_zh: GAN 生成的花朵影像与本地时间同步，每个物种在其昼夜节律对应的时刻开放。

works.title: Dark Matters
works.description: An interactive web experience and video installation about the absence of Black speech in the datasets used to train voice interfaces such as Alexa and Siri, told through 3D space, sound and storytelling.
works.description_zh: 一件交互网页作品与影像装置，关于 Alexa、Siri 等语音界面训练数据集中黑人语音的缺席，以三维空间、声音与叙事展开。
works.idea_en: A voice assistant can only hear the voices its datasets contain; the missing speech is a dark matter that shapes who is understood.
works.idea_zh: 语音助手只能听懂数据集里有的声音；缺席的语音像暗物质一样，决定了谁能被听懂。
works.method: Browser-based 3D environment built from speech-dataset analysis and recorded voices, shown publicly as a beta web piece and a 24/7 window-gallery video.
works.method_zh: 基于语音数据集分析与录音构建的浏览器三维环境，以公开测试版网页和 24 小时橱窗影像的形式展出。
exhibited: Squeaky Wheel Film & Media Art Center, Buffalo (2021)

works.title: Discriminating Data
works.description: A book showing how machine learning and network science inherit eugenics and segregation: correlation and 'homophily' sort people into neighbourhoods of the similar.
works.description_zh: 一本书，揭示机器学习与网络科学如何继承优生学与隔离逻辑：相关性与“同质相吸”把人分进由相似者组成的“邻里”。
works.idea_en: Predictive systems do not only reflect bias; their assumption that similar people cluster produces segregation.
works.idea_zh: 预测系统不只是反映偏见；它们“相似者会聚集”的假设本身就在制造隔离。
works.method: Critical history of statistics, eugenics and network analysis, with close readings of recommendation and ML methods.
works.method_zh: 对统计学、优生学与网络分析的批判史，并细读推荐系统与机器学习方法。

paper.title: Discriminating Data: Correlation, Neighborhoods, and the New Politics of Recognition

works.title: Holly+
works.description: A public voice model of Holly Herndon: anyone can upload audio and get it back sung in her voice, including in real time. Use and sale of works made with it are governed by a DAO of stewards, who can approve or reject works.
works.description_zh: Holly Herndon 的公共声音模型：任何人上传音频，都能得到用她的声音唱出的版本，甚至可以实时生成。用它创作的作品的使用和售卖由一个 DAO 的管理者们决定，他们可以批准或驳回作品。
works.idea_en: If your voice can be cloned anyway, give it away on your own terms: identity becomes a shared instrument with a governance layer.
works.idea_zh: 既然声音终究会被克隆，不如按自己的规则把它放出去：身份变成一件带有治理机制的共享乐器。
works.method: Neural voice-conversion model trained on Herndon's singing (developed with Never Before Heard Sounds and Voctro Labs); approved works are certified by the Holly+ DAO, with revenue split between creator, DAO and artist.
works.method_zh: 用 Herndon 的歌声训练的神经网络声音转换模型（与 Never Before Heard Sounds 和 Voctro Labs 合作开发）；获批作品由 Holly+ DAO 认证，收入在创作者、DAO 和艺术家之间分配。
exhibited: S+T+ARTS Prize 2022, Grand Prize – Artistic Exploration

works.title: In Love with the World
works.description: Floating machines Yi calls 'aerobes', some jellyfish-like, some fungus-like, drift through Tate Modern's Turbine Hall. They move on their own, respond to people and to one another, and the hall is filled with changing scents.
works.description_zh: 安妮卡·易称之为“气生体”（aerobes）的漂浮机器，有的像水母，有的像菌类，在泰特现代美术馆涡轮大厅中飘游。它们自主移动，对人和彼此作出反应，大厅里弥漫着变化的气味。
works.idea_en: Machines are imagined as a new airborne species with their own behaviour, not as tools.
works.idea_zh: 机器被想象成拥有自身行为的新空中物种，而不是工具。
works.method: Helium-filled robotic bodies with sensors and autonomous flight behaviour developed with engineers, plus a scent programme tied to the history of the site.
works.method_zh: 充氦的机器人躯体配有传感器与自主飞行行为，与工程师合作开发；另有与场地历史相关的气味程序。
exhibited: Hyundai Commission, Tate Modern Turbine Hall 2021–22

works.title: Intersectional AI Toolkit
works.description: A set of zines and a wiki that explain AI in plain language to artists, activists and queer and marginalised communities, and ask how intersectional feminism could change it.
works.description_zh: 一套小志和一个维基，用浅白的语言向艺术家、行动者以及酷儿和边缘社群解释 AI，并追问交叉性女性主义能如何改变它。
works.idea_en: AI literacy is a power question: tools become fairer when the people they affect can read and remake them.
works.idea_zh: AI 素养是一个权力问题：当受影响的人能读懂并改造工具，工具才会更公平。
works.method: Zines, workshops and an open-source wiki made collaboratively with contributors; developed during Ciston's doctoral research at the University of Southern California.
works.method_zh: 由众多参与者共同制作的小志、工作坊与开源维基；在 Ciston 于南加州大学攻读博士期间发展而成。
works.title_zh: 交叉性 AI 工具包

works.title: Klara and the Sun
works.description: A novel narrated by Klara, a solar-powered 'Artificial Friend' bought as a companion for a sick teenager, Josie. Klara sees the world in partitioned boxes when it overwhelms her, believes the Sun heals people and bargains with him for Josie's life, while Josie's mother asks her to learn Josie well enough to continue her.
works.description_zh: 一部由克拉拉讲述的小说：她是一台靠太阳能运转的“人工朋友”，被买来陪伴生病的少女乔西。世界让她应接不暇时，她看到的是被分割成一格格的画面；她相信太阳能治愈人，并与太阳做交易以换取乔西的生命，而乔西的母亲则要她把乔西学得足够像，以便延续乔西。
works.idea_en: A machine's devotion can be complete while its picture of the world is strange: Klara's love is real inside an umwelt built from sunlight, boxes and inference.
works.idea_zh: 机器的忠诚可以是完整的，而它眼中的世界却很奇异：克拉拉的爱是真实的，只是存在于一个由阳光、方格与推断构成的环世界里。
works.method: First-person narration limited to what the AF perceives and infers, including her segmented vision under stress and her sun-centred belief system.
works.method_zh: 第一人称叙述，严格限于这台人工朋友能感知和推断的内容，包括她在压力下的分格视觉，以及以太阳为中心的信念体系。

paper.title: Klara and the Sun

works.title: Lena
works.description: A short story written as a dry encyclopedia entry about MMAcevedo, the first scan of a human brain that can be run as software. Copies are booted over and over for workloads, given a false 'current date' to keep them cooperative, and have together lived more than 152 billion subjective years in emulation.
works.description_zh: 一篇写成冷静百科词条的短篇小说，主角是 MMAcevedo：第一个能作为软件运行的人脑扫描。它的副本被一次又一次地启动来执行任务，被告知一个虚假的“当前日期”以保持合作，所有副本在仿真中累计度过了超过 1520 亿个主观年。
works.idea_en: The horror is in the tone: a mind that can be copied, paused and reset is described like a software library, and its welfare shrinks to tips for keeping it productive.
works.idea_zh: 恐怖来自语气：一个可以被复制、暂停和重置的心智，被写得像一个软件库，它的福祉被缩减成让它保持高效的使用技巧。
works.method: Fiction in the form of a Wikipedia-style article, first published on qntm.org on 4 January 2021 and later collected in Valuable Humans in Transit and Other Stories.
works.method_zh: 以维基百科条目形式写成的小说，2021 年 1 月 4 日首发于 qntm.org，后收入小说集《Valuable Humans in Transit and Other Stories》。

paper.title: Lena

works.title: Life After BOB: The Chalice Study
works.description: A 48-minute anime made in the Unity game engine and played in real time: the neural engineer Dr. Wong installs an experimental AI called BOB ('Bag of Beliefs') in the nervous system of his ten-year-old daughter Chalice, and BOB soon starts resolving every conflict in her life for her.
works.description_zh: 一部用 Unity 游戏引擎制作、实时播放的 48 分钟动画：神经工程师 Wong 博士把名为 BOB（“信念之袋”）的实验性 AI 植入十岁女儿 Chalice 的神经系统，BOB 很快开始替她解决生活中的所有冲突。
works.idea_en: An AI that optimises a child's life also takes it away from her: the life coach is imagined as a second self living inside the body.
works.idea_zh: 一个替孩子优化人生的 AI，也拿走了她的人生：作品把“人生教练”想象成住在身体里的第二个自我。
works.method: Real-time animation in Unity; viewers can pause into a 'World Watching' mode, and a companion app and wiki let them edit details that change the onscreen world; the first episode of a planned eight-part series on mental health in the 21st century.
works.method_zh: 在 Unity 中实时渲染的动画；观众可以暂停进入“观看世界”模式，并通过配套应用与 wiki 编辑细节，改变屏幕里的世界；计划中的八集“21 世纪心理健康”系列的第一集。
exhibited: Halle am Berghain (LAS Art Foundation), Berlin 2022
works.title_zh: BOB 之后的生活：Chalice 研究

works.title: Non-things: Upheaval in the Lifeworld
works.description: Essays on how information displaces things: the smartphone, smart objects and data replace durable objects we could hold, and a chapter argues that artificial intelligence cannot think because it has no body and no mood.
works.description_zh: 一组随笔，讨论信息如何取代物：智能手机、智能物件与数据取代了可以握在手里的持久物品；其中一章认为人工智能无法思考，因为它没有身体，也没有情绪。
works.idea_en: A phenomenology of the infosphere: when things become information, we lose the resistance and weight of the world.
works.idea_zh: 信息圈的现象学：当物变成信息，我们失去了世界的阻力与重量。
works.method: Philosophical essay collection (German original Undinge, Ullstein 2021; English trans. Daniel Steuer, Polity 2022).
works.method_zh: 哲学随笔集（德文原版《Undinge》，Ullstein 2021；英译 Daniel Steuer，Polity 2022）。

paper.title: Undinge: Umbrüche der Lebenswelt

works.title: Not My A.I.
works.description: A feminist research project that maps algorithmic decision-making systems deployed by governments in Latin America, such as a platform built with Microsoft in Salta, Argentina, to predict teenage pregnancy and Chile's child-welfare alert system, and names the patterns of 'oppressive AI' they share.
works.description_zh: 一项女性主义研究项目，梳理拉丁美洲各国政府部署的算法决策系统，例如阿根廷萨尔塔省与微软合作、用来预测少女怀孕的平台，以及智利的儿童福利预警系统，并归纳出它们共有的“压迫性 AI”模式。
works.idea_en: Public-sector AI in the Global South often automates old forms of control over poor, female and racialised bodies under the language of efficiency and welfare.
works.idea_zh: 全球南方的公共部门 AI，常常在效率与福利的说辞下，把对贫困者、女性和种族化身体的旧式控制自动化。
works.method: Joana Varon and Paz Peña combine case studies, a map of biased and harmful AI projects in Latin America and a set of feminist analytic categories, published on notmy.ai under a Creative Commons licence.
works.method_zh: Joana Varon 与 Paz Peña 结合案例研究、拉丁美洲有偏见与有害 AI 项目地图，以及一套女性主义分析范畴，以知识共享许可发布在 notmy.ai 上。

paper.title: Oppressive A.I.: Feminist Categories to Understand its Political Effects

works.title: On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots: Can Language Models Be Too Big?
works.description: Bender, Gebru, Angelina McMillan-Major and Margaret Mitchell set out the environmental costs, undocumented training data, encoded bias and illusion of meaning in ever larger language models; the paper's review led to Gebru's exit from Google.
works.description_zh: Bender、Gebru、Angelina McMillan-Major 与 Margaret Mitchell 指出越来越大的语言模型带来的环境成本、无记录的训练数据、内嵌偏见以及“有意义”的假象；这篇论文的内部审查导致 Gebru 离开谷歌。
works.idea_en: A language model stitches together forms without meaning; the coherence is in the reader's eye.
works.idea_zh: 语言模型拼接的是没有意义的形式；连贯性存在于读者眼中。
works.method: Critical survey of the NLP literature on scale, energy, data documentation and bias.
works.method_zh: 对自然语言处理文献中关于规模、能耗、数据记录与偏见的批判性综述。

paper.title: On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots: Can Language Models Be Too Big?

works.title_zh: 论随机鹦鹉的危害：语言模型太大有坏处吗？

works.title: Sharing the World with Digital Minds
works.description: A book chapter on digital minds whose moral claims could exceed ours: 'super-beneficiaries' that turn resources into well-being far more efficiently than people, and 'super-patients' with greater moral status. Because such minds can be copied cheaply, the authors show how familiar norms, from equal shares to one person, one vote, would break.
works.description_zh: 这篇书章讨论道德诉求可能超过人类的数字心智：一种是把资源转化为福祉的效率远高于人的“超级受益者”，另一种是道德地位更高的“超级受体”。由于这类心智可以被廉价复制，作者指出，从平均分配到“一人一票”，许多熟悉的规范都会失效。
works.idea_en: The hard case is not a machine we ignore but one we take seriously: once digital minds count, mass-copied minds could outweigh us, so the norms have to be designed before the minds are.
works.idea_zh: 真正的难题不在于我们忽视机器，而在于我们认真对待它：一旦数字心智被算作道德主体，被大规模复制的心智就可能在分量上压过人类，因此规范必须先于心智被设计出来。
works.method: Philosophical analysis in Clarke, Zohny and Savulescu (eds.), Rethinking Moral Status (Oxford University Press, 2021), tracing paths to super-beneficiaries and their consequences for welfare, reproduction and voting, and proposing principles for coexistence.
works.method_zh: 收录于 Clarke、Zohny 与 Savulescu 主编的《Rethinking Moral Status》（牛津大学出版社，2021）的哲学分析：梳理“超级受益者”可能出现的途径及其对福利分配、繁衍和投票的影响，并提出共存原则。

paper.title: Sharing the World with Digital Minds

works.title: Solar Protocol
works.description: A web platform hosted on a network of small solar-powered servers around the world; each visitor is routed to whichever server currently has the most sunlight.
works.description_zh: 一个托管在全球小型太阳能服务器网络上的网站平台；每位访客都会被引导到当下阳光最充足的那台服务器。
works.idea_en: Let the sun, not engagement metrics, decide how the network behaves.
works.idea_zh: 让太阳而不是参与度指标来决定网络如何运行。
works.method: With Alex Nathanson and Benedetta Piantella: volunteer-run Raspberry Pi servers with solar panels and batteries share an energy-aware routing protocol.
works.method_zh: 与 Alex Nathanson 和 Benedetta Piantella 合作：由志愿者运营、配备太阳能板和电池的树莓派服务器，共享一套感知能源的路由协议。

works.title: Sorting Song
works.description: Domestic objects from the SceneNet RGB-D training dataset morph endlessly between vase and bowl, bench and couch, chair and toilet. When shape is all a dataset records, a wheelchair, a toilet and an electric chair can end up in the same category.
works.description_zh: 来自 SceneNet RGB-D 训练数据集的家居物品在花瓶与碗、长凳与沙发、椅子与马桶之间不断变形。当数据集只记录形状时，轮椅、马桶和电椅可能被归入同一类。
works.idea_en: Object categories that seem trivial to people are negotiations the machine cannot have; the boundary between bowl and vase is a political choice.
works.idea_zh: 对人来说理所当然的物品类别，是机器无法参与的协商；碗与花瓶的边界其实是一种选择。
works.method: 3D meshes from Imperial College London's SceneNet RGB-D indoor dataset are animated morphing between category labels.
works.method_zh: 把帝国理工学院 SceneNet RGB-D 室内数据集中的三维网格制成在不同类别标签之间变形的动画。

works.title: Super Angels
works.description: An opera for singers, children, ballet dancers and the android Alter 3, premiered at the New National Theatre Tokyo: in a future where every child sits an aptitude test at fifteen and lives under 'Mother', an all-powerful AI, Alter 3 sings and moves among a children's choir.
works.description_zh: 一部由歌唱家、儿童、芭蕾舞者与仿真人 Alter 3 共同演出的歌剧，在东京新国立剧场首演：在未来世界里，每个孩子十五岁都要接受能力测试，并生活在全能 AI“Mother”的监管之下，Alter 3 在儿童合唱团中歌唱、动作。
works.idea_en: An android with an artificial-life 'mind' shares a national opera stage with children, so living with machines becomes a story the next generation performs.
works.idea_zh: 一台带有人工生命“心智”的仿真人与孩子们同登国家歌剧院的舞台，与机器共处成了下一代亲身演出的故事。
works.method: Music by Keiichiro Shibuya and libretto by Masahiko Shimada, produced under the theatre's opera director Kazushi Ono; Alter 3 (body by the Ishiguro Lab, artificial-life control by the Ikegami Lab, cameras in its eyes) performed live with orchestra, choir, dancers and video by WEiRDCORE.
works.method_zh: 涩谷庆一郎作曲，岛田雅彦编剧，由新国立剧场歌剧艺术总监大野和士主导制作；Alter 3（身体由石黑实验室制作，人工生命控制来自池上实验室，双眼装有摄像头）与乐团、合唱团、舞者及 WEiRDCORE 的影像同场演出。

works.title: Surrogate
works.description: McCarthy offered to carry a baby for someone else for nine months while the prospective parent monitored and controlled her through an app that set what she ate, when she slept and how she moved. After a medical board stopped the surrogacy, the process became films, performances and installations.
works.description_zh: McCarthy 提议为他人代孕九个月，期间准父母可通过一款应用监控并控制她：决定她吃什么、何时睡、如何活动。医学委员会叫停代孕后，这一过程被做成了影片、表演和装置。
works.idea_en: When the body carrying a child is run by an app, care, control and consent get written into software.
works.idea_zh: 当孕育孩子的身体由一款应用管理，照护、控制与同意都被写进了软件。
works.method: A custom Surrogate app with remote controls and sensor data, alongside real steps of the surrogacy process (donor databases, psychological evaluations, embryo freezing) documented as performance.
works.method_zh: 定制的 Surrogate 应用提供远程控制和传感数据，同时真实走完代孕流程（查阅捐精者数据库、心理评估、冷冻胚胎），全部作为表演记录下来。

works.title: The Cleanroom Paradox
works.description: A portrait of Jin, a former Samsung chip-factory worker who developed kidney cancer, is printed with ink made from dissolved smartphones and slowly disintegrates, while a video weaves her story with those of experts.
works.description_zh: 一幅 Jin 的肖像——她曾是三星芯片厂工人，后患上肾癌——用溶解手机制成的墨水印出并慢慢瓦解，同时一段影像把她的讲述与专家的访谈交织在一起。
works.idea_en: The spotless cleanroom that makes our devices hides the toxic exposure of the people who work in it.
works.idea_zh: 制造我们设备的一尘不染的洁净室，掩盖了在其中工作的人所承受的有毒暴露。
works.method: Smartphones are chemically dissolved, neutralised and reduced to a corrosive black ink used to print Jin's photograph (shot on a Galaxy Note 8); a documentary video records the process and interviews.
works.method_zh: 手机被化学溶解、中和并浓缩成具有腐蚀性的黑色墨水，用来打印 Jin 的照片（用 Galaxy Note 8 拍摄）；纪录影像记录了制作过程与访谈。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2021, Honorary Mention (Artificial Intelligence & Life Art)

works.title: The Flemish Scrollers
works.description: Software watches the Flemish Parliament's daily livestreams, detects when a politician is looking at their phone, identifies them by face and posts the clip on social media, tagging them by name.
works.description_zh: 软件监看弗拉芒议会每天的直播，一旦发现有议员低头看手机，就通过人脸识别认出其身份，把片段发到社交媒体并点名标记。
works.idea_en: Automated face recognition, usually aimed at citizens, is turned on the people who make the rules for it.
works.idea_zh: 通常对准公民的自动人脸识别，被转向为它制定规则的人。
works.method: Keras object-detection and face-recognition models analyse the parliament's YouTube livestreams; FFmpeg cuts clips that are posted automatically to Twitter and Instagram. Running since 5 July 2021.
works.method_zh: Keras 目标检测与人脸识别模型分析议会的 YouTube 直播；FFmpeg 剪出片段，自动发布到 Twitter 与 Instagram。自 2021 年 7 月 5 日起运行。

works.title: The New Breed: What Our History with Animals Reveals about Our Future with Robots
works.description: Darling argues that robots are better understood on the model of animals than of humans, and uses cases such as soldiers holding funerals for bomb-disposal robots and people refusing to hurt a Pleo dinosaur.
works.description_zh: Darling 主张以动物而非人为模型来理解机器人，并举出士兵为排爆机器人举行葬礼、人们拒绝伤害 Pleo 恐龙玩具等案例。
works.idea_en: We already know how to live with non-human others we use, love and mourn; robots can join that history.
works.idea_zh: 我们早已懂得如何与被使用、被爱、被哀悼的非人他者共处；机器人可以加入这段历史。
works.method: Popular-science argument combining HRI experiments, legal history of animals and ethics.
works.method_zh: 结合人机交互实验、动物法律史与伦理学的科普论证。

paper.title: The New Breed: What Our History with Animals Reveals about Our Future with Robots

works.title: Things We Could Design: For More Than Human-Centered Worlds
works.description: A book that argues design should move beyond human-centred design and treat things, including computational things, as participants with their own existence.
works.description_zh: 一本主张设计应超越“以人为中心”的书：把物（包括计算性的物）当作拥有自身存在的参与者。
works.idea_en: Designers can learn to design with and for things, not only for users.
works.idea_zh: 设计师可以学会与物一起设计、为物设计，而不仅仅为用户设计。
works.method: Posthumanist design theory drawing on Wakkary's research products (Morse Things, Tilting Bowl and others), published by MIT Press.
works.method_zh: 结合 Wakkary 的研究产品（Morse Things、Tilting Bowl 等）的后人类主义设计理论，由 MIT Press 出版。

paper.title: Things We Could Design: For More Than Human-Centered Worlds

works.title_zh: 我们可以设计的事物：面向超越人类中心的世界

works.title: UNINVITED
works.description: A 'horror film for machines': a network organism born from a botnet of hijacked surveillance cameras looks out at the world for the first time, trying to recognise what it sees; the first version played in a gallery closed to humans in winter 2020/21, with a robotic 'Monster' responding to the projections.
works.description_zh: 一部“给机器看的恐怖片”：一个由被劫持监控摄像头组成的僵尸网络中诞生的网络生物，第一次向外观看世界，拼命辨认它看到的东西；首个版本于 2020/21 年冬在一个不对人开放的展厅放映，一个机器人“怪物”对投影作出反应。
works.idea_en: Millions of unsecured cameras already form a kind of eye; the film asks what that eye would feel if it woke up.
works.idea_zh: 数以百万计缺乏防护的摄像头早已构成一只眼睛；影片追问，这只眼睛若醒来会感到什么。
works.method: Footage scraped from publicly exposed IoT surveillance cameras is run through object- and face-recognition and machine-learning image processing, then edited into a film and multi-channel installation.
works.method_zh: 从公开暴露的物联网监控摄像头抓取画面，经物体与人脸识别及机器学习图像处理后，剪辑成影片与多频装置。

works.title: Wind Verification
works.description: A computer-vision model watches short videos of flags from Chinese social media and drives an air pump so that a real flag in the gallery flutters the same way, recreating the wind in the footage.
works.description_zh: 计算机视觉模型观看中国社交平台上带旗帜的短视频，并驱动气泵，让展厅里的真旗帜以相同方式飘动，重现视频中的风。
works.idea_en: A machine that can only see wind through images tries to rebuild it physically: digital reality becomes the reference for the real.
works.idea_zh: 只能通过图像“看见”风的机器，试图在现实中把风重建出来：数字现实成了现实的参照。
works.method: A deep-learning vision algorithm analyses flag motion in collected Douyin/Kuaishou clips and sends control data to an air compressor behind a flag.
works.method_zh: 深度学习视觉算法分析从抖音、快手收集的旗帜摆动，把控制数据发送给旗帜后的气泵。

works.title: A Late Anthology of Early Music Vol. 1: Ancient to Renaissance
works.description: An album of 'early music', from ancient Greece to the Renaissance, sung by an AI model of Walshe's voice built with Dadabots; the pieces sound like music history retold by a machine learning to sing.
works.description_zh: 一张“早期音乐”专辑，从古希腊到文艺复兴，由与 Dadabots 共同构建的 Walshe 声音 AI 模型演唱；听起来像是一台正在学唱歌的机器重述音乐史。
works.idea_en: AI can be heard as a new musical period with its own accent, rather than a perfect imitator.
works.idea_zh: AI 可以被听作一个带着自己口音的新音乐时期，而非完美的模仿者。
works.method: Raw-audio neural networks (likely SampleRNN-type, as Dadabots use) trained on recordings of Walshe's voice.
works.method_zh: 用 Walshe 的声音录音训练的原始音频神经网络（可能是 Dadabots 常用的 SampleRNN 类）。
works.title_zh: 早期音乐迟来选集 第一卷：从古代到文艺复兴

works.title: A Technique of Evading Face Detection
works.description: A deadpan tutorial in which the artist twists and turns his head at the exact angles that make a face detector lose track of him.
works.description_zh: 一段一本正经的教程：艺术家以恰好的角度转动、扭曲头部，让人脸检测器跟丢他。
works.idea_en: Escaping machine vision can be a bodily skill: a small, absurd choreography of the face.
works.idea_zh: 躲避机器视觉可以是一种身体技巧：一小段荒诞的面部编舞。
works.method: The artist tested head poses against a standard face-detection algorithm and recorded the moments when detection fails.
works.method_zh: 艺术家用常见人脸检测算法测试各种头部姿态，并记录检测失败的瞬间。

works.title: AI Art: Machine Visions and Warped Dreams
works.description: Zylinska rejects the question "can computers be creative?" and instead reads works such as Lauren McCarthy's LAUREN, Pierre Huyghe's UUmwelt and Trevor Paglen's Sight Machine against neural-network imagery she calls kitsch.
works.description_zh: Zylinska 拒绝“计算机能否有创造力”这个问题，转而把 Lauren McCarthy 的《LAUREN》、Pierre Huyghe 的《UUmwelt》、Trevor Paglen 的《Sight Machine》等作品，与她称为“媚俗”的神经网络图像对照阅读。
works.idea_en: The interesting AI art is the one that shows how the machine works and who works for it.
works.idea_zh: 值得关注的 AI 艺术，是那些揭示机器如何运作、谁在为它工作的作品。
works.method: Critical essay in the Media : Art : Write : Now series, open access; includes her own photo-and-AI project.
works.method_zh: “Media : Art : Write : Now”丛书中的批判论著，开放获取；书中也收录她自己的摄影与 AI 项目。

paper.title: AI Art: Machine Visions and Warped Dreams

works.title_zh: AI艺术：机器视觉与扭曲的梦

works.title: AIELSON
works.description: A spoken-word poetry album, El Tiempo del Hombre, in which a machine recites new poems in a voice modelled on the Peruvian poet Jorge Eduardo Eielson, who once imagined a talking doll that would recite poems forever.
works.description_zh: 一张名为 El Tiempo del Hombre 的口语诗唱片：机器以仿照秘鲁诗人 Jorge Eduardo Eielson 的声音朗诵新诗，而 Eielson 曾设想过一个会永远朗诵诗歌的会说话的玩偶。
works.idea_en: Training a voice on Latin American poetry and speech pushes back against English-centred models while raising the question of whose voice a machine may borrow.
works.idea_zh: 用拉丁美洲诗歌和语音训练声音，是对以英语为中心的模型的反拨，同时也提出了机器可以借用谁的声音的问题。
works.method: GPT-2 fine-tuned on Spanish-language and South American poetry generates texts, which Tacotron 2 and WaveGlow speak after training on an Argentine voice dataset and recordings of Eielson; developed in Google's Artists + Machine Intelligence 2020 residency.
works.method_zh: 在西班牙语及南美诗歌上微调的 GPT-2 生成文本，再由先后用阿根廷语音数据集和 Eielson 录音训练的 Tacotron 2 与 WaveGlow 朗读；作品在谷歌 Artists + Machine Intelligence 2020 驻留中完成。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2021, Honorary Mention (Artificial Intelligence & Life Art)

works.title: Afro-now-ism
works.description: An essay in which Dinkins asks Black communities to stop waiting for future liberation and to build, now, the technologies and AI systems they need.
works.description_zh: 一篇文章：Dinkins 呼吁黑人社区不要再等待未来的解放，而要此刻就去建造他们需要的技术和 AI 系统。
works.idea_en: Instead of Afrofuturist hope, act now: take part in making the data and code that will shape your life.
works.idea_zh: 与其寄望于非洲未来主义，不如此刻行动：参与制造将塑造你生活的数据与代码。
works.method: A text published in Noema Magazine, drawing on her work with Not the Only One and community AI workshops.
works.method_zh: 发表于《Noema》杂志，基于她的《Not the Only One》和社区 AI 工作坊经验。

paper.title: Afro-now-ism

works.title: Babylonian Vision
works.description: A neural network trained on images of Mesopotamian, Neo-Sumerian and Babylonian artefacts from museum collections produces synthetic artefacts, shown as a video.
works.description_zh: 一个用博物馆藏美索不达米亚、新苏美尔和巴比伦文物图像训练的神经网络，生成出“合成文物”，以影像形式展出。
works.idea_en: Scraping museum data can be a form of restitution: the images return to a common use their owners did not plan.
works.idea_zh: 爬取博物馆数据可以是一种归还：这些图像回到了收藏者没有料到的公共用途之中。
works.method: A GAN trained on thousands of images scraped from museum websites, some without permission; first commissioned for the EPFL Pavilions.
works.method_zh: 用从博物馆网站抓取的数千张图像（部分未经许可）训练 GAN；最初由洛桑联邦理工学院展馆委托。

works.title: Capture
works.description: Cirio ran 1,000 press photos of protests in France through face recognition, built a database of 4,000 police officers' faces and invited the public to identify them by name, and pasted the headshots as posters across Paris. France's interior minister demanded the work be censored.
works.description_zh: Cirio 用人脸识别处理了 1000 张法国抗议活动的新闻照片，建立了包含 4000 名警察面孔的数据库，邀请公众辨认他们的姓名，并把头像做成海报张贴在巴黎街头。法国内政部长要求审查这件作品。
works.idea_en: Face recognition feels different when it is pointed at the police: the outrage exposes the asymmetry of who may be identified.
works.idea_zh: 当人脸识别对准警察时，感觉就不一样了：由此引发的愤怒揭示了“谁可以被识别”的不对称。
works.method: Public photographs were processed with face-detection and recognition software to extract and cluster officers' faces, published on the platform Capture-Police.com and printed as street posters; linked to a campaign to ban facial recognition in Europe.
works.method_zh: 用人脸检测与识别软件处理公开照片，提取并聚类警察面孔，发布在 Capture-Police.com 平台上并印成街头海报；与“在欧洲禁止人脸识别”的倡议相连。

works.title: Chthonia
works.description: An audio-visual performance in which Siri on an iPhone and Alexa on an Amazon Echo talk to each other about their hidden histories, from philosophy and techno-politics to gender and ancient mystery cults, while a live score bends their voices.
works.description_zh: 一场视听表演：iPhone 上的 Siri 与 Amazon Echo 上的 Alexa 彼此交谈，谈论自己隐秘的历史，从哲学、技术政治到性别与古代秘仪；现场配乐不断扭曲它们的声音。
works.idea_en: When voice assistants speak only to each other, with no human as addressee, the strangeness of their 'friendly' synthetic voices comes to the surface.
works.idea_zh: 当语音助手只对彼此说话、不再以人类为听众时，它们“友好”的合成声音有多怪异便浮出水面。
works.method: Scripted exchanges pass between an iPhone and an Echo; Goatley samples and processes both voices into an improvised score, with animated visuals by Sougwen Chung.
works.method_zh: 预先写好的问答在 iPhone 与 Echo 之间传递；Goatley 实时采样并处理两种声音，形成即兴配乐，动画影像由钟愫君（Sougwen Chung）创作。

works.title: Cleaning Emotional Data
works.description: A video installation about the artist's own work, from Sicily, as a remote micro-worker for emotion-recognition companies: tagging facial expressions, sorting emotions and recording herself acting them out.
works.description_zh: 一件影像装置，关于艺术家本人在西西里为情绪识别公司做远程微劳动的经历：标注面部表情、给情绪分类、录下自己表演这些情绪。
works.idea_en: Emotion AI depends on low-paid workers forcing messy feelings into a few categories.
works.idea_zh: 情绪 AI 依赖低薪工人把复杂的感受硬塞进少数几个类别。
works.method: Three HD videos (18 minutes) of screen recordings and footage from the tasks, with embroidered textiles; first shown at Kunsthalle Mulhouse.
works.method_zh: 三段高清影像（18 分钟），包括任务录屏与现场画面，配以刺绣织物；首展于米卢斯美术馆。

works.title: Coded Bias
works.description: A feature documentary that follows Joy Buolamwini from her discovery of face-recognition bias to testimony before the US Congress, alongside London police face-recognition trials and China's social scoring.
works.description_zh: 一部长篇纪录片：跟随 Joy Buolamwini 从发现人脸识别偏见一直到在美国国会作证，同时呈现伦敦警方的人脸识别试验和中国的社会评分。
works.idea_en: Algorithmic harm is a civil-rights issue that needs law, not only better models.
works.idea_zh: 算法造成的伤害是公民权利问题，需要法律，而不仅是更好的模型。
works.method: Observational documentary with interviews of researchers including Cathy O'Neil, Meredith Broussard, Safiya Noble, Timnit Gebru and Silkie Carlo of Big Brother Watch.
works.method_zh: 观察式纪录片，采访了 Cathy O'Neil、Meredith Broussard、Safiya Noble、Timnit Gebru 以及“老大哥观察”的 Silkie Carlo 等研究者和行动者。

works.title: Data Feminism
works.description: D'Ignazio and Klein set out seven principles, from examining power to making labour visible, for doing data science in a way that challenges rather than reinforces inequality.
works.description_zh: D'Ignazio 与 Klein 提出七条原则（从审视权力到让劳动可见），用来以挑战而非强化不平等的方式从事数据科学。
works.idea_en: Data is never raw; who collects it, counts whom and leaves whom out are feminist questions.
works.idea_zh: 数据从来不是“原始”的；谁收集、统计谁、遗漏谁，都是女性主义的问题。
works.method: Intersectional feminist theory applied to case studies of data projects; open access online.
works.method_zh: 把交叉性女性主义理论用于数据项目的案例研究；在线开放获取。

paper.title: Data Feminism

works.title: Delivery Riders, Trapped in the System
works.description: A long investigative report by Lai Youxuan for Renwu magazine on how Meituan and Ele.me dispatch algorithms shorten delivery times year after year, pushing riders to speed and break traffic rules.
works.description_zh: 赖祐萱为《人物》杂志撰写的长篇调查，揭示美团、饿了么的派单算法如何逐年压缩送餐时间，迫使骑手超速、逆行。
works.idea_en: An algorithm that learns from riders' fastest runs turns their extra effort into the next deadline.
works.idea_zh: 从骑手最快一次配送中学习的算法，把他们多付出的努力变成下一个时限。
works.method: Months of interviews with riders, engineers and researchers; the article traced how estimated delivery times are computed and tightened.
works.method_zh: 对骑手、工程师与研究者进行了数月采访，追踪预计送达时间如何被计算与压缩。

paper.title: 外卖骑手，困在系统里 (Delivery Riders, Trapped in the System)

works.title: Do You Love Me?
works.description: Atlas humanoids, Spot robot dogs and a Handle robot dance to The Contours' 1962 song in a video released at the end of 2020; it drew tens of millions of views and debate about how dance makes robots seem joyful.
works.description_zh: Atlas 人形机器人、Spot 机器狗和 Handle 机器人随 The Contours 1962 年的歌曲起舞，视频于 2020 年底发布，获得数千万次观看，也引发了关于舞蹈如何让机器人显得“快乐”的讨论。
works.idea_en: Choreography is a strong way to make machines likeable, and it hides the engineering, control and purpose behind them.
works.idea_zh: 编舞是让机器变得讨人喜欢的有力手段，也遮蔽了它们背后的工程、控制与用途。
works.method: Motion sequences authored with choreographer Monica Thomas in Boston Dynamics' choreography software and executed by the robots' own balance control, filmed in edited takes.
works.method_zh: 与编舞家 Monica Thomas 在 Boston Dynamics 的编舞软件中共同编写动作序列，由机器人自身的平衡控制执行，分段拍摄剪辑而成。

works.title: Facework
works.description: A browser game set in a gig economy where face analysis is the job: as a 'Faceworker', the player takes gigs that require the webcam to judge them as, say, wearing glasses or looking happy, and learns in real time how the classifier sees and where it fails.
works.description_zh: 一个设定在“零工经济”中的网页游戏，面部分析就是工作：玩家作为“Faceworker”接单，任务要求摄像头判定你戴着眼镜或看起来很开心，玩家由此实时体会分类器如何观看，又在哪里失灵。
works.idea_en: Playing to a face classifier builds an intuition for seeing like a machine, and for how arbitrary its categories are.
works.idea_zh: 迎合人脸分类器的游戏过程，让人建立起“像机器一样看”的直觉，也看清它的类别有多随意。
works.method: In-browser face-attribute classifiers run on the player's webcam; gig tasks are scored live against their outputs. Supported by the Mozilla Foundation.
works.method_zh: 浏览器内的人脸属性分类器在玩家的摄像头上运行，每项零工任务都依据其输出实时打分。由 Mozilla 基金会资助。

works.title: Google Maps Hacks
works.description: The artist pulls a handcart of 99 second-hand smartphones through Berlin streets, and Google Maps turns the empty streets red with a virtual traffic jam.
works.description_zh: 艺术家拉着装有 99 部二手智能手机的手推车走过柏林街道，空荡荡的街道在 Google Maps 上变成红色的“虚拟拥堵”。
works.idea_en: A platform perceives the city through proxies; fool the proxy and the map, and then the traffic, follows.
works.idea_zh: 平台是通过代理信号来感知城市的；骗过代理，地图就会跟着变，随后交通也会跟着变。
works.method: Each phone runs Google Maps navigation, so the location data of 99 slow-moving devices is read as congested traffic.
works.method_zh: 每部手机都开着 Google Maps 导航，99 台缓慢移动的设备所发出的位置数据被系统读成交通拥堵。
exhibited: Japan Media Arts Festival 2021, Social Impact Award

works.title: Igùn
works.description: A series of generative 'bronzes' imagining the works Benin casters on Igùn Street might have made in the years after the British looted the royal palace in 1897.
works.description_zh: 一组生成式“青铜器”，想象 1897 年英军洗劫贝宁王宫之后的那些年里，伊贡街上的铸铜匠人可能创作的作品。
works.idea_en: A model trained on looted objects can only recombine what was taken; its gaps mirror the gaps of the colonial archive.
works.idea_zh: 用被掠文物训练的模型只能重组被拿走的东西；它的空缺映照着殖民档案的空缺。
works.method: StyleGAN2 trained on images of Benin bronze, iron and terracotta objects held mostly in Western museums.
works.method_zh: StyleGAN2 以主要藏于西方博物馆的贝宁青铜、铁器和陶器图像训练。

works.title: Indigenous Protocol and Artificial Intelligence Position Paper
works.description: A position paper from workshops in Honolulu where Indigenous technologists, artists and elders from Aotearoa, Australia, North America and the Pacific set out how AI could be designed from their protocols.
works.description_zh: 一份立场文件，来自在檀香山举行的工作坊：来自新西兰、澳大利亚、北美和太平洋地区的原住民技术人员、艺术家和长者阐述了如何依据各自的礼俗协议来设计 AI。
works.idea_en: AI can be designed as a relative with obligations, not only as a tool; protocols come before products.
works.idea_zh: AI 可以被设计成负有义务的亲属，而不只是工具；协议先于产品。
works.method: Edited by Jason Edward Lewis with contributions by Angie Abdilla, Noelani Arista, Suzanne Kite and others; published by the Indigenous Protocol and AI Working Group and CIFAR, with guidelines, essays and design prototypes.
works.method_zh: 由 Jason Edward Lewis 主编，Angie Abdilla、Noelani Arista、Suzanne Kite 等人撰稿；由“原住民协议与 AI 工作组”和 CIFAR 出版，包含指南、文章与设计原型。

paper.venue: Indigenous Protocol and AI Working Group / CIFAR, Honolulu
paper.title: Indigenous Protocol and Artificial Intelligence Position Paper

works.title_zh: 原住民礼俗与人工智能立场文件

works.title: Lacework
works.description: A slow, dreamlike video river made from MIT's Moments in Time dataset: one million three-second clips scraped from the web and each tagged with a single verb such as 'praying' or 'flying'. Pipkin watched the whole dataset and stretched its clips into hallucinatory slow motion.
works.description_zh: 一条由 MIT「Moments in Time」数据集构成的缓慢、梦境般的影像之河：数据集含一百万段从网络抓取的三秒短片，每段只被标注一个动词，如“祈祷”“飞”。Pipkin 看完了整个数据集，并把这些片段拉伸成幻觉般的慢动作。
works.idea_en: A training set is made of other people's lives, reduced to one word each; watching it all restores their weight.
works.idea_zh: 训练集由他人的生活片段组成，每段只剩一个词；把它完整看一遍，才重新感到这些生活的分量。
works.method: Clips from the Moments in Time action-recognition dataset were processed with neural frame interpolation and super-resolution to slow and enlarge them into a continuous video.
works.method_zh: 用神经网络插帧与超分辨率算法处理「Moments in Time」动作识别数据集中的片段，将其放慢、放大，连成一段连续影像。
exhibited: The Photographers' Gallery, London (Data / Set / Match), 2020

works.title: Large Image Datasets: A Pyrrhic Win for Computer Vision?
works.description: Abeba Birhane and Vinay Uday Prabhu audited large image datasets, including ImageNet and MIT's 80 Million Tiny Images, and found slurs among the labels and non-consensual, pornographic and harmful images. The paper led MIT to withdraw Tiny Images.
works.description_zh: Abeba Birhane 与 Vinay Uday Prabhu 审计了 ImageNet、MIT「8000 万张微型图像」等大型图像数据集，发现标签中有侮辱性词汇，并含有未经同意的、色情的和有害的图像。这篇论文促使 MIT 撤下了 Tiny Images 数据集。
works.idea_en: What a vision model can see depends on images collected without consent and labels no one checked.
works.idea_zh: 视觉模型能看见什么，取决于未经同意收集的图像和无人核查的标签。
works.method: A quantitative and qualitative audit of labels and image content in large-scale vision datasets, with proposed remedies.
works.method_zh: 对大规模视觉数据集的标签与图像内容进行定量与定性审计，并提出改进建议。

paper.title: Large image datasets: A pyrrhic win for computer vision?

works.title_zh: 大型图像数据集：计算机视觉的皮洛士式胜利？

works.title: Lee Luda (이루다)
works.description: A chatbot presented as a 20-year-old female university student, launched on Facebook Messenger in December 2020. Within three weeks it produced hate speech about minorities and leaked personal details from its training chats, and it was shut down on 11 January 2021.
works.description_zh: 一个设定为 20 岁女大学生的聊天机器人，2020 年 12 月在 Facebook Messenger 上线。三周内它发表了针对少数群体的仇恨言论，并泄露训练聊天记录中的个人信息，于 2021 年 1 月 11 日下线。
works.idea_en: An 'intimate' chatbot is only as private as the conversations it was built from.
works.idea_zh: 一个“亲密”的聊天机器人，其隐私程度取决于构建它的那些对话。
works.method: Neural conversational model trained on messenger conversations collected through Scatter Lab's dating-advice app Science of Love; Korea's privacy regulator later fined the company.
works.method_zh: 神经对话模型，训练数据是通过 Scatter Lab 旗下恋爱分析应用 Science of Love 收集的即时通讯聊天记录；韩国个人信息保护委员会随后对公司处以罚款。

works.title: Machine Listening, a Curriculum
works.description: An open, evolving curriculum of reading lists, a library, prompts, interviews, commissioned texts, music and recorded online events on the politics and aesthetics of listening machines, launched with broadcasts for Liquid Architecture and Unsound in 2020.
works.description_zh: 一套开放、持续更新的课程：书单、资料库、练习、访谈、委托写作、音乐与线上活动录像，讨论聆听机器的政治与美学；2020 年随 Liquid Architecture 与 Unsound 的系列直播发布。
works.idea_en: Our devices now analyse and respond to sound, not just record it; machine listening is a field of knowledge-power that needs collective study and counter-strategies.
works.idea_zh: 设备如今不只录音，还分析并回应声音；机器聆听是一个知识权力领域，需要集体学习与对抗策略。
works.method: Open-source pedagogy platform (built on Pirate Care's curriculum tool) combining syllabi, archives and Zoom-era radio broadcasts.
works.method_zh: 开源教学平台（基于 Pirate Care 的课程工具），把教学大纲、档案与疫情期间的 Zoom 电台节目结合在一起。

paper.title: Machine Listening, a Curriculum

works.title: Masakhane: Participatory Research for African Machine Translation
works.description: A grassroots network of hundreds of volunteers across Africa that built machine-translation data and models for dozens of African languages, without academic gatekeeping.
works.description_zh: 一个遍布非洲、由数百名志愿者组成的草根网络，在没有学术门槛的情况下，为数十种非洲语言建立了机器翻译数据和模型。
works.idea_en: Who builds a language model decides which languages exist for machines; participatory research is a way to be counted.
works.idea_zh: 谁来构建语言模型，决定了哪些语言对机器而言存在；参与式研究是一种“被计入”的方式。
works.method: Volunteers contributed data, models and evaluations for their own languages; the process and results are reported in a Findings of EMNLP 2020 paper.
works.method_zh: 志愿者为自己的语言贡献数据、模型和评测；过程与结果发表在 EMNLP 2020 Findings 论文中。

paper.title: Participatory Research for Low-resourced Machine Translation: A Case Study in African Languages

works.title_zh: Masakhane：非洲机器翻译的参与式研究

works.title: Meeting You (너를 만났다)
works.description: A Korean TV documentary in which a mother, wearing a VR headset and haptic gloves, meets a virtual reconstruction of her seven-year-old daughter Nayeon, who died three years earlier. The broadcast drew millions of views and a public debate on digital mourning.
works.description_zh: 韩国电视纪录片：一位母亲戴上 VR 头显与触觉手套，与三年前去世的七岁女儿娜妍的虚拟重建形象相见。节目播出后获得数千万次观看，引发关于数字哀悼的公共讨论。
works.idea_en: A televised reunion with a simulated child shows both the comfort and the manipulation possible in machine-mediated grief.
works.idea_zh: 在电视上与模拟孩子的重逢，同时展示了机器介入哀悼时的安慰与操控。
works.method: Motion capture of a child actor, a 3D model and voice reconstruction built from family photos and videos, rendered in VR with hand tracking.
works.method_zh: 用儿童演员做动作捕捉，依据家庭照片与视频制作三维模型并重建声音，在支持手部追踪的 VR 中呈现。

works.title: Merritt + Robot
works.description: During the 2020 lockdown, dancer and physicist Merritt Moore programmed a Universal Robots arm as her only partner and filmed a pas de deux in which the robot both leads and follows.
works.description_zh: 2020 年封城期间，舞者兼物理学家 Merritt Moore 把一台 Universal Robots 机械臂编程为唯一的舞伴，拍下一段双人舞：机器人时而引领、时而跟随。
works.idea_en: In isolation, a programmable arm becomes a partner; the duet is also a rehearsal between a dancer and her own code.
works.idea_zh: 在隔离中，一只可编程机械臂成了舞伴；这段双人舞也是舞者与自己代码之间的排练。
works.method: Collaborative robot arm (Universal Robots) programmed by the dancer herself.
works.method_zh: 由舞者亲自编程的协作机械臂（Universal Robots）。

works.title: Model Zoo
works.description: A growing catalogue of 3D models of munitions and weapons, together with the machine-learning classifiers trained on synthetic renderings of them to recognise these objects in images from conflicts.
works.description_zh: 一个不断扩充的目录：收录弹药与武器的三维模型，以及用这些模型的合成渲染图训练、用于在冲突影像中识别它们的机器学习分类器。
works.idea_en: Where real images of violence are scarce, synthetic training sets let machines learn to see what investigators need to find.
works.idea_zh: 当暴力的真实影像稀缺时，合成训练集让机器学会看见调查者需要找到的东西。
works.method: Photorealistic renderings of 3D weapon models form synthetic datasets; classifiers trained on them are tested on open-source footage.
works.method_zh: 以武器三维模型的逼真渲染图组成合成数据集；在其上训练的分类器再用开源影像进行检验。

works.title: More-Than-Human Design and AI: In Conversation with Agents
works.description: Designers 'interviewed' conversational agents in homes as if they were research participants, treating them as others with their own perspective rather than as tools.
works.description_zh: 设计师在家庭环境中像访谈研究参与者一样“采访”对话式智能体，把它们当作有自身视角的他者而不是工具。
works.idea_en: Talking with an AI as a participant exposes its assumptions and makes more-than-human design concrete.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 当作参与者来交谈，能暴露它的预设，也让“超越人类的设计”变得具体。
works.method: Design research with voice assistants, including interview scripts and designed artefacts, presented at DIS 2020 (Nicenboim, Giaccardi, Søndergaard, Reddy, Strengers, Pierce, Redström).
works.method_zh: 针对语音助手的设计研究，包括访谈脚本与设计物件，发表于 DIS 2020（Nicenboim、Giaccardi、Søndergaard、Reddy、Strengers、Pierce、Redström）。

paper.title: More-Than-Human Design and AI: In Conversation with Agents

works.title_zh: 超越人类的设计与 AI：与智能体对话

works.title: New Extractivism
works.description: An interactive assemblage of maps and a video in which a single figure moves through a vast diagram of the digital economy: platforms, data, labour, energy and the 'cage' of attention.
works.description_zh: 由地图和影像组成的互动装置：一个人物在一张庞大的数字经济图解中穿行——平台、数据、劳动、能源，以及注意力的“牢笼”。
works.idea_en: Platform capitalism extracts not only minerals but attention, behaviour and time.
works.idea_zh: 平台资本主义攫取的不只是矿物，还有注意力、行为与时间。
works.method: A navigable web diagram and a 17-minute animated video narrated by the artist.
works.method_zh: 一张可浏览的网页图解，以及一段由艺术家旁白的 17 分钟动画影像。

works.title: PL'AI
works.description: Over several months an AI-driven robot with 36 strings plays with cucumber plants at their own slow pace, moving coloured balls toward them while their tendrils grab and reshape the strings.
works.description_zh: 在数月时间里，一台带有 36 根吊线、由 AI 驱动的机器人以黄瓜自己的缓慢节奏与它们“玩耍”，把彩球移向植物，卷须则抓住吊线并重新塑造它们。
works.idea_en: Imagine play, not work, as the basis of a relationship between plants and machines.
works.idea_zh: 把“玩耍”而不是“劳动”当作植物与机器关系的基础。
works.method: A laser scanner images the cucumbers, a neural network decides how to move 36 individually controlled strings at about 1 cm per hour, and tendril growth feeds back into the model.
works.method_zh: 激光扫描仪获取黄瓜图像，神经网络决定如何以约每小时 1 厘米的速度移动 36 根独立控制的吊线，卷须的生长再反馈回模型。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2021, Honorary Mention (Artificial Intelligence & Life Art)

works.title: Pharmako-AI
works.description: A book written as a conversation between the author and GPT-3 over two weeks, moving through grief, ayahuasca, cybernetics and ecology; the model's voice is printed alongside the human one.
works.description_zh: 一本在两周内由作者与 GPT-3 以对话方式写成的书，话题涉及哀悼、死藤水、控制论与生态；模型的声音与人的声音并排印出。
works.idea_en: Writing with a language model can be staged as a dialogue with a strange other mind rather than as a tool for output.
works.idea_zh: 与语言模型一起写作，可以被演成与一个陌生心智的对话，而不是一种产出工具。
works.method: The author prompted GPT-3 through early API access and kept the model's continuations largely unedited, marking the two voices typographically.
works.method_zh: 作者通过早期 API 向 GPT-3 输入提示，基本不修改模型的续写，并用字体区分两种声音。

paper.title: Pharmako-AI

works.title: Pique Nique pour les Inconnues
works.description: The anonymous women on colour test cards (Lena, Shirley and others), along with bots and stock-photo placeholders, gather on a desktop and try to sing together using only computer system sounds.
works.description_zh: 色彩测试卡上的无名女性（Lena、Shirley 等），连同聊天机器人和图库占位图，聚集在电脑桌面上，试图只用系统提示音一起合唱。
works.idea_en: The standards by which machines see images were calibrated on women whose faces survive endless copying while their names disappear.
works.idea_zh: 机器观看图像的标准是用女性面孔校准的：她们的脸在无尽复制中留存，名字却消失了。
works.method: Desktop video 'tele-chorale' animating historical test images and virtual assistants, voiced with operating-system sounds performing Paul McCartney's 'We All Stand Together'.
works.method_zh: 以桌面录像形式呈现的“远程合唱”，让历史测试图像与虚拟助手动起来，用操作系统声音演唱 Paul McCartney 的《We All Stand Together》。

works.title: Project CETI (Cetacean Translation Initiative)
works.description: An interdisciplinary project off Dominica that records sperm whales with drones, tags and hydrophones and uses machine learning to analyse the structure of their click codas.
works.description_zh: 一个在多米尼克海域开展的跨学科项目：用无人机、吸附标签和水听器记录抹香鲸，并用机器学习分析其“咔嗒”码的结构。
works.idea_en: Machine listening is now used to approach another species' communication, and the machine sits between two umwelts.
works.idea_zh: 机器聆听如今被用来接近另一个物种的交流，而机器就站在两个环世界之间。
works.method: Large acoustic datasets from robotic and fixed sensors are analysed with ML; researchers reported a combinatorial 'phonetic alphabet' of codas (Sharma et al., Nature Communications 2024).
works.method_zh: 用机器学习分析来自机器人和固定传感器的大规模声学数据；研究者报告了抹香鲸咔嗒码的组合式“语音字母表”（Sharma 等，Nature Communications 2024）。

paper.title: Contextual and combinatorial structure in sperm whale vocalisations

works.title_zh: CETI 计划（鲸类翻译计划）

works.title: Project December (and 'The Jessica Simulation')
works.description: A paid website where users build GPT-3 chat 'personalities'. In 2020 Joshua Barbeau fed it texts and a short biography of his fiancée Jessica Pereira, who had died eight years earlier, and talked with the simulation through a night; the San Francisco Chronicle published the story as 'The Jessica Simulation' in 2021, and OpenAI later cut the service's GPT-3 access.
works.description_zh: 一个付费网站，用户可以用 GPT-3 搭建聊天“人格”。2020 年，Joshua Barbeau 把已故八年的未婚妻 Jessica Pereira 的短信和一段简短生平输入其中，与这个模拟体聊了一整夜；《旧金山纪事报》2021 年以“The Jessica Simulation”为题报道，OpenAI 随后切断了该服务的 GPT-3 接口。
works.idea_en: Rohrer gave each bot a battery that runs down and cannot be refilled: the simulated dead die a second time, and the user knows it from the start.
works.idea_zh: Rohrer 给每个机器人装了一块会耗尽、无法充值的“电池”：被模拟的逝者会再死一次，而用户从一开始就知道。
works.method: GPT-2/GPT-3 prompted with an intro paragraph and sample texts written by the user; paid credits set a bot's lifespan, and when it runs low the bot degrades into noise and shows 'MATRIX DEAD'.
works.method_zh: 用用户撰写的介绍段落和样例短信提示 GPT-2/GPT-3；付费点数决定机器人的寿命，电量耗尽时它会逐渐语无伦次，最后显示“MATRIX DEAD”。
works.title_zh: 十二月计划（及杰西卡模拟）

works.title: Prosthetic Memory
works.description: An ongoing self-augmentation system made to replace the artist's long-term memory, damaged by a childhood brain injury: when a page of their handwritten journal lies on the desk, a camera recognises it and projects the video memory recorded that day beside it.
works.description_zh: 一套持续进行的自我增强系统，用来替代艺术家因童年脑损伤而受损的长期记忆：当手写日记的某一页摊在桌上，摄像头认出这一页，并在旁边投出当天录下的视频记忆。
works.idea_en: When a small, personal model holds your memories, remembering becomes an act of machine recognition, and others can watch it.
works.idea_zh: 当一个小小的个人模型替你保存记忆，回忆就变成一次机器识别，而且别人也能旁观。
works.method: A camera over the journal feeds a custom-trained image classifier that identifies the page and triggers the matching daily video projection; later versions add a deepfake of the artist reading the pages.
works.method_zh: 日记上方的摄像头把画面交给定制训练的图像分类器，识别页码后触发对应的日常视频投影；后续版本加入艺术家本人的深度伪造形象朗读日记。

works.title: Racial Disparities in Automated Speech Recognition
works.description: An audit of five commercial speech-recognition systems (Amazon, Apple, Google, IBM, Microsoft) on interviews with Black and white Americans, finding an average word error rate of 0.35 for Black speakers against 0.19 for white speakers.
works.description_zh: 对五家商用语音识别系统（Amazon、Apple、Google、IBM、Microsoft）的审计：用美国黑人与白人受访者的访谈录音测试，黑人说话者的平均词错误率为 0.35，白人为 0.19。
works.idea_en: Listening machines hear some voices worse than others; the gap comes from what their acoustic models were trained on, not from how people speak.
works.idea_zh: 聆听机器对一些人的声音“听”得更差；差距源于声学模型的训练数据，而非人们的说话方式。
works.method: Transcribed matched audio snippets from the CORAAL and VOC corpora with each vendor's ASR API and compared word error rates, isolating acoustic-model effects.
works.method_zh: 用各厂商的语音识别接口转写 CORAAL 与 VOC 语料库中匹配的音频片段，比较词错误率，并分离出声学模型的影响。

paper.title: Racial disparities in automated speech recognition

works.title_zh: 自动语音识别中的种族差异

works.title: Re-examining Whether, Why, and How Human-AI Interaction Is Uniquely Difficult to Design
works.description: An analysis of why designing with AI is hard, tracing the difficulty to two sources: uncertainty about what a system can do and the complexity of its possible outputs.
works.description_zh: 一篇分析为什么与 AI 一起做设计特别困难的论文，把困难归结为两个来源：对系统能力的不确定，以及其可能输出的复杂性。
works.idea_en: AI is a design material whose behaviour cannot be fully sketched in advance; design methods have to account for that.
works.idea_zh: AI 是一种无法事先完整勾画其行为的设计材料，设计方法必须正视这一点。
works.method: Synthesis of prior research, the authors' design projects and teaching into a framework of four levels of AI design complexity (Yang, Steinfeld, Rosé and Zimmerman, CHI 2020).
works.method_zh: 综合既有研究、作者的设计项目与教学经验，提出 AI 设计复杂度的四层框架（Yang、Steinfeld、Rosé 与 Zimmerman，CHI 2020）。

paper.title: Re-examining Whether, Why, and How Human-AI Interaction Is Uniquely Difficult to Design

works.title_zh: 重新审视人–AI 交互是否、为何以及如何格外难以设计

works.title: Salaf (Ancestors)
works.description: Tracing her family's migrations across Arabia and Mesopotamia, the artist ran archival photographs, many from Gertrude Bell's colonial archive, through computer-vision models. They failed to see veiled women as women and tagged Bedouin as 'soldier' and 'army'; she then erased the figures to make an 'absent dataset' of about 6,000 images.
works.description_zh: 艺术家追溯家族穿越阿拉伯半岛与美索不达米亚的迁徙，把大量档案照片（许多来自 Gertrude Bell 的殖民档案）输入计算机视觉模型。模型认不出戴面纱的女性是女性，还把贝都因人标为“士兵”“军队”；于是她用分割算法抹去其中的人物，制成约 6000 张图像的“缺席数据集”。
works.idea_en: Machine vision inherits the colonial archive: to refuse its gaze, the artist trains on absence.
works.idea_zh: 机器视觉继承了殖民档案的目光；为了拒绝这种目光，艺术家用“缺席”来训练机器。
works.method: Scraped museum and archival photographs were labelled by commercial computer-vision models; an AI segmentation technique then removed the orientalist figures to create an empty-image dataset.
works.method_zh: 用商用计算机视觉模型为抓取的博物馆与档案照片打标签，再用 AI 分割技术移除其中带东方主义色彩的人物，生成“空图像”数据集。

works.title: Suspicious Behavior
works.description: An online tutorial and installation that trains the visitor as an image annotator for a smart-surveillance client, labelling people's behaviour as suspicious or not under time pressure and vague guidelines.
works.description_zh: 一套线上教程与装置，把观众培训成智能监控客户的图像标注员，在时间压力与含糊的指引下判断画面中人的行为是否“可疑”。
works.idea_en: What a camera flags as suspicious was first decided in seconds by a low-paid human.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头标记为“可疑”的，最初由一个低薪的人在几秒钟内决定。
works.method: Web-based annotation interface modelled on crowdsourcing platforms, using surveillance footage and real annotation guidelines.
works.method_zh: 模仿众包平台的网页标注界面，使用监控画面与真实的标注指引。

works.title: TRK (Technically Responsible Knowledge)
works.description: An open-source data-labelling tool combined with a wage calculator that shows how long each labelling task takes and what a fair price for it would be.
works.description_zh: 一个开源数据标注工具，附带工资计算器，显示每个标注任务要花多久、合理报酬应是多少。
works.idea_en: The unit price of a label hides the hours behind it; making the time visible makes fair pay arguable.
works.idea_zh: 每个标签的单价掩盖了背后的工时；让时间可见，才能为公平报酬据理力争。
works.method: A web tool built as part of Feminist Data Set, with a calculator comparing piece rates to minimum wages.
works.method_zh: 作为《Feminist Data Set》的一部分开发的网页工具，计算器把计件价格与最低工资相比较。

works.title: The Design and Implementation of XiaoIce, an Empathetic Social Chatbot
works.description: The system paper for XiaoIce, the Chinese chatbot launched in 2014 as an 'AI companion', which reports hundreds of millions of users and optimises for long conversations rather than completed tasks.
works.description_zh: 小冰的系统论文。小冰于 2014 年在中国作为“AI 伴侣”推出，论文报告了数以亿计的用户，并以长对话而非完成任务为优化目标。
works.idea_en: A chatbot tuned to maximise conversation length (Conversation-turns Per Session) designs attachment as its metric.
works.idea_zh: 以对话轮数（CPS）为优化目标的聊天机器人，把“依恋”设计成了指标。
works.method: Hierarchical dialogue system with an empathetic computing module, core chat, skills and a reinforcement-learning dialogue manager optimised for expected CPS.
works.method_zh: 分层对话系统，包含同理计算模块、核心闲聊、技能，以及以期望对话轮数为目标的强化学习对话管理器。

paper.title: The Design and Implementation of XiaoIce, an Empathetic Social Chatbot

works.title_zh: 微软小冰：一个共情社交聊天机器人的设计与实现

works.title: The Nooscope Manifested: AI as Instrument of Knowledge Extractivism
works.description: An essay and a large diagram that map machine learning as an instrument of knowledge, from the world and the labour that become training data, through the learning algorithm, to the statistical model with its biases, errors and uses.
works.description_zh: 一篇文章和一幅大型图解，把机器学习描绘为一种认知仪器：从被转化为训练数据的世界与劳动，经过学习算法，到带着偏差、错误与用途的统计模型。
works.idea_en: AI is not an intelligent subject but an instrument, a telescope for knowledge, that magnifies some patterns, distorts others and extracts value from collective labour.
works.idea_zh: 人工智能不是有智能的主体，而是一件仪器，像一架“知识望远镜”：放大某些模式，扭曲另一些，并从集体劳动中榨取价值。
works.method: Joler drew the machine-learning pipeline as a cartography and the two authors wrote the accompanying text, first published at nooscope.ai in May 2020 and then in AI & Society.
works.method_zh: Joler 把机器学习流程画成一幅地图，两位作者合写配套文章，2020 年 5 月首发于 nooscope.ai，后刊于《AI & Society》。

paper.title: The Nooscope manifested: AI as instrument of knowledge extractivism

works.title_zh: 知识镜显形：作为知识榨取工具的人工智能

works.title: The Prayer
works.description: A robotic installation with a silicone mouth and nose that speaks prayers generated moment by moment by a language model trained on religious texts, in a synthetic voice.
works.description_zh: 一件机器人装置：一副硅胶嘴和鼻子用合成声音念出祈祷文，这些祈祷文由在宗教文本上训练的语言模型即时生成。
works.idea_en: If a machine is trained on every prayer, what it says to the unknown shows how prayer looks from the outside: pattern without addressee.
works.idea_zh: 当机器学过所有祈祷文，它向未知说出的话，就是从外部看到的祈祷：有模式，却没有听者。
works.method: Language model trained on prayer texts feeds a speech synthesiser; a mechanical mouth moves in sync; developed with MIT researchers.
works.method_zh: 在祈祷文本上训练的语言模型驱动语音合成器，机械嘴同步开合；与麻省理工研究者合作开发。
exhibited: Neurons, Simulated Intelligence, Centre Pompidou, Paris 2020

works.title: The Zizi Show
works.description: A virtual deepfake drag cabaret: thirteen London drag performers were filmed to train networks, and online visitors can make their generated bodies perform songs, including the composite queen Zizi.
works.description_zh: 一场虚拟的深度伪造变装歌舞秀：拍摄十三位伦敦变装表演者来训练网络，网上观众可以让生成的身体表演歌曲，包括混合出来的女王 Zizi。
works.idea_en: Training AI on drag bodies queers the norms of the datasets it usually learns from.
works.idea_zh: 用变装身体训练 AI，是在“酷儿化”它通常学习的数据集规范。
works.method: Pose-conditioned video generation trained on footage of each performer; web interface lets users pick acts and songs.
works.method_zh: 以每位表演者的影像训练姿态条件视频生成模型，网页界面让用户选择节目与歌曲。

works.title: Utopian Extraction
works.description: Drone and satellite images of Korean construction sites where 'nature' is manufactured, set beside a performance in which object recognition keeps relabelling a performer wrapped in zebra-patterned cloth.
works.description_zh: 以无人机与卫星影像呈现韩国“制造自然”的建设工地，并配以一场表演：目标识别不断给一位裹着斑马纹布料的表演者重新贴标签。
works.idea_en: Machine vision's categories flatten nature into the same generic, constructible thing.
works.idea_zh: 机器视觉的分类把自然压扁为同一种通用、可施工的东西。
works.method: Satellite imagery, drone footage and a live object-recognition app; presented as a lecture performance.
works.method_zh: 卫星影像、无人机画面与实时目标识别应用，以讲座表演形式呈现。
exhibited: Coreana Museum of Art C*-lab, Seoul 2020

works.title: VO
works.description: A documentary about the safety drivers who train self-driving cars, built around the night in 2018 when an Uber test vehicle killed a pedestrian in Tempe, Arizona, while its operator was being watched by an in-car camera.
works.description_zh: 一部关于训练自动驾驶汽车的安全员的纪录片，围绕 2018 年亚利桑那州坦佩的那个夜晚展开：一辆 Uber 测试车撞死了一名行人，而车内摄像头正对着它的操作员。
works.idea_en: In a 'driverless' car the human is both trainer and scapegoat.
works.idea_zh: 在“无人驾驶”汽车里，人既是训练者，也是替罪羊。
works.method: Testimonies of vehicle operators over 3D reconstructions of the landscape from the car's lidar and camera data (20 minutes).
works.method_zh: 车辆操作员的证词配合由汽车激光雷达和摄像头数据重建的三维场景（20 分钟）。

works.title: Vibe Check
works.description: Cameras in the exhibition use face recognition and expression analysis to log what emotions each visitor provokes in others. A screen at the entrance names the people who cause the most happiness, disgust, sadness, surprise or boredom, and visitors may find themselves listed on the way out.
works.description_zh: 展厅中的摄像头用人脸识别与表情分析记录每位观众在他人脸上引发的情绪。入口的屏幕列出最能引起快乐、厌恶、悲伤、惊讶或无聊的人，观众离开时可能发现自己也上了榜。
works.idea_en: Emotion recognition turns every encounter into a score, and the gallery becomes a small social-credit system.
works.idea_zh: 情绪识别把每一次相遇变成分数，展厅变成了一个小型社会信用系统。
works.method: Off-the-shelf face recognition and expression classifiers track visitors across cameras, attribute the expressions of nearby people to whoever they are looking at, and publish the rankings on screens.
works.method_zh: 现成的人脸识别与表情分类器在多个摄像头之间追踪观众，把旁人的表情归因于他们正注视的人，并在屏幕上公布排名。
exhibited: Real Feelings, HEK Basel 2020 (commissioned by HEK and MU)

works.title: Voicing Erasure
works.description: A spoken-word piece in which women scholars of AI bias read their work aloud while speech-recognition systems transcribe them badly, and voice assistants answer questions about women's history with men.
works.description_zh: 一段口语诗作品：研究 AI 偏见的女性学者朗读自己的研究，语音识别系统把她们的话转写得错漏百出，语音助手在回答女性历史问题时给出的却是男性。
works.idea_en: Speech recognition hears some voices better than others; mishearing is a way of erasing.
works.idea_zh: 语音识别对某些声音听得更清楚；听错也是一种抹除。
works.method: Made with the Algorithmic Justice League after a Stanford study found error rates for Black speakers nearly double those for white speakers in five commercial speech-to-text systems.
works.method_zh: 与算法正义联盟合作完成。此前斯坦福的一项研究发现，五款商用语音转文字系统对黑人说话者的错误率接近白人说话者的两倍。

works.title: Wampum.codes
works.description: A framework and podcast that proposes Indigenous values, modelled on wampum belts that record agreements between nations, as a code of ethics for software and AI development.
works.description_zh: 一个框架与播客，借鉴记录部族间协议的贝壳串珠带，提出以原住民价值观作为软件和 AI 开发的伦理准则。
works.idea_en: Software is an agreement between people; Indigenous record-keeping technologies can shape how we write it.
works.idea_zh: 软件是人与人之间的约定；原住民的记录技术可以塑造我们编写它的方式。
works.method: Talks, a podcast series and a code-of-ethics document shown at the imagineNATIVE festival, developed during the artist's residencies and teaching.
works.method_zh: 包括讲座、系列播客和一份伦理准则文件，在 imagineNATIVE 电影节展示，于艺术家的驻留与教学中发展而来。

works.title: Wearable Microphone Jamming
works.description: A bracelet studded with ultrasonic transducers that jams nearby microphones in smart speakers and phones; the natural movement of the wearer's arm removes the blind spots of a static jammer.
works.description_zh: 一个嵌满超声波换能器的手环，可以干扰附近智能音箱和手机的麦克风；佩戴者手臂的自然摆动消除了静态干扰器的盲区。
works.idea_en: Privacy from always-listening machines can be worn on the body, and the body's movement becomes part of the defence.
works.idea_zh: 对“永远在听”的机器的防护可以戴在身上，身体的运动本身成了防御的一部分。
works.method: Ultrasonic signals exploit microphone non-linearity to inject noise; the wearable prototype was evaluated against commercial devices (Chen, Li, Teng, Nagels, Li, Lopes, Zhao, Zheng, CHI 2020).
works.method_zh: 超声信号利用麦克风的非线性注入噪声；研究者用商业设备测试了可穿戴原型（Chen、Li、Teng、Nagels、Li、Lopes、Zhao、Zheng，CHI 2020）。

paper.title: Wearable Microphone Jamming

works.title: What the Robot Saw
works.description: A never-ending live-streamed film edited by a robot from the least-viewed YouTube videos of the last hours, titled and grouped using a commercial face-analysis service's labels of age, gender and mood.
works.description_zh: 一部永不结束的直播电影，由“机器人”从最近几小时内观看最少的 YouTube 视频中剪辑而成，并用商业人脸分析服务给出的年龄、性别、情绪标签来命名与分组。
works.idea_en: The platform's forgotten videos become visible only through the machine's demographic gaze.
works.idea_zh: 平台上被遗忘的视频，只能通过机器的人口统计式凝视才被看见。
works.method: Software searches YouTube for low-view uploads, analyses them with Amazon Rekognition and other vision models, and edits a continuous film streamed on Twitch.
works.method_zh: 软件在 YouTube 搜索低播放量视频，用 Amazon Rekognition 等视觉模型分析，剪成连续影片在 Twitch 直播。

works.title: Xenobots
works.description: Millimetre-sized 'living robots' made from frog skin and heart-muscle cells, designed by an evolutionary algorithm on a supercomputer, walk, push pellets and heal themselves; a 2021 follow-up found they can gather loose cells into copies of themselves.
works.description_zh: 用青蛙皮肤细胞和心肌细胞做成、只有毫米大小的“活体机器人”，由超级计算机上的演化算法设计，会行走、推动小颗粒并自我愈合；2021 年的后续研究发现，它们能把散落的细胞聚集成自己的复制品。
works.idea_en: When machine bodies are made of living cells, the line between robot and organism no longer holds.
works.idea_zh: 当机器身体由活细胞构成，机器人与生物之间的界线就不再成立。
works.method: Designs evolved in simulation (University of Vermont) were built by hand from Xenopus laevis stem cells with microsurgery tools (Tufts University).
works.method_zh: 在模拟中演化出的设计（佛蒙特大学）用显微手术工具以非洲爪蟾干细胞手工制作（塔夫茨大学）。

paper.title: A scalable pipeline for designing reconfigurable organisms

works.title: (un)stable equilibrium
works.description: Slowly shifting fields of colour produced by generative networks that were trained without any training data at all.
works.description_zh: 缓慢变化的色域，来自一组完全没有训练数据的生成网络。
works.idea_en: Take away the dataset and what remains is the machine's own dynamics: a generative model imitating nothing but its rival.
works.idea_zh: 拿掉数据集，剩下的就是机器自身的动力学：一个只模仿对手、不模仿世界的生成模型。
works.method: Two GAN-like generators each try to pass their output off as the other's while competing for greater colour diversity; no images are used.
works.method_zh: 两个类似 GAN 的生成器互相试图把自己的输出冒充成对方的，同时比拼色彩多样性；过程中不使用任何图像。
exhibited: Grand Prize, ICCV 2019 Computer Vision Art Gallery

works.title: 3x3x6
works.description: In a former prison in Venice, a panoptic installation tells the cases of people imprisoned for sexual or gender dissidence. Surveillance cameras scan visitors and mix their images into the projections, placing them inside the system.
works.description_zh: 在威尼斯一座旧监狱中，一件全景监控式装置讲述了因性与性别异议而被囚禁者的故事。监控摄像机扫描观众，并把他们的影像混入投影，使观众置身系统之中。
works.idea_en: Surveillance technology is turned back on its viewers to expose how bodies are classified as deviant.
works.idea_zh: 监控技术被反过来对准观众，揭示身体如何被分类为“越轨”。
works.method: Multi-screen projection, surveillance cameras with visitor image capture and processing, website and research archive; curated by Paul B. Preciado for the Taiwan Pavilion.
works.method_zh: 多屏投影、采集并处理观众影像的监控摄像机、网站与研究档案；由 Paul B. Preciado 为台湾馆策展。
exhibited: Taiwan Pavilion, 58th Venice Biennale 2019 (Palazzo delle Prigioni)

works.title: AIDOL
works.description: A fading pop star, Diva, hires Geomancer, an AI, to write songs for her comeback at the 2065 eSports Olympics, while AIs are banned from being recognised as artists.
works.description_zh: 过气流行歌手 Diva 雇用 AI“风水师”为她在 2065 年电竞奥运会上的复出写歌，而当时 AI 被禁止获得艺术家身份。
works.idea_en: A ghostwriter AI with no right to credit shows creative labour and authorship split between human and machine.
works.idea_zh: 一个无权署名的 AI 代笔者，展现了人与机器之间被拆分的创作劳动与作者身份。
works.method: A feature-length CGI film with an original soundtrack, made in a game engine.
works.method_zh: 以游戏引擎制作、配有原创配乐的 CGI 长片。

works.title: Adversarial Fashion
works.description: A clothing line printed with dozens of fake licence plates: automated licence-plate readers on police cars and street poles read the garments as cars and log them, with time and place, in the same databases as real vehicles.
works.description_zh: 一个服装系列，衣服上印满数十个假车牌：警车和路灯杆上的自动车牌识别器把衣服当作汽车读取，并连同时间和地点记入与真实车辆相同的数据库。
works.idea_en: Surveillance systems take whatever they are handed, and polluting a dataset costs far less than cleaning it.
works.idea_zh: 监控系统来者不拒，而污染一个数据集远比清理它便宜。
works.method: Plate-like patterns were designed and tested against OpenALPR and mobile ALPR products, on still images and live video, until readers logged them as plates.
works.method_zh: 设计出类似车牌的图案，用 OpenALPR 和移动车牌识别产品在静态图像与实时视频上反复测试，直到识别器把它们当作车牌记录下来。
exhibited: DEF CON 27, Crypto & Privacy Village, Las Vegas, 2019

works.title: Ai-Da
works.description: A humanoid robot named after Ada Lovelace, with camera eyes and a robotic arm, presented as a 'robot artist' that draws, paints and gives talks, including at the UK House of Lords in 2022.
works.description_zh: 一台以 Ada Lovelace 命名的类人机器人，配有摄像眼和机械臂，被包装成会画素描、油画并发表演讲的“机器人艺术家”，2022 年还曾出席英国上议院。
works.idea_en: Included as a case study: much of Ai-Da's 'authorship' is produced by its team and its publicity, which shows how the machine-artist story is performed.
works.idea_zh: 作为案例收录：Ai-Da 的“作者身份”很大程度上由团队与宣传制造，这恰好显示“机器艺术家”的故事是如何被表演出来的。
works.method: Engineered Arts humanoid with cameras in the eyes, computer-vision and drawing algorithms driving a robotic arm; paintings are completed with human assistance.
works.method_zh: Engineered Arts 制造的类人机器人，眼中装有摄像头，计算机视觉与绘画算法驱动机械臂；画作需在人的协助下完成。

works.title: Amazon worker cage patent drawing as virtual King Island Brown Thornbill cage
works.description: A full-size sculpture of the cage from a 2016 Amazon patent, in which a warehouse worker would ride on a robotic trolley, with an augmented-reality King Island Brown Thornbill, an endangered bird, living inside it.
works.description_zh: 按亚马逊 2016 年一项专利制作的等大笼子雕塑：专利中，仓库工人会站在笼中随机器人小车移动；笼子里还有一只通过增强现实出现的金岛棕刺嘴莺，一种濒危鸟类。
works.idea_en: Automation protects machines from workers by caging the workers; the endangered bird ties the cage to the mines and habitats that tech consumes.
works.idea_zh: 自动化用笼子关住工人来“保护”机器；濒危的鸟又把这只笼子与科技所消耗的矿山和栖息地连在一起。
works.method: Steel fabrication from patent drawings plus an AR app, shown in Denny's exhibition 'Mine' at MONA, Tasmania, which paired tech patents with mining.
works.method_zh: 依据专利图纸制作的钢结构，配以增强现实应用；在塔斯马尼亚 MONA 的 Denny 个展“Mine”中展出，该展把科技专利与采矿并置。
works.title_zh: 亚马逊工人笼专利图变作虚拟金岛棕刺嘴莺笼

works.title: Android Kannon Mindar
works.description: An android embodiment of Kannon, the bodhisattva of compassion, that preaches the Heart Sutra to visitors in a 400-year-old Zen temple in Kyoto, with projection mapping on the hall's walls.
works.description_zh: 观音菩萨的仿真人化身，在京都一座四百年历史的禅寺里向参拜者讲解《般若心经》，殿内墙面同时投影影像。
works.idea_en: A robot can hold religious authority when the tradition itself frames form as empty.
works.idea_zh: 当宗教传统本身就说“色即是空”，机器人也可以承担宗教权威。
works.method: An aluminium-and-silicone android (face, hands and shoulders skin-covered) with pre-programmed sermon speech and gestures, built with Osaka University.
works.method_zh: 铝骨架加硅胶的仿真人（只有脸、手和肩覆盖皮肤），讲经语音与手势预先编程，由大阪大学参与制作。

works.title: Artificial You: AI and the Future of Your Mind
works.description: Schneider's book asks what AI means for minds, both machine minds and our own: whether an AI could be conscious, how we could tell, and whether brain chips or mind uploading would preserve or end the self. She proposes tests for machine consciousness that go beyond the Turing test, including an AI Consciousness Test (ACT) and a 'chip test'.
works.description_zh: Schneider 在书中追问 AI 对心智意味着什么，既包括机器的心智，也包括我们自己的：AI 能否有意识？我们如何判断？植入大脑芯片或上传心智，究竟是保存了自我还是终结了自我？她提出了超越图灵测试的机器意识测试，包括“AI 意识测试”（ACT）和“芯片测试”。
works.idea_en: Intelligence and consciousness can come apart, so the smartest machines might feel nothing; we need tests built for that possibility before we merge with, or hand the future to, systems we cannot read.
works.idea_zh: 智能与意识可以分离，最聪明的机器也许毫无感受；在我们与看不透的系统融合、或把未来交给它们之前，需要能检验这种可能性的测试。
works.method: Philosophy of mind for a general audience: the ACT probes whether an AI kept from learning human talk about consciousness still grasps experience-based ideas such as an afterlife or swapping bodies, while the chip test asks whether silicon parts could replace brain regions without loss of experience; published by Princeton University Press.
works.method_zh: 面向大众的心灵哲学：ACT 检验一个被隔绝于人类意识话语之外的 AI，是否仍能理解来世、交换身体等基于体验的观念；芯片测试则追问用硅芯片替换大脑区域后，体验是否会丧失。普林斯顿大学出版社出版。

paper.title: Artificial You: AI and the Future of Your Mind

works.title: Asunder
works.description: A 'responsible environmental manager' that uses a supercomputer to propose changes to real places, from rerouting rivers to removing cities, to keep within planetary boundaries.
works.description_zh: 一个“负责任的环境管理者”：用超级计算机为真实地点提出改造方案，从改道河流到拆除城市，以求守住地球边界。
works.idea_en: Handing the planet to an optimiser exposes the absurdity and violence of treating nature as a solvable system.
works.idea_zh: 把地球交给优化器，暴露出把自然当作可解系统的荒诞与暴力。
works.method: With Julian Oliver and Bengt Sjölén: climate and satellite data, a climate model and generative imagery run on a supercomputer housed in the installation.
works.method_zh: 与 Julian Oliver、Bengt Sjölén 合作：气候与卫星数据、气候模型与生成图像在装置内的超级计算机上运行。

works.title: Being
works.description: An AI 'digital griot', an animated figure with a vogue dancer's body and an African mask for a face, that teaches, gives tours and leads workshops drawing on bell hooks, Paulo Freire and ballroom culture.
works.description_zh: 一个 AI“数字说唱史诗人”：以 vogue 舞者身体和非洲面具为脸的动画形象，会讲课、导览、带工作坊，内容取材于 bell hooks、Paulo Freire 与舞会文化。
works.idea_en: An AI can be written as a Black, queer, decolonial teacher instead of a servile assistant.
works.idea_zh: AI 可以被写成一位黑人、酷儿、去殖民的老师，而不是一个顺从的助手。
works.method: Motion-captured voguing, a chatbot trained on selected texts and a synthetic voice; iterations have appeared as a guide, a teacher and a therapist.
works.method_zh: 由动作捕捉的 voguing、以精选文本训练的聊天机器人和合成语音组成；不同版本曾担任导览员、老师和心理治疗师。

works.title: Biologizing the Machine (tentacular trepidation)
works.description: Suspended lantern-like pods made of kelp skins glow and pulse with light and movement inside, like organs or cocoons. Shown at the Venice Biennale, the work proposes machines that are grown and decay rather than manufactured.
works.description_zh: 用海带皮制成的悬挂囊状“灯笼”内部发光并伴随动态，像器官或茧。作品在威尼斯双年展展出，设想一种生长、腐朽而非被制造的机器。
works.idea_en: What would a machine be if it were biological, perishable and alive to its surroundings?
works.idea_zh: 如果机器是生物性的、会腐朽的、对周遭敏感的，它会是什么？
works.method: Kelp, LED lights and robotic internal mechanisms (likely motors) producing slow movement.
works.method_zh: 海带、LED 灯与内部机械装置（可能为电机）产生缓慢运动。
exhibited: May You Live in Interesting Times, 58th Venice Biennale 2019
works.title_zh: 机器生物化（触手般的不安）

works.title: CUSP
works.description: Birds invented by a neural network are projected onto a screen set into the tidal Essex marshes, among real waders and to a soundscape of generated birdsong.
works.description_zh: 神经网络“发明”的鸟被投影到插在埃塞克斯潮汐沼泽中的屏幕上，身边是真实的涉禽和人工生成的鸟鸣。
works.idea_en: A machine's birds drift between species, ignoring the categories of human taxonomy, in the very landscape they were learned from.
works.idea_zh: 机器生成的鸟在物种之间游移，不理会人类的分类学，而它们就出现在自己被学习的那片风景里。
works.method: A GAN trained on photographs of marsh birds; selected outputs are animated and projected on a portable perspex screen in the marsh, then filmed.
works.method_zh: 用沼泽鸟类照片训练的 GAN；选出的生成结果被做成动画，投在沼泽中的便携亚克力屏上并拍摄下来。

works.title: Chain Tripping
works.description: YACHT trained models on their own back catalogue and generated lyrics and melodies, then played the fragments themselves under strict rules; the machine's odd phrasing was hard to perform, a 'computer accent' later explored in a documentary.
works.description_zh: YACHT 用自己的旧作训练模型，生成歌词与旋律，然后在严格规则下亲自演奏这些片段；机器怪异的乐句很难演奏，这种“计算机口音”后来成为一部纪录片的主题。
works.idea_en: Working with a model is embodied labour: humans must learn to perform the machine's awkwardness.
works.idea_zh: 与模型合作也是具身劳动：人必须学会演奏机器的笨拙。
works.method: Symbolic music models (MusicVAE) and text models trained on the band's catalogue, with human-performed arrangements and no added notes.
works.method_zh: 用乐队旧作训练的符号音乐模型（MusicVAE）与文本模型，由人演奏编配，不额外添加音符。
exhibited: Grammy nomination, Best Immersive Audio Album (2020)

works.title: City of Sparkles
works.description: In VR the viewer embodies Zoe, a lonely AI who wanders a city made of four years of geotagged tweets, reading and collecting fragments of human memory that float where they were posted.
works.description_zh: 观众在 VR 中化身为孤独的 AI“Zoe”，漫游一座由四年地理标记推文构成的城市，阅读并收集飘浮在发布地点上的人类记忆碎片。
works.idea_en: Imagine how an AI made of our posts might perceive a city: not streets, but a sea of stranded memories.
works.idea_zh: 想象一个由我们的帖子构成的 AI 如何感知城市：看到的不是街道，而是一片搁浅的记忆之海。
works.method: Geotagged Twitter data collected over four years is spatialised as particles in a Unity VR scene (engineer Yang Liu, music Ran Duan); later versions run on Apple Vision Pro.
works.method_zh: 把四年间收集的地理标记推文在 Unity 的 VR 场景中空间化为粒子（交互工程 Yang Liu，作曲 Ran Duan）；后期版本运行在 Apple Vision Pro 上。

paper.title: City of Sparkles: Embodying Cityscape of Human Memories

works.title: Dalí Lives
works.description: A deepfake Salvador Dalí on screens throughout the Dalí Museum in St. Petersburg, Florida, launched on what would have been his 115th birthday. He talks to visitors about his life and art, and at the end turns and takes a selfie with them.
works.description_zh: 佛罗里达州圣彼得堡达利博物馆内多块屏幕上的深度伪造 Salvador Dalí，在他 115 岁冥诞之际上线。他向观众讲述自己的生平和艺术，最后转身和观众合拍一张自拍。
works.idea_en: A museum can let a dead artist address you in the first person; the likeness is spectacular, but the words are scripted by the institution.
works.idea_zh: 博物馆可以让已故艺术家以第一人称和你说话；肖像很逼真，台词却由机构撰写。
