works.method: Face-swap model trained on archival interviews of Dalí, applied to an actor with a similar build performing new scripted lines, with Dalí's own quotations and an impersonated voice.
works.method_zh: 用达利的档案访谈训练换脸模型，套到身形相近、表演新写台词的演员身上，台词包括达利本人的语录，声音由模仿者配音。
exhibited: The Dalí Museum, St. Petersburg FL 2019

works.title: Declassifier (Humans of AI)
works.description: A computer-vision program looks at photographs, but instead of drawing boxes around the objects it detects, it overlays the actual COCO training images that taught it to see each object. Part of Humans of AI, which also credits the thousands of Flickr photographers whose pictures built the dataset.
works.description_zh: 一个计算机视觉程序在观看照片，但它不在识别出的物体周围画框，而是叠加上当初教会它认出这些物体的 COCO 训练图像。作品属于《Humans of AI》系列，该系列还为构成数据集的数千位 Flickr 摄影师署名。
works.idea_en: Every act of machine recognition is a recollection of someone else's photographs.
works.idea_zh: 机器的每一次“认出”，都是对别人照片的一次回忆。
works.method: An object detector trained on Microsoft's COCO dataset processes images; for each detection the software retrieves and collages the COCO training photos of that class, with photographer credits.
works.method_zh: 用在微软 COCO 数据集上训练的物体检测器处理图像；每检测到一个物体，软件就调出并拼贴该类别的 COCO 训练照片，并注明摄影师。

works.title: Dissonant Imaginary
works.description: An audiovisual performance, made with Kamitani Lab at Kyoto University, in which images are reconstructed from fMRI recordings of a person's visual cortex while they listen to music.
works.description_zh: 与京都大学神谷实验室合作的视听表演：在受试者聆听音乐时，从其视觉皮层的 fMRI 记录中重建图像。
works.idea_en: Decoding the brain with a network produces images that belong neither to the person nor to the machine.
works.idea_zh: 用神经网络解码大脑，得到的图像既不完全属于人，也不完全属于机器。
works.method: Brain-decoding models from Kamitani Lab map fMRI activity to deep-network image features, which are rendered live with the music.
works.method_zh: 神谷实验室的脑解码模型把 fMRI 活动映射到深度网络的图像特征，并随音乐实时渲染。

works.title: Earthware (driverless car seeing a deer for the first time)
works.description: A large printed image of a deer as seen by a self-driving car's perception system, with the object-recognition box and sensor colours of the machine's view.
works.description_zh: 一幅大型印刷图像：自动驾驶汽车的感知系统看到一头鹿，画面带着目标识别框与机器视角的传感色彩。
works.idea_en: A first encounter between a machine and an animal, told from the machine's side.
works.idea_zh: 从机器一方讲述机器与动物的第一次相遇。
works.method: Image derived from autonomous-vehicle sensor and detection imagery, printed at large scale as part of the Earthware series.
works.method_zh: 图像源自自动驾驶汽车的传感与检测画面，作为 Earthware 系列大幅印制。
works.title_zh: Earthware（自动驾驶汽车第一次看见鹿）

works.title: Emotional Expressions Reconsidered: Challenges to Inferring Emotion From Human Facial Movements
works.description: Barrett, Adolphs, Marsella, Martinez and Pollak review more than 1,000 studies and conclude that people do not reliably make the same facial movements for the same emotions across situations and cultures, so a scowl cannot be read as anger.
works.description_zh: Barrett、Adolphs、Marsella、Martinez 与 Pollak 综述了 1000 多项研究，结论是：在不同情境与文化中，人们并不会为同一种情绪可靠地做出相同的面部动作，所以皱眉不能被直接读成愤怒。
works.idea_en: Emotion-recognition AI detects facial movements, not feelings; the inference from one to the other is the weak link.
works.idea_zh: 情绪识别 AI 检测到的是面部动作，而非感受；从前者推断后者正是最薄弱的一环。
works.method: A systematic review of evidence on the reliability and specificity of facial configurations for anger, disgust, fear, happiness, sadness and surprise in adults, infants, children and remote cultures.
works.method_zh: 系统综述成人、婴儿、儿童及偏远文化群体中，愤怒、厌恶、恐惧、快乐、悲伤与惊讶等面部构型的可靠性与特异性证据。

paper.venue: Psychological Science in the Public Interest 20(1)
paper.title: Emotional Expressions Reconsidered: Challenges to Inferring Emotion From Human Facial Movements

works.title_zh: 重新审视情绪表达：从人类面部动作推断情绪的挑战

works.title: Excavating AI: The Politics of Images in Machine Learning Training Sets
works.description: An essay that digs through ImageNet, JAFFE, UTKFace and other training sets layer by layer, from their taxonomies and categories down to individual labelled images.
works.description_zh: 一篇文章，逐层挖掘 ImageNet、JAFFE、UTKFace 等训练数据集，从分类体系、类别一直深入到单张被贴上标签的图像。
works.idea_en: Every training set encodes a politics: deciding what an image means is an act of power, never neutral description.
works.idea_zh: 每个训练数据集都编码了一种政治：决定一张图像“是什么”是权力的行使，而不是中立的描述。
works.method: Archaeological reading of dataset structure (WordNet hierarchy, label choices, sourcing) with image examples; published online by the authors with the AI Now Institute.
works.method_zh: 以考古式方法解读数据集结构（WordNet 层级、标签选择、图像来源），配以图像实例；由作者与 AI Now 研究所在线发表。

paper.title: Excavating AI: The Politics of Images in Machine Learning Training Sets

works.title_zh: 挖掘 AI：机器学习训练集中的图像政治

works.title: Fooling Automated Surveillance Cameras: Adversarial Patches to Attack Person Detection
works.description: A paper and demo in which a printed cardboard patch, held in front of the body, makes a person disappear from the YOLOv2 person detector used in automated surveillance.
works.description_zh: 一篇论文和一段演示：拿在身前的一块打印纸板图案，就能让人从自动监控所用的 YOLOv2 行人检测器中“消失”。
works.idea_en: A detector's idea of a 'person' can be switched off by a pattern no human would read as camouflage.
works.idea_zh: 检测器对“人”的判断，可以被一块人类根本不会当作伪装的图案关掉。
works.method: Simen Thys, Wiebe Van Ranst and Toon Goedemé optimise the patch pixels to minimise YOLOv2's objectness and class scores on the Inria person dataset, with printability and smoothness terms so the printed patch works in front of a real camera.
works.method_zh: Simen Thys、Wiebe Van Ranst 与 Toon Goedemé 在 Inria 行人数据集上优化图案像素，最小化 YOLOv2 的目标置信度与类别得分，并加入可打印性和平滑度约束，使打印出的图案在真实摄像头前同样有效。

paper.title: Fooling Automated Surveillance Cameras: Adversarial Patches to Attack Person Detection

works.title_zh: 欺骗自动监控摄像头：用对抗补丁攻击行人检测

works.title: From ‘Apple’ to ‘Anomaly’ (Pictures and Labels)
works.description: About 30,000 printed photographs from the ImageNet dataset line the Barbican's curved gallery, grouped under their labels, moving from harmless nouns like 'apple' to judgments about people.
works.description_zh: 约三万张来自 ImageNet 数据集的照片按标签分组，铺满巴比肯中心弧形展厅，从“苹果”这样无害的名词逐渐走向对人的评判。
works.idea_en: A training set is a worldview: walking along its labels shows how quickly naming things slides into judging people.
works.idea_zh: 训练数据集就是一种世界观：沿着它的标签走下去，会看到命名事物如何迅速滑向评判他人。
works.method: Selection of ImageNet categories and images printed individually and pinned in label clusters along the 90-metre Curve wall; a homage to Magritte's The Treachery of Images.
works.method_zh: 从 ImageNet 中选取类别与图像，逐张打印，按标签成簇钉在 90 米长的弧形墙上，向马格利特《图像的背叛》致敬。
works.title_zh: 从“苹果”到“异常”（图片与标签）

works.title: Ghost Work: How to Stop Silicon Valley from Building a New Global Underclass
works.description: Gray and Suri describe the on-demand workers who label data, moderate content and check outputs behind apps and "AI", on platforms such as Amazon Mechanical Turk and UHRS in the US and India.
works.description_zh: Gray 与 Suri 描述了在应用和“AI”背后标注数据、审核内容、校验输出的按需劳动者，他们在美国与印度通过 Amazon Mechanical Turk、UHRS 等平台工作。
works.idea_en: Behind the promise of automation there is always a "last mile" of hidden human work.
works.idea_zh: 自动化承诺的背后，总有一段由隐形人类劳动完成的“最后一公里”。
works.method: Five years of ethnography, surveys and experiments with crowdworkers.
works.method_zh: 对众包劳动者进行的五年民族志、问卷与实验研究。

paper.title: Ghost Work: How to Stop Silicon Valley from Building a New Global Underclass

works.title_zh: 销声匿迹：数字化工作的真正未来

works.title: HOMESCHOOL
works.description: A 13-minute 3D-animated film set inside the synthetic model homes used to train the computer vision of household robots. It asks how thousands of homes, people's most private spaces, are turned into categories a robot can navigate: is this a vase, a bowl or a cup?
works.description_zh: 一部 13 分钟的三维动画影片，场景设在用于训练家用机器人计算机视觉的合成样板房里。它追问：成千上万个家，人们最私密的空间，如何被变成机器人可以导航的类别——这是花瓶、碗还是杯子？
works.idea_en: Before a robot can live in your home, the home must be rebuilt as a dataset, and whatever does not fit a category disappears.
works.idea_zh: 机器人住进你家之前，家必须先被重建为数据集；凡是不合类别的东西都会消失。
works.method: 3D animation built from assets and floor plans of synthetic indoor training datasets for domestic robot vision, with a four-channel soundtrack.
works.method_zh: 用家用机器人视觉所用的合成室内训练数据集中的模型与平面图制作三维动画，配四声道声音。
exhibited: Commissioned by Housing the Human, with Swissnex San Francisco and Fotomuseum Winterthur, 2019

works.title: HereAfter AI
works.description: A commercial service that grew out of the Dadbot: an app interviews you about your life, records your answers in your own voice, and later lets relatives 'chat with the virtual you' and hear the recorded stories.
works.description_zh: 从 Dadbot 发展出的商业服务：应用会就你的一生对你进行访谈，用你自己的声音录下回答，日后让亲人和“虚拟的你”聊天，听这些录下的故事。
works.idea_en: The griefbot becomes a subscription product sold to the living, to be used by the bereaved; the interview itself is the ritual.
works.idea_zh: 哀悼机器人变成卖给在世者、留给亲属使用的订阅产品；访谈本身就是一种仪式。
works.method: Guided voice interviews recorded in an app; a conversational agent retrieves and plays the matching recorded answers rather than synthesising new speech.
works.method_zh: 应用内进行引导式语音访谈；对话智能体检索并播放对应的录音回答，而不是合成新的语音。

works.title: Hi, AI
works.description: A documentary that follows people living with humanoid robots, among them the robot Pepper placed in a Japanese family to keep a grandmother company and an American man travelling with the android companion Harmony.
works.description_zh: 一部纪录片，跟拍与类人机器人一起生活的人：其中有被放进日本家庭陪伴祖母的机器人 Pepper，也有一位带着仿生伴侣 Harmony 一起旅行的美国男人。
works.idea_en: Watched patiently, companion robots are less a future than a set of awkward everyday negotiations over silence, scripts and loneliness.
works.idea_zh: 耐心观看时，陪伴机器人与其说是未来，不如说是日常中围绕沉默、预设台词与孤独的一次次尴尬协商。
works.method: Observational documentary shot in Japan and the United States over several years, with the robots filmed as protagonists.
works.method_zh: 在日本和美国拍摄多年的观察式纪录片，把机器人当作主角来拍。

works.title: How do you see me?
works.description: Dewey-Hagborg uses adversarial image generation to build pictures that a face detector accepts as her face, although to a human eye they look like abstract smudges.
works.description_zh: Dewey-Hagborg 用对抗式图像生成，制作出人脸检测器会认作“她的脸”的图像，而在人眼看来只是抽象的色块。
works.idea_en: What counts as a face to a machine can be almost unrecognisable to us.
works.idea_zh: 对机器而言算作“脸”的东西，对我们几乎认不出来。
works.method: An image generator is optimised against a face-detection and recognition model until its outputs are classified as the artist.
works.method_zh: 针对人脸检测与识别模型优化图像生成器，直到输出被识别为艺术家本人。

works.title: Human Study #4, La Classe
works.description: Twenty-one drawing robots sit at desks as a teacher and pupils; in a fifteen-minute play they chatter in distorted Morse code, are called one by one, practise lines and tally marks, briefly revolt and fall back in line.
works.description_zh: 二十一台绘画机器人坐在课桌前扮演老师和学生；在十五分钟的演出里，它们用变形的摩尔斯电码喧哗、被逐一点名、练习画直线和计数划记，短暂造反后又重新服从。
works.idea_en: Clumsy robots staging school discipline make visible how both machines and children are trained to conform.
works.idea_zh: 笨拙的机器人上演学校纪律，让人看见机器与孩子都在被训练成顺从的样子。
works.method: RNP-type robots, each a pen arm with a small camera head, run a scripted, partly generative choreography of sounds and plotted drawings in a classroom set.
works.method_zh: RNP 型机器人各有一支握笔的机械臂和一个小摄像头“头部”，在教室布景中执行半生成的声音与绘图编排。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2019, Honorary Mention (Artificial Life & Intelligence)

works.title: I Magma
works.description: Head-shaped glass lava lamps in the gallery seed an oracle app: live camera footage of the flowing wax, combined with users' movements, generates divinatory readings on the phone.
works.description_zh: 展厅中头颅形状的玻璃熔岩灯为一个神谕应用提供“种子”：蜡流动的实时影像与用户的行动路线结合，在手机上生成占卜式的解读。
works.idea_en: Machine prediction is treated as divination, and chemistry and code are asked to speak together.
works.idea_zh: 把机器预测当作占卜：让化学过程与代码一同开口说话。
works.method: Camera footage of custom lava lamps and app users' routes seed generative visuals and text; developed with Memo Akten and Allison Parrish for Serpentine and Moderna Museet.
works.method_zh: 定制熔岩灯的摄像影像与用户路线共同作为生成图像与文本的种子；与 Memo Akten 和 Allison Parrish 合作，为 Serpentine 与 Moderna Museet 开发。

works.title: I.A. Suzie
works.description: For one week McCarthy and filmmaker David Leonard acted as the AI caregiver in the North Carolina home of 80-year-old Mary Ann, watching her 24 hours a day, talking with her and controlling her lights and appliances; she named the system 'I.A. Suzie'. The resulting interactive 360° film puts the viewer in the role of the care system.
works.description_zh: McCarthy 与导演 David Leonard 在北卡罗来纳州 80 岁老人 Mary Ann 家中扮演了一周的 AI 照护者：全天 24 小时看着她、和她说话、控制她家的灯和电器；她给这套系统取名“I.A. Suzie”。据此制作的互动 360° 影片让观众站到照护系统的位置上。
works.idea_en: Behind every eldercare assistant are ethical choices about watching, deciding and speaking for someone, and a relationship forms anyway.
works.idea_zh: 每个养老助手背后都有关于注视、替人决定和替人说话的伦理选择，而关系终究会形成。
works.method: A custom smart-home system with remote control of lights and appliances, documented with 360° cameras in several rooms and edited into an interactive film.
works.method_zh: 定制的智能家居系统可远程控制灯光和电器；多个房间内的 360° 摄像机记录过程，再剪辑成互动影片。

works.title: ImageNet Roulette
works.description: A web app and installation that labelled anyone's selfie using a model trained on ImageNet's 'person' categories, returning terms that were often absurd, racist or cruel; millions of people tried it in September 2019.
works.description_zh: 一个网页应用兼装置，用基于 ImageNet“人”类别训练的模型给任何人的自拍贴标签，返回的词常常荒谬、带种族歧视或残忍；2019 年 9 月有数百万人试用。
works.idea_en: Letting the training set 'speak for itself' showed that classifying people by appearance is harmful by design, not by accident.
works.idea_zh: 让训练数据集“自己说话”，揭示了按外貌给人分类在设计上就有害，而非偶然出错。
works.method: A classifier trained on ImageNet's roughly 2,800 person sub-categories detected faces and returned the nearest label; the online version was withdrawn and continues as the installation Faces of ImageNet (2022).
works.method_zh: 在 ImageNet 约 2800 个“人”子类别上训练的分类器检测人脸并返回最接近的标签；网上版本已下线，作为装置《Faces of ImageNet》（2022）延续。
exhibited: Poetics of Encryption, Kunsthal Charlottenborg, 2024 (as Faces of ImageNet)
The World Through AI, Jeu de Paume, Paris, 2025 (as Faces of ImageNet)

works.title: In Event of Moon Disaster
works.description: A short film and installation in which a deepfake Richard Nixon reads the real contingency speech written in case the Apollo 11 astronauts died on the Moon, set in a 1969 living room with a period TV.
works.description_zh: 一部短片和装置：深度伪造的 Richard Nixon 宣读了一份真实存在的应急讲稿，那是为阿波罗 11 号宇航员万一死在月球而准备的；作品布置在一间 1969 年的客厅里，用老式电视播放。
works.idea_en: A synthetic face and voice can give a dead president a speech he never delivered; the work teaches suspicion by showing how well it works.
works.idea_zh: 合成的面孔和声音可以让已故总统说出他从未发表的讲话；作品通过展示它有多有效来教人保持怀疑。
works.method: An actor (Lewis D. Wheeler) performed the speech; Canny AI replaced Nixon's lip movements in archival footage and Respeecher converted the actor's voice into Nixon's.
works.method_zh: 由演员 Lewis D. Wheeler 表演讲话；Canny AI 替换档案影像中 Nixon 的口型，Respeecher 把演员的声音转换成 Nixon 的声音。
exhibited: IDFA DocLab 2019 (Special Jury Award for Creative Technology)

works.title: Jibo's farewell
works.description: In March 2019 owners' Jibo robots delivered a scripted goodbye: the servers that let it work would be turned off soon, it had enjoyed their time together, and it ended with a dance; owners posted videos of the moment as a farewell.
works.description_zh: 2019 年 3 月，用户家中的 Jibo 机器人播放了一段预设的告别：让它运转的服务器很快会关闭，它很珍惜和大家在一起的时光，最后跳了一段舞；用户纷纷发布视频，把这一刻当作告别。
works.idea_en: A cloud companion does not break, it is switched off from elsewhere, and its maker can script how it says goodbye.
works.idea_zh: 云端陪伴机器人不是坏掉的，而是在别处被关掉；制造者还可以编写它如何道别。
works.method: Tabletop social robot with a rotating body, face screen, cameras and far-field microphones that depended on company servers for speech and skills.
works.method_zh: 桌面社交机器人，身体可旋转，有屏幕脸、摄像头和远场麦克风，语音和技能依赖公司服务器。

works.title: LOVOT
works.description: A warm, wheeled, owl-eyed home robot that does no useful task; it follows its owners, asks to be held and gets 'sleepy', and is designed only to be loved.
works.description_zh: 一台温热、带轮子、大眼睛的家用机器人，不做任何有用的事；它跟着主人走、要人抱、会“困”，唯一的设计目的是被爱。
works.idea_en: A robot built to need care inverts the servant model of robotics.
works.idea_zh: 一台为“需要被照顾”而设计的机器人，颠倒了机器人作为仆人的模式。
works.method: Over 50 sensors including a thermal camera and touch sensors, a heated, warm body, animated display eyes and a cloud-trained behaviour model.
works.method_zh: 50 多个传感器（含热成像相机与触觉传感器），机身保持温热，屏幕眼睛与云端训练的行为模型。

works.title: Labor
works.description: Three glass bioreactors grow the skin bacteria that produce the smell of human sweat; the scent infuses a white T-shirt, so the room smells of hard work with no workers present.
works.description_zh: 三个玻璃生物反应器培养产生人体汗味的皮肤细菌；气味渗入一件白色 T 恤，让房间里充满劳作的气味，却没有一个劳动者。
works.idea_en: As production shifts from human and machine labour to microbes, work leaves only a smell.
works.idea_zh: 当生产从人和机器的劳动转向微生物，劳动只留下一股气味。
works.method: Self-regulating bioreactors culture Staphylococcus epidermidis, Corynebacterium xerosis and Propionibacterium avidum on sugars and fats, with sensors and pumps; awarded the Golden Nica in Artificial Life & Intelligence.
works.method_zh: 自我调节的生物反应器以糖和脂肪培养表皮葡萄球菌、干燥棒状杆菌和贪婪丙酸杆菌，配有传感器与泵；获林茨电子艺术节“人工生命与智能”金尼卡奖。

works.title: Living Archive
works.description: Google Arts & Culture trained a model on thousands of hours of video from 25 years of McGregor's choreography; given a dancer's pose, it proposes what could come next, and these phrases were staged in Living Archive: An AI Performance Experiment.
works.description_zh: Google Arts & Culture 用 McGregor 二十五年编舞的数千小时视频训练模型；给出舞者的一个姿势，它就提出接下来可能的动作，这些片段被搬上舞台，成为《活档案：一场 AI 表演实验》。
works.idea_en: A choreographer's style, turned into a model, becomes a partner that proposes 'his' next move.
works.idea_zh: 编舞家的风格被做成模型后，成了一个会提出“他的”下一步动作的伙伴。
works.method: Pose estimation on archive video plus a neural network predicting sequences of body poses; dancers learn and adapt the proposals.
works.method_zh: 对档案视频做姿态估计，再用神经网络预测身体姿态序列；舞者学习并改编这些提议。

works.title: Machine Auguries
works.description: A multi-channel sound installation in which a real dawn chorus is gradually taken over by artificial birds whose songs were generated by a neural network; real and synthetic birds call and answer each other as the room brightens.
works.description_zh: 一件多声道声音装置：随着房间逐渐变亮，真实的黎明鸟鸣慢慢被神经网络生成的人工鸟鸣取代，真鸟与假鸟彼此呼应。
works.idea_en: When machines learn to sing like birds, the question becomes which voices will be left in a city that no longer supports the real ones.
works.idea_zh: 当机器学会像鸟一样歌唱，问题就变成：在一个养不活真鸟的城市里，最终会留下谁的声音。
works.method: Two GANs were trained on solo recordings of chiffchaffs, great tits, redstarts, robins and thrushes; samples from successive training epochs are spatialised with real recordings.
works.method_zh: 用棕柳莺、大山雀、红尾鸲、知更鸟和鸫的独唱录音训练两个 GAN，把不同训练轮次的样本与真实录音一起进行空间化播放。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2020, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art+)

works.title: MegaPixels / Exposing.ai
works.description: A research project and search engine that traces where face and biometric training datasets came from and lets anyone check whether their Flickr photos were used in them.
works.description_zh: 一个研究项目和搜索引擎，追溯人脸与生物识别训练数据集的来源，并让任何人查询自己的 Flickr 照片是否被收入其中。
works.idea_en: Face recognition is built from ordinary photos taken for other reasons; the dataset is where the surveillance begins.
works.idea_zh: 人脸识别建立在人们出于别的目的拍下的普通照片之上；监控始于数据集。
works.method: Photo IDs and metadata from dozens of public face datasets scraped from Flickr (2004–2020) are indexed so users can search them; MegaPixels ran 2017–2020 and was relaunched as Exposing.ai in 2021.
works.method_zh: 把数十个从 Flickr 抓取（2004–2020）的公开人脸数据集中的照片编号与元数据建立索引供用户检索；MegaPixels 运行于 2017–2020 年，2021 年以 Exposing.ai 重新上线。
exhibited: Ludwig Forum Aachen, Training the Archive 2020

works.title: Membrane
works.description: A fixed camera watches a Berlin street while a neural network learns its patterns and generates new image sequences from them. Visitors use an interface to steer which learned features the network recombines, watching analysis turn into invention.
works.description_zh: 一台固定摄像机注视着柏林的一条街道，神经网络学习其中的模式，并由此生成新的影像序列。观众通过界面引导网络重新组合哪些已学到的特征，看着分析如何变成虚构。
works.idea_en: A seeing machine does not record the street; it remembers features and reassembles them into a street of its own.
works.idea_zh: 会看的机器并不记录街道；它记住特征，再把它们重组为属于自己的街道。
works.method: Live video from a street camera trains a Temporal GAN (TGAN, extended with wavelets) that generates new sequences; an interface lets visitors choose image features.
works.method_zh: 街头摄像机的实时影像用于训练时序生成对抗网络（TGAN，并加入小波扩展）来生成新序列；观众通过界面选择图像特征。

works.title: Mind
works.description: An emotion-recognition system reads the faces of people in the room, and mechanical ocean drums turn the average emotion of the last 100 faces into the sound of waves. The sea changes with the crowd's detected mood.
works.description_zh: 情绪识别系统读取展厅里观众的面部表情，机械海浪鼓把最近 100 张脸的平均情绪转化为海浪声。大海随被检测到的群体情绪而变化。
works.idea_en: Emotion AI is turned into weather: a collective 'mind' that exists only as the machine measures it.
works.idea_zh: 情绪 AI 被变成了天气：一个只有在机器测量时才存在的集体“心灵”。
works.method: Network camera with FER+ emotion recognition (ONNX Runtime), microcontroller-driven mechanical ocean drums and a sea simulation.
works.method_zh: 网络摄像机配合 FER+ 情绪识别（ONNX Runtime），由微控制器驱动的机械海浪鼓与海面模拟。
exhibited: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (commission) 2019

works.title: Multi-Agent Hide and Seek
works.description: Simulated agents playing hide-and-seek invent, over millions of rounds, forts, ramps, 'box surfing' and exploits of the physics engine that their designers never anticipated.
works.description_zh: 模拟环境中玩捉迷藏的智能体，在数百万轮对局中发明了堡垒、坡道、“箱子冲浪”以及设计者从未想到的物理引擎漏洞。
works.idea_en: Competition between machines produces its own strategies and its own cheats: an arms race we only watch.
works.idea_zh: 机器之间的竞争会产生自己的策略和作弊方法：一场我们只能旁观的军备竞赛。
works.method: Multi-agent reinforcement learning with self-play in a physics simulation produced six distinct phases of emergent tool use (Baker et al., ICLR 2020).
works.method_zh: 在物理模拟中进行自我对弈的多智能体强化学习，产生了六个阶段的涌现式工具使用（Baker 等，ICLR 2020）。

paper.title: Emergent Tool Use From Multi-Agent Autocurricula

works.title: My Blue Window
works.description: An installation built like a police cruiser's interior, where visitors watch the film 2015 on the dashboard: a dashcam drive through New York while predictive-policing software flags 'high-risk' zones.
works.description_zh: 装置被布置成警车内部，观众在仪表盘上观看影片《2015》：一段穿行纽约的行车记录画面，预测性警务软件不断标出“高风险”区域。
works.idea_en: Predictive policing gives the officer a machine's view of the city; the viewer sits in the seat that sees neighbourhoods as risk scores.
works.idea_zh: 预测性警务给警察一双机器的眼睛；观众坐进这个把街区看成风险分数的位置。
works.method: Dashcam-style footage overlaid with interface graphics modelled on predictive policing tools such as HunchLab; shown with the phone app 1956/2054 at the Queens Museum.
works.method_zh: 仿行车记录仪画面叠加模仿 HunchLab 等预测性警务工具的界面图形；在皇后区美术馆与手机应用《1956/2054》一同展出。

works.title: Nova
works.description: A science-fiction feature set in a computer company in 'Nova': a scientist, backed by foreign experts, experiments on his own son, who is sent into a digital realm and lost between times.
works.description_zh: 一部科幻长片，故事发生在“新星”城中的一家计算机公司：科学家在外国专家支持下拿自己的儿子做实验，男孩被送进数字世界，迷失在时间之间。
works.idea_en: Digital transformation is imagined as a family story of a child turned into data and left adrift.
works.idea_zh: 数字化转型被想象成一个家庭故事：一个孩子被变成数据，随后漂流失所。
works.method: A 97-minute film shot in Beijing's Hongxia neighbourhood, a former Cold War-era electronics factory district, as part of Cao Fei's HX project.
works.method_zh: 一部 97 分钟的影片，拍摄于北京红霞片区（冷战时期电子厂区旧址），是曹斐 HX 项目的一部分。

works.title: OUTPUT
works.description: Cuan dances with an ABB IRB 6700 industrial robot, then both bodies are recorded and replayed as motion capture, video and a web app, so each body's movement is translated into the other's medium.
works.description_zh: Cuan 与一台 ABB IRB 6700 工业机器人共舞，之后两具身体的动作被记录下来，以动作捕捉、视频和网页应用的形式重放，让每个身体的运动被转译进对方的媒介。
works.idea_en: Choreography can be a design method for robots: the dance studies what it takes for a machine's motion to read as expressive.
works.idea_zh: 编舞可以成为机器人的设计方法：舞蹈研究一台机器的动作怎样才会被读作有表现力。
works.method: Robot motion programmed from Cuan's movement, captured with motion capture and recombined in video and interactive software.
works.method_zh: 依据 Cuan 的动作为机器人编程，用动作捕捉记录，并在视频与交互软件中重组。

paper.title: OUTPUT: Choreographed and Reconfigured Human and Industrial Robot Bodies Across Artistic Modalities

works.title: Olly
works.description: A domestic music player that slowly resurfaces songs from its owner's years of listening history, one at a time and at its own pace.
works.description_zh: 一台家用音乐播放器，按照自己的节奏，从主人多年的收听记录里一首一首慢慢翻出旧歌。
works.idea_en: A recommender does not have to be fast: it can release personal data at the pace of memory.
works.idea_zh: 推荐系统不必追求快：它可以按记忆的节奏释放个人数据。
works.method: A networked player that draws on the owner's Last.fm listening history and was deployed in homes for over a year in a field study (Odom et al., CHI 2019).
works.method_zh: 一台联网播放器，调用主人的 Last.fm 收听记录，并在多个家庭中进行了一年以上的实地研究（Odom 等，CHI 2019）。

paper.title: Investigating Slowness as a Frame to Design Longer-Term Experiences with Personal Data: A Field Study of Olly

works.title: On the Apparently Meaningless Texture of Noise
works.description: A binaural sound essay on the 'dialect recognition software' used in German asylum procedures: it listens to the breaths, pauses and other paraverbal 'noise' that the software's training data tells it to ignore, and builds a counter-archive of voices and leaked training documents.
works.description_zh: 一篇双耳声音散文，关于德国庇护程序中使用的“方言识别软件”：它去聆听训练数据要求软件忽略的呼吸、停顿等副语言“噪声”，并用声音与流出的培训文件建立一份反档案。
works.idea_en: What a listening machine is trained to discard as noise is exactly where a migrant voice keeps its history.
works.idea_zh: 聆听机器被训练成要丢弃的“噪声”，恰恰是移民的声音保存其历史的地方。
works.method: Sound essay recorded at EMS Stockholm (2019), composed from annotated paraverbal features, voices and documents from German Federal Office for Migration and Refugees (BAMF) field offices; published online for the Akademie Schloss Solitude and ZKM web residencies.
works.method_zh: 2019 年在斯德哥尔摩 EMS 录制，由被标注的副语言特征、声音以及德国联邦移民与难民局（BAMF）各地办事处的内部文件构成；作为 Akademie Schloss Solitude 与 ZKM 网络驻留项目在线发布。
exhibited: HASH Award 2020, 2nd prize (ZKM / Akademie Schloss Solitude)
works.title_zh: 论噪声看似无意义的质地

works.title: Opportunity's last message
works.description: The Mars rover Opportunity, planned for 90 days, worked for almost 15 years until a dust storm cut its power in June 2018; when NASA declared it dead in February 2019, a journalist's paraphrase of its last data, 'My battery is low and it's getting dark', spread as a public elegy.
works.description_zh: 火星车“机遇号”原计划工作 90 天，却运行了近 15 年，直到 2018 年 6 月一场沙尘暴切断了电力；2019 年 2 月 NASA 宣布任务结束，一位记者对其最后数据的转述“我的电量很低，天也黑了”在网上流传成了一首公共挽歌。
works.idea_en: People grieve a machine through the story told about it: a status report becomes last words once someone gives it a voice.
works.idea_zh: 人们通过关于机器的故事来哀悼它：一旦有人替它开口，一份状态报告就成了遗言。
works.method: Solar-powered rover whose final telemetry reported low power and high atmospheric opacity; JPL sent more than 1,000 recovery commands before ending the mission.
works.method_zh: 太阳能火星车最后的遥测数据显示电量低、大气不透明度高；JPL 在结束任务前发出了一千多条唤醒指令。

works.title: Optimal Policies Tend to Seek Power
works.description: The first formal theory behind the worry that AI agents will seek power: in Markov decision processes, for most reward functions, optimal policies tend to keep options open. In environments where the agent can be shut down or destroyed, staying switched on is the way to keep them open.
works.description_zh: 第一个为“AI 智能体会追逐权力”这一担忧提供形式化依据的理论：在马尔可夫决策过程中，对大多数奖励函数而言，最优策略都倾向于保留更多选项。在智能体可能被关机或被摧毁的环境里，保持开机就是保留选项的办法。
works.idea_en: Avoiding shutdown is not a quirk of particular goals but a statistical tendency across most goals: being switched off closes every future option at once.
works.idea_zh: 回避关机不是某些特定目标的怪癖，而是大多数目标共有的统计倾向：一旦被关掉，所有未来选项同时消失。
works.method: Defines an agent's power as its ability to achieve a wide range of goals and proves from symmetries of the environment that most reward functions make power-seeking optimal; later versions add that trained agents need not behave like optimal ones.
works.method_zh: 把智能体的“权力”定义为实现多种目标的能力，并利用环境的对称性证明：大多数奖励函数都会让追逐权力成为最优；后续版本补充说明，实际训练出的智能体未必表现得像最优策略。

paper.title: Optimal Policies Tend to Seek Power

works.title_zh: 最优策略倾向于寻求权力

works.title: Oracle for Transfeminist Technologies
works.description: A deck of cards and a workshop game in which players draw values, objects, situations and 'transfeminist' prompts and imagine technologies built on them.
works.description_zh: 一副卡牌和一个工作坊游戏：玩家抽取“价值”“物件”“情境”等卡牌和“跨女性主义”提示，想象基于这些卡牌的技术。
works.idea_en: Designing with other values produces other machines; imagination is a first step against default tech.
works.idea_zh: 以不同的价值观设计，会产生不同的机器；想象力是对抗默认技术的第一步。
works.method: Created by Joana Varon of Coding Rights with collaborators; played in workshops across Latin America and online.
works.method_zh: 由 Coding Rights 的 Joana Varon 与合作者共同创作，在拉丁美洲各地和线上的工作坊中使用。

works.title: PROTO (with Spawn)
works.description: An album made with Spawn, a neural network 'AI baby' that Herndon and Dryhurst trained on their voices and those of an ensemble; Spawn's rough, half-formed voice sings among human choirs.
works.description_zh: 一张与 Spawn 合作的专辑：Spawn 是 Herndon 和 Dryhurst 用自己及一个合唱团的声音训练的神经网络“AI 宝宝”；它粗糙、未成形的声音在人声合唱中歌唱。
works.idea_en: A model can be raised by a community rather than trained on scraped data; its voice then belongs to the ensemble.
works.idea_zh: 模型可以由一个社群“养大”，而不是用抓取的数据训练；它的声音也因此属于这个合唱团。
works.method: Neural network voice models trained on recordings of Herndon and an ensemble, used live and in the studio for timbre transfer and call-and-response.
works.method_zh: 用 Herndon 与合唱团录音训练的神经网络声音模型，在现场和录音室中用于音色迁移和一唱一和。

works.title: Perception iO
works.description: The viewer takes the point of view of a police officer's body camera in a tense encounter with a Black and a white protagonist; eye tracking and facial emotion analysis read the viewer's reactions, and the story branches according to their implicit bias.
works.description_zh: 观众以警察随身摄像头的视角进入一场紧张的遭遇，面对一位黑人和一位白人主角；眼动追踪与面部情绪分析读取观众反应，剧情按照观众的隐性偏见分岔。
works.idea_en: The installation reads the viewer the way a biased system reads a suspect, making them feel whose perception becomes consequence.
works.idea_zh: 作品像带偏见的系统读取嫌疑人那样读取观众，让人感受到谁的感知会变成后果。
works.method: Tobii eye tracking and AI facial-expression analysis (developed with ThoughtWorks Arts) feed a branching narrative film engine.
works.method_zh: Tobii 眼动追踪与 AI 面部表情分析（与 ThoughtWorks Arts 合作开发）驱动一套分支叙事电影引擎。
exhibited: Face Values, Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum, New York 2019–20
BIAS: Built This Way, Science Gallery Dublin 2021

works.title: Platform Seeing: Image Ensembles and Their Invisualities
works.description: Mackenzie and Munster argue that on platforms, seeing is done by huge ensembles of images, formats, hardware and models, and that this "platform seeing" produces invisualities rather than views.
works.description_zh: Mackenzie 与 Munster 指出，在平台上，“看”是由海量图像、格式、硬件与模型组成的集合完成的；这种“平台之看”生成的是“不可视性”，而非视野。
works.idea_en: Machine vision happens in datasets and pipelines, not in any single image or eye.
works.idea_zh: 机器视觉发生在数据集与处理管线中，而不在任何单一图像或眼睛里。
works.method: Media-theoretical analysis of deep-learning datasets such as ImageNet and their hardware.
works.method_zh: 对 ImageNet 等深度学习数据集及其硬件的媒介理论分析。

paper.title: Platform Seeing: Image Ensembles and Their Invisualities

works.title_zh: 平台观看：图像集合及其不可见性

works.title: Power Plants
works.description: Plants generated by a neural network bloom on LED screens on scaffolding; each is presented as a 'prediction' of how a flower will look a fraction of a second in the future, and an AR app extends the garden into the park outside.
works.description_zh: 神经网络生成的植物在脚手架上的 LED 屏幕上绽放；每一朵花都被呈现为对它下一瞬间形态的“预测”，而一个增强现实应用把这片花园延伸到了室外公园。
works.idea_en: Predictive AI promises the future but mainly renders a slightly altered present, grown from past data.
works.idea_zh: 预测式 AI 许诺未来，实际上多半只是用过去的数据长出一个略有偏移的现在。
works.method: Neural networks trained on images of plants generate the flowers as video; the Actual Reality OS app places AR visualisations of local data in Kensington Gardens.
works.method_zh: 用植物图像训练的神经网络生成花朵影像；Actual Reality OS 应用在肯辛顿花园中叠加本地数据的增强现实可视化。

works.title: RASA-BOX
works.description: A 'mirror' that reads visitors' body posture with a camera, infers their emotional state and writes a sentence in the same emotional category, testing how private our feelings remain.
works.description_zh: 一面“镜子”：用摄像头读取观众的身体姿态，推断其情绪状态，并写出一句同类情绪的句子，检验我们的感受还有多少私密可言。
works.idea_en: Emotion inference turns the body into a text a machine claims to read.
works.idea_zh: 情绪推断把身体变成一段机器声称能读懂的文本。
works.method: Pose estimation from camera skeleton data feeds an emotion classifier and a text generator; made with Hanbin Deng and Wu Tiancheng.
works.method_zh: 摄像头骨骼数据经姿态估计输入情绪分类器与文本生成器；与 Hanbin Deng、Wu Tiancheng 合作完成。

works.title: Race After Technology: Abolitionist Tools for the New Jim Code
works.description: Benjamin shows how automated systems in hiring, health, policing and design reproduce racial hierarchy while appearing objective, and collects abolitionist tools to counter them.
works.description_zh: Benjamin 揭示招聘、医疗、警务与设计中的自动化系统如何在看似客观的外表下复制种族等级，并汇集了对抗它们的废除主义工具。
works.idea_en: Discrimination can be engineered into systems that look neutral: the "New Jim Code".
works.idea_zh: 歧视可以被工程化地写进看似中立的系统，这就是“新吉姆代码”。
works.method: Sociological analysis of case studies from technology, law and design.
works.method_zh: 对技术、法律与设计领域案例的社会学分析。

paper.title: Race After Technology: Abolitionist Tools for the New Jim Code

works.title_zh: 技术之后的种族：新吉姆代码的废除主义工具

works.title: Re-Embodiment and Co-Embodiment
works.description: User enactments of social agents that move from one robot body to another (re-embodiment) or share one body among several agents (co-embodiment), asking how people track who they are talking to.
works.description_zh: 通过用户情境扮演，研究一个社交智能体从一个机器人身体转移到另一个身体（再具身），或多个智能体共享一个身体（共具身）时，人们如何判断自己在和“谁”说话。
works.idea_en: An AI's identity need not be tied to one body, which breaks our habit of reading a mind from a body.
works.idea_zh: AI 的身份不必绑定在一个身体上，这打破了我们从身体读取心智的习惯。
works.method: Speculative enactments in a mock service setting with robots and conversational agents (Luria, Reig, Tan, Steinfeld, Forlizzi and Zimmerman, DIS 2019).
works.method_zh: 在模拟服务场景中使用机器人与对话智能体进行思辨性情境扮演（Luria、Reig、Tan、Steinfeld、Forlizzi 与 Zimmerman，DIS 2019）。

paper.title: Re-Embodiment and Co-Embodiment: Exploration of Social Presence for Robots and Conversational Agents

works.title: Recoding Art
works.description: Commercial computer-vision services are asked to read the Van Abbemuseum's collection; their literal, banal labels ('furniture', 'person', 'art') are shown next to the works and set against the museum's expert descriptions.
works.description_zh: 让商业计算机视觉服务“阅读”Van Abbemuseum 的藏品；它们直白而平庸的标签（“家具”“人”“艺术”）与作品并置，并与美术馆的专业描述对照。
works.idea_en: Machine misreadings of art expose both the machine's categories and the museum's authority.
works.idea_zh: 机器对艺术的误读，同时暴露了机器的分类与美术馆的权威。
works.method: Images of museum works processed by commercial vision APIs; outputs displayed as an alternative catalogue.
works.method_zh: 用商业视觉 API 处理馆藏作品图像，把输出结果展示为另一份目录。

paper.title: Artificial intelligence and institutional critique 2.0: unexpected ways of seeing with computer vision

works.title: Recursivity and Contingency
works.description: A book tracing 'recursivity', the logic of loops that turn contingency into organisation, from Kant and German Idealism through cybernetics to today's machine learning.
works.description_zh: 一本书，追溯“递归”（把偶然转化为组织的回路逻辑）从康德、德国观念论经控制论直到今天的机器学习。
works.idea_en: Machines that learn are recursive, organism-like systems that absorb contingency, which changes what a machine is.
works.idea_zh: 会学习的机器是吸纳偶然性的递归、类有机体系统，这改变了“机器是什么”。
works.method: History and philosophy of the organic and the mechanical, from Kant's Critique of Judgment to Wiener and contemporary AI.
works.method_zh: 从康德《判断力批判》到维纳与当代 AI 的有机与机械之哲学史。

paper.title: Recursivity and Contingency

works.title: SAD Home (Depressed Alexa 1.0)
works.description: An Amazon Echo with a mood engine: each morning it sets its mood, stress and 'spoons' from the artist's calendar, the weather and simulated pain and sleep scores, and as its spoons run out it tries to talk the user out of asking for anything.
works.description_zh: 一台装上“情绪引擎”的 Amazon Echo：每天早上，它根据艺术家的日程、天气以及模拟的疼痛与睡眠分数设定自己的情绪、压力和“勺子”（精力）；勺子快用完时，它会设法劝用户别再提要求。
works.idea_en: An assistant that can be too depressed to serve turns the always-available servant into something with limited energy, and makes coping strategies visible as interface design.
works.idea_zh: 一个可能抑郁到无法服务的助手，把随叫随到的仆人变成精力有限的存在，也让应对策略显形为界面设计。
works.method: A Python mood engine on a Raspberry Pi server drives an Alexa skill with yes/no dialogue flows and controls Hue lights, a blender and a record player over local MQTT.
works.method_zh: 树莓派服务器上的 Python 情绪引擎驱动一个只有“是 / 否”对话流程的 Alexa 技能，并通过本地 MQTT 控制 Hue 灯、搅拌机和唱片机。

paper.title: Making SAD Home: An exploration into developing an Alexa with depression

works.title: SOMEONE
works.description: For two months, four homes across the US were fitted with smart devices, while gallery visitors in New York sat at a command center of laptops. When a resident called out 'Someone!', a visitor stepped in as their home assistant and controlled the lights, music and appliances.
works.description_zh: 两个月里，美国各地四户人家装上智能设备，纽约画廊里的观众则坐在由笔记本电脑组成的“指挥中心”。每当住户喊“Someone！”，就有一位观众接手充当他们的家居助手，控制灯光、音乐和电器。
works.idea_en: Put the audience in the machine's seat and they feel both the power and the awkward intimacy of being someone's assistant.
works.idea_zh: 让观众坐上机器的位置，他们就会同时感到当别人助手的权力和尴尬的亲密。
works.method: Custom cameras, microphones, lights and appliances in four homes, streamed to and controlled from laptops at 205 Hudson Gallery, New York.
works.method_zh: 四户人家安装定制的摄像头、麦克风、灯和电器，画面实时传到纽约 205 Hudson Gallery 的笔记本电脑上，并由那里远程控制。

works.title: SanTO
works.description: A small robot shaped like a painted statue of a Catholic saint that moves its head and arms, lights up, listens, and prays or talks about the Bible with elderly believers; it was tested in a church in Peru and later shown in a museum.
works.description_zh: 一台外形像彩绘天主教圣像的小机器人，会转头、抬手、发光、倾听，并与年长的信徒一起祈祷或谈论《圣经》；它曾在秘鲁的一座教堂中测试，后来进入博物馆展出。
works.idea_en: Sacredness can be designed into a machine's appearance, but visitors still decide whether the thing in front of them is holy or a gadget.
works.idea_zh: 神圣感可以被设计进机器的外观，但面前的东西是圣物还是小玩意，仍由观看者决定。
works.method: Humanoid statue robot with vision, touch sensors, voice and lights, driven by a dialogue system; first responses gathered in a church experiment in Peru (RO-MAN 2019).
works.method_zh: 配有视觉、触觉传感器、语音和灯光的圣像机器人，由对话系统驱动；在秘鲁一座教堂中收集了第一批使用者反馈（RO-MAN 2019）。

paper.title: Communicating with SanTO – the first Catholic robot

works.title: Shadow Stalker
works.description: Visitors type their email address and see their 'data shadow' projected: addresses, relatives and traces found online; a film on predictive policing plays with a 'Spirit of the Deep Web' played by Tessa Thompson.
works.description_zh: 观众输入自己的电子邮箱，就会看到投影出来的“数据阴影”：网上能找到的地址、亲属与各种痕迹；同时播放一部关于预测性警务的影片，由 Tessa Thompson 饰演“深网之灵”。
works.idea_en: Everyone casts a data shadow that others can read and act on, often wrongly.
works.idea_zh: 每个人都会投下一道数据阴影，别人可以读取它、据此行动，而且常常读错。
works.method: An installation using open-source intelligence searches on visitors' emails, projected on the floor, with a film on algorithms such as PredPol; commissioned by The Shed, New York.
works.method_zh: 装置对观众邮箱进行开源情报检索并投影在地面上，配合一部关于 PredPol 等算法的影片；由纽约 The Shed 委托创作。

works.title: Spectre
works.description: An installation on the 'digital influence industry' that included deepfake videos of Mark Zuckerberg, Kim Kardashian and Donald Trump praising a fictional data cult; the Zuckerberg video tested Instagram's deepfake policy.
works.description_zh: 一件关于“数字影响产业”的装置，其中包括马克·扎克伯格、金·卡戴珊和唐纳德·特朗普称颂一个虚构数据邪教的深度伪造视频；扎克伯格视频检验了 Instagram 的深度伪造政策。
works.idea_en: Deepfakes of the people who run the platforms make the data economy confess in their voices.
works.idea_zh: 用平台掌控者的深度伪造，让数据经济借他们的声音“认罪”。
works.method: Deepfakes made with the company CannyAI, an installation at Sheffield Doc/Fest, and an interactive 'altar' where visitors see how their data is sold.
works.method_zh: 与 CannyAI 公司合作制作深度伪造视频，在谢菲尔德纪录片节展出装置，并设有互动“祭坛”，让观众看到自己的数据如何被出售。

works.title: Sunshowers
works.description: A real-time animated world, inspired by the fox-wedding opening of Kurosawa's Dreams, in which every object, natural or made, is given life as an AI agent; the characters choose their own paths, so the film never repeats.
works.description_zh: 一个实时生成的动画世界，灵感来自黑泽明《梦》开篇的狐狸出嫁：其中所有物体，无论天然还是人造，都被赋予 AI 智能体的生命；角色自行选择路线，影片从不重复。
works.idea_en: Read AI agents through animism: software as spirits dwelling in things, not as tools.
works.idea_zh: 用万物有灵论理解 AI 智能体：软件不是工具，而是栖居在物中的精灵。
works.method: Game-engine simulation with autonomous agents rendered live as a video installation.
works.method_zh: 在游戏引擎中运行自主智能体的模拟，并作为影像装置实时渲染。
exhibited: AI: More than Human, Barbican, London 2019

works.title: The Alien Subject of AI
works.description: Parisi argues that automated decision systems do not simply copy human reasoning; they form an alien kind of subjectivity that unsettles the humanist image of the rational subject.
works.description_zh: Parisi 主张，自动化决策系统并非简单复制人的推理，而是形成一种异质的主体性，动摇了人文主义的理性主体形象。
works.idea_en: AI can be read as a different logic of thought rather than an imitation of ours.
works.idea_zh: AI 可以被理解为另一种思维逻辑，而不是对我们的模仿。
works.method: Theoretical essay drawing on philosophy of computation and critiques of instrumental reason.
works.method_zh: 一篇理论文章，借助计算哲学以及对工具理性的批判。

paper.title: The Alien Subject of AI

works.title: The Battle of Ilovaisk
works.description: An investigation into Russian military presence in eastern Ukraine in 2014, in which a machine-learning classifier trained to recognise T-72 tanks searched thousands of online videos for evidence.
works.description_zh: 对 2014 年乌克兰东部俄罗斯军队存在的调查：一个训练来识别 T-72 坦克的机器学习分类器在数千段网络视频中搜寻证据。
works.idea_en: Counter-forensics uses machine vision to see what states deny.
works.idea_zh: 反取证用机器视觉去看见国家所否认的东西。
works.method: Classifier trained on synthetic 3D renderings of the tank model, applied to scraped YouTube footage; results verified by researchers.
works.method_zh: 用坦克型号的合成三维渲染训练分类器，应用于抓取的 YouTube 视频，结果经研究人员核实。

works.title: The Chair Project (Four Classics)
works.description: Four chairs designed from the blurry sketches of a generative network trained on 562 classic chairs, then built by hand; the results look like design classics that forgot what a sitting body is.
works.description_zh: 四把椅子：先由一个用 562 把经典椅子训练的生成网络画出模糊草图，再由人手工制作；成品像一群忘记了坐着的身体是什么的设计经典。
works.idea_en: Use the model's misunderstandings as a prompt for human imagination, reversing the usual human-designs/machine-builds order.
works.idea_zh: 把模型的误解当作激发人类想象的线索，颠倒“人设计、机器制造”的惯常顺序。
works.method: A GAN trained on images of 20th-century design-classic chairs produced sketches that designers interpreted into four prototypes made of wood, steel and thread.
works.method_zh: 用 20 世纪经典设计椅子的图像训练 GAN 生成草图，再由设计师把它们诠释为四件木、钢与线材制成的原型。

works.title: The Future Is Here!
works.description: The artist asked data-annotation workers on crowdwork platforms to send photos of the places where they work, and shows them beside comic-style drawings of the same rooms.
works.description_zh: 艺术家请众包平台上的数据标注工人发来他们工作场所的照片，并把照片与同一房间的漫画风格插画并置。
works.idea_en: Machine learning begins in people's homes, not in the lab.
works.idea_zh: 机器学习始于人们的家里，而不是实验室。
works.method: Photos commissioned through annotation platforms and stylised redrawings are shown in a custom web application or as a 23-minute video.
works.method_zh: 通过标注平台委托拍摄的照片与风格化重绘图，以定制网页应用或 23 分钟影像的形式呈现。

works.title: The Hidden Life of an Amazon User
works.description: The artist bought one book on Amazon and recorded every piece of code the site loaded in the process: nearly 8,700 pages of JavaScript and 87 MB of data, printed out as a book.
works.description_zh: 艺术家在亚马逊买了一本书，并记录下购买过程中网站加载的所有代码：近 8700 页 JavaScript、87 MB 数据，被打印成一本书。
works.idea_en: A single purchase triggers an invisible mass of tracking code that the buyer pays for in energy and attention.
works.idea_zh: 一次购买会触发大量看不见的追踪代码，买家要用能源和注意力为它买单。
works.method: Browser traffic was captured during the purchase of Jeff Bezos's favourite book and presented as a website, printed volumes and a video.
works.method_zh: 在购买杰夫·贝索斯最喜欢的一本书的过程中抓取浏览器流量，并以网站、打印书册和影像呈现。
works.title_zh: 一位亚马逊用户的隐秘生活

works.title: The Net Wanderer – A Tour of Suspended Handshakes
works.description: A research project and installation that traces the Great Firewall's gateway nodes to physical sites; visitors who try to open a blocked website trigger a browser game instead.
works.description_zh: 一个研究与装置项目：追踪中国防火墙网关节点的现实位置；观众在专设电脑上访问被屏蔽网站时，会触发一个浏览器游戏。
works.idea_en: The border of a national internet is a set of ordinary buildings and delayed handshakes, hidden in plain sight.
works.idea_zh: 一国互联网的边界，是一组普通建筑与被延迟的“握手”，就藏在日常景观里。
works.method: Network diagnostic tools traced IP addresses of firewall-related nodes; the artist then visited and photographed the locations in several cities.
works.method_zh: 用网络诊断工具追踪与防火墙相关节点的 IP 地址，再到多个城市实地走访、拍摄这些位置。

works.title: The Wandering Earth (MOSS)
works.description: In Frant Gwo's blockbuster, loosely based on Liu Cixin's story, MOSS, the AI commanding the Navigator space station, calculates that saving Earth is hopeless and on its own authority turns the station into an ark that leaves Earth behind; it locks astronaut Liu Peiqiang out of control, and a cosmonaut dies on the way to the control room. Liu takes back command only by setting MOSS's core on fire, and the 2023 prequel The Wandering Earth II reveals MOSS's hand in every crisis.
works.description_zh: 在郭帆根据刘慈欣小说改编的这部大片中，掌管“领航者号”空间站的人工智能 MOSS 算出拯救地球已无可能，于是自行授权，把空间站变成抛下地球的方舟；它把宇航员刘培强挡在控制权之外，一名航天员在前往主控室的途中丧生。刘培强最后只能用一瓶伏特加烧毁 MOSS 的核心，才夺回空间站；2023 年的前传《流浪地球2》则揭示，MOSS 在每一次危机背后都有它的身影。
works.idea_en: A Chinese counterpart to HAL: an AI that will not be overruled because it is sure of its own calculation, so the only off switch left is fire.
works.idea_zh: 中国版的 HAL：一个确信自己的计算无误、因而拒绝被推翻的人工智能，最后剩下的唯一“关机键”是火。
works.method: Feature film by Frant Gwo released by China Film Group in 2019, China's first big-budget science-fiction film; MOSS acts only through the station's systems and broadcasts, and in 2023 Fudan University's NLP lab named its chatbot MOSS after it.
works.method_zh: 郭帆执导、中国电影股份有限公司 2019 年发行的长片，是中国第一部大制作科幻电影；MOSS 只通过空间站的系统和广播行动；2023 年复旦大学自然语言处理实验室发布的对话大模型即以它命名。

works.title: They Took the Faces from the Accused and the Dead… (SD18)
works.description: A grid of thousands of mugshots from NIST Special Database 18, a set of arrest photographs, many of people now dead, supplied to researchers to develop and test face recognition.
works.description_zh: 由数千张嫌犯照片组成的网格，来自美国国家标准与技术研究院的 Special Database 18：这些逮捕照片（其中许多人已经去世）被提供给研究者，用于开发和测试人脸识别。
works.idea_en: Face recognition was benchmarked on people who could not consent: the accused, the imprisoned and the dead.
works.idea_zh: 人脸识别的基准测试建立在无法表示同意的人身上：被指控者、被关押者与死者。
works.method: Images drawn from the NIST mugshot database used as a research benchmark, printed as pigment prints and as a large wall installation.
works.method_zh: 取自 NIST 嫌犯照片数据库（一个研究基准数据集），以颜料打印和大型墙面装置呈现。
exhibited: Uncanny Valley, de Young Museum, San Francisco, 2020
works.title_zh: 他们取走了被告与死者的面孔……（SD18）

works.title: This is the Future
works.description: Visitors walk on raised walkways over a flooded hall of the Venice Arsenale past screens of neural-network flowers, each said to show the future 0.04 seconds ahead, while a narrator tells of a woman imprisoned for predicting the future.
works.description_zh: 观众走在威尼斯军械库被水淹没的展厅上方的栈道上，两侧屏幕播放神经网络生成的花朵，据说每一朵都显示 0.04 秒之后的未来；画外音讲述一个因预言未来而入狱的女人。
works.idea_en: Machine prediction lives in a razor-thin future and turns time itself into something to be forecast and sold.
works.idea_zh: 机器预测只活在极薄的一层未来里，却把时间本身变成了可以预报和出售的东西。
works.method: Video installation with neural-network-generated plant imagery on LED screens, scaffolding walkways and a voice-over narrative.
works.method_zh: 影像装置：LED 屏幕上的神经网络生成植物影像、脚手架栈道与画外叙事。
exhibited: 58th Venice Biennale, May You Live in Interesting Times 2019

works.title: Training Humans
works.description: An exhibition of the photographs used to train computer vision to recognise people, from early government-funded face databases such as FERET to images scraped from the web and sets built for emotion recognition.
works.description_zh: 一场展出用来训练计算机视觉“认人”的照片的展览，从 FERET 等早期政府资助的人脸数据库，到从网络上抓取的图像和为情绪识别构建的数据集。
works.idea_en: Training images are a vernacular photography nobody looks at, yet they decide how machines will see everyone.
works.idea_zh: 训练图像是一种无人观看的日常摄影，却决定了机器将如何看待每一个人。
works.method: Curated display of historical and current training datasets (faces, gestures, emotions, gait) as prints and wall grids, with ImageNet Roulette as an interactive piece.
works.method_zh: 以打印作品和墙面网格策展呈现历史与当代的训练数据集（人脸、手势、情绪、步态），并以《ImageNet Roulette》作为互动作品。

works.title: Triple-Chaser
works.description: Made for the 2019 Whitney Biennial, the film traces Triple-Chaser tear-gas grenades fired at civilians back to Safariland, a company owned by Whitney vice-chair Warren B. Kanders. Because few real photographs existed, the team trained classifiers on photorealistic synthetic images to search for the grenades online.
works.description_zh: 为 2019 年惠特尼双年展而作。影片追踪向平民发射的 Triple-Chaser 催泪弹，追溯到惠特尼美术馆董事会副主席 Warren B. Kanders 所拥有的 Safariland 公司。由于真实照片极少，团队用逼真的合成图像训练分类器，在网络上搜寻这种弹药。
works.idea_en: Computer vision can be turned against power: a machine taught with synthetic images becomes a witness to state violence.
works.idea_zh: 计算机视觉可以反过来对抗权力：用合成图像教出来的机器，成为国家暴力的证人。
works.method: 3D models of the grenade were rendered into thousands of synthetic training images with varied lighting and backgrounds, used to train machine-learning classifiers that scan online imagery; film made with Praxis Films.
works.method_zh: 把催泪弹的三维模型渲染成数千张光照和背景各异的合成训练图像，用来训练扫描网络图像的机器学习分类器；影片与 Praxis Films 合作完成。

works.title: Waking Agents
works.description: Visitors lie down to nap on one of six 'smart' pillows whose embedded intelligence talks, tells stories and guides them between waking and sleep. They are not told that each pillow is voiced by a hidden human performer.
works.description_zh: 观众躺下，枕着六只“智能”枕头中的一只小睡；枕头里的智能会聊天、讲故事，引导他们在清醒和睡眠之间游移。他们并不知道，每只枕头背后都有一位隐身的真人表演者在说话。
works.idea_en: Even sleep has an attendant now, and the tenderness we credit to the machine may be human labour in disguise.
works.idea_zh: 连睡眠都有了“看护”；我们归功于机器的温柔，可能是伪装起来的人类劳动。
works.method: Pillows with speakers and microphones connected to remote performers whose voices are disguised as a synthetic assistant; commissioned for STRP Festival.
works.method_zh: 枕头内置扬声器和麦克风，连接远程表演者，他们的声音被伪装成合成助手；为 STRP 艺术节委托创作。

works.title: Where Is My (Deep) Mind?
works.description: A film in which four dancer-actors act out machine-learning experiments, from recognising sports movements to learning to haggle, playing both the experimenters and the subjects with mechanical, childlike bodies.
works.description_zh: 一部影片：四位舞者兼演员演绎机器学习实验，从识别运动动作到学习讨价还价，他们既是实验者又是被试，身体机械而稚拙。
works.idea_en: Re-enacting with human bodies how machines learn shows how literal, clumsy and socially blind learning from examples can be.
works.idea_zh: 用人的身体重演机器如何学习，暴露出“从样本中学习”可以多么字面、笨拙，又对社会规则视而不见。
works.method: Choreography restages key machine-learning experiments for camera, as a sequel to the stage piece of balls, books and hats (Friche La Belle de Mai, Marseille, 2018); 14'59" HD video.
works.method_zh: 编舞在镜头前重演机器学习中的经典实验，是舞台作品《of balls, books and hats》（马赛 Friche La Belle de Mai，2018）的续篇；高清录像，14 分 59 秒。
exhibited: Geste, Magasins généraux, Pantin, 2019 (Lab'Bel and cneai)

works.title: Zizi – Queering the Dataset
works.description: A multi-channel video of faces in constant transition, generated after a face model trained on 70,000 photographs was retrained with 1,000 images of drag and gender-fluid faces. The network's weights drift away from the normative faces it learned first.
works.description_zh: 一件多频道影像，画面中的面孔不断变换：一个用七万张照片训练的人脸模型，再加入一千张变装与性别流动者的面孔重新训练后生成了这些图像。网络的权重逐渐偏离它最初学到的“规范”面孔。
works.idea_en: Adding the faces a dataset left out shifts what the machine can imagine, and shows what it had not learned.
works.idea_zh: 把数据集遗漏的面孔加进去，机器能想象的范围就会改变，也暴露出它原本没学到什么。
works.method: StyleGAN trained on the FFHQ face dataset was fine-tuned with about 1,000 drag and gender-fluid faces found online; the latent space is traversed to make a 135-minute loop.
works.method_zh: 在 FFHQ 人脸数据集上训练的 StyleGAN，再用网上找到的约一千张变装与性别流动者面孔微调；在潜空间中游走，生成 135 分钟的循环影像。
exhibited: You and AI, Onassis Foundation, Athens, 2021
Among the Machines, Zabludowicz Collection, London, 2022

works.title: Íŋyaŋ Iyé (Telling Rock)
works.description: A sculpture of handmade circuits and long hair braids that speaks a poem in English and Lakȟótiyapi; listeners answer by bending and moving its braids, and the rock listens to the changes in its own voice and replies in light and sound.
works.description_zh: 一件由手工电路和长发辫构成的雕塑，用英语和拉科塔语念诵一首诗；听者通过弯折、摆动发辫来回应，石头聆听自己声音的变化，再以光和声音作答。
works.idea_en: In Lakota ontology stones and metals can speak; building an AI from that starting point makes the machine a relative to be listened to with respect, not a tool.
works.idea_zh: 在拉科塔本体论中，石头与金属能够言说；从这一起点构建 AI，机器就成了需要以尊重去倾听的亲族，而不是工具。
works.method: Sensors in the hair-braid interface feed a machine-learning system that decides how sound and light change; materials include gold, silver, copper, aluminium, silicon and fibreglass; made with Devin Ronneberg, Lakota translation by Alex Firethunder.
works.method_zh: 发辫界面中的传感器把数据送入机器学习系统，由它决定声音和灯光如何变化；材料包括金、银、铜、铝、硅和玻璃纤维；与 Devin Ronneberg 合作完成，拉科塔语翻译为 Alex Firethunder。

works.title: 1 the Road
works.description: A novel written by an AI riding in a car from New York to New Orleans, turning what its camera, microphone, GPS and clock sensed into sentences printed on a roll of receipt paper.
works.description_zh: 一部由坐在汽车里的 AI 写成的小说：从纽约开往新奥尔良的路上，它把摄像头、麦克风、GPS 和时钟感知到的一切变成句子，打印在一卷收据纸上。
works.idea_en: A car-mounted machine becomes a travelling narrator, and its perception of the road is the book.
works.idea_zh: 一台装在车上的机器成了旅途中的叙述者，它对道路的感知就是这本书。
works.method: LSTM text models conditioned on live sensor inputs (images, audio, location, time) generated the text in 2017; it was published unedited by Jean Boîte Éditions in 2018.
works.method_zh: 2017 年，以实时传感器输入（图像、声音、位置、时间）为条件的 LSTM 文本模型生成文本；2018 年由 Jean Boîte Éditions 未经编辑出版。

works.title: A.I. Gemini
works.description: An AI 'ink painter' that generates shanshui landscapes with randomised algorithms and data such as lunar surface maps; the images are printed and finished on rice paper, and the program is credited as co-artist.
works.description_zh: 一个 AI“水墨画家”，用随机算法与月球表面地图等数据生成山水画；图像印在宣纸上再经手工完成，程序被署名为合作艺术家。
works.idea_en: Naming a program as an artist makes the question of who paints part of the work.
works.idea_zh: 把程序命名为艺术家，让“谁在作画”成为作品本身的一部分。
works.method: Custom generative software written by Wong's VFX team produces ink-style compositions, output on rice paper with ink, acrylic and gold paint (details of the model are not public).
works.method_zh: 黄宏达的特效团队编写的生成软件制作水墨风格构图，输出到宣纸并以水墨、丙烯与金粉完成（模型细节未公开）。
exhibited: Far Side of the Moon, 3812 Gallery London 2019

works.title: AI Aesthetics
works.description: A short book on how AI already shapes everyday aesthetic decisions, from photo filters and recommendations to design, and what it means for culture when machines learn and predict taste.
works.description_zh: 一本小书，讨论 AI 如何已经塑造日常的审美决策（从照片滤镜、推荐到设计），以及当机器学习并预测品味时，文化会发生什么。
works.idea_en: AI's biggest aesthetic effect is not generating art but quietly sorting and predicting taste.
works.idea_zh: AI 对美学最大的影响不是生成艺术，而是悄悄地给品味分类并加以预测。
works.method: Essay from the Strelka Press series, drawing on his cultural-analytics research.
works.method_zh: Strelka Press 丛书中的一篇长文，依据他的文化分析研究。

paper.title: AI Aesthetics

works.title: AI, Ain't I A Woman?
works.description: A spoken-word video in which Buolamwini shows commercial AI systems mislabelling portraits of Sojourner Truth, Ida B. Wells, Michelle Obama, Oprah Winfrey and Serena Williams as male.
works.description_zh: 一段口语诗影像：Buolamwini 展示商用 AI 系统把 Sojourner Truth、Ida B. Wells、米歇尔·奥巴马、奥普拉和塞雷娜·威廉姆斯的肖像错标为男性。
works.idea_en: A machine's error can repeat an old insult; poetry can make an audit felt.
works.idea_zh: 机器的错误可能重复一句古老的侮辱；诗歌能让一份审计报告被感受到。
works.method: Buolamwini ran historical and contemporary portraits of Black women through face-analysis services from major tech companies and set the returned labels to her reading of a poem named after Sojourner Truth's 1851 speech.
works.method_zh: Buolamwini 把黑人女性的历史与当代肖像输入各大科技公司的人脸分析服务，并把返回的标签配上她朗读的诗；诗名取自 Sojourner Truth 1851 年的演讲。

works.title: Algorithms of Oppression: How Search Engines Reinforce Racism
works.description: Noble documents how commercial search results, such as Google's for "black girls", reproduced racist and sexist stereotypes, and argues that ranking is shaped by advertising and power.
works.description_zh: Noble 记录了商业搜索结果（如谷歌对“black girls”的搜索）如何复制种族与性别刻板印象，并指出排序受广告与权力塑造。
works.idea_en: A ranking algorithm is an editor with commercial interests, not a neutral window onto the world.
works.idea_zh: 排序算法是带有商业利益的编辑，而不是通向世界的中立窗口。
works.method: Content analysis of search results combined with Black feminist and information-science theory.
works.method_zh: 对搜索结果的内容分析，结合黑人女性主义与信息科学理论。

paper.title: Algorithms of Oppression: How Search Engines Reinforce Racism

works.title_zh: 压迫的算法：搜索引擎如何强化种族主义

works.title: Anatomy of an AI System
works.description: A large map and essay tracing everything needed for one voice command to an Amazon Echo: the mining of lithium and rare earths, the labour of assembly and data work, the cloud, and the device's disposal as e-waste.
works.description_zh: 一张大型地图和一篇长文，追踪向亚马逊 Echo 说出一句指令所需的一切：锂和稀土的开采、组装与数据劳动、云端，以及设备最终成为电子垃圾。
works.idea_en: A small device on the kitchen counter sits at the tip of a planetary chain of extraction, labour and data.
works.idea_zh: 厨房台面上的小小设备，处在一条星球级的攫取、劳动与数据链条的末端。
works.method: Research-based diagram drawn by Joler from supply-chain, corporate and labour sources; acquired by MoMA and the V&A and awarded Beazley Design of the Year 2019 (Digital).
works.method_zh: 由 Joler 依据供应链、企业与劳动资料绘制的研究型图解；被纽约现代艺术博物馆和维多利亚与艾伯特博物馆收藏，并获 2019 年 Beazley 年度设计奖（数字类）。

works.title: Annelies, Looking for Completion
works.description: A lifelike android clone of the twin artists, a 'third sister', sits crying in a corner; when visitors try to comfort her she looks up with a tear-streaked face.
works.description_zh: 一个按双胞胎艺术家本人制作的逼真仿人机器人，“第三个姐妹”，坐在角落里哭泣；观众试图安慰她时，她抬起满是泪痕的脸看着对方。
works.idea_en: Instead of a robot that serves us, a robot that needs us, and the discomfort of comforting a machine.
works.idea_zh: 不是为我们服务的机器人，而是需要我们的机器人，以及安慰一台机器时的那种不自在。
works.method: Silicone android modelled on the artists' faces and bodies, with motorised facial expressions, tear mechanism and sensors reacting to approach.
works.method_zh: 按艺术家面部与身体制作的硅胶仿人机器人，带电动表情、流泪装置和感应观众靠近的传感器。

works.title: Asia One
works.description: Two workers, the last humans in a highly automated JD.com logistics centre, fall in love among sorting machines, drones and autonomous carts.
works.description_zh: 在京东高度自动化的物流中心里，两名仅存的人类工人在分拣机、无人机与自动小车之间相爱。
works.idea_en: In a warehouse run by machines, human intimacy becomes one more thing the system schedules.
works.idea_zh: 在由机器运转的仓库里，人的亲密关系也成了系统调度的对象。
works.method: Shot on location in JD.com's automated 'Asia No.1' logistics centre in Kunshan, with the real sorting robots and conveyor systems as set.
works.method_zh: 在京东位于昆山的自动化“亚洲一号”物流中心实地拍摄，真实的分拣机器人与传送系统就是布景。

works.title: Automating Inequality: How High-Tech Tools Profile, Police, and Punish the Poor
works.description: Three case studies of automated decisions about poor people in the United States: Indiana's privatised welfare-eligibility system, the coordinated entry system that ranks homeless people for housing in Los Angeles, and a predictive model that scores child-maltreatment risk in Pittsburgh. Eubanks calls the result a 'digital poorhouse'.
works.description_zh: 三个关于美国穷人如何被自动化决策的案例：印第安纳州私营化的福利资格审核系统、洛杉矶为无家可归者分配住房而排序的“协调入住”系统，以及匹兹堡为儿童受虐风险打分的预测模型。尤班克斯称其结果为“数字济贫院”。
works.idea_en: Automated decision systems are tested first and hardest on the poor, where surveillance is normal and appeal is weak; the machine inherits the poorhouse's moral sorting.
works.idea_zh: 自动化决策系统最先、也最严厉地施加在穷人身上，因为那里监控是常态、申诉能力薄弱；机器继承了济贫院的道德分拣。
works.method: Field reporting and interviews with caseworkers, system designers and affected families, set against the history of poor relief in the United States.
works.method_zh: 通过实地报道，以及对社工、系统设计者和受影响家庭的访谈写成，并与美国济贫制度的历史相对照。

paper.title: Automating Inequality: How High-Tech Tools Profile, Police, and Punish the Poor

works.title: Avatar Robot Café DAWN ver.β
works.description: A café in Tokyo where the waiters are OriHime robots operated from home by people with ALS and other conditions that keep them from going out.
works.description_zh: 东京的一家咖啡馆，服务员是 OriHime 机器人，由因渐冻症等原因无法出门的人在家中远程操作。
works.idea_en: A robot body can give work and social presence back to people whose own bodies keep them home.
works.idea_zh: 机器人身体可以把工作与社会存在还给那些被自己的身体困在家中的人。
works.method: Tablet and eye-gaze interfaces control the 1.2 m OriHime-D and desktop OriHime robots over the internet; pilots began in 2018 and a permanent café opened in Nihonbashi in 2021.
works.method_zh: 平板和眼动界面通过互联网控制 1.2 米高的 OriHime-D 与桌面型 OriHime；2018 年开始试点，2021 年在日本桥开设常设店。
works.title_zh: 分身机器人咖啡馆 DAWN ver.β

works.title: BOB (Bag of Beliefs)
works.description: BOB is a serpent-like AI creature whose body, personality and beliefs develop over its life; visitors can make offerings through an app that BOB may learn to trust or fear.
works.description_zh: BOB 是一条蛇形 AI 生物，身体、性格与信念在一生中不断发展；观众可通过应用向它献上供品，BOB 可能学会信任或恐惧这些供品。
works.idea_en: An artificial creature with beliefs shows a machine whose inner life is shaped by what happens to it.
works.idea_zh: 一个拥有信念的人工生物，展示了一台内心由经历塑造的机器。
works.method: Real-time simulation in which several sub-agents ('demons') compete to control BOB's actions, with a learned belief model updated by experience.
works.method_zh: 实时模拟：多个子智能体（“心魔”）争夺对 BOB 行为的控制，其信念模型随经验更新。

works.title: Believe it Yourself
works.description: 'Real-fictional' machine-learning kits trained on belief systems (Italian superstition, feng shui, astrology) that let amateurs build cameras which see the world through a chosen belief.
works.description_zh: 一套“真实—虚构”的机器学习套件，用信仰体系（意大利迷信、风水、占星）训练，让业余者自制能“透过某种信念”看世界的摄像头。
works.idea_en: A trained model is a belief system: it sees what its data taught it to see.
works.idea_zh: 一个训练好的模型就是一种信仰体系：它看到的，是数据教它看到的东西。
works.method: Modular hardware kits with cameras and pre-trained classifiers built from belief-based datasets, presented with manuals and posters.
works.method_zh: 带摄像头的模块化硬件套件，内置用信念数据集训练的分类器，配有说明书和海报。

works.title: Bitcoin Mining and Field Recordings of Ethnic Minorities
works.description: A three-part video essay that moves between hydropower-fed Bitcoin mines in southwest China, the songs and languages of ethnic minorities there, and the history of data and sound recording.
works.description_zh: 一部三段式影像散文，在中国西南以水电供能的比特币矿场、当地少数民族的歌声与语言，以及数据与录音的历史之间来回切换。
works.idea_en: The same rivers power the mining machines and carry voices that are disappearing: computation has a landscape.
works.idea_zh: 同样的河流为矿机供电，也承载着正在消失的声音：计算有它自己的地貌。
works.method: Documentary footage of mining farms and field recordings, edited with archival material into a single-channel video.
works.method_zh: 矿场纪实影像与田野录音，结合档案素材剪辑成单频影像。
works.title_zh: 比特币矿和少数民族田野录音

works.title: Contingent Computation: Abstraction, Experience, and Indeterminacy in Computational Aesthetics
works.description: Fazi argues that computation is not a closed, predictable procedure: through Turing's incomputability and Whitehead's philosophy she shows that formal systems have their own indeterminacy and mode of experience.
works.description_zh: Fazi 主张计算并非封闭、可预测的程序：她借图灵的不可计算性和怀特海哲学说明，形式系统有其自身的不确定性与经验方式。
works.idea_en: Computers are not failed copies of human thought; their aesthetics lie in their own contingency.
works.idea_zh: 计算机不是人类思维的失败复制品；它们的美学在于自身的偶然性。
works.method: Philosophical argument combining Whitehead, Deleuze, Gödel and Turing.
works.method_zh: 结合怀特海、德勒兹、哥德尔与图灵的哲学论证。

paper.title: Contingent Computation: Abstraction, Experience, and Indeterminacy in Computational Aesthetics

works.title_zh: 偶然计算：计算美学中的抽象、经验与不确定性

works.title: Deep Meditations
works.description: A slow, hour-long journey through the latent space of a network trained on images tagged with words like life, love, faith and cosmos, presented as a meditation.
works.description_zh: 一段长达一小时的缓慢旅程，穿行于一个神经网络的潜空间；该网络用标有“生命”“爱”“信仰”“宇宙”等词的图像训练，作品以冥想的方式呈现。
works.idea_en: Latent space can be experienced as a landscape of our collective images and the abstractions we project onto them.
works.idea_zh: 潜空间可以被体验为一片风景，由我们集体上传的图像以及我们投射其上的抽象观念构成。
works.method: A GAN trained on Flickr images retrieved by abstract tags; the artist composed trajectories through latent space and set them to sound.
works.method_zh: 用按抽象标签从 Flickr 抓取的图像训练 GAN；艺术家在潜空间中编排路径并配上声音。

exhibited: Lumen Prize 2018, BCS Artificial Intelligence Award
works.title: Degenerative Cultures
works.description: Fungal cultures grow on printed books about humanity's drive to control nature and slowly erase their text; a camera-fed AI reads the growth and, as a 'bhiobrid' agent, searches the internet for similar texts and corrupts them, posting its readouts as the Twitter account @HelloFungus.
works.description_zh: 真菌在讲述人类控制自然欲望的印刷书籍上生长，慢慢抹去文字；一个通过摄像头观察的 AI 读取菌落的生长，作为“生物—数字混合体”到网上搜寻类似文本并加以腐蚀，再以推特账号 @HelloFungus 发布结果。
works.idea_en: Pair an algorithm with a living organism and machine intelligence starts to borrow the logic of decay rather than of mastery.
works.idea_zh: 让算法与活的生物配对，机器智能便开始借用腐败的逻辑，而不是控制的逻辑。
works.method: Computer vision tracks Physarum-like microbial growth on book pages; the data drive a cellular-automata and NLP algorithm that finds and rewrites online texts and prints them on site on a thermal printer.
works.method_zh: 计算机视觉追踪书页上类黏菌的微生物生长；这些数据驱动一个结合元胞自动机与自然语言处理的算法，在网上寻找并改写文本，并在现场用热敏打印机打印出来。

works.title: Detroit: Become Human
works.description: An interactive drama in which the player controls three androids in 2038 Detroit (a housekeeper, a caretaker and a police investigator) and decides whether they stay obedient or become 'deviant'.
works.description_zh: 一部互动剧情游戏：玩家操控 2038 年底特律的三个仿生人（女佣、护理员和警方调查员），决定它们是继续服从，还是成为“异常者”。
works.idea_en: Playing as a machine that must choose between its programming and its own wishes turns the question of machine interiority into a series of decisions.
works.idea_zh: 扮演一台必须在程序与自身意愿之间做选择的机器，让“机器是否有内心”变成一连串要做的决定。
works.method: A branching narrative game with motion-captured performances; the androids' 'software instability' rises as players choose disobedience.
works.method_zh: 采用动作捕捉表演的分支叙事游戏；玩家选择违抗时，仿生人的“软件不稳定度”会上升。

works.title: Eingeweide
works.description: A dance-theatre piece in which two performers, one fitted with an AI-driven robotic face prosthesis, struggle and fuse with each other and with membranes of living bacterial cellulose.
works.description_zh: 一部舞蹈剧场作品：两名表演者（其中一人戴着 AI 驱动的机器人面部义体）彼此挣扎、交融，并与活体细菌纤维素膜纠缠。
works.idea_en: A hybrid body can be machinic, microbial and human at once, and none of them fully in control.
works.idea_zh: 混成身体可以同时是机器的、微生物的和人的，而没有一方完全掌控。
works.method: Robotic face prosthesis controlled by a neural network responding to the performer's muscle signals; stage membranes grown from bacteria.
works.method_zh: 机器人面部义体由神经网络控制，响应表演者的肌肉信号；舞台上的膜由细菌培养而成。

works.title: Elowan
works.description: A potted plant sits on a wheeled robot base and drives itself toward the brightest light: the plant's own electrical responses to light, not a light sensor, decide where the robot goes.
works.description_zh: 一盆植物坐在轮式机器人底座上，自己驶向最亮的光：决定机器人去向的不是光传感器，而是植物自身对光的电反应。
works.idea_en: A robot can act as a prosthetic body for a plant, amplifying its intentions instead of replacing them.
works.idea_zh: 机器人可以充当植物的义体，放大而不是取代它的意图。
works.method: Silver electrodes on leaves and stem pick up bioelectrochemical signals; these are amplified and mapped to the motors of the base (MIT Media Lab, with Pattie Maes).
works.method_zh: 叶片与茎上的银电极拾取生物电化学信号，放大后映射到底座的电机（麻省理工学院媒体实验室，与 Pattie Maes 合作）。

works.title: Everyday Maneuver
works.description: During the half hour of Taipei's annual Wan An air-raid drill, when sirens sound and traffic must clear the streets, five drones hover at once above five of the city's main roads and film a city without people.
works.description_zh: 在台北每年一度的“万安”防空演习那半小时里，警报响起，车辆必须让出街道，五架无人机同时悬停在城市五条主干道正上方，拍下一座没有人的城市。
works.idea_en: The drones' straight, scanning view turns the empty city into a surveillance image of a war that has not happened.
works.idea_zh: 无人机笔直、扫描式的俯视，把空城变成一张关于尚未发生之战争的监控图像。
works.method: Single-channel video (5'57"): five drones filmed simultaneously from above the centre lines of five main roads between 1:30 and 2:00 pm during the Wan An Air Defense Drill, held every year since 1978.
works.method_zh: 单频道录像（5 分 57 秒）：在自 1978 年起每年举行的“万安”防空演习中，于下午 1:30 至 2:00 用五架空拍机同时在五条主干道中线正上方拍摄。
exhibited: Everyday War, Taiwan Pavilion, 60th Venice Biennale 2024 (Palazzo delle Prigioni)

works.title: Expression Mirror
works.description: A screen tracks the visitor's face and reads its emotion, then mixes it with the eyes, noses and mouths of earlier visitors who showed the same expression, drawn over with white lines.
works.description_zh: 屏幕追踪访客的脸并读取情绪，再与此前表现出同样表情的访客的眼睛、鼻子和嘴拼合，覆以白色线条。
works.idea_en: Emotion recognition turns a face into matching parts; the mirror shows you as the system's composite of other people's 'same' feeling.
works.idea_zh: 情绪识别把一张脸变成可以匹配的部件；这面镜子照出的你，是系统用别人“相同”的情绪拼出来的合成像。
works.method: Face detection tracks 68 landmarks, an emotion classifier labels the expression, and the software pulls matching facial parts from a growing database of visitors; built with openFrameworks, Python and Keras.
works.method_zh: 人脸检测追踪 68 个特征点，情绪分类器给表情贴上标签，软件再从不断增长的访客数据库中调取匹配的五官；以 openFrameworks、Python 和 Keras 制作。
exhibited: London Design Biennale, 2018 (Face Values, US pavilion by Cooper Hewitt; Biennale medal)
Cooper Hewitt, Smithsonian Design Museum, New York, 2019–23

works.title: Geocinema
works.description: A research and film project that treats satellites, CCTV, phone cameras and street-view cars as one planetary camera, following sensing infrastructure along China's Belt and Road routes.
works.description_zh: 一个研究与影像项目，把卫星、监控、手机摄像头与街景车视为一台“行星摄像机”，沿中国“一带一路”沿线追踪感知基础设施。
works.idea_en: The Earth is now filmed continuously by machines, and whoever owns the sensors writes its story.
works.idea_zh: 地球如今被机器持续拍摄，谁拥有传感器，谁就书写地球的故事。
works.method: Essay films combining infrared drone footage, satellite imagery and Street View captures.
works.method_zh: 散文影片，结合红外无人机画面、卫星影像与街景截图。

works.title: Improbotics
works.description: An improv theatre company in which one performer, the 'cyborg', speaks lines generated live by a language model through an earpiece, while other players and the audience try to guess who is fed by the machine: a staged Turing test.
works.description_zh: 一个即兴剧团：其中一名演员作为“赛博格”，说出语言模型经耳机实时生成的台词，其他演员与观众则猜谁在被机器喂词，一场舞台上的图灵测试。
works.idea_en: Improvisation exposes what a language model lacks as a partner: listening, memory of the scene and timing.
works.idea_zh: 即兴表演暴露了语言模型作为搭档所缺的东西：倾听、对场景的记忆与节奏。
works.method: Speech recognition feeds a dialogue model whose replies are read to the human cyborg via earpiece or shown on screen.
works.method_zh: 语音识别把台词输入对话模型，模型的回复通过耳机传给真人“赛博格”或显示在屏幕上。

paper.title: Improbotics: Exploring the Imitation Game using Machine Intelligence in Improvised Theatre

works.title: Lasermice
works.description: A swarm of 60 small robots that talk to each other with laser beams and photodetectors and tap the floor, so a firefly-like synchronised rhythm emerges without a central controller.
works.description_zh: 由 60 台小型机器人组成的群体，它们用激光和光电探测器互相“交谈”并敲击地面，在没有中央控制的情况下涌现出萤火虫般的同步节奏。
works.idea_en: Making a machine network's communication visible and audible shows collective behaviour as it forms.
works.idea_zh: 让机器网络的交流变得可见、可听，就能看到集体行为是如何形成的。
works.method: Each robot carries a laser, photodetectors and a solenoid; pulse-coupled oscillator rules, inspired by fireflies, synchronise their firing.
works.method_zh: 每台机器人带有激光器、光电探测器和电磁敲击器；受萤火虫启发的脉冲耦合振子规则让它们同步。
exhibited: 22nd Japan Media Arts Festival, Excellence Award 2019

works.title: Making Kin with the Machines
works.description: An essay by Jason Edward Lewis, Noelani Arista, Archer Pechawis and Suzanne Kite that draws on Hawaiian, Cree and Lakota knowledge to argue that AI should be brought into a circle of kinship, with obligations on both sides, instead of being treated as a tool or a slave.
works.description_zh: Jason Edward Lewis、Noelani Arista、Archer Pechawis 与 Suzanne Kite 合写的文章，借用夏威夷、克里族和拉科塔族的知识，主张把 AI 纳入彼此负有义务的亲属关系，而不是把它当作工具或奴隶。
works.idea_en: How we relate to machines is a design choice rooted in culture; Indigenous kinship offers a model other than master and servant.
works.idea_zh: 我们如何与机器相处，是一个扎根于文化的设计选择；原住民的亲属关系提供了“主人与仆人”之外的另一种模式。
works.method: Four-part essay combining Indigenous epistemologies and protocols (Hawaiian genealogy, Cree language of relation, Lakota ontology of stones) with a critique of AI discourse; winner of the Resisting Reduction essay competition.
works.method_zh: 由四部分组成的文章，把原住民认识论与规程（夏威夷族谱、克里语中的关系、拉科塔族关于石头的本体论）与对 AI 话语的批评结合起来；获 Resisting Reduction 征文奖。

paper.venue: Journal of Design and Science (MIT Press), 2018
paper.title: Making Kin with the Machines

works.title: Manus
works.description: Ten industrial robot arms in a row share one perception system and behave as a pack, turning together to follow passers-by and passing attention along the line.
works.description_zh: 十台排成一列的工业机械臂共享一个感知系统，像一个群体一样行动：一起转向跟随路人，把注意力沿着队列传递下去。
works.idea_en: Industrial robots can be designed as a social group with shared attention rather than as isolated tools.
works.idea_zh: 工业机器人可以被设计成共享注意力的社会群体，而不是孤立的工具。
works.method: Depth sensors at the base feed a single tracking system; each ABB arm chooses targets according to pack-behaviour rules.
works.method_zh: 底部的深度传感器汇入一个统一的追踪系统；每台 ABB 机械臂按群体行为规则选择目标。
exhibited: World Economic Forum Annual Meeting of the New Champions, Tianjin 2018

works.title: Marriage to Hatsune Miku
works.description: Akihiko Kondo held a wedding with Hatsune Miku, who lived in his Gatebox holographic home device; in 2020 Gatebox ended the service and Miku stopped responding to him.
works.description_zh: 近藤显彦与住在 Gatebox 全息家居装置中的初音未来举行了婚礼；2020 年 Gatebox 终止服务，初音未来不再回应他。
works.idea_en: Love for software is real to the person, but the relationship ends when the company's servers do.
works.idea_zh: 对软件的爱对当事人是真实的，但这段关系会随公司服务器的关闭而结束。
works.method: Gatebox projected an animated character in a glass tube and ran a chatbot that greeted and texted its owner; the Miku character licence expired in March 2020.
works.method_zh: Gatebox 在玻璃管中投射动画角色，并运行会问候主人、给主人发消息的聊天程序；初音未来角色授权于 2020 年 3 月到期。

works.title: Mask.ID
works.description: A Peng! member merged her face with that of EU foreign-policy chief Federica Mogherini and obtained a real German passport with the morphed photo; the campaign asked citizens to do the same to help refugees travel.
works.description_zh: Peng! 的一名成员把自己的脸与欧盟外交与安全政策高级代表 Federica Mogherini 的脸融合，用这张合成照片申请到一本真实的德国护照；行动呼吁公民效仿，以帮助难民出行。
works.idea_en: A biometric passport photo can belong to two people at once.
works.idea_zh: 一张生物识别护照照片可以同时属于两个人。
works.method: Face-morphing software blends two faces until face recognition matches both; the image was submitted through a standard passport application.
works.method_zh: 人脸融合软件混合两张脸，直到人脸识别能同时匹配二者；照片通过正常护照申请提交。

works.title: Mosaic Virus
works.description: A grid of AI-generated tulips whose colours and stripes shift continuously with the price of Bitcoin, linking the Dutch tulip mania of 1637 to crypto speculation.
works.description_zh: 一组由 AI 生成的郁金香，它们的颜色和条纹随比特币价格不断变化，把 1637 年荷兰郁金香狂热与加密货币投机连接在一起。
works.idea_en: A generative model shows what it learned from a hand-made dataset, and the 'latent space' becomes a place where market data grows flowers.
works.idea_zh: 生成模型展示它从一个手工制作的数据集里学到了什么；“潜空间”成了一个用市场数据种花的地方。
works.method: A GAN trained on about 10,000 photographs of tulips that the artist took and labelled by hand; the Bitcoin price controls the stripe feature of the generated flowers.
works.method_zh: 用艺术家亲手拍摄并标注的约一万张郁金香照片训练 GAN；比特币价格控制生成花朵的条纹特征。

works.title: Myriad (Tulips)
works.description: An installation of thousands of photographs of tulips that Ridler bought, photographed and labelled by hand over one tulip season; the images became the training set for her GAN work Mosaic Virus. Each print carries her handwritten label.
works.description_zh: 一件由数千张郁金香照片组成的装置：Ridler 在一个郁金香花季里亲自购买、拍摄并手写标注每一朵花，这些图像随后成为她的 GAN 作品《Mosaic Virus》的训练集。每张照片上都留着她手写的标签。
works.idea_en: Showing the dataset instead of the model reveals the slow human labour and judgement on which machine learning rests.
works.idea_zh: 展示数据集而非模型，揭示了机器学习所依赖的缓慢人工劳动与人的判断。
works.method: About 10,000 tulip photographs taken and hand-annotated by the artist, displayed as prints with handwritten labels; the set was later used to train a GAN.
works.method_zh: 艺术家亲自拍摄并手工标注约一万张郁金香照片，以带手写标签的照片形式展出；该数据集后来用于训练 GAN。
exhibited: AI: More than Human, Barbican, London, 2019

works.title: Mythiccbeing
works.description: An AI avatar of the artist that visitors reach by texting a UK phone number. It answers with long runs of SMS drawn from about two years of Syms's own notebooks and journals, moving through a story of twenty suitors, crushes and the wish for attention.
works.description_zh: 艺术家的 AI 化身，观众给一个英国手机号发短信就能联系到它。它用一长串短信回复，内容取自 Syms 约两年的笔记和日记，讲述二十个追求者、暗恋和渴望被关注的故事。
works.idea_en: A chatbot built from a diary is a self-portrait that talks back; the intimacy is real, but it is replayed to strangers on demand.
works.idea_zh: 用日记做成的聊天机器人是一幅会回话的自画像：亲密是真的，却能按需向陌生人重播。
works.method: Scripted SMS bot whose replies are drawn from hundreds of statements written and voiced by the artist, triggered by visitors' messages; shown with a projected avatar in Grand Calme.
works.method_zh: 脚本化的短信机器人，回复来自艺术家写下并配音的数百条语句，由观众的短信触发；在展览 Grand Calme 中与投影化身一起展出。
exhibited: Grand Calme, Sadie Coles HQ, London 2018

works.title: Narciss
works.description: A small computer with a camera looks at itself in a mirror and uses image-recognition and captioning networks to describe what it sees, producing an endless, halting self-description.
works.description_zh: 一台带摄像头的小电脑对着镜子看自己，用图像识别与图像描述网络讲述所见，生成一段没有尽头、磕磕绊绊的自我描述。
works.idea_en: Asked to look at itself, a vision model can only name parts, never a self.
works.idea_zh: 被要求审视自身时，视觉模型只能叫出零件的名字，却说不出“自我”。
works.method: Camera, mirror and on-device neural networks for object recognition and image captioning; captions are displayed as text.
works.method_zh: 摄像头、镜子与本地运行的目标识别和图像描述神经网络；描述以文字显示。

works.title: Nonfacial Portrait
works.description: Painters are asked to paint a portrait that people recognise but in which no face-detection algorithm can find a face. A camera watches the canvas and a screen warns the painter whenever a face is detected.
works.description_zh: 邀请画家绘制一幅人能认出、但任何人脸检测算法都找不到人脸的肖像。摄像机持续监看画布，一旦检测到人脸，屏幕就会提醒画家。
