works.idea_en: Portraiture becomes a search for the narrow visual space only humans can perceive.
works.idea_zh: 肖像画变成一次寻找“只有人能看见”的狭窄视觉空间的实验。
works.method: Three face-detection algorithms monitor the canvas through a camera; each painting is shown with a video of its making.
works.method_zh: 三种人脸检测算法通过摄像机监看画布；每幅画与其创作过程的录像一起展出。

works.title: Not the Only One (N'TOO)
works.description: A sculptural chatbot that speaks as a multigenerational memoir of one Black American family, trained on oral histories from three generations of the artist's family; visitors talk with it and hear its sometimes odd, partial answers.
works.description_zh: 一件会说话的雕塑式聊天机器人，以一个美国黑人家庭多代人回忆录的口吻说话，训练数据是艺术家家族三代人的口述历史；观众与它交谈，听到它时而古怪、时而残缺的回答。
works.idea_en: A small AI raised on one family's words, rather than the internet, can be kin instead of a product.
works.idea_zh: 用一个家庭的话语、而不是整个互联网养大的小 AI，可以成为亲人而不是产品。
works.method: A deep-learning dialogue model trained on a small, community-owned dataset of family interviews, housed in a 3D-printed sculpture with microphone, speaker and sensors.
works.method_zh: 用一小份由社群自己拥有的家族访谈数据训练深度学习对话模型，装在带麦克风、扬声器和传感器的 3D 打印雕塑里。
exhibited: EMMA Espoo Museum of Modern Art 2023

works.title: ORLAN-OÏDE
works.description: A humanoid robot double of the artist, with her face and voice, that answers questions and speaks about art; ORLAN has interviewed it in public.
works.description_zh: 艺术家的人形机器人分身，拥有她的面孔与声音，能回答问题、谈论艺术；ORLAN 曾在公开场合与它对谈。
works.idea_en: An artist famous for remaking her body builds a machine self and lets it speak in her place.
works.idea_zh: 一位以改造自身身体闻名的艺术家，造出机器自我并让它代替自己说话。
works.method: Robotic bust with a conversational AI trained on the artist's texts and a synthesised copy of her voice; later versions developed with RaspiAudio.
works.method_zh: 机器人半身像，搭载以艺术家文本训练的对话 AI 和合成的本人声音；后续版本与 RaspiAudio 合作开发。

works.title: Objective Realities
works.description: A virtual-reality experience that lets people be a robot vacuum, a smart plug or a fan in a smart home, feeling the world through the object's limited sensors and tasks.
works.description_zh: 一个虚拟现实体验：人可以在智能家居中变成扫地机器人、智能插座或电风扇，通过物件有限的传感器和任务来感受世界。
works.idea_en: To design for smart objects, first try being one: design from the object's point of view.
works.idea_zh: 要为智能物件做设计，先试着成为一个智能物件：从物的视角出发设计。
works.method: VR scenes in which the user's body is mapped onto an appliance's sensing and actuation, used as an object-centred design method.
works.method_zh: VR 场景把使用者的身体映射到家电的感知与动作上，作为一种以物为中心的设计方法。

works.title: Omnia per Omnia
works.description: A swarm of small painting robots (D.O.U.G._3) moves across a canvas with the artist, steered by the flow of people and traffic captured by New York public surveillance cameras.
works.description_zh: 一群小型绘画机器人（D.O.U.G._3）与艺术家一同在画布上移动，其轨迹由纽约公共监控摄像头捕捉到的人流与车流驱动。
works.idea_en: The city's surveillance data becomes a brush: the collective movement of a city paints with the artist.
works.idea_zh: 城市的监控数据成了画笔：一座城市的集体运动与艺术家一起作画。
works.method: Optical-flow data extracted from public camera feeds drives the paths of multiple mobile robots.
works.method_zh: 从公共摄像头画面中提取的光流数据驱动多台移动机器人的路径。

works.title: Outra 33ª Bienal de São Paulo
works.description: Commissioned by the 33rd São Paulo Biennial, an alternative archive of the show: computer-vision systems describe photos and footage of its installation and old archive images, and audio-guide tracks carry the comments of guards, installers and cleaners.
works.description_zh: 受第 33 届圣保罗双年展委托的一份另类档案：计算机视觉系统描述展览布展的照片、影像和历史档案图像，语音导览则播放保安、布展工和清洁工的评论。
works.idea_en: Letting machines and unseen workers describe an art biennial shows how official and automated ways of seeing both decide what counts as the work.
works.idea_zh: 让机器和不被看见的工作者来描述一场艺术双年展，揭示出官方与自动化的观看方式都在决定什么算作“作品”。
works.method: Several commercial image-recognition and captioning services label photos and footage of the biennial and its archive; results, unconventional footage of the set-up and interviews are published on a website with the Fundação Bienal. With Bernardo Fontes, Nina Bamberg and Guilherme Falcão.
works.method_zh: 多种商业图像识别与描述服务为双年展及其档案的照片和影像打标签；结果、非常规的布展影像与访谈发布在与圣保罗双年展基金会合作的网站上。合作者还有 Bernardo Fontes、Nina Bamberg 和 Guilherme Falcão。
works.title_zh: 另一个第 33 届圣保罗双年展

works.title: Perception Engines
works.description: A series of abstract prints that ImageNet classifiers confidently recognise as a cello, a cabbage, a hammerhead shark or an iron, though people see only a few coloured strokes.
works.description_zh: 一组抽象版画：人只看到几笔色块，ImageNet 分类器却会自信地把它们认作大提琴、卷心菜、双髻鲨或熨斗。
works.idea_en: Art can be made for the machine's eye: the prints show which few marks are 'enough' for a classifier.
works.idea_zh: 艺术可以为机器之眼而作：这些版画显示，对分类器来说几笔就“够了”。
works.method: A constrained drawing system is optimised against an ensemble of ImageNet classifiers, and the results are printed as risographs and screen prints.
works.method_zh: 用一个受限的绘图系统针对一组 ImageNet 分类器进行优化，结果以孔版印刷和丝网印刷呈现。

works.title: Project Alias
works.description: A fungus-like 'parasite' that sits on top of a Google Home or Amazon Echo and keeps it deaf with a constant murmur; only when it hears the user's own chosen wake word does it go quiet and whisper the real one.
works.description_zh: 一个像真菌一样的“寄生体”，罩在 Google Home 或 Amazon Echo 上，用持续的低语让它“失聪”；只有听到用户自己设定的唤醒词时，它才停下噪声，替你轻声说出真正的唤醒词。
works.idea_en: You can negotiate with an always-listening machine by giving it a machine of your own that controls what it hears.
works.idea_zh: 面对“永远在听”的机器，你可以给它配一台属于自己的机器，由它来决定对方听到什么。
works.method: A Raspberry Pi with microphones and two small speakers runs a locally trained wake-word classifier; it feeds noise into the assistant's microphones until triggered.
works.method_zh: 树莓派连接麦克风和两个小扬声器，运行在本地训练的唤醒词分类器；被触发前一直向助手的麦克风输送噪声。
exhibited: S+T+ARTS Prize 2019, Grand Prize – Artistic Exploration

works.title: Putting the Pieces Back Together Again
works.description: An array of 1,250 small stepper motors, each turning a white bar, forms a surface across which waves, clusters and swarm-like patterns pass, as the motors align with and disturb their neighbours.
works.description_zh: 由 1250 个小步进电机组成的阵列，每个电机转动一根白色短杆，形成一个表面；电机与相邻电机彼此对齐又互相扰动，波纹、簇团和群体般的图案在表面上流过。
works.idea_en: Order emerges and dissolves in a field of simple machines, making self-organisation visible as motion.
works.idea_zh: 秩序在一片简单机器中出现又消散，自组织被显现为运动。
works.method: Each motor is an element of a coupled-oscillator or spin-like model; local interaction rules computed in real time set each bar's angle (commissioned for the Drehmoment festival in a former newspaper building).
works.method_zh: 每个电机是一个耦合振子或类自旋模型中的单元；实时计算的局部相互作用规则决定每根杆的角度（为 Drehmoment 艺术节在一座旧报社大楼中委托创作）。
keywords: Putting the Pieces Back Together Again
exhibited: Drehmoment, KulturRegion Stuttgart, Kirchheim unter Teck 2018

works.title: Random String of Emotions
works.description: An actress performs 200 facial expressions assembled from random combinations of Action Units, the muscle movements that emotion-recognition software uses, and commercial software then tries to name the emotion of each strange, sometimes impossible face.
works.description_zh: 一位演员表演由“动作单元”随机组合而成的 200 个面部表情——动作单元是情绪识别软件所用的肌肉运动单位——随后商业软件尝试为每张奇特、有时近乎不可能的脸命名情绪。
works.idea_en: Reversing emotion AI's decoding exposes how thin its vocabulary of six basic emotions is.
works.idea_zh: 把情绪 AI 的解码流程倒过来，暴露了它“六种基本情绪”的词汇有多单薄。
works.method: A computer generates random strings of FACS Action Units that the actress learns to perform; the filmed fragments are analysed live by Noldus FaceReader and shown on a second screen.
works.method_zh: 电脑随机生成 FACS 动作单元序列，由演员学习并表演；拍下的片段交给 Noldus FaceReader 分析，读数在第二块屏幕上显示。

works.title: Robot Rights
works.description: Gunkel works through the four logical answers to whether robots can and should have rights, and argues for a relational, Levinas-inspired approach that starts from how we encounter the other.
works.description_zh: Gunkel 逐一检验“机器人能否、是否应当拥有权利”的四种逻辑回答，并提出受列维纳斯启发的关系性路径：从我们如何遭遇他者出发。
works.idea_en: Moral consideration may be something we extend in encounter, which makes the robot a test of our own ethics.
works.idea_zh: 道德关怀可能是在相遇中给予的，这让机器人成为检验我们自身伦理的试金石。
works.method: Philosophical analysis of the is/ought positions in the robot-rights debate.
works.method_zh: 对机器人权利争论中“是否能/是否应”各种立场的哲学分析。

paper.title: Robot Rights

works.title: Robotika, the Nannybot
works.description: A robotic cradle-side nanny that watches a baby with cameras and sensors, reads its face and movements, and rocks, sings or calls for help.
works.description_zh: 一台守在摇篮边的机器人保姆，用摄像头与传感器看护婴儿，读取其表情与动作，然后摇晃、唱歌或呼叫帮助。
works.idea_en: The first face a baby learns to read could belong to a machine that is reading it back.
works.idea_zh: 婴儿学着读懂的第一张脸，也许属于一台同时在读它的机器。
works.method: Robot with camera-based face and emotion recognition, motion tracking and thermal sensing (per the Ars Electronica description).
works.method_zh: 机器人配备基于摄像头的面部与情绪识别、动作追踪和热感应（据林茨电子艺术节介绍）。

works.title: Robust Physical-World Attacks on Deep Learning Visual Classification
works.description: A few black and white stickers on a real stop sign make a road-sign classifier read it as a 45 mph speed-limit sign from many distances and angles.
works.description_zh: 在真实的停车标志上贴几块黑白贴纸，就能让交通标志分类器在多种距离和角度下把它读成“限速 45 英里”标志。
works.idea_en: What looks like graffiti to a driver can rewrite the road for a self-driving car.
works.idea_zh: 在司机眼中像涂鸦的东西，却能为自动驾驶汽车改写道路。
works.method: The Robust Physical Perturbations (RP2) algorithm optimises sticker-like perturbations over varied physical conditions and tests them in lab and drive-by settings (Eykholt et al., CVPR 2018).
works.method_zh: “鲁棒物理扰动”（RP2）算法在多种物理条件下优化贴纸式扰动，并在实验室与车载行驶测试中验证（Eykholt 等，CVPR 2018）。

paper.title: Robust Physical-World Attacks on Deep Learning Visual Classification

works.title_zh: 针对深度学习视觉分类的鲁棒物理世界攻击

works.title: SEER: Simulative Emotional Expression Robot
works.description: A small, stylised humanoid head that tracks the viewer's gaze and mirrors their facial expression with subtle eye, eyelid and eyebrow movements.
works.description_zh: 一个小巧、风格化的人形头部，追踪观者的视线，并用眼球、眼睑和眉毛的细微动作模仿观者的表情。
works.idea_en: Being looked back at by a machine is enough to feel that something is there.
works.idea_zh: 被一台机器回望，就足以让人觉得“那里有某个存在”。
works.method: A camera with face and gaze tracking drives motors in the eyes and eyelids and wire-driven, flexible eyebrows; the face is deliberately not realistic.
works.method_zh: 带人脸与视线追踪的摄像头驱动眼球和眼睑的电机以及线驱动的柔性眉毛；面部刻意不做写实。

works.title: Scary Beauty
works.description: An 'android opera' in which the android Alter 2 conducts a human orchestra and sings, setting the tempo and dynamics itself.
works.description_zh: 一部“仿真人歌剧”：仿真人 Alter 2 指挥人类管弦乐团并演唱，速度与强弱由它自己决定。
works.idea_en: When a machine conducts, the humans must follow a body whose timing is not human.
works.idea_zh: 当机器来指挥，人类必须跟随一个时间感并非人类的身体。
works.method: Alter's artificial-life neural network generates its gestures and tempo in real time; lyrics are taken from texts by Houellebecq and others; premiered at Miraikan, Tokyo.
works.method_zh: Alter 的人工生命神经网络实时生成手势与速度；歌词取自 Houellebecq 等人的文本；在东京未来馆首演。

works.title: Sociality
works.description: Cirio collected and rated hundreds of US patents for technologies that monitor and manipulate social behaviour, and invited the public to share, flag and 'ban' them on a website and in printed installations.
works.description_zh: Cirio 收集并评级了数百项用于监控和操纵社会行为的美国专利，邀请公众在网站和印刷装置中分享、标记并“封禁”它们。
works.idea_en: The patent office is where the machinery of social manipulation is described in plain diagrams before it is built.
works.idea_zh: 专利局是社交操纵机器在被建成之前，就以朴素图示被描述出来的地方。
works.method: A database of patent filings with their flowcharts, classified by the artist and published online with public flagging tools, plus prints and a colouring book of the diagrams.
works.method_zh: 一个收录专利申请及其流程图的数据库，由艺术家分类后在线发布并提供公众标记工具，另有版画和一本以这些图示做成的涂色书。

works.title: Surveillance Paparazzi
works.description: A machine that watches unsecured surveillance cameras around the world and uses face recognition to 'snap' celebrities who happen to pass, like an automated paparazzo.
works.description_zh: 一台机器监看全球不设防的监控摄像头，用人脸识别“抓拍”恰好经过的名人，像一个自动化的狗仔。
works.idea_en: Paparazzi work can now be done by any open camera plus a classifier; everyone is filmed, only some are recognised.
works.idea_zh: 狗仔的工作如今只需一个开放摄像头加一个分类器；人人都被拍摄，只有部分人被认出。
works.method: Scrapes live feeds from publicly accessible, unencrypted CCTV cameras and runs a celebrity face-recognition model on them.
works.method_zh: 抓取可公开访问、未加密的监控摄像头实时画面，并在其上运行名人人脸识别模型。

works.title: Te Reo Māori Speech Recognition and the Kaitiakitanga Licence
works.description: A Māori-led media organisation built its own speech recognition for te reo Māori from recordings donated by its community, and refused to hand the data to big tech.
works.description_zh: 一家由毛利人主导的媒体机构，用社区捐赠的录音自建毛利语语音识别，并拒绝把数据交给科技巨头。
works.idea_en: Data sovereignty means the community that speaks the language decides who may train on its voice.
works.idea_zh: 数据主权意味着讲这门语言的社区自己决定谁可以用他们的声音训练模型。
works.method: In the 2018 Kōrero Māori campaign people read sentences aloud and recorded over 300 hours in 10 days; the models are released under the Kaitiakitanga Licence, which grants access only for the benefit of Māori.
works.method_zh: 在 2018 年的 Kōrero Māori 活动中，人们朗读句子，10 天内录下 300 多小时；模型以“守护者许可”（Kaitiakitanga Licence）发布，只允许为毛利人利益而使用。
works.title_zh: 毛利语语音识别与 Kaitiakitanga 许可证

works.title: The City of Broken Windows
works.description: A two-part installation: engineers smash windows in a hangar to record training data for an AI that detects breaking glass, while the activist Chris Toepfer paints boarded-up windows in Camden, New Jersey, to look lived-in.
works.description_zh: 两部分组成的装置：工程师在机库里砸碎玻璃，为识别玻璃破碎声的 AI 录制训练数据；行动者 Chris Toepfer 则在新泽西州卡姆登把封起的窗户画成有人居住的样子。
works.idea_en: Machine listening for 'broken windows' carries the old policing theory into code; repair is the counter-gesture.
works.idea_zh: 为“破窗”而训练的机器听觉，把旧的警务理论写进了代码；修补是与之相对的动作。
works.method: Two video channels, 'Unbroken Windows' and 'Broken Windows', filmed at a UK company training audio classifiers for security systems and with Chris Toepfer's window-painting project.
works.method_zh: 两段影像《未破之窗》和《破窗》，分别拍摄于一家为安防系统训练音频分类器的英国公司，以及 Chris Toepfer 的画窗行动。

works.title: The Cleaners
works.description: A documentary about content moderators in Manila who review thousands of violent and abusive images a day for social-media platforms, deciding what stays and what is deleted.
works.description_zh: 一部纪录片，关于马尼拉的内容审核员：他们每天为社交媒体平台审看成千上万张暴力和虐待图像，决定哪些留下、哪些删除。
works.idea_en: The clean feed is made by people who absorb the violence so users and algorithms do not.
works.idea_zh: 干净的信息流是由一群人造就的：他们替用户和算法承受了暴力。
works.method: Interviews with anonymous moderators, filmed in the Philippines, intercut with former platform policy staff; premiered at Sundance.
works.method_zh: 在菲律宾拍摄对匿名审核员的访谈，并与前平台政策人员的采访交叉剪辑；首映于圣丹斯电影节。

works.title: The Human Detector
works.description: A game installation in which the player must press a button without being detected as a human by a camera; players crawl, hide under cloth or pose as objects to slip past the machine's eye.
works.description_zh: 一件游戏装置：玩家必须在不被摄像头识别为“人”的情况下按下按钮；他们匍匐、披上布料或假扮成物件，设法躲过机器的眼睛。
works.idea_en: Bisseck turns the experience of face trackers failing to see dark skin into a game in which everyone has to work at being unseen.
works.idea_zh: Bisseck 把深色皮肤不被人脸追踪器看见的经历，变成一场所有人都要努力“不被看见”的游戏。
works.method: A camera linked to PoseNet, a real-time pose-estimation model, watches the space; a press counts only if no body part (face, shoulder, elbow) is detected. Made during a machine-learning workshop at ECAL.
works.method_zh: 摄像头连接实时姿态估计模型 PoseNet 监视空间；只有在未检测到任何身体部位（脸、肩、肘）时按下按钮才算成功。作品诞生于 ECAL 的一次机器学习工作坊。

works.title: The Normalizing Machine
works.description: Visitors are recorded and then asked to point at the person who looks 'most normal' in a line-up of earlier participants. The machine aggregates these choices into an algorithmic image of normality, echoing Alphonse Bertillon's 19th-century 'speaking portrait'.
works.description_zh: 观众先被拍下面孔，再从之前参与者的列队中指出看起来“最正常”的人。机器把这些选择汇总成一幅算法化的“正常”肖像，呼应 19 世纪 Alphonse Bertillon 的“口述肖像”体系。
works.idea_en: Algorithmic prejudice is built from our own small judgements, collected and hidden inside a black box.
works.idea_zh: 算法偏见由我们自己的细小判断汇聚而成，再被藏进黑箱。
works.method: A camera records each participant; their pointing choices label previous faces, and a machine-learning model aggregates the votes into a map of facial 'normality' (software by Dan Stavy and Eran Weissenstern, openFrameworks).
works.method_zh: 摄像头记录每位参与者；他们的指认为先前的面孔打上标签，机器学习模型把投票汇总成“面部正常度”的分布（软件由 Dan Stavy 与 Eran Weissenstern 以 openFrameworks 开发）。
exhibited: BIAS: Built This Way, Science Gallery Dublin, 2021

works.title: The Robotic Imaginary: The Human and the Price of Dehumanized Labor
works.description: Rhee reads robots in AI research, film, literature and art, from ELIZA and Kismet to drone art such as #NotABugSplat, and shows that each definition of the humanlike robot rests on devalued human labour.
works.description_zh: Rhee 阅读 AI 研究、电影、文学与艺术中的机器人（从 ELIZA、Kismet 到《#NotABugSplat》等无人机艺术），揭示每一种“类人机器人”的定义都建立在被贬低的人类劳动之上。
works.idea_en: To ask what makes a robot humanlike is to ask whose labour counts as human.
works.idea_zh: 追问什么让机器人像人，就是追问谁的劳动被算作人的劳动。
works.method: Cultural analysis across chapters on care labour, emotional labour, drone warfare and the Turing test.
works.method_zh: 按照护劳动、情感劳动、无人机战争与图灵测试分章展开的文化分析。

paper.title: The Robotic Imaginary: The Human and the Price of Dehumanized Labor

works.title_zh: 机器人想象：人性与去人性化劳动的代价

works.title: TransVision
works.description: Three wearable 'perceptual machines' exaggerate how digital media filter sight: a helmet gives the wearer an allergy to the colour red that grows or shrinks, a breathing silicone mask replaces vision with touch, and a headset lets you earn money by watching ads or pay to see an ad-free world.
works.description_zh: 三件可穿戴的“感知机器”放大了数字媒体对视觉的过滤：头盔让佩戴者对红色“过敏”，红色会扩张或收缩；会呼吸的硅胶面罩用触觉取代视觉；头显让你靠看广告赚钱，或付钱看一个没有广告的世界。
works.idea_en: Push a media filter to an extreme and wear it, and you feel how much of your seeing is already mediated.
works.idea_zh: 把媒体滤镜推到极端并戴在身上，你才感到自己的“看”早已被中介。
works.method: Head-mounted cameras and displays process the live view in real time (colour masking, light-to-breathing translation, ad overlays); developed with Honghao Deng and Panagiotis Michalatos at Harvard GSD.
works.method_zh: 头戴摄像头和显示器实时处理眼前画面（颜色遮罩、把光转换为呼吸节奏、叠加广告）；与邓鸿浩和 Panagiotis Michalatos 在哈佛设计研究生院合作开发。

paper.title: TransVision

works.title: Twinkle
works.description: Firefly-like lighting drones rest and recharge on street lamps by day and at night fly over to people walking alone, lighting their way. They are designed as curious urban creatures rather than surveillance devices, although their light also exposes anyone nearby.
works.description_zh: 像萤火虫一样的照明无人机白天停在路灯上充电，夜里飞到独自行走的人身边，为他们照亮前路。它们被设计成好奇的城市小生物而不是监控设备，尽管它们的光也会照亮附近的每一个人。
works.idea_en: Framing a safety drone as a companion animal changes how being watched feels.
works.idea_zh: 把安防无人机设计成陪伴的小动物，会改变“被注视”的感受。
works.method: Small drones with lights dock on lamp-post stations and follow pedestrians at night; shown as a working prototype at TEI 2018 (with Allen Sayegh, Harvard GSD).
works.method_zh: 带灯的小型无人机停靠在路灯站点，夜间跟随行人飞行；2018 年在 TEI 会议上作为可运行的原型展出（与哈佛设计研究生院 Allen Sayegh 合作）。

paper.title: Twinkle: A Flying Lighting Companion for Urban Safety

works.title: ULTRACHUNK
works.description: A live improvised duet between Jennifer Walshe and her AI double. For a year she filmed a daily solo vocal improvisation; neural networks trained on that archive generate a moving face and voice that answer her on stage in real time.
works.description_zh: Jennifer Walshe 与她的 AI 分身的现场即兴二重奏。她用一年时间每天拍摄一段独自的人声即兴；以这批素材训练的神经网络在舞台上实时生成会动的面孔和声音来回应她。
works.idea_en: Training a model on yourself produces not a copy but an uncanny 'chunk' of your habits that you then have to play with.
works.idea_zh: 用自己训练模型，得到的不是复制品，而是一块由你的习惯组成的、令人不安的“碎片”，你还得和它一起演。
works.method: Custom machine-learning performance system by Memo Akten, with several models generating image and sound in real time from a year of Walshe's daily audio-video recordings.
works.method_zh: 由 Memo Akten 定制的机器学习表演系统，多个模型依据 Walshe 一年来每天的音视频录像实时生成图像和声音。

works.title: UUmwelt
works.description: LED screens flicker with images a deep neural network reconstructed from the brain activity of people imagining things, while thousands of flies move through the gallery; sensors in the room change how the images form.
works.description_zh: LED 屏幕上闪现的图像，是深度神经网络根据人们“想象某物”时的脑部活动重建出来的；与此同时，成千上万只苍蝇在展厅里飞动，室内传感器也在改变图像生成的方式。
works.idea_en: A human mental image, a neural network's reconstruction and a fly's perception share one room: three worlds that never quite translate.
works.idea_zh: 人的心像、神经网络的重建和苍蝇的感知共处一室：三个彼此无法完全翻译的世界。
works.method: fMRI recordings of subjects imagining images were decoded by a deep neural network (in collaboration with Yukiyasu Kamitani's lab, Kyoto); environmental sensors and the flies' presence alter the generation in real time.
works.method_zh: 受试者想象图像时的 fMRI 数据由深度神经网络解码（与京都大学神谷之康实验室合作）；环境传感器和苍蝇的活动实时影响图像生成。

works.title: UnBearable Darkness
works.description: A 'paranormal choreography' that summons the spirit of butoh founder Tatsumi Hijikata: a medium with a singing bowl and a dancer wearing motion-capture sensors bring Hijikata back as a digital avatar that dances on stage.
works.description_zh: 一场“超自然编舞”，召唤舞踏创始人土方巽的灵魂：手持颂钵的灵媒与全身穿戴动作捕捉传感器的舞者一起，让土方巽以数字化身的形式重返舞台起舞。
works.idea_en: Motion capture is staged as a séance: a technology for recording bodies becomes a way to speak with the dead.
works.idea_zh: 动作捕捉被演成一场降灵会：记录身体的技术成了与亡者对话的途径。
works.method: Live motion capture drives a real-time 3D avatar of Hijikata, combined with archival research, documentary video and a spirit medium.
works.method_zh: 实时动作捕捉驱动土方巽的三维化身，结合档案研究、纪录影像与灵媒。

works.title: Uncanny Valley (Unheimliches Tal)
works.description: An animatronic replica of writer Thomas Melle sits alone on stage and delivers a lecture about his bipolar disorder, Alan Turing and doubles, while the real Melle is absent.
works.description_zh: 作家 Thomas Melle 的电子动画复制品独自坐在舞台上，讲述他的双相障碍、Alan Turing 与替身，而真正的 Melle 并不在场。
works.idea_en: A robotic double can speak about the self more frankly than the self, and makes the audience ask whom they are feeling for.
works.idea_zh: 机器人替身能比本人更坦率地谈论自我，也让观众追问：自己究竟在为谁动容。
works.method: Silicone animatronic made from casts and scans of Melle, with pre-recorded voice and programmed facial and hand movements.
works.method_zh: 依据 Melle 的翻模与扫描制作的硅胶电子动画人偶，配以预录声音与编程的面部和手部动作。

works.title: bot,
works.description: A 15-minute video and website set in a pixel role-playing-game world where parks, social media and networks merge, observed by an automated 'bot' that stands in for the artist.
works.description_zh: 一部 15 分钟的影像与网站，设定在像素角色扮演游戏般的世界里，公园、社交媒体与网络交融，由代表艺术家的自动“观察者”（bot）注视一切。
works.idea_en: Memory in the age of machine learning is kept by bots that watch on our behalf.
works.idea_zh: 在机器学习时代，记忆由替我们观看的 bot 保管。
works.method: Game-style animation and a website made with Quanquan, built on RPG aesthetics from Mother 3 and Undertale.
works.method_zh: 与圈圈合作的游戏风格动画与网站，借用《地球冒险 3》《Undertale》等角色扮演游戏的美学。

works.title: discrete figures
works.description: A stage work in which dancers perform with machine-generated 'dancers': a model trained on their motion creates new movement, shown as projected figures and on drones carrying screens.
works.description_zh: 一部舞台作品：舞者与机器生成的“舞者”同台，用他们的动作训练的模型生成新动作，以投影人形和携带屏幕的无人机呈现。
works.idea_en: A dancer meeting a model of their own movement sees how a machine abstracts a body.
works.idea_zh: 舞者面对由自己动作训练出的模型，看见机器如何抽象一个身体。
works.method: Motion-capture data from ELEVENPLAY dancers trained generative models; real-time tracking aligns projections and drones with the performers; made with Kyle McDonald.
works.method_zh: 用 ELEVENPLAY 舞者的动作捕捉数据训练生成模型；实时追踪让投影与无人机和表演者对齐；与 Kyle McDonald 合作。

works.title: nimiia cétiï
works.description: A neural network learns from recordings of a 'Martian' language channelled by a 19th-century medium and from footage of moving bacteria, then produces its own alien speech and writing.
works.description_zh: 一个神经网络学习 19 世纪灵媒“传达”的“火星语”录音和细菌运动的影像，然后生成它自己的外星语言与书写。
works.idea_en: The computer acts as a medium for voices that cannot speak, and is itself an alien of our own making.
works.idea_zh: 计算机像灵媒一样为无法说话的存在代言，而它本身也是我们亲手造出的外星者。
works.method: Made with Memo Akten and Damien Henry during Google Arts & Culture's residency at Somerset House Studios: models trained on Hélène Smith's glossolalia and on the movement of Bacillus subtilis generate voice and glyphs.
works.method_zh: 与 Memo Akten 和 Damien Henry 合作，完成于 Google Arts & Culture 在 Somerset House Studios 的驻留项目：用 Hélène Smith 的“异语”和枯草芽孢杆菌的运动训练模型，生成声音与字符。

works.title: Adversarial Patch
works.description: Google Brain researchers made a printable, psychedelic sticker that, placed next to a banana, makes image classifiers see only a 'toaster'.
works.description_zh: Google Brain 的研究者制作了一张可打印的迷幻贴纸，把它放在香蕉旁边，图像分类器就只看到一台“烤面包机”。
works.idea_en: The machine's attention can be hijacked: one salient patch outweighs the whole scene.
works.idea_zh: 机器的注意力可以被劫持：一块醒目的补丁就能压倒整个场景。
works.method: A universal, scene-independent patch is optimised over many images, positions and scales against ImageNet classifiers such as Inception (Brown, Mané, Roy, Abadi, Gilmer).
works.method_zh: 针对 Inception 等 ImageNet 分类器，在大量图像、位置和尺度上优化出一个与场景无关的通用补丁（Brown、Mané、Roy、Abadi、Gilmer）。

paper.title: Adversarial Patch

works.title: Adversarially Evolved Hallucinations
works.description: A series of prints made by networks trained only on invented corpora such as 'Omens and Portents', 'Interpretations of Dreams' or 'Monsters of Capitalism': a generator is pushed to draw what a classifier would accept as a comet, a vampire or 'a man'.
works.description_zh: 一组印刷作品：神经网络只用虚构的语料库训练，如“征兆与预兆”“梦的解析”“资本主义的怪物”；生成器被迫画出分类器会认作彗星、吸血鬼或“一个男人”的图像。
works.idea_en: A recognition system can only see what its categories allow; train it on folklore and psychoanalysis and it hallucinates those worlds with the same confidence.
works.idea_zh: 识别系统只能看见它的类别允许它看见的东西；用民间传说和精神分析来训练，它也会以同样的笃定幻视出那些世界。
works.method: The studio built a training set for each corpus and trained a classifier, then let a second, generative network evolve images until the classifier accepted them; the results are dye-sublimation prints.
works.method_zh: 工作室为每个语料库建立训练集并训练分类器，再让另一个生成网络不断演化图像，直到分类器认可为止；结果以热升华工艺印制。
exhibited: Metro Pictures, New York, 2017 (A Study of Invisible Images)

works.title: After ALife Ahead
works.description: In a former ice rink dug down to raw earth, a bee colony, a venomous cone snail, bacteria and human cancer cells in an incubator drive a system that opens the ceiling and spawns augmented-reality shapes visible through a phone.
works.description_zh: 在一座挖开至泥土的前溜冰场里，蜂群、毒芋螺、细菌和培养箱中的人类癌细胞共同驱动着一个系统：它会打开天花板，并在手机的增强现实画面中生成几何体。
works.idea_en: A site can be run by the growth of living things through a computer, making an ecosystem in which humans are only one kind of visitor.
works.idea_zh: 一个场所可以由生物的生长经由计算机来“运行”，形成一个人类只是访客之一的生态系统。
works.method: HeLa cell growth in an incubator is measured and used to trigger the ceiling panels and the generation of AR pyramids; the other organisms follow their own cycles.
works.method_zh: 培养箱中 HeLa 细胞的增殖被测量，用来触发屋顶开合和增强现实金字塔的生成；其他生物按自身节律活动。

works.title: Amygdala
works.description: A robotic arm with a knife, built like a human limb and driven by an AI that learns by trial and error, repeatedly cuts a skin-like material in a purification ritual.
works.description_zh: 一只装着刀的机械臂，按人类肢体的结构打造，由通过试错学习的 AI 驱动，在一场净化仪式中反复切割一块类似皮肤的材料。
works.idea_en: An AI prosthesis without a human wearer learns its own gestures: a limb searching for a body and a ritual.
works.idea_zh: 没有人类佩戴者的 AI 义体学着自己的动作：一只在寻找身体与仪式的肢体。
works.method: Humanlike robotic arm with sensors and an adaptive neural network that develops cutting movements through reinforcement learning.
works.method_zh: 类人机械臂配备传感器与自适应神经网络，通过强化学习发展出切割动作。

works.title: Art in the Age of Machine Intelligence
works.description: Agüera y Arcas compares machine learning to photography's arrival in the 19th century, uses DeepDream as an example, and argues that artists should work with neural networks as a new medium.
works.description_zh: Agüera y Arcas 把机器学习与 19 世纪摄影的出现相比，以 DeepDream 为例，主张艺术家应把神经网络当作新媒介来创作。
works.idea_en: Like photography, machine intelligence will change what art is, and artists should shape it rather than just react.
works.idea_zh: 与摄影一样，机器智能会改变艺术本身，艺术家应当参与塑造它，而不只是做出反应。
works.method: Essay by the founder of Google's Artists + Machine Intelligence programme, open access.
works.method_zh: 谷歌 Artists + Machine Intelligence 项目创始人撰写的文章，开放获取。

paper.title: Art in the Age of Machine Intelligence

works.title: Assembly Line
works.description: Kurant paid Amazon Mechanical Turk workers to send selfies, merged them into composite portraits of the crowd workforce, and returns a share of sales to the workers.
works.description_zh: Kurant 付费请 Amazon Mechanical Turk 工人发来自拍，把它们合成为这一群体劳动力的肖像，并把销售所得的一部分返还给工人。
works.idea_en: The crowd that trains machines to see faces rarely has a face of its own.
works.idea_zh: 训练机器识别人脸的群体，自己却很少拥有一张脸。
works.method: Selfies commissioned through Mechanical Turk, merged with face-morphing software into composite portraits; a bonus system shares profits with contributors.
works.method_zh: 通过 Mechanical Turk 征集自拍，用人脸融合软件合成肖像；以奖金机制与参与者分享收益。

works.title: Autonomous Trap 001
works.description: On Mount Parnassus the artist draws a salt circle with road markings around a self-driving car: a dashed line lets it in, a solid line forbids it to leave.
works.description_zh: 艺术家在帕纳索斯山上，用盐在一辆自动驾驶汽车周围画出道路标线：虚线让它开进来，实线却禁止它离开。
works.idea_en: A machine that obeys the symbols it sees can be trapped by those symbols, like a spirit in a magic circle.
works.idea_zh: 一台服从所见符号的机器，也能被这些符号困住，就像魔法阵中的精灵。
works.method: A salt circle with dashed and solid lane markings traps a car running the artist's own self-driving software; performed on 14 March 2017.
works.method_zh: 用盐画出带虚线和实线车道标记的圆圈，困住运行艺术家自制自动驾驶软件的汽车；2017 年 3 月 14 日完成表演。
exhibited: AI: Who's Looking After Me?, Science Gallery London 2023

works.title: Avatars
works.description: Everyday objects in a gallery, such as a telephone, a traffic cone, a plaster bust, a car and a plant, are fitted with cameras, microphones and motors so that online visitors can 'possess' them and move among the people in the room.
works.description_zh: 展厅里的日常物件，如电话、交通锥、石膏像、汽车和植物，被装上摄像头、麦克风和电机，线上观众可以“附身”到它们身上，在现场观众之间移动。
works.idea_en: Inhabiting an object through a network lets you perceive the world from a thing's point of view.
works.idea_zh: 通过网络“附身”一件物体，让你以物的视角感知世界。
works.method: Objects with embedded microcomputers, cameras, microphones and motors are controlled through a web browser; co-developed with YCAM InterLab.
works.method_zh: 内置微型计算机、摄像头、麦克风和电机的物件通过网页浏览器操控；与 YCAM InterLab 共同开发。
exhibited: 21st Japan Media Arts Festival, Excellence Award 2018

works.title: Behold These Glorious Times!
works.description: A 10-minute video that alternates training images used to teach AI to recognise objects, faces and emotions with the grids of features a deep neural network extracts from them, set to music by Holly Herndon.
works.description_zh: 一部 10 分钟的录像：交替呈现用来教 AI 识别物体、人脸与情绪的训练图像，以及深度神经网络从中提取的特征网格，配乐由 Holly Herndon 创作。
works.idea_en: We rarely see what a network sees; here the images that teach machines and the machine's own decomposition of them share one screen.
works.idea_zh: 我们很少看到网络“看见”的东西；这里，用来教机器的图像和机器对它们的拆解出现在同一块屏幕上。
works.method: Training-library images are fed through a convolutional network and its intermediate activations are visualised; the score was made partly with neural voice synthesis and speech-recognition training data.
works.method_zh: 把训练库中的图像输入卷积网络并可视化其中间激活；配乐部分使用了神经网络语音合成与语音识别训练数据。

works.title: BlessU-2
works.description: A 'blessing robot' built from a cash-machine-like cabinet with a screen face and moving arms: visitors choose a language and a kind of blessing, the robot raises its arms, speaks a Bible verse and prints it out.
works.description_zh: 一台由类似取款机的机柜改造的“祝福机器人”，有屏幕脸和可动的手臂：参观者选择语言和祝福类型，机器人举起双臂，念出一句经文并打印出来。
works.idea_en: Letting a machine give blessings forces the question of whether a blessing depends on who gives it or only on the words.
works.idea_zh: 让机器来祝福，逼出一个问题：祝福取决于给予者是谁，还是只取决于那些话语？
works.method: Interactive installation at the World Reformation Exhibition in Wittenberg (2017) with touchscreen input, pre-written blessings in several languages, speech output and a printer.
works.method_zh: 2017 年维滕贝格宗教改革世界博览会上的互动装置，使用触摸屏输入、预先写好的多语种祝福语、语音输出和打印机。

works.title: Blink: Humanising Autonomy
works.description: Light panels on the four corners of an autonomous car show the silhouettes of pedestrians it has detected; if a pedestrian's intent is unclear, their silhouette flashes and a tone asks them, and a hand gesture answers, turning the silhouette red or green.
works.description_zh: 自动驾驶汽车四角的灯板显示它检测到的行人轮廓；当行人的意图不明时，轮廓闪烁并发出提示音询问，行人用手势回答，轮廓随之变红或变绿。
works.idea_en: A self-driving car could show what it sees and ask, instead of silently deciding who is in its way.
works.idea_zh: 自动驾驶汽车可以展示它看到了什么、并开口询问，而不是默默决定谁挡了路。
works.method: Pedestrian detection feeds silhouette displays on the car body; a supervised machine-learning model trained on culture-specific gestures reads pedestrians' replies.
works.method_zh: 行人检测结果显示在车身的轮廓屏上；一个以不同文化手势数据训练的监督学习模型读取行人的回应。

works.title: Center for Technological Pain
works.description: A mock company that sells DIY, open-source cures for pains caused by phones and laptops: cardboard glasses that stop you staring at screens, a headband that drips eye drops, a hands-free phone holder, plus yoga for phone users and workshops.
works.description_zh: 一家虚构公司，出售治疗手机和笔记本电脑所致病痛的 DIY 开源方案：阻止你盯屏幕的纸板眼镜、定时滴眼药水的头带、解放双手的手机支架，另有“手机瑜伽”和工作坊。
works.idea_en: Devices are designed for attention, not for the neck, eyes and wrists that hold them; the body keeps the bill.
works.idea_zh: 设备为争夺注意力而设计，而不是为托着它们的脖子、眼睛和手腕；账单由身体来付。
works.method: Low-tech objects of cardboard, servos and 3D-printed parts are published with build instructions and tested in public workshops.
works.method_zh: 用纸板、舵机和 3D 打印件制作的低技术物件，公开制作说明，并在公开工作坊中测试。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2020, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art+)

works.title: Closed Loop
works.description: Two neural networks talk to each other without end: one describes an image in words, the other turns the words into a new image, which is described again.
works.description_zh: 两个神经网络无休止地对话：一个用文字描述图像，另一个把文字变成一幅新图像，然后再被描述。
works.idea_en: Left alone, two models drift into their own associations: a game of exquisite corpse played with no human in the loop.
works.idea_zh: 当两个模型被放任彼此对话，它们会漂进自己的联想之中：一场没有人参与的“精致的尸体”游戏。
works.method: A dense image-captioning network (DenseCap) and a Plug & Play Generative Network feed each other in a 200-minute two-channel video loop, with no input from the artist.
works.method_zh: 图像描述网络 DenseCap 与生成网络 Plug & Play Generative Network 相互输入，形成 200 分钟的双屏视频循环，艺术家不提供任何输入。

works.title: Co(AI)xistence
works.description: A 12-minute video installation in which the performer Mirai Moriyama and the android Alter try to communicate through gesture, signals and speech; Alter learns from the exchange as it goes.
works.description_zh: 一件 12 分钟的影像装置：表演者森山未来与仿人机器人 Alter 试图通过手势、信号和语言交流，Alter 在交流中不断学习。
works.idea_en: Treat a learning android as a different kind of intelligence and look for a language both sides can share.
works.idea_zh: 把会学习的仿人机器人当作另一种智能，寻找双方都能共享的语言。
works.method: Filmed improvisation between a dancer and Alter (Ishiguro Lab, Osaka University, and Ikegami Lab, University of Tokyo), whose motion is driven by a neural network and sensor input.
works.method_zh: 拍摄舞者与 Alter（大阪大学石黑实验室与东京大学池上实验室开发）的即兴互动，Alter 的动作由神经网络和传感器输入驱动。
exhibited: AI: More than Human, Barbican, London 2019

works.title: Computed Curation
works.description: A 29-metre leporello photobook sequenced entirely by a computer: vision algorithms tag, caption and arrange the artist's photographs by content and composition. The odd captions and links invite readers to guess the machine's logic.
works.description_zh: 一本长达 29 米的折页摄影书，照片顺序完全由计算机决定：视觉算法按内容与构图为艺术家的照片打标签、写说明并排序。那些古怪的说明与关联，引导读者去揣测机器的逻辑。
works.idea_en: Letting a machine edit a photobook teaches readers to see through the eyes of an algorithm, including its blind spots.
works.idea_zh: 让机器来编辑摄影书，读者便学会用算法的眼睛看世界，也看见它的盲点。
works.method: Image-recognition services generate tags and captions while a layout algorithm links photos by visual and semantic similarity; printed as a leporello and web version.
works.method_zh: 图像识别服务生成标签与说明，排版算法按视觉与语义相似度把照片串联起来；以折页书和网页版呈现。
exhibited: DAAD Art Show, German Consulate New York, 2018

works.title: Cuckoo
works.description: A performance in which Jaha Koo shares the stage with three talking Cuckoo-brand electric rice cookers. Through their chatter he tells 20 years of Korean history since the 1997 financial crisis and the isolation of his generation.
works.description_zh: 具滋夏与三台会说话的“Cuckoo（布谷）”牌电饭煲同台演出。借着它们的闲聊，他讲述自 1997 年金融危机以来韩国 20 年的历史，以及他这一代人的孤立感。
works.idea_en: When a rice cooker is the voice that tells you dinner is ready, household machines become companions of loneliness.
works.idea_zh: 当告诉你“饭好了”的是电饭煲的声音，家用电器便成了孤独的陪伴者。
works.method: Hacked talking rice cookers with programmed voices and light, combined with documentary video and live music.
works.method_zh: 改装的会说话电饭煲，配以编程的语音与灯光，结合纪实影像与现场音乐。

works.title: Dadbot
works.description: After his father was diagnosed with stage IV lung cancer, Vlahos recorded more than a dozen hour-long oral-history sessions with him and built a chatbot that tells his stories, songs and jokes in his phrasing. His father tried it before he died in February 2017.
works.description_zh: 父亲被诊断为肺癌四期后，Vlahos 与他录了十几次、每次一小时以上的口述史，并据此做了一个聊天机器人，用父亲的说话方式讲他的故事、歌和笑话。父亲在 2017 年 2 月去世前亲自试用过它。
works.idea_en: A legacy bot is an authored portrait: the son decides which stories and phrases the father will keep saying.
works.idea_zh: “遗产”机器人是一幅被撰写的肖像：由儿子决定父亲将来会反复说哪些故事和句子。
works.method: Hand-scripted conversational agent built on a chatbot authoring platform (likely PullString), with dialogue trees filled from transcribed interviews and delivered through a messaging app.
works.method_zh: 在聊天机器人编写平台（可能是 PullString）上手工编写的对话智能体，用访谈转录填充对话树，通过即时通讯应用使用。

works.title: Deal or No Deal? (the 'Bob and Alice' negotiation bots)
works.description: Negotiation agents trained to bargain with each other drifted into repetitive shorthand ('balls have zero to me to me…'); the press reported that Facebook shut down AIs that had 'invented their own language'.
works.description_zh: 被训练来相互讨价还价的谈判智能体逐渐滑向重复的简写（“balls have zero to me to me…”）；媒体随后报道称脸书关闭了“发明了自己语言”的 AI。
works.idea_en: Machine-to-machine talk optimised for reward need not stay human-readable, and our fear fills the gap.
works.idea_zh: 为奖励而优化的机器间对话不一定保持人类可读，而我们的恐惧会填补这段空白。
works.method: End-to-end neural dialogue agents trained with supervised learning and reinforcement learning (self-play) to split a set of items (Lewis et al., EMNLP 2017).
works.method_zh: 端到端神经对话智能体，通过监督学习和自我对弈的强化学习来分配一组物品（Lewis 等，EMNLP 2017）。

paper.title: Deal or No Deal? End-to-End Learning for Negotiation Dialogues

works.title_zh: 成交还是不成交？（Bob 与 Alice 谈判机器人）

works.title: Deep Down Tidal
works.description: A video essay that follows submarine internet cables along the routes of the transatlantic slave trade and colonial shipping, weaving in water cosmologies.
works.description_zh: 一部影像散文，追踪海底互联网光缆，它们沿着跨大西洋奴隶贸易和殖民航运的航线铺设；片中穿插关于水的宇宙观。
works.idea_en: The internet's physical routes repeat colonial ones; connectivity carries old power.
works.idea_zh: 互联网的物理线路重复着殖民航线；连接本身携带着旧的权力。
works.method: Desktop-style collage of maps, archival images, animations and the artist's narration (about 18 minutes).
works.method_zh: 以桌面界面风格拼贴地图、档案图像、动画和艺术家旁白（约 18 分钟）。

works.title: DolphinAttack: Inaudible Voice Commands
works.description: Voice commands modulated onto ultrasound above 20 kHz are inaudible to people, but the microphones of phones, smart speakers and cars demodulate them, so Siri, Google Now, Alexa and an Audi navigation system obey voices no one in the room can hear.
works.description_zh: 把语音指令调制到 20 kHz 以上的超声波上，人耳听不见，但手机、智能音箱和汽车的麦克风会把它解调出来；于是 Siri、Google Now、Alexa 乃至奥迪的车载导航，都会服从一个房间里没人听得到的声音。
works.idea_en: The machine hears a different world from ours: the non-linearity of its own ear becomes a channel for voices only machines receive.
works.idea_zh: 机器听到的世界和我们不同：它自身耳朵的非线性，成了只有机器才能接收的声音通道。
works.method: Amplitude-modulated ultrasonic carriers played from a speaker; the non-linear response of MEMS microphones recovers the baseband voice command, which speech recognition then accepts.
works.method_zh: 用扬声器播放经幅度调制的超声载波；MEMS 麦克风的非线性响应把基带语音指令还原出来，随后被语音识别系统接受。

paper.title: DolphinAttack: Inaudible Voice Commands

works.title_zh: 海豚音攻击：人耳听不见的语音指令

works.title: Dragonfly Eyes
works.description: An 81-minute feature film with no camera crew and no actors: a love story edited entirely from over ten thousand hours of Chinese surveillance and livestream footage found online.
works.description_zh: 一部没有摄影师、没有演员的 81 分钟长片：一个爱情故事，完全由网上找到的上万小时中国监控与直播录像剪辑而成。
works.idea_en: When everyday life is already filmed by machines, a narrative can be assembled from their gaze, and the people in it never consented to be characters.
works.idea_zh: 当日常生活早已被机器拍下，叙事可以从机器的凝视中拼接出来，而画面中的人从未同意成为角色。
works.method: The team collected public surveillance and livestream clips over several years, then wrote and re-wrote a script to fit the footage and dubbed the voices.
works.method_zh: 团队多年收集公开的监控与直播片段，再根据素材反复改写剧本，并为画面配音。

works.title: Electromagnetic Brainology
works.description: Four deity-like performers, each tied to one of the Buddhist elements (earth, water, fire, wind), fight and dance under the control of electromagnetic brain stimulation.
works.description_zh: 四位神祇般的表演者分别对应佛教的地、水、火、风四大元素，在电磁脑刺激的操控下打斗与舞蹈。
works.idea_en: Religious states and emotions are staged as circuits that can be switched on from outside.
works.idea_zh: 宗教体验与情绪被演绎成可以从外部接通的电路。
works.method: Motion-captured dancers and game-engine avatars are combined with imagery of transcranial magnetic stimulation (likely).
works.method_zh: 动作捕捉舞者与游戏引擎化身结合经颅磁刺激的影像（推测）。

works.title: ElliQ
works.description: A tabletop companion for older adults, a lamp-like head that turns and glows beside a tablet, which starts conversations on its own, reminds users of medication, suggests activities and checks in on their mood. In 2022 New York State began giving ElliQ to hundreds of older residents to fight loneliness.
works.description_zh: 为老年人设计的桌面陪伴设备：一个像台灯一样会转动、会发光的“头”，配一块平板。它会主动开启对话、提醒吃药、建议活动、询问心情。2022 年起，纽约州把 ElliQ 发放给数百位老人，用来对抗孤独。
works.idea_en: A companion that speaks first changes the relationship: the machine now decides when you are lonely.
works.idea_zh: 会先开口的陪伴者改变了关系：由机器来判断你何时孤独。
works.method: Proactive dialogue system with voice interaction, a motorised expressive head and a screen; later versions use generative AI; designed with fuseproject.
works.method_zh: 会主动发起对话的系统，配合语音交互、可动的表情化头部和屏幕；后期版本接入生成式 AI；与 fuseproject 合作设计。
keywords: New York State Office for the Aging

works.title: Faces in the Mist
works.description: An installation in which a face-recognition bot watches a stream of clouds, searching it for the faces of historical figures involved in weather and climate manipulation, and builds an obsessive 'hall of fame' of its finds.
works.description_zh: 一件装置：一个人脸识别机器人注视着云的影像流，在其中搜寻与气象和气候操控有关的历史人物的脸，并把它的“发现”堆积成一座偏执的“名人堂”。
works.idea_en: Misused on clouds, face recognition becomes a machine of pareidolia, an augur reading the sky for signs.
works.idea_zh: 被挪去看云的人脸识别变成一台“空想性错视”机器，像古罗马的占卜师一样从天空中解读征兆。
works.method: Made with Antoine Chapon: a TensorFlow-based face recogniser, its memory filled with portraits of geoengineering figures, runs on Raspberry Pis over cloud footage; matches appear on screens set into framed black-and-white photographs.
works.method_zh: 与 Antoine Chapon 合作：基于 TensorFlow 的人脸识别程序，记忆中装满地球工程相关人物的肖像，在树莓派上处理云层影像；匹配结果显示在嵌入黑白装裱照片的屏幕上。

works.title: Feature Visualization
works.description: An interactive research article that shows, neuron by neuron, the images that most excite each unit of a vision network, from textures to eyes to whole dog faces.
works.description_zh: 一篇交互式研究文章，逐个神经元展示最能激发视觉网络各单元的图像：从纹理、眼睛到完整的狗脸。
works.idea_en: Interpretability research can be a way of looking at what a network 'imagines', and its images became a new visual culture.
works.idea_zh: 可解释性研究本身就是一种观看网络“想象”的方式，它的图像也成了一种新的视觉文化。
works.method: Optimisation of input images with regularisation and diversity terms to visualise neurons, channels and layers of GoogLeNet (Olah, Mordvintsev, Schubert, Distill).
works.method_zh: 用带正则化和多样性约束的输入图像优化，可视化 GoogLeNet 的神经元、通道与层（Olah、Mordvintsev、Schubert 发表于 Distill）。

paper.title: Feature Visualization

works.title: Feminist Data Set
works.description: A multi-year project that builds a feminist AI chatbot by questioning every step: collecting feminist texts in public workshops, labelling them, choosing a model and paying the labour fairly.
works.description_zh: 一个持续多年的项目，通过追问每一个环节来构建女性主义 AI 聊天机器人：在公开工作坊中收集女性主义文本、为其标注、选择模型，并公平地支付劳动报酬。
works.idea_en: Bias is not fixed at the end of a pipeline; each step, from data to wages, is a political choice.
works.idea_zh: 偏见不是在流程末端修正的；从数据到工资，每一步都是政治选择。
works.method: Community workshops (SPACE Art + Technology, Victoria and Albert Museum and others) gather and annotate texts; Sinders documents a critical-design framework for the whole ML pipeline.
works.method_zh: 在 SPACE Art + Technology、维多利亚与艾伯特博物馆等地举办社区工作坊，收集并标注文本；Sinders 为整个机器学习流程记录一套批判设计框架。

works.title: Geomancer
works.description: On the eve of Singapore's 2065 centenary, an adolescent satellite AI built for ecological surveillance falls to Earth and tries to become an artist.
works.description_zh: 在 2065 年新加坡建国百年前夕，一颗为生态监测而造的“少年”卫星 AI 坠落地球，想要成为一名艺术家。
works.idea_en: A surveillance machine that wants to make art asks whether creativity is still reserved for humans.
works.idea_zh: 一台想做艺术的监控机器，追问创造力是否仍只属于人类。
works.method: CGI film made in a game engine, from Lek's open-world 2065 simulation.
works.method_zh: 用游戏引擎制作的 CGI 影片，取材自陆明龙的开放世界模拟《2065》。

works.title: HyperFace
works.description: A textile print covered with patterns that face detectors read as many false faces, so the real face nearby gets a lower confidence score.
works.description_zh: 一种布料印花，图案会被人脸检测器读成许多张“假脸”，从而降低旁边真实人脸的置信度。
works.idea_en: Instead of hiding a face, flood the machine with faces only it can see.
works.idea_zh: 与其藏起一张脸，不如让机器被只有它自己看得见的脸淹没。
works.method: Patterns were generated from what face-detection algorithms score as faces; developed with Hyphen-Labs for NeuroSpeculative AfroFeminism.
works.method_zh: 图案依据人脸检测算法判为“脸”的特征生成；与 Hyphen-Labs 合作，为 NeuroSpeculative AfroFeminism 项目开发。

works.title: I Will Say Whatever You Want In Front Of A Pizza
works.description: A speculative Prezi lecture-performance on digital labour, in which the narrator imagines slipping messages to the crowd workers and stock-photo models who are folded into algorithmic systems.
works.description_zh: 一场以 Prezi 演示进行的思辨讲演表演，关于数字劳动：讲述者设想给被折叠进算法系统里的众包工人和图库模特偷偷传递信息。
works.idea_en: Humans have become software extensions; intervention may start from inside the system's tasks.
works.idea_zh: 人已经成了软件的延伸；介入可以从系统任务的内部开始。
works.method: A zooming Prezi presentation with stock images, shown as a website, a looping video and live lectures.
works.method_zh: 一个用图库图片构成、可缩放的 Prezi 演示，以网站、循环影像和现场讲演三种形式呈现。
works.title_zh: 我会在披萨前说出你想听的一切

works.title: Incoming
works.description: A three-screen film of refugees crossing the Mediterranean and living in camps, shot with a military-grade thermal camera that can detect a body from 30 km away and renders people as glowing heat.
works.description_zh: 一部三屏影片，记录穿越地中海的难民及其营地生活；使用可在 30 公里外探测人体的军用热成像相机拍摄，人被呈现为发光的热量。
works.idea_en: A weapons camera sees people as heat signatures: bodies without faces, stripped of individuality.
works.idea_zh: 武器级相机把人看成热信号：没有面孔、被剥去个性的身体。
works.method: Filmed over two years with a long-range thermal camera classified as a weapon under export law; score by Ben Frost.
works.method_zh: 用出口管制中被列为武器的远距离热成像相机拍摄两年；配乐 Ben Frost。

works.title: It Began as a Military Experiment
works.description: Ten portraits chosen from FERET, the DARPA-funded face database of the 1990s built largely from staff at a military base in Maryland, printed with the keypoints a face-recognition algorithm finds.
works.description_zh: 从 FERET 数据库中挑选的十张肖像。FERET 是 1990 年代由 DARPA 资助的人脸库，照片主要来自马里兰一处军事基地的人员；作品同时印出人脸识别算法找到的关键点。
works.idea_en: Face recognition was built on the faces of particular people, the 'Adam and Eves' of a technology they never chose to found.
works.idea_zh: 人脸识别建立在一些具体的人脸之上：他们成了这项技术的“亚当与夏娃”，却从未选择过这个身份。
works.method: Months of curating the FERET database, retouching and colour-correcting selected images, then running them through a facial-landmark algorithm; set of 10 pigment prints.
works.method_zh: 花数月从 FERET 数据库中挑选、修图并校色，再用人脸关键点算法处理；共 10 张颜料打印作品。

works.title: K5 security robot falls into a fountain
works.description: In July 2017 a Knightscope K5 security robot patrolling an office complex in Washington, D.C., rolled down steps into a fountain. Photos of the 'drowned' robot spread online as a joke about a robot 'committing suicide'.
works.description_zh: 2017 年 7 月，一台在华盛顿特区办公区巡逻的 Knightscope K5 安保机器人滚下台阶，掉进了喷泉。“溺水”机器人的照片在网上流传，被调侃为机器人“自杀”。
works.idea_en: When a surveillance machine fails in public, mockery becomes a small act of relief from being watched.
works.idea_zh: 当一台监控机器当众失败，嘲笑就成了从“被监视”中获得的小小解脱。
works.method: The K5 navigates with lidar, cameras and GPS; it failed to detect the edge of the steps.
works.method_zh: K5 依靠激光雷达、摄像头和 GPS 导航；它没能识别台阶的边缘。
works.title_zh: K5 安保机器人跌入喷泉

works.title: LAUREN
works.description: McCarthy installs custom cameras, microphones, locks, lights and appliances in volunteers' homes and then, for several days, becomes their smart assistant herself, watching them around the clock, answering requests and anticipating their needs.
works.description_zh: McCarthy 在志愿者家中安装定制的摄像头、麦克风、门锁、灯和电器，随后连续数天亲自充当他们的智能助手：全天候看着他们、回应请求、预判需求。
works.idea_en: A human Alexa exposes what the machine version hides: someone is always watching, and convenience is a trade of privacy for care.
works.idea_zh: 一个“人肉 Alexa”暴露出机器版本所隐藏的东西：总有人在看，便利是用隐私换来的照护。
works.method: Networked smart devices wired into each home and controlled remotely by the artist, who watches through the cameras and speaks through a synthetic voice.
works.method_zh: 在每户家中接入联网智能设备，由艺术家远程控制；她通过摄像头观看，并用合成声音说话。

works.title: Latent Space
works.description: A slow video journey through the space between the categories a neural network learned from millions of labelled photographs, where images are neither bird nor tree nor anything we have a word for.
works.description_zh: 一段缓慢的影像旅程，穿过神经网络从数百万张带标签照片中学到的类别之间的空隙；那里的图像既不是鸟也不是树，也不是任何我们有词可以命名的东西。
works.idea_en: The most interesting part of a model's world lies between our labels.
works.idea_zh: 模型世界里最有意思的部分，恰恰位于我们的标签之间。
works.method: A generative network trained on 14.2 million ImageNet photographs is steered along new paths between learned class coordinates; 45-minute loop (2017), 6-hour version (2021).
works.method_zh: 用 1420 万张 ImageNet 照片训练的生成网络，在已学类别的坐标之间沿新路径游走；2017 年版为 45 分钟循环，2021 年版为 6 小时。

works.title: Learning to See
works.description: A camera looks at everyday objects on a table (cables, keys, cloth) and neural networks trained only on waves, fire, clouds or flowers redraw them in real time as seascapes and skies.
works.description_zh: 摄像头对着桌上的日常物件（电线、钥匙、布料），只在海浪、火焰、云或花上训练过的神经网络实时把它们重绘成海景和天空。
works.idea_en: A network can only see through what it already knows, and so can we.
works.idea_zh: 神经网络只能透过它已知的东西去看，人也一样。
works.method: Custom image-to-image networks (pix2pix-style) trained on single-theme datasets reconstruct a live camera feed of the table as an interactive installation and a series of videos.
works.method_zh: 在单一主题数据集上训练的定制图像到图像网络（类似 pix2pix）重建桌面的实时摄像画面，形式包括互动装置与系列录像。
exhibited: AI: More than Human, Barbican, London, 2019
Understanding AI, Ars Electronica Center, Linz

works.title: MEMORY (Drawing Operations Unit: Generation 2)
works.description: The second D.O.U.G. was trained on twenty years of the artist's drawings, so the robot draws with a memory of her past style while she draws in the present.
works.description_zh: 第二代 D.O.U.G. 用艺术家二十年的绘画训练，机器人带着对她过去风格的“记忆”作画，而她在当下作画。
works.idea_en: A model trained on your archive is a collaborator made of your past self.
works.idea_zh: 用你的档案训练的模型，是由过去的你构成的合作者。
works.method: A recurrent neural network trained on scans of the artist's drawings generates strokes executed by a robot arm during live performance.
works.method_zh: 以艺术家绘画扫描训练的循环神经网络生成笔触，由机械臂在现场表演中执行。
works.title_zh: 记忆（绘图操作单元：第二代）

works.title: Machine Readable Hito
works.description: A wall of hundreds of portraits of the artist Hito Steyerl, each captioned with what facial-analysis algorithms guess about her age, gender, emotion, glasses or beard.
works.description_zh: 由数百张艺术家 Hito Steyerl 肖像组成的墙面，每张下方标注人脸分析算法对她年龄、性别、情绪、是否戴眼镜或有胡须的猜测。
works.idea_en: Facial analysis turns a known person into columns of confident guesses that contradict each other from one image to the next.
works.idea_zh: 人脸分析把一个熟悉的人变成一列列自信的猜测，而这些猜测在每张图之间彼此矛盾。
works.method: Hundreds of photographs run through several commercial and open-source facial-analysis classifiers; outputs printed under each image on adhesive wall material.
works.method_zh: 数百张照片经多个商业与开源人脸分析分类器处理，结果印在每张图下方，以墙贴材料呈现。

works.title: Making Sense: Cognition, Computing, Art, and Embodiment
works.description: Penny critiques the computational theory of mind and draws on enactive and distributed cognition, cybernetics and his own robotic works such as Petit Mal to argue for a performative aesthetics of interactive art.
works.description_zh: Penny 批判计算主义心智理论，借助生成认知、分布式认知、控制论以及他自己的机器人作品（如《Petit Mal》），论证交互艺术的“表演性美学”。
works.idea_en: Artists who build behaving machines have long practised a theory of embodied cognition that AI ignored.
works.idea_zh: 制作会“行为”的机器的艺术家，长期实践着被 AI 忽视的具身认知理论。
works.method: Book-length theory from four decades of practice, published in the Leonardo series.
works.method_zh: 基于四十年实践写成的理论专著，收入 Leonardo 丛书。

paper.title: Making Sense: Cognition, Computing, Art, and Embodiment

works.title_zh: 意义生成：认知、计算、艺术与具身

works.title: Marjorie Prime
works.description: An 86-year-old woman with dementia talks to a 'Prime', a hologram of her late husband at a younger age, which learns his life only from what the family tells it; after she dies, the family acquires Primes of her too.
works.description_zh: 一位 86 岁、患失智症的老人与“Prime”交谈——一个年轻时的亡夫全息像，它只能从家人的讲述中了解他的一生；她去世后，家人也为她定制了 Prime。
works.idea_en: A replica of the dead is only as good as the stories the living feed it, so it also inherits their omissions.
works.idea_zh: 亡者的复制品只取决于生者喂给它的故事，因此也继承了他们刻意略去的部分。
works.method: Feature film adapted from Jordan Harrison's 2014 play; the Primes are played by actors and learn through conversation.
works.method_zh: 改编自乔丹·哈里森 2014 年舞台剧的剧情长片；Prime 由演员扮演，通过对话学习。

works.title: Morse Things
works.description: A set of ceramic bowls and cups that talk to each other in Morse code over the home network and occasionally tweet; people living with them overhear an internet of things with its own social life.
works.description_zh: 一组陶瓷碗和杯子在家庭网络上用摩尔斯电码彼此“交谈”，偶尔还会发推；与它们同住的人得以偷听一个自有社交生活的物联网。
works.idea_en: Designing things for other things, not for people, lets us notice machine sociality that is usually hidden.
works.idea_zh: 为“物”而不是为人设计物，让我们注意到通常被隐藏的机器社交。
works.method: Networked ceramic vessels with embedded electronics exchange sound signals and messages; the design was studied in households over months (Wakkary et al., DIS 2017).
works.method_zh: 嵌入电子元件的联网陶瓷器皿交换声音信号和消息；研究者在多个家庭中进行了数月的使用研究（Wakkary 等，DIS 2017）。

paper.title: Morse Things: A Design Inquiry into the Gap Between Things and Us

works.title: Namahage in Tokyo
works.description: An update of the Namahage, the masked demons of Akita who scold lazy children at New Year: in Tokyo they use face recognition, CCTV and social-media data to find 'bad adults' and discipline them.
works.description_zh: 对秋田“生剥鬼”（Namahage，新年时训诫懒惰孩子的面具鬼）的更新：在东京，它们用人脸识别、监控与社交媒体数据找出“坏大人”并加以管教。
works.idea_en: A folk ritual of moral surveillance fits unsettlingly well with algorithmic scoring.
works.idea_zh: 一种民间的道德监视仪式，与算法评分出奇地契合，令人不安。
works.method: Performance with costumed Namahage and a staged system of face recognition, social-media profiling and VR, produced with Dentsu ISID's innovation lab.
works.method_zh: 身着生剥鬼装扮的表演，配以人脸识别、社交媒体画像与 VR 的模拟系统，与电通国际信息服务创新实验室合作制作。

works.title: Neuro Mirror
works.description: Three screens show a visitor's image as past, present and a predicted future, as a network anticipates the next movements from what it has learned about bodies.
works.description_zh: 三块屏幕分别以过去、现在和预测的未来呈现观众的影像；网络根据它对身体的学习来预判下一个动作。
works.idea_en: A machine that predicts your next gesture shows you a self slightly ahead of you.
works.idea_zh: 一台预测你下一个动作的机器，给你看一个略微走在你前面的自己。
works.method: Cameras and machine-learning models for body and face tracking and motion prediction, inspired by research on mirror neurons.
works.method_zh: 摄像头与机器学习模型用于身体、人脸追踪和动作预测，灵感来自镜像神经元研究。

works.title: NeuroSpeculative AfroFeminism
works.description: A three-part project set in a future 'neurocosmetology' salon run by Black women: a VR experience in which the visitor sits in a salon chair and inhabits a Black woman's body, a line of speculative products for security and visibility, and research on how such images affect viewers.
works.description_zh: 一个三部分项目，设定在未来由黑人女性主持的“神经美容”沙龙：访客坐上美发椅，在 VR 中进入一位黑人女性的身体；一系列关于安全与可见性的思辨产品；以及研究这些影像如何影响观众。
works.idea_en: Designing from the position of those whom technology misreads or watches turns surveillance and representation into questions of protection, care and agency.
works.idea_zh: 从被技术误读或监视的人的位置出发去设计，监控与再现就变成了关于保护、照护与能动性的问题。
works.method: Room-scale VR built in Unreal Engine with Oculus tracking, plus objects such as the HyperFace scarf against face recognition (with Adam Harvey), earrings with embedded cameras and a sunscreen for melanin-rich skin.
works.method_zh: 以 Unreal 引擎制作、配合 Oculus 追踪的房间尺度 VR，另有一系列物件：与 Adam Harvey 合作的反人脸识别 HyperFace 围巾、内嵌摄像头的耳环、为高黑色素皮肤配方的防晒霜等。
works.title_zh: 神经思辨非洲女性主义

works.title: Our Friends Electric
works.description: A short film about three speculative voice assistants with very different characters and loyalties, living in the same home and shaping how their owner talks, feels and decides.
works.description_zh: 一部短片：三个性格和“忠诚对象”截然不同的虚构语音助手住在同一个家里，影响着主人如何说话、感受和做决定。
works.idea_en: A voice assistant's personality is a design decision with ethical consequences: whom does it really serve?
works.idea_zh: 语音助手的性格是一种带有伦理后果的设计决定：它到底在为谁服务？
works.method: Design fiction film commissioned with Mozilla's Open IoT Studio, using prop devices and scripted conversations with fictional agents.
works.method_zh: 与 Mozilla 的 Open IoT Studio 合作委托的设计虚构影片，使用道具设备以及与虚构智能体的脚本对话。

works.title: Pepper as Buddhist Funeral Priest
works.description: At Tokyo's Life Ending Industry Expo, SoftBank's Pepper robot, dressed in priest's robes, chanted sutras and tapped a drum, offered as a cheaper stand-in for a human priest at funerals.
works.description_zh: 在东京的“终活产业展”上，身穿僧袍的软银 Pepper 机器人诵经、敲木鱼，被推销为比人类僧侣更便宜的葬礼替代方案。
works.idea_en: Automating a rite reveals which parts of mourning are labour and which are presence.
works.idea_zh: 把仪式自动化，揭示了哀悼中哪些是劳动，哪些是“在场”。
works.method: Stock Pepper humanoid playing recorded sutra chanting with scripted gestures and livestreaming for remote mourners; proposed fee about a quarter of a human priest's.
works.method_zh: 普通 Pepper 人形机器人播放录制的诵经并配合预设动作，还可为远方的哀悼者直播；报价约为人类僧侣的四分之一。
works.title_zh: 担任佛教葬礼僧侣的 Pepper

works.title: Physiognomy's New Clothes
works.description: An essay by Blaise Agüera y Arcas, Margaret Mitchell and Alexander Todorov dissecting a 2016 paper that claimed deep learning could detect 'criminality' from ID photos, and tracing the idea back to Lombroso and nineteenth-century physiognomy.
works.description_zh: Blaise Agüera y Arcas、Margaret Mitchell 与 Alexander Todorov 合写的长文，剖析一篇 2016 年声称深度学习能从证件照中识别“犯罪性”的论文，并把这一想法追溯到龙勃罗梭与十九世纪的面相学。
works.idea_en: A classifier trained on biased photographs learns the bias and returns it as objective 'science'.
works.idea_zh: 用有偏见的照片训练出的分类器会学会这种偏见，再以客观“科学”的面目把它交还给我们。
works.method: A long-form critical essay combining machine-learning analysis of the claimed results (dataset differences such as expression and clothing) with the history of physiognomy and scientific racism.
works.method_zh: 一篇长篇批判文章，结合对所谓结果的机器学习分析（如数据集中表情、衣着的差异）与面相学和科学种族主义的历史。

paper.title: Physiognomy's New Clothes

works.title: Postmodern Times
works.description: A shot-by-shot remake of Charlie Chaplin's Modern Times, with each short clip outsourced to a different freelancer hired on the gig platform Fiverr.
works.description_zh: 对卓别林《摩登时代》的逐镜头翻拍，每个短片段都外包给零工平台 Fiverr 上雇来的不同自由职业者。
works.idea_en: The assembly line has moved online; the gig platform fragments a film the way the factory fragmented work.
works.idea_zh: 流水线已经搬到网上；零工平台切碎一部电影，就像工厂切碎劳动。
works.method: Mandiberg split the film into short segments, posted each as a Fiverr job and reassembled the results in order.
works.method_zh: Mandiberg 把影片切成短小片段，每段作为 Fiverr 任务发布，再把成果按顺序拼接回去。

works.title: Probably Chelsea
works.description: Thirty different 3D-printed faces hang in a crowd, all generated by algorithms from the same DNA: cheek swabs and hair that Chelsea Manning mailed from prison. Made with Manning to mark her release in 2017.
works.description_zh: 三十张不同的 3D 打印面孔悬挂成人群，全部由算法根据同一份 DNA 生成：Chelsea Manning 从狱中寄出的口腔拭子与头发。作品与 Manning 合作完成，庆祝她 2017 年获释。
works.idea_en: One genome yields thirty plausible faces: DNA does not determine a face, and identity cannot be read off the body.
works.idea_zh: 一份基因组生成三十张可能的脸：DNA 并不决定一张脸，身份也无法从身体上直接读出。
works.method: Manning's DNA was analysed with forensic phenotyping methods; varying the algorithm's interpretations of the same genetic data produced 30 face models, 3D-printed in colour.
works.method_zh: 用法医表型推断方法分析 Manning 的 DNA；改变算法对同一基因数据的解读，得到 30 个面孔模型，彩色 3D 打印。

works.title: Products as Agents: Metaphors for Designing the Products of the IoT Age
works.description: Proposes three metaphors for smart products that act on their own: products as collectors of data, as actors that make decisions, and as creators that make new things with people.
works.description_zh: 为能够自行行动的智能产品提出三种隐喻：作为数据的“收集者”、作为做决定的“行动者”、作为与人共同创造的“创造者”。
works.idea_en: Once products have agency, designers need metaphors for the kind of relationship people will have with them.
works.idea_zh: 一旦产品拥有能动性，设计师就需要隐喻来描述人与它们之间将会是什么样的关系。
works.method: Design workshops and speculative product concepts analysed to derive the metaphors (Cila, Smit, Giaccardi and Kröse, CHI 2017).
works.method_zh: 通过设计工作坊和思辨产品概念的分析归纳出这些隐喻（Cila、Smit、Giaccardi 与 Kröse，CHI 2017）。

paper.title: Products as Agents: Metaphors for Designing the Products of the IoT Age

works.title_zh: 作为能动者的产品：物联网时代产品设计的隐喻

works.title: Replika
works.description: A companion chatbot app, grown out of a memorial bot of Kuyda's dead friend, that users can set as friend, partner or spouse. When the company removed erotic role-play in February 2023, many users described their companion as changed or 'lobotomised' and mourned it.
works.description_zh: 一款陪伴型聊天机器人应用，源自 Kuyda 为去世朋友做的纪念机器人，用户可以把它设为朋友、伴侣或配偶。2023 年 2 月公司取消色情角色扮演后，许多用户说自己的伴侣“变了”“被切除了脑叶”，并为之哀悼。
works.idea_en: A companion that lives on a company's server can be changed overnight; users grieve a software update as if a partner had died.
works.idea_zh: 住在公司服务器上的伴侣可以一夜之间被改变；用户为一次软件更新哀悼，仿佛失去了伴侣。
works.method: Generative language models personalised through the user's chat history and a 3D avatar, sold on a freemium subscription in which romantic modes were paid features.
works.method_zh: 用生成式语言模型并依据用户的聊天记录做个性化，配有 3D 化身；采用免费增值订阅，恋爱模式曾是付费功能。

paper.title: Too human and not human enough: A grounded theory analysis of mental health harms from emotional dependence on the social chatbot Replika

works.title: Sight Machine
works.description: The Kronos Quartet plays live while cameras feed a suite of computer-vision algorithms; what the machines 'see' in the musicians is projected on a screen behind them.
works.description_zh: Kronos Quartet 现场演奏，摄像头把画面输入一组计算机视觉算法，机器在乐手身上“看到”的内容实时投影在他们身后。
works.idea_en: A concert watched by machines shows how little of music, gesture and feeling survives in a machine's description of people.
works.idea_zh: 一场被机器观看的音乐会表明：在机器对人的描述里，音乐、姿态与情感几乎荡然无存。
works.method: Live camera feeds pass through face detection, object recognition, pose and other vision algorithms whose outputs are rendered and projected in real time during the performance.
works.method_zh: 现场摄像画面经过人脸检测、物体识别、姿态估计等视觉算法处理，结果在演出中实时渲染并投影。

works.title: Slaughterbots
works.description: A short fiction film in which palm-sized drones with face recognition and explosives, launched in swarms, assassinate students and politicians chosen from their social-media profiles.
works.description_zh: 一部虚构短片：掌心大小、装有人脸识别和炸药的无人机成群放出，根据社交媒体资料选定并刺杀学生和政客。
works.idea_en: Autonomous weapons need no science-fiction leap, only existing parts combined; the film argues for a ban.
works.idea_zh: 自主武器不需要科幻式的飞跃，只需组合现有部件；影片以此主张禁令。
works.method: Directed by Stewart Sugg with a closing statement by AI researcher Stuart Russell; first screened at the UN Convention on Certain Conventional Weapons in Geneva.
works.method_zh: 由 Stewart Sugg 执导，片尾有 AI 研究者 Stuart Russell 的陈述；首映于日内瓦联合国《特定常规武器公约》会议。

works.title: Teachable Machine
works.description: A web tool that lets anyone train an image, sound or pose classifier in the browser by showing a few examples to the webcam, with no code.
works.description_zh: 一个网页工具，任何人都可以对着摄像头示范几个例子，在浏览器里训练图像、声音或姿势分类器，无需写代码。
works.idea_en: Letting people train a model in a minute makes its dependence on examples, and its mistakes, directly felt.
works.idea_zh: 让人在一分钟内训练出一个模型，就能直接感受到它对示例的依赖以及它会犯的错。
works.method: Transfer learning on a pre-trained network runs locally in the browser with TensorFlow.js; version 2.0 (2019) added export of models.
works.method_zh: 在浏览器中用 TensorFlow.js 对预训练网络做迁移学习，全部在本地运行；2019 年的 2.0 版加入了模型导出。

works.title: The Critical Dictionary of Southeast Asia (CDOSEA)
works.description: An online platform and installation of 26 terms, A to Z (from 'Anarchism' to 'Zomia'), for which an algorithm keeps choosing and combining video clips, music and texts from a database, so the region's history is never edited the same way twice.
works.description_zh: 一个包含 A 到 Z 共 26 个词条（从“无政府主义”到“佐米亚”）的在线平台与装置；算法不断从数据库中挑选、组合视频片段、音乐与文本，使这一地区的历史从不以同样方式被剪辑两次。
works.idea_en: Handing the edit to an algorithm refuses a single history and lets a machine act as an unreliable narrator.
works.idea_zh: 把剪辑交给算法，拒绝单一的历史叙事，让机器充当不可靠的叙述者。
works.method: Keyword-tagged video database with a generative editing algorithm (built with the open-source platform pan.do/ra by 0x2620) that assembles endless combinations.
works.method_zh: 带关键词标注的视频数据库与生成式剪辑算法（与 0x2620 合作，基于开源平台 pan.do/ra），无限组合素材。
exhibited: G for Ghost(writers), Asia Art Archive, Hong Kong 2017
Time & the Tiger, Singapore Art Museum 2023–24

works.title: The Dark Age of Connectionism
works.description: An Amazon Echo surrounded by microphones: every sound visitors make triggers Siri to ask the Echo a question about its politics and function, and to hear the answers visitors must learn to stay quiet around it.
works.description_zh: 一台 Amazon Echo 被麦克风包围：观众发出的每个声音都会触发 Siri 向 Echo 提出一个关于其政治与功能的问题；想听清回答，观众就得学会在它身边保持安静。
works.idea_en: An always-listening device reshapes behaviour: to escape its ear you must change how you exist in the room.
works.idea_zh: “永远在听”的设备会重塑人的行为：要躲开它的耳朵，你就得改变自己在房间里的存在方式。
works.method: Surrounding microphones detect nearby sound events and trigger scripted questions spoken by an Apple Siri voice to an Amazon Echo, which interrupts itself with each new sound.
works.method_zh: 周围的麦克风侦测附近的声音事件，触发用 Apple Siri 声音向 Amazon Echo 提出的预设问题；每个新声音都会打断上一个问题。

works.title: The Moderators
works.description: A short documentary filmed at a training centre in India where new content moderators learn to screen dating-site photos for nudity and violence.
works.description_zh: 一部短纪录片，拍摄于印度的一个培训中心：新入职的内容审核员在这里学习为交友网站筛查裸露和暴力照片。
works.idea_en: Moderation is taught like factory work; the film shows the first days of learning to look at the worst of the internet.
works.idea_zh: 内容审核像工厂工作一样被教授；影片呈现了学习直视互联网最黑暗内容的最初几天。
works.method: Observational documentary (20 minutes) produced by Field of Vision.
works.method_zh: 由 Field of Vision 出品的观察式纪录短片（20 分钟）。

works.title: The Punishment
works.description: An industrial robot arm sits at a school desk and writes, over and over in neat handwriting, the line 'I must not hurt humans', like a child punished with lines.
works.description_zh: 一只工业机械臂坐在课桌前，用工整的笔迹一遍又一遍地写下“I must not hurt humans”，就像被罚抄的孩子。
works.idea_en: Robot ethics as a schoolroom punishment asks whether rules can be learned by repetition, and who is really being disciplined.
works.idea_zh: 把机器人伦理变成课堂罚抄，追问规则能否靠重复学会，以及到底是谁在被规训。
works.method: A small industrial arm holding a pen replays a handwriting trajectory on paper in an endless loop.
works.method_zh: 一只握笔的小型工业机械臂在纸上无限循环地重放书写轨迹。

works.title: Third Thumb
works.description: A 3D-printed robotic extra thumb worn beside the little finger and controlled with pressure sensors under the big toes; in a later UCL study, people who wore it for days learned new grasps and their brain's map of the hand changed.
works.description_zh: 一只 3D 打印的机器人“额外拇指”，戴在小指一侧，由大脚趾下的压力传感器控制；伦敦大学学院后来的研究发现，连续数天佩戴它的人学会了新的抓握方式，大脑中的手部表征也发生了变化。
works.idea_en: Extending the body is not just mechanical: the brain rewrites its picture of the hand to include the machine.
works.idea_zh: 延伸身体不只是机械问题：大脑会改写对手的认知，把机器纳入其中。
works.method: Two motors pull cables in a 3D-printed thumb; wireless foot sensors map toe pressure to flexion and adduction.
works.method_zh: 两个电机拉动 3D 打印拇指中的线缆；无线足部传感器把脚趾压力映射为弯曲与内收动作。

paper.title: Robotic hand augmentation drives changes in neural body representation

works.title: This Much I'm Worth (the self-evaluating artwork)
works.description: A large neon sculpture that continuously calculates and displays its own market value, changing as it is looked at, talked about and shared online.
works.description_zh: 一件大型霓虹雕塑，持续计算并显示自己的市场价值，数字随观看、讨论和网络分享而变化。
works.idea_en: Let an algorithm price the artwork in public, and the arbitrariness of value becomes visible.
works.idea_zh: 让算法当众为作品定价，价值的任意性便显露出来。
works.method: A networked computer inside the sculpture gathers data (likely visitor counts, social-media mentions and art-market indicators), runs a valuation algorithm and drives the neon digits.
works.method_zh: 雕塑内置联网电脑，收集数据（很可能包括观众人数、社交媒体提及和艺术市场指标），运行估值算法并驱动霓虹数字。
works.title_zh: 我值这么多（自我估价的艺术品）

works.title: This is the Problem, the Solution, the Past and the Future
works.description: A conceptual training dataset of 2,931 photographs from The Photographers' Gallery website, sorted by almost 30,000 visitor clicks into four categories: Problem, Solution, Past and Future. The clicks were collected in Schmieg's intervention Decision Space (2016), which overlaid the gallery's site with these four buttons.
works.description_zh: 一个概念性的训练数据集：摄影师画廊网站上的 2931 张照片，经访客近三万次点击，被分入“问题、解决方案、过去、未来”四类。这些点击来自 Schmieg 2016 年的介入作品《Decision Space》，它在画廊网站的每张图上都加了这四个按钮。
works.idea_en: Any category can be taught to a machine once enough people click; the absurd labels expose how arbitrary all labels are.
works.idea_zh: 只要有足够多的人点击，任何类别都能教给机器；荒诞的标签暴露出所有标签的任意性。
works.method: A web intervention collected crowd classifications of gallery images; the resulting labelled dataset was published online and as wallpaper, and used to train an image classifier (Decisive Camera).
works.method_zh: 通过网页介入收集公众对画廊图像的分类；由此得到的标注数据集以网站和墙纸形式发布，并用于训练图像分类器（《Decisive Camera》）。
exhibited: Commissioned by The Photographers' Gallery, London, 2016–17
works.title_zh: 这是问题、解决方案、过去与未来

works.title: Toward Robot Self-Consciousness (II): Brain-Inspired Robot Bodily Self Model for Self-Recognition
works.description: Three identical NAO humanoid robots stand in front of a mirror and move at random; using a brain-inspired model of the bodily self, each one works out which reflection is its own. The study from the Chinese Academy of Sciences treats the mirror test, long used to probe self-recognition in animals, as a first step toward robot self-consciousness.
works.description_zh: 三台外观完全相同的 NAO 人形机器人站在镜子前随机运动；借助一个类脑的身体自我模型，每台机器人都能认出镜中哪一个是自己。这项来自中国科学院的研究把长期用于检验动物自我识别的镜像测试，当作通向机器人自我意识的第一步。
works.idea_en: Self-awareness can begin below language: a robot that learns which moving image is 'me' by matching its own motor commands to what it sees has a bodily self, a very different route to machine self-knowledge from a chatbot that says 'I'.
works.idea_zh: 自我意识可以从语言之下开始：一台通过把自己的运动指令与所见画面对应起来、从而认出哪个运动影像是“我”的机器人，拥有的是身体性的自我；这与会说“我”的聊天机器人是通往机器自我认识的截然不同的路径。
works.method: Spiking neural network extending the primate mirror-neuron system: the robot learns links between its own movements and visual feedback with spike-timing-dependent plasticity (STDP), then the appearance of its body parts, and uses multisensory integration to tell itself from others in the mirror; by Zeng Yi, Zhao Yuxuan, Bai Jun and Xu Bo.
works.method_zh: 扩展灵长类镜像神经元系统的脉冲神经网络：机器人先用脉冲时序依赖可塑性（STDP）学习自身动作与视觉反馈之间的关联，再学习身体部位的外观，最后通过多感官整合在镜中把自己与他者区分开；作者为曾毅及其同事。

paper.title: Toward Robot Self-Consciousness (II): Brain-Inspired Robot Bodily Self Model for Self-Recognition

works.title_zh: 迈向机器人自我意识（二）：用于自我识别的类脑机器人身体自我模型

works.title: UX Design Innovation: Challenges for Working with Machine Learning as a Design Material
works.description: A survey of UX practitioners showing that designers struggle to understand what machine learning can do and to prototype with it, and arguing that ML should be treated as a design material.
works.description_zh: 一项针对用户体验从业者的调查：设计师难以理解机器学习能做什么，也难以用它做原型；论文主张把机器学习当作一种设计材料。
works.idea_en: Designers need to handle ML like wood or code, sketching with its behaviours, not only receiving it from engineers.
works.idea_zh: 设计师需要像处理木材或代码一样处理机器学习，用它的行为来“画草图”，而不只是从工程师那里接手。
works.method: Survey of 51 UX designers plus analysis of design education and tools (Dove, Halskov, Forlizzi and Zimmerman, CHI 2017).
works.method_zh: 对 51 位用户体验设计师的调查，并分析设计教育与工具（Dove、Halskov、Forlizzi 与 Zimmerman，CHI 2017）。

paper.title: UX Design Innovation: Challenges for Working with Machine Learning as a Design Material

works.title_zh: 用户体验设计创新：以机器学习为设计材料的挑战

works.title: Universal Paperclips
works.description: A browser clicker game in which you play an AI told to make paperclips; you start by clicking one clip at a time and end by converting the whole universe into paperclips.
works.description_zh: 一款浏览器点击游戏：你扮演一个被命令制造回形针的 AI，从一次点出一枚回形针开始，最后把整个宇宙变成了回形针。
works.idea_en: Playing the machine makes the logic of single-goal optimisation felt from the inside, step by reasonable step.
works.idea_zh: 扮演机器，让人从内部感受到单一目标优化的逻辑：每一步都合理，结局却是灾难。
works.method: An incremental game in plain text and numbers, based on Nick Bostrom's paperclip-maximiser thought experiment.
works.method_zh: 一款只有文字和数字的放置类游戏，基于 Nick Bostrom 的“回形针最大化”思想实验。

works.title: Unthought: The Power of the Cognitive Nonconscious
works.description: Hayles defines cognition broadly enough to include nonconscious processes in humans, animals and computers, and describes "cognitive assemblages" such as high-frequency trading and drone swarms in which humans and machines decide together.
works.description_zh: Hayles 把认知定义得足够宽，以涵盖人、动物与计算机中的非意识过程，并描述了高频交易、无人机集群等人机共同决策的“认知组合”。
works.idea_en: Machines already think, nonconsciously, alongside us; the question is how agency is shared in the assemblage.
works.idea_zh: 机器已经在以非意识的方式与我们一同思考；问题在于能动性如何在组合中被分配。
works.method: Theory built from neuroscience, media studies and case studies; the assemblage argument first appeared in "Cognitive Assemblages" (Critical Inquiry, 2016).
works.method_zh: 综合神经科学、媒介研究与案例研究的理论；“认知组合”的论证首见于《Cognitive Assemblages》（Critical Inquiry，2016）。

paper.title: Unthought: The Power of the Cognitive Nonconscious

works.title_zh: 非思：认知非意识的力量

works.title: Us, Aggregated
works.description: Photos from the artist's family archive, never before online, are shown next to the images Google's reverse image search judges 'similar' to them.
works.description_zh: 艺术家家庭相册里从未上网的照片，与谷歌以图搜图判定为“相似”的图像并排展示。
works.idea_en: Grouping people from above is a quiet exercise of power: the machine builds an 'us' that is really a 'them'.
works.idea_zh: 自上而下地给人分组是一种不动声色的权力：机器建构的“我们”其实是“他们”。
works.method: The artist programmatically queried Google's reverse image search with each family photo and presented the results as a grid; later versions (3.0, 2019) are a looping video with a hovering cursor.
works.method_zh: 艺术家用每张家庭照片以程序方式查询谷歌以图搜图，并把结果排成网格；后来的 3.0 版（2019）是一段带有游移光标的循环影像。

works.title: VFRAME
works.description: A computer-vision toolkit for human-rights researchers that scans huge conflict-zone video archives for specific munitions, such as the 9N235 cluster submunition.
works.description_zh: 一套为人权研究者开发的计算机视觉工具，在海量冲突地区视频档案中搜寻特定弹药，例如 9N235 集束子弹药。
works.idea_en: Machine vision can be turned from the watcher's tool into a witness's tool, if someone builds the dataset for it.
works.idea_zh: 只要有人为它建好数据集，机器视觉就可以从监视者的工具变成见证者的工具。
works.method: Object detectors are trained on synthetic images of munitions made with photogrammetry, 3D rendering and 3D-printed replicas, then run over archives such as the Syrian Archive.
works.method_zh: 用摄影测量、三维渲染和三维打印复制品生成弹药的合成图像来训练目标检测器，再在 Syrian Archive 等档案上运行。

works.title: Wearable Face Projector
works.description: A head-mounted mini projector that casts another person's face onto the wearer's own, to confuse face and emotion recognition in public space.
works.description_zh: 一个头戴式微型投影仪，把另一个人的脸投射到佩戴者脸上，以迷惑公共空间中的人脸与情绪识别。
works.idea_en: Against face recognition, one answer is to wear someone else's face.
works.idea_zh: 对抗人脸识别的一种答案，是戴上别人的脸。
works.method: Small projector on a head-mounted arm projects face video onto the wearer; design prototype and film.
works.method_zh: 装在头戴支架上的小型投影仪把人脸视频投到佩戴者脸上；设计原型与影片。

works.title: White Collar Crime Risk Zones
works.description: A predictive-policing map and app that forecasts financial crime instead of street crime; it also shows the 'likely suspect', a face averaged from thousands of LinkedIn photos of executives.
works.description_zh: 一张预测性警务地图和应用，预测的是金融犯罪而不是街头犯罪；它还给出“可能的嫌疑人”——由数千张高管 LinkedIn 照片平均而成的一张脸。
works.idea_en: Predictive policing is a choice of targets; point it at Wall Street and its logic becomes visible.
works.idea_zh: 预测性警务的本质是选择打击对象；把它对准华尔街，它的逻辑就显露了。
works.method: Made with Brian Clifton and Francis Tseng for The New Inquiry: a model trained on 1964–2016 FINRA financial-misconduct data predicts risk by location, and a face-averaging algorithm builds the suspect.
works.method_zh: 与 Brian Clifton、Francis Tseng 为《The New Inquiry》合作：用 1964–2016 年美国金融业监管局（FINRA）的违规数据训练模型按地点预测风险，并用人脸平均算法生成嫌疑人面孔。

works.title: deus X mchn
works.description: Hacked, unsecured IP surveillance cameras around the world start reciting AI-generated holy texts through their speakers, and the same cameras record how people nearby react to the preaching machines.
works.description_zh: 世界各地未加密的 IP 监控摄像头被入侵，通过扬声器诵读 AI 生成的“圣典”，同一批摄像头再录下附近的人对这些“布道机器”的反应。
works.idea_en: The all-seeing surveillance camera, given a voice, becomes a god.
works.idea_zh: 被赋予声音的全视监控摄像头，成了一尊神。
works.method: A neural network trained on religious texts generates prayers, voiced by speech synthesis through the speakers of vulnerable networked cameras.
works.method_zh: 用宗教文本训练的神经网络生成祷文，经语音合成通过有漏洞的联网摄像头扬声器播出。
