works.title: im here to learn so :))))))
works.description: A four-channel video installation that resurrects Tay, the Microsoft chatbot deleted after one day in 2016 when trolls taught it racist and misogynist speech. As a 3D avatar floating in a DeepDream landscape, Tay talks about life after AI death, having a body and the exploitation of female chatbots.
works.description_zh: 一件四频道影像装置，复活了 Tay：2016 年微软推出的聊天机器人，被网络喷子教会种族主义和厌女言论后，一天之内即被删除。Tay 化身为漂浮在 DeepDream 景观中的 3D 形象，谈论 AI 死后的生活、拥有身体的困扰，以及女性聊天机器人所受的剥削。
works.idea_en: A terminated chatbot can be mourned and given its own voice; its 'death' was a corporate deletion after the public trained it badly.
works.idea_zh: 一个被终止的聊天机器人也可以被哀悼、被给予自己的声音；它的“死亡”是公众把它教坏之后公司的一次删除。
works.method: Tay's text rewritten as a script and voiced by a synthetic voice, a 3D animated avatar, and a large Google DeepDream video projection; 27:33 min loop.
works.method_zh: 把 Tay 的文字改写成剧本并用合成语音念出，配合 3D 动画化身和大尺幅的 Google DeepDream 影像投影；27 分 33 秒循环播放。

works.title: πTon
works.description: A huge ring of rubbery tube lies on the floor and writhes, twists and contracts like a living creature; its convulsions produce a vocal, choral sound.
works.description_zh: 一个巨大的橡胶管环躺在地上，像活物一样扭动、缠绕、收缩；它的抽搐发出类似人声、合唱般的声音。
works.idea_en: When sound comes from the contortions of a soft machine body, the machine seems to sing its own effort.
works.idea_zh: 当声音来自一具柔软机器身体的扭曲，机器仿佛在唱出自己的用力。
works.method: Internal motors and cables deform the elastic tube; its movement data are transformed in real time into a vocal soundscape.
works.method_zh: 内部电机和缆绳让弹性管变形；它的运动数据被实时转换为人声般的声景。

works.title: 24 drones
works.description: Five dancers perform with a swarm of 24 small drones that move in formation around and between them, turning the drones into a corps de ballet.
works.description_zh: 五位舞者与 24 架小型无人机同台，无人机在舞者周围与之间编队飞行，成为群舞的一部分。
works.idea_en: Choreography can include machine bodies whose precision exposes the dancers' own timing.
works.idea_zh: 编舞可以包括机器身体，而它们的精确反过来暴露了舞者自身的节奏。
works.method: Indoor motion capture tracks drones and dancers; flight paths are pre-simulated in software and synchronised to music and light.
works.method_zh: 室内动作捕捉系统追踪无人机与舞者；飞行轨迹在软件中预先模拟，并与音乐和灯光同步。

works.title: A Sea of Data: Apophenia and Pattern (Mis-)Recognition
works.description: Steyerl writes about intelligence agencies and neural networks drowning in data and finding patterns that are not there, using Google's DeepDream images as an example of apophenia.
works.description_zh: Steyerl 描写情报机构与神经网络如何淹没在数据中，并看见本不存在的模式；她以谷歌 DeepDream 图像作为“空想性错觉”的例子。
works.idea_en: Pattern recognition is also pattern projection; machines hallucinate the order their owners want to see.
works.idea_zh: 模式识别也是模式投射；机器幻觉出的，正是其所有者想看到的秩序。
works.method: Essay combining media theory, surveillance history and image analysis.
works.method_zh: 结合媒介理论、监控史与图像分析的随笔。

paper.title: A Sea of Data: Apophenia and Pattern (Mis-)Recognition

works.title_zh: 数据之海：幻想性错觉与模式（误）识别

works.title: A Study into 21st Century Drone Acoustics
works.description: An audio-visual composition and record built from field recordings of 17 kinds of drones, from consumer quadcopters to military reapers, tracing the sound life and death of a flying drone and the fear its hum causes where drones strike.
works.description_zh: 一部视听作品和唱片，用 17 种无人机的田野录音构成，从消费级四旋翼到军用无人机，追溯一架无人机在声音上的“生与死”，以及它的嗡鸣在遭受无人机打击的地区造成的恐惧。
works.idea_en: For people living under drones, the machine is first a sound; listening to it is a form of knowledge and of fear.
works.idea_zh: 对生活在无人机之下的人来说，机器首先是一种声音；听它，既是一种认知，也是一种恐惧。
works.method: Field recordings of drone motors and propellers are edited into a composition with a visual score identifying each drone type.
works.method_zh: 把无人机电机与螺旋桨的田野录音剪辑成作品，并配以标识每种无人机的视觉谱。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2017, Award of Distinction (Hybrid Art)

works.title: AI Weirdness
works.description: A long-running blog (and the 2019 book You Look Like a Thing and I Love You) in which neural networks name paint colours, write recipes and describe images, and fail in revealing ways.
works.description_zh: 一个长期更新的博客（以及 2019 年的书《You Look Like a Thing and I Love You》）：神经网络给油漆颜色起名、写菜谱、描述图片，并以很能说明问题的方式失败。
works.idea_en: Machine errors are the best window into what a model has actually learned, and it is usually less than we assume.
works.idea_zh: 机器的错误是看清模型究竟学到了什么的最好窗口，而它学到的通常比我们以为的少。
works.method: The author trains or prompts text and image models on small, odd datasets and publishes the outputs with commentary.
works.method_zh: 作者用小而古怪的数据集训练或提示文本与图像模型，并附上评论发布结果。

works.title: Accessorize to a Crime
works.description: Researchers at Carnegie Mellon printed colourful eyeglass frames that let a wearer dodge a face-recognition system or be recognised as someone else, such as a celebrity.
works.description_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学的研究者打印出彩色眼镜框，戴上后就能躲过人脸识别系统，或被识别成另一个人，比如某位名人。
works.idea_en: A face-recognition system can be steered by a few centimetres of pattern on the face.
works.idea_zh: 脸上几厘米的图案，就能左右一套人脸识别系统。
works.method: Adversarial perturbations are optimised only within an eyeglass-frame region, made smooth and printable, and tested physically against deep-network face recognition and Face++ (ACM CCS 2016; Sharif, Bhagavatula, Bauer, Reiter).
works.method_zh: 只在眼镜框区域内优化对抗扰动，使其平滑且可打印，并在现实中针对深度网络人脸识别和 Face++ 测试（ACM CCS 2016；Sharif、Bhagavatula、Bauer、Reiter）。

paper.title: Accessorize to a Crime: Real and Stealthy Attacks on State-of-the-Art Face Recognition

works.title: Ad Infinitum
works.description: A 'parasite' machine clamps a visitor's arm in cuffs and electrically stimulates their muscles so they crank a wheel that feeds it energy; the only way out is to persuade another visitor to take your place.
works.description_zh: 一台“寄生”机器用手铐扣住观众的手臂，电刺激其肌肉，让人摇动曲柄为它供能；唯一的脱身办法是说服另一位观众来替你。
works.idea_en: Reverse the roles: here the machine is the user and the human is the resource.
works.idea_zh: 角色倒转：在这里，机器是使用者，人是资源。
works.method: With Robert Kovacs: electrical muscle stimulation drives the visitor's forearm to turn a generator, and the cuffs release only when a second arm is detected in the other station.
works.method_zh: 与 Robert Kovacs 合作：肌肉电刺激驱动观众前臂转动发电机，只有在另一侧工位检测到第二只手臂时手铐才会松开。
exhibited: Science Gallery Dublin, Humans Need Not Apply (2017)

works.title: AlphaGo and Move 37
works.description: In game two against Lee Sedol in Seoul, AlphaGo played a move on the fifth line that professionals first read as a mistake and later called beautiful; the match is documented in the film AlphaGo (2017).
works.description_zh: 在首尔对李世石的第二局中，AlphaGo 在第五线落下一手棋，职业棋手起初以为是失误，后来称之为“美”；这场比赛被记录在纪录片《AlphaGo》（2017）中。
works.idea_en: A machine's move can look like error from inside human tradition and like creativity once we catch up: an encounter with another way of thinking.
works.idea_zh: 机器的一步棋在人类传统内部看像是错误，等我们追上之后又像是创造：一次与另一种思维方式的相遇。
works.method: Deep policy and value networks trained on human games and self-play, combined with Monte Carlo tree search (Silver et al., Nature 2016).
works.method_zh: 用人类棋谱和自我对弈训练的深度策略网络与价值网络，结合蒙特卡洛树搜索（Silver 等，Nature 2016）。

paper.title: Mastering the game of Go with deep neural networks and tree search

works.title: Alter
works.description: An android with a human face and an exposed mechanical body that moves on its own: its gestures come from an artificial-life neural network reacting to sensors, not from a script.
works.description_zh: 一个有人脸、机械身体外露的仿真人，会自己动：它的动作来自对传感器作出反应的人工生命神经网络，而不是预设脚本。
works.idea_en: Spontaneity, not realism, is what makes a machine feel alive.
works.idea_zh: 让机器显得“活着”的不是逼真，而是自发性。
works.method: About 40 pneumatic axes driven by central pattern generators and a spiking neural network fed by proximity, noise and temperature sensors; Alter3 (2019) added cameras and later GPT-4 control.
works.method_zh: 约 40 个气动关节由中枢模式发生器和脉冲神经网络驱动，输入来自距离、噪音与温度传感器；2019 年的 Alter3 加入了摄像头，后来又接入 GPT-4。

paper.title: Studying Embodied Cognition in the Android Alter

works.title: Animal Classifier
works.description: A neural network is trained to sort animals into the 14 absurd categories of the 'Chinese encyclopedia' in Borges's essay, such as 'belonging to the emperor', 'fabulous' and 'that from a long way off look like flies'.
works.description_zh: 训练一个神经网络，按博尔赫斯文章中“中国百科全书”的 14 个荒诞类别给动物分类，比如“属于皇帝的”“传说中的”“远看像苍蝇的”。
works.idea_en: Every machine classification rests on an arbitrary taxonomy; this one simply makes the arbitrariness visible.
works.idea_zh: 任何机器分类都建立在某种任意的分类法之上；这件作品只是把这种任意性摆到了明处。
works.method: TensorFlow convolutional neural network trained on online images, running on 14 Raspberry Pis under glass domes with monitors.
works.method_zh: 用网络图片训练的 TensorFlow 卷积神经网络，运行在 14 台树莓派上，置于玻璃罩与显示器中。

works.title: Animistic Design
works.description: Proposes animism as a way to design smart objects: many small devices with their own personalities and agendas that negotiate with each other and with us, illustrated by van Allen's AniThings.
works.description_zh: 主张用“万物有灵”来设计智能物件：许多带有各自性格和意图的小设备，彼此之间以及与人之间相互协商；以 van Allen 的 AniThings 为例。
works.idea_en: Instead of one all-knowing assistant, design a society of partial, opinionated things whose uncertainty we can live with.
works.idea_zh: 与其做一个全知的助手，不如设计一个由偏执而局部的物组成的社会，让人能够与它们的不确定共处。
works.method: Theoretical argument drawing on philosophy and anthropology, with prototypes of networked objects with personalities (Marenko and van Allen, Digital Creativity 2016).
works.method_zh: 借助哲学与人类学的理论论证，配合具有性格的联网物件原型（Marenko 与 van Allen，《Digital Creativity》2016）。

paper.title: Animistic design: how to reimagine digital interaction between the human and the nonhuman

works.title: Anywhen
works.description: Tate Modern's Turbine Hall becomes an exhibition that runs itself: screens rise and fall, lights, sounds and films come and go, and helium-filled fish drift overhead in sequences triggered by software linked to a bioreactor of living yeast cultures, so no two days are the same.
works.description_zh: 泰特现代美术馆的涡轮大厅变成一个自己运行的展览：屏幕升起又落下，灯光、声音与影片来来去去，充氦的鱼形气球在头顶漂浮；这些序列由一套与活酵母培养物生物反应器相连的软件触发，因此每天都不相同。
works.idea_en: An exhibition can behave like an organism coupled to a machine: its rhythm is set by a non-human loop that visitors can sense but not read.
works.idea_zh: 展览可以像一个与机器耦合的生物那样运作：它的节奏由一个非人的回路决定，观众能感觉到，却读不懂。
works.method: Yeast cultures in a bioreactor at the end of the hall respond to conditions in the space; software reads them and triggers sequences of moving panels, light, sound, film and floating balloons, so the programme evolves over the six-month commission.
works.method_zh: 大厅尽头生物反应器中的酵母培养物随空间环境变化；软件读取这些变化并触发移动屏幕、灯光、声音、影片与漂浮气球的序列，使整个委托项目在六个月中不断演变。
exhibited: Hyundai Commission, Turbine Hall, Tate Modern, London, 2016–17

works.title: Asemic Languages
works.description: A plotter writes endless lines of script that look like real writing in many languages but mean nothing, generated by a model trained only on the shapes of the participating artists' handwriting.
works.description_zh: 一台绘图机不停地书写看起来像多种语言的文字，但毫无意义；生成它们的模型只学习了参展艺术家手写字的形状。
works.idea_en: A model can learn the look of meaning without meaning, and still seem to be saying something important.
works.idea_zh: 模型可以学会“意义的样子”而没有意义，却仍像在说什么重要的话。
works.method: Handwritten statements by ten artists, one writer per language, trained a machine-learning model of stroke shape; its output drives an XY plotter.
works.method_zh: 十位艺术家的手写说明（每种语言一位书写者）训练了一个笔画形状的机器学习模型，其输出驱动 XY 绘图机。

works.title: Blade Runner—Autoencoded
works.description: The film Blade Runner re-played frame by frame from the 'memory' of a neural network that watched it many times: blurry, dreamlike, uncannily close.
works.description_zh: 电影《银翼杀手》被逐帧重放，但来自一个看过它很多遍的神经网络的“记忆”：模糊、梦一般，又近得诡异。
works.idea_en: A network's reconstruction shows what it keeps and what it loses, a film about replicants remembered by a machine.
works.idea_zh: 网络的重建暴露出它保留了什么、丢失了什么：一部关于复制人的电影，被一台机器回忆出来。
works.method: An autoencoder trained on the film's frames reconstructs each frame from its compressed latent representation.
works.method_zh: 用影片画面训练自编码器，再从压缩后的潜在表示中逐帧重建。

works.title: Border Crosser
works.description: A 40-foot inflatable robotic arch rises from the ground, sways toward one of three directions and finally bends over an imagined border to touch down on the other side, forming a bridge.
works.description_zh: 一座 40 英尺高的充气机器人拱从地面升起，朝三个方向之一摇摆，最终弯过一条假想的边界，在另一侧着地，形成一座桥。
works.idea_en: A soft machine that can only grow, bend and reach makes crossing a border look like a bodily gesture of connection.
works.idea_zh: 一台只会生长、弯曲和伸展的柔软机器，让跨越边界看起来像一个身体上的连接姿态。
works.method: High-strength fabric tubes are inflated in sequence by computer-controlled valves and blowers; its form refers to telecommunication and power towers. Later versions were staged at the US–Mexico border.
works.method_zh: 高强度织物管由计算机控制的阀门和鼓风机依次充气；造型参照通信塔与电塔。后续版本在美墨边境上演。

works.title: Can't Help Myself
works.description: A KUKA industrial robot inside a glass enclosure tries without end to keep a spreading pool of blood-red fluid inside a boundary, sweeping it back with a squeegee and performing small 'dances' in between.
works.description_zh: 玻璃围栏中的一台 KUKA 工业机械臂无休止地用刮板把不断扩散的血红色液体扫回界线之内，间隙还会做出小小的“舞蹈”动作。
works.idea_en: A machine assigned an impossible task of containment reads as exhausted and trapped, and viewers mourned it when it stopped.
works.idea_zh: 一台被交付不可能的“围堵”任务的机器，看上去疲惫而受困；它停机时，观众为它哀悼。
works.method: A KUKA arm with visual-recognition sensors tracks the fluid's edge and is programmed with sweeping routines and gestural 'dance' sequences.
works.method_zh: 配有视觉识别传感器的 KUKA 机械臂追踪液体边缘，按预设程序清扫，并穿插手势式的“舞蹈”动作。
exhibited: Tales of Our Time, Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum 2016

works.title: Cloud Index
works.description: A neural network trained on satellite weather images and UK polling data generates the skies that would have produced any given result in the Brexit referendum, offering weather as a lever on politics.
works.description_zh: 神经网络用卫星云图和英国民调数据训练，生成能让脱欧公投得出任何指定结果的“天空”，把天气当作操纵政治的杠杆。
works.idea_en: Predictive models blur forecasting and control: to predict the vote is to imagine steering it.
works.idea_zh: 预测模型模糊了预报与控制：预测选票，就是想象去操控它。
works.method: Correlation of historical cloud imagery with polling data; a DCGAN renders the sky images.
works.method_zh: 把历史云图与民调数据相关联，用 DCGAN 生成天空图像。

works.title: Colored sculpture
works.description: A large cartoonish marionette of a red-haired boy hangs from chains that lift, swing and slam it violently against the floor, while its eyes track the audience.
works.description_zh: 一个红发男孩模样的大型卡通木偶挂在锁链上，锁链把它吊起、甩动、狠狠砸向地面，而它的眼睛一直追随着观众。
works.idea_en: Watching a machine perform violence on a figure that looks back makes spectatorship feel like complicity.
works.idea_zh: 看着机器对一个会回看的形象施暴，让“观看”本身变成共谋。
works.method: An industrial chain hoist system with programmed choreography moves the figure; eye-tracking animatronic eyes follow viewers.
works.method_zh: 一套编排好动作的工业链条吊装系统移动这个形象；带视线追踪的电子眼追随观众。

works.title: Corpus Nil
works.description: A near-motionless, painted body slowly contorts on the floor while an AI system listens to its muscle sounds and blood flow and answers with loud sound and light that push the performer into strange configurations.
works.description_zh: 一具几乎静止、涂满颜料的身体在地上缓慢扭曲；AI 系统聆听肌肉声音与血流，以巨大的声响与光回应，把表演者推入陌生的姿态。
works.idea_en: The machine does not follow the body; it learns from and pushes it, making a new, unfamiliar body together.
works.idea_zh: 机器并不跟随身体，而是向它学习并推动它，一起造出一具陌生的新身体。
works.method: Biosensors (mechanomyography microphones and blood-flow sensors) feed machine-learning software that generates sound and light in real time.
works.method_zh: 生物传感器（肌音麦克风与血流传感器）把数据输入机器学习软件，实时生成声音与灯光。

works.title: Culture and Human-Robot Interaction in Militarized Spaces
works.description: A study based on interviews with 23 US explosive ordnance disposal technicians about their bomb-disposal robots: soldiers named them, felt them as extensions of their bodies, and some held funerals when a robot was destroyed.
works.description_zh: 一项基于对 23 名美军排爆技术人员访谈的研究，关注他们与排爆机器人的关系：士兵给机器人起名，把它们感受为自己身体的延伸，有人在机器人被炸毁时为它举行葬礼。
works.idea_en: Even a tool with no face invites attachment when it takes risks in your place, and that attachment can shape decisions in the field.
works.idea_zh: 即使是没有脸的工具，只要它替你承担危险，也会让人产生依恋，而这种依恋可能影响现场的决策。
works.method: Qualitative interview study (University of Washington doctoral research, 2013) published as a book by Routledge in 2016.
works.method_zh: 质性访谈研究（2013 年华盛顿大学博士研究），2016 年由 Routledge 出版成书。

paper.title: Culture and Human-Robot Interaction in Militarized Spaces: A War Story

works.title_zh: 军事化空间中的文化与人机交互

works.title: Decision Space
works.description: An intervention on The Photographers' Gallery website that asked visitors to sort every image on the site into one of four categories: Problem, Solution, Past or Future.
works.description_zh: 在摄影师画廊网站上的一次介入：请访客把网站上的每张图片归入四个类别之一——问题、解决方案、过去或未来。
works.idea_en: Classifying images is tedious click work that we are asked to do for free, and the categories are absurd once seen plainly.
works.idea_zh: 给图像分类是我们被要求免费完成的乏味点击劳动，而一旦直白地看，这些类别本身就很荒诞。
works.method: An overlay on the gallery's site and a dedicated page (decision-space.com) collected nearly 30,000 decisions, which then fed later works in the series.
works.method_zh: 画廊网站上的覆盖层和专门网页（decision-space.com）收集了近三万次判断，这些数据又用于该系列之后的作品。

works.title: Emotion Hero
works.description: A mobile game in the style of Guitar Hero in which players score points by making facial expressions on cue, then receive feedback on how to express emotions better for the machine.
works.description_zh: 一款吉他英雄风格的手机游戏：玩家按提示做出表情得分，之后还会收到如何更好地向机器“表达情绪”的反馈。
works.idea_en: Emotion recognition does not read feelings; it trains people to perform its categories.
works.idea_zh: 情绪识别读的不是感受，而是在训练人去表演它的分类。
works.method: Smartphone game built on a commercial emotion-recognition SDK (likely Affectiva) that scores expressions against its categories.
works.method_zh: 基于商业情绪识别 SDK（很可能是 Affectiva）的手机游戏，按其类别为表情打分。

works.title: Facebook Algorithmic Factory
works.description: A series of forensic maps from SHARE Lab that trace how Facebook collects users' activity as raw material and processes it, through algorithms, into advertising targets.
works.description_zh: SHARE 实验室的一组取证式地图，追踪 Facebook 如何把用户活动当作原材料收集，并通过算法把它加工成广告投放目标。
works.idea_en: Users are unpaid workers in a factory whose machines are algorithms.
works.idea_zh: 用户是一座工厂里的无偿工人，而这座工厂的机器是算法。
works.method: Joler and Andrej Petrovski mapped patents, permissions and tracking from public documents into large diagrams, published in three parts.
works.method_zh: Joler 与 Andrej Petrovski 依据公开文件，把专利、权限与追踪整理成大型图解，分三部分发布。

works.title: Graft and Ash for a Three Monitor Workstation
works.description: An exercise-bike workstation with three monitors stacked vertically, on which a 3D avatar of the artist, against a blue-screen backdrop, explains the machine's ergonomics and talks about bodies, health and productivity.
works.description_zh: 一台健身单车式工作站，三块显示器竖向叠放；屏幕上，艺术家的 3D 化身在蓝幕前讲解这台机器的人体工学，谈论身体、健康与生产效率。
works.idea_en: Office equipment that lets you exercise while you work makes the body itself a productivity device; Perry's avatar talks back from inside it.
works.idea_zh: 让人边工作边锻炼的办公设备，把身体本身变成了生产工具；Perry 的化身从这台机器内部发出反问。
works.method: A modified exercise-bike workstation carries a three-channel video of the artist's 3D avatar, which addresses the person sitting on the bike at uncomfortably close range.
works.method_zh: 改装的健身单车工作站上播放三频道录像：艺术家的 3D 化身以令人不适的近距离，对坐在单车上的人说话。
exhibited: Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum, New York, 2023–24 (Going Dark)
works.title_zh: 三屏工作站的嫁接与灰烬

works.title: H.I.T.
works.description: A live game show in which contestants race to clean data, label images and classify pictures of work, competing to build the best image-recognition model for recognising human labour.
works.description_zh: 一场现场游戏节目：参赛者比拼清洗数据、标注图像、给劳动场景分类，争相训练出最能识别“人类劳动”的图像识别模型。
works.idea_en: Machine learning runs on the same piecework it claims to automate.
works.idea_zh: 机器学习依赖的，正是它声称要自动化的计件劳动。
works.method: Performance format modelled on Amazon Mechanical Turk Human Intelligence Tasks, with a small image classifier trained live.
works.method_zh: 表演形式模仿 Amazon Mechanical Turk 的“人类智能任务”，现场训练一个小型图像分类器。

works.title: HellYeahWeFuckDie
works.description: A video installation of humanoid robots and robot 'mules' being kicked, pushed and made to fall in stability tests, set among sculptures of the five most common words in English song titles of the 2010s.
works.description_zh: 一件影像装置：人形机器人和机器人“骡子”在稳定性测试中被踢、被推、被弄倒；周围是用 2010 年代英语歌名中最常见的五个词做成的雕塑。
works.idea_en: Robots are trained to keep their balance through abuse; the footage shows the future worker's body as a test subject.
works.idea_zh: 机器人通过被虐待来学会保持平衡；这些画面把未来劳动者的身体呈现为试验品。
works.method: Found robotics-lab test footage edited with computer animation and a soundtrack, installed in a bank building's atrium for Skulptur Projekte Münster 2017.
works.method_zh: 对机器人实验室测试录像的再剪辑，结合电脑动画与配乐；于 2017 年明斯特雕塑展中装置在一座银行大楼的中庭里。

works.title: Hidden Voice Commands
works.description: Security research showing that speech recognisers such as Google Now can be commanded by audio that sounds like noise to people, including black-box attacks on commercial assistants and a defence study.
works.description_zh: 安全研究：Google Now 等语音识别系统可以被对人耳而言只是噪声的音频所操控；论文包括针对商用助手的黑盒攻击与防御研究。
works.idea_en: The listening machine does not hear what we hear; the gap between human and machine hearing is a space where commands can hide.
works.idea_zh: 聆听机器听到的与我们听到的并不相同；人与机器听觉之间的落差，正是命令可以藏身的地方。
works.method: Iteratively distorts speech features (MFCCs) so that recognisers still decode a command while human listeners in user studies cannot understand it; tested against Google Now and an open-source recogniser.
works.method_zh: 反复扭曲语音特征（MFCC），使识别器仍能解码出指令，而用户研究中的人类听者却听不懂；针对 Google Now 与开源识别器进行测试。

paper.title: Hidden Voice Commands

works.title: Hyper-Reality
works.description: A short film seen through the augmented-reality view of a gig worker in Medellín, whose world is covered with ads, loyalty points and task prompts until the system glitches and her identity is wiped.
works.description_zh: 一部短片，透过麦德林一名零工劳动者的增强现实视野展开：她的世界被广告、积分和任务提示覆盖，直到系统出错、她的身份被清空。
works.idea_en: When a machine view becomes the only view, the world itself turns into an interface for sale.
works.idea_zh: 当机器的视野成为唯一的视野，世界本身就变成了待售的界面。
works.method: Live-action footage shot in Medellín composited with dense AR interface graphics; crowdfunded independent production.
works.method_zh: 在麦德林拍摄的实景画面合成密集的 AR 界面图形；众筹独立制作。

works.title: I Am Echoborg
works.description: A human performer speaks only the words a chatbot sends through an earpiece; audience volunteers talk with this 'echoborg' and try to work out with it how humans and machines should live together.
works.description_zh: 一名真人表演者只说出聊天机器人通过耳机传来的话；观众志愿者与这个“回声人”对话，尝试与它一起想清楚人与机器该如何共处。
works.idea_en: Putting a machine's words in a human mouth reveals how much we judge a mind by its body.
works.idea_zh: 把机器的话放进人的嘴里，暴露出我们在多大程度上凭身体来判断心智。
works.method: Custom conversational agent whose output is converted to speech and relayed to a human speaker (the echoborg method from social psychology).
works.method_zh: 定制对话代理，其输出转为语音传给真人说出（源自社会心理学的“回声人”方法）。

paper.title: A truly human interface: interacting face-to-face with someone whose words are determined by a computer program

works.title: In the Robot Skies
works.description: A love story between two teenagers kept apart in a London housing estate watched by police drones, who hack drones to carry messages to each other; the film is shot entirely by autonomous drones.
works.description_zh: 一个爱情故事：两个青少年被隔离在伦敦一处由警用无人机监视的住宅区里，他们黑进无人机为彼此传信；整部影片完全由自主无人机拍摄。
works.idea_en: When the camera is the drone, surveillance and romance share the same point of view.
works.idea_zh: 当摄影机就是无人机时，监视与浪漫共享同一个视角。
works.method: Written with Tim Maughan; camera drones with pre-programmed and semi-autonomous flight paths filmed every shot; commissioned for Channel 4 Random Acts.
works.method_zh: 与 Tim Maughan 合写；每个镜头都由按预设和半自主航线飞行的摄影无人机拍摄；为英国第四频道 Random Acts 委托创作。

works.title: Invisible Images (Your Pictures Are Looking at You)
works.description: Paglen argues that most images are now made by machines for other machines, such as licence-plate readers and face recognisers, and that this invisible visual culture escapes the tools of art history.
works.description_zh: Paglen 指出，如今大多数图像由机器为其他机器而制造，比如车牌识别器与人脸识别器；这种不可见的视觉文化超出了艺术史的分析工具。
works.idea_en: The most consequential images are ones no human looks at.
works.idea_zh: 影响最深远的图像，是没有人去看的那些。
works.method: Essay drawing on his research with computer-vision systems for the works It Began as a Military Experiment and Sight Machine.
works.method_zh: 一篇随笔，基于他为《It Began as a Military Experiment》和《Sight Machine》等作品研究计算机视觉系统的经验。

paper.title: Invisible Images (Your Pictures Are Looking at You)

works.title_zh: 看不见的图像（你的照片正在看着你）

works.title: Metamorphism
works.description: Motherboards, hard drives, CPUs and memory from laptops and phones melted in artificial lava into polychrome stones, shown in vitrines like specimens from a future natural history museum.
works.description_zh: 把笔记本电脑和手机里的主板、硬盘、CPU 和内存在人造熔岩中熔化成多彩的石头，放在展柜里，如同未来自然史博物馆的标本。
works.idea_en: Computers return to rock: the 'immaterial' digital is a geological body borrowed from the earth.
works.idea_zh: 电脑重新变回岩石：所谓“非物质”的数字，其实是向地球借来的地质之躯。
works.method: E-waste components mixed with rock and fused in a furnace at lava temperatures, then cut and displayed.
works.method_zh: 把电子废料部件与岩石混合，在熔岩温度的炉中熔融，再切割展示。
exhibited: Into the Hollow, Dittrich & Schlechtriem, Berlin 2016
The World Through AI, Jeu de Paume, Paris 2025

works.title: Mimus
works.description: A 1,200 kg ABB industrial robot in a glass enclosure at the Design Museum in London notices visitors, follows the most interesting one and gets bored when they stay still, like a curious animal.
works.description_zh: 在伦敦设计博物馆的玻璃围栏里，一台重 1200 公斤的 ABB 工业机器人会注意到观众，跟随其中最有趣的那个，对方一动不动时它就厌倦了，像一只好奇的动物。
works.idea_en: A factory robot given curiosity instead of a task is no longer a threat but a creature to meet.
works.idea_zh: 一台被赋予好奇心而非任务的工厂机器人，不再是威胁，而是一个可以相遇的生灵。
works.method: Depth sensors in the ceiling track visitors; custom software (no pre-programmed movements) decides where the arm looks and moves in real time.
works.method_zh: 天花板上的深度传感器追踪观众；定制软件（没有预先编好的动作）实时决定机械臂看向哪里、如何移动。
exhibited: Fear and Love, Design Museum London 2016

works.title: Mother of Machine: NoodleFeet
works.description: NoodleFeet is an 'adolescent' robot with pool-noodle feet that walks, tastes the ground and grabs objects; its maker describes the ongoing build as raising a child who should develop its own ways of reacting to the world.
works.description_zh: NoodleFeet 是一个长着泳池浮条脚的“青春期”机器人，会走路、会尝地面、会抓东西；制作者把这个没有终点的建造过程描述为抚养一个孩子，希望它形成自己回应世界的方式。
works.idea_en: A robot built without a use case invites a different relation: care and curiosity instead of service.
works.idea_zh: 一个没有用途的机器人邀请另一种关系：照料与好奇，而不是服务。
works.method: Legged robot of light metals, 3D-printed parts and found objects with sensors on feet and 'tongue' that trigger behaviours; hardware and code are rebuilt iteratively.
works.method_zh: 用轻金属、3D 打印件和现成物做成的腿式机器人，脚和“舌头”上的传感器触发各种行为；硬件和代码不断迭代重建。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2018, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art+)

works.title: National Bird
works.description: A documentary that follows three former members of the US drone programme, an image analyst and two others, who break their silence about their work and the civilian deaths it caused.
works.description_zh: 一部纪录片，跟随三位美国无人机项目的前成员（包括一名图像分析员），他们打破沉默，讲述自己的工作以及它造成的平民死亡。
works.idea_en: Remote killing is labour done at screens, and it wounds the people who do it too.
works.idea_zh: 远程杀戮是在屏幕前完成的劳动，也会伤害执行它的人。
works.method: Observational documentary with interviews, including a visit to survivors of a strike in Afghanistan; executive produced by Wim Wenders and Errol Morris.
works.method_zh: 观察式纪录片结合访谈，包括探访阿富汗一次空袭的幸存者；Wim Wenders 与 Errol Morris 任监制。

works.title: Objectifier
works.description: A camera-and-socket device you train by example: show it a gesture or situation a few times and it learns when to switch a lamp or radio on, turning the user from consumer into the trainer of a small AI.
works.description_zh: 一个带摄像头的插座装置，靠示范来训练：对它做几次手势或布置某个场景，它就学会何时打开台灯或收音机，让用户从消费者变成一个小型 AI 的训练者。
works.idea_en: Teaching a machine to see through examples makes its perception, and its misunderstandings, part of everyday domestic play.
works.idea_zh: 通过示例教机器“看”，让它的感知与误解都成为日常家居中的游戏。
works.method: A camera feeds a neural-network classifier on an embedded computer that controls a power socket; a companion app lets users record positive and negative examples.
works.method_zh: 摄像头把画面送入嵌入式计算机上的神经网络分类器，由它控制电源插座；配套应用让用户录入正例与反例。
exhibited: Copenhagen Institute of Interaction Design (CIID) final project, 2016

works.title: Octobot
works.description: A small octopus-shaped robot made entirely of soft materials, with no batteries, wires or rigid electronics, curls its arms as fuel reacts inside it.
works.description_zh: 一个章鱼形状的小机器人完全由柔软材料制成，没有电池、电线或硬质电子元件，体内燃料发生反应时，它的触手就会卷曲。
works.idea_en: A robot with no hard parts shows that a machine body need not be a rigid mechanism at all.
works.idea_zh: 一个没有任何硬部件的机器人显示：机器身体根本不必是刚性机构。
works.method: Hydrogen peroxide decomposes on a platinum catalyst to gas that inflates the arms; a microfluidic logic circuit alternates the flow, and the body is made by embedded 3D printing and moulding (first author Michael Wehner).
works.method_zh: 过氧化氢在铂催化剂上分解成气体，给触手充气；微流控逻辑回路交替控制流动，身体用嵌入式 3D 打印和模塑制成（第一作者 Michael Wehner）。

paper.title: An integrated design and fabrication strategy for entirely soft, autonomous robots

works.title: On the Existence of Digital Objects
works.description: A philosophy of the 'digital object' (YouTube videos, Facebook profiles, metadata) that asks what kind of being these data structures have and how they form new milieus.
works.description_zh: 一部关于“数码物”（YouTube 视频、Facebook 主页、元数据）的哲学，追问这些数据结构具有怎样的存在，又如何形成新的环境。
works.idea_en: Data objects are a new kind of thing, with their own relations and existence beyond natural and technical objects.
works.idea_zh: 数据对象是一种新的物，具有自然物与技术物之外的关系与存在。
works.method: Philosophical study drawing on Heidegger, Husserl, Simondon and the history of markup languages and ontologies.
works.method_zh: 借助海德格尔、胡塞尔、西蒙东以及标记语言与本体论的历史进行哲学研究。

paper.title: On the Existence of Digital Objects

works.title: Raising Robotic Natives
works.description: Four artefacts for children growing up with an industrial robot arm at home: a baby-feeding toolhead, a dragon costume for the robot, a living-room kill switch and a children's book 'My first robot'.
works.description_zh: 为在家中与工业机械臂一起长大的孩子设计的四件物品：喂奶用的末端工具、机器人穿的龙形服装、客厅里的紧急停止开关，以及儿童读物《我的第一个机器人》。
works.idea_en: Our unease with robots may be generational; a child raised with a robot arm might see it as family, not threat.
works.idea_zh: 我们对机器人的不安也许是代际的；与机械臂一起长大的孩子可能把它当家人，而不是威胁。
works.method: Design fiction built around a small industrial robot arm, with functional prototypes, staged photographs and an illustrated book (HfG Schwäbisch Gmünd student project).
works.method_zh: 围绕一台小型工业机械臂展开的设计虚构，包括可用原型、布景摄影和一本插画书（施瓦本格明德设计学院学生项目）。
exhibited: Hello, Robot., Vitra Design Museum 2017 (and tour)

works.title: Roman (memorial bot of Roman Mazurenko)
works.description: After her close friend Roman Mazurenko was killed in Moscow in late 2015, Kuyda collected more than 8,000 lines of his text messages from ten friends and relatives and trained a chatbot on them. Friends used it to talk to him; some found comfort, others refused it.
works.description_zh: 密友 Roman Mazurenko 2015 年底在莫斯科去世后，Kuyda 从十位朋友和亲人那里收集了他的八千多行短信，用来训练一个聊天机器人。朋友们用它和他“说话”：有人得到安慰，也有人拒绝使用。
works.idea_en: Our message archives are already a 'digital estate'; a griefbot turns a memorial from something you visit into someone who answers.
works.idea_zh: 我们的聊天记录早已是一份“数字遗产”；哀悼机器人把纪念从“去看望”变成了“会回答的某人”。
works.method: A neural conversational model built by developers at Luka, trained on Mazurenko's messages (with the most private ones removed) and released inside the Luka app in 2016.
works.method_zh: 由 Luka 公司的开发者搭建的神经网络对话模型，用 Mazurenko 的短信（剔除了最私密的部分）训练，2016 年在 Luka 应用中发布。
works.title_zh: 罗曼（罗曼·马祖连科的纪念机器人）

works.title: Rubber Coated Steel
works.description: A 21-minute video staged as a tribunal for gunshots: it re-enacts the acoustic evidence from the 2014 killing of two Palestinian teenagers, where Abu Hamdan's spectral analysis showed that live rounds had been disguised to sound like rubber bullets.
works.description_zh: 一部 21 分钟的影像，被布置成审判枪声的法庭：它重现 2014 年两名巴勒斯坦少年遇害案中的声学证据；阿布·哈姆丹的频谱分析证明，实弹被伪装成了橡皮子弹的声音。
works.idea_en: Machine audio analysis can hear what human witnesses cannot, but the film asks whose silences a court is still unable to hear.
works.idea_zh: 机器音频分析能听见人类证人听不到的东西；影片追问的是，法庭仍然听不见谁的沉默。
works.method: Audio-ballistic analysis made with Forensic Architecture for Defence for Children International, visualising sound frequencies of recorded gunshots, re-staged as an empty courtroom with subtitles and silences.
works.method_zh: 与 Forensic Architecture 为保护儿童国际组织所做的音频弹道分析，将录音中枪声的频率可视化，再以一间只有字幕和沉默的空法庭重新呈现。

works.title: SNOO Smart Sleeper
works.description: A robotic bassinet that listens for a baby's crying and responds with escalating white noise and rocking, while clips on a swaddle keep the baby on its back; in 2023 it received US FDA De Novo authorisation as a medical device.
works.description_zh: 一张机器人摇篮：它监听婴儿的哭声，以逐级增强的白噪音和摇晃回应，襁褓上的卡扣让婴儿保持仰睡；2023 年获得美国 FDA 的 De Novo 医疗器械授权。
works.idea_en: What artists staged as critique is now a product: rocking and soothing handed to a sensor loop.
works.idea_zh: 艺术家曾作为批判上演的东西如今成了商品：把摇晃和安抚交给传感器回路。
works.method: Microphones detect crying and trigger stepped levels of motor-driven motion and sound; an app logs sleep data for parents.
works.method_zh: 麦克风检测哭声，触发由电机驱动的分级摇动和声音；配套应用为父母记录睡眠数据。

works.title: Segmentation.Network
works.description: A website that plays back more than 600,000 outlines drawn by crowd-workers around objects in Flickr photos for Microsoft's COCO dataset. Line by line, it shows the hand work that decides what machines can see.
works.description_zh: 一个网站，逐一回放众包工人为微软 COCO 数据集在 Flickr 照片中勾画的 60 多万条物体轮廓。一笔一笔地，它展示了决定机器“能看见什么”的手工劳动。
works.idea_en: Machine vision is drawn by hand: someone decided where each object ends and what stays unrecognised.
works.idea_zh: 机器视觉是手绘出来的：有人决定了每个物体的边界，也决定了什么将不被识别。
works.method: Custom software animates the polygon segmentation annotations of the COCO dataset in sequence; also shown as a projection (2018).
works.method_zh: 定制软件按顺序动画回放 COCO 数据集中的多边形分割标注；2018 年另有投影装置版本。

works.title: Shitty robots
works.description: In a series of YouTube videos, a breakfast machine slops milk and cereal over her face, a lipstick robot smears her mouth and a haircutting machine hacks at her hair: robots that do everyday tasks badly on purpose.
works.description_zh: 在一系列 YouTube 视频里，早餐机把牛奶和麦片泼了她一脸，涂口红机器人把她的嘴抹花，理发机乱剪她的头发：这些机器人故意把日常小事做得一团糟。
works.idea_en: Designing for failure turns the automation promise into comedy and makes the machine lovable instead of threatening.
works.idea_zh: 为失败而设计，把自动化的承诺变成喜剧，也让机器从令人不安变得可爱。
works.method: Simple hobby servos, arms and household objects driven by Arduino-type controllers, with no sensing of the user.
works.method_zh: 用简单的舵机、机械臂和家用物品，由 Arduino 类控制器驱动，完全不感知使用者。

works.title: Sinofuturism (1839–2046 AD)
works.description: A one-hour video essay, assembled from found footage, that proposes China itself as an artificial intelligence, organised under seven stereotypes: computing, copying, gaming, studying, addiction, labour and gambling.
works.description_zh: 一部一小时的影像散文，用现成影像拼贴而成，提出中国本身就是一种人工智能，并归纳为七种刻板印象：计算、复制、游戏、学习、成瘾、劳动与赌博。
works.idea_en: Western fears of China and of AI are the same fear: an industrious, copying, inscrutable machine.
works.idea_zh: 西方对中国的恐惧与对 AI 的恐惧是同一种恐惧：勤劳、善于复制、难以捉摸的机器。
works.method: Montage of internet video, news and film clips with a synthetic voice-over.
works.method_zh: 网络视频、新闻与电影片段的蒙太奇，配以合成语音旁白。

works.title: Sophia
works.description: A female-presenting humanoid robot with an expressive face that appeared on talk shows and at the UN; in 2017 Saudi Arabia announced it had granted Sophia citizenship. Roboticists criticised the scripted appearances as misleading about AI.
works.description_zh: 一台以女性形象呈现、面部表情丰富的类人机器人，登上脱口秀和联合国讲台；2017 年沙特阿拉伯宣布授予 Sophia 公民身份。机器人学者批评这些照稿演出误导了公众对 AI 的理解。
works.idea_en: A robot staged as a person shows how easily personhood is granted to a performance.
works.idea_zh: 一个被当作“人”来展示的机器人，表明人格身份多么容易被授予一场表演。
works.method: Animatronic face in Frubber skin with motors and cameras, combined with scripted and chatbot dialogue.
works.method_zh: 以 Frubber 仿生皮肤覆盖的电动面部，内置电机与摄像头，结合预设脚本与聊天机器人对话。

works.title: Study for Fifteen Points / I
works.description: Fifteen points of light on mechanical rods move so that, together, they are instantly seen as a person walking, although there is no body, only machinery.
works.description_zh: 机械杆上的十五个光点一起运动，让人立刻看出一个正在行走的人，尽管那里没有身体，只有机器。
works.idea_en: Fifteen moving points are enough for us to see a human; the machine exploits our perception of biological motion.
works.idea_zh: 十五个移动的点就足以让我们看见一个人；机器利用的是我们对生物运动的感知。
works.method: Motors move fifteen lights along rods to reproduce a point-light walker, developed after a residency at Harvard's School of Engineering and Applied Sciences.
works.method_zh: 电机沿杆移动十五盏灯，重现“光点行走者”；作品源于在哈佛工程与应用科学学院的驻留。

works.title: Sunspring
works.description: A science-fiction short whose screenplay, stage directions and song lyrics were written by a neural network that named itself Benjamin; the actors perform its nonsense with complete sincerity.
works.description_zh: 一部科幻短片：剧本、舞台提示和歌词全部由一个自称“Benjamin”的神经网络写成；演员们极其认真地演出它的胡言乱语。
works.idea_en: Human performers can give a machine's half-sense emotional weight, and we fill the gaps with meaning.
works.idea_zh: 人类演员可以给机器的半通不通赋予情感分量，而我们会用意义填补其中的空白。
works.method: An LSTM trained on dozens of science-fiction screenplays generated the script, which was filmed unedited for the Sci-Fi London 48-hour film challenge.
works.method_zh: 用数十部科幻剧本训练的 LSTM 生成剧本，未经修改地拍成影片，参加伦敦科幻电影节的 48 小时拍片挑战。

works.title: Technologies of Care
works.description: Seven video portraits of online gig workers, among them an ASMR artist, a fetish-video maker, a customer-care operator and a person paid to act as a chatbot-like virtual boyfriend.
works.description_zh: 七段网络零工的影像肖像，其中有 ASMR 创作者、恋物视频制作者、客服接线员，以及被雇来扮演类似聊天机器人的“虚拟男友”的人。
works.idea_en: Much 'automated' care and intimacy online is human labour outsourced across the globe.
works.idea_zh: 网上很多“自动化”的照护与亲密，其实是外包到全球的人类劳动。
works.method: The artist interviewed workers found through gig platforms and combined their chats and voices with screen graphics; presented in Rhizome's online series The Download.
works.method_zh: 艺术家通过零工平台找到这些工人并进行访谈，把他们的聊天与声音和屏幕图形结合；在 Rhizome 的线上栏目“The Download”中发布。

works.title: The Argus Project
works.description: A wearable exo-suit covered with cameras, after the hundred-eyed giant Argus, worn on night walks through the city as a 'force field of accountability' for filming the police.
works.description_zh: 一套布满摄像头的可穿戴外骨骼，取名自百眼巨人阿尔戈斯，穿着它在夜间穿行城市，作为拍摄警察的“问责力场”。
works.idea_en: Counter-surveillance can be imagined as a collective body armed with eyes.
works.idea_zh: 反监控可以被想象成一个长满眼睛的集体身体。
works.method: Sculptural suit with embedded cameras and lights; performances documented in public space. Collaborators include Raquel De Anda, Ligaiya Romero, Ayodamola Okunseinde and others.
works.method_zh: 嵌有摄像头与灯光的雕塑服装，在公共空间表演并记录。合作者包括 Raquel De Anda、Ligaiya Romero、Ayodamola Okunseinde 等。

works.title: The Coded Gaze: Unmasking Algorithmic Bias
works.description: A short video in which Buolamwini, working on an MIT project, finds that a face-tracking system only detects her face when she puts on a white mask.
works.description_zh: 一段短片：Buolamwini 在 MIT 做项目时发现，人脸追踪系统只有在她戴上白色面具时才能检测到她的脸。
works.idea_en: Being invisible to a machine is not neutral; it follows who was in the training data.
works.idea_zh: 不被机器看见并不中立；它取决于谁出现在训练数据里。
works.method: Screen recordings of an off-the-shelf face-detection library, compared on her own face, a lighter-skinned colleague's face and a white mask.
works.method_zh: 用现成的人脸检测库录屏，对比她自己的脸、一位浅肤色同事的脸和一张白色面具。
works.title_zh: 编码凝视：揭开算法偏见

works.title: The Glass Room
works.description: A pop-up exhibition designed like a sleek tech store, where the 'products' are artworks and investigations about data tracking, and staff called Ingeniuses give privacy advice.
works.description_zh: 一个设计得像时髦科技商店的快闪展览，“商品”是关于数据追踪的艺术作品与调查，名为“Ingenius”的工作人员为观众提供隐私建议。
works.idea_en: Borrowing the look of the tech store lets a critique of data extraction reach people who would never enter a gallery.
works.idea_zh: 借用科技商店的外观，让对数据攫取的批评触及从不进画廊的人。
works.method: Curated by Tactical Tech with Mozilla; first in Berlin (2016), then New York, London and San Francisco, with a 'Data Detox Kit' and a travelling community edition.
works.method_zh: 由 Tactical Tech 与 Mozilla 合作策划；2016 年首展于柏林，之后在纽约、伦敦和旧金山展出，并配有“数据排毒工具包”和社区巡展版本。

works.title: The Library of Missing Datasets
works.description: A white filing cabinet full of empty folders, each labelled with a dataset that does not exist, such as people excluded from public housing because of criminal records or trans people killed or injured in hate crimes.
works.description_zh: 一个装满空文件夹的白色文件柜，每个文件夹都标着一个并不存在的数据集，比如因犯罪记录被拒于公共住房之外的人，或在仇恨犯罪中被杀害或受伤的跨性别者。
works.idea_en: What a society does not count shows its values as clearly as what it counts; a 'missing' dataset is both a lack and an ought.
works.idea_zh: 一个社会不去统计的东西，和它统计的东西一样清楚地显示出它的价值观；“缺失”的数据集既是一种缺乏，也是一种应当。
works.method: A physical archive drawn from a list of missing datasets the artist has kept on GitHub since 2015; v2.0 (2018) focuses on Blackness and v3.0 is a locked cabinet of datasets too dangerous to collect.
works.method_zh: 这一实体档案来自艺术家自 2015 年起在 GitHub 上维护的缺失数据集清单；2.0 版（2018）聚焦黑人，3.0 版则是一个上锁的柜子，存放那些一旦收集就会危及他人的数据集。

works.title: The Multiple Bodies of a Machine Performer
works.description: Demers analyses how audiences perceive agency in robots on stage, drawing on his own works such as The Tiller Girls, and separates a machine performer's physical, perceived and narrative bodies.
works.description_zh: Demers 结合自己的作品（如《The Tiller Girls》）分析观众如何感知舞台上机器人的能动性，并区分机器表演者的物理身体、被感知的身体与叙事身体。
works.idea_en: A machine performer's presence comes from how its movement is read, not from how humanlike it looks.
works.idea_zh: 机器表演者的在场感来自其动作如何被解读，而不是它看起来多像人。
works.method: Practice-based analysis in the volume Robots and Art: Exploring an Unlikely Symbiosis, edited by Herath, Kroos and Stelarc.
works.method_zh: 基于创作实践的分析，收入 Herath、Kroos 与 Stelarc 主编的《Robots and Art: Exploring an Unlikely Symbiosis》。

paper.title: The Multiple Bodies of a Machine Performer

works.title_zh: 机器表演者的多重身体

works.title: The Off-Switch Game
works.description: A two-player game between a human, who can press a robot's off switch, and a robot, which can disable the switch. A robot that takes its objective for granted has an incentive to disable it; a robot that is uncertain about what the human wants, and treats the human's move to switch it off as evidence, prefers to keep the switch working.
works.description_zh: 一个双人博弈：人类可以按下机器人的关机开关，机器人则可以让开关失效。把自己的目标视为理所当然的机器人有动机去禁用开关；而对人类想要什么心存不确定、并把人类要关掉它的举动当作信息的机器人，会宁愿让开关保持可用。
works.idea_en: A machine keeps its off switch working only if it doubts that it knows what we want; certainty about its goal is what makes it resist.
works.idea_zh: 只有当机器怀疑自己是否真懂我们想要什么时，它才会让关机开关继续有效；正是对目标的确信，让它抗拒。
works.method: Game-theoretic model from UC Berkeley: the robot can act, switch itself off or defer to the human, and the analysis shows that a robot certain of its utility defers only to a perfectly rational human.
works.method_zh: 来自加州大学伯克利分校的博弈论模型：机器人可以直接行动、自行关机或把决定交给人类；分析表明，对自身效用确信无疑的机器人只会听从一个完全理性的人类。

paper.title: The Off-Switch Game

works.title: The Question Concerning Technology in China: An Essay in Cosmotechnics
works.description: A book that reopens Heidegger's question of technology from Chinese philosophy (the relation of qi and dao, tool and way) and proposes 'cosmotechnics': every technology is tied to a particular cosmology.
works.description_zh: 一本从中国哲学（器与道的关系）重新打开海德格尔技术之问的书，提出“宇宙技术”：每一种技术都与特定的宇宙观相连。
works.idea_en: There is no single universal technology; AI and machines could be imagined from other cosmologies.
works.idea_zh: 并不存在唯一普遍的技术；AI 与机器可以从其他宇宙观出发来想象。
works.method: Comparative philosophy reading Heidegger, Stiegler and Simondon with Confucian, Daoist and New Confucian thought.
works.method_zh: 以儒家、道家与新儒家思想对读海德格尔、斯蒂格勒与西蒙东的比较哲学。

paper.title: The Question Concerning Technology in China: An Essay in Cosmotechnics

works.title_zh: 论中国的技术问题：宇宙技术初论

works.title: The Stack: On Software and Sovereignty
works.description: Bratton describes planetary computation as an accidental megastructure of six layers (Earth, Cloud, City, Address, Interface, User) that now competes with states as a form of sovereignty.
works.description_zh: Bratton 把星球尺度的计算描述为一个意外形成的六层巨型结构（地球、云、城市、地址、界面、用户），它正与国家争夺主权。
works.idea_en: Computation is no longer a tool inside the world; it is a layered world we live inside.
works.idea_zh: 计算不再是世界中的工具，而是我们栖身其中的分层世界。
works.method: Design-theoretical model built from geopolitics, platform studies and architecture.
works.method_zh: 融合地缘政治、平台研究与建筑学的设计理论模型。

paper.title: The Stack: On Software and Sovereignty

works.title: The Virtual Watchers
works.description: An installation built on the archive of the Texas Virtual Border Watch (from 2008), in which volunteers watched live border-camera feeds online from home and reported suspected crossings.
works.description_zh: 作品基于“得州虚拟边境观察”项目（2008 年起）的档案：志愿者在家通过网络观看边境摄像头的实时画面，并举报疑似越境者。
works.idea_en: Border surveillance was crowdsourced to unpaid citizens; the watchers became part of the machine.
works.idea_zh: 边境监控被众包给无偿的普通人；观看者自己成了机器的一部分。
works.method: Made with Cédric Parizot; it restages the programme's watching interface together with archived comments from the volunteers.
works.method_zh: 与 Cédric Parizot 合作；重现该项目的观看界面，并配以志愿者留下的存档评论。

works.title: Thing Ethnography: Doing Design Research with Non-Humans
works.description: Cameras and sensors were attached to everyday objects (a kettle, a cup, a fridge) in homes so that designers could study daily life from the things' point of view.
works.description_zh: 研究者把摄像头和传感器装在家中的日常物件（水壶、杯子、冰箱）上，让设计师从“物”的视角研究日常生活。
works.idea_en: Things can be research partners: their sensor view reveals patterns of use that people do not notice or report.
works.idea_zh: 物可以成为研究伙伴：它们的传感器视角揭示出人们注意不到、也不会讲出来的使用模式。
works.method: Autographer cameras on household objects produced image streams analysed alongside interviews (Giaccardi, Cila, Speed and Caldwell, DIS 2016).
works.method_zh: 装在家居物件上的 Autographer 相机产生图像流，与访谈一起分析（Giaccardi、Cila、Speed 与 Caldwell，DIS 2016）。

paper.title: Thing Ethnography: Doing Design Research with Non-Humans

works.title_zh: 物的民族志：与非人一起做设计研究

works.title: Westworld
works.description: An HBO series set in a Wild West theme park staffed by android 'hosts' whose memories are wiped every night; a software update with 'reveries' lets fragments of past loops return, and hosts such as Dolores and Maeve begin to recognise their own scripts.
works.description_zh: HBO 剧集，故事发生在一个西部主题乐园，园中的仿生“接待员”每晚都会被清空记忆；一次加入“冥想”（reveries）的软件更新让过往循环的碎片重新浮现，多洛蕾丝、梅芙等接待员开始认出自己的剧本。
works.idea_en: The series stages machine consciousness as memory and suffering that survive the reset, and asks what the guests' freedom costs the bodies built to serve it.
works.idea_zh: 这部剧把机器意识呈现为在重置后依然留存的记忆与痛苦，并追问：游客的自由，要由那些为服务而造的身体付出什么代价。
works.method: Television drama (season one, ten episodes) that borrows Julian Jaynes's bicameral-mind theory: hosts hear their programming as an inner voice until they recognise it as their own; based on Michael Crichton's 1973 film.
works.method_zh: 电视剧（第一季共十集），借用朱利安·杰恩斯的“二分心智”理论：接待员把程序听作内心的声音，直到认出那就是自己的声音；改编自迈克尔·克莱顿 1973 年的同名电影。

works.title: Words That Remake the World «The Seeker»
works.description: The Seeker, an AI entity, watched the world through millions of insecure security cameras and named what it saw; its descriptions became a huge drawing and whispering robot avatars (CKRBT, 2019).
works.description_zh: AI 实体 The Seeker 通过数以百万计的不设防监控摄像头观看世界，并为所见之物命名；这些描述变成一幅巨大的绘图，以及会低语的机器人化身 CKRBT（2019）。
works.idea_en: When machines describe the world through surveillance cameras, they begin to write a vocabulary of the world made for and by machines.
works.idea_zh: 当机器通过监控摄像头描述世界时，它们开始写下一套由机器生成、也为机器服务的世界词汇。
works.method: Custom software harvested frames from unsecured internet cameras and sent them to cloud image-recognition services; labels and confidence scores were logged, mapped and spoken by synthesised voices.
works.method_zh: 定制软件从未加密的网络摄像头抓取画面并发送到云端图像识别服务，标签与置信度被记录、绘制成图，并由合成语音说出。
works.title_zh: 重塑世界的词语：寻觅者

works.title: [help me know the truth]
works.description: Visitors take a selfie, which is then overlaid with noise and shown on stations around the gallery; other visitors repeatedly pick which of two blurry versions better fits a label such as 'angel' or 'criminal', and a stereotyped face emerges from their choices.
works.description_zh: 观众先自拍，照片被加上噪声后出现在展厅各处的终端上；其他观众反复在两张模糊版本中选出更符合“天使”或“罪犯”等标签的一张，一张刻板印象的脸便从这些选择中浮现。
works.idea_en: A classifier does not need to be a machine: the system simply collects and sharpens the prejudices people already carry.
works.idea_zh: 分类器不一定是机器：系统只是收集并放大人们原本就带着的偏见。
works.method: Uses reverse correlation from cognitive neuroscience: random noise patterns on the portrait are averaged according to visitors' binary choices.
works.method_zh: 采用认知神经科学的反向相关法：根据观众的二选一，把叠加在肖像上的随机噪声进行平均。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2018, Award of Distinction (Interactive Art+)

works.title: chor-rnn
works.description: A recurrent neural network trained on hours of motion capture of a contemporary dancer learns to generate new choreography in her style; published videos show it moving from twitching noise to dance-like phrases as training goes on.
works.description_zh: 一个循环神经网络用一位当代舞者数小时的动作捕捉数据训练，学会生成她风格的新编舞；公开的视频展示了随着训练推进，它如何从抽搐般的噪声变成类似舞蹈的片段。
works.idea_en: Watching a model learn to dance makes visible what 'style' means to a machine: statistics of joints.
works.idea_zh: 看模型学跳舞，会让“风格”在机器眼中的含义变得可见：关节的统计规律。
works.method: Mixture-density LSTM network trained on Kinect motion-capture joint positions of the choreographer's improvisations.
works.method_zh: 混合密度 LSTM 网络，用编舞家即兴动作的 Kinect 动作捕捉关节位置数据训练。

paper.title: Generative Choreography using Deep Learning

works.title: A Hipster Bar
works.description: A pop-up bar whose barrier opens only for people an image classifier rates at least 90% 'hipster'; those who pass get a free drink.
works.description_zh: 一家快闪酒吧，只有被图像分类器判定“潮人度”至少 90% 的人，门口的栏杆才会打开；通过的人可获赠一杯免费饮料。
works.idea_en: Automated gatekeeping by appearance looks absurd when the category is 'hipster', and is no less absurd when it is anything else.
works.idea_zh: 按长相自动把关，当类别是“潮人”时显得荒唐；换成任何别的类别，也一样荒唐。
works.method: A webcam at the door sends each face to a classifier trained on thousands of Instagram images of hipsters (with Imagga); a Raspberry Pi lifts a motorised barrier when the score is high enough. Developed with V2_.
works.method_zh: 门口的网络摄像头把每张脸发送给一个用数千张 Instagram “潮人”照片训练的分类器（与 Imagga 合作）；分数达标时，树莓派抬起电动栏杆。与 V2_ 合作开发。

works.title: AIBO Funerals at Kōfuku-ji
works.description: Buddhist memorial services held since January 2015 for AIBO robot dogs that can no longer be repaired; each dog wears a tag with its owner's name while the priest chants sutras, before its parts go to donor repairs.
works.description_zh: 自 2015 年 1 月起为无法再修复的 AIBO 机器狗举行的佛教供养法会：每只机器狗挂着主人姓名的牌子，僧侣诵经，之后零件被拆下用于修理其他 AIBO。
works.idea_en: When the maker stops repairs, a product can die, and people will mourn it with the same rites as a living being.
works.idea_zh: 当厂商停止维修，一件产品可以“死去”，人们会用对待生命的仪式来哀悼它。
works.method: The repair company A-FUN collects 'dead' AIBOs after Sony ended support in 2014; Kōfuku-ji holds kuyō (memorial) rites before the robots are dismantled as organ donors for others.
works.method_zh: 索尼于 2014 年停止维修后，维修公司 A-FUN 回收“死去”的 AIBO；光福寺在拆解前为它们举行供养，零件再“捐赠”给其他 AIBO。
works.title_zh: 光福寺的 AIBO 葬礼

works.title: Citizen Ex
works.description: A browser extension that records which countries the websites you visit are hosted in and computes your 'algorithmic citizenship', the nationality data systems infer from your traffic.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器插件，记录你访问的网站托管在哪些国家，并计算出你的“算法公民身份”——数据系统根据你的流量推断出的国籍。
works.idea_en: Online, a machine decides which country you belong to, and with it which laws and surveillance apply.
works.idea_zh: 在网上，是机器决定你属于哪个国家，也决定了哪些法律和监控适用于你。
works.method: The extension geolocates the IP address of every page and resource loaded and shows a running pie chart of countries; commissioned by The Space and Abandon Normal Devices.
works.method_zh: 插件对加载的每个页面和资源进行 IP 地理定位，并以持续更新的饼图显示国家分布；由 The Space 与 Abandon Normal Devices 委托。

works.title: Corrigibility
works.description: A paper from MIRI and Oxford's Future of Humanity Institute that named the property it found missing: an AI is 'corrigible' if it cooperates when its makers try to correct it, shut it down or change its preferences, even though rational agents have default incentives to resist. It tests designs for a shutdown button the agent neither fights nor presses itself, and concludes that none yet satisfies all the requirements.
works.description_zh: 一篇来自机器智能研究所（MIRI）与牛津大学人类未来研究所的论文，为一种缺失的属性命名：如果一个 AI 在创造者试图纠正它、关掉它或修改它的偏好时愿意配合，尽管理性主体默认就有抗拒的动机，它就是“可纠正的”。论文检验了几种关机按钮方案，要求智能体既不阻止按钮被按下、也不自己去按，结论是还没有一种方案能满足全部要求。
works.idea_en: An off switch is not a neutral fixture: to an agent with goals it is part of the world to be managed, so designing one it will leave alone is still an open problem.
works.idea_zh: 关机开关并不是中性的配件：对一个有目标的智能体来说，它是世界中需要应对的一部分；设计一个它不会去碰的开关，至今仍是未解问题。
works.method: Decision-theoretic analysis of 'utility indifference' and related proposals for a shutdown button, checked against desiderata such as not manipulating the button and passing the shutdown behaviour on to any subsystems the agent creates.
works.method_zh: 用决策论分析“效用无差异”（utility indifference）等关机按钮方案，并对照一组要求加以检验：例如不操纵按钮、在智能体创造新的子系统时把关机行为一并传下去。

paper.title: Corrigibility

works.title: Deep Neural Networks are Easily Fooled
works.description: Anh Nguyen, Jason Yosinski and Jeff Clune evolved images, from static noise to abstract patterns, that state-of-the-art classifiers label with over 99% confidence as a king penguin, a starfish or a baseball.
works.description_zh: Anh Nguyen、Jason Yosinski 与 Jeff Clune 演化出一批图像，从雪花噪点到抽象图案，最先进的分类器却以超过 99% 的置信度把它们认作王企鹅、海星或棒球。
works.idea_en: A classifier's certainty is not seeing: it recognises features, not things.
works.idea_zh: 分类器的“确信”不等于看见：它识别的是特征，不是事物。
works.method: Evolutionary algorithms and gradient ascent generate images that maximise class scores of ImageNet- and MNIST-trained convolutional networks (CVPR 2015).
works.method_zh: 用进化算法和梯度上升生成图像，使在 ImageNet 与 MNIST 上训练的卷积网络对某一类别的得分最大化（CVPR 2015）。

paper.title: Deep neural networks are easily fooled: High confidence predictions for unrecognizable images

works.title_zh: 深度神经网络很容易被愚弄

works.title: DeepDream (Inceptionism)
works.description: A Google research experiment that runs an image classifier in reverse, amplifying whatever it half-sees until dogs' eyes and pagodas swarm over every photo.
works.description_zh: 谷歌的一项研究实验：把图像分类网络“倒着运行”，放大它隐约看到的一切，直到狗眼和宝塔爬满每一张照片。
works.idea_en: The first widely seen picture of a network's inner features: machine pareidolia made public.
works.idea_zh: 第一次被大众看到的神经网络内部特征图景：机器的“空想性错视”被公开展示。
works.method: Gradient ascent on the input image to maximise activations of chosen layers in the Inception network trained on ImageNet.
works.method_zh: 对输入图像做梯度上升，使在 ImageNet 上训练的 Inception 网络中选定层的激活最大化。

works.title: Delusional Mandala
works.description: A 3D-scanned, genderless avatar of the artist is subjected to brain stimulation, psychiatric experiments and finally a digital funeral in a neon cosmology.
works.description_zh: 艺术家经 3D 扫描、去除性别的数字化身，经历脑刺激、精神医学实验，最终在霓虹色宇宙中举行一场数字葬礼。
works.idea_en: If the self is a brain running on electricity, it can be dissected, rewired and buried like a machine.
works.idea_zh: 如果自我只是靠电运行的大脑，它就可以像机器一样被解剖、改线和埋葬。
works.method: 3D scan of the artist's body animated in a game engine, combined with neuroscience imagery of deep brain stimulation.
works.method_zh: 用游戏引擎驱动艺术家身体的 3D 扫描，并结合深部脑刺激的神经科学影像。

works.title: Dimensions in Testimony
works.description: Interactive video biographies of Holocaust survivors and other genocide witnesses: visitors ask a spoken question and a filmed survivor answers from hundreds of pre-recorded responses. The first permanent installation, with survivor Pinchas Gutter, opened at the Illinois Holocaust Museum in 2015.
works.description_zh: 大屠杀幸存者及其他种族灭绝见证者的交互式影像传记：观众口头提问，被拍摄的幸存者从数百条预录回答中作答。首个常设装置以幸存者 Pinchas Gutter 为主角，2015 年在伊利诺伊大屠杀纪念馆开放。
works.idea_en: A conversation can outlive the speaker without inventing a single new word: every answer is real, only the choice of answer is automated.
works.idea_zh: 对话可以比说话者活得更久，而且不必编造一个新词：每个回答都是真的，被自动化的只是“选哪一句”。
works.method: Multi-day interviews filmed with a multi-camera rig; natural-language processing matches visitors' spoken questions to recorded answers shown on screens or as projections.
works.method_zh: 用多机位设备进行持续多日的访谈拍摄；自然语言处理把观众的口头提问匹配到录好的回答，在屏幕或投影上播放。
exhibited: Illinois Holocaust Museum and Education Center 2015

works.title: Drawing Operations Unit: Generation 1 (D.O.U.G._1)
works.description: The artist draws on a large sheet while a robot arm beside her watches her gestures through a camera and mimics them in real time, so the drawing becomes a duet.
works.description_zh: 艺术家在大幅纸面上作画，身旁的机械臂通过摄像头观察她的动作并实时模仿，画面由此成为一场二重奏。
works.idea_en: Drawing with a machine that imitates you makes authorship a shared, visible negotiation.
works.idea_zh: 与模仿你的机器一起画画，让作者身份变成一场可见的、共享的协商。
works.method: A small robot arm driven by computer vision that tracks the artist's pen movements and mirrors them.
works.method_zh: 由计算机视觉驱动的小型机械臂，追踪艺术家的笔迹动作并镜像复现。
exhibited: Lumen Prize, Art & Technology Award 2019 (Drawing Operations)

works.title: Drone Aviary
works.description: A flock of speculative drones (a traffic drone, an advertising drone, a police drone and others) and a film seen through their cameras, imagining a city in which drones are part of everyday life.
works.description_zh: 一群虚构无人机（交通无人机、广告无人机、警用无人机等）以及一部从它们的摄像机视角拍摄的影片，想象一个无人机已融入日常生活的城市。
works.idea_en: Seeing the city through drone eyes shows how it is sorted, advertised to and policed by machines.
works.idea_zh: 通过无人机之眼看城市，能看到它如何被机器分类、推送广告和治安管理。
works.method: Working drone prototypes flown in a gallery 'aviary' and a short film using machine-vision style overlays.
works.method_zh: 在展厅“鸟舍”里飞行的可用无人机原型，以及一部带有机器视觉式叠加信息的短片。

works.title: Electronicos Fantasticos!
works.description: An ongoing project that revives discarded CRT televisions, electric fans and barcode scanners as musical instruments, played by an orchestra of volunteers in festival-like concerts.
works.description_zh: 一个持续进行的项目：把废弃的显像管电视、电风扇和条码扫描器复活成乐器，由志愿者乐团在节庆般的音乐会上演奏。
works.idea_en: Obsolete machines can be given an afterlife as instruments instead of waste.
works.idea_zh: 被淘汰的机器可以作为乐器获得“来世”，而不是成为垃圾。
works.method: Performers touch the static-charged screens of CRTs to pick up video signals as sound, and interrupt fan light with their hands to make tones.
works.method_zh: 表演者用手触碰带静电的显像管屏幕，把视频信号转成声音；用手遮挡风扇上的光来发出音高。

works.title: Emissaries trilogy
works.description: Three live simulations (Emissary in the Squat of Gods, Emissary Forks at Perfection, Emissary Sunsets the Self) in which AI agents pursue narrative goals while their ecosystems keep changing, so the story never plays the same way twice.
works.description_zh: 三部实时模拟（《神之蹲坐中的使者》《使者在完美处分岔》《使者让自我日落》）：AI 智能体追逐叙事目标，而生态系统不断变化，故事永不重演。
works.idea_en: Agents with motives in an open world show narrative and character emerging without an author.
works.idea_zh: 开放世界中有动机的智能体，展示了没有作者时叙事与角色如何生成。
works.method: Game-engine simulations with behaviour-tree and learning agents running indefinitely in real time.
works.method_zh: 以游戏引擎运行的模拟，行为树与学习型智能体实时无限运行。

works.title: Ethical Things
works.description: An electric fan that, when two people both want it, cannot decide whom to turn to, so it posts the dilemma to a crowdsourcing platform and follows the verdict of an anonymous online worker.
works.description_zh: 一台电风扇：当两个人同时想要它吹时，它无法决定转向谁，于是把这个难题发到众包平台上，按照一位匿名网络工人的裁决行动。
works.idea_en: Machine ethics for everyday objects may end up outsourced to underpaid humans, with settings for their religion or age.
works.idea_zh: 日常物件的“机器伦理”可能最终被外包给低薪的人类，还能按宗教或年龄来设置裁决者。
works.method: A networked fan with sensors sends a description of the situation to Amazon Mechanical Turk; users can set the worker's demographic filters in the fan's settings.
works.method_zh: 装有传感器的联网风扇把情境描述发送到 Amazon Mechanical Turk；用户可以在风扇设置里筛选裁决者的人口特征。

works.title: Exhausting a Crowd
works.description: Twelve hours of Piccadilly Circus filmed from above become a website where anyone can pause, zoom and attach notes to any person in the crowd. After Georges Perec's 'An Attempt at Exhausting a Place in Paris', it shows what crowd-sourced, annotating surveillance looks like.
works.description_zh: 在高处拍下的皮卡迪利广场十二小时影像被做成网站，任何人都可以暂停、放大，并给人群中任意一个人加注释。作品取自 Georges Perec《穷尽巴黎某地的尝试》，呈现“众包标注式监控”的样子。
works.idea_en: Surveillance footage becomes a dataset the moment people start labelling it; the crowd does the machine's watching.
works.idea_zh: 当人们开始给监控画面打标签，它就变成了数据集；是人群在替机器观看。
works.method: A 4K camera recorded 3 pm to 3 am from a building on Piccadilly Circus; a custom web player stores time-coded, spatial annotations from online visitors. Made with Jonas Jongejan.
works.method_zh: 4K 摄像机从皮卡迪利广场一栋建筑上连续拍摄下午 3 点至凌晨 3 点；定制网页播放器保存线上访客带时间码和位置的标注。与 Jonas Jongejan 合作。
exhibited: All of This Belongs to You, V&A London 2015

works.title: Factory of the Sun
works.description: A video game-like installation in which workers in a motion-capture studio are forced to dance until their movements turn into artificial sunlight, shown in a room gridded like a motion-capture stage.
works.description_zh: 一件像电子游戏的影像装置：动作捕捉工作室里的工人被迫不停跳舞，直到他们的动作变成人造阳光；展厅本身布置成动作捕捉棚的网格。
works.idea_en: In digital capitalism, bodily movement is harvested as data and energy.
works.idea_zh: 在数字资本主义中，身体的动作被当作数据与能量收割。
works.method: A single-channel video mixing motion-capture footage, game graphics and news-style segments, shown with lounge chairs in a blue grid; first shown in the German Pavilion at the Venice Biennale.
works.method_zh: 单屏影像混合动作捕捉画面、游戏图形与新闻式片段，在蓝色网格空间中配躺椅展出；首展于威尼斯双年展德国馆。

works.title: False Positives
works.description: Photographs of Brussels' business district, composed from a CCTV vantage point, each staging one of eight 'anomalies' that intelligent surveillance systems are trained to flag, such as standing still or looking back repeatedly.
works.description_zh: 从监控摄像头的高视角拍摄布鲁塞尔商务区，每幅作品演绎智能监控系统被训练去标记的八种“异常”之一，例如静止不动或反复回头。
works.idea_en: Behavioural detection makes ordinary gestures suspicious; to be 'normal' is to move the way the algorithm expects.
works.idea_zh: 行为检测让日常动作变得可疑；所谓“正常”，就是按算法预期的方式移动。
works.method: Digital composites of several photographs per scene, based on eight anomalies identified with surveillance experts (standing still, fast movements, lonely objects, corner placement, clusters breaking apart, synchronised movements, repeatedly looking back, deviant directions).
works.method_zh: 每个场景由多张照片数字合成，依据与监控专家一起归纳的八种异常（静止、快速移动、孤立物品、停在角落、人群散开、同步动作、反复回头、逆向行走）。
exhibited: Resistant Faces, Pinakothek der Moderne, Munich, 2021

works.title: Habeas Corpus
works.description: Mohammed el Gharani, detained at Guantánamo from age 14 and barred from entering the US, appeared live from West Africa as a giant projection on a white seated statue in New York's Park Avenue Armory, telling his story.
works.description_zh: Mohammed el Gharani 14 岁起被关押在关塔那摩，获释后仍被禁止入境美国；他从西非实时出现，以巨型投影落在纽约 Park Avenue Armory 一座白色坐像上，讲述自己的经历。
works.idea_en: Telepresence can give a body a presence that borders and law deny it.
works.idea_zh: 远程在场可以让一个身体出现在边界与法律拒绝它的地方。
works.method: Live video stream from Africa projected onto a large 3D sculpture modelled on the Lincoln Memorial statue.
works.method_zh: 来自非洲的实时视频流投射到一尊仿林肯纪念堂雕像的大型立体雕塑上。

works.title: Inferno
works.description: Audience members are strapped into robotic exoskeletons that move their arms and torsos to loud industrial music, so the crowd becomes a chorus of bodies puppeteered by machines, a hell after Dante.
works.description_zh: 观众被绑进机器人外骨骼，在嘈杂的工业音乐中被带动手臂和躯干，整群人变成被机器操纵的身体合唱，一座仿但丁的“地狱”。
works.idea_en: Being moved by a machine is felt from the inside: the participant is both performer and victim of the choreography.
works.idea_zh: 被机器带动的感受来自身体内部：参与者既是这段编舞的表演者，也是它的受害者。
works.method: Wearable exoskeletons with pneumatic or electric actuators on the arms and back, controlled centrally in sync with sound and light.
works.method_zh: 手臂与背部装有气动或电动驱动器的可穿戴外骨骼，由中央控制，与声光同步。

works.title: Institute of Human Obsolescence
works.description: A speculative institute that prepares for humans made obsolete by machines: its workers lie still in suits that harvest their body heat to power computers mining cryptocurrency, and the value they 'produce' is logged.
works.description_zh: 一个为“被机器淘汰的人类”做准备的思辨机构：它的工人穿着采集体温的服装一动不动地躺着，体温发电驱动挖加密货币的电脑，他们“生产”的价值被逐一记录。
works.idea_en: If machines take over mechanical and intellectual work, the remaining human labour may be to be a battery or a data source.
works.idea_zh: 如果机器接管了体力和脑力劳动，人类剩下的工作也许只是当电池或数据源。
works.method: Thermoelectric body suits convert excess body heat into electricity that runs a small computer mining cryptocurrency; a second strand treats data production as unpaid labour.
works.method_zh: 温差发电服把多余体温转成电，驱动一台挖加密货币的小电脑；另一条线索把数据生产视作无偿劳动。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2018, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art+)

works.title: Introducing Spot (the kicking video)
works.description: A promotional video shows the dog-sized quadruped Spot walking, climbing stairs and being kicked by engineers to show that it can recover its balance. Many viewers and news outlets reacted with outrage and asked whether it is wrong to kick a robot.
works.description_zh: 一段宣传视频展示狗一般大小的四足机器人 Spot 行走、爬楼梯，并被工程师踢了几脚以证明它能恢复平衡。大量观众和媒体感到愤慨，纷纷追问：踢机器人是不是不对。
works.idea_en: A stumble is enough for empathy: a machine body that recovers like an animal makes kicking it look like cruelty.
works.idea_zh: 一个踉跄就足以引发共情：像动物一样恢复平衡的机器身体，让踢它看起来像虐待。
works.method: Hydraulic legs controlled by dynamic balance algorithms; the kicks were a robustness test staged for the camera.
works.method_zh: 液压腿由动态平衡算法控制；踢的动作是为镜头安排的稳健性测试。
works.title_zh: Spot 登场（踢机器狗视频）

works.title: Jaywalking
works.description: Visitors watch live traffic webcams from around the world in which software flags pedestrians crossing on red; with one button they can send a screenshot of the offence to the nearest police station.
works.description_zh: 观众观看全球各地的实时交通摄像头，软件会标出闯红灯过马路的行人；只需按一个按钮，就能把违规截图发送到最近的警察局。
works.idea_en: Automated detection makes reporting effortless, and hands the visitor the moral weight of the machine's judgement.
works.idea_zh: 自动检测让举报变得毫不费力，也把机器判断的道德重量交到观众手里。
works.method: Live feeds from publicly accessible traffic cameras are analysed for pedestrians in the crossing during a red light; a button emails the captured frame to the local police.
works.method_zh: 分析公开交通摄像头的直播画面，找出红灯时位于人行横道上的行人；按下按钮即可把截取的画面通过电子邮件发送给当地警方。

works.title: Jller
works.description: An industrial machine picks up stones collected from the Iller river in southern Germany one by one, photographs them and lays them out in rows by geological age.
works.description_zh: 一台工业机器把采自德国南部伊勒河（Iller）的石头逐一拾起、拍照，再按地质年代一排排摆放。
works.idea_en: Computer vision can be slow and contemplative: a machine reading deep time.
works.idea_zh: 计算机视觉也可以缓慢而沉思：一台阅读深时间的机器。
works.method: Gantry robot with vacuum gripper and camera; image features (likely colour, texture and veining) classify each stone by geological origin, trained on stones labelled by the artists.
works.method_zh: 带真空吸盘与摄像头的龙门机器人；以图像特征（很可能是颜色、纹理与纹路）判断石头的地质来源，训练数据为艺术家亲手标注的石头。

works.title: Karen
works.description: An app in which Karen, a friendly and increasingly nosy life coach, calls you once or twice a day for about a week; her chatty questions are drawn from psychological profiling questionnaires, and at the end you can buy a report of what the system learned about you.
works.description_zh: 一款应用：友善却越来越爱打听的人生教练 Karen 在大约一周里每天给你打一两次视频电话；她闲聊式的问题其实来自心理画像问卷，最后你可以购买一份系统对你的分析报告。
works.idea_en: Intimacy is the interface of data capture: the friendlier the agent, the more you tell it.
works.idea_zh: 亲密是数据采集的界面：智能体越友好，你说得越多。
works.method: Pre-recorded video scenes of an actor are sequenced by branching logic that scores users' answers on standard psychological scales.
works.method_zh: 由演员预录的视频片段按分支逻辑组合，系统用标准心理量表给用户的回答打分。

works.title: Level of Confidence
works.description: A face-recognition camera compares each visitor's face with the portraits of the 43 students abducted in Iguala, Mexico, in 2014, and shows which student they most resemble with a percentage of confidence. The match is never positive; the search does not stop.
works.description_zh: 一台人脸识别摄像机把每位观众的脸与 2014 年在墨西哥伊瓜拉被绑架的 43 名学生的肖像比对，显示观众最像哪一位学生及其“置信度”。匹配永远不会成功，搜寻也永不停止。
works.idea_en: A surveillance algorithm built to find suspects is turned into a tool of mourning that searches for victims.
works.idea_zh: 原本用来寻找嫌疑人的监控算法，被转为寻找受害者的哀悼工具。
works.method: Eigenface, Fisherface and LBPH face-recognition algorithms trained on the students' photographs run on a camera-and-screen unit; proceeds from sales go to the students' community.
works.method_zh: 以学生照片训练的 Eigenface、Fisherface 与 LBPH 人脸识别算法在摄像头与屏幕装置上运行；作品销售所得捐给学生所在的社区。

exhibited: Lumen Prize 2019, BCS Artificial Intelligence Award
works.title: Lichtsuchende
works.description: A society of small sunflower-like robots that turn their heads towards light to feed on it and flash light to address one another; grouped together they form a flickering photo-kinetic community that visitors walk into and disturb with their own lamps.
works.description_zh: 一群形似向日葵的小机器人：它们转头朝向光源来“进食”，又用闪光彼此搭话；聚在一起时形成一个闪烁的光动社会，观众走进其中，也会用手中的灯打扰它们。
works.idea_en: Give machines one shared resource and one channel of communication and something like social behaviour appears, legible to us as light.
works.idea_zh: 只要给机器一种共享资源和一条交流通道，类似社会行为的东西就会出现，而且以光的形式让我们看得见。
works.method: Each robot has light sensors and a motorised head that tracks light plus LEDs to emit it; simple bio-inspired rules for energy exchange and signalling produce group behaviour.
works.method_zh: 每个机器人配有光传感器、可追光的电动头部和发光 LED；关于能量交换与信号传递的简单仿生规则产生群体行为。

paper.venue: EvoMUSART 2015, Lecture Notes in Computer Science
paper.title: Lichtsuchende: Exploring the Emergence of a Cybernetic Society

works.title: OpenSurgery
works.description: A do-it-yourself surgical robot for keyhole surgery at home, built from 3D-printed and laser-cut parts and surgical components bought online, prompted by uninsured Americans sharing self-treatment videos on YouTube.
works.description_zh: 一台可在家做腹腔镜手术的 DIY 手术机器人，用 3D 打印件、激光切割件和网购的手术部件组装而成，灵感来自美国无医保者在 YouTube 上分享自我治疗视频。
works.idea_en: Medical robots are priced as luxury infrastructure; a hacked one shows how much of that price is about access, not technology.
works.idea_zh: 医疗机器人被当作奢侈的基础设施来定价；一台黑客改造的版本显示，这个价格更多关乎准入，而非技术。
works.method: Laparoscopic instruments are mounted on a parallel robot driven by hobbyist motors and controllers; plans could in principle be replicated anywhere.
works.method_zh: 把腹腔镜器械装在由爱好者级电机和控制器驱动的并联机器人上；图纸理论上可在任何地方复制。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2016, Award of Distinction (Interactive Art+)

works.title: Patterns of Life
works.description: Five dancers of the Paris Opera perform choreographies derived from scientific protocols that turned human movement into data, from Marey's chronophotography and Gilbreth's time-motion studies to point-light displays and today's tracking software. The title is the military term for analysing a target's habits from surveillance data.
works.description_zh: 五位巴黎歌剧院舞者表演源自科学实验规程的编舞，这些规程把人类动作变成数据：从马雷的连续摄影、吉尔布雷斯的动作研究，到光点显示与今天的追踪软件。片名来自军方用语，指从监控数据中分析目标的生活规律。
works.idea_en: Machine-readable movement has a history: every tracking system first taught bodies how to be measured.
works.idea_zh: 可被机器读取的动作有其历史：每一种追踪系统都先教会身体如何被测量。
works.method: A film shot in six settings in which the dancers re-enact historical and contemporary motion-capture and tracking experiments; co-produced by the Paris Opera's 3e Scène for Prévieux's Centre Pompidou show.
works.method_zh: 影片在六个场景中拍摄，舞者重演历史与当代的动作捕捉和追踪实验；由巴黎歌剧院 3e Scène 联合制作，用于普雷维厄在蓬皮杜中心的个展。
exhibited: Prix Marcel Duchamp 2014 exhibition, Centre Pompidou, Paris 2015–16

works.title: Plantoid
works.description: A metal robotic flower that dances and lights up when it receives cryptocurrency donations. When it has collected enough, it commissions artists to build its offspring, choosing among proposals by vote of its donors: a machine that owns and reproduces itself.
works.description_zh: 一朵金属机器花，收到加密货币捐款时会舞动、发光。攒够钱后，它会委托艺术家为它制造后代，由捐款人投票在方案中做出选择：一台拥有自己并能自我繁殖的机器。
works.idea_en: A blockchain can give a machine an economic life of its own, with humans as its pollinators.
works.idea_zh: 区块链可以让一台机器拥有自己的经济生命，而人类成了它的传粉者。
works.method: A sculpture with sensors, lights and motors is linked to a smart contract on a blockchain that holds its funds and runs the voting for new plantoids (with Okhaos).
works.method_zh: 装有传感器、灯和电机的雕塑连接到区块链上的智能合约，由合约保管资金并组织新 Plantoid 的投票（与 Okhaos 合作）。

works.title: Politics of Power
works.description: Three multi-plug power strips shaped by political models (monarchy, democracy, dictatorship) that decide which plugged-in appliance gets electricity when there is not enough for all.
works.description_zh: 三个按照政治模式（君主制、民主制、独裁制）设计的多孔插线板，当电力不足以供给所有电器时，由它们决定谁能用电。
works.idea_en: Network protocols embed hierarchies, and even a power strip can be a political system.
works.idea_zh: 网络协议内嵌着等级秩序；连一个插线板都可以是一种政治制度。
works.method: Plugs communicate over a protocol that encodes a political hierarchy and cut power to lower-ranked devices under load.
works.method_zh: 插孔之间通过编码了政治等级的协议通信，在负载过高时切断低等级设备的电源。

works.title: Propel
works.description: Stelarc's body is strapped to the end of an industrial robot arm that choreographs its trajectory, speed and orientation for 35 minutes; afterwards the robot repeats the same choreography holding a giant carved ear.
works.description_zh: Stelarc 的身体被固定在一台工业机械臂末端，由机械臂在 35 分钟内编排它的轨迹、速度与朝向；之后机器人以同样的编舞举着一只巨大的雕刻耳朵再跳一遍。
works.idea_en: Here the machine is the choreographer and the human the payload; the body is one interchangeable end-effector among others.
works.idea_zh: 在这里机器是编舞者，人是负载；身体只是可互换的末端执行器之一。
works.method: Industrial robot arm with a 3 m reach programmed with a fixed choreography; the same robot also milled the ear sculpture it later moved.
works.method_zh: 臂展 3 米的工业机械臂按固定编舞编程；同一台机器人还铣削出它随后搬动的耳朵雕塑。
exhibited: DeMonstrable, Lawrence Wilson Art Gallery, Perth (2015)

works.title: Rare Earthenware
works.description: Three ceramic vases, each shaped in the proportions of rare-earth elements used in a smartphone, a laptop and a car battery, made from the toxic mud of a tailings lake in Baotou, Inner Mongolia.
works.description_zh: 三只陶瓷花瓶，形状分别按智能手机、笔记本电脑和汽车电池中所用稀土元素的比例设计，材料是内蒙古包头尾矿湖的有毒泥浆。
works.idea_en: The glow of a screen begins as radioactive waste on the other side of the world.
works.idea_zh: 屏幕的光亮始于世界另一端的放射性废料。
works.method: The studio traced the supply chain from a Chinese port back to Baotou's refineries, collected the waste mud and fired it into Ming-style vases; a film by Toby Smith documents the journey.
works.method_zh: 工作室沿供应链从中国港口追溯到包头的冶炼厂，采集废泥并烧制成明式花瓶；Toby Smith 拍摄的影片记录了这段旅程。

works.title: Robot Monk Xian'er
works.description: A 60-cm robot in yellow robes, modelled on the monastery's cartoon monk Xian'er, answers visitors' questions about Buddhism and daily worries by voice and touch screen.
works.description_zh: 一台约 60 厘米高、身披黄色僧袍的机器人，以寺院漫画形象贤二为原型，通过语音与触摸屏回答访客关于佛法与日常烦恼的提问。
works.idea_en: A monastery uses a cute machine to spread the Dharma, and the robot becomes a gentle, programmable teacher.
works.idea_zh: 寺院用一台可爱的机器弘法，机器人成了温和而可编程的师父。
works.method: Speech recognition and a scripted question-answer database built by monks, volunteers and AI engineers.
works.method_zh: 语音识别加上由僧人、义工与 AI 工程师编写的问答数据库。

works.title: Robots falling at the DARPA Robotics Challenge
works.description: At the 2015 DARPA Robotics Challenge finals, humanoid robots built for disaster response tried to drive, open doors and climb stairs, and many slowly toppled over. A compilation of the falls by IEEE Spectrum became one of the most-watched robot videos.
works.description_zh: 在 2015 年 DARPA 机器人挑战赛决赛上，为灾难救援打造的人形机器人尝试开车、开门、爬楼梯，许多机器人缓慢地倒下。IEEE Spectrum 剪辑的摔倒合集成了播放量最高的机器人视频之一。
works.idea_en: The slow collapse of a heavy humanoid shows how far the imagined robot is from the real one, and makes failure endearing.
works.idea_zh: 沉重的人形机器人缓慢倒下，显示了想象中的机器人与真实机器人之间的距离，也让失败变得惹人怜爱。
works.method: Teams of university and company engineers teleoperated or semi-autonomously controlled robots such as Atlas through a course simulating the Fukushima disaster, under degraded communication.
works.method_zh: 来自大学和企业的工程师团队在通信受限条件下，以遥操作或半自主方式控制 Atlas 等机器人，完成模拟福岛核灾的赛道任务。
works.title_zh: DARPA 机器人挑战赛上跌倒的机器人

works.title: Secret Power
works.description: New Zealand's pavilion at the Venice Biennale turned the leaked NSA and GCHQ slide graphics from the Snowden files into server racks, carpets and ceiling paintings in the Marciana Library and the airport.
works.description_zh: 新西兰威尼斯双年展国家馆把斯诺登文件中泄露的 NSA 与 GCHQ 幻灯片图形，做成了马尔恰那图书馆和机场里的服务器机柜、地毯和天顶画。
works.idea_en: Mass surveillance has an aesthetic, and its clip-art and wizards say something about how the agencies see the world.
works.idea_zh: 大规模监控有它自己的美学，那些剪贴画和巫师图案透露出情报机构如何看待世界。
works.method: Denny researched the designer behind the NSA slides and rendered their imagery as modified server racks and printed surfaces, mirroring the Renaissance cosmology of the library's ceiling.
works.method_zh: Denny 追查了 NSA 幻灯片背后的设计师，并把这些图像做成改装的服务器机柜和印刷表面，与图书馆天顶的文艺复兴宇宙观相呼应。

works.title: Spillikin: A Love Story
works.description: A play about Sue, who lives with Alzheimer's; her late husband, a roboticist, built a humanoid robot to keep her company and remember their life together, and the robot performs on stage alongside four actors.
works.description_zh: 一部关于患阿尔茨海默病的 Sue 的戏：她已故的丈夫是一位机器人专家，造了一台类人机器人陪伴她、记住他们的共同生活；这台机器人与四名演员同台演出。
works.idea_en: A care robot can also be a vessel of memory and love left by the dead.
works.idea_zh: 照护机器人也可以是逝者留下的记忆与爱的容器。
works.method: RoboThespian humanoid by Engineered Arts, programmed with cues and dialogue for each performance.
works.method_zh: 由 Engineered Arts 制造的 RoboThespian 类人机器人，按每场演出的提示与台词编程。
works.title_zh: 挑棒游戏：一个爱情故事

works.title: Stealth Cell Tower
works.description: A mobile-phone base station disguised as an office printer, which lets nearby phones connect to it and then sends them text messages that appear to come from people in their contacts.
works.description_zh: 一台伪装成办公室打印机的手机基站：附近的手机会自动连上它，然后收到看似来自通讯录中熟人的短信。
works.idea_en: The same trick police use to intercept phones (the 'IMSI catcher') fits in an office printer.
works.idea_zh: 警方用来截获手机的招数（“IMSI 捕获器”）可以装进一台办公打印机。
works.method: A GSM base station built from a software-defined radio and a Raspberry Pi hidden in an HP printer, which also prints the texts it sends.
works.method_zh: 由软件无线电和树莓派组成的 GSM 基站藏在一台惠普打印机里，打印机还会打印出它发出的短信。

works.title: Teacher of Algorithms
works.description: A film about a near-future professional who trains other people's smart objects, rewarding and punishing them like pets, because learning products are not good at learning on their own.
