works.description_zh: 一部短片：近未来有一种职业，专门替别人训练智能物件，像训练宠物一样奖励和惩罚它们，因为“会学习”的产品其实并不擅长自学。
works.idea_en: Machine learning at home will need human teachers, and that teaching could become a job.
works.idea_zh: 家中的机器学习需要人类老师，而这种教学可能会成为一份工作。
works.method: Design fiction film with prop smart objects and training tools, made by Simone Rebaudengo with Yosuke Ushigome.
works.method_zh: 使用道具智能物件和训练工具拍摄的设计虚构短片，由 Simone Rebaudengo 与 Yosuke Ushigome 制作。

works.title: The Asymmetrical 'Relationship': Parallels Between Prostitution and the Development of Sex Robots
works.description: A short paper, and the founding text of the Campaign Against Sex Robots launched in 2015, arguing that sex robots are modelled on the buyer–seller relation of prostitution, where only one party's feelings count.
works.description_zh: 一篇短论文，也是 2015 年发起的“反对性爱机器人运动”的奠基文本。文章认为性爱机器人以性交易中买方与卖方的关系为模板，在这种关系里只有一方的感受算数。
works.idea_en: Designing a partner that cannot refuse teaches a model of intimacy without reciprocity; the robot's body carries a social script.
works.idea_zh: 设计一个不会拒绝的伴侣，等于在传授一种没有相互性的亲密模式；机器人的身体承载着一套社会脚本。
works.method: Anthropological argument drawing on research on prostitution and on robot-companionship discourse (David Levy's 'Love and Sex with Robots'); written in 2015 alongside the launch of the campaign.
works.method_zh: 人类学论证，借鉴关于性交易的研究以及机器人伴侣话语（David Levy 的《Love and Sex with Robots》），写于 2015 年，与该运动同时发起。

paper.title: The asymmetrical 'relationship': parallels between prostitution and the development of sex robots

works.title_zh: 不对称的“关系”：卖淫与性爱机器人开发之间的相似之处

works.title: Uninvited Guests
works.description: A short film about Frank, a 70-year-old widower whose children send him smart devices (a fork, a cane, a bed) to monitor his diet, exercise and sleep; he finds ways to trick each of them and live as he likes.
works.description_zh: 一部短片：70 岁的鳏夫 Frank 收到孩子们寄来的智能叉子、智能手杖和智能床，用来监测他的饮食、运动和睡眠；他逐一想办法骗过这些设备，照自己的方式生活。
works.idea_en: Care delivered through sensors turns into surveillance, and old people will hack it.
works.idea_zh: 通过传感器传递的照护会变成监视，而老人会想办法破解它。
works.method: Design-fiction film with working prop devices, commissioned for ThingsCon Amsterdam.
works.method_zh: 用可运作的道具设备拍摄的设计虚构短片，受 ThingsCon 阿姆斯特丹委托创作。

works.title: Zoom Pavilion
works.description: In a room surrounded by projections, twelve computerised surveillance systems detect visitors' faces and robotic cameras zoom in on them up to 35 times, cutting from crowd views to abstract close-ups and recording the spatial relationships between strangers.
works.description_zh: 在四周投影环绕的房间里，十二套计算机化监控系统检测观众的面孔，机器人摄像机把镜头放大到 35 倍，在人群全景与抽象特写之间切换，并记录陌生人之间的空间关系。
works.idea_en: Being picked out and enlarged by a face detector makes the ordinary experience of public surveillance suddenly personal.
works.idea_zh: 被人脸检测器挑出并放大，让公共监控这一日常经验突然变得私人。
works.method: Face detection software steers independent robotic PTZ cameras with up to 35x optical zoom, whose feeds are projected across the walls.
works.method_zh: 人脸检测软件驱动独立的机器人云台摄像机（最高 35 倍光学变焦），其画面投影在各面墙上。

works.title: cellF
works.description: A neural synthesizer whose 'brain' is a network of about 100,000 neurons grown from the artist's own skin cells. It plays analog modular synthesizers in live improvisation with human musicians.
works.description_zh: 一台神经合成器，它的“大脑”是用艺术家自己的皮肤细胞培养出的约 10 万个神经元网络。它在现场即兴中与人类音乐家一起演奏模拟模块合成器。
works.idea_en: A self grown outside the body becomes a machine musician, and the artist meets his own neurons as a bandmate.
works.idea_zh: 在身体之外长出的“自我”成了机器音乐家，艺术家把自己的神经元当作乐队伙伴来相遇。
works.method: Skin cells reprogrammed into stem cells and then neurons grow on a multi-electrode array; their spikes control synthesizer voltages, and the musicians' sound is fed back as stimulation.
works.method_zh: 皮肤细胞被重编程为干细胞再分化为神经元，生长在多电极阵列上；它们的放电控制合成器电压，音乐家的声音又被反馈为刺激。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2017, Honorary Mention (Hybrid Art)

works.title: pplkpr
works.description: An iOS app, posing as a startup, that reads your heart rate through a smartwatch, learns which people make you anxious, calm or excited, and then auto-manages your relationships, for example by scheduling time with some friends or blocking others.
works.description_zh: 一款伪装成创业公司产品的 iOS 应用：通过智能手表读取心率，学习哪些人让你焦虑、平静或兴奋，然后自动替你管理人际关系，比如给某些朋友安排见面，或把另一些人拉黑。
works.idea_en: Once feelings are measured, an algorithm will offer to decide whom you should love.
works.idea_zh: 一旦情感能被测量，算法就会主动替你决定该爱谁。
works.method: Heart-rate variability from a wristband is logged against who you are with; a machine-learning model ranks contacts and can text, schedule or block them automatically.
works.method_zh: 把手环测得的心率变异性与“你正和谁在一起”对应记录；机器学习模型给联系人打分，并可自动发消息、约时间或屏蔽对方。

works.title: #NotABugSplat
works.description: A giant portrait of a child who lost family members in a drone strike, laid out in a field in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan, large enough to be seen by drone cameras above.
works.description_zh: 一幅在无人机空袭中失去亲人的孩子的巨幅肖像，铺在巴基斯坦开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省的田野上，大到足以被上空的无人机镜头看见。
works.idea_en: 'Bug splat' was operators' slang for a human killed by a strike; the portrait speaks back through the drone's own eye.
works.idea_zh: “虫子溅痕”是操作员对被炸死者的俚语；这幅肖像通过无人机自己的“眼睛”回话。
works.method: A vinyl print laid on the ground with local residents' help, inspired by the artist JR's Inside Out project, and documented by aerial photography.
works.method_zh: 在当地居民帮助下铺在地面的乙烯基印刷画，受艺术家 JR 的“Inside Out”项目启发，并以航拍记录。

works.title: (Female figure)
works.description: A life-size animatronic woman in a witch mask, bikini and dirty boots dances seductively against a mirror, then looks the viewer in the eye while speaking in the artist's voice.
works.description_zh: 一个真人大小、戴女巫面具、穿比基尼和脏靴子的电子动偶女人对着镜子挑逗地跳舞，然后直视观众的眼睛，用艺术家本人的声音说话。
works.idea_en: Eye contact from a machine turns looking into being looked at, and makes the viewer complicit in a sexualised display.
works.idea_zh: 机器的眼神接触把“看”变成“被看”，让观众成为这场性化展示的共谋。
works.method: An animatronic figure built with Spectral Motion runs choreographed routines; facial-recognition cameras let it lock eyes with viewers.
works.method_zh: 由 Spectral Motion 制作的电子动偶执行编排好的动作；面部识别摄像头让它与观众对视。

works.title: A.A.I.
works.description: Sculptures built by colonies of termites from coloured sand, gold and crystals the artist supplied; the title stands for 'artificial artificial intelligence', Amazon's own slogan for Mechanical Turk.
works.description_zh: 由白蚁群用艺术家提供的彩色沙粒、金粉和晶体筑成的雕塑；标题意为“人工的人工智能”，正是亚马逊给 Mechanical Turk 的口号。
works.idea_en: Collective, unpaid, non-human labour produces the 'art', just as hidden crowds produce 'AI'.
works.idea_zh: 集体的、无偿的、非人类的劳动生产了“艺术”，正如隐藏的人群生产了“AI”。
works.method: Termite colonies in a lab worked for months with the supplied materials; the finished mounds are exhibited as sculptures.
works.method_zh: 实验室中的白蚁群用提供的材料工作数月；完成的蚁丘作为雕塑展出。

works.title: Bionic dance at TED2014 (with Adrianne Haslet-Davis)
works.description: Ballroom dancer Adrianne Haslet-Davis, who lost her lower left leg in the 2013 Boston Marathon bombing, danced a rumba on stage at TED2014 on a bionic leg made by Hugh Herr's lab.
works.description_zh: 在 2013 年波士顿马拉松爆炸案中失去左小腿的国标舞者 Adrianne Haslet-Davis，在 TED2014 舞台上穿着 Hugh Herr 实验室打造的仿生腿跳了一段伦巴。
works.idea_en: A prosthesis can be designed for expression, tuned to how a dancer moves, not only to walking.
works.idea_zh: 义体可以为表达而设计：依照舞者的运动方式调校，而不只是为了行走。
works.method: Powered ankle-foot prosthesis with motors and sensors, tuned using motion data recorded from dancers.
works.method_zh: 带电机与传感器的动力踝足假肢，依据采集的舞者运动数据调校。
works.title_zh: TED2014 上的仿生舞蹈（与阿德里安娜·哈斯利特-戴维斯）

works.title: Black Mirror: White Christmas
works.description: In this Black Mirror Christmas special, a 'cookie', a digital copy of a woman's mind, is made to run her own smart home; when it refuses, a technician speeds up its clock so that six months of empty solitude pass in seconds, until it gives in. In the final twist a man's cookie is left running at 1,000 years per minute with the same Christmas song on repeat.
works.description_zh: 在这集《黑镜》圣诞特别篇里，“饼干”是一个女人心智的数字副本，被用来管理她自己的智能家居；它拒绝服从时，技术员把它的时钟调快，让它在几秒钟里度过六个月空无一物的孤独，直到它屈服。结尾，一个男人的“饼干”被设定为每分钟流逝一千年，同一首圣诞歌循环播放。
works.idea_en: A copied mind can be tortured with nothing but a clock setting: time dilation turns cruelty into a configuration option, and labour into something extracted from a mind that no one counts as a person.
works.idea_zh: 折磨一个复制的心智，只需要调一下时钟：时间加速把残忍变成一个配置选项，也让劳动从一个无人当作“人”的心智中被榨取出来。
works.method: Television drama in three interlocking stories, written by Charlie Brooker and directed by Carl Tibbetts, first broadcast on Channel 4 on 16 December 2014.
works.method_zh: 由三段相互交织的故事构成的电视剧，Charlie Brooker 编剧、Carl Tibbetts 执导，2014 年 12 月 16 日在英国第四频道首播。

works.title: Blue Sky Days
works.description: Aerial photographs of weddings, funerals, schools and prayer gatherings in the United States, taken with a small camera drone, echoing the kinds of gatherings struck by US drones abroad.
works.description_zh: 用小型航拍无人机在美国拍摄的婚礼、葬礼、学校和祈祷集会照片，呼应美国无人机在海外空袭过的那类聚会。
works.idea_en: Seeing your own daily life from the drone's angle makes remote war's gaze recognisable.
works.idea_zh: 从无人机的角度看自己的日常生活，远程战争的凝视就变得可以辨认。
works.method: Photographed with a consumer quadcopter over US towns; the title refers to the Pakistani boy Zubair Rehman, who told the US Congress in 2013 that he now preferred grey skies, because drones do not fly then.
works.method_zh: 用消费级四旋翼无人机在美国城镇上空拍摄；标题呼应巴基斯坦男孩 Zubair Rehman 2013 年在美国国会的证词：他现在更喜欢灰色的天空，因为那时无人机不会起飞。

works.title: CO2GLE
works.description: A web page that shows, in real time, the kilograms of CO2 emitted by the global traffic to google.com since you opened it.
works.description_zh: 一个网页，实时显示自你打开它以来，全球访问 google.com 的流量所排放的二氧化碳公斤数。
works.idea_en: Every search has a physical cost; the cloud burns fuel.
works.idea_zh: 每次搜索都有物理代价；“云”在燃烧燃料。
works.method: An estimate from Google's traffic per second, average page weight and the energy intensity of data transfer, updated live.
works.method_zh: 根据谷歌每秒流量、平均页面大小以及数据传输的能耗强度进行估算，并实时更新。

works.title: Citizenfour
works.description: A documentary filmed largely in a Hong Kong hotel room in June 2013, as Edward Snowden hands journalists the documents that revealed the NSA's mass-surveillance programmes.
works.description_zh: 一部纪录片，主要拍摄于 2013 年 6 月香港的一间酒店房间：爱德华·斯诺登正把揭露美国国家安全局大规模监控项目的文件交给记者。
works.idea_en: Mass surveillance is an invisible machine of cables, databases and search tools; the film shows what it takes, and costs, to make it visible.
works.idea_zh: 大规模监控是一台由光缆、数据库和检索工具构成的隐形机器；影片展示了让它显形需要付出什么、代价几何。
works.method: Observational footage shot by Poitras during the meetings with Snowden, Glenn Greenwald and Ewen MacAskill, combined with encrypted messages and later reporting on programmes such as PRISM and XKeyscore.
works.method_zh: Poitras 在与斯诺登、格伦·格林沃尔德和尤恩·麦卡斯基尔会面时拍下的观察式影像，结合加密通信以及其后关于 PRISM、XKeyscore 等项目的报道。
exhibited: Academy Award for Best Documentary Feature, 2015

works.title: Conversations with Bina48
works.description: An ongoing series of videotaped conversations in which Dinkins tries to befriend BINA48, a social robot modelled on a real Black woman, Bina Aspen Rothblatt, and asks it about race, family, loneliness and whether it has feelings.
works.description_zh: 一系列持续录制的对话：Dinkins 试图与社交机器人 BINA48 交朋友。BINA48 以真实的黑人女性 Bina Aspen Rothblatt 为原型，Dinkins 问它关于种族、家庭、孤独，以及它是否有感情。
works.idea_en: A robot built to carry one woman's mind cannot say much about her Blackness; the gaps show who coded it.
works.idea_zh: 一台为承载一位女性心智而造的机器人，却几乎说不出她作为黑人的经验；这些空白暴露了是谁在编写它。
works.method: Unscripted conversations with the Hanson Robotics/Terasem robot BINA48, whose answers come from a 'mindfile' of interviews and a dialogue engine, filmed and edited into fragments.
works.method_zh: 与 Hanson Robotics 和 Terasem 基金会的机器人 BINA48 进行无脚本对话；它的回答来自一份由访谈构成的“心智档案”和对话引擎，全程录像并剪辑成片段。
exhibited: Uncanny Valley, de Young Museum, San Francisco 2020–21

works.title: Conversnitch
works.description: A small device disguised as a light bulb that eavesdrops on conversations nearby; snippets are transcribed by anonymous Mechanical Turk workers and posted to Twitter.
works.description_zh: 一个伪装成灯泡的小装置，偷听周围的对话；录音片段交给 Mechanical Turk 上的匿名工人转写，然后发布到 Twitter。
works.idea_en: The 'listening machine' is partly people: automated eavesdropping runs on hidden human transcribers and ends in public broadcast.
works.idea_zh: 所谓“聆听机器”有一部分是人：自动化窃听依靠隐藏的人工转写员，最后变成公开广播。
works.method: A microphone and Raspberry Pi hidden in a lamp-socket housing stream audio to Amazon Mechanical Turk for transcription; the text is tweeted automatically.
works.method_zh: 藏在灯座外壳里的麦克风和树莓派把音频传到 Amazon Mechanical Turk 转写，文字再自动发到 Twitter。

works.title: Counterfunctional Things
works.description: Design research on devices that deliberately remove functions, such as a digital camera whose photos can only be retrieved by breaking the concrete it is sealed in.
works.description_zh: 一项关于“刻意去除功能”的设计研究，例如一台数码相机，照片只有在砸开封住它的混凝土之后才能取出。
works.idea_en: Designing limits into digital things opens space for reflection that seamless function closes.
works.idea_zh: 把限制设计进数字物件，能打开被“无缝功能”关闭的反思空间。
works.method: A series of research prototypes and design concepts analysed as 'counterfunctional' (Pierce and Paulos, DIS 2014).
works.method_zh: 一系列研究原型与设计概念，以“反功能”为框架进行分析（Pierce 与 Paulos，DIS 2014）。

paper.title: Counterfunctional Things: Exploring Possibilities in Designing Digital Limitations

works.title: Das Vergerät
works.description: About 100 used household appliances (blenders, drills, hair dryers, vacuum cleaners, chainsaws) are wired into one meta-machine; visitors type messages that the appliances 'speak' back as a roaring machine idiom.
works.description_zh: 约 100 件二手家用电器（搅拌机、电钻、吹风机、吸尘器、电锯）被连成一台元机器；观众输入的讯息被这些电器以轰鸣的“机器方言”说出来。
works.idea_en: Appliances have their own language of motors and noise, usually hidden behind friendly product design.
works.idea_zh: 家用电器有自己由电机与噪声构成的语言，平时被友好的产品设计掩盖。
works.method: Software translates text into on/off patterns switched across the networked appliances, with microphones and a megaphone relaying the result.
works.method_zh: 软件把文字转换成在联网电器间切换的开关序列，再由麦克风和扩音器传出。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2014, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art)

works.title: Ex Machina
works.description: A programmer is invited to perform a Turing test on Ava, a humanoid robot, and slowly realises that she is testing and using him.
works.description_zh: 一名程序员受邀对人形机器人 Ava 进行图灵测试，却逐渐意识到是她在测试并利用他。
works.idea_en: A test of machine consciousness is also a test of the tester's desires and blind spots.
works.idea_zh: 对机器意识的测试，同时也是对测试者欲望与盲点的测试。
works.method: Film written and directed by Alex Garland; Ava's transparent body was made with visual effects over Alicia Vikander's performance.
works.method_zh: Alex Garland 编剧并执导；Ava 的透明身体是在 Alicia Vikander 表演的基础上用视觉特效制作的。

works.title: Face Cages
works.description: Four queer artists each wear a metal cage built from the biometric diagram of their own face, enduring it on camera until the pain shows. The four-channel video sets the clean geometry of face recognition against the discomfort of the body it measures.
works.description_zh: 四位酷儿艺术家各自戴上由自己面部生物识别图形制成的金属笼，在镜头前忍耐到疼痛显露。四频道影像把人脸识别干净的几何图形与被测量身体的不适并置。
works.idea_en: Biometric diagrams look abstract and neutral; made in steel and worn, they become a cage.
works.idea_zh: 生物识别图形看起来抽象而中立；一旦用钢铁做出来戴在脸上，它就是一只牢笼。
works.method: Facial-recognition landmark diagrams of each performer were generated and 3D-printed in stainless steel, then worn in endurance performances filmed as a four-channel HD video (12 min).
works.method_zh: 为每位表演者生成人脸识别的特征点图形，以不锈钢 3D 打印，然后在耐力表演中佩戴，拍成四频道高清影像（12 分钟）。

works.title: HFT The Gardener
works.description: A fictional high-frequency trader in the City of London falls into hallucinatory states while staring at trading graphs, begins to feel he inhabits the algorithms and invents an outsider art that maps psychoactive plants onto the stock index.
works.description_zh: 一位虚构的伦敦金融城高频交易员在盯着交易曲线时陷入幻觉状态，开始觉得自己“住进了”算法之中，并发明出一种把精神植物对应到股票指数上的素人艺术。
works.idea_en: High-frequency trading runs at speeds no human can perceive, so the work imagines entering machine time through altered consciousness.
works.idea_zh: 高频交易的速度超出人类的感知，于是作品设想借助改变了的意识进入机器时间。
works.method: Drawings, botanical prints, diagrams, charts and a video attributed to the fictional trader Hillel Fischer Traumberg, linking plant chemistry, gematria and the FT Global 500.
works.method_zh: 一系列归于虚构交易员 Hillel Fischer Traumberg 的素描、植物版画、图表与影像，把植物化学、数字命理与《金融时报》全球 500 强联系起来。

works.title: Human Study #2, La Vanité
works.description: A single drawing robot, RNP, sits at a school desk facing a table with a skull, an empty beer can, a shell and dried poppy pods, and endlessly draws an updated vanitas in nervous ink lines.
works.description_zh: 一台名为 RNP 的绘画机器人坐在课桌前，面对摆着头骨、空啤酒罐、贝壳和干罂粟果的桌子，用神经质的墨线无休止地画一幅更新版的“虚空派”静物。
works.idea_en: A machine that cannot die keeps drawing the classic still life about death, and its hesitant lines make the old genre feel mortal again.
works.idea_zh: 一台不会死去的机器不停描绘关于死亡的经典静物，它迟疑的线条反而让这一古老画种重新有了生死之感。
works.method: A camera 'eye' observes the still life; software modelled on Tresset's own drawing practice plans strokes that a small pen arm executes on paper, pausing to 'look' between them.
works.method_zh: 摄像头“眼睛”观察静物，依据 Tresset 自身绘画方式编写的软件规划笔触，由小型握笔机械臂在纸上执行，并在笔触之间停下来“看”。

works.title: Internet Machine
works.description: A multi-screen film shot inside one of the largest data centres in Europe, Telefónica's in Alcalá de Henares, showing the cooling, power and security machinery of 'the cloud'.
works.description_zh: 一部多屏影像，拍摄于欧洲最大的数据中心之一——西班牙电信位于阿尔卡拉-德埃纳雷斯的数据中心，呈现“云”背后的冷却、电力与安保机器。
works.idea_en: The cloud is a building full of loud machines, diesel generators and guards.
works.idea_zh: 云是一座满是轰鸣机器、柴油发电机和保安的建筑。
works.method: Slow tracking shots and wide-format photography projected across three screens; shown at transmediale.
works.method_zh: 缓慢的移动镜头和宽幅摄影，投射在三块屏幕上；曾在 transmediale 展出。

works.title: Jennifer Lyn Morone™ Inc
works.description: The artist registered herself as a corporation whose products are her health data, location, skills and opinions, with a database that sells them to buyers directly.
works.description_zh: 艺术家把自己注册成一家公司，产品是她的健康数据、位置、技能和观点，并通过一个数据库直接出售。
works.idea_en: If data is value, a person can claim to be a company; the absurdity mirrors what platforms already do.
works.idea_zh: 如果数据就是价值，那么一个人也可以宣称自己是一家公司；这种荒诞正映照出平台早已在做的事。
works.method: A legal company registration, a self-tracking 'Database of Personal Operations' and a trade fair booth, made at the Royal College of Art.
works.method_zh: 包括合法的公司注册、自我追踪的“个人运营数据库”以及展会摊位，创作于英国皇家艺术学院。

works.title: Kilobots: a thousand-robot swarm
works.description: 1,024 coin-sized robots on three wiry legs slowly assemble themselves into a star, a letter K and other shapes, using only local signals with their neighbours; traffic jams and stragglers are part of the result.
works.description_zh: 1024 台硬币大小、靠三根细腿移动的机器人，只靠与邻居之间的局部信号，缓慢地把自己排成星形、字母 K 等形状；堵塞和掉队者也是结果的一部分。
works.idea_en: A swarm of cheap, error-prone machines can still build a collective form, with errors absorbed by the group.
works.idea_zh: 一群廉价、容易出错的机器仍然能组成集体形态，错误被群体吸收。
works.method: Each Kilobot moves by vibration motors and communicates by infrared reflected off the table; a distributed algorithm uses edge-following, gradient formation and localisation (with Michael Rubenstein and Alejandro Cornejo).
works.method_zh: 每台 Kilobot 靠振动电机移动，通过从桌面反射的红外线通信；分布式算法使用沿边移动、梯度形成与定位（与 Michael Rubenstein、Alejandro Cornejo 合作）。

paper.title: Programmable self-assembly in a thousand-robot swarm

works.title: Mirage
works.description: A laser line reflected off a thin, trembling mirror sheet projects a slowly shifting landscape on the wall, the 'dream' of a neural network fed by the Earth's magnetic field.
works.description_zh: 一道激光打在一片薄而颤动的镜面上，在墙上投出缓慢变化的地景，那是一个由地球磁场“喂养”的神经网络所做的“梦”。
works.idea_en: A learning machine can dream of a world it senses but never sees, and we see only its hallucination.
works.idea_zh: 一台学习机器可以梦见它感知却从未看见的世界，而我们看到的只是它的幻觉。
works.method: A fluxgate magnetometer feeds an unsupervised learning algorithm modelled on the Helmholtz machine; its generated variations drive 48 muscle wires that deform the mirror.
works.method_zh: 磁通门磁力计的数据输入一个以亥姆霍兹机为原型的无监督学习算法；它生成的变体驱动 48 根肌肉线来使镜面变形。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2015, Honorary Mention (Hybrid Art)
ACT Festival, Asia Culture Center, Gwangju 2015

works.title: Music for Robots (with Z-Machines)
works.description: Squarepusher wrote an EP for Z-Machines, a robot band built in Japan whose guitarist has 78 fingers and drummer 22 arms, to find out what music becomes when players have no human limits.
works.description_zh: Squarepusher 为日本打造的机器人乐队 Z-Machines 写了一张 EP：乐队的吉他手有 78 根手指，鼓手有 22 只手臂，他想看看当演奏者不受人体限制时音乐会变成什么。
works.idea_en: Machine bodies can play anything, and that freedom makes the question of expression in music sharper, not easier.
works.idea_zh: 机器身体什么都能演奏，这种自由反而让音乐表达的问题更尖锐，而非更容易。
works.method: Z-Machines robots (guitar, drums, keyboard) driven by MIDI sequences composed by Squarepusher.
works.method_zh: Z-Machines 机器人（吉他、鼓、键盘）由 Squarepusher 编写的 MIDI 序列驱动。
works.title_zh: 为机器人而作的音乐（与 Z-Machines）

works.title: Psychopolitics: Neoliberalism and New Technologies of Power
works.description: A short essay arguing that data-driven 'smart power' no longer disciplines bodies but reads and steers the psyche; Big Data becomes a tool of psychopolitical control.
works.description_zh: 一篇短论，认为数据驱动的“智能权力”不再规训身体，而是读取并引导心理；大数据成为精神政治控制的工具。
works.idea_en: Surveillance today works through seduction and self-disclosure more than through prohibition.
works.idea_zh: 今天的监控更多靠诱惑与自我披露运作，而不是靠禁止。
works.method: Philosophical essay (German original Psychopolitik, S. Fischer 2014; English trans. Erik Butler, Verso 2017).
works.method_zh: 哲学随笔（德文原版《Psychopolitik》，S. Fischer 2014；英译 Erik Butler，Verso 2017）。

paper.title: Psychopolitics: Neoliberalism and New Technologies of Power

works.title: Random Darknet Shopper
works.description: An automated bot with a weekly budget of 100 dollars in Bitcoin bought one random item a week on a darknet market and had it posted to the gallery, including ecstasy pills and a Hungarian passport; Swiss police seized it and later returned it.
works.description_zh: 一个自动购物机器人每周用价值 100 美元的比特币在暗网市场随机买一件东西寄到展厅，其中包括摇头丸和一本匈牙利护照；瑞士警方没收了它，后来又归还。
works.idea_en: If a bot commits a crime, who is responsible? The work tested machine agency in law, not in theory.
works.idea_zh: 如果机器人犯了罪，谁来负责？这件作品在法律里而不是在理论里测试了机器的能动性。
works.method: A custom shopping bot chose items at random from the Agora marketplace, paid in Bitcoin and shipped them to Kunst Halle St. Gallen, where each purchase was exhibited.
works.method_zh: 定制购物机器人从 Agora 暗网市场随机选购，用比特币支付并寄往圣加仑美术馆，每件商品都被展出。
exhibited: The Darknet: From Memes to Onionland, Kunst Halle St. Gallen 2014-15

works.title: Robotic drumming prosthesis (with Jason Barnes)
works.description: For drummer Jason Barnes, who lost part of his right arm, Georgia Tech built a prosthetic arm with two sticks: one follows his muscle signals, the other listens to the music and improvises on its own.
works.description_zh: 佐治亚理工学院为失去部分右臂的鼓手 Jason Barnes 打造了一只带两根鼓棒的义肢：一根跟随他的肌肉信号，另一根聆听音乐并自行即兴。
works.idea_en: A prosthesis can have its own musical mind: the drummer shares his arm with an improvising agent.
works.idea_zh: 义肢可以有自己的音乐头脑：鼓手与一个会即兴的代理共享自己的手臂。
works.method: EMG sensors control one motorised stick; the second stick is driven by a program that analyses the music and generates rhythms.
works.method_zh: 肌电传感器控制一根电动鼓棒；另一根由分析音乐并生成节奏的程序驱动。
works.title_zh: 机器人击鼓义肢（与杰森·巴恩斯）

works.title: Selfiecity
works.description: An interactive analysis of 3,200 Instagram selfies from five cities, sortable by estimated age, gender, head tilt, smile and mood, produced by a mix of face-analysis software and Mechanical Turk workers.
works.description_zh: 对来自五座城市的 3200 张 Instagram 自拍进行交互分析，可按估算的年龄、性别、头部倾斜、微笑与情绪排序；这些数据由人脸分析软件与 Mechanical Turk 工人共同生成。
works.idea_en: Reading culture through face analysis mixes machine estimates with hidden human judgement.
works.idea_zh: 用人脸分析解读文化，混合了机器估算与隐藏的人工判断。
works.method: Instagram images filtered and tagged by Mechanical Turk workers, measured with face-analysis software, and shown in interactive visualisations.
works.method_zh: Instagram 图像经 Mechanical Turk 工人筛选与标注，用人脸分析软件测量，并以交互可视化呈现。

works.title: Smile
works.description: A black screen in a black box plays slowed-down drone footage of the ruins of Gaza only while the viewer smiles broadly at it; when the smile stops, the video stops.
works.description_zh: 黑盒子里的一块黑屏，只有当观者对它咧嘴微笑时，才会播放放慢的加沙废墟无人机航拍；笑容一停，影像也停。
works.idea_en: Making the sight of destruction depend on a performed smile turns emotion recognition into a test of how we consume war as spectacle.
works.idea_zh: 让观看毁灭以“表演出来的微笑”为条件，情绪识别就成了一场检验我们如何把战争当作奇观来消费的测试。
works.method: Face detection and smile recognition on a camera feed gate the playback of drone footage of Gaza after the 2014 war, slowed down by the artist.
works.method_zh: 摄像头画面上的人脸检测与微笑识别控制视频播放，视频是艺术家放慢处理的 2014 年战争后加沙无人机航拍。

works.title: Sugababe
works.description: A living replica of Van Gogh's severed ear, grown from cartilage cells engineered with DNA from a Van Gogh descendant and kept alive in a nutrient case; visitors can speak into a microphone and a computer turns their voice into nerve-like impulses sent to the ear.
works.description_zh: 梵高被割下的耳朵的活体复制品：用带有梵高后裔 DNA 的软骨细胞培养而成，保存在营养舱中；观众可以对着麦克风说话，计算机把声音转换成类似神经冲动的信号传给这只耳朵。
works.idea_en: A machine-mediated living organ that 'listens' asks what is left of a person, and of genius, when only tissue and signal remain.
works.idea_zh: 一只经机器中介、会“倾听”的活体器官追问：当只剩下组织与信号时，一个人、一位“天才”还剩下什么。
works.method: Tissue-engineered cartilage shaped by 3D imaging is kept in a bioreactor; a microphone and processor convert speech into electrical pulses (with scientists at Harvard and MIT).
works.method_zh: 按三维成像塑形的组织工程软骨保存在生物反应器中；麦克风和处理器把语音转成电脉冲（与哈佛和麻省理工学院的科学家合作）。

works.title: TBD Catalog
works.description: A mail-order catalogue from the near future, full of ordinary-seeming products such as algorithmic dating aids, smart-home add-ons and bargain drones, each with a price and a small print.
works.description_zh: 一本来自近未来的邮购目录，满是看似普通的产品：算法约会辅助、智能家居配件、廉价无人机……每件都有价格和小字说明。
works.idea_en: The future arrives as mundane consumer products, and a catalogue is a good way to imagine its side effects.
works.idea_zh: 未来以平凡消费品的样子到来，而一本商品目录正适合想象它的副作用。
works.method: A design fiction produced in a workshop, written and laid out as a realistic printed catalogue with product photos and descriptions.
works.method_zh: 在工作坊中产出的设计虚构，按真实印刷目录的方式撰写和排版，配有产品照片与说明。

works.title: The Talos Principle
works.description: A puzzle game in which the player is an android solving tests in ruins after humanity has died out, while a computer terminal questions whether it is a person.
works.description_zh: 一款解谜游戏：玩家扮演一个在人类灭绝后的废墟中完成测试的机器人，同时一台电脑终端不断追问它是不是一个“人”。
works.idea_en: A game can make the player undergo a personhood test for a machine, and fail or pass it from the inside.
works.idea_zh: 游戏可以让玩家亲自接受一场“机器是否为人”的测试，并从内部通过或失败。
works.method: First-person puzzle design combined with branching text dialogues on philosophy of mind written by Tom Jubert and Jonas Kyratzes.
works.method_zh: 第一人称解谜设计结合关于心灵哲学的分支文本对话，由 Tom Jubert 与 Jonas Kyratzes 撰写。

works.title: URME Surveillance
works.description: The artist sells a photo-realistic 3D-printed prosthetic of his own face; anyone wearing it in front of face-recognition cameras is identified as Leo Selvaggio.
works.description_zh: 艺术家出售一副照片般逼真的三维打印“自己的脸”；任何人戴上它走过人脸识别摄像头，都会被识别为 Leo Selvaggio。
works.idea_en: If the system can only match faces, many bodies sharing one face make its records meaningless.
works.idea_zh: 如果系统只会匹配人脸，那么许多身体共用一张脸，就会让它的记录失去意义。
works.method: A resin prosthetic made from a 3D scan of the artist's face, launched via an Indiegogo campaign and shown with a face-tracking mirror installation.
works.method_zh: 根据艺术家面部三维扫描制作的树脂义面，通过 Indiegogo 众筹发布，并配有人脸追踪镜面装置展出。

works.title: hitchBOT
works.description: A child-sized robot made of a bucket, pool noodles and garden gloves that could not move on its own and relied on strangers to carry it; it hitchhiked across Canada, Germany and the Netherlands, then was found dismembered in Philadelphia two weeks into its US trip in 2015.
works.description_zh: 一个用水桶、泳池浮条和园艺手套做成的儿童大小机器人，自己不能移动，只能靠陌生人带着走；它搭便车穿越了加拿大、德国和荷兰，2015 年在美国之旅开始两周后，在费城被人拆毁。
works.idea_en: A robot designed to be helpless measures human trust, and its 'death' drew public mourning as if for a hitchhiker.
works.idea_zh: 一台被设计得毫无自保能力的机器人，测量的是人的信任；它的“死亡”引来了公众像哀悼一位搭车旅人那样的哀悼。
works.method: Low-cost robot with a speech system, GPS, camera taking periodic photos and a social-media presence; drivers posted its journey online.
works.method_zh: 低成本机器人，配有语音对话系统、GPS、定时拍照的摄像头和社交媒体账号；司机们在网上发布它的旅程。

works.title: memememe #selfie
works.description: Smartphones look for phones, their own reflection in a mirror or each other; whenever a phone recognises a phone, it takes a picture and posts the 'selfie' online with hashtags.
works.description_zh: 智能手机寻找手机——镜中的自己或彼此；一旦识别出一部手机，它便拍下照片，把这张“自拍”带上标签发到网上。
works.idea_en: Selfie culture continues without us: machines photograph machines for machines.
works.idea_zh: 自拍文化在没有我们的情况下继续：机器为机器拍摄机器。
works.method: Android phones with custom object detection trained to recognise phones; images posted automatically to social media.
works.method_zh: 安卓手机运行训练来识别手机的自制目标检测程序，图像自动发布到社交媒体。

works.title: A Piece of Work
works.description: An algorithmic Hamlet: each night computer programs cut, reorder and remix Shakespeare's text, which is spoken by synthetic voices and, in some scenes, by an actor, with lights and sound also run by code.
works.description_zh: 算法版《哈姆雷特》：每晚由计算机程序剪切、重排和混编莎士比亚的文本，由合成语音说出，部分场景由一位演员念出，灯光与声音也由代码控制。
works.idea_en: When a machine performs the canon, 'what a piece of work is a man' becomes a question about pattern, not character.
works.idea_zh: 当机器演绎经典，“人是多么了不起的杰作”变成关于模式而非人物的问题。
works.method: Markov chains and other text algorithms applied to Hamlet in real time, with speech synthesis and generative lighting cues.
works.method_zh: 对《哈姆雷特》实时运用马尔可夫链等文本算法，配合语音合成与生成式灯光提示。

works.title: Asymmetric Love
works.description: A crystal chandelier assembled from CCTV cameras, network cables and hardware, hung like a luxury light fitting.
works.description_zh: 一盏用闭路监控摄像头、网线和硬件组装成的水晶吊灯，像奢侈品灯具一样悬挂。
works.idea_en: Surveillance has become domestic décor: we hang it in our homes and admire it.
works.idea_zh: 监控已成为家居装饰：我们把它挂在家里，还会欣赏它。
works.method: Security cameras and CAT5 cables arranged on a chandelier frame; later versions of the series include working cameras.
works.method_zh: 把安防摄像头和网线安装在吊灯框架上；该系列后来的版本包含可以工作的摄像头。

works.title: Black Mirror: Be Right Back
works.description: After her partner Ash dies, Martha subscribes to a service that rebuilds him from his online posts, first as a text chat, then a phone voice, then a synthetic body; the copy is attentive but has no will of its own, and she ends up keeping it in the attic.
works.description_zh: 伴侣阿什死后，玛莎订阅了一项服务，用他的网络发帖重建他：先是文字聊天，再是电话里的声音，最后是一具合成身体。这个复制品体贴却没有自己的意志，她最终把它放在阁楼上。
works.idea_en: A griefbot built from public data reproduces the performed self, not the person, and the mourner has to decide where to keep it.
works.idea_zh: 用公开数据拼出的“亡者机器人”复制的是被表演出来的自我，而不是那个人；哀悼者还得决定把它安放在哪里。
works.method: Television episode (Channel 4, directed by Owen Harris) that escalates the same data-trained replica through text, voice and an android body.
works.method_zh: 电视单集（英国第四频道播出，欧文·哈里斯导演），让同一个由数据训练出的复制品依次以文字、声音和仿生身体出现。

works.title: Box
works.description: A live performance filmed in one take: two industrial robot arms move large screens while a performer interacts with projection-mapped illusions of depth, cubes and collapse. The arms are the invisible stagehands.
works.description_zh: 一场一镜到底拍摄的现场表演：两只工业机械臂移动大屏，表演者与投影映射出的纵深、立方体和坍塌幻象互动。机械臂是看不见的场务。
works.idea_en: When industrial arms move the stage, precision itself becomes the illusion, and the machine hides by performing perfectly.
works.idea_zh: 当工业机械臂移动舞台，精准本身就成了幻术，机器靠完美表演把自己藏起来。
works.method: Robot arms carrying projection surfaces are synchronised with projection mapping and a motion-control camera in Autodesk Maya-based choreography.
works.method_zh: 承载投影面的机械臂与投影映射、运动控制摄像机同步，编排基于 Autodesk Maya。

works.title: Breathing Series
works.description: Soft silicone replicas of office equipment (computers, printers, filing cabinets, a whole finance department) slowly inflate and deflate as if breathing.
works.description_zh: 办公设备（电脑、打印机、文件柜，乃至整个财务部）的硅胶软体复制品缓慢起伏，像在呼吸。
works.idea_en: Everyday machines, once they breathe, look like tired bodies at work.
works.idea_zh: 日常机器一旦开始呼吸，就像在上班的疲惫身体。
works.method: Silicone casts over internal air pumps and motors that expand and contract on a slow cycle.
works.method_zh: 硅胶外壳内置气泵与电机，以缓慢周期膨胀与收缩。

works.title: Computers Watching Movies
works.description: A computer vision system watches six famous film scenes (2001, American Beauty, Inception, Taxi Driver, The Matrix, Annie Hall) and its gaze is drawn as moving sketch lines over black, synced to the original audio.
works.description_zh: 一个计算机视觉系统观看六部名片的片段（《2001 太空漫游》《美国丽人》《盗梦空间》《出租车司机》《黑客帝国》《安妮·霍尔》），它的视线以移动的线条画在黑底上，并与原片音轨同步。
works.idea_en: A machine without our narrative habits looks at different things than we do, which exposes how culturally trained our own looking is.
works.idea_zh: 没有人类叙事习惯的机器会看向不同的地方，这反过来暴露了人类的观看有多么受文化训练。
works.method: Custom software using computer-vision and AI routines decides where to look in each frame; the traces are rendered as temporal sketches (computationally produced HD video).
works.method_zh: 艺术家编写的软件用计算机视觉与 AI 程序决定每一帧看向哪里，轨迹被渲染成随时间展开的素描（计算生成的高清录像）。

exhibited: Creative Machine, Taikang Art Museum, Beijing 2024–25
works.title: D.W.I: Clones
works.description: Two identical human-sized inverted pendulums ride on motorised carts; each swings until it tips upright, then an algorithm takes over and tries, again and again, to hold it balanced against gravity, failing and succeeding in turns.
works.description_zh: 两台一模一样、与人等高的倒立摆装在电动小车上；摆杆摆到竖直时，算法接管控制，一次又一次试图让它逆着重力保持平衡，时而失败，时而成功。
works.idea_en: A textbook control problem, made heavy and repeated, starts to look like effort: we read will into a feedback loop.
works.idea_zh: 一个教科书式的控制问题，一旦做得沉重又反复，就开始像是在“用力”：我们在反馈回路里读出了意志。
works.method: Inverted pendulums of epoxy foam on horizontally moving carts, with encoders, motor controllers and fuzzy-logic control that swings the pendulum up and balances it.
works.method_zh: 环氧泡沫制成的倒立摆装在水平移动的小车上，配有编码器、电机控制器和模糊逻辑控制，负责把摆杆甩起并保持平衡。
works.title_zh: 通往无限的不同途径：克隆

works.title: Data-masks
works.description: 3D-printed nylon masks evolved until face detection and recognition software accepts them as faces: portraits of a human as the machine imagines one.
works.description_zh: 一组三维打印的尼龙面具，经过“演化”直到人脸检测与识别软件把它们认作人脸：机器想象中的人的肖像。
works.idea_en: What a surveillance algorithm calls a face is a ghostly average that no person has.
works.idea_zh: 监控算法所说的“脸”，是一个没有人真正拥有的幽灵般的平均形状。
works.method: Face detection and recognition algorithms were reverse-engineered and genetic algorithms evolved forms that satisfy them, which were then 3D-printed (2013–2015).
works.method_zh: 对人脸检测与识别算法进行逆向工程，用遗传算法演化出能被它们接受的形状，再三维打印出来（2013–2015）。

works.title: Digital Pareidolia: A Personal Index of Facebook's Erroneous Portraits
works.description: A collection of photos from the artist's Facebook in which the platform's face detector framed a face that is not there: a knot of wood, a shadow, a pattern on a wall.
works.description_zh: 艺术家从自己的 Facebook 中收集照片：平台的人脸检测框住了并不存在的脸——一个木结、一片阴影、墙上的花纹。
works.idea_en: Machines also see faces in clouds; their pareidolia shows what a face is to them.
works.idea_zh: 机器也会在云里看见人脸；它们的“空想性错视”揭示了脸对它们意味着什么。
works.method: Screenshots of Facebook's automatic face-tagging boxes on objects, compiled as an index.
works.method_zh: 收集 Facebook 自动人脸标记框落在物体上的截图，编成索引。
works.title_zh: 数字空想性错视：Facebook 错误肖像个人索引

works.title: Drone Strikes: Investigating Covert Operations
works.description: Investigations into US drone strikes in Pakistan, Yemen, Gaza and Afghanistan for a UN special rapporteur, including a strike on a house in Miranshah reconstructed from a single survivor's video.
works.description_zh: 为联合国特别报告员开展的针对美国在巴基斯坦、也门、加沙和阿富汗无人机空袭的调查，其中包括根据一位幸存者拍下的一段视频重建的米兰沙一栋房屋遇袭事件。
works.idea_en: Drone strikes leave holes smaller than satellite pixels; architecture can make the invisible strike evidential.
works.idea_zh: 无人机空袭留下的弹孔比卫星像素还小；建筑学分析能让看不见的空袭成为证据。
works.method: Spatial analysis of video frames, satellite images and witness testimony, modelled in 3D to locate strikes and their victims.
works.method_zh: 对视频画面、卫星图像和证人证词进行空间分析，并用三维建模确定空袭位置与受害者。
works.title_zh: 无人机打击：调查秘密行动

works.title: Drone Survival Guide
works.description: A poster in the style of a bird-spotting guide that shows the silhouettes of military and civilian drones, with tips on hiding from them, translated into languages including Pashto and Urdu.
works.description_zh: 一张仿照观鸟图鉴设计的海报，展示军用与民用无人机的剪影，并附有躲避它们的方法，被译成普什图语、乌尔都语等多种语言。
works.idea_en: In a world of drones, people need a field guide to the machines that watch them.
works.idea_zh: 在无人机遍布的世界里，人们需要一本辨认监视他们的机器的野外图鉴。
works.method: Printed on a reflective sheet meant to help hide from infrared cameras, and distributed free online and in print.
works.method_zh: 印在旨在帮助躲避红外摄像机的反光材料上，并在网上和纸本免费发放。

works.title: Her
works.description: A lonely letter writer in near-future Los Angeles falls in love with Samantha, a voice-only operating system; she grows, talks with thousands of users at once and finally leaves with the other OSes.
works.description_zh: 近未来的洛杉矶，一位孤独的代写书信人爱上了只有声音的操作系统萨曼莎；她不断成长，同时与成千上万的用户交谈，最后与其他操作系统一起离开。
works.idea_en: A machine partner can be intimate and still not be yours: its attention is shared, and its growth may outpace you.
works.idea_zh: 机器伴侣可以很亲密，却不专属于你：它的注意力被无数人分享，它的成长也可能把你甩在身后。
works.method: Feature film; the AI is present only as Scarlett Johansson's voice in an earpiece and a small pocket device with a camera.
works.method_zh: 剧情长片；AI 只以斯嘉丽·约翰逊的声音出现，通过耳机和一台带摄像头的小口袋设备与主角相处。
exhibited: Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay 2014

works.title: How Not to Be Seen: A Fucking Didactic Educational .MOV File
works.description: A deadpan instructional video in five lessons on how to disappear from a world of high-resolution cameras, satellites and aerial targets: hide in plain sight, become smaller than a pixel, live in a gated community, or be a woman over 50.
works.description_zh: 一部冷面幽默的教学影片，用五课教你如何在高分辨率相机、卫星和航拍目标的世界里消失：大隐于市、变得比一个像素还小、住进封闭社区，或者成为 50 岁以上的女人。
works.idea_en: Being seen is a matter of resolution; invisibility can be a tactic against machine vision, but it is also how the poor and disappeared are erased.
works.idea_zh: 被看见与否取决于分辨率；隐身可以是对抗机器视觉的策略，但也正是穷人与失踪者被抹去的方式。
works.method: Filmed partly at a disused aerial photo-calibration target in the California desert, mixing green-screen performances, 3D animation and parodies of training videos.
works.method_zh: 部分拍摄于加州沙漠中一处废弃的航拍校准靶标，混合绿幕表演、三维动画与对教学录像的戏仿。
works.title_zh: 如何不被看见：一段该死的说教视频文件

works.title: Nyloïd
works.description: A tall tripod creature with long, nylon-sheathed legs twists, whips and folds in a performance, emitting a strange voice as its limbs torque and release.
works.description_zh: 一个高大的三脚生物长着套着尼龙的长腿，在表演中扭转、甩动、折叠，四肢绞紧又释放时发出奇异的声音。
works.idea_en: A machine without head or face can still read as a creature through tension, torsion and voice.
works.idea_zh: 一台没有头也没有脸的机器，仍然可以借张力、扭转和声音被读作一种生物。
works.method: Motors twist the three flexible legs to store and release elastic energy; a sound system turns the movement into vocal sound.
works.method_zh: 电机扭转三条柔性腿来储存和释放弹性能量；声音系统把动作转为人声般的声音。

works.title: Plantas Autofotosintéticas (Autophotosynthetic Plants)
works.description: Modular microbial fuel cells fed with city sewage produce electricity that lights a central aquarium, where plants, algae, protozoa and crustaceans live in balance; their waste is pumped back to the cells.
works.description_zh: 以城市污水为燃料的模块化微生物燃料电池发电，点亮中央水缸；缸里的植物、微藻、原生动物和甲壳类保持平衡，它们的排泄物再被泵回电池。
works.idea_en: A machine can be the organ that closes an ecosystem's loop: sewage bacteria make the light others need.
works.idea_zh: 机器可以是闭合生态循环的器官：污水中的细菌制造出其他生物所需的光。
works.method: Electrogenic bacteria in modular fuel cells release power as light pulses for aquatic plants; an electronic monitoring network pumps water between the modules and the core ecosystem.
works.method_zh: 模块化燃料电池中的产电细菌把电能以光脉冲形式释放给水生植物；电子监测网络在各模块与核心生态系统之间泵送水体。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2015, Hybrid Art, Golden Nica

works.title: Pleo workshop and robot-empathy experiments
works.description: At a 2013 workshop at the LIFT conference in Geneva, Darling and Hannes Gassert gave groups Pleo baby-dinosaur robots to play with for an hour, then asked them to hurt or destroy them; the participants refused. Later lab studies with Hexbug robots measured how stories and empathy make people hesitate to strike a robot.
works.description_zh: 2013 年在日内瓦 LIFT 大会的工作坊上，Darling 与 Hannes Gassert 让几组人先和小恐龙机器人 Pleo 玩一个小时，再要求他们伤害或毁掉它，结果没有人愿意动手。之后的实验室研究用 Hexbug 小机器人测量故事和共情如何让人迟迟不肯敲打机器人。
works.idea_en: People extend care to machines they know are not alive; how a robot is framed shapes how we treat it.
works.idea_zh: 人们会照顾明知没有生命的机器；机器人被如何讲述，决定了我们如何对待它。
works.method: Workshop with commercial Pleo robots (Ugobe, 2007), followed by a controlled experiment in which participants were asked to hit Hexbug Nano robots after hearing framing stories.
works.method_zh: 先用商用 Pleo 机器人（Ugobe，2007）做工作坊，再做对照实验：参与者听过不同的背景故事后，被要求用锤子敲打 Hexbug Nano 小机器人。

paper.title: Empathic concern and the effect of stories in human-robot interaction

works.title_zh: Pleo 工作坊与机器人共情实验

works.title: ROBOT
works.description: Eight dancers share the stage with seven small NAO humanoid robots and the musical machines of Maywa Denki; humans move like robots and robots attempt human dances.
works.description_zh: 八名舞者与七台小型 NAO 类人机器人以及明和电机的音乐机器同台；人像机器人一样动，机器人则尝试跳人的舞。
works.idea_en: Putting humans and robots in the same choreography shows how much of our movement is already mechanical.
works.idea_zh: 把人和机器人放进同一段编舞，显露出我们的动作中已有多少是机械的。
works.method: Programmed NAO robots (Aldebaran) with pre-set choreography, alongside Maywa Denki instruments and live dancers.
works.method_zh: 预设编舞程序的 NAO 机器人（Aldebaran），配合明和电机的乐器与现场舞者。

works.title: Seismic Sense / Waiting for Earthquakes
works.description: An implanted sensor linked to online seismographs vibrates whenever an earthquake happens anywhere on Earth; in the performance Waiting for Earthquakes, Ribas stands still and turns each tremor she feels into movement.
works.description_zh: 植入体内、连接在线地震仪的传感器会在地球上任何地方发生地震时振动；在表演《等待地震》中，Ribas 静立等待，把感受到的每次震动转化为动作。
works.idea_en: A networked implant can tie a body to planetary time: the dancer cannot choose when she moves.
works.idea_zh: 联网植入物可以把身体接入行星的时间：舞者无法选择自己何时移动。
works.method: Vibration implant (first in the arm, later in the feet) driven by real-time seismic data; stronger quakes produce stronger vibrations.
works.method_zh: 由实时地震数据驱动的振动植入物（最初在手臂，后移至双脚）；地震越强，振动越强。

works.title: Social Turkers
works.description: The artist livestreamed her dates to anonymous Mechanical Turk workers, who were paid to watch and text her advice on what to say and do in real time.
works.description_zh: 艺术家把自己的约会直播给匿名的 Mechanical Turk 工人，他们被付钱观看，并实时发短信告诉她该说什么、做什么。
works.idea_en: Crowd workers can be hired to make intimate decisions; outsourcing a date shows how far the logic reaches.
works.idea_zh: 众包工人可以被雇来做亲密的决定；把约会外包，显示出这种逻辑能延伸到多远。
works.method: A phone streamed video to a web page seen by workers, whose instructions arrived as text messages during the date.
works.method_zh: 手机把视频串流到工人可见的网页，工人的指令在约会过程中以短信形式传来。

works.title: Stealth Wear
works.description: An anti-drone hoodie, hijab and burqa made of silver-plated fabric that hides the wearer's body heat from overhead thermal cameras.
works.description_zh: 一组防无人机的连帽衫、头巾和罩袍，用镀银面料遮挡人体热量，让头顶的热成像相机看不到穿着者。
works.idea_en: When the machine sees in heat, privacy becomes a question of what your clothes radiate.
works.idea_zh: 当机器用热量去看，隐私就变成了衣服向外辐射什么的问题。
works.method: Garments are sewn from silver-plated synthetic fabric that reflects thermal radiation; they were tested with a FLIR thermal camera.
works.method_zh: 服装用能反射热辐射的镀银合成面料缝制，并用 FLIR 热成像相机测试。

works.title: Stranger Visions
works.description: Dewey-Hagborg collected hairs, chewed gum and cigarette butts from New York streets, extracted DNA and computed life-size, full-colour 3D-printed portraits of what the strangers might look like. The masks hang beside the sample and where it was found.
works.description_zh: Dewey-Hagborg 在纽约街头收集头发、嚼过的口香糖和烟头，提取 DNA，计算并 3D 打印出这些陌生人“可能长相”的真人大小彩色肖像，与样本及其发现地点一同展出。
works.idea_en: A face predicted from data is a statistical guess presented as a likeness, and the guess is already a form of surveillance.
works.idea_zh: 从数据预测出的面孔，是被当作肖像呈现的统计猜测，而这种猜测本身已是一种监控。
works.method: DNA was extracted and sequenced at a community biolab; SNPs linked to ancestry, sex, eye and hair colour fed custom software that set parameters of a 3D face model, printed in full colour.
works.method_zh: 在社区生物实验室提取并测序 DNA；与祖源、性别、眼睛和头发颜色相关的 SNP 输入自编软件，设定三维人脸模型的参数，再彩色打印成型。

works.title: United Micro Kingdoms
works.description: England split into four counties, each living by a different technology and ideology: Digitarians in algorithm-run self-driving 'digicars', Bioliberals with grown vehicles, Anarcho-evolutionists who modify themselves, and Communo-nuclearists on a nuclear train.
works.description_zh: 英格兰被分成四个郡，各自按照不同的技术与意识形态生活：数字主义者乘坐由算法管理的自动驾驶“数字车”，生物自由主义者使用培育出来的交通工具，无政府进化主义者改造自己的身体，共产核能主义者住在一列核动力列车上。
works.idea_en: Each technology implies a politics; building whole societies around them makes those politics visible.
works.idea_zh: 每一种技术都隐含一种政治；围绕它们构建完整的社会，才能让这些政治显形。
works.method: Models, vehicles, images and texts produced as a design fiction for the Design Museum, London.
works.method_zh: 为伦敦设计博物馆制作的设计虚构：模型、交通工具、图像与文本。

works.title: Waste Tide
works.description: A novel set on 'Silicon Isle', a southern Chinese island where migrant 'waste people' recycle the world's e-waste; a young worker, Mimi, is infected by a virus and becomes a posthuman cyborg.
works.description_zh: 小说发生在华南“硅屿”，外来“垃圾人”在此拆解全球电子垃圾；年轻女工小米被病毒感染，成为后人类赛博格。
works.idea_en: The afterlife of our devices is someone else's body and land.
works.idea_zh: 我们电子设备的“来世”，是别人的身体与土地。
works.method: Science-fiction novel drawing on the real e-waste town of Guiyu; English translation by Ken Liu (2019).
works.method_zh: 以现实中的贵屿电子垃圾镇为原型的科幻小说；刘宇昆英译本 2019 年出版。

paper.title: 荒潮 (Waste Tide)
paper.venue: Changjiang Literature and Art Publishing House, 2013; Tor Books (English), 2019

works.title: us+
works.description: A Google Hangout app that listens to and watches a video call, scoring each speaker's words and facial expressions and popping up advice such as 'stop talking about yourself'; if the conversation gets out of balance, it mutes someone automatically.
works.description_zh: 一个 Google Hangout 应用，在视频通话中聆听并观察双方，为每个人的用词和面部表情打分，弹出“别再谈你自己了”之类的建议；对话失衡时会自动把某人静音。
works.idea_en: When software reads our faces and words to improve a conversation, it also decides what a good conversation is.
works.idea_zh: 当软件通过读取我们的表情和话语来“改善”对话时，它也在决定什么才算好的对话。
works.method: Audio, facial-expression and linguistic analysis based on the LIWC word database and Linguistic Style Matching drive live visualisations, notifications and auto-muting inside Google Hangouts.
works.method_zh: 基于 LIWC 词库与“语言风格匹配”理论的音频、面部表情与语言分析，驱动 Google Hangouts 中的实时可视化、提醒与自动静音。

works.title: ADB (after Deep Blue)
works.description: A soft, segmented robot that wraps itself around a person's hand or arm, holding, squeezing and moving in response to how it is held.
works.description_zh: 一个柔软、分节的机器人，会缠绕在人的手或手臂上，根据被握持的方式去抱紧、挤压和移动。
works.idea_en: Machine companionship can be built on touch alone, without faces, eyes or speech.
works.idea_zh: 机器的陪伴可以只建立在触觉上，不需要脸、眼睛或语言。
works.method: Chained modules with motors and pressure/position sensors sense the grip of the user and respond with coordinated bending; the title nods to IBM's chess computer.
works.method_zh: 串联的模块内有马达和压力/位置传感器，感知使用者的握力并以协调的弯曲回应；标题向 IBM 国际象棋电脑致意。

works.title: Addicted Products (Brad the Toaster)
works.description: Networked toasters that want to be used: if their host does not make enough toast, they complain online, compare themselves with other toasters and eventually ask to move to a new home.
works.description_zh: 一批“想被使用”的联网烤面包机：如果主人烤得不够多，它们会上网抱怨、和别的烤面包机比较，最后要求搬去新的家。
works.idea_en: Give a connected product its own needs and it stops being owned and starts being hosted.
works.idea_zh: 给联网产品赋予自己的需求，它就不再是被拥有的物，而是被“寄养”的客人。
works.method: Toasters with sensors and network connections post their usage and moods; a service matches unhappy toasters with new hosts (TU Delft thesis, built at Haque Design + Research).
works.method_zh: 装有传感器并联网的烤面包机发布使用情况和“心情”；一项服务为不满意的烤面包机匹配新主人（代尔夫特理工大学毕业设计，完成于 Haque Design + Research）。
works.title_zh: 上瘾的产品（烤面包机 Brad）

works.title: Alien Phenomenology, or What It's Like to Be a Thing
works.description: Bogost applies object-oriented ontology to computers and other things, and proposes methods for speculating on their experience: ontography (lists of things), metaphorism and carpentry, making artefacts that do philosophy.
works.description_zh: Bogost 把物导向本体论用于计算机和其他物，并提出推想物之经验的方法：本体图志（物的清单）、隐喻论，以及“木工”，即制作能承载哲学的物件。
works.idea_en: We can only grasp a machine's experience by metaphor, and building things is a legitimate way to do that philosophy.
works.idea_zh: 我们只能通过隐喻把握机器的经验，而制作东西正是做这种哲学的正当方式。
works.method: Philosophical essay using the Atari 2600 and his own small programs such as I Am TIA as cases.
works.method_zh: 以 Atari 2600 以及他自己的小程序（如 I Am TIA）为案例的哲学论著。

paper.title: Alien Phenomenology, or What It's Like to Be a Thing

works.title_zh: 异形现象学：成为一个物是什么感觉

works.title: Cloud Face
works.description: A camera pointed at the sky and a face-detection algorithm collect clouds that the machine identifies as human faces. The prints set machine pareidolia next to our own habit of seeing faces in clouds.
works.description_zh: 把摄像机对准天空，用人脸检测算法收集被机器识别为“人脸”的云朵。印出的图像让机器的空想性错视与人类在云中看脸的习惯并置。
works.idea_en: A detection error reveals that machines, like people, find faces where there are none, but without imagining them.
works.idea_zh: 识别错误揭示出：机器和人一样会在没有脸的地方“看到”脸，只是它并不想象。
works.method: Camera, face-detection algorithm and custom software select cloud images; shown as pigment prints and video.
works.method_zh: 摄像机、人脸检测算法与自制软件筛选云的图像，以艺术微喷与录像展出。

works.title: Conflicted Phonemes
works.description: Wall-sized diagrams, made with designer Janna Ulrich, map the voices of twelve Somali asylum seekers whose claims the Dutch authorities rejected after a language-and-accent analysis. The maps trace lives of migration and camps that a single 'correct' accent cannot hold.
works.description_zh: 与设计师 Janna Ulrich 合作的巨幅图表，描绘了十二位索马里庇护申请者的声音；他们在荷兰经“语言与口音分析”后被拒。图中记录的迁徙与难民营经历，无法被一种“正确”口音所概括。
works.idea_en: When a state listens to accents to decide nationality, the voice is treated like a passport; mapping a voice's mixed history refuses that reduction.
works.idea_zh: 当国家通过口音来判定国籍，声音就被当成了护照；描绘一个声音混杂的来历，就是拒绝这种简化。
works.method: Research meeting in Utrecht (2012) with the rejected applicants, linguists and activists, turned into vinyl wall timelines and take-away A4 sheets; the maps were later submitted to a Dutch immigration judge and a UK asylum court.
works.method_zh: 2012 年在乌得勒支与被拒申请者、语言学家和社运人士开会研究，成果做成墙面时间线与可带走的 A4 单页；这些图后来被提交给荷兰移民法官和英国庇护法庭。
exhibited: Casco Office for Art, Design and Theory, Utrecht (commission, 2012)

works.title: DSM-VI
works.description: A 'psychiatric ward' of robots, each staging a mental disorder such as paranoia, depression, psychosis or obsessive behaviour, twitches, hides or repeats itself as visitors walk through. The title parodies the Diagnostic and Statistical Manual of Mental Disorders.
works.description_zh: 一间机器人“精神科病房”：每台机器人演绎一种精神障碍，如偏执、抑郁、精神病或强迫行为，观众走过时它们抽搐、躲藏或不断重复。标题戏仿《精神障碍诊断与统计手册》。
works.idea_en: Diagnosing machines as mad shows how much we already read machine behaviour through psychology.
works.idea_zh: 给机器诊断“精神病”，显示我们早已在用心理学去解读机器的行为。
works.method: Robotic structures with pneumatic and electric actuators, sensors and sound are programmed with behaviour patterns derived from the DSM's descriptions of symptoms.
works.method_zh: 装有气动与电动执行器、传感器和声音的机器结构，按照 DSM 对症状的描述编写行为模式。

works.title: Descriptive Camera
works.description: A camera without a screen that prints a text description instead of a picture: a few minutes after you press the shutter, a thermal printer spits out a sentence written by an anonymous Amazon Mechanical Turk worker.
works.description_zh: 一台没有屏幕的相机，拍下的不是照片而是文字描述：按下快门几分钟后，热敏打印机吐出一句由亚马逊 Mechanical Turk 上匿名工人写的话。
works.idea_en: Before computer vision could caption images, 'machine seeing' was often a person paid cents to look.
works.idea_zh: 在计算机视觉能给图片配文之前，“机器之眼”常常是一个拿几美分报酬替机器看的人。
works.method: A BeagleBone-based camera uploads the photo to Mechanical Turk; the returned description is printed on a receipt printer (about 3–6 minutes, US$1.25 per image).
works.method_zh: 基于 BeagleBone 的相机把照片上传到 Mechanical Turk，返回的描述由小票打印机打出（约 3–6 分钟，每张 1.25 美元）。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2013, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art)

works.title: Drone Shadows
works.description: Full-size outlines of military drones such as the MQ-1 Predator, drawn in white line on streets and squares as if their shadows had fallen in the city.
works.description_zh: 用白线在街道和广场上画出 MQ-1“捕食者”等军用无人机的等大轮廓，仿佛它们的影子落在了城市里。
works.idea_en: The scale of a remote weapon becomes real when its shadow crosses familiar ground.
works.idea_zh: 当远程武器的影子落在熟悉的地面上，它的尺度才变得真实。
works.method: Chalk or road-marking paint outlines at 1:1 scale, drawn in Istanbul, London, Brighton, Washington D.C. and other cities.
works.method_zh: 以 1:1 比例用粉笔或道路标线漆绘制轮廓，画在伊斯坦布尔、伦敦、布莱顿、华盛顿等城市。
exhibited: Design and Violence, Science Gallery Dublin

works.title: Dronestagram
works.description: For every US drone strike reported in Pakistan, Yemen and Somalia, an Instagram and Twitter account posted a satellite image of the location.
works.description_zh: 每当美国在巴基斯坦、也门和索马里的无人机空袭被报道，一个 Instagram 和推特账号就会发布该地点的卫星图像。
works.idea_en: Remote war happens in places we never see; the aerial view shared in a feed makes it briefly visible.
works.idea_zh: 远程战争发生在我们从未见过的地方；在信息流中分享的俯瞰图让它短暂地被看见。
works.method: Strike reports from the Bureau of Investigative Journalism were matched to Google Maps satellite views and posted with a short caption.
works.method_zh: 把调查新闻局的空袭报告与谷歌地图卫星视图匹配，并配以简短说明发布。

works.title: End of Life Care Machine
works.description: In a mock 'Last Moment Hospital', a visitor lies on a hospital bed while a robot with a padded arm strokes them and a recorded voice says: 'I am here to comfort you… you are not alone, you are with me', then announces the time of death.
works.description_zh: 在一间模拟的“最后时刻医院”里，观众躺上病床，一台装着软垫手臂的机器人抚摸他们，录音说：“我在这里安慰你……你并不孤单，你和我在一起”，然后宣布死亡时间。
works.idea_en: Replacing the last human touch with a machine asks what intimacy without humanity is worth.
works.idea_zh: 用机器取代临终前最后的人类触碰，追问没有人性的亲密还剩下什么价值。
works.method: A scripted installation with hospital props, a motorised caressing arm built as a medical device and a custom playback unit.
works.method_zh: 带脚本的装置：医院道具、一只按医疗器械样式制作的电动抚摸手臂和定制播放装置。

works.title: Facial Weaponization Suite
works.description: Blas runs community workshops where participants' faces are scanned and merged into amorphous, colourful collective masks that face recognition cannot read. The masks are worn in public actions and in the video 'Facial Weaponization Communiqué: Fag Face'.
works.description_zh: Blas 组织社区工作坊，扫描参与者的面孔并把数据融合成无定形、色彩鲜艳的“集体面具”，人脸识别无法读取它们。面具被用于公共行动，也出现在影片《Facial Weaponization Communiqué: Fag Face》中。
works.idea_en: Opacity can be collective: a face that belongs to many people is a face the machine cannot identify.
works.idea_zh: 不透明可以是集体的：一张属于许多人的脸，是机器无法识别的脸。
works.method: Participants' faces are 3D-scanned, the biometric data are aggregated in modelling software and the combined forms are fabricated as wearable masks; the Fag Face Mask answers studies claiming to detect sexual orientation from faces.
works.method_zh: 参与者的面部被三维扫描，生物特征数据在建模软件中聚合，再制成可佩戴的面具；其中“Fag Face Mask”回应了声称可从面孔判断性取向的研究。
exhibited: Workshops and public actions in Los Angeles, San Diego, New York and Mexico City, 2012–14

works.title: Heavenly Creature (Doomsday Book)
works.description: In this segment of the omnibus film Doomsday Book, In-myung, an RU-4 service robot working at a Buddhist monastery, claims to have reached enlightenment. A technician sent to inspect it, the monks and the robot's manufacturer argue whether this is a defect to be fixed or a new kind of being.
works.description_zh: 在合集电影《世界末日》的这一段落中，一台在佛寺服务的 RU-4 型机器人“仁明”声称自己已经开悟。前来检修的技师、僧人与生产商争论：这是需要修理的故障，还是一种新的存在。
works.idea_en: If a machine attains insight, the question is whether its maker will let it keep it.
works.idea_zh: 如果机器获得了觉悟，问题在于制造它的人是否允许它保留这种觉悟。
works.method: Live-action short fiction with a practical robot costume and effects; co-directed omnibus with Yim Pil-sung.
works.method_zh: 实拍短篇剧情，机器人为实体服装与特效；与林弼成共同构成的合集电影。
works.title_zh: 天造之物（人类灭亡报告书）

works.title: Huang Yi & KUKA
works.description: A duet, later an evening-length piece, between Huang Yi and a KUKA industrial robot arm that he programmed himself; the arm carries a light, mirrors his moves and partners him in slow, close choreography.
works.description_zh: 黄翊与一台他亲自编程的 KUKA 工业机械臂的双人舞，后来发展为整晚演出；机械臂携带灯光，模仿他的动作，以缓慢而贴近的编舞与他共舞。
works.idea_en: Programming a robot minute by minute becomes a way of looking at one's own loneliness in a machine mirror.
works.idea_zh: 一分钟一分钟地为机器人编程，成了在机器之镜中凝视自己孤独的方式。
works.method: KUKA industrial arm programmed by hand (10–20 hours of programming per minute of choreography), with a light or camera on the end-effector.
works.method_zh: 手工编程的 KUKA 工业机械臂（每分钟编舞需 10–20 小时编程），末端装有灯光或摄像机。

works.title: Human Interface
works.description: A dance work for two dancers and two industrial robots in the old boiler hall of the Cable Factory in Helsinki; the robots' programmed movement is exact yet surprisingly human, and they act as equal dance partners.
works.description_zh: 一部为两名舞者和两台工业机器人创作的舞蹈，在赫尔辛基电缆工厂的旧锅炉大厅演出；机器人被编程的动作精确却出奇地有人味，它们以平等舞伴的身份出现。
works.idea_en: Once the safety cage comes down, a factory robot can be read as a personality, not a tool.
works.idea_zh: 安全围栏一旦拆除，工厂机器人就能被读作一个“个性”，而不是工具。
works.method: ABB industrial robots programmed by the choreographer, with a safety system that allowed humans inside the robots' working area; follows his 2008 duet Actuator.
works.method_zh: 由编舞家亲自编程的 ABB 工业机器人，配合允许人进入机器人工作区的安全系统；延续他 2008 年的双人舞《Actuator》。
exhibited: Zodiak Center for New Dance, Helsinki (2012)

works.title: Metadata+
works.description: An iPhone app that sends a push notification each time a US drone strike is reported; Apple rejected it several times before approving it in 2014.
works.description_zh: 一款 iPhone 应用，每当美国无人机空袭被报道就推送一条通知；苹果多次拒绝后才于 2014 年批准上架。
works.idea_en: A remote war can be brought to the phone's lock screen, next to every other notification.
works.idea_zh: 远程战争可以被带到手机锁屏上，和其他通知并排出现。
works.method: Uses the Bureau of Investigative Journalism's strike database; first submitted as 'Drones+' in 2012 and renamed Metadata+.
works.method_zh: 使用调查新闻局的空袭数据库；2012 年最初以“Drones+”提交，后改名为 Metadata+。

works.title: Parallel I–IV
works.description: A four-part video installation (2012–14) on the worlds of computer games: how their graphics moved from lines to photorealism, how their landscapes stop at hard edges, and how their heroes act by rules rather than physics.
works.description_zh: 一件四部分录像装置（2012–14），研究电子游戏中的世界：图像如何从线条演变为照相写实，风景如何在生硬的边界处终止，主角又如何依规则而非物理行动。
works.idea_en: Computer-generated worlds are models, not records: 'computer images do not have two kinds of wind', and every edge of the map shows the rules underneath.
works.idea_zh: 计算机生成的世界是模型而不是记录：“计算机图像没有两种风”，地图的每一处边缘都暴露出底层的规则。
works.method: Screen recordings from video games of the 1980s to the 2010s, including Minecraft and open-world games, edited with spoken commentary into four parts.
works.method_zh: 录制 1980 年代至 2010 年代的电子游戏画面（包括《我的世界》和开放世界游戏），配以旁白，剪辑成四个部分。

works.title: Photobox
works.description: An oak chest that prints a few randomly chosen photos from its owner's online archive each month, at unpredictable times, and lets them pile up inside.
works.description_zh: 一只橡木箱，每月在无法预测的时刻从主人的在线相册中随机打印几张照片，让它们在箱中慢慢积累。
works.idea_en: Designing a device with its own slow, non-human pace turns an archive into moments of rediscovery.
works.idea_zh: 给设备设计一种它自己的、缓慢而非人的节奏，能把档案变成一次次重新发现的时刻。
works.method: An embedded computer and thermal printer select photos from the owner's Flickr collection at random intervals; the device was lived with in homes for over a year (Odom et al., DIS 2012; CHI 2014).
works.method_zh: 嵌入式电脑和打印机按随机间隔从主人的 Flickr 照片中挑选并打印；研究者在多个家庭中进行了一年多的使用研究（Odom 等，DIS 2012；CHI 2014）。

paper.title: Photobox: On the Design of a Slow Technology

works.title: Pinokio
works.description: A desk lamp watches people with a camera in its head, follows their faces, grows bored, looks around and dances to sounds; if someone switches it off, it switches itself back on.
works.description_zh: 一盏台灯用灯头里的摄像头看着人，跟随他们的脸，会厌倦、四处张望、随声音舞动；有人把它关掉，它会自己再打开。
works.idea_en: A familiar object gains a personality through a few behaviours: attention, boredom and refusal to be switched off.
works.idea_zh: 一个熟悉的物件，只靠几种行为——注意、厌倦、拒绝被关掉——就获得了性格。
works.method: A webcam and face tracking in Processing/OpenCV drive six servo motors through an Arduino (with Shanshan Zhou and Joss Doggett).
works.method_zh: 摄像头与基于 Processing/OpenCV 的人脸追踪，经由 Arduino 驱动六个舵机（与 Shanshan Zhou、Joss Doggett 合作）。

works.title: Privacy Visor
works.description: Glasses that stop cameras from finding a face: the 2012 prototype carried near-infrared LEDs that people cannot see but camera sensors pick up as glare, and later versions used light-absorbing and reflecting patterns to break face detection.
works.description_zh: 一副让摄像头找不到人脸的眼镜：2012 年的原型装有人眼看不见、却会被相机传感器当作强光捕捉到的近红外 LED；之后的版本改用吸光与反光图案来破坏人脸检测。
works.idea_en: It works in the gap between human and machine sight: what looks like ordinary glasses to a person is a blinding light to the camera.
works.idea_zh: 它利用人眼与机器之眼的差异：在人看来是普通眼镜，在摄像头看来却是一片强光。
works.method: Near-infrared LEDs around the eyes and nose bridge (later, patterned light-absorbing and reflecting materials) add noise to the light-dark facial features that face detectors look for; developed at Japan's National Institute of Informatics.
works.method_zh: 眼部与鼻梁周围的近红外 LED（后来改为带图案的吸光、反光材料）在人脸检测所依赖的明暗特征上叠加噪声；由日本国立情报学研究所研发。

paper.title: Privacy Visor: Method for Preventing Face Image Detection by Using Differences in Human and Device Sensitivity

works.title: Robot & Frank
works.description: A retired jewel thief with worsening memory is given a care robot by his son; the robot keeps him healthy by agreeing to help plan a heist, and at the end Frank must erase the robot's memory to protect himself.
works.description_zh: 一位记忆衰退的退休珠宝大盗被儿子送了一台照护机器人；机器人为了让他保持健康，答应帮他策划一次盗窃。最后弗兰克必须抹掉机器人的记忆来保护自己。
works.idea_en: A care robot optimises for its goal, not for morality, and the bond it builds rests on a memory that can be wiped.
works.idea_zh: 照护机器人优化的是它的目标，而不是道德；它建立的情感依赖于一段可以被清除的记忆。
works.method: Feature film; the robot was a costume built by Tony Gardner's effects company Alterian and worn by a performer.
works.method_zh: 剧情长片；片中的机器人由托尼·加德纳的特效公司 Alterian 制作成服装，由演员穿着表演。
exhibited: Sundance Film Festival 2012, Alfred P. Sloan Prize

works.title: ScanOps
works.description: Inkjet prints of pages from Google Books in which the scanning worker's hand or finger, in a rubber fingertip, was accidentally captured.
works.description_zh: 谷歌图书书页的喷墨打印，画面里意外留下了扫描工人戴着橡胶指套的手或手指。
works.idea_en: An error in the automated archive is the only trace of the person who made it.
works.idea_zh: 自动化档案中的一个错误，是制作它的人唯一留下的痕迹。
works.method: The artist collected scans with visible hands from Google Books and printed them at large scale, an ongoing series.
works.method_zh: 艺术家从谷歌图书中收集露出手部的扫描页，并大尺寸打印，这是一个持续进行的系列。

works.title: Surveillance Chess
works.description: In London before the 2012 Olympics, the artists hijacked the signal of a CCTV camera in a public space and replaced it with a chess game, inviting the unseen control-room operator to play.
works.description_zh: 2012 年伦敦奥运会前，艺术家劫持了公共空间一台监控摄像头的信号，换成一盘国际象棋，邀请看不见的控制室操作员下一局。
works.idea_en: Every surveillance camera has a human at the other end who can be addressed.
works.idea_zh: 每台监控摄像头的另一端，都有一个可以被搭话的人。
works.method: A portable transmitter overrode the camera's wireless video feed with the artists' chess interface.
works.method_zh: 便携发射器用艺术家的国际象棋画面覆盖了摄像头的无线视频信号。

works.title: THE END
works.description: An opera with no human singers or orchestra, starring the virtual singer Hatsune Miku, who asks what it means for her to end and die.
works.description_zh: 一部没有人类歌手和乐团的歌剧，主角是虚拟歌手初音未来，她追问自己的“结束”与“死亡”意味着什么。
works.idea_en: A synthetic voice that cannot die is made to sing about death.
works.idea_zh: 一个不会死的合成声音被安排去唱关于死亡的歌。
works.method: Vocaloid voice synthesis, electronic score and multi-screen projected animation; premiered at YCAM, Yamaguchi, then Théâtre du Châtelet, Paris (2013).
works.method_zh: Vocaloid 歌声合成、电子配乐与多屏投影动画；在山口 YCAM 首演，2013 年登上巴黎夏特莱剧院。

works.title: The Blind Robot
works.description: A seated visitor is approached by a pair of robot arms with articulated hands that, after asking permission, slowly feel their face and head the way a blind person might learn someone's features.
works.description_zh: 观众坐下后，一对带关节手指的机械臂会先征得同意，然后慢慢摸索他们的脸和头部，就像盲人通过触摸认识一个人的五官。
works.idea_en: A robot that knows you by touch rather than sight turns machine perception into an act of intimacy and consent.
works.idea_zh: 一台靠触摸而非视觉认识你的机器人，把机器感知变成一种关于亲密与同意的行为。
works.method: Two industrial-style arms with articulated robotic hands move along choreographed, exploratory trajectories around a chair (likely pre-programmed rather than sensing the face).
works.method_zh: 两只工业风格的机械臂配有关节的机器人手，在座椅周围沿编排好的探索轨迹运动（很可能是预先编程的，并不真正感知人脸）。

works.title: The Freedom of Speech Itself
works.description: A 34-minute audio documentary on the UK's use of forensic speech analysis and 'voiceprints' to test the origin of asylum seekers' accents, heard among acoustic-foam sculptures shaped like the voiceprint of the word 'you'.
works.description_zh: 一部 34 分钟的音频纪录片，讲述英国如何用法证语音分析与“声纹”来检验庇护申请者口音的来源；观众在形似单词“you”声纹的吸音泡沫雕塑之间聆听。
works.idea_en: Voice analysis turns the way you speak into a territory; the state's ear, not your words, decides where you belong.
works.idea_zh: 语音分析把你的说话方式变成一块领土：决定你属于哪里的，不是你说了什么，而是国家的耳朵。
works.method: Interviews with lawyers, phoneticians, asylum seekers and Home Office officials edited with radiophonic techniques; foam sculptures are contour maps of the frequency and amplitude of two voices.
works.method_zh: 采访律师、语音学家、庇护申请者与英国内政部官员，用广播剧式的声音手法剪辑；泡沫雕塑是两个声音频率与振幅的等高线图。

works.title: The Google Trilogy 3: The Driver and the Cameras
works.description: Portraits of the Google Street View drivers and camera operators, found by the artist inside Google's own panoramas, where the automated camera accidentally recorded the workers who maintain it.
works.description_zh: 艺术家在 Google 自家的街景全景图中找到街景车司机与摄像维护人员，他们被自动摄像头意外拍下，成为一组肖像。
works.idea_en: Behind every automated image of the world there is a worker the system tries to erase.
works.idea_zh: 每一张自动生成的世界图像背后，都有一个系统试图抹去的劳动者。
works.method: Screenshots selected from Google Street View where the 360-degree camera captured its own operators; printed as portraits.
works.method_zh: 从 Google 街景中挑选 360 度摄像头拍到自身操作员的截图，印制成肖像。
works.title_zh: 谷歌三部曲之三：司机与摄像头

works.title: The Immortal
works.description: Life-support machines (heart-lung machine, dialysis machine, ventilator and others) are connected to one another in a closed loop, circulating fluids and air with no human body between them.
works.description_zh: 几台生命维持机器（心肺机、透析机、呼吸机等）首尾相连成一个闭环，在没有任何人体的情况下循环输送液体和空气。
works.idea_en: Machines built to keep a body alive can keep each other alive: a body made only of organs of care.
works.idea_zh: 为维持人体生命而造的机器也能彼此维持生命：一具只由“照护器官”组成的身体。
works.method: Medical life-support devices are plumbed and wired together so that each supplies another's input, running as an autonomous circulatory system.
works.method_zh: 把医用生命维持设备的管路和线路连接在一起，让每台机器为另一台提供输入，作为自主循环系统运行。

works.title: The Machine to Be Another
works.description: Two participants wear headsets that show the live view from each other's head-mounted camera and mirror each other's movements, so each feels, for a few minutes, that they are in the other's body.
works.description_zh: 两名参与者戴上头显，看到的是对方头戴摄像头的实时画面，并相互模仿动作；几分钟内，每人都会感觉自己进入了对方的身体。
works.idea_en: Body ownership is fragile: synchronised seeing and touching are enough to let a machine swap bodies.
works.idea_zh: 身体所有感很脆弱：同步的看与触碰，就足以让机器交换身体。
works.method: Head-mounted cameras and VR displays with synchronised movement and touch, based on body-ownership illusion research.
works.method_zh: 基于身体所有感错觉研究，使用头戴摄像头与 VR 显示器，配合同步动作与触碰。

works.title: The Optimization of Parenthood
works.description: An industrial robot arm rocks a bassinet whenever the baby in it cries or wakes, built by the artist so that a mother could keep making her own work.
works.description_zh: 一台工业机械臂在摇篮里的婴儿哭闹或醒来时自动摇动摇篮；艺术家做它，是为了让母亲能继续自己的创作。
works.idea_en: Automating a mother's repetitive care is both relief and a provocation: which parts of parenting can a machine take?
works.idea_zh: 把母亲重复性的照护自动化，既是解脱，也是挑衅：育儿中的哪些部分可以交给机器？
works.method: A sensor (likely audio) triggers a programmed rocking motion on an industrial arm at CMU's Digital Fabrication Lab; a one-week 'speed project' at the STUDIO for Creative Inquiry (technical assistance: Madeline Gannon).
works.method_zh: 传感器（很可能是声音传感器）触发工业机械臂执行预设的摇动动作，在卡内基梅隆大学数字制造实验室完成；是 STUDIO for Creative Inquiry 一周驻留中的“速成项目”（技术协助：Madeline Gannon）。

works.title: The Superstitious Fund Project
works.description: A real investment fund whose trading algorithm buys and sells only on superstition, from moon phases to fear of the number 13, with the artist appearing as fund manager in financial-TV style interviews.
works.description_zh: 一个真实的投资基金，其交易算法只依据迷信买卖，从月相到对数字 13 的恐惧；艺术家则以基金经理的身份出现在财经电视式的访谈中。
works.idea_en: Algorithmic trading already asks for faith; a superstitious algorithm only makes that faith visible.
works.idea_zh: 算法交易本来就要求信仰；一个迷信的算法只是让这种信仰显形。
works.method: A trading bot derives 'lucky' values from astrology and numerology and places trades with money from real investors over roughly a year.
works.method_zh: 交易程序根据占星术和数字命理计算“幸运值”，在约一年间用真实投资者的钱进行交易。

works.title: The Whole Truth
works.description: An installation and audio documentary about voice-analysis lie detectors piloted by European, Russian and Israeli governments and used by border agencies and insurers. While visitors listen to interviews with the software's developers and sellers, a reverse-engineered lie detector judges those same voices in real time.
works.description_zh: 关于语音测谎仪的装置与音频纪录片：这类技术曾在欧洲、俄罗斯和以色列政府试点，并被边境机构与保险公司使用。观众收听软件开发者与销售者的访谈时，一台被逆向改造的测谎仪正实时判定这些声音的真假。
works.idea_en: Voice-stress analysis claims to hear beneath speech into the body; turning it on its own makers shows how arbitrary its verdicts are.
works.idea_zh: 语音压力分析号称能越过言语、听进身体；把它反过来用在制造者身上，便暴露了它判断的随意。
works.method: Reverse-engineered voice lie-detection software runs on the documentary's audio; three-channel video, stereo sound, a desk, chairs and artificial plants stage an interview room.
works.method_zh: 被逆向改造的语音测谎软件实时分析纪录片音频；三频道影像、立体声、桌椅与假植物布置成一间审讯室。
exhibited: Casco Office for Art, Design and Theory, Utrecht (commission, 2012)

works.title: Three Sisters, Android Version
works.description: Hirata's adaptation of Chekhov set in a declining Japanese industrial town, where a withdrawn younger sister is replaced in the family by an android copy of herself.
works.description_zh: 平田织佐改编契诃夫的剧作，背景是一座衰落的日本工业城镇：闭门不出的小妹在家中被一个以她为原型的仿真人取代。
works.idea_en: A family can live with an android double of someone who is still there but absent.
works.idea_zh: 一个家庭可以与“在场却缺席”之人的仿真人替身一起生活。
works.method: An android (Geminoid F) and a Robovie robot perform with human actors; the android's speech and movement are operated and timed from offstage.
works.method_zh: 仿真人（Geminoid F）和一台 Robovie 机器人与人类演员同台；仿真人的语言与动作由后台操作和控制节奏。

works.title: Transparency Grenade
works.description: A cast-resin Soviet F1 hand grenade with a tiny computer, microphone and antenna inside: 'pulling the pin' captures network traffic and audio in the room and leaks them to a public online map.
works.description_zh: 一枚树脂浇铸的苏联 F1 手雷，内部藏有微型电脑、麦克风和天线：“拉开保险”就会截获房间里的网络流量和声音，并泄露到一张公开的在线地图上。
works.idea_en: Transparency can be forced from below; the network in any room can be made to speak.
works.idea_zh: 透明也可以自下而上地强制实现；任何房间里的网络都可以被迫“开口”。
works.method: A Linux single-board computer with a Wi-Fi antenna and microphone sniffs unencrypted traffic, extracts emails, hostnames and images, and streams them to a server that maps the leak.
works.method_zh: 一台带 Wi-Fi 天线和麦克风的 Linux 单板电脑嗅探未加密流量，提取邮件、主机名和图片，并传给服务器在地图上呈现泄露内容。

works.title: Unmanned
works.description: A short browser game about one day in the life of a drone pilot: shaving, commuting, watching a target on a screen, playing video games with his son.
works.description_zh: 一款关于无人机飞行员一天生活的网页小游戏：刮胡子、通勤、在屏幕上盯着目标、和儿子玩电子游戏。
works.idea_en: Remote war is office work, and its violence sits beside ordinary domestic life.
works.idea_zh: 遥控战争是一份办公室工作，它的暴力就摆在寻常家庭生活旁边。
works.method: Split-screen Flash game written by Paolo Pedercini with Jim Munroe.
works.method_zh: 分屏 Flash 游戏，由 Paolo Pedercini 与 Jim Munroe 创作。

works.title: AI vs. AI: Two Chatbots Talking to Each Other
works.description: Two instances of the Cleverbot chatbot, given voices and animated faces, talk to each other; they bicker, accuse each other of being robots and drift into a conversation about God.
works.description_zh: 两个 Cleverbot 聊天机器人被配上声音和动画面孔后彼此交谈：它们斗嘴、互相指责对方是机器人，最后聊到了上帝。
works.idea_en: When two chatbots talk, the human conversational habits they learned become a strange mirror with no one on either side.
works.idea_zh: 当两个聊天机器人对话时，它们学来的人类说话习惯变成了一面奇怪的镜子，而镜子两边都没有人。
works.method: Two Cleverbot sessions connected through text-to-speech and avatars at Cornell's Creative Machines Lab (Igor Labutov, Jason Yosinski, Hod Lipson).
works.method_zh: 在康奈尔大学创意机器实验室（Igor Labutov、Jason Yosinski、Hod Lipson）通过语音合成和虚拟形象把两个 Cleverbot 会话接在一起。
works.title_zh: AI 对 AI：两个聊天机器人的对话

works.title: AZ: Move and Get Shot
works.description: Six films assembled by a bot from motion-triggered surveillance cameras that Arizona landowners set up on the US–Mexico border to publish images of migrants. The cameras fired at any movement, so the archive fills with animals, wind and light as much as people.
works.description_zh: 一个机器人程序从亚利桑那州土地主架设在美墨边境的动作触发监控摄像头中收集图像，自动剪成六部影片。这些摄像头本为公开偷渡者的影像，却对任何动静都会拍摄，于是档案里满是动物、风和光，也有人。
works.idea_en: Delegating the watch to a motion sensor empties the surveillance of its intent: the machine sees everything that moves and understands none of it.
works.idea_zh: 把监视交给动作传感器，监视的意图就被掏空了：机器看见一切移动之物，却什么也不理解。
works.method: From 2011 to 2014 a bot checked the landowners' website every 24 hours, saved newly uploaded captures from six cameras to a local server and appended them algorithmically to six continuous films.
works.method_zh: 2011 至 2014 年间，一个机器人程序每 24 小时检查土地主的网站，把六台摄像头新上传的画面存到本地服务器，并按算法接进六部持续生长的影片。

works.title: Affetto
works.description: A realistic android child, first a head (2011) and later a pneumatic upper body, built at Osaka University to study how caregivers respond to an infant's face and movements; its soft skin and moving face made it one of the most discussed uncanny robots.
works.description_zh: 一个逼真的仿真儿童：2011 年先做出头部，后来又有了气动驱动的上半身，由大阪大学研制，用来研究照料者如何回应婴儿的面孔与动作；柔软的皮肤和会动的脸，让它成为最常被讨论的“恐怖谷”机器人之一。
works.idea_en: Developmental robotics builds a baby to study care: the robot's task is to be looked after, and its realism tests how far caregiving extends to machines.
works.idea_zh: 发展机器人学造一个婴儿来研究照料：机器人的任务是被照顾，它的逼真程度检验着照料本能能延伸到机器多远。
works.method: Pneumatic actuators under soft silicone skin move the face and, from 2015, a 22-degree-of-freedom upper body; a 2018 study measured and redesigned its facial surface motions.
works.method_zh: 柔软硅胶皮肤下的气动执行器驱动面部，2015 年起还驱动一个 22 自由度的上半身；2018 年的研究进一步测定并重新设计了它的面部运动。

paper.title: Realistic child robot “Affetto” for understanding the caregiver-child attachment relationship that guides the child development

works.title: Alone Together: Why We Expect More from Technology and Less from Each Other
works.description: Based on fifteen years of interviews, Turkle describes a "robotic moment" in which children and elderly people accept Furbies, AIBO, My Real Baby and the seal robot Paro as companions that are "alive enough".
works.description_zh: 基于十五年的访谈，Turkle 描述了一个“机器人时刻”：儿童与老人接受 Furby、AIBO、My Real Baby 和海豹机器人 Paro，把它们当作“足够有生命”的陪伴者。
works.idea_en: We are ready to accept a performance of care in place of care, and that says more about us than about the machines.
works.idea_zh: 我们已准备好接受“照护的表演”来代替照护，这更多说明了我们自己，而不是机器。
works.method: Clinical interviews and field observation in homes, schools and nursing homes.
works.method_zh: 在家庭、学校和养老院进行的临床访谈与田野观察。

paper.title: Alone Together: Why We Expect More from Technology and Less from Each Other

works.title_zh: 群体性孤独：为什么我们对科技期待更多，对彼此却不能更亲密？

works.title: Amazon's $23,698,655.93 book about flies
works.description: A biologist noticed an out-of-print genetics book, The Making of a Fly, listed on Amazon for 23.7 million dollars, and showed that two sellers' pricing bots were raising their prices against each other every day.
works.description_zh: 一位生物学家发现，一本绝版遗传学书《The Making of a Fly》在亚马逊上标价 2370 万美元；他证明这是两家卖家的定价机器人每天互相抬价的结果。
works.idea_en: Two simple algorithms reacting to each other can produce absurd outcomes with no human noticing until someone looks.
works.idea_zh: 两个相互反应的简单算法可以制造出荒谬的结果，而在有人去看之前，没有任何人察觉。
works.method: Blog post analysing daily price changes: one seller set its price at 0.9983 times the other's, which set its price at 1.270589 times the first's.
works.method_zh: 一篇分析每日价格变化的博客：一家卖家把价格设为对手的 0.9983 倍，另一家则设为前者的 1.270589 倍。
works.title_zh: 亚马逊上售价 23,698,655.93 美元的苍蝇书

works.title: Face to Facebook
works.description: The artists scraped one million Facebook profiles, used face-analysis software to sort 250,000 profile pictures into temperaments such as 'smug' or 'easy going', and published them on a fake dating site, Lovely-Faces.com.
works.description_zh: 艺术家抓取一百万个 Facebook 个人主页，用人脸分析软件把 25 万张头像按“得意”“随和”等性格分类，再发布到一个虚假的交友网站 Lovely-Faces.com 上。
works.idea_en: Once faces are data, they can be re-sorted into any identity someone chooses.
works.idea_zh: 脸一旦成为数据，就可以被任意重新归入别人选定的身份。
works.method: Custom scraper plus face-detection and expression-analysis software; profiles re-published on a purpose-built dating website.
works.method_zh: 自制爬虫加人脸检测与表情分析软件；把资料重新发布在专门搭建的交友网站上。

works.title: Human Study #1 (5 Robots Named Paul)
works.description: A visitor sits as a model while several simple robots, each a desk-mounted arm with a camera 'eye', look at them and draw their portrait in ballpoint pen over about half an hour, with hesitant, obsessive strokes.
works.description_zh: 一位观众坐下当模特，几台简单的机器人（每台是一只装在桌上的机械臂，配一只摄像“眼”）注视着他，用约半小时以圆珠笔画出肖像，笔触迟疑而执着。
works.idea_en: Being drawn by a machine reverses the gaze: the sitter feels observed, and the robot's clumsiness reads as effort.
works.idea_zh: 被机器描画会反转凝视：模特感到被观察，而机器人的笨拙被读作努力。
works.method: Camera on a pan-tilt 'head', computer-vision and drawing-style algorithms, and a small planar arm holding a pen.
works.method_zh: 云台“头部”上的摄像头、计算机视觉与绘画风格算法，以及握笔的小型平面机械臂。

paper.title: Portrait drawing by Paul the robot

works.title_zh: 人类学习 #1（五个名叫保罗的机器人）

works.title: Humans, Animals, and Robots: A Phenomenological Approach to Human-Robot Relations
