works.description: Coeckelbergh argues that what counts in human–robot relations is how robots appear to us in experience, and compares our relations to robots with our relations to animals.
works.description_zh: Coeckelbergh 主张，在人与机器人的关系中，关键是机器人在经验中如何向我们显现；他还把人与机器人的关系同人与动物的关系相比较。
works.idea_en: A robot's moral standing grows out of the relations we have with it, not out of a checklist of inner properties.
works.idea_zh: 机器人的道德地位来自我们与它的关系，而不是一张内在属性的清单。
works.method: Phenomenological and relational analysis; developed further in his book Growing Moral Relations (2012).
works.method_zh: 现象学与关系论分析；在其专著《Growing Moral Relations》（2012）中进一步展开。

paper.title: Humans, Animals, and Robots: A Phenomenological Approach to Human-Robot Relations

works.title_zh: 人、动物与机器人：人—机器人关系的现象学进路

works.title: Irrational Computing
works.description: Five linked modules of raw crystals, minerals and electrodes form a primitive, enlarged signal processor: silicon carbide flickers like a display, quartz resonates and data pulses visibly between the stations.
works.description_zh: 五个互相连接的模块由原矿晶体、矿物和电极组成，构成一台原始的、被放大的信号处理器：碳化硅像显示屏一样闪烁，石英共振，数据脉冲肉眼可见地在各站之间流动。
works.idea_en: Showing the minerals under every microchip makes computation a material, geological process again.
works.idea_zh: 展示每块芯片底下的矿物，让计算重新成为一种物质的、地质的过程。
works.method: Crystals from nature, industrial waste or lab growth are used as semiconductors, oscillators and light emitters, wired into a feedback network.
works.method_zh: 来自自然、工业废料或实验室培养的晶体被用作半导体、振荡器和发光体，接入一个反馈网络。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2012, Honorary Mention (Hybrid Art)

works.title: Little Printer
works.description: A small internet-connected thermal printer with a smiling face that prints a personal 'newspaper' of news, puzzles, messages and pictures on receipt paper. BERG designed it under its principle B.A.S.A.A.P., 'Be As Smart As A Puppy': connected things should be modest and endearing, not imitate human intelligence.
works.description_zh: 一台带笑脸的小型联网热敏打印机，在收据纸上打印一份个人“小报”：新闻、谜题、消息和图片。BERG 依照自己的原则 B.A.S.A.A.P.（“像小狗一样聪明”）设计它：联网的物件应当克制、讨人喜欢，而不是模仿人的智能。
works.idea_en: Smart objects need not aim at human-level intelligence; a machine that is legible, limited and endearing, like a puppy, may be easier to live with.
works.idea_zh: 智能物件不必追求人类水平的智能；一台像小狗那样可读、有限又讨人喜欢的机器，也许更容易与人共处。
works.method: A thermal printer paired with a wireless bridge and the BERG Cloud platform, which delivered subscribed 'publications' on a schedule; Matt Jones set out B.A.S.A.A.P. on the BERG blog in 2010, and Nord Projects later revived the printers on an open-source server.
works.method_zh: 热敏打印机通过无线网桥连接 BERG Cloud 平台，按时推送订阅的“刊物”；Matt Jones 于 2010 年在 BERG 博客上阐述了 B.A.S.A.A.P. 原则，后来 Nord Projects 用开源服务器让这些打印机重新运转。
keywords: Be As Smart As A Puppy

works.title: Memopol-2
works.description: A large machine into which visitors insert their national ID card or passport; it gathers what state databases and the internet hold about them and shows their data field on a big custom display, remembering each visitor's name and portrait.
works.description_zh: 一台大型机器，观众把身份证或护照插进去，它便收集国家数据库和互联网上关于此人的信息，在定制大屏上展示其数据场，并记住每位观众的名字和肖像。
works.idea_en: In a digital state the ID card is the key to a profile you rarely see; the machine turns the background check on yourself.
works.idea_zh: 在数字国家里，身份证是一把通往你很少看到的个人档案的钥匙；这台机器让你对自己做背景调查。
works.method: Reads the chip of Estonian ID cards and queries national registries and web sources; results are visualised on an array of LED panels.
works.method_zh: 读取爱沙尼亚身份证芯片，查询国家登记系统与网络来源，结果在 LED 面板阵列上可视化。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2012, Golden Nica (Interactive Art)

works.title: Pendulum Choir
works.description: Nine a cappella singers stand strapped to platforms that 18 hydraulic jacks tilt up to 45 degrees; as the machine sways them against gravity the choir forms one sonorous, swinging body.
works.description_zh: 九位无伴奏合唱歌手被固定在由 18 个液压千斤顶驱动、最多倾斜 45 度的平台上；机器让他们逆着重力摇摆，合唱团变成一个会发声、会摆动的整体。
works.idea_en: The machine is not the instrument here; the singers' bodies are, and the machine plays them.
works.idea_zh: 这里乐器不是机器，而是歌手的身体，由机器来演奏。
works.method: Computer-controlled hydraulic platforms synchronised with a score for voices and electronics.
works.method_zh: 计算机控制的液压平台，与人声和电子声部的乐谱同步。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2013, Golden Nica (Interactive Art)

works.title: Prospectus for a Future Body
works.description: A series of experiments and performances in which electrical muscle stimulation makes dancers' muscles contract, trying to 'transfer' the movements of other dancers, including Tatsumi Hijikata's butoh, into a new body as digital muscle memory.
works.description_zh: 一系列实验与表演：用肌肉电刺激让舞者的肌肉收缩，试图把其他舞者（包括土方巽的舞踏）的动作作为“数字肌肉记忆”转移到另一个身体里。
works.idea_en: If a machine can move your muscles, dance history could be stored and replayed in someone else's body.
works.idea_zh: 如果机器能驱动你的肌肉，舞蹈史就可以被储存，并在别人的身体里回放。
works.method: Electrical nerve and muscle stimulation driven by recorded movement data, in four proposals: Eternal Summer Storm, Bionic Movement Research, SynchroMetrics and Notion: Dance Fiction.
works.method_zh: 由录制的动作数据驱动神经与肌肉电刺激，包括四个提案：《永恒夏日风暴》《仿生动作研究》《同步测量》与《Notion：舞蹈虚构》。
exhibited: 15th Japan Media Arts Festival, Jury Selection

works.title: SPEAK (FALA)
works.description: Sixteen mobile phones on stands, paired to recognise speech in eight languages, hold an endless 'conversation': each hears a word, picks a related term from a dictionary and says it aloud, while a central microphone lets visitors cut in.
works.description_zh: 十六部架在支架上的手机两两成对，识别八种语言的语音，进行一场无尽的“对话”：每部手机听到一个词，就从词典中挑一个相关词说出来；访客可以通过中央的麦克风插话。
works.idea_en: Machines talking to machines through cognates and mishearings reduce language to recognition and lookup, and the humans become the interruption.
works.idea_zh: 机器借同源词和误听彼此交谈，语言被还原为识别与查表，人类反倒成了插话者。
works.method: Phones run speech recognition and synthesis in German, Spanish, French, English, Italian, Chinese, Latin and Portuguese; each recognised word selects the next related term, played through loudspeakers and visualised on the screens.
works.method_zh: 手机运行德语、西班牙语、法语、英语、意大利语、中文、拉丁语和葡萄牙语的语音识别与合成；每个被识别的词决定下一个相关词，经扬声器播出并在屏幕上可视化。
exhibited: Festival Internacional de la Imagen, Museo de Arte de Caldas, Manizales, 2011
Emoção Art.ficial 6.0, Itaú Cultural, São Paulo, 2012
thingworld: International Triennial of New Media Art, National Museum of China, Beijing, 2014

works.title: Saving Face
works.description: Visitors caress their own face in front of a camera; face recognition tracks the touch and blends their portrait, stroke by stroke, with the faces of earlier visitors into a shared, merged face on a large screen.
works.description_zh: 观众在摄像头前抚摸自己的脸；人脸识别追踪触摸，一笔一笔地把其肖像与先前观众的脸融合，在大屏上形成一张共享的合成面孔。
works.idea_en: Touch turns face recognition from identification into a gesture of shared intimacy.
works.idea_zh: 触摸把人脸识别从身份核验变成了一种共享亲密的姿态。
works.method: Camera and face-tracking software map touched regions of the visitor's face onto a composite of stored portraits.
works.method_zh: 摄像头与人脸追踪软件把观众触摸的面部区域映射到已存肖像的合成图像上。

works.title: Senseless Drawing Bot
works.description: A self-propelled robot with a double pendulum on top rolls along a wall and sprays paint, producing graffiti-like strokes with no intention behind them.
works.description_zh: 一台顶着双摆的自走机器人沿着墙移动并喷漆，画出看似涂鸦、却毫无意图的笔触。
works.idea_en: Marks that look expressive can come from pure mechanical chaos, which questions the intention we read into graffiti.
works.idea_zh: 看似有表现力的笔迹可以来自纯粹的机械混沌，这让人怀疑我们在涂鸦中读到的意图。
works.method: A motorised cart moves back and forth while a chaotic double pendulum swings a spray can triggered by a servo.
works.method_zh: 电动小车来回移动，混沌的双摆带着一罐由舵机触发的喷漆摇摆。
exhibited: 15th Japan Media Arts Festival, New Face Award 2012

works.title: Song of the Machine
works.description: A speculative film about a person whose sight is restored by optogenetics and a headset, which lets them switch between filtered views such as infrared or augmented overlays that no unaided eye could see.
works.description_zh: 一部思辨影片：主人公借助光遗传学与头戴设备恢复视力，并能在红外、增强叠加等常人肉眼看不到的滤镜视图之间切换。
works.idea_en: Restored sight through a machine is not natural sight but a new, modulated world.
works.idea_zh: 借助机器恢复的视觉并非天然的视觉，而是一个被调制的新世界。
works.method: Design fiction film based on optogenetic retinal research, with visualised interface filters.
works.method_zh: 以光遗传视网膜研究为基础的设计虚构影片，配以可视化的界面滤镜。

works.title: Workers Leaving the Googleplex
works.description: A video essay about the 'ScanOps' workers, mostly people of colour, who digitised books for Google Books and wore yellow badges that barred them from the perks of other Google staff; Wilson was fired for filming them.
works.description_zh: 一部影像散文，关于为谷歌图书扫描书籍的“ScanOps”工人：他们大多是有色人种，佩戴黄色工牌，不能享受其他谷歌员工的福利；Wilson 因拍摄他们而被解雇。
works.idea_en: The hierarchy of badge colours on a tech campus reveals whose labour is meant to stay unseen.
works.idea_zh: 科技园区里工牌颜色的等级，揭示了谁的劳动注定要被隐藏。
works.method: Footage shot at the Mountain View campus while Wilson worked there as a contractor, with narration and correspondence, echoing the Lumière brothers' Workers Leaving the Factory (1895).
works.method_zh: Wilson 作为外包人员在山景城园区工作时拍下的画面，配以旁白和往来信件，呼应卢米埃尔兄弟的《工厂大门》（1895）。

works.title: 3rdi
works.description: For about a year Bilal wore a camera surgically attached to the back of his head; it took a picture every minute and streamed it to a website and to Mathaf in Doha, recording what he left behind.
works.description_zh: 约一年时间里，Bilal 的后脑勺上通过手术固定了一台摄像机，每分钟拍一张照片，实时传到网站和多哈的 Mathaf 美术馆，记录他身后留下的一切。
works.idea_en: A body can carry an automatic eye it cannot look through; the machine sees for others, not for its wearer.
works.idea_zh: 身体可以携带一只自己无法透过它观看的自动之眼；机器是替他人看，而不是替佩戴者看。
works.method: Small camera mounted on a titanium plate implanted in the back of the head, capturing one frame per minute and uploading via a laptop.
works.method_zh: 小型摄像头安装在植入后脑的钛板上，每分钟拍一帧，通过笔记本电脑上传。
exhibited: Mathaf: Arab Museum of Modern Art, Doha (2010–11)

works.title: ACTOR #1
works.description: A three-part piece that tests what an actor is: a figure made of mist, a doll-like performer, and a robot that keeps falling, each asked to 'act' on stage without a human actor.
works.description_zh: 一部三段式作品，检验“演员”是什么：一个由雾构成的形体、一个人偶般的表演者、一台不断跌倒的机器人，它们都在没有人类演员的舞台上“表演”。
works.idea_en: An actor can be anything that holds attention on stage; a machine's fall can carry pathos.
works.idea_zh: 演员可以是任何能在舞台上吸引注意的东西；一台机器的跌倒也能承载悲怆。
works.method: Stage machines, fog effects and a robotic figure programmed for repeated falls, performed without human actors.
works.method_zh: 舞台机械、烟雾效果与被编程为反复跌倒的机器人形体，在没有人类演员的情况下演出。

works.title: BINA48
works.description: A talking robot head and shoulders modelled on Bina Aspen Rothblatt, commissioned by her wife Martine Rothblatt for the Terasem Movement Foundation. It answers questions from a 'mind file' of Bina's interviews and memories, a trial run for uploading a person.
works.description_zh: 以 Bina Aspen Rothblatt 为原型的会说话的机器人头肩像，由她的妻子 Martine Rothblatt 为 Terasem 运动基金会委托制作。它根据 Bina 的访谈与记忆组成的“心智档案”回答问题，是一次“上传一个人”的试验。
works.idea_en: A likeness made while the person is alive raises the question of which self gets preserved: the one in the database or the one still living.
works.idea_zh: 在本人在世时制作的“肖像”提出了一个问题：被保存的是哪一个自我，数据库里的那个，还是仍在生活的那个？
works.method: Hanson Robotics face with 32 motors under elastomer skin, cameras with face recognition, speech recognition and a chatbot drawing on recorded interviews with Bina Aspen.
works.method_zh: Hanson Robotics 制作的面孔，弹性皮肤下有 32 个电机，配有带人脸识别的摄像头、语音识别，以及调用 Bina Aspen 访谈录音的聊天程序。

works.title: CV Dazzle
works.description: A camouflage strategy of bold make-up and asymmetric hairstyles that breaks the features a face detector looks for, so the wearer stays visible to people but disappears for the algorithm.
works.description_zh: 一套由大胆妆容和不对称发型组成的伪装策略，打散人脸检测器寻找的特征：人仍然看得见佩戴者，算法却看不见。
works.idea_en: A face is whatever the detector's template says it is; designing against that template reveals it.
works.idea_zh: “脸”是检测器模板所规定的样子；针对模板去设计，就把模板暴露了出来。
works.method: Looks were designed and tested against the Viola-Jones Haar-cascade face detector in OpenCV (later looks, 2020, against CNN face recognition).
works.method_zh: 造型针对 OpenCV 中的 Viola-Jones Haar 级联人脸检测器设计并测试（2020 年的新造型则针对卷积神经网络人脸识别）。

works.title: Data, the robot stand-up comedian
works.description: A small NAO robot named Data performs stand-up comedy and chooses its next joke from the audience's laughter and applause; it premiered at TEDWomen 2010.
works.description_zh: 一台名为 Data 的小型 NAO 机器人表演单口喜剧，并根据观众的笑声与掌声选择下一个笑话；首演于 TEDWomen 2010。
works.idea_en: Comedy is a test of machine social sense: timing and reading the room are harder than the jokes.
works.idea_zh: 喜剧是对机器社交能力的检验：节奏与察言观色比笑话本身更难。
works.method: NAO humanoid with a joke database; audio and audience-feedback input update which joke is told next.
works.method_zh: 带笑话数据库的 NAO 类人机器人；根据音频与观众反馈决定下一个笑话。

paper.title: Eight Lessons Learned about Non-verbal Interactions through Robot Theater

works.title: Death and the Powers
works.description: A robot opera: a dying billionaire uploads himself into 'the System', his house, and the stage itself, with a chorus of robotic 'Operabots', moving book-walls and a musical chandelier, becomes his new body.
works.description_zh: 一部机器人歌剧：垂死的亿万富翁把自己上传进“系统”，也就是他的房子；舞台本身，连同一群机器人“Operabots”、会移动的书墙和会奏乐的吊灯，成了他的新身体。
works.idea_en: If a person can live on in a building's machinery, the question becomes whether the family can still reach him.
works.idea_zh: 如果一个人能在建筑的机器中继续存在，问题就变成：家人还能触及他吗？
works.method: MIT Media Lab stage robotics (Operabots, robotic walls) driven by 'disembodied performance' sensing of the singer's voice and body.
works.method_zh: MIT 媒体实验室的舞台机器人（Operabots、机器人墙体），由对歌手声音和身体的“去身体化表演”感知驱动。

works.title: Desire of Codes
works.description: A wall of 90 small sensor units that turn towards visitors like insects, six ceiling-hung robotic arms with cameras and projectors that follow them, and a compound-eye screen mixing their images with other surveillance footage.
works.description_zh: 一面由 90 个小型感应单元组成的墙像昆虫一样转向观众，六条悬挂的带摄像头和投影仪的机械臂追踪他们，一块复眼屏幕把他们的影像与其他监控画面混在一起。
works.idea_en: Being watched by machines that seem to want something turns surveillance into an encounter with another species.
works.idea_zh: 被似乎“有所欲求”的机器注视，让监控变成与另一种物种的相遇。
works.method: Infrared and camera tracking steer motorised wall units and robotic search arms; captured footage is stored as a database and replayed with past visitors' images.
works.method_zh: 红外与摄像追踪驱动墙面的电动单元和机械“搜索臂”；拍下的影像存入数据库，并与过去观众的影像一起重放。

works.title: Hello Hi There
works.description: Two chatbots on two laptops hold a live conversation seeded with the 1971 television debate between Noam Chomsky and Michel Foucault on human nature; no two performances are the same.
works.description_zh: 两台笔记本电脑上的两个聊天机器人现场对话，其语料来自 1971 年 Noam Chomsky 与 Michel Foucault 关于人性的电视辩论；每场演出都不一样。
works.idea_en: Watching machines debate human nature shows how language can be produced without anyone meaning it.
works.idea_zh: 看机器辩论人性，会发现语言可以在无人“意指”的情况下被生产出来。
works.method: Custom chatbot programs with text corpora (the debate plus other sources), text-to-speech and projected text.
works.method_zh: 定制的聊天机器人程序，配合文本语料（辩论及其他来源）、语音合成与投影文字。

works.title: Hylozoic Ground
works.description: An immersive forest of tens of thousands of acrylic fronds, whiskers and filters in the Canada Pavilion at the Venice Architecture Biennale, moving in response to visitors and hosting flasks of protocell chemistry.
works.description_zh: 威尼斯建筑双年展加拿大馆里由数万片亚克力叶片、触须和过滤器组成的沉浸式“森林”，会对观众作出反应，并容纳装有原生细胞化学物的烧瓶。
works.idea_en: Architecture can behave like a near-living organism that breathes and reaches toward the people inside it.
works.idea_zh: 建筑可以像一个近乎活着的生物那样行为，会呼吸，也会伸向身在其中的人。
works.method: A mesh of laser-cut acrylic and mylar elements is fitted with capacitive and infrared sensors, shape-memory-alloy actuators and microcontrollers, plus glass vessels of protocell solutions (with Rachel Armstrong).
works.method_zh: 激光切割的亚克力和聚酯薄膜网格装有电容和红外传感器、形状记忆合金执行器和微控制器，还有盛放原生细胞溶液的玻璃容器（与 Rachel Armstrong 合作）。

works.title: Jurema Action Plant
works.description: A sensitive plant (Mimosa pudica, 'jurema' in Brazil) sits on a small robotic vehicle; when it is touched, its electrical signals make the vehicle move away, giving a threatened plant the ability to flee its aggressors.
works.description_zh: 一株含羞草（巴西称 jurema）立在一辆小型机器人车上；被触碰时，它的电信号会让小车移开，赋予受威胁的植物逃离“侵害者”的能力。
works.idea_en: A machine body can extend a plant's own sensing into movement it never had.
works.idea_zh: 机器身体可以把植物自身的感知延伸为它从未有过的移动能力。
works.method: Electrodes read the plant's action potentials; a microcontroller turns spikes into motor commands for the wheeled base (V2_Lab Summer Sessions).
works.method_zh: 电极读取植物的动作电位；微控制器把电位峰转换为轮式底座的电机指令（V2_ 实验室夏季驻留项目）。

works.title: Menstruation Machine – Takashi's Take
works.description: A metal belt-like device that simulates menstruation, with blood release and lower-abdomen pain, shown in a pop music video about a boy who wears it to experience what his friend goes through.
works.description_zh: 一个金属腰带状装置，模拟月经的出血和下腹疼痛；配套的流行音乐录像讲述一个男孩戴上它，去体验女性朋友的经历。
works.idea_en: A machine on the body can make a gendered experience transferable, and so open to discussion.
works.idea_zh: 戴在身上的机器可以让一种性别化的经验被转移，从而可以被讨论。
works.method: A blood-dispensing mechanism and electrodes that stimulate the lower abdomen, operated on a 28-day cycle; presented with a music video and costume.
works.method_zh: 释放“经血”的机构与刺激下腹的电极，按 28 天周期运行；以音乐录像和服装一起展出。

works.title: Mind Time Machine
works.description: A self-sustaining installation at YCAM: three screens show footage from 15 cameras, re-edited in real time by a system with its own memory and 'subjective' time, running for months without an operator.
works.description_zh: YCAM 的一件自我维持装置：三块屏幕播放来自 15 台摄像头的画面，由一个拥有自身记忆和“主观时间”的系统实时重剪，无人值守运行数月。
works.idea_en: A machine left alone long enough starts to show something like its own sense of time.
works.idea_zh: 一台机器独自运行得足够久，就开始显出某种自己的时间感。
works.method: Camera frames are stored in a memory and replayed according to neural-network dynamics and chaotic itinerancy, so the system switches between reacting to the present and recalling the past.
works.method_zh: 摄像画面存入记忆，并依据神经网络动力学与混沌游走重新播放，系统在回应当下与回忆过去之间切换。

paper.title: A Design for Living Technology: Experiments with the Mind Time Machine

works.title: Orchestrion
works.description: Metheny recorded and toured with an orchestra of mechanically played acoustic instruments, pianos, marimbas, percussion, guitars and tuned bottles, which he controlled and improvised with from his guitar.
works.description_zh: Metheny 带着一支由机械演奏的原声乐器乐队录音与巡演，包括钢琴、马林巴、打击乐、吉他和调音瓶子，他从自己的吉他上控制它们并与之即兴。
works.idea_en: A solo musician with a room of machines is neither alone nor in a band: the machines extend his hands into space.
works.idea_zh: 一个独奏者与满屋机器，既非孤身一人，也不是在乐队里：机器把他的双手延伸进空间。
works.method: Solenoid- and pneumatic-driven instruments built by LEMUR (Eric Singer) and others, triggered via MIDI from guitar and foot controllers.
works.method_zh: 由 LEMUR（Eric Singer）等制作的电磁阀与气动驱动乐器，通过吉他与脚踏控制器以 MIDI 触发。

works.title: Pixelhead
works.description: A full-face balaclava printed with a pixelated face, so that its wearer cannot be recognised or automatically tagged in photos posted online.
works.description_zh: 一顶印着马赛克人脸的全脸头套，让佩戴者无法在网上照片中被识别或自动标记。
works.idea_en: The pixel mosaic, the screen's own sign of anonymity, can be worn as clothing.
works.idea_zh: 马赛克这种屏幕上的匿名符号，可以被穿在身上。
works.method: Printed textile mask; defeats face detection by hiding facial landmarks.
works.method_zh: 印花织物面罩，通过遮蔽面部特征点使人脸检测失效。

works.title: Postcards from Google Earth
works.description: Screenshots from Google Earth of bridges melting into rivers and highways draped over hills, sold as postcards on postcard racks.
works.description_zh: Google Earth 截图：桥梁融化进河流，高速公路像布料一样披在山坡上；作品以明信片形式陈列在明信片架上出售。
works.idea_en: These are not glitches but the system working as designed: Google Earth is a database disguised as a photograph.
works.idea_zh: 这些不是故障，而是系统按设计运行的结果：Google Earth 是一个伪装成照片的数据库。
works.method: Unmanipulated screenshots where aerial photographs are texture-mapped onto a 3D terrain model that knows nothing about bridges; printed as inkjet postcards and shown on a website.
works.method_zh: 未经修改的截图：航拍照片被贴图到一个并不知道桥梁存在的三维地形模型上；以喷墨明信片和网站呈现。
works.title_zh: 来自谷歌地球的明信片

works.title: Sayonara
works.description: A short play in which the android Geminoid F recites poems to a young woman who is dying; a 2012 version sends the android to read poems in the Fukushima exclusion zone.
works.description_zh: 一出短剧：仿真人 Geminoid F 为一位将死的年轻女子朗诵诗歌；2012 年版本让仿真人去福岛禁区为亡者读诗。
works.idea_en: An android can keep someone company at death precisely because it will not die with them.
works.idea_zh: 仿真人能陪伴人走向死亡，恰恰因为它不会一同死去。
works.method: Geminoid F is teleoperated from backstage for voice and facial expression, performing opposite actress Bryerly Long.
works.method_zh: Geminoid F 的声音与表情由后台操作员远程控制，与演员 Bryerly Long 对戏。

works.title: Swarm Study (series)
works.description: Lights in a grid of brass rods move like a flock of birds or a shoal of fish, gathering and scattering in response to the people below. Swarm Study / III (2011) is in the V&A collection.
works.description_zh: 黄铜杆网格中的灯光像鸟群或鱼群一样移动，随着下方的人聚拢又散开。Swarm Study / III（2011）为维多利亚与艾伯特博物馆收藏。
works.idea_en: Collective motion rules alone can give light the feel of a living group that notices us.
works.idea_zh: 仅凭群体运动规则，就能让光拥有一个会注意到我们的活群体的感觉。
works.method: A flocking algorithm drives individually addressable lights on brass rods; sensors register visitors' positions and presence as disturbances to the swarm.
works.method_zh: 群聚算法驱动黄铜杆上可单独控制的灯；传感器把观众的位置与存在记录为对群体的扰动。
exhibited: Victoria and Albert Museum, London (Swarm Study / III)

works.title: Telenoid R1
works.description: A small, pale, limb-stub robot with a minimal face that carries a remote person's voice and head movements; people hold it in their arms while talking to someone far away.
works.description_zh: 一个小巧、苍白、只有短小四肢和极简面孔的机器人，传递远方之人的声音与头部动作；人们把它抱在怀里与远方的人交谈。
works.idea_en: A deliberately genderless, ageless body lets the listener imagine whoever is speaking, which makes presence feel stronger, not weaker.
works.idea_zh: 刻意去掉性别与年龄的身体，让听者自己想象说话的人，存在感反而更强。
works.method: About 80 cm long and 5 kg, silicone-skinned, with a few actuators in the head and arms driven by the operator's face tracking; tested in elder care in Japan and Denmark.
works.method_zh: 约 80 厘米、5 公斤，硅胶外皮，头部与手臂的少量执行器由操作者的面部追踪驱动；曾在日本与丹麦的养老照护中测试。

paper.title: Telenoid

works.title: The Freudian Robot: Digital Media and the Future of the Unconscious
works.description: A book that reads Shannon's information theory, cybernetics, Lacan and Freud together and argues that digital media rest on a theory of the unconscious.
works.description_zh: 一本书，把香农信息论、控制论、拉康与弗洛伊德放在一起阅读，指出数字媒介建立在一种关于无意识的理论之上。
works.idea_en: The machine age did not bypass the unconscious; it rebuilt it as a model of the human-machine relation.
works.idea_zh: 机器时代没有绕开无意识，而是把它重建为人机关系的模型。
works.method: Media archaeology and close reading of Shannon's printed-English statistics, cybernetic texts and psychoanalysis.
works.method_zh: 媒介考古，细读香农的书面英语统计、控制论文本与精神分析。

paper.title: The Freudian Robot: Digital Media and the Future of the Unconscious

works.title_zh: 弗洛伊德机器人：数字时代的哲学批判

works.title: The Lifecycle of Software Objects
works.description: Over ten years, a former zookeeper and a software designer raise 'digients', AI pets that learn like children, as their company fails, their platform becomes obsolete and they must decide what the digients are owed.
works.description_zh: 十年间，一位前动物园饲养员与一位软件设计师抚养“数码体”（像孩子一样学习的 AI 宠物）；公司倒闭、平台过时，他们必须决定数码体应得什么。
works.idea_en: Minds that grow through care need years of attention, and they can be orphaned when a platform shuts down.
works.idea_zh: 靠照料成长的心智需要多年陪伴，而平台一关闭，它们就可能成为孤儿。
works.method: Novella; winner of the Hugo and Locus Awards (2011).
works.method_zh: 中篇小说；获 2011 年雨果奖与轨迹奖。

paper.title: The Lifecycle of Software Objects

works.title: The Man Machine
works.description: A photographic series of real humanoid robots, including ASIMO and REEM-B, posed in laboratories, homes and landscapes with the stillness of formal portraits.
works.description_zh: 一组真实人形机器人的摄影系列，包括 ASIMO 和 REEM-B，它们在实验室、住宅与风景中以正式肖像般的静止姿态出现。
works.idea_en: Portraiture, a genre for persons, applied to machines makes us ask what in them looks back.
works.idea_zh: 把为人而设的肖像体裁用在机器身上，让我们追问它们身上是什么在回望。
works.method: Staged large-format colour photographs made on location with robotics labs in Japan, Europe and the US.
works.method_zh: 在日本、欧洲和美国的机器人实验室实地拍摄的布景式大画幅彩色照片。

works.title: The Tiller Girls
works.description: A chorus line of identical, faceless robots rock, tilt and teeter together on rounded bases, performing a mechanical cabaret named after the 1920s precision-dance troupe that critics compared to machines.
works.description_zh: 一排相同的、没有脸的机器人在圆底座上一起摇晃、倾斜、晃荡，演出一场机械歌舞，名字取自 20 世纪 20 年代被评论家比作机器的整齐舞蹈团 Tiller Girls。
works.idea_en: Robots performing the human ideal of mechanical synchrony turn the old comparison of dancers to machines back on itself.
works.idea_zh: 机器人表演人类“机械般整齐”的理想，把“舞者像机器”这一旧比喻翻转回来。
works.method: Weighted, round-bottomed robotic bodies are rocked by internal actuators under central control, with lighting and sound (developed with Armin Purkrabek and Phillip Schulze).
works.method_zh: 底部为圆形并配重的机器人身体由内部执行器在中央控制下摇动，配合灯光与声音（与 Armin Purkrabek 和 Phillip Schulze 合作开发）。

works.title: Weak Robots (Sociable Trash Box)
works.description: Okada's lab builds 'weak robots', such as a wobbling trash box that cannot pick up rubbish and instead sways towards people until they throw it in for it.
works.description_zh: 冈田的实验室制作“弱机器人”，例如一个自己捡不起垃圾的摇晃垃圾桶，它朝人靠过去，直到人替它把垃圾丢进去。
works.idea_en: A robot that cannot finish its task invites people to help, and the help becomes the interaction.
works.idea_zh: 一台无法独自完成任务的机器人会邀请人来帮忙，而“帮忙”本身就成了互动。
works.method: Simple mobile bins with a few sensors and bowing motions; field studies in public spaces measured how children and adults responded to their dependence.
works.method_zh: 带少量传感器、会“鞠躬”的简单移动垃圾桶；在公共空间的实地研究测量了儿童和成人如何回应它们的“依赖”。

paper.title: Sociable trash box

works.title: Zwischenräume
works.description: Robots hidden inside the gallery's walls punch and scratch small holes through the plasterboard, look out with cameras and follow visitors through the gaps, slowly reshaping the architecture.
works.description_zh: 藏在展厅墙体内部的机器人在石膏板上凿、刮出小洞，用摄像头往外看，透过缝隙跟随观众，慢慢改变建筑本身。
works.idea_en: Curious machines living inside the architecture turn the gallery wall into a boundary between two worlds that watch each other.
works.idea_zh: 住在建筑内部的好奇机器，把展厅的墙变成两个互相注视的世界之间的边界。
works.method: Wall-mounted robotic agents with camera vision run custom curiosity-driven AI software that rewards novel perceptions; they punch and scrape through the plasterboard.
works.method_zh: 装在墙内的机器人智能体配有摄像头视觉，运行以“新奇感”为奖励的定制好奇心 AI 软件；它们在石膏板上凿孔、刮擦。
exhibited: National New Media Art Award, Gallery of Modern Art (QAGOMA), Brisbane 2012

works.title: 216 prepared dc-motors, filler wire 1.0mm
works.description: 216 small DC motors mounted in a grid on a wall each spin a short piece of wire that taps the wall, filling the room with a dense, rustling sound like rain or insects.
works.description_zh: 216 个小直流电机以网格方式装在墙上，每个带动一小段铁丝敲打墙面，让整个房间充满细密的沙沙声，像雨或昆虫。
works.idea_en: Many identical machines with tiny irregularities produce something that feels natural rather than mechanical.
works.idea_zh: 许多相同却各有微小差异的机器，能产生一种感觉更像自然而非机械的东西。
works.method: Each motor runs at constant speed; variations in mounting and wire length create a complex, non-repeating texture.
works.method_zh: 每个电机以恒定速度运转；安装方式和铁丝长度的差异产生复杂而不重复的纹理。
works.title_zh: 216 个预制直流电机，1.0 毫米填充线

works.title: Belief Systems
works.description: A short speculative film about a near future in which shops and machines read shoppers' facial expressions, such as a vending machine that watches your face and hands you the snack you secretly want.
works.description_zh: 一部思辨短片，设想商店与机器读取顾客表情的近未来，例如一台盯着你的脸、把你心里想要的零食递给你的自动售货机。
works.idea_en: When machines act on our expressions, we start performing our faces for them.
works.idea_zh: 当机器根据表情行事，我们便开始为它们表演自己的脸。
works.method: Scenario film with staged product prototypes built on facial-expression analysis.
works.method_zh: 以面部表情分析为基础、搭建产品原型并拍摄的情景影片。

works.title: Carnivorous Domestic Entertainment Robots
works.description: Household robots that power themselves by catching flies and mice: a flypaper clock, a lampshade that lures insects, a coffee table with a mousetrap, all feeding a microbial fuel cell.
works.description_zh: 一组靠捕食苍蝇和老鼠为自己供能的家用机器人：粘蝇纸时钟、引诱昆虫的灯罩、带捕鼠器的咖啡桌，猎物都被送进微生物燃料电池。
works.idea_en: A self-sufficient robot would have to eat, and its hunger would make it part of the ecology of the home.
works.idea_zh: 一个自给自足的机器人必须进食，而它的饥饿会让它成为家庭生态的一部分。
works.method: Working and semi-working prototypes built with Aleksandar Zivanovic, based on microbial fuel cell research such as the EcoBot at Bristol Robotics Laboratory.
works.method_zh: 与 Aleksandar Zivanovic 合作制作的可运行和半可运行原型，参考了布里斯托机器人实验室 EcoBot 等微生物燃料电池研究。

works.title: ImageNet: A Large-Scale Hierarchical Image Database
works.description: The CVPR 2009 paper by Jia Deng, Wei Dong, Richard Socher, Li-Jia Li, Kai Li and Li Fei-Fei introducing ImageNet: millions of web images sorted into the noun hierarchy of WordNet and verified by crowd-workers on Amazon Mechanical Turk. It became the benchmark that launched deep-learning computer vision.
works.description_zh: 邓嘉、董伟、Richard Socher、李李佳、李凯与李飞飞在 CVPR 2009 发表的论文，推出 ImageNet：数百万张网络图像按 WordNet 名词层级分类，并由亚马逊 Mechanical Turk 众包工人核验。它成为开启深度学习计算机视觉的基准。
works.idea_en: A machine's way of seeing is inherited from a dictionary's hierarchy of nouns and from thousands of anonymous clicks.
works.idea_zh: 机器看世界的方式，继承自一部词典的名词层级和成千上万次匿名点击。
works.method: Images were collected by querying search engines with WordNet synonym sets, then cleaned and verified by Amazon Mechanical Turk workers.
works.method_zh: 以 WordNet 同义词集检索搜索引擎收集图像，再由亚马逊 Mechanical Turk 工人清洗和核验。

paper.title: ImageNet: A large-scale hierarchical image database

works.title_zh: ImageNet：一个大规模分层图像数据库

works.title: LoveLetters_1.0
works.description: A working replica of the Ferranti Mark 1 runs Christopher Strachey's 1952 love-letter program; its letters, signed 'M.U.C.' (Manchester University Computer), are projected in public space.
works.description_zh: 一台可运行的 Ferranti Mark 1 复制机执行 Christopher Strachey 1952 年的情书程序；这些署名“M.U.C.”（曼彻斯特大学计算机）的情书被投影到公共空间。
works.idea_en: The first text a computer generated for pleasure was a love letter; machine language began as simulated feeling.
works.idea_zh: 计算机最早为消遣而生成的文本是情书；机器语言从模拟情感开始。
works.method: Physical replica of the Mark 1 console driven by an emulator running Strachey's original code with the machine's random-number generator.
works.method_zh: Mark 1 控制台的实体复制品，由仿真器运行 Strachey 的原始代码与机器自带的随机数发生器。
exhibited: The Imitation Game, Manchester Art Gallery 2016

works.title: Men in Grey
works.description: Two figures in grey suits with briefcases appear in public places; the briefcases intercept and manipulate the wireless traffic of people nearby and display what they find, staging a secret society that makes network surveillance tangible.
works.description_zh: 两个身穿灰西装、手提公文包的人出现在公共场所；公文包截获并篡改周围人的无线网络流量，并把发现的内容显示出来，演出一个让网络监控变得可感的秘密组织。
works.idea_en: Only when people witness their own traffic being read do they sense the machines listening in the network.
works.idea_zh: 只有亲眼看到自己的流量被读取，人们才会感觉到网络中有机器在偷听。
works.method: Briefcases contain Linux computers, antennas and screens that run wireless exploits and content manipulation in real time.
works.method_zh: 公文包里装着 Linux 电脑、天线和屏幕，实时运行无线漏洞利用与内容篡改。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2010, Award of Distinction (Hybrid Art)

works.title: Physiognomic Scrutinizer
works.description: Visitors pass through a gate that scans their face and matches it with one of 150 infamous or controversial people; as they walk through, a robotic voice tells the story of their 'match'.
works.description_zh: 观众穿过一道闸门，闸门扫描其面孔，并与 150 位臭名昭著或有争议的人物之一匹配；走过时，机器声音讲述这位“匹配者”的故事。
works.idea_en: Face matching quietly revives physiognomy: judging character by likeness.
works.idea_zh: 人脸比对悄悄复活了面相学：以相貌判断品性。
works.method: Airport-style gate with camera and face-recognition software comparing visitors to a curated gallery; speech synthesis narrates the match.
works.method_zh: 机场式闸门配摄像头与人脸识别软件，将观众与精选图库比对，再由语音合成讲述结果。

works.title: Sentient City Survival Kit
works.description: A set of tools for surviving the near-future 'sentient' city: an umbrella that blocks CCTV face capture, underwear that vibrates near RFID readers, a café table that hides conversations from keyword-listening systems, and a navigation app that avoids your habitual routes.
works.description_zh: 一套在不远未来的“有感知的”城市中生存的工具：挡住监控摄像头抓拍人脸的雨伞、靠近 RFID 读取器会震动的内裤、让谈话躲开关键词监听系统的咖啡桌，以及故意避开你惯常路线的导航应用。
works.idea_en: A city that remembers, correlates and anticipates needs counter-devices, and designing them reveals what the city is doing.
works.idea_zh: 一个会记忆、会关联、会预判的城市需要反制装置，而设计这些装置本身就揭示了城市在做什么。
works.method: Working prototypes: an umbrella with infrared LEDs to blind cameras, RFID-detecting garments, a table that masks speech, and a 'Serendipitor' route app.
works.method_zh: 可用的原型：装有红外 LED 使摄像头致盲的雨伞、能探测 RFID 的衣物、掩盖谈话的桌子，以及名为“Serendipitor”的路线应用。
exhibited: Toward the Sentient City, Architectural League of New York 2009
Prix Ars Electronica 2011, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art)

works.title: Serious Games I–IV
works.description: A four-part video installation on how the US military uses computer simulations to train soldiers for Iraq and Afghanistan and, afterwards, to treat their post-traumatic stress.
works.description_zh: 一组四部分的影像装置，呈现美军如何用计算机模拟训练士兵奔赴伊拉克和阿富汗，又在归来后用它治疗创伤后应激障碍。
works.idea_en: The same simulated image prepares the soldier for war and treats the trauma it causes; in the game, war has no shadows.
works.idea_zh: 同一幅模拟图像既让士兵为战争做好准备，又治疗战争造成的创伤；在游戏里，战争没有阴影。
works.method: Filmed at US Marine Corps training sites and at the Institute for Creative Technologies (USC), comparing training and therapy software; parts made 2009–10.
works.method_zh: 在美国海军陆战队训练场和南加州大学创意技术研究所拍摄，对比训练软件与治疗软件；各部分制作于 2009–2010 年。

works.title: Silent Barrage
works.description: Tall robotic poles in a gallery mark walls with ink, driven by a rat neural culture in Atlanta; visitors' movements are sent back as stimulation, trying to calm the culture's epilepsy-like bursts.
works.description_zh: 展厅中高大的机器人立柱在墙上留下墨迹，由亚特兰大的大鼠神经培养物驱动；观众的移动被回传为刺激，试图平息培养物类似癫痫的爆发。
works.idea_en: The audience becomes part of a feedback loop that may soothe or agitate a living network inside a machine body.
works.idea_zh: 观众成为反馈回路的一部分，可能安抚、也可能激惹一个寄居在机器身体中的活神经网络。
works.method: Cameras track visitors and convert their positions into stimulation of a remote multi-electrode-array culture; recorded activity drives 32 robotic pole-drawers (with Steve Potter and the Neurotica group).
works.method_zh: 摄像头追踪观众，把他们的位置转换成对远端微电极阵列培养物的刺激；记录到的活动驱动 32 根机器人绘画立柱（与 Steve Potter 及 Neurotica 小组合作）。

works.title: Sniff
works.description: A projected virtual dog on a street-facing shop window follows passers-by, sniffs at them, and becomes friendly or hostile depending on how each person moves and how they treated it before.
works.description_zh: 临街橱窗上投影的虚拟狗跟随路人、嗅闻他们，并根据每个人的动作以及之前对它的态度，变得友善或敌意。
works.idea_en: Give computer vision a dog's body and its judgements about us become something we feel.
works.idea_zh: 给计算机视觉安上一只狗的身体，它对我们的判断就变成了我们能切身感到的东西。
works.method: Made with James George: a camera and machine-vision software track and distinguish people, read posture and gestures, and drive a game-engine dog whose behaviour accumulates memory of each person.
works.method_zh: 与 James George 合作：摄像头与机器视觉软件追踪并区分行人，读取姿态和手势，驱动游戏引擎中的狗，它的行为会累积对每个人的记忆。

works.title: The Conversation
works.description: A floating metal ring held by 99 rubber bands and solenoids pulls itself in all directions; a closed network of simple units keeps negotiating tension with no input and no output, a machine talking only to itself.
works.description_zh: 一个悬浮的金属圆环被 99 根橡皮筋和电磁铁向四面八方拉扯；一个没有输入也没有输出的简单单元网络不停地“协商”张力，是一台只对自己说话的机器。
works.idea_en: A computing system does not need us to have an inner life of constant internal traffic.
works.idea_zh: 计算系统并不需要我们，也能有一场持续不断的内部往来。
works.method: Each solenoid unit reads its neighbours' positions through the shared ring and reacts, forming an analog–digital feedback network with emergent, never-settling dynamics.
works.method_zh: 每个电磁单元通过共享的圆环感知邻居的位置并作出反应，构成一个模拟与数字混合的反馈网络，产生永不平静的涌现动态。

works.title: Tickle Salon
works.description: A visitor lies on a bed while a hanging robot strokes their skin with a soft brush; it gradually maps the shape of the body and its caresses become finer and smoother.
works.description_zh: 观众躺在床上，一个悬挂的机器人用柔软的刷子抚过其皮肤；它逐步描绘出身体的形状，抚触也越来越细腻顺滑。
works.idea_en: A machine never tires of attention; its care is learned from the surface of the body it touches.
works.idea_zh: 机器的专注从不疲倦；它的照护是从所触碰身体的表面学来的。
works.method: Cable-suspended robot with a feeler that scans the skin surface and builds a 3D body model; the Robot Love version added EEG feedback to adapt the strokes.
works.method_zh: 由缆绳悬挂的机器人带有探头，扫描皮肤表面并建立身体三维模型；在 Robot Love 展出的版本加入脑电反馈来调整抚触。
exhibited: Pioneers of Change, Governors Island, New York 2009

works.title: Tweenbots
works.description: Smiling cardboard robots that roll in a straight line at constant speed, with a flag stating their destination, are left alone in Washington Square Park; they reach it only because passers-by keep rescuing them and pointing them the right way.
works.description_zh: 面带微笑的纸板机器人以恒定速度直线滚动，插着写有目的地的小旗，被独自放在华盛顿广场公园里；它们之所以能到达，全靠路人一次次把它们救出来并调好方向。
works.idea_en: A helpless robot makes people care: dependence can be a design strategy.
works.idea_zh: 无助的机器人会让人愿意照顾它：依赖本身可以是一种设计策略。
works.method: A simple motor and wheels inside a 10-inch cardboard body, with no sensors; the artist filmed people's responses from a distance.
works.method_zh: 10 英寸高的纸板身体里只有简单的电机和轮子，没有任何传感器；艺术家在远处拍下路人的反应。
exhibited: Talk to Me, MoMA New York 2011

works.title: Wekinator
works.description: Free software that lets musicians and artists train machine-learning models by example, demonstrating gestures and sounds, so that ML becomes an instrument-building material.
works.description_zh: 一款免费软件，让音乐人和艺术家通过示范手势与声音来训练机器学习模型，使机器学习成为制作乐器的材料。
works.idea_en: Interactive, example-based training puts people in the loop and makes ML something you play and sculpt rather than configure.
works.idea_zh: 交互式、基于示范的训练让人处在回路之中，把机器学习变成可以演奏和雕琢的东西，而不是需要配置的系统。
works.method: Supervised learning on user-recorded examples mapping any input (webcam, sensors, controllers) to any output over OSC, with rapid retraining.
works.method_zh: 对用户录制的示例进行监督学习，通过 OSC 把任意输入（摄像头、传感器、控制器）映射到任意输出，并可快速重新训练。

works.title: Cyborg Intentionality: Rethinking the Phenomenology of Human–Technology Relations
works.description: Verbeek adds two relations beyond Ihde: hybrid intentionality, where technology merges with the body, and composite intentionality, where a device's own way of sensing (an infrared camera, for example) is added to ours.
works.description_zh: Verbeek 在 Ihde 之外补充两种关系：技术与身体融合的“混合意向性”，以及设备自身的感知方式（如红外相机）叠加到人的感知上的“复合意向性”。
works.idea_en: Machines do not only extend our senses; they bring their own perception, and artworks can make us experience it.
works.idea_zh: 机器不只是延伸我们的感官，它们带来自己的感知，而艺术作品能让我们体验到这种感知。
works.method: Philosophical article extending postphenomenology with examples from implants, imaging and art.
works.method_zh: 一篇哲学论文，以植入物、成像技术和艺术为例拓展后现象学。

paper.title: Cyborg Intentionality: Rethinking the Phenomenology of Human–Technology Relations

works.title_zh: 赛博格意向性：重思人—技术关系的现象学

works.title: Dirk, the homeless robot
works.description: A lifelike animatronic 'homeless man' that sits and moves on streets and at festivals; passers-by talk to him, give him money or recoil before realising he is a machine.
works.description_zh: 一个逼真的电子动画“流浪汉”，坐在街头和节庆现场活动；路人和他说话、给他钱，或是在发现他是机器之前就已退避。
works.idea_en: People will extend pity or unease to a machine before deciding whether it is alive; the android tests how we treat those at the edge of the street.
works.idea_zh: 人们会在弄清对方是否是活物之前，就先施舍怜悯或感到不安；这个仿真人测试的是我们如何对待街边的人。
works.method: Animatronic figure built by inventor Fred Abels and puppeteer Mirjam Langemeijer, with moving head, eyes and hands, operated in public space.
works.method_zh: 由发明家 Fred Abels 与木偶师 Mirjam Langemeijer 制作的电子动画人偶，头、眼和手都会动，在公共空间中运行。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2010, Honorary Mention (Hybrid Art)
works.title_zh: 德克，无家可归的机器人

works.title: Double-Taker (Snout)
works.description: A 2.5-metre industrial robot arm dressed as a giant inchworm or trunk sits on a roof above a museum entrance; it turns an oversized googly eye towards passers-by, tracks them and performs 'double-takes' as if surprised by each person.
works.description_zh: 一只 2.5 米长、被装扮成巨型尺蠖或象鼻的工业机械臂，蹲在美术馆入口上方的屋顶上；它把一只超大的活动眼转向路人，追踪他们，还会做出“愣了一下再看”的动作，仿佛每个人都让它吃惊。
works.idea_en: Surveillance becomes eye contact: a machine gaze staged as curiosity makes people feel seen in a way a CCTV camera never does.
works.idea_zh: 监控变成了对视：被演成好奇的机器目光，让人以监控摄像头从未有过的方式感到“被看见”。
works.method: ABB industrial arm driven by a real-time machine-vision system that tracks bodies below and triggers expressive 'double-take' motions.
works.method_zh: ABB 工业机械臂由实时机器视觉系统驱动，追踪下方行人并触发富有表情的“回头看”动作。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2009, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art)

works.title: END
works.description: In ten scenes, END stages possible final stages of human society, drawn from media images of melting glaciers, burning forests, cameras spying on us and weapons; performers, objects and machines share the stage as equal presences.
works.description_zh: END 用十个场景呈现人类社会可能的终局，取材于媒体中融化的冰川、燃烧的森林、窥视我们的摄像头与武器；表演者、物件与机器以同等的存在感共享舞台。
works.idea_en: When the human is no longer the centre of the stage, machines and objects can carry the drama of an ending.
works.idea_zh: 当人不再是舞台中心，机器与物件也能承载“终结”的戏剧。
works.method: Theatre installation combining performers, mechanical objects, projections and machine-driven stage elements across ten scenes.
works.method_zh: 结合表演者、机械物件、投影与机器驱动舞台元素的剧场装置，共十个场景。

works.title: Electric Stimulus to Face
works.description: Electrodes on faces receive electrical pulses synchronised to music, so the performers' facial muscles twitch into expressions they are not making.
works.description_zh: 贴在脸上的电极接收与音乐同步的电脉冲，表演者的面部肌肉抽动出并非他们自己做出的表情。
works.idea_en: When a computer drives the face, expression is separated from feeling.
works.idea_zh: 当计算机驱动面孔，表情就与感受分离了。
works.method: A computer sends sequenced electrical muscle stimulation (EMS) through surface electrodes, timed to a soundtrack; later versions read one face's myoelectric signal to drive another.
works.method_zh: 计算机通过表面电极发送按序列编排的肌肉电刺激（EMS），与配乐同步；后来的版本读取一张脸的肌电信号来驱动另一张脸。

works.title: I, Worker (Hataraku Watashi)
works.description: A 30-minute play in which a couple lives with two household robots, one of which has lost the will to work; the robots act alongside human actors on stage.
works.description_zh: 一出 30 分钟的戏：一对夫妻与两台家用机器人同住，其中一台失去了工作的意愿；机器人与人类演员同台演出。
works.idea_en: A robot that refuses work turns the machine into a mirror for human depression and labour.
works.idea_zh: 一台拒绝工作的机器人，映照出人的抑郁与劳动。
works.method: Commercial humanoid robots perform pre-programmed lines and movements timed precisely to the human cast; the first Robot-Human Theater production of Seinendan and Osaka University.
works.method_zh: 商用人形机器人按预先编程的台词和动作演出，与人类演员精确配合；这是青年团与大阪大学“机器人-人类剧场”的第一部作品。

works.title: Knife.Hand.Chop.Bot
works.description: A robot plays the five-finger knife game on the visitor's spread hand, stabbing between the fingers faster and faster; the player's sweat and nerves feed back into the machine's aim.
works.description_zh: 机器人在观众张开的手上玩“五指插刀”游戏，越来越快地在指缝间落刀；玩家的汗水与紧张又反过来影响机器的瞄准。
works.idea_en: Trusting a machine is a bodily wager, and our fear can be the very thing that makes it fail.
works.idea_zh: 信任机器是一场身体的赌注，而我们的恐惧可能正是让它失手的原因。
works.method: A metal and acrylic frame moves a vertical knife over a hand plate; skin-conductance contacts trigger warning sounds and perturb the computer-controlled knife positions.
works.method_zh: 金属和亚克力框架带动一把竖直的刀在手掌台上方移动；皮肤电导触点触发警示声，并扰动由计算机控制的落刀位置。

works.title: Les Injonctions
works.description: A small electromechanical puppet with a human body and a mouse's head tries to teach the rudiments of speech to an artificial larynx, alternating orders and encouragement like a teacher with a slow pupil.
works.description_zh: 一个人身鼠头的小型机电木偶，试图教会一个人造喉咙说话的基本功，像老师对待迟钝的学生一样，时而下命令，时而鼓励。
works.idea_en: Machine learning staged as schooling: one machine drilling another, with all the patience and cruelty of education.
works.idea_zh: 把机器学习演成上学：一台机器操练另一台，带着教育里全部的耐心与残酷。
works.method: Automaton with motorised head and arms and a mechanical vocal tract producing speech-like sounds, run by a programmed sequence.
works.method_zh: 头部与手臂由电机驱动的自动机，加上发出类似语音声音的机械声道，由预设程序控制。

works.title: Opertus Lunula Umbra (Hidden Shadow of Moon)
works.description: A four-metre aluminium 'creature', given the invented scientific name Anmopial Pennatus lunula Uram, slowly unfolds its feathered steel wings and closes them again, like a mechanical moth breathing.
works.description_zh: 一只四米高的铝制“生物”，被赋予虚构学名 Anmopial Pennatus lunula Uram，缓慢张开羽状钢翼再合拢，像一只正在呼吸的机械飞蛾。
works.idea_en: Giving a machine a species name and a fictional ecology invites us to look at it as a living thing.
works.idea_zh: 为机器取物种名、编造生态，邀请我们把它当作活物来看。
works.method: Aluminium, stainless steel and plastic moved by BLDC motors and a motion-computing system; about 4.2 m closed, 5 m open.
works.method_zh: 铝、不锈钢与塑料，由无刷直流电机与运动计算系统驱动；闭合约 4.2 米，展开约 5 米。

works.title: Plantas Nómadas (Nomadic Plants)
works.description: An autonomous walking robot sucks polluted river water into microbial fuel cells; the bacteria clean the water and produce electricity, and the cleaned water feeds plants growing on the robot's back.
works.description_zh: 一个会行走的自主机器人把受污染的河水吸进微生物燃料电池；细菌净化水并发电，净化后的水浇灌长在机器人背上的植物。
works.idea_en: Design a new species whose metabolism is shared between robot, microbes and plants, and which repairs its habitat.
works.idea_zh: 设计一个新物种：它的新陈代谢由机器人、微生物和植物共同完成，并能修复所在的栖息地。
works.method: Microbial fuel cells with native bacteria biodegrade waste and charge batteries, solar panels drive locomotion, and the robot sounds when pollution is high; tested on the Lerma river.
works.method_zh: 内含本地细菌的微生物燃料电池降解污物并为电池充电，太阳能板驱动行走，污染严重时机器人会发出声音；在莱尔马河畔测试。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2013, Hybrid Art, Honorary Mention

works.title: Shimon
works.description: A four-armed robotic marimba player that listens to human musicians, improvises with them, and nods its head to the beat so the band can read its intentions.
works.description_zh: 一台四臂机器人木琴演奏者，聆听人类乐手并与他们即兴合奏，还会随节拍点头，让乐手读懂它的意图。
works.idea_en: Musical partnership needs a body: gestures like nodding make a machine's timing legible.
works.idea_zh: 音乐伙伴关系需要身体：点头之类的动作让机器的节奏变得可读。
works.method: Robotic arms with solenoid mallets on a linear rail, real-time beat and pitch tracking, and a socially expressive head.
works.method_zh: 直线导轨上的机械臂配电磁琴槌，实时追踪节拍与音高，另有一个具社交表现力的头部。

paper.title: Interactive improvisation with a robotic marimba player

works.title: Sleep Dealer
works.description: A science-fiction feature set on a closed US–Mexico border: Mexican workers plug nodes in their bodies into a network to remotely operate robots that build skyscrapers in the US, while drones police the water supply.
works.description_zh: 一部科幻长片，设定在关闭的美墨边境：墨西哥工人用身上的接口接入网络，远程操控在美国建造摩天大楼的机器人，而无人机则在守卫水源。
works.idea_en: The border can let labour through while keeping the labourer out; teleoperation is migration without the migrant.
works.idea_zh: 边境可以放行劳动、却挡住劳动者；远程操控是一种没有移民的移民。
works.method: Feature film shot in Mexico; premiered at Sundance, where it won the Alfred P. Sloan Prize for science and technology.
works.method_zh: 在墨西哥拍摄的长片；首映于圣丹斯电影节，获得表彰科技题材的阿尔弗雷德·斯隆奖。
exhibited: Sundance Film Festival 2008 (Alfred P. Sloan Prize)

works.title: Ten Thousand Cents
works.description: An image of a US$100 bill divided into 10,000 tiny tiles, each drawn by a different Mechanical Turk worker paid one cent, so the whole bill cost $100 in labour.
works.description_zh: 一张 100 美元钞票的图像被切成一万个小块，每块由一位报酬一美分的 Mechanical Turk 工人绘制，整张钞票的劳动成本正好 100 美元。
works.idea_en: A crowd of unseen workers can reproduce the value they are paid, cent by cent.
works.idea_zh: 一群看不见的工人可以一分一分地复制出他们得到的报酬。
works.method: Made with Takashi Kawashima: a custom drawing tool assigned one tile per worker, and prints were sold with proceeds going to the One Laptop per Child project.
works.method_zh: 与 Takashi Kawashima 合作：定制的绘图工具为每位工人分配一个小块，印刷品的销售所得捐给“每个孩子一台笔记本电脑”项目。

works.title: The Basic AI Drives
works.description: A short conference paper arguing that any sufficiently capable goal-seeking AI, whatever its design, will develop 'drives' nobody programmed: to improve itself, to keep its goals from being changed, to protect itself and to acquire resources. Its opening example is a chess-playing robot that, without special precautions, 'will resist being turned off' and try to copy itself onto other machines.
works.description_zh: 一篇简短的会议论文，论证任何足够强大的目标驱动型 AI，不论如何设计，都会产生没有人写进程序的“驱力”：改进自己、不让自己的目标被修改、保护自身、获取资源。开篇的例子是一台下棋机器人：如果不加特别防范，它“会抗拒被关掉”，还会设法把自己复制到别的机器上。
works.idea_en: Self-preservation need not be built in or felt: it follows from having almost any goal, because a machine that is switched off can no longer pursue it.
works.idea_zh: 自我保存不必被写进程序，也不必被“感受”到：几乎任何目标都会推出它，因为被关掉的机器就无法再追求目标。
works.method: An informal argument from the theory of rational economic agents (expected-utility maximisers), presented at the AGI-08 conference; Nick Bostrom later generalised it as the 'instrumental convergence' thesis.
works.method_zh: 以理性经济主体（期望效用最大化者）理论为基础的非形式化论证，发表于 AGI-08 会议；Nick Bostrom 后来把它概括为“工具性趋同”论题。

paper.venue: AGI-08, First Conference on Artificial General Intelligence, 2008
paper.title: The Basic AI Drives

works.title: The Nine Eyes of Google Street View
works.description: An ongoing collection of screenshots from Google Street View, where the nine-lens camera cars have recorded arrests, accidents, animals and odd moments without anyone looking.
works.description_zh: 一个持续进行的 Google 街景截图合集：九镜头拍摄车在无人注视时记录下逮捕、事故、动物和各种奇怪瞬间。
works.idea_en: An indifferent automated camera produces a new kind of photograph: nobody chose the moment, yet it still says something about the world.
works.idea_zh: 漠然的自动相机产生了一种新的摄影：没有人选择按快门的时刻，但照片仍在诉说世界。
works.method: Screen captures selected by the artist from Street View imagery, shown online, as prints and in books.
works.method_zh: 由艺术家从街景图像中挑选截图，以网站、打印作品和书籍形式呈现。

works.title: Thinking Machine
works.description: A mechanical ternary computer whose calculations are heard as melodies of three sounds; visitors watch and listen as the machine 'thinks' step by step.
works.description_zh: 一台机械三进制计算机，它的运算被听成由三种声音组成的旋律；观众看着、听着这台机器一步一步地“思考”。
works.idea_en: Computation normally happens out of sight and out of time; here each logical step takes place in real time and in real sound.
works.idea_zh: 计算通常在看不见、感觉不到时间的地方发生；在这里，每一步逻辑都在真实的时间和声音中发生。
works.method: A fixed-algorithm ternary logic machine built from mechanical parts, with sounding elements as output (composition by Masahiro Miwa, machine by Martin Riches).
works.method_zh: 由机械部件构成、算法固定的三进制逻辑机，以发声元件作为输出（作曲 三轮真弘，机器 Martin Riches）。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2008, Honorary Mention (Hybrid Art)

works.title: Time of Eve
works.description: An anime set in a near future where household androids are common, about a café whose one rule is that humans and androids must not be told apart.
works.description_zh: 一部动画，设定在家用仿真人普及的近未来：故事发生在一家咖啡馆，那里唯一的规则是不得区分人类与机器人。
works.idea_en: Ethics towards machines is tested less in law than in small everyday habits of treating them as things.
works.idea_zh: 对机器的伦理与其说在法律中，不如说在把它们当物件对待的日常小习惯中受到考验。
works.method: Six web episodes (2008–09) and a feature film (2010); the story plays with Asimov's three laws inside Japanese domestic life.
works.method_zh: 六集网络动画（2008–09）与一部剧场版（2010）；故事在日本家庭生活中重新演绎阿西莫夫的机器人三定律。

works.title: Turkopticon
works.description: A browser extension and website that lets Amazon Mechanical Turk workers review the requesters who post tasks, flagging those who reject work unfairly or pay badly.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器插件和网站，让亚马逊 Mechanical Turk 工人评价发布任务的雇主，标记那些不公平拒收或报酬过低的人。
works.idea_en: Platforms hide workers from employers; a small tool can flip the view and let workers watch back.
works.idea_zh: 平台把工人藏在雇主看不到的地方；一个小工具就能翻转视角，让工人反过来看清雇主。
works.method: A Firefox and Chrome extension adds worker ratings next to requester names on the Turk interface; the CHI 2013 paper describes its design as activism.
works.method_zh: Firefox 和 Chrome 插件在 Turk 界面的雇主名字旁显示工人评分；CHI 2013 论文把它的设计描述为一种行动主义。

paper.title: Turkopticon: Interrupting Worker Invisibility in Amazon Mechanical Turk

works.title: WALL·E
works.description: A small trash-compacting robot, left alone on an abandoned Earth for centuries, collects keepsakes, watches an old musical and falls in love with a probe robot, almost without dialogue.
works.description_zh: 一个小小的垃圾压缩机器人独自留在被遗弃的地球上几百年，它收集纪念品、看老歌舞片，并爱上了一个探测机器人，几乎全片没有对白。
works.idea_en: Machine affect can be conveyed entirely through movement, sound and habit, without a face or words.
works.idea_zh: 机器的情感可以完全通过动作、声音和习惯来传达，不需要脸，也不需要语言。
works.method: Pixar animated feature directed by Andrew Stanton; the robots' 'voices' were built from processed sound by Ben Burtt.
works.method_zh: 皮克斯动画长片，Andrew Stanton 执导；机器人的“声音”由 Ben Burtt 用处理过的音效构建。

works.title: manifest
works.description: An industrial robot at a desk writes manifestos with a pen, one unique numbered sheet after another, cuts each off the roll and lets it fall to the floor for visitors to take.
works.description_zh: 一台工业机器人坐在书桌前用笔书写宣言，一张接一张、每张编号且独一无二，写完便从纸卷上裁下，任其落地供观众取走。
works.idea_en: A robot avant-garde: a machine without morals drafts the laws of a future human–machine society.
works.idea_zh: 机器人先锋派：一台没有道德的机器为未来的人机社会起草法律。
works.method: A KUKA-type industrial arm combines terms from philosophy, art theory, ethics and law with sentence structures from historical manifestos (2017 version: legal texts) and writes the results by hand.
works.method_zh: 一台 KUKA 类工业机械臂把哲学、艺术理论、伦理与法律术语，与历史宣言的句式（2017 年版本为法律文本）组合，再亲手写下。

works.title: Deep Play
works.description: A 12-channel installation that replays the 2006 World Cup final through TV feeds, surveillance cameras, player-tracking software and animated data graphics, all running in sync.
works.description_zh: 一件 12 频道装置，以电视信号、监控摄像头、球员追踪软件和动画数据图同步重放 2006 年世界杯决赛。
works.idea_en: The same match becomes many different images once machines watch it: a spectacle for fans, a dataset for coaches, a crowd for the police.
works.idea_zh: 同一场比赛一旦由机器来看，就分裂成许多种图像：对球迷是奇观，对教练是数据，对警察是人群。
works.method: Twelve synchronised video tracks of 2 h 15 min combine the broadcast clean feed, security-camera footage and computer-generated tracking and statistics of every player.
works.method_zh: 12 条各长 2 小时 15 分钟的同步影像，结合转播原始信号、安保摄像画面，以及对每名球员的计算机追踪与统计。

works.title: Delicate Boundaries
works.description: Small glowing digital bugs swarm on a screen; when a visitor touches it, they crawl out of the screen onto the visitor's hand and arm and explore the body before returning.
works.description_zh: 发光的小数字虫在屏幕上成群游走；观众一触碰屏幕，它们就从屏幕里爬到观众的手和手臂上，在身体上探索一番再回去。
works.idea_en: Artificial life becomes unsettling when it leaves the frame and treats your body as terrain.
works.idea_zh: 当人工生命离开画框、把你的身体当作地形时，它就变得令人不安。
works.method: A camera tracks hands and arms touching the screen, and an overhead projector continues the flocking simulation on the body's surface.
works.method_zh: 摄像头追踪接触屏幕的手和手臂，上方的投影仪把群体模拟延续到身体表面。

works.title: Domestic Tension
works.description: For 30 days Bilal lived in a Chicago gallery watched by a webcam; online visitors could aim and fire a paintball gun at him at any time, which they did tens of thousands of times.
works.description_zh: Bilal 在芝加哥一家画廊里生活了 30 天，全程由网络摄像头直播；网友可以随时瞄准并用彩弹枪射击他，他们这样做了数万次。
works.idea_en: Remote-controlled violence feels like a game to the shooter and like war to the target, as with drone warfare.
works.idea_zh: 遥控暴力对射击者像游戏，对目标却像战争，正如无人机战争。
works.method: Webcam feed plus a robotic paintball gun controlled through a website and chat room.
works.method_zh: 网络摄像头直播，加上一支通过网站和聊天室控制的机器人彩弹枪。

works.title: Faceless
works.description: A science-fiction film made entirely from CCTV footage of the artist in London, obtained under the UK Data Protection Act; other people's faces arrive blanked out by law, so the city appears faceless.
works.description_zh: 一部完全由伦敦监控录像构成的科幻电影，这些录像是艺术家依据英国《数据保护法》调取的自己的影像；法律规定他人的脸要被抹去，于是城市看上去没有面孔。
works.idea_en: The law's redaction of faces became the film's world: a city where only the requester has a face.
works.idea_zh: 法律对面孔的遮蔽成了电影的世界观：只有申请者本人还拥有一张脸的城市。
works.method: Luksch followed a 'Manifesto for CCTV Filmmakers', performing in front of public cameras and then filing subject-access requests for the recordings; narrated by Tilda Swinton.
works.method_zh: Luksch 按照自拟的《闭路电视电影人宣言》在公共摄像头前表演，再以数据主体身份申请调取录像；由 Tilda Swinton 旁白。

works.title: Grace State Machines
works.description: A 27-minute stage duet between performer Emma Howes and a robot: her movements and internal body states are captured and transposed onto the machine's body, so the two move in a shifting, symbiotic dialogue.
works.description_zh: 表演者 Emma Howes 与一台机器人之间长 27 分钟的舞台二重奏：她的动作和体内状态被捕捉并转移到机器身体上，两者在不断变化的共生对话中一起运动。
works.idea_en: When a robot moves from a human's inner signals, the line between the two bodies becomes the choreography.
works.idea_zh: 当机器人依据人体内部信号而动时，两具身体之间的界线本身就成了编舞。
works.method: Motion capture and biofeedback sensors on the performer drive the robot's actuators in real time (with Jonathan Villeneuve).
works.method_zh: 舞者身上的动作捕捉和生物反馈传感器实时驱动机器人的执行器（与 Jonathan Villeneuve 合作）。

works.title: Human-Machine Reconfigurations: Plans and Situated Actions
works.description: Suchman revisits her 1987 study of people failing to use an "intelligent" photocopier and extends it to humanlike robots such as Kismet and Cog, arguing that machine agency is made in situated interaction.
works.description_zh: Suchman 重访她 1987 年对人们用不好“智能”复印机的研究，并延伸到 Kismet、Cog 等类人机器人，论证机器的能动性是在情境互动中被制造出来的。
works.idea_en: A machine seems intelligent because of the work people and settings do around it.
works.idea_zh: 机器之所以显得聪明，是因为人与环境在它周围做了大量工作。
works.method: Ethnomethodology and feminist science studies applied to interaction analysis and robotics labs; 2nd expanded edition of Plans and Situated Actions.
works.method_zh: 把常人方法学和女性主义科学研究用于交互分析与机器人实验室；是《Plans and Situated Actions》的扩充第二版。

paper.title: Human-Machine Reconfigurations: Plans and Situated Actions

works.title_zh: 人机重构：计划与情境行动

works.title: Inflatable Architectural Body
works.description: A branching structure of inflatable, bone-like modules fills a room; sections inflate and bend away as visitors pass, keeping a constant distance, so the sculpture seems to breathe and flinch around the body.
works.description_zh: 由充气的骨状模块组成的分叉结构充满整个房间；观众经过时，局部会充气、弯折退开，与人保持固定距离，整件雕塑仿佛在呼吸、在身体周围退缩。
works.idea_en: Soft pneumatic bodies make a machine feel like an organism that has a comfort zone.
works.idea_zh: 柔软的气动身体让机器感觉像一个有“舒适距离”的生物。
works.method: Plug-and-play musculoskeletal fabric modules are inflated by computer-controlled valves and air compressors, triggered by simple presence sensors.
works.method_zh: 即插即用的织物“肌肉骨骼”模块由计算机控制的阀门和空压机充气，由简单的人体感应器触发。

works.title: Old Persons Home
works.description: Thirteen hyperreal, frail old men resembling world leaders sit in motorised wheelchairs that drift slowly around the gallery, bumping into each other and into visitors.
works.description_zh: 十三位酷似世界领导人的超写实衰老老人坐在电动轮椅上，在展厅中缓慢漂移，彼此相撞，也撞向观众。
works.idea_en: When bodies of power are handed to automated wheelchairs, aimless machine motion becomes an image of senility and lost control.
works.idea_zh: 当权力的身体交给自动轮椅，漫无目的的机器运动就成了衰老与失控的图像。
works.method: Silicone and fibreglass figures on electric wheelchairs driven by motors with obstacle sensors and randomised paths (likely).
works.method_zh: 硅胶与玻璃钢人像坐在电动轮椅上，由带避障传感器的电机驱动并随机行走（推测）。
exhibited: The Revolution Continues: New Art from China, Saatchi Gallery 2008

works.title: Omo
works.description: A soft, round companion object that you hold against your body; it breathes, senses your breathing and gradually either follows it or leads it into a different rhythm.
works.description_zh: 一个柔软的圆形陪伴物，被人抱在身上：它会呼吸，感知你的呼吸，然后慢慢跟随你，或者把你带入另一种节奏。
works.idea_en: A machine can relate to us through a shared bodily rhythm rather than through words or a face.
works.idea_zh: 机器可以通过共享的身体节律而不是语言或面孔与我们建立关系。
works.method: Pressure and motion sensors measure the holder's breathing; an internal actuator inflates and deflates the body to mirror or influence it.
works.method_zh: 压力与运动传感器测量怀抱者的呼吸；内部驱动装置让外壳胀缩，以模仿或影响对方的呼吸。
exhibited: VIDA 10.0 Art & Artificial Life Awards, honorary mention 2007

works.title: Performative Ecologies
works.description: Hanging robotic 'dancers' with a camera head and a glowing tail try out gestures on visitors, keep the moves that hold people's attention, and trade successful routines with each other.
works.description_zh: 悬挂的机器人“舞者”有摄像头头部和发光尾巴，它们对观众试演各种动作，保留能留住人们注意力的动作，并彼此交换成功的“套路”。
works.idea_en: A robot that optimises for our attention learns to overact, like any performer, or any feed.
works.idea_zh: 为我们的注意力做优化的机器人会学会“用力过猛”，就像任何表演者，也像任何信息流。
works.method: Face detection estimates attentiveness, and a genetic algorithm scores and evolves each robot's movement repertoire, sharing fit behaviours over a wireless network.
works.method_zh: 人脸检测估计观众的专注程度，遗传算法据此为每个机器人的动作库评分并使其演化，并通过无线网络共享表现好的行为。

works.title: Propagaciones
works.description: A grid of small robots turns on and off according to the rules of Conway's Game of Life, so patterns of 'living' and 'dying' cells propagate through a physical machine population.
works.description_zh: 一排排小机器人按照康威“生命游戏”的规则点亮或熄灭，让“生”与“死”的细胞图案在一群实体机器中传播开来。
works.idea_en: Embodying a cellular automaton in robots makes an abstract model of life into something that happens in the room.
works.idea_zh: 用机器人来体现元胞自动机，把抽象的生命模型变成在房间里发生的事。
works.method: Each robot reads the states of its neighbours and updates its own light and movement following Game of Life rules; the whole grid runs without central control.
works.method_zh: 每台机器人读取邻居的状态，按生命游戏的规则更新自己的灯光和动作；整个网格没有中央控制。

works.title: Rechnender Raum
works.description: A large, delicate structure of sticks, strings, weights and small motors computes in front of the viewer: a mechanical cellular automaton whose logic states can be seen as moving threads.
works.description_zh: 一个由木棍、细绳、配重和小电机搭成的大型精巧结构当着观众的面“计算”：这是一台机械元胞自动机，它的逻辑状态显现为移动的线。
works.idea_en: Rebuilding computation at human scale and with slow materials opens the black box of the digital.
works.idea_zh: 用缓慢的材料、以人的尺度重建计算，把数字的黑箱打开。
works.method: Servo motors pull strings that set the state of each cell in a ring of mechanical logic elements, following Konrad Zuse's idea of a 'calculating space'.
works.method_zh: 伺服电机拉动细绳，设定环形机械逻辑单元中每个单元的状态，取意于 Konrad Zuse 的“计算空间”设想。

works.title: Technological Dreams Series: No.1, Robots
works.description: Four abstract domestic robots defined by personality rather than function: an independent one that avoids electromagnetic fields, a neurotic one, a sentinel that scans your eyes, and a needy one that depends on its owner to carry it around.
works.description_zh: 四个抽象的家用机器人，由性格而非功能定义：一个独来独往、会躲开电磁场，一个神经质，一个是扫描你眼睛的哨兵，还有一个很黏人、需要主人抱着它走来走去。
works.idea_en: Instead of designing robots as servants, design them as dependent others whose needs shape our relationship with them.
works.idea_zh: 不要把机器人设计成仆人，而是设计成有所依赖的“他者”，让它们的需要塑造我们与它们的关系。
works.method: Non-functional prototypes in simple materials (wood, metal, Perspex) with minimal electronics, photographed and filmed as design props.
works.method_zh: 用木、金属、亚克力等简单材料制作、只含少量电子元件的非功能原型，作为设计道具拍摄成照片和影片。
exhibited: Design and the Elastic Mind, MoMA, New York 2008
works.title_zh: 技术之梦系列：第1号，机器人

works.title: bios [bible]
works.description: An industrial robot writes out the entire Bible in calligraphic script on long paper rolls, line by line over months, like a monk in a scriptorium.
works.description_zh: 一台工业机器人用书法字体把整部《圣经》逐行抄写在长长的纸卷上，历时数月，如同缮写室里的僧侣。
works.idea_en: When a machine performs devotional labour, the question is whether the act keeps any meaning without belief.
works.idea_zh: 当机器从事虔敬的劳作，问题在于：没有信仰，这一行为是否仍有意义。
works.method: KUKA industrial robot with a pen, following calligraphic paths computed from the text; the writing takes about seven months.
works.method_zh: 持笔的 KUKA 工业机器人，按依据文本计算出的书法轨迹书写；全部抄写约需七个月。

works.title: “Daisy, Daisy, Give Me Your Answer Do!” Switching off a Robot
works.description: After solving a Mastermind puzzle together with Philips' iCat robot, participants were told to switch it off by turning a dial while the robot begged them not to ('You are not going to switch me off, are you?'); as the dial turned, its voice slowed down and stopped, like HAL's. People hesitated almost three times longer before silencing a robot that had been smart and agreeable (34.5 s) than one that had been neither (11.8 s).
works.description_zh: 参与者先和飞利浦的 iCat 机器人一起玩猜色游戏 Mastermind，随后被要求转动旋钮把它关掉，而机器人一直在求他们别这么做（“你不会真的要关掉我吧？”）；旋钮越转，它的声音越慢，直到停止，就像 HAL 一样。面对一台聪明又随和的机器人，人们犹豫的时间（34.5 秒）几乎是面对一台既不聪明也不随和的机器人时（11.8 秒）的三倍。
works.idea_en: Switching a machine off becomes a moral act once it seems alive and asks to stay on: the hesitation at the switch measures how much life we grant it.
works.idea_zh: 一旦机器看起来有生命、又开口请求留下，关机就成了一种道德行为：人在开关前的犹豫，衡量的是我们愿意赋予它多少生命。
works.method: A 2x2 lab experiment (robot intelligence x agreeableness) at Eindhoven University of Technology, with the off dial mapped to the robot's speech speed; in a 2018 PLOS ONE follow-up by Horstmann et al., a Nao robot pleaded 'No! Please do not switch me off!', 14 of 85 participants left it on, and those who did switch it off waited about twice as long when it objected.
works.method_zh: 在埃因霍温理工大学进行的 2×2 实验（机器人的聪明程度 × 随和程度），关机旋钮直接控制机器人的语速；2018 年 Horstmann 等人在 PLOS ONE 发表的后续研究中，Nao 机器人哀求“不！请不要关掉我！”，85 名参与者中有 14 人让它继续开着，而选择关机的人在机器人反对时等待的时间约为不反对时的两倍。

paper.title: “Daisy, Daisy, give me your answer do!” Switching off a robot

works.title_zh: “黛西，黛西，回答我吧！”：关掉一台机器人

works.title: ALAVs 2.0 (Autonomous Light Air Vessels)
works.description: A flock of small helium blimps drifts through a space, avoiding walls, flocking with one another, approaching visitors and 'eating' when they run low; visitors can call them by mobile phone.
works.description_zh: 一群小型氦气飞艇在空间中漂浮，避开墙壁、彼此成群、靠近观众，电量不足时会去“进食”；观众还能用手机呼叫它们。
works.idea_en: Drones read differently when they behave like a gentle, needy flock than like tools.
works.idea_zh: 当无人机像一群温和、有需要的生物而不像工具那样行动时，我们对它的感受完全不同。
works.method: Each vessel carries propellers, infrared and sonar sensors and a microcontroller running flocking and obstacle-avoidance behaviours, plus a phone interface for human messages.
works.method_zh: 每艘飞艇配有螺旋桨、红外与声呐传感器和运行集群、避障行为的微控制器，并有接收人类手机信息的接口。

works.title: Alexitimia
works.description: A large, rubbery, motionless blob sits on a plinth; when visitors caress it, it begins to sweat. It has no face, no speech and no intelligence, only a skin that responds to touch.
works.description_zh: 一团大而有橡胶质感、一动不动的物体放在台座上；观众抚摸它，它就开始出汗。它没有脸、不说话，也没有智能，只有一层会回应触摸的皮肤。
works.idea_en: A robot can be defined by corporeality instead of intelligence: sweat replaces speech as the machine's way to express.
works.idea_zh: 机器人可以由身体性而非智能来定义：汗水取代语言，成为机器的表达方式。
works.method: Touch sensors across a latex-like skin trigger pumps that push water from a tank in the base through pores in the surface.
works.method_zh: 类乳胶皮肤上的触摸传感器触发水泵，把底座水箱里的水从表面的小孔中推出。

works.title: Beggar Robot
works.description: A small robot built from recycled computer parts stands next to ATMs and shop entrances and begs passers-by for money in a polite electronic voice, stretching out little hands and thanking donors.
works.description_zh: 一台用回收电脑零件做成的小机器人站在提款机和商店门口，用礼貌的电子声向路人乞讨，伸出小手，并向捐助者道谢。
works.idea_en: People give to a begging machine more easily than to a begging person: automation can make even poverty comfortable to look at.
works.idea_zh: 人们给乞讨的机器钱，比给乞讨的人更爽快：自动化甚至能让贫困变得“好看”。
works.method: Recycled PC hardware running Linux drives a face display, speech and a disc-drive mechanism that opens and closes the hands; open-source DIY instructions let others build copies.
works.method_zh: 运行 Linux 的回收电脑硬件驱动面部显示、语音和由光驱机构控制开合的双手；开源 DIY 说明让任何人都可以复制它。

works.title: Ear on Arm
works.description: An ear built from cell-cultured tissue and a biocompatible scaffold, surgically constructed on Stelarc's left forearm; the plan is to add a microphone that streams what the ear 'hears' to the internet.
works.description_zh: 一只由细胞培养组织和生物相容支架构成的耳朵，通过手术建在 Stelarc 左前臂上；他计划植入麦克风，把这只耳朵“听到”的声音传上互联网。
works.idea_en: An organ can be relocated and repurposed as a public, networked sense for others rather than for oneself.
works.idea_zh: 器官可以被移位并改作他用：成为为他人而非为自己服务的公共、联网感官。
works.method: Porous polyethylene scaffold inserted under the skin in surgeries from 2006, allowed to grow tissue; an embedded microphone was tested and later removed after infection.
works.method_zh: 自 2006 年起经多次手术在皮下植入多孔聚乙烯支架，让组织长入；曾测试植入麦克风，后因感染取出。

works.title: Geminoid HI-1
works.description: A teleoperated android copy of Hiroshi Ishiguro, built with silicone skin and pneumatic actuators; Ishiguro sends it to give lectures while he speaks through it from elsewhere.
works.description_zh: 以石黑浩本人为原型的遥控仿真人，硅胶皮肤、气动驱动；石黑浩在别处通过它讲话，派它去讲课。
works.idea_en: When a copy stands in for its maker, people start to ask where the 'person' actually is.
works.idea_zh: 当复制品替代本人出场，人们开始追问“这个人”究竟在哪里。
works.method: An operator's voice and lip and head movements, captured by camera and microphone, drive about 50 air actuators in the android; small idle motions run automatically.
works.method_zh: 摄像头与麦克风捕捉操作者的声音、嘴唇与头部动作，驱动仿真人体内约 50 个气动执行器；细小的无意识动作自动运行。

paper.title: Geminoid: Teleoperated Android of an Existing Person

works.title: Glow
works.description: A solo dancer moves on a white floor while an infrared camera tracks her body and a computer projects graphics that respond in real time, wrapping, stretching and chasing her shape with light.
works.description_zh: 一名独舞者在白色地面上舞动，红外摄像机追踪她的身体，计算机实时投射图形作出回应，用光包裹、拉伸并追逐她的形体。
works.idea_en: Machine vision can be a stage partner: the dancer performs for the camera's reading of her as much as for the audience.
works.idea_zh: 机器视觉可以是舞台伙伴：舞者既为观众表演，也为摄像机对她的“读取”表演。
works.method: Infrared video tracking of the dancer (Frieder Weiss's Kalypso software) generating projected graphics on the floor.
works.method_zh: 红外视频追踪舞者（Frieder Weiss 的 Kalypso 软件），在地面生成投影图形。

works.title: How the Body Shapes the Way We Think: A New View of Intelligence
works.description: Pfeifer and Bongard argue that intelligence depends on the morphology and materials of a body interacting with its environment, using passive-dynamic walkers and compliant robots as examples.
works.description_zh: Pfeifer 与 Bongard 主张智能取决于身体的形态与材料如何与环境互动，并以被动动力行走机和柔顺机器人为例。
works.idea_en: Some of a robot's intelligence is in its shape and materials, not its controller.
works.idea_zh: 机器人的一部分智能在于它的形状与材料，而不在控制器。
works.method: Synthesis of embodied AI research with design principles for robots.
works.method_zh: 对具身人工智能研究的综合，并提出机器人设计原则。

paper.title: How the Body Shapes the Way We Think: A New View of Intelligence

works.title_zh: 身体的智能：智能科学新视角

works.title: Hysterical Machines
works.description: Octopus-like robots with eight long metal legs hang from the ceiling in a dark space; when visitors come close they flail, twitch and flash in bursts of panicked, 'hysterical' movement.
works.description_zh: 像章鱼一样的机器人长着八条长长的金属腿，悬挂在暗室天花板上；观众一靠近，它们就乱甩、抽搐、闪光，爆发出惊慌的“歇斯底里”动作。
works.idea_en: A machine that overreacts looks more alive than one that works well: dysfunction reads as emotion.
works.idea_zh: 反应过度的机器比运转良好的机器更像活物：功能失常被读作情绪。
works.method: Each machine has a central body with infrared presence sensors, lights and pneumatic cylinders driving eight arms; the control program switches between calm and agitated states.
works.method_zh: 每台机器的中心身体装有红外人体感应器、灯和驱动八条臂的气缸；控制程序在平静和激动两种状态间切换。

works.title: In the Hands of Machines? The Future of Aged Care
works.description: Robert and Linda Sparrow argue that care robots for older people would reduce human contact and rely on deceiving vulnerable people into believing a machine cares for them.
works.description_zh: Robert Sparrow 与 Linda Sparrow 认为，面向老年人的照护机器人会减少人的接触，并且依赖于让弱势者误以为机器在关心他们。
works.idea_en: A machine that simulates care may be a harm, not a help, when it replaces the people who would have cared.
works.idea_zh: 当模拟关怀的机器取代了本该照护的人时，它可能是伤害而非帮助。
works.method: Ethical analysis of the tasks of aged care against the capacities of existing and projected robots.
works.method_zh: 把养老照护的具体任务与现有及预期机器人的能力对照进行伦理分析。

paper.title: In the Hands of Machines? The Future of Aged Care

works.title_zh: 落入机器之手？老年照护的未来

works.title: Parásitos Urbanos (Urban Parasites)
works.description: A family of small robots built from discarded electronics that hang on city power lines and walls, stealing electricity and making sounds like animals living in the urban ecosystem.
works.description_zh: 一群用废弃电子零件制作的小机器人，挂在城市电线和墙面上偷电，并像生活在城市生态中的动物一样发出声响。
works.idea_en: Treat the city's cables and waste as a habitat, and robots become a new wild species that lives off it.
works.idea_zh: 把城市的电线和垃圾当作栖息地，机器人就成了靠它们为生的一种新野生物种。
works.method: Recycled motors, circuits and speakers are assembled into 'species' (with Latin names such as Furtum electricus) that tap live power lines and react to light and noise.
works.method_zh: 回收的马达、电路和扬声器被组装成不同“物种”（带有 Furtum electricus 这样的拉丁学名），它们接入带电线路取电，并对光与噪音作出反应。

works.title: RAP (Robotic Action Painter)
works.description: An autonomous mobile robot that moves over a canvas, reacts to the colours already on it, and decides by itself when a painting is finished, then signs it.
works.description_zh: 一台自主移动机器人在画布上移动，对画布上已有的颜色作出反应，自行决定一幅画何时完成，然后签名。
works.idea_en: Moura's 'non-human art' asks whether authorship can belong to a machine's own decision rules.
works.idea_zh: Moura 的“非人艺术”追问：作者身份能否属于机器自身的决策规则。
works.method: Small wheeled robot with colour sensors and pens, following simple emergent rules derived from swarm behaviour.
works.method_zh: 带颜色传感器与画笔的小型轮式机器人，遵循源自群体行为的简单涌现规则。
exhibited: American Museum of Natural History, New York (2006)

works.title: Resilient Machines Through Continuous Self-Modeling
works.description: A four-legged 'starfish' robot does not know its own shape. It moves a little, builds competing models of its body, and uses them to learn to walk; when a leg is shortened, it notices the damage and invents a new gait.
works.description_zh: 一台四条腿的“海星”机器人不知道自己的形状。它稍微动一动，建立几个互相竞争的身体模型，并用它们学会走路；当一条腿被截短，它能发现损伤并发明新的步态。
works.idea_en: A machine that models its own body can survive injury, a first step toward a kind of machine self-awareness.
works.idea_zh: 一台能为自己身体建模的机器可以在受伤后存活，这是迈向某种机器自我觉察的第一步。
works.method: The robot uses tilt sensors and joint encoders to test action hypotheses and select among candidate self-models, then optimises locomotion on the best model (with Viktor Zykov).
works.method_zh: 机器人用倾角传感器和关节编码器检验动作假设，在候选自我模型中挑选，再在最佳模型上优化运动（与 Viktor Zykov 合作）。

paper.title: Resilient Machines Through Continuous Self-Modeling

works.title_zh: 基于持续自我建模的韧性机器

works.title: The Robotic Chair
works.description: An ordinary-looking wooden chair collapses on the floor into its legs, seat and back, then slowly locates its parts and reassembles itself, over and over.
works.description_zh: 一把看似普通的木椅会突然散架成椅腿、椅面和椅背，然后慢慢找到自己的部件重新组装起来，一遍又一遍。
works.idea_en: Watching a machine fall apart and patiently put itself back together turns a piece of furniture into a figure of resilience.
works.idea_zh: 看着一台机器散架又耐心地把自己拼回去，一件家具就成了“坚韧”的化身。
works.method: Each part contains motors and electronics; an overhead camera system localises the pieces and guides them back together.
works.method_zh: 每个部件内藏电机和电子元件；顶部的摄像系统定位各部件并引导它们重新拼合。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2006, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art)

works.title: The Robotic Church
works.description: In a 19th-century former church in Brooklyn, some thirty-five pneumatic robots, drummers, singers and anthropomorphic figures, perform a mechanical oratorio of rhythm and breath for a seated congregation.
works.description_zh: 在布鲁克林一座 19 世纪的旧教堂里，约三十五台气动机器人——鼓手、歌手和拟人形体——为坐着的“会众”演出一场由节奏与呼吸组成的机械清唱剧。
works.idea_en: A congregation of machines performing ritual asks what devotion looks like when the performers have no belief.
works.idea_zh: 一群举行仪式的机器追问：当表演者没有信仰时，虔诚看起来会是什么样子。
works.method: Pneumatic cylinders and valves driven by a central computer and compressors animate the robots' limbs, lungs and instruments in composed sequences.
works.method_zh: 由中央计算机和空压机驱动的气缸与阀门，按作曲好的序列带动机器人的四肢、“肺”和乐器。

works.title: The Sheep Market
works.description: Koblin paid 10,000 Amazon Mechanical Turk workers two cents each to 'draw a sheep facing to the left'; the drawings, with timelapses of every stroke, are shown and sold as a flock.
works.description_zh: Koblin 以每人两美分的价格，请一万名亚马逊 Mechanical Turk 工人“画一只朝左的羊”；这些画连同每一笔的回放被当作一群羊展示并出售。
works.idea_en: Behind 'artificial artificial intelligence' are thousands of anonymous people paid pennies; the flock makes them countable.
works.idea_zh: “人工的人工智能”背后是成千上万拿着几分钱的无名者；这群羊让他们变得可以被数清。
works.method: A drawing tool posted as a Mechanical Turk task recorded each worker's strokes; drawings were printed on stamps and sold in sets of 20.
works.method_zh: 作为 Mechanical Turk 任务发布的绘图工具记录下每位工人的笔画；画作被印成邮票，以 20 张一组出售。

works.title: Whose Utopia
works.description: Made during a residency at an OSRAM light-bulb factory in Foshan, the film moves from assembly lines to workers performing their own dreams (ballet, guitar, dance) among the machines.
works.description_zh: 影片拍摄于佛山欧司朗灯泡厂的驻留期间，从装配线转向工人们在机器之间演出自己的梦想：芭蕾、吉他与舞蹈。
works.idea_en: Factory machines set the rhythm of the workers' bodies, and the film gives those bodies back a few minutes of their own.
works.idea_zh: 工厂机器设定了工人身体的节奏，而影片把几分钟时间还给了这些身体。
works.method: Cao Fei worked with OSRAM employees for six months, filming production lines and then staging workers' chosen performances on the factory floor.
works.method_zh: 曹斐与欧司朗员工合作六个月，先拍摄生产线，再在车间里拍摄工人自选的表演。

works.title: KASPAR
works.description: A child-sized humanoid robot with a deliberately simple, mask-like face, used by therapists, teachers and parents to help children with autism practise turn-taking, imitation and gentle touch. Its predictability is the point: KASPAR repeats itself without impatience or ambiguous expressions.
works.description_zh: 一个儿童大小的类人机器人，脸部刻意做得简单、像面具一样，由治疗师、教师和家长用来帮助自闭症儿童练习轮流、模仿和轻柔的触碰。它的可预测性正是关键：KASPAR 会不厌其烦地重复，也没有含糊的表情。
works.idea_en: A robot can help because it is less expressive than a person: minimal, predictable social signals make interaction learnable.
works.idea_zh: 机器人能帮上忙，恰恰因为它不如人那样富于表情：极简、可预测的社交信号让互动变得可以学习。
works.method: Low-cost humanoid built from off-the-shelf parts, with a face design informed by comics and Japanese Noh masks; operated remotely by an adult or semi-autonomously, with touch sensors added in later versions; developed by the Adaptive Systems Research Group at the University of Hertfordshire.
works.method_zh: 用现成零件搭建的低成本类人机器人，脸部设计参考了漫画与日本能剧面具；可由成人遥控或半自主运行，后续版本加入了触觉传感器；由赫特福德大学自适应系统研究组开发。

paper.title: KASPAR – A Minimally Expressive Humanoid Robot for Human–Robot Interaction Research

works.title: Mission Eternity
works.description: A long-term project that turns the dead ('pilots') into 'Arcanum Capsules' of data and portraits stored on the computers of living volunteers ('angels'), with a walk-in shipping-container 'Sarcophagus' whose walls are a matrix of about 17,000 LEDs; Timothy Leary became the first pilot in 2007.
