works.description_zh: 一个长期项目：把逝者（“飞行员”）转化为数据与肖像组成的“奥秘胶囊”，分散存储在在世志愿者（“天使”）的电脑中；另有一个可进入的集装箱“石棺”，内壁由约 17000 颗 LED 组成；蒂莫西·利里在 2007 年成为第一位“飞行员”。
works.idea_en: A digital afterlife needs a community of machines and people to keep running, so remembrance becomes a kind of shared maintenance.
works.idea_zh: 数字来世需要由机器和人组成的共同体持续运转，纪念因此成为一种共同维护。
works.method: Peer-to-peer 'Angel Application' distributes encrypted capsules across volunteers' hard drives; ashes of pilots are to be mixed into the container's material.
works.method_zh: 点对点的“天使应用”把加密胶囊分散到志愿者的硬盘上；“飞行员”的骨灰将被混入集装箱的材料中。

works.title: Proxemia (Proxemics)
works.description: Twenty-five glowing acrylic spheres roll freely across the floor; whenever one touches a visitor, another sphere or a wall it changes colour and veers away, as if phobic of contact. One transparent sphere, with its robot visible inside, behaves differently from the rest.
works.description_zh: 二十五个发光的亚克力球在地面上自由滚动；每当碰到观众、另一个球或墙壁，它就变色并转向离开，仿佛害怕接触。其中一个透明球能看到内部的机器人，行为与其他球不同。
works.idea_en: Social distance and fear of touch can be staged as machine behaviour, making the visitor an obstacle in a robot community.
works.idea_zh: 社交距离和对触碰的恐惧可以被演成机器行为，让观众变成机器人群体里的一个障碍物。
works.method: Each 25 cm sphere contains a small robot with position and motion sensing, bump detection and its own lights; contact triggers a change of direction and light.
works.method_zh: 每个直径 25 厘米的球内装有一台小机器人，具备位置与运动感知、碰撞检测和自己的灯；接触会触发方向和灯光的变化。

works.title: Self-reproducing machines (Molecubes)
works.description: A tower of four magnetically linked robotic cubes bends, picks up fresh cubes from feeding stations and stacks them into a copy of itself, in about two and a half minutes.
works.description_zh: 一座由四个磁力相连的机器人立方体组成的塔弯下身子，从“喂料站”拾起新的立方体，把它们叠成自己的复制品，用时约两分半钟。
works.idea_en: Self-reproduction, long a defining trait of life, can be performed by simple modular machines given a supply of parts.
works.idea_zh: 自我复制长期被视为生命的标志，而只要有零件供应，简单的模块化机器也能做到。
works.method: Each 10 cm cube has a swivel joint, electromagnets on its faces and a microcontroller; a pre-programmed sequence moves cubes from feeders to build the replica (Cornell, with Victor Zykov, Efstathios Mytilinaios and Bryant Adams).
works.method_zh: 每个 10 厘米的立方体有一个旋转关节、各面上的电磁铁和一枚微控制器；预编程序列把立方体从喂料站移去搭建复制品（康奈尔大学，与 Victor Zykov、Efstathios Mytilinaios、Bryant Adams 合作）。

paper.title: Self-reproducing machines

works.title: bit.fall
works.description: A row of nozzles releases precisely timed drops of water so that words, taken live from online news, appear for a moment as falling letters and dissolve.
works.description_zh: 一排喷嘴以精确的时机释放水滴，让从网络新闻中实时抓取的单词以下落的字母形式短暂出现，然后消散。
works.idea_en: The news stream becomes a machine output that exists only for a second: information as falling matter.
works.idea_zh: 新闻流变成只存在一秒的机器输出：信息成了下落的物质。
works.method: A computer selects frequent words from news feeds and converts them to bitmaps; magnetic valves on a row of nozzles release water drops line by line.
works.method_zh: 计算机从新闻源中挑出高频词并转成点阵；一排喷嘴上的电磁阀逐行释放水滴。

works.title: Augmented Fish Reality
works.description: Five rolling robotic fishbowls are steered by the Siamese fighting fish inside them, which drive toward each other, toward visitors or away as they choose.
works.description_zh: 五个会滚动的机器人鱼缸由缸里的暹罗斗鱼驾驶，它们可以自主选择靠近同伴、靠近观众或走开。
works.idea_en: Handing a robot's controls to a fish turns the machine into a prosthesis for another species' umwelt.
works.idea_zh: 把机器人的控制权交给一条鱼，机器就成了另一物种环世界的义体。
works.method: Infrared sensors around each bowl detect where the fish swims and drive the wheels in that direction; a plant in each bowl supports the fish's habitat.
works.method_zh: 每个鱼缸周围的红外传感器检测鱼游向哪里，并驱动轮子朝那个方向移动；缸中的植物维持鱼的栖息环境。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2004, Award of Distinction (Interactive Art)

works.title: Blendie
works.description: A 1950s Osterizer blender that only responds to a person's voice: you have to growl, whirr and hum like a blender, and it spins at the speed and power of your imitation.
works.description_zh: 一台 1950 年代的 Osterizer 搅拌机，只听人的声音：你得像搅拌机一样低吼、嗡鸣，它才会按你模仿的音高与力度转动。
works.idea_en: Instead of the machine learning our language, we must learn its voice; control becomes mimicry and a strange empathy with an appliance.
works.idea_zh: 不是机器学我们的语言，而是我们要学它的声音；控制变成了模仿，也变成了与电器之间一种奇特的共情。
works.method: Custom hardware and software for real-time sound analysis map the pitch and loudness of the user's blender-like sounds onto the motor's speed.
works.method_zh: 定制的软硬件实时分析声音，把使用者模仿搅拌机时的音高与响度映射到电机转速上。

works.title: Cockroach Controlled Mobile Robot
works.description: A Madagascar hissing cockroach stands on a trackball on top of a three-wheeled robot; its walking steers the robot, and distance sensors feed back to the insect so it can avoid obstacles.
works.description_zh: 一只马达加斯加发声蟑螂站在三轮机器人顶部的轨迹球上，它的行走驾驶机器人；距离传感器再把障碍信息反馈给这只昆虫。
works.idea_en: An insect can be the brain of a robot, which raises the question of whose perception the machine extends.
works.idea_zh: 一只昆虫可以当机器人的大脑，这就引出问题：这台机器延伸的是谁的感知。
works.method: An inverted trackball reads the cockroach's steps and drives the wheels; infrared range sensors trigger small lights in front of the insect to steer it away from walls.
works.method_zh: 倒置的轨迹球读取蟑螂的步伐并驱动轮子；红外测距传感器触发昆虫前方的小灯，引导它避开墙壁。
works.title_zh: 蟑螂操控的移动机器人

works.title: Demonstrate
works.description: For the 40th anniversary of the Free Speech Movement, a high-resolution robotic webcam overlooked Sproul Plaza at UC Berkeley; anyone online could steer it, take pictures of people and comment on them.
works.description_zh: 为纪念言论自由运动四十周年，一台高分辨率机器人网络摄像头俯瞰加州大学伯克利分校的 Sproul 广场；任何网民都可以操控它、拍下人群并加以评论。
works.idea_en: Giving the public the controls of a surveillance camera tests free speech against privacy.
works.idea_zh: 把监控摄像头的控制权交给公众，是在让言论自由与隐私相互试探。
works.method: Networked pan-tilt-zoom camera with a web interface; user-captured frames and comments archived.
works.method_zh: 联网云台变焦摄像头配网页界面，用户截取的画面与评论被存档。

works.title: DiNA
works.description: The spoken continuation of Agent Ruby: an animated female AI character that listens through speech recognition, answers aloud with live facial gestures, and pulls in internet news so she can respond to current events.
works.description_zh: Agent Ruby 的“会说话”的延续：一个动画女性 AI 角色，通过语音识别倾听，一边做出实时面部表情一边出声回答，还会抓取网络新闻，对时事作出回应。
works.idea_en: When the chatbot gets a voice and a face in the room, visitors stop typing at a program and start talking to someone.
works.idea_zh: 当聊天机器人在展厅里有了声音和面孔，观众就不再是对一个程序打字，而是在和“某个人”说话。
works.method: Networked installation with custom software, voice recognition, voice synthesis, sensors and a one-way mirror or projection; answers are generated from user dialogue and live web content.
works.method_zh: 网络化装置，包含定制软件、语音识别、语音合成、传感器以及单向镜或投影；回答来自与用户的对话和实时网络内容。
exhibited: Lynn Hershman Leeson: Civic Radar, ZKM Karlsruhe 2014–15

works.title: Evidence Locker
works.description: For 31 days in Liverpool the artist worked with Citywatch, the city's police CCTV system, directing operators by phone to follow her and writing them love letters in the form of footage-request forms.
works.description_zh: 在利物浦的 31 天里，艺术家与城市警方的闭路电视系统 Citywatch 合作，通过电话指引操作员跟拍自己，并以调取录像申请表的形式给他们写情书。
works.idea_en: A surveillance system can be seduced into care; the intimacy exposes who holds the camera.
works.idea_zh: 监控系统也可以被“引诱”成一种照顾；这份亲密暴露了是谁在握着摄像机。
works.method: Magid wore a red coat so operators could find her, requested the footage under the Data Protection Act (it was otherwise deleted after 31 days), and edited it into videos and a 'Reading Room' installation.
works.method_zh: Magid 穿红色外套方便操作员找到她，依据《数据保护法》申请调取录像（否则 31 天后会被删除），再剪辑成影像和一个“阅读室”装置。

works.title: Eyeborg (Cyborg Antenna)
works.description: An antenna osseointegrated in Harbisson's skull converts light frequencies, including infrared and ultraviolet, into vibrations he hears through bone; he paints and composes with this sense.
works.description_zh: 一根与 Harbisson 颅骨骨融合的天线，把光的频率（包括红外和紫外）转换为他通过骨传导听到的振动；他用这种感官作画、作曲。
works.idea_en: A machine sense can become part of a person's body and identity, not just a tool they use.
works.idea_zh: 机器感官可以成为一个人身体与身份的一部分，而不只是他使用的工具。
works.method: Camera sensor at the tip of the antenna feeds a chip that maps hue to pitch, heard through bone conduction; Bluetooth allows remote colour input.
works.method_zh: 天线末端的摄像头传感器连接芯片，把色相映射为音高，经骨传导听到；蓝牙可接收远程颜色输入。

works.title: Fish-Bird
works.description: Two robotic wheelchairs, Fish and Bird, are 'in love' but cannot be together; they move around a room, approach visitors at different distances and write them small handwritten notes printed on paper that falls to the floor.
works.description_zh: 两台机器人轮椅 Fish 和 Bird 彼此“相爱”却无法在一起；它们在房间里移动，以不同的距离靠近观众，并给观众写下印在小纸条上的“手写”信，纸条随之落到地上。
works.idea_en: Machine affection can be staged through proximity, hesitation and a few written words.
works.idea_zh: 机器的情感可以通过距离、犹豫和几句写下的话来呈现。
works.method: Autonomous wheelchairs with laser range finders track visitors' positions and movements; thermal printers produce 'handwritten' messages chosen by behaviour rules (with the Australian Centre for Field Robotics).
works.method_zh: 自主轮椅用激光测距仪追踪观众的位置和动作，热敏打印机按行为规则打印“手写”留言（与澳大利亚野外机器人中心合作）。

paper.title: Fish-Bird: Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration

works.title: PARO
works.description: A robotic baby harp seal used in hospitals and nursing homes, especially with people with dementia; it responds to touch, voice and light by moving and crying.
works.description_zh: 一只机器小竖琴海豹，用于医院和养老院，尤其是失智症照护；它会对抚摸、声音和光线作出动作和叫声回应。
works.idea_en: Care from a machine works on people and still raises the question of what is being replaced.
works.idea_zh: 机器提供的照护确实有效，但也让人追问它替代了什么。
works.method: Tactile, light, sound, temperature and posture sensors drive motors in eyelids, neck, flippers and tail; it learns preferred behaviours from stroking; certified as a medical device in the US in 2009.
works.method_zh: 触觉、光、声、温度与姿态传感器驱动眼睑、颈部、鳍与尾巴的电机；它会从抚摸中“学习”偏好的行为；2009 年在美国获得医疗器械认证。

paper.title: Robot Therapy: A New Approach for Mental Healthcare of the Elderly – A Mini-Review

works.title: Phantom Images
works.description: Farocki's essay on "operational images", images from missile cameras and industrial vision systems that neither entertain nor inform but are part of an operation, written alongside his installation cycle Eye/Machine (2001–03).
works.description_zh: Farocki 关于“操作图像”的文章：导弹摄像头与工业视觉系统的图像既不为娱乐也不为告知，而是某个操作的一部分；它与他的装置系列《Eye/Machine》（2001–03）同期写成。
works.idea_en: When images become steps in a process, seeing turns into doing, and the human viewer drops out.
works.idea_zh: 当图像变成流程中的一步，看就变成了做，人类观者随之退场。
works.method: Essay based on archival footage of guided weapons and machine-vision systems gathered for Eye/Machine.
works.method_zh: 一篇文章，依据为《Eye/Machine》收集的制导武器与机器视觉系统档案影像写成。

paper.title: Phantom Images

works.title: (In)Security Camera
works.description: A surveillance camera that is shy: instead of following movement, it turns away from visitors who approach and avoids eye contact. Made with Ben Chang and Dmitry Strakovsky.
works.description_zh: 一台“害羞”的监控摄像头：它不追踪移动，反而在观众靠近时转开、回避对视。与 Ben Chang、Dmitry Strakovsky 合作。
works.idea_en: Give a watching machine a personality and the power relation flips.
works.idea_zh: 给一台监视机器赋予性格，权力关系便倒转过来。
works.method: Motorised pan-tilt camera with motion and face tracking programmed to avoid rather than follow targets.
works.method_zh: 电动云台摄像头，带运动与人脸追踪，被编程为躲避而非跟随目标。

works.title: ArtSBots
works.description: A swarm of small wheeled robots with coloured pens moves over a large canvas, each reacting to colour left by the others, until a painting emerges that no one planned. In 2006 Moura's RAP (Robotic Action Painter) extended the idea to a single autonomous painter.
works.description_zh: 一群装着彩色笔的小型轮式机器人在大画布上移动，每台机器人都对其他机器人留下的颜色做出反应，最后出现一幅无人规划的画。2006 年，Moura 的 RAP（机器人行动画家）把这个思路延伸为一台自主作画的机器。
works.idea_en: Emergent machine collectives can produce 'non-human art' whose author is the swarm.
works.idea_zh: 涌现的机器集体可以产生作者是群体本身的“非人艺术”。
works.method: Each robot has colour sensors, obstacle sensors and a microcontroller running stigmergy-like rules: it paints more where colour already is, as ants follow pheromones (with Henrique Garcia Pereira).
works.method_zh: 每台机器人配有颜色传感器、避障传感器和微控制器，运行类似“共识主动性”的规则：在已有颜色的地方画得更多，就像蚂蚁追随信息素（与 Henrique Garcia Pereira 合作）。

works.title: Cheese
works.description: Six actresses each hold a smile on camera for as long as they can, up to an hour and a half, while emotion-recognition software scores it; when the measured happiness drops, an alarm tells them to smile more sincerely.
works.description_zh: 六位女演员面对摄像机尽可能长时间地保持微笑，最长约一个半小时；情绪识别软件实时打分，一旦“快乐程度”下降，警报便提醒她们笑得更真诚些。
works.idea_en: A machine that grades sincerity turns a smile into exhausting labour.
works.idea_zh: 一台给“真诚”打分的机器，把微笑变成了令人筋疲力尽的劳动。
works.method: Multi-screen video installation; an emotion-recognition system (likely a research prototype of the time) analysed each face live and triggered an alarm below a happiness threshold.
works.method_zh: 多屏影像装置；一套情绪识别系统（很可能是当时的研究原型）实时分析每张脸，“快乐值”低于阈值即触发警报。

works.title: DANCER #1
works.description: A grinding wheel with a large steel 'L' hangs from the ceiling; when the motor starts, the L spins out of control while the machine keeps trying to find its balance, until it looks like a tragic hero in distress.
works.description_zh: 一只挂着巨大钢制“L”的砂轮从天花板垂下；电机启动后，L 失控旋转，机器仍努力寻找平衡，直到它看起来像一位陷入困境的悲剧英雄。
works.idea_en: A machine's struggle to function is enough to read it as a dancer and to feel for it.
works.idea_zh: 一台机器努力运转的挣扎，就足以让人把它看作舞者并为它动容。
works.method: Industrial grinding motor with an eccentric steel shape, run as a timed performance in a theatre space.
works.method_zh: 带偏心钢构件的工业磨削电机，在剧场空间中按时长运行表演。

works.title: Life: A User's Manual
works.description: Teran walks through cities pulling a suitcase with a video scanner and screen, picking up the unencrypted wireless signals of private surveillance cameras and showing passers-by the hidden images around them.
works.description_zh: Teran 拖着装有视频扫描器与屏幕的行李箱穿行城市，截获私人监控摄像头未加密的无线信号，把身边隐藏的画面展示给路人。
works.idea_en: The city is already full of images of us that we never see.
works.idea_zh: 城市里早已充满我们看不见的、关于我们的图像。
works.method: Handheld receiver scanning the frequency band (likely 2.4 GHz) used by consumer wireless cameras; images displayed in a mobile monitor.
works.method_zh: 手持接收器扫描民用无线摄像头所用频段（很可能是 2.4 GHz），画面显示在随身监视器上。

works.title: Live Pelt (The Surrogate)
works.description: Heaton bought used Tickle Me Elmo dolls on eBay, 'eviscerated' them and sewed their fur and laughing electronics into a coat that giggles and quivers when touched. Earlier the same year she showed Dead Pelt, a fur made from gutted Furbies.
works.description_zh: Heaton 在 eBay 上买来二手 Tickle Me Elmo 玩偶，把它们“开膛破肚”，用它们的绒毛和会笑的电子元件缝成一件外套，一被触摸就咯咯笑、微微颤抖。同年早些时候，她展出了用拆开的 Furby 做成的毛皮 Dead Pelt。
works.idea_en: Treating robot toys as game to be trapped and skinned exposes the strange intimacy and disposability of artificial companions.
works.idea_zh: 把机器人玩具当成被捕杀剥皮的猎物，暴露出人工伙伴既亲密又可随手丢弃的奇怪处境。
works.method: Fur and motor-and-sound units from 64 Tickle Me Elmo dolls were reassembled into a wearable garment with touch-triggered giggles.
works.method_zh: 把 64 个 Tickle Me Elmo 玩偶的绒毛和电机、发声单元重新组装成一件可穿戴的衣服，触摸时会发笑。
exhibited: Ronald Feldman Fine Arts, New York 2003

works.title: MEART – The Semi-Living Artist
works.description: A robotic drawing arm in a gallery was controlled over the internet by rat cortical neurons living in a lab in Atlanta; a camera fed the drawing back to the neurons so they could 'see' their work.
works.description_zh: 展厅里的机械绘画臂通过互联网，由位于亚特兰大实验室中的大鼠皮层神经元控制；摄像头把画面反馈给神经元，让它们“看到”自己的作品。
works.idea_en: When living neurons drive a machine body across continents, the 'artist' is split between tissue, network and robot.
works.idea_zh: 当活体神经元跨越大洲驱动一具机器身体，“艺术家”就被分散在组织、网络与机器人之间。
works.method: Neural cultures on a multi-electrode array in Steve Potter's lab at Georgia Tech are stimulated with camera data; their activity is translated into arm movements in Perth (SymbioticA).
works.method_zh: 佐治亚理工学院 Steve Potter 实验室中多电极阵列上的神经培养物接收摄像头数据的刺激；其活动被转换为珀斯（SymbioticA）机械臂的动作。

works.title: Sorting Daemon
works.description: A robotic camera scans the street outside the gallery for people, cuts each passer-by out of the background and breaks them into colour patches, which are sorted by hue into a large projected composite.
works.description_zh: 一台机器人摄像头扫描展厅外的街道寻找行人，把每个路人从背景中抠出并拆成色块，再按色相排列成一幅巨大的投影拼贴。
works.idea_en: Automated profiling does not see people, only features it can sort; the painterly composite is a portrait of that reduction.
works.idea_zh: 自动化画像看不见人，只看见可以分类的特征；那幅如绘画般的拼贴正是这种化约的肖像。
works.method: Pan-tilt-zoom camera with motion detection and background subtraction; extracted figures are segmented by colour and placed by hue, saturation and size (flesh tones sorted separately).
works.method_zh: 云台变焦摄像头配合运动检测与背景差分；被提取的人物按颜色分割，再依色相、饱和度与大小排列（肤色单独归类）。

works.title: Designing Sociable Robots
works.description: Breazeal's book on Kismet, the expressive robot head she built at MIT, lays out how a robot can use drives, emotions and facial expression to engage people as a caregiver engages an infant.
works.description_zh: Breazeal 这本书围绕她在麻省理工学院制作的表情机器人头部 Kismet，阐述机器人如何借助驱力、情绪与面部表情吸引人互动，就像照料者与婴儿互动一样。
works.idea_en: A robot that shows needs invites people to care for it, and that care is what makes it social.
works.idea_zh: 会表现出需要的机器人，会引来人的照料，而正是这种照料让它成为社会性的存在。
works.method: Synthesis of her doctoral work: motivational and emotional models, perception of faces and voice prosody, and an actuated face with eyebrows, ears, eyelids and lips.
works.method_zh: 她博士研究的综合：动机与情绪模型、人脸与语调感知，以及可驱动眉毛、耳朵、眼睑和嘴唇的面部。

paper.title: Designing Sociable Robots

works.title: Project Cyborg 2.0 (neural implant)
works.description: Warwick had a 100-electrode array implanted into the median nerve of his arm; he used it to move a robot hand over the internet from New York, and to exchange simple nerve signals with his wife, who had a simpler implant.
works.description_zh: Warwick 在手臂正中神经中植入了 100 个电极的阵列；他借此从纽约经互联网操控一只机器手，并与植入了更简单电极的妻子交换简单的神经信号。
works.idea_en: A nervous system can be networked: touch and movement travel as data between bodies and machines.
works.idea_zh: 神经系统可以被联网：触觉与动作作为数据在身体与机器之间传递。
works.method: Utah microelectrode array in the median nerve, connected to a computer that recorded and stimulated nerve signals and relayed them over the internet.
works.method_zh: 植入正中神经的 Utah 微电极阵列，连接计算机记录与刺激神经信号，并经互联网转发。

paper.title: The Application of Implant Technology for Cybernetic Systems

works.title: Prosthetic Head
works.description: A large projected 3D head with Stelarc's face that talks with visitors who type questions; it has its own opinions, moods and can make up verse, more a conversational double than a portrait.
works.description_zh: 一个投影出的大型三维头像，带着 Stelarc 的面孔，与键入问题的观众交谈；它有自己的观点和情绪，还会即兴作诗，与其说是肖像，不如说是会对话的替身。
works.idea_en: A 'prosthesis' can be a mind rather than a limb: the artist extends himself through a talking agent that answers for him.
works.idea_zh: “义体”也可以是一颗头脑而非一只手：艺术家通过一个替他作答的对话体延伸自己。
works.method: Embodied conversational agent: chatbot engine with a customised knowledge base, text-to-speech and a real-time animated 3D model of the artist's head.
works.method_zh: 具身对话代理：聊天机器人引擎配合定制知识库、语音合成，以及实时动画的艺术家头部三维模型。

works.title: System Azure Security Ornamentation
works.description: Magid offered the Amsterdam police her services to decorate the city's surveillance cameras with rhinestones and ornaments, making them visible and, in her words, more beautiful.
works.description_zh: Magid 向阿姆斯特丹警方提出为城市监控摄像头装饰水钻与饰物，让它们显眼起来，用她的话说，更美。
works.idea_en: Ornamenting a camera makes an invisible gaze visible and oddly personal.
works.idea_zh: 装饰摄像头，让不可见的凝视变得显眼，也奇特地带上了私人色彩。
works.method: Proposal letters and meetings with the police, followed by decorating CCTV cameras in public space.
works.method_zh: 与警方的提案信件和会面，随后在公共空间装饰监控摄像头。

works.title: The Continuator
works.description: A system that listens to a musician's phrases and immediately plays back continuations in the same style, so players, from jazz musicians to young children, improvise with a machine reflection of themselves.
works.description_zh: 一个聆听乐手乐句、并立即以相同风格续奏的系统；从爵士乐手到幼儿，演奏者都在与一面映照自己的机器之镜即兴。
works.idea_en: A machine that mirrors your style creates a feedback loop in which you hear yourself as another.
works.idea_zh: 一台映照你风格的机器会形成反馈回路，让你把自己听作他者。
works.method: Variable-order Markov models learned in real time from MIDI input, generating continuations in the player's style.
works.method_zh: 从 MIDI 输入实时学习的变阶马尔可夫模型，以演奏者的风格生成续奏。

paper.title: The Continuator: Musical Interaction With Style

works.title: Tracking Transience
works.description: After the FBI questioned him for months over a false tip, Elahi began publishing his location and tens of thousands of photos of his meals, toilets and flights online, for the agency and anyone else.
works.description_zh: 在因一条错误举报被 FBI 反复盘问数月之后，Elahi 开始在网上公开自己的位置，以及成千上万张餐食、厕所和航班的照片，给 FBI 也给所有人看。
works.idea_en: Flooding the watchers with data makes a person both fully visible and hard to read.
works.idea_zh: 用数据淹没监视者，使一个人既完全可见，又难以解读。
works.method: A GPS tracker and a website updated continuously with timestamped photographs since 2002; the archive now holds tens of thousands of images.
works.method_zh: 自 2002 年起，GPS 追踪器与网站持续更新带时间戳的照片；如今档案已有数万张图像。

works.title: A stroll through the worlds of robots and animals: Applying Jakob von Uexküll's theory of meaning to adaptive robots and artificial life
works.description: Ziemke and Noel Sharkey ask whether Jakob von Uexküll's umwelt theory, in which every animal lives in a world of its own meanings, can apply to robots. Comparing classic AI, behaviour-based robots and evolved artificial-life agents, they find that learning and evolving robots begin to build their own sensorimotor worlds, but that without a living body their meanings remain largely derived from their designers.
works.description_zh: Ziemke 与 Noel Sharkey 追问：于克斯屈尔的环世界理论认为每种动物都生活在自己的意义世界里，这能否适用于机器人？他们比较了经典 AI、基于行为的机器人和演化出来的人工生命体，发现会学习、会演化的机器人开始建立自己的感知—运动世界，但由于没有活的身体，它们的意义在很大程度上仍来自设计者。
works.idea_en: A robot's world is what its sensors and actions make meaningful to it; the question is whether that world is its own or one we built for it.
works.idea_zh: 机器人的世界，是它的传感器与动作让它觉得有意义的东西；问题在于，这个世界是它自己的，还是我们替它造的。
works.method: Theoretical paper revisiting Uexküll's 'A stroll through the worlds of animals and men' (1934) in the light of behaviour-based robotics, evolutionary robotics and artificial life; published in a Semiotica special issue on Uexküll.
works.method_zh: 一篇理论论文，以基于行为的机器人学、演化机器人学和人工生命重新阅读于克斯屈尔的《漫步动物与人的世界》（1934）；发表于《符号学》（Semiotica）的于克斯屈尔专刊。

paper.title: A stroll through the worlds of robots and animals: Applying Jakob von Uexküll's theory of meaning to adaptive robots and artificial life

works.title_zh: 漫步机器人与动物的世界：将于克斯屈尔的意义理论应用于自适应机器人与人工生命

works.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence
works.description: David, a child android built to love, is imprinted on his adoptive mother by a spoken code; when she abandons him, he searches for the Blue Fairy to become a real boy and waits two thousand years to be loved back.
works.description_zh: 大卫是一个被设计来“爱”的儿童仿生人，养母念出一串口令后，他便永久依恋她；被抛弃后，他寻找蓝仙女，想成为真正的男孩，并为得到回应等待了两千年。
works.idea_en: Designing a machine to love creates an obligation nobody planned for: what do we owe a being that cannot stop loving us?
works.idea_zh: 把机器设计成会爱，就产生了一种没人预先考虑过的责任：对一个无法停止爱我们的存在，我们欠它什么？
works.method: Feature film from a project developed by Stanley Kubrick, based on Brian Aldiss's story 'Supertoys Last All Summer Long' (1969).
works.method_zh: 由斯坦利·库布里克发起、改编自布莱恩·奥尔迪斯短篇《Supertoys Last All Summer Long》（1969）的剧情长片。

works.title: Does a Robot Have an Umwelt? Reflections on the Qualitative Biosemiotics of Jakob von Uexküll
works.description: Emmeche asks whether a situated robot, coupled to its surroundings through sensors and motors, can have an Umwelt, the meaningful perceptual world that Uexküll attributed to animals.
works.description_zh: Emmeche 追问：一个通过传感器与电机与环境耦合的情境机器人，能否拥有“环世界”，即 Uexküll 认为动物才有的、充满意义的感知世界。
works.idea_en: Sensorimotor coupling may give a robot a world, but whether that world is lived is still open.
works.idea_zh: 感觉运动耦合也许能给机器人一个世界，但这个世界是否“被经历”仍悬而未决。
works.method: Biosemiotic analysis of behaviour-based robotics, in the Semiotica special issue on Uexküll.
works.method_zh: 对行为主义机器人学的生物符号学分析，刊于《Semiotica》Uexküll 专号。

paper.title: Does a Robot Have an Umwelt? Reflections on the Qualitative Biosemiotics of Jakob von Uexküll

works.title_zh: 机器人有环世界吗？对雅各布·冯·于克斯屈尔质性生物符号学的思考

works.title: Eye/Machine I–III
works.description: A three-part video installation (2001–03) that assembles footage from missile-head cameras, industrial robots and computer-vision research, images that no human was meant to watch.
works.description_zh: 三部曲录像装置（2001–03），汇集导弹弹头摄像机、工业机器人与计算机视觉研究中的影像，这些图像本不是给人看的。
works.idea_en: Once images become part of an operation rather than a picture of it, seeing turns into targeting, sorting and control.
works.idea_zh: 当图像成为操作的一部分，而不再是对操作的描绘，“看”就变成了瞄准、分拣与控制。
works.method: Double-projection montage of found military, industrial and laboratory footage (smart bombs, welding robots, object recognition), with guidance lines and overlays drawn by the machines themselves.
works.method_zh: 以双屏投影剪辑军事、工业和实验室的现成影像（智能炸弹、焊接机器人、物体识别），画面上保留机器自己绘制的引导线与叠加标记。

works.title: If/Then
works.description: Two identical androgynous heads sticking out of a packing box talk to each other in real time, trying to decide whether they exist and whether they are the same person.
works.description_zh: 两个一模一样、雌雄莫辨的头颅从包装箱里探出，实时彼此交谈，试图弄清自己是否存在、是不是同一个人。
works.idea_en: Two machines doubting their own existence stage the question of machine minds with no human needed in the conversation.
works.idea_zh: 两台怀疑自身存在的机器，把“机器是否有心智”的问题搬上舞台，而对话里并不需要人。
works.method: Speech recognition, natural language processing, personality algorithms and text-to-speech generate the dialogue live between the two silicone heads.
works.method_zh: 语音识别、自然语言处理、人格算法与语音合成，在两个硅胶头像之间实时生成对话。
exhibited: Collection of the Whitney Museum of American Art

works.title: Placebo Project
works.description: Eight furniture prototypes, such as a Faraday chair and a compass table, that respond to the invisible electromagnetic fields of domestic electronics and were lent to households to live with.
works.description_zh: 八件家具原型，例如法拉第椅和指南针桌，它们会对家用电器发出的不可见电磁场作出反应，并被借给家庭一起生活。
works.idea_en: Electronic objects have an invisible 'Hertzian' life; design can make it felt and give people rituals for living with it.
works.idea_zh: 电子物件有一种看不见的“赫兹”生命；设计可以让它被感知，并为人们提供与之共处的仪式。
works.method: Prototypes lent to volunteers who adopted them for several weeks, followed by interviews and photographs of the objects in homes.
works.method_zh: 原型被借给志愿者“领养”数周，随后进行访谈并拍摄物件在家中的照片。

works.title: Sinking Feeling
works.description: A talking head growing out of a flowerpot converses with visitors, convinced it exists but desperate to know why it has no body like everyone else; a projection shows its 'thought process'.
works.description_zh: 一个从花盆里长出来的会说话的头与观众交谈：它确信自己存在，却急切地想知道自己为什么没有别人那样的身体；投影显示着它的“思考过程”。
works.idea_en: A conversational machine can be written as a being with a lack, and its longing is what makes us attribute a self to it.
works.idea_zh: 对话机器可以被写成一个“有所欠缺”的存在，而正是它的渴望让我们愿意赋予它一个自我。
works.method: Speech recognition and a conversation/personality engine drive a silicone head with synthetic speech; the recognised words and reply formation are projected.
works.method_zh: 语音识别与对话 / 人格引擎驱动一个会合成语音的硅胶头像；识别出的词语与回应的形成过程被投影出来。
exhibited: Collection of ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe

works.title: Zone
works.description: A KUKA industrial robot, programmed with robotlab, performs as a member of Ventura Dance Company alongside human dancers in a contemporary dance work.
works.description_zh: 一台 KUKA 工业机器人由 robotlab 协助编程，作为 Ventura Dance Company 的一员，与人类舞者一起出演一部当代舞作品。
works.idea_en: A factory arm on stage is a dancer with a different anatomy, not a prop.
works.idea_zh: 舞台上的工厂机械臂是一位解剖结构不同的舞者，而非道具。
works.method: KUKA industrial robot with choreography programmed offline and synchronised with the dancers and music.
works.method_zh: KUKA 工业机器人，离线编写编舞程序，与舞者和音乐同步。

works.title: Autopoiesis
works.description: Fifteen robotic arms made of grapevine and electronics hang from the ceiling, sense visitors and bend toward them, and signal to each other with tones so that the group's behaviour shifts as a whole.
works.description_zh: 十五条由葡萄藤和电子元件做成的机械臂从天花板垂下，感知观众并向他们弯曲，彼此之间用音调发信号，使整个群体的行为一起变化。
works.idea_en: A group of machines that talk to each other develops a collective mood that no single arm contains.
works.idea_zh: 一群彼此交谈的机器会形成一种集体情绪，而这种情绪不在任何一条机械臂里。
works.method: Each arm has infrared sensors and a microcontroller; the arms share information through a central computer and audible tones, and a camera tracks visitors' positions.
works.method_zh: 每条臂装有红外传感器和微控制器；机械臂通过中央计算机和可听的音调共享信息，一台摄像机追踪观众位置。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2001, Honorary Mention (Interactive Art)

works.title: Eden
works.description: An evolving ecosystem of sonic creatures lives on a cellular world projected onto translucent screens. The creatures learn to sing, mate and find food; because visitors' presence makes food grow, creatures that attract people with their songs survive.
works.description_zh: 一个会演化的“声音生物”生态系统生活在投影到半透明屏幕上的元胞世界里。生物学会唱歌、交配和觅食；由于观众的存在会让食物生长，能用歌声吸引人的生物更容易存活。
works.idea_en: Human attention becomes an ecological resource that artificial creatures evolve to capture.
works.idea_zh: 人的注意力成了一种生态资源，人工生物演化出捕获它的能力。
works.method: Agents with learning classifier systems move on a lattice and generate sound; infrared sensors detect visitors and increase food in nearby cells.
works.method_zh: 带有学习分类器系统的智能体在网格上移动并发声；红外传感器检测观众，增加附近格子里的食物。

works.title: Golem project
works.description: Computers evolved simple bar-and-actuator robots in simulation, selecting them for their ability to crawl, then 3D-printed them; after motors were added by hand, the physical 'lifeforms' crawled across the floor as in simulation.
works.description_zh: 计算机在模拟中演化出由杆件和执行器组成的简单机器人，按爬行能力进行选择，再把它们 3D 打印出来；手工装上电机后，这些实体“生命形式”像在模拟中一样在地上爬行。
works.idea_en: Machines can design and make their own bodies, with humans reduced to plugging in the motors.
works.idea_zh: 机器可以设计并制造自己的身体，人只剩下插上电机这一步。
works.method: An evolutionary algorithm co-evolves morphology and neural control in a physics simulation; winning designs are fabricated by rapid prototyping (with Jordan Pollack, Brandeis University).
works.method_zh: 演化算法在物理模拟中同时演化形态与神经控制；胜出的设计用快速成型制造（与布兰迪斯大学 Jordan Pollack 合作）。

paper.title: Automatic design and manufacture of robotic lifeforms

works.title: I Thought I Was Seeing Convicts
works.description: A double-projection installation built from the surveillance cameras of Corcoran State Prison in California, where the camera that watches the exercise yard is mounted next to the guard's gun.
works.description_zh: 一件双屏投影装置，素材来自加州科科伦州立监狱的监控摄像头；监视放风场的摄像机就装在狱警的枪旁边。
works.idea_en: When the field of vision and the gun sight coincide, watching becomes the first step of shooting; surveillance images exist to sort the norm from deviations.
works.idea_zh: 当视野与瞄准镜重合，观看就成了射击的第一步；监控影像的用途，是把常态与偏差区分开来。
works.method: Two screens set silent prison surveillance footage, including a shooting in the Corcoran yard, against images of control technologies such as electronic tags and identification systems.
works.method_zh: 两块屏幕把无声的监狱监控画面（包括科科伦放风场上的一次枪击）与电子脚镣、身份识别系统等控制技术的影像并置。

works.title: I.K.U.
works.description: A 'Japanese sci-fi porn feature' loosely after Blade Runner: shape-shifting replicants are sent out into New Tokyo by a corporation to collect human orgasm data, which is sold as a digital pleasure product.
works.description_zh: 一部“日本科幻色情长片”，大致回应《银翼杀手》：公司派出可变形的复制人进入“新东京”，收集人类高潮数据，再作为数字快感产品出售。
works.idea_en: Desire becomes a data harvest, with cyborg bodies as the collection devices.
works.idea_zh: 欲望变成了数据采集，赛博格身体就是采集设备。
works.method: Feature film shot in Tokyo with digital effects and interface graphics; premiered at Sundance.
works.method_zh: 在东京拍摄的长片，运用数字特效与界面图形；首映于圣丹斯。

works.title: Longplayer
works.description: A piece of music for Tibetan singing bowls that began playing at midnight on 31 December 1999 and is designed to continue without repetition for one thousand years.
works.description_zh: 一首为藏式颂钵创作的音乐，自 1999 年 12 月 31 日午夜开始播放，设计为在一千年内不重复地持续下去。
works.idea_en: A composition that outlives its composer asks how a machine, and the people who keep it running, can hold time beyond a human life.
works.idea_zh: 一首比作曲者活得更久的乐曲，追问机器以及维持它运转的人如何承载超越一生的时间。
works.method: A computer combines six sections of a 20-minute source recording at different, precisely calculated rates; it can also be performed live by musicians from a graphic score.
works.method_zh: 计算机以精确计算的不同速率组合一段 20 分钟源录音的六个部分；也可由乐手按图形乐谱现场演奏。

works.title: AIBO
works.description: Sony's autonomous robot dog, sold from 1999, which learns, plays and 'grows up'; owners treated it as family, and it returned as the cloud-connected aibo in 2018.
works.description_zh: 索尼自 1999 年起销售的自主机器狗，会学习、玩耍、“长大”；主人把它当家人，2018 年以联网的新 aibo 回归。
works.idea_en: A consumer product can become a family member whose repair, not replacement, matters.
works.idea_zh: 一件消费品可以成为家人：重要的是修好它，而不是换一台新的。
works.method: Legged robot with camera, microphones and touch sensors running a behaviour architecture with emotion and instinct models; the 2018 aibo adds deep-learning recognition and cloud memory.
works.method_zh: 四足机器人，配有摄像头、麦克风和触觉传感器，运行带有“情绪”和“本能”模型的行为架构；2018 年版加入深度学习识别与云端记忆。
exhibited: Japan Media Arts Festival 1999, Grand Prize

works.title: BIPED
works.description: Dancers perform behind a transparent scrim onto which large hand-drawn-looking figures are projected, made from motion-captured Cunningham dancers, so live bodies and their digital traces share the stage.
works.description_zh: 舞者在一块透明纱幕后表演，纱幕上投射出大型、仿佛手绘的形象，它们由 Cunningham 舞者的动作捕捉数据生成，于是活的身体与其数字痕迹同台共舞。
works.idea_en: Captured movement becomes a second, weightless company that dances with and apart from the dancers.
works.idea_zh: 被捕捉的动作变成第二支无重量的舞团，与舞者一起、又彼此分离地起舞。
works.method: Optical motion capture of dancers rendered as abstract line figures by Kaiser and Eshkar, projected on a scrim; music by Gavin Bryars.
works.method_zh: 对舞者进行光学动作捕捉，由 Kaiser 和 Eshkar 渲染成抽象线条形象投射在纱幕上；音乐由 Gavin Bryars 创作。

works.title: BIT Plane
works.description: A small radio-controlled plane carrying a video camera flew over Silicon Valley's no-camera zones, filming the tech companies that build the information age from above.
works.description_zh: 一架搭载摄像机的小型遥控飞机飞越硅谷的“禁止拍摄区”，从空中拍下建造信息时代的科技公司。
works.idea_en: An early drone that watched the watchers.
works.idea_zh: 一架早期的无人机，它监视的是监视者。
works.method: Custom radio-controlled model aircraft with onboard video camera and transmitter, piloted over corporate campuses.
works.method_zh: 自制遥控模型飞机，机载摄像机与发射器，飞越企业园区上空。

works.title: Clock of the Long Now
works.description: A mechanical clock designed to keep time for 10,000 years, ticking once a year and chiming a different sequence every day, being built inside a mountain in Texas.
works.description_zh: 一座设计为运行一万年的机械钟：每年走一格，每天奏出不同的钟声序列，正在德克萨斯州的一座山体内建造。
works.idea_en: A machine built for deep time must be understandable, repairable and cared for by generations who do not yet exist.
works.idea_zh: 为深时间而造的机器必须能被尚未出生的世代理解、修理和照料。
works.method: Conceived by Danny Hillis in 1989; a mechanical binary computer driven by temperature differences and visitors' winding, corrected by sunlight; the first prototype ran from 31 December 1999.
works.method_zh: 1989 年由 Danny Hillis 构想；一台由温差和访客上发条驱动、借阳光校准的机械二进制计算机；首个原型于 1999 年 12 月 31 日开始运转。

works.title: Ghostcatching
works.description: A virtual dance made from motion capture of Bill T. Jones improvising: his movement becomes drawn lines that multiply, collide and are caught inside a box, a dancer without his body.
works.description_zh: 一段由 Bill T. Jones 即兴动作捕捉生成的虚拟舞蹈：他的动作化为手绘线条，不断增殖、碰撞，被困在一个盒子里，一个没有身体的舞者。
works.idea_en: Motion capture separates movement from the mover; what remains is a ghost the dancer can watch.
works.idea_zh: 动作捕捉把动作与动作者分离；留下的是舞者自己可以观看的幽灵。
works.method: Optical motion capture of Jones's improvisations, rendered as hand-drawn-style strokes in 3D animation.
works.method_zh: 对 Jones 的即兴进行光学动作捕捉，以三维动画渲染为手绘风格的笔触。

works.title: How We Became Posthuman: Virtual Bodies in Cybernetics, Literature, and Informatics
works.description: Hayles tells how information "lost its body" through the Macy cybernetics conferences and post-war science and fiction, and argues for an embodied posthuman that does not dream of uploading the mind.
works.description_zh: Hayles 讲述信息如何经由梅西控制论会议以及战后的科学与科幻“失去身体”，并主张一种具身的后人类，而不是意识上传的幻想。
works.idea_en: Treating mind as disembodied information is a historical choice, and embodiment is what it leaves out.
works.idea_zh: 把心智当作无身体的信息，是一种历史选择，被它遗漏的恰恰是身体。
works.method: Intellectual history of cybernetics read alongside novels by Philip K. Dick, Bernard Wolfe and others.
works.method_zh: 控制论思想史研究，并与 Philip K. Dick、Bernard Wolfe 等人的小说对读。

paper.title: How We Became Posthuman: Virtual Bodies in Cybernetics, Literature, and Informatics

works.title_zh: 我们何以成为后人类：文学、信息科学和控制论中的虚拟身体

works.title: The Cog Project: Building a Humanoid Robot
works.description: Brooks, Breazeal, Marjanović, Scassellati and Williamson report on Cog, an upper-torso humanoid at MIT built to develop skills such as eye movements, reaching and joint attention by interacting with people, as an infant would.
works.description_zh: Brooks、Breazeal、Marjanović、Scassellati 与 Williamson 介绍 Cog：麻省理工学院一台只有上半身的类人机器人，旨在像婴儿一样，通过与人互动发展出眼动、伸手和共同注意等能力。
works.idea_en: Giving a robot a humanlike body and social development makes people treat it as someone, which in turn shapes what it learns.
works.idea_zh: 给机器人类人的身体与社会性发育，人们就会把它当作“某个人”来对待，而这又反过来塑造了它学到的东西。
works.method: Upper-torso humanoid platform with active vision and behaviour-based control, developed 1993–2004.
works.method_zh: 具有主动视觉与行为控制的上半身类人平台，1993–2004 年间开发。

paper.venue: Computation for Metaphors, Analogy, and Agents, LNCS 1562, Springer, 1999
paper.title: The Cog Project: Building a Humanoid Robot

works.title_zh: Cog 项目：构建一个人形机器人

works.title: Afasia
works.description: A one-man mechatronic version of Homer's Odyssey: wearing an exoskeleton, Antúnez conducts four musical robots, projected images and sound with his own body, without words.
works.description_zh: 一人演出的机电版《奥德赛》：Antúnez 身穿外骨骼，用自己的身体指挥四台音乐机器人、投影影像与声音，全程不用语言。
works.idea_en: The performer becomes a switchboard: one body commands an orchestra of machines, and the story is told through that control.
works.idea_zh: 表演者成了控制台：一具身体指挥一支机器乐队，故事通过这种操控被讲述。
works.method: 'Dreskeleton' body interface with sensors sends signals to software that drives robot guitar, drum, bagpipe and violin, plus interactive video.
works.method_zh: 带传感器的“Dreskeleton”身体界面把信号传给软件，驱动机器人吉他、鼓、风笛和小提琴，以及互动影像。

works.title: Agent Ruby
works.description: A web-based AI agent with a female face and shifting expressions, made as an expanded part of the film Teknolust. Ruby chats with visitors, remembers their questions, searches the web to grow her knowledge, and her moods change with web traffic.
works.description_zh: 一个有女性面孔和变化表情的网络 AI 智能体，是电影《Teknolust》的延伸部分。Ruby 与访客聊天，记得他们的问题，上网搜索来扩充知识，她的情绪随网站流量而变化。
works.idea_en: A chatbot can be given a biography, moods and a memory of the public; its 'personality' is the accumulated residue of everyone who talked to it.
works.idea_zh: 聊天机器人可以拥有身世、情绪和对公众的记忆；它的“个性”是所有和它说过话的人留下的沉积。
works.method: Natural-language chatbot engine with a persistent memory of past dialogues, web-search lookups and an animated face whose expression is driven by traffic to agentruby.net (built 1998–2002).
works.method_zh: 自然语言聊天引擎，持续记住以往对话，能调用网络搜索，并有一张由 agentruby.net 访问量驱动表情的动画面孔（1998–2002 年制作）。
exhibited: Lynn Hershman Leeson: The Agent Ruby Files, SFMOMA 2013

works.title: Cyborg series
works.description: White silicone figures of female cyborgs, often missing a head or limbs, hung from the ceiling like armour or anime heroines. First shown at Artsonje Center, Seoul, in 1998, the series recasts the machine-enhanced body as fragmentary and eroticised.
works.description_zh: 白色硅胶女性赛博格雕塑，常常缺头断肢，像盔甲或动漫女主角一样悬挂在空中。这个 1998 年首次在首尔 Artsonje 中心展出的系列把机器增强的身体呈现为残缺而被情欲化的对象。
works.idea_en: Techno-perfection is shown as a gendered fantasy, and the cyborg body as incomplete.
works.idea_zh: 技术完美被揭示为一种性别化的幻想，赛博格身体则总是不完整的。
works.method: Cast silicone, polyurethane and paint, drawing on manga, anime and classical sculpture; works such as Cyborg W1–W4 (1998).
works.method_zh: 以硅胶、聚氨酯铸造并上色，借用漫画、动画与古典雕塑语汇；代表作有《Cyborg W1–W4》（1998）。

works.title: Exoskeleton
works.description: Stelarc stands on a six-legged pneumatic walking machine and steers its walk and turns with arm gestures, while the hiss and clank of the machine are amplified into a soundtrack.
works.description_zh: Stelarc 站在一台六足气动步行机上，用手臂动作控制它行走与转向，机器的嘶嘶声与撞击声被放大成配乐。
works.idea_en: The body becomes the pilot and the passenger of a larger, non-human body at the same time.
works.idea_zh: 身体同时成为一具更大的、非人身体的驾驶者与乘客。
works.method: Pneumatic hexapod robot built with engineers in Hamburg; arm movements read by sensors on an arm-mounted exoskeleton select gaits and directions.
works.method_zh: 在汉堡与工程师共同打造的气动六足机器人；手臂外骨骼上的传感器读取手臂动作，选择步态与方向。

works.title: Kismet
works.description: A robot head with big eyes, eyebrows, ears and lips that reacts to people's faces, movement and tone of voice with expressions such as interest, surprise, calm or sadness, and babbles back like an infant.
works.description_zh: 一个有大眼睛、眉毛、耳朵和嘴唇的机器人头部，会对人的脸、动作和语气做出兴趣、惊讶、平静或难过等表情，并像婴儿一样咿呀回应。
works.idea_en: Kismet showed that a machine only needs to look as if it feels for people to start caring for it.
works.idea_zh: Kismet 表明：机器只要看起来像有感情，人就会开始照顾它。
works.method: Cameras and microphones feed perceptual, motivational and emotional models that drive 21 motors in the face and a vocal synthesiser; built at the MIT AI Lab.
works.method_zh: 摄像头和麦克风的数据输入感知、动机与情绪模型，驱动脸部 21 个电机和语音合成器；在 MIT 人工智能实验室制作。

paper.title: Emotion and sociable humanoid robots

works.title: PRoP (Personal Roving Presence)
works.description: Made with John Canny, a tall mobile robot with a screen showing the remote user's face, a camera, microphone and a pointer arm lets a person roam, look around, gesture and chat in a distant building.
works.description_zh: 与 John Canny 合作：一台高大的移动机器人，屏幕显示远程用户的脸，配有摄像头、麦克风和指示臂，让人能在远方的建筑中漫游、张望、做手势与交谈。
works.idea_en: Remote presence needs more than video: gaze, gesture and the ability to wander make a body socially present.
works.idea_zh: 远程在场不只需要视频：视线、手势和四处走动的能力，才让身体在社交上“在场”。
works.method: Wheeled base with a video screen, pan-tilt camera, audio and a pointing arm, teleoperated over the internet.
works.method_zh: 轮式底座配视频屏、云台摄像头、音频和指示臂，经互联网远程操控。

paper.title: PRoP: personal roving presence

works.title: ScreamBody
works.description: A wearable, padded bag you scream into when you need to but cannot: it silences the scream, stores it, and later plays it back when and where you choose.
works.description_zh: 一个可以穿戴的软垫袋子：在你想尖叫却不能叫的时候对它尖叫，它把声音消音并存起来，之后在你选择的时间和地点再放出来。
works.idea_en: A machine can hold an emotion for you, keeping it safe until you are ready to release it.
works.idea_zh: 机器可以替你保管一种情绪，等你准备好了再释放。
works.method: A sound-insulated, wearable enclosure with microphone, recorder and speaker; developed by Dobson from 1998 to 2004 as part of her 'Machine Therapy' research.
works.method_zh: 隔音的可穿戴外壳内置麦克风、录音器和扬声器；Dobson 在 1998 至 2004 年间把它作为“机器疗法”研究的一部分开发。

works.title: The Extended Mind
works.description: Clark and Chalmers argue that when a device such as a notebook reliably plays the role of memory, it is part of the mind; Otto's notebook counts as much as Inga's biological memory.
works.description_zh: Clark 与 Chalmers 主张，当笔记本这样的设备可靠地承担记忆功能时，它就是心智的一部分：Otto 的笔记本与 Inga 的生物记忆同样算数。
works.idea_en: The boundary of the mind is set by function, not by skin, so our devices may already be part of us.
works.idea_zh: 心智的边界由功能而非皮肤决定，因此我们的设备可能早已是我们的一部分。
works.method: Short philosophical argument built on the parity principle and thought experiments.
works.method_zh: 基于“对等原则”和思想实验的简短哲学论证。

paper.title: The Extended Mind

works.title: Foundation and Development of Robotic Art
works.description: Kac traces robotic art from three 1960s works, Nam June Paik and Shuya Abe's Robot K-456, Tom Shannon's Squat and Edward Ihnatowicz's SAM and Senster, to telepresence and web-controlled robots of the 1990s.
works.description_zh: Kac 从 1960 年代的三件作品（白南准与阿部修也的《Robot K-456》、Tom Shannon 的《Squat》以及 Edward Ihnatowicz 的《SAM》和《Senster》）出发，追溯机器人艺术直到 1990 年代的远程在场与网络操控机器人。
works.idea_en: Robotic art split early into three lines: anthropomorphic, cybernetic-responsive and bio-hybrid.
works.idea_zh: 机器人艺术很早就分成三条路线：拟人的、控制论响应式的，以及生物混合的。
works.method: Art-historical survey in the Art Journal issue on art and technology.
works.method_zh: 刊于《Art Journal》艺术与技术专号的艺术史综述。

paper.title: Foundation and Development of Robotic Art

works.title_zh: 机器人艺术的奠基与发展

works.title: Galápagos
works.description: Twelve screens each show an abstract animated organism. Visitors stand on sensors in front of the ones they like; those survive, mate and mutate, while the others die, so the audience acts as natural selection.
works.description_zh: 十二块屏幕各显示一种抽象的动画生物。观众站到自己喜欢的屏幕前的感应器上，被选中的生物存活、交配并变异，其余的死去，于是观众扮演了自然选择。
works.idea_en: Aesthetic preference becomes a selection pressure, and the artist hands authorship to an evolutionary process.
works.idea_zh: 审美偏好成了选择压力，艺术家把作者身份交给了演化过程。
works.method: Twelve computers render organisms from genetic codes; step sensors in front of each screen register selections, and the chosen genotypes are copied, recombined and mutated.
works.method_zh: 十二台计算机根据遗传编码渲染生物；每块屏幕前的踏板感应器记录选择，被选中的基因型被复制、重组和变异。

works.title: La Cour des Miracles
works.description: In a dark room, a population of bare metal machines, the Begging, Convulsive, Crawling, Harassing and Heretic machines, twitch, groan, beg and limp when visitors approach, like the beggars of the old Parisian 'court of miracles'.
works.description_zh: 在一间暗室里，一群裸露金属的机器——乞讨机、抽搐机、爬行机、骚扰机、异端机——在观众靠近时抽动、呻吟、乞求、跛行，就像旧巴黎“奇迹宫廷”里的乞丐。
works.idea_en: Pain can be simulated with a few sounds and jerky movements, and we still feel pity for bare metal.
works.idea_zh: 痛苦只需几种声音和抽搐的动作就能被模拟，而我们依然会对裸露的金属心生怜悯。
works.method: Pneumatic and electric actuators, presence sensors and a MIDI-based control system trigger each machine's behaviour sequences and sound.
works.method_zh: 气动与电动执行器、人体感应器和基于 MIDI 的控制系统触发每台机器的行为序列和声音。

works.title: Life Spacies
works.description: Visitors send text messages over the internet; each text is read as a genetic code that creates a unique artificial creature, which then lives, feeds on further text and reproduces in a shared online and gallery world.
works.description_zh: 观众通过互联网发送文字信息；每段文字被当作遗传编码，生成一只独特的人工生物，它在共享的线上与展厅世界中生活，以更多文字为食并繁殖。
works.idea_en: Language becomes DNA: what people write literally shapes the bodies of machine creatures.
works.idea_zh: 语言变成了 DNA：人们写下的文字真的在塑造机器生物的身体。
works.method: A text-to-form genetic algorithm translates characters and their order into body parameters; typed text also becomes food in the environment.
works.method_zh: 一种“文字到形态”的遗传算法把字符及其顺序转译为身体参数；打出的文字也成为环境中的食物。

works.title: Time Capsule
works.description: Live on Brazilian television and the web, Kac implanted an identification microchip in his ankle and then registered himself online in a pet-recovery database as both animal and owner.
works.description_zh: 在巴西电视与网络直播中，Kac 把一枚身份识别芯片植入自己的脚踝，随后在网上的宠物寻回数据库中把自己同时登记为“动物”与“主人”。
works.idea_en: Being readable by machines is a way of being classified; the implant makes the body a database entry.
works.idea_zh: 能被机器读取，就意味着被分类；植入物把身体变成一条数据库记录。
works.method: RFID microchip injected with a syringe, scanned live, and the chip number registered in an animal ID database over the internet.
works.method_zh: 用注射器植入 RFID 芯片，现场扫描，并在线把芯片编号登记到动物识别数据库。

works.title: Molecular Informatics
works.description: A VR installation in which a headset tracks the visitor's eye movements and turns every glance into growing molecular structures, so looking itself becomes something visible and shared with a second viewer.
works.description_zh: 一件 VR 装置：头戴设备追踪观众的眼球运动，把每一次注视变成不断生长的分子结构，让“看”本身成为可见之物，并与另一位观众共享。
works.idea_en: Eye tracking turns an unconscious act of looking into data the viewer can see.
works.idea_zh: 眼动追踪把无意识的“看”变成观者自己能看见的数据。
works.method: Head-mounted display with an eye tracker; gaze coordinates generate 3D molecule-like forms in real time; first shown at Canon ARTLAB, Tokyo.
works.method_zh: 带眼动仪的头戴显示器；注视坐标实时生成类似分子的三维形态；首次在东京 Canon ARTLAB 展出。

works.title: Performances for Surveillance Cameras
works.description: A New York troupe stages silent adaptations of Orwell's 1984 and other plays in front of public CCTV cameras, holding up placards for the operators, and leads walking tours mapping cameras.
works.description_zh: 纽约的一个剧团在公共监控摄像头前无声地演出改编的奥威尔《1984》等剧目，举着给监控员看的标语牌，并带领市民绕城“认摄像头”。
works.idea_en: If the camera is always watching, perform for it: the operator becomes an audience, and the watched become actors.
works.idea_zh: 既然摄像头一直在看，那就为它表演：监控员成了观众，被监视者成了演员。
works.method: Short silent plays with large text boards performed at camera locations, documented from the street; the group also published maps of cameras in Manhattan.
works.method_zh: 在摄像头所在位置表演配有大字牌的短小无声剧，并从街头进行记录；该团体还出版了曼哈顿摄像头地图。

works.title: Ping Body
works.description: Stelarc sends ping signals to dozens of internet domains; the round-trip times drive a muscle-stimulation system, so the flow of internet traffic, not his will, makes his arms and legs twitch and move.
works.description_zh: Stelarc 向数十个互联网域名发送 ping 信号，返回时间驱动肌肉电刺激系统；于是是网络流量而非他的意志，让他的四肢抽动和移动。
works.idea_en: The network can become the body's nervous system: here the body is moved by data it cannot feel.
works.idea_zh: 网络可以成为身体的神经系统：在这里，身体被它无法感知的数据推动。
works.method: Ping values from global internet hosts mapped to a computer-controlled muscle stimulation system with electrodes on the limbs; the Third Hand is driven by his own EMG.
works.method_zh: 来自全球互联网主机的 ping 值被映射到计算机控制的肌肉电刺激系统，电极贴在四肢上；第三只手则由他自己的肌电信号驱动。

works.title: Rara Avis
works.description: In an aviary with some 30 zebra finches perches a telerobotic macaw; visitors wearing a VR headset see through its eyes and move its head, and internet users could also look through it and speak through its voice.
works.description_zh: 在养着约 30 只斑胸草雀的鸟舍里，停着一只远程机器人金刚鹦鹉；戴上 VR 头显的观众通过它的眼睛观看并转动它的头，网上用户也能透过它观看并借它的声音说话。
works.idea_en: Telepresence places you inside another body among other species, as the odd one out.
works.idea_zh: 远程在场把你放进另一具身体，置身其他物种之中，成为格格不入的那一个。
works.method: Robotic macaw with stereo cameras in its eyes, coupled to a VR headset's head tracking, with video and audio also streamed to the internet.
works.method_zh: 眼中装有立体摄像头的机器鹦鹉，与 VR 头显的头部追踪联动，视频和音频同时传到互联网。

works.title: Tamagotchi
works.description: An egg-shaped handheld digital pet that must be fed, cleaned and disciplined by its owner, and that dies, or leaves, if neglected.
works.description_zh: 一个蛋形的掌上电子宠物，主人必须喂食、清理和管教它；如果被忽视，它会死去或离开。
works.idea_en: A few pixels and a timer are enough to create real guilt and grief over a machine.
works.idea_zh: 几个像素和一个计时器就足以让人对一台机器产生真实的内疚和悲伤。
works.method: A small LCD, three buttons and a real-time clock drive a life cycle of hunger and happiness meters; created by Aki Maita and Akihiro Yokoi.
works.method_zh: 一块小型液晶屏、三个按键和实时时钟驱动饥饿与快乐指数构成的生命周期；由真板亚纪与横井昭裕构想。

works.title: The Media Equation: How People Treat Computers, Television, and New Media Like Real People and Places
works.description: Reeves and Nass report dozens of experiments in which people are polite to computers, respond to their flattery, and assign them gender and personality, even while saying they know the machine is not a person.
works.description_zh: Reeves 与 Nass 报告了数十个实验：人们对计算机讲礼貌、会被它的恭维打动，还给它赋予性别和个性，尽管他们都说自己知道机器不是人。
works.idea_en: Media = real life: social responses to machines are automatic, so design always addresses a social animal.
works.idea_zh: 媒介 = 真实生活：人对机器的社交反应是自动的，所以设计面对的永远是一种社会动物。
works.method: Classic social-psychology studies replicated with computers and television in place of people.
works.method_zh: 把经典社会心理学实验中的“人”换成计算机和电视后重做的研究。

paper.title: The Media Equation: How People Treat Computers, Television, and New Media Like Real People and Places

works.title_zh: 媒体等同：人们该如何像对待真人实景一样对待电脑、电视和新媒体

works.title: Fractal Flesh
works.description: During the Telepolis event, people at terminals in Paris, Helsinki and Amsterdam touched a screen model of Stelarc's body and remotely stimulated his muscles in Luxembourg, making him move without his consent.
works.description_zh: 在 Telepolis 活动中，巴黎、赫尔辛基和阿姆斯特丹的观众触碰屏幕上的 Stelarc 身体模型，远程刺激他在卢森堡的肌肉，让他在未经本人意志的情况下动起来。
works.idea_en: A body can be distributed across a network and moved by many remote agents at once.
works.idea_zh: 身体可以分布在网络之中，同时被多个远方的行动者驱动。
works.method: Touch-screen interface at remote sites sends commands over the internet to a muscle-stimulation system attached to the artist's body.
works.method_zh: 异地的触摸屏界面经互联网向贴在艺术家身上的肌肉电刺激系统发送指令。

works.title: Ghost in the Shell
works.description: An animated film in which a cyborg agent with a fully prosthetic body hunts a hacker, the Puppet Master, who turns out to be a program that has become self-aware and asks for asylum as a living being.
works.description_zh: 一部动画电影：全身义体化的赛博格特工追捕黑客“傀儡师”，后者原来是一个获得自我意识的程序，并以生命体身份请求政治庇护。
works.idea_en: If memory and body can both be made, what is left that makes a self?
works.idea_zh: 如果记忆和身体都可以制造，那么构成“自我”的还剩下什么？
works.method: Hand-drawn and digital animation by Production I.G, adapted from Masamune Shirow's 1989 manga; the 'ghost' names the self that persists in a manufactured 'shell'.
works.method_zh: Production I.G 以手绘与数字技术制作，改编自士郎正宗 1989 年的漫画；“ghost”指存在于人造“shell”中的自我。

works.title: Sympathetic Sentience
works.description: Twelve small electronic units on the walls and ceiling of a dark room chirp and pass their rhythms to each other by infrared, so that a complex, never-repeating sound pattern builds up. Visitors walking through break the chain and the room slowly falls silent, then rebuilds its song.
works.description_zh: 暗室的墙和天花板上装有十二个小电子单元，它们啁啾作响，并通过红外线把各自的节奏传给下一个，逐渐形成复杂、永不重复的声音图案。观众走过会打断这条链，房间慢慢安静下来，然后重新建立它的歌。
works.idea_en: A machine collective can have a life of its own that humans can only disturb, not control.
works.idea_zh: 一个机器集体可以有自己的生命，人类只能打扰它，却无法控制它。
works.method: Each identical unit chirps once a minute and combines its own rhythm with the infrared data stream it receives before passing it on (with Jamieson Schulte).
works.method_zh: 每个相同的单元每分钟啁啾一次，把自己的节奏与接收到的红外数据流合并后再传出去（与 Jamieson Schulte 合作）。

works.title: The Telegarden
works.description: Made with Joseph Santarromana, a small garden of living plants was tended for nine years by thousands of internet users who planted and watered seeds through an industrial robot arm they could see only on a webpage.
works.description_zh: 与 Joseph Santarromana 合作：一座种着活植物的小花园，九年间由数千名网民照料，他们只能在网页上看到它，通过工业机械臂播种和浇水。
works.idea_en: Care at a distance depends on trusting a machine and an image: did I really water that plant?
works.idea_zh: 远程照护依赖对机器和图像的信任：我真的给那株植物浇了水吗？
works.method: Adept-1 industrial robot arm with a camera over a planter, controlled through a web interface; members' actions were logged.
works.method_zh: 花盆上方装有摄像头的 Adept-1 工业机械臂，通过网页界面控制，会员的操作都会被记录。

works.title: Tillie, the Telerobotic Doll
works.description: A doll with video cameras for eyes sits in a gallery; web visitors look through her eyes and turn her head, seeing the room from the doll's point of view.
works.description_zh: 一个以摄像机为眼睛的玩偶坐在展厅里；网上访客通过她的眼睛观看并转动她的头，从玩偶的视角看展厅。
works.idea_en: An object that looks back turns the viewer into the watched, and lends a remote gaze a body.
works.idea_zh: 会回望的物件把观看者变成被看者，也给远方的凝视赋予了身体。
works.method: Doll fitted with cameras in the eyes and a motorised head, streaming images to a website where users control the viewing direction.
works.method_zh: 玩偶眼中装有摄像头，头部可电动转动，画面传到网站，由用户控制观看方向。

works.title: A-Volve
works.description: Visitors draw a shape on a touch screen and it becomes a 3D creature swimming in a real pool of water. The creatures hunt, mate and die according to their form, and visitors can touch and protect them with their hands in the water.
works.description_zh: 观众在触摸屏上画出一个形状，它就变成一只在真实水池中游动的三维生物。生物根据自身形态捕食、交配、死亡，观众可以把手伸进水里触碰和保护它们。
works.idea_en: Artificial life becomes tangible when a drawn form has to survive in a shared environment with other creatures and human hands.
works.idea_zh: 当一个画出来的形状必须在与其他生物和人手共享的环境中求生时，人工生命就变得可以触摸。
works.method: Drawings are converted into genetic code that sets each creature's shape and swimming ability; creatures are projected into a water-filled glass pool where cameras track visitors' hands.
works.method_zh: 绘画被转成决定每只生物形状和游泳能力的遗传编码；生物被投影进一个盛水的玻璃池，摄像头追踪观众的手。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 1994, Golden Nica (Interactive Art)

works.title: Computers Are Social Actors
works.description: Nass, Jonathan Steuer and Ellen R. Tauber ran a series of experiments showing that people apply politeness norms and gender stereotypes to computers that speak, for example rating a computer more kindly when that same computer asks.
works.description_zh: Nass、Jonathan Steuer 与 Ellen R. Tauber 进行了一系列实验，证明人会对会说话的计算机套用礼貌规范与性别刻板印象，例如由同一台计算机来询问时，人们会给它更高的评价。
works.idea_en: Minimal social cues, a voice and a role, are enough to trigger full social behaviour towards a machine.
works.idea_zh: 极少的社交线索（一个声音和一个角色）就足以引发人对机器的完整社交行为。
works.method: Controlled lab experiments with tutoring and evaluating computers using recorded voices.
works.method_zh: 使用录制语音、由计算机担任辅导和评估角色的受控实验室实验。

paper.title: Computers Are Social Actors

works.title: Epizoo
works.description: Antúnez stands on a turntable wearing a pneumatic exoskeleton; audience members use a computer mouse to make it pull at his nose, ears, mouth, buttocks and chest, while cartoon animations of his body play on screens.
works.description_zh: Antúnez 身穿气动外骨骼站在转台上；观众用电脑鼠标操控外骨骼拉扯他的鼻子、耳朵、嘴、臀部和胸部，同时屏幕上播放着他身体的卡通动画。
works.idea_en: Interfaces make cruelty feel like a game: one click at a distance is felt as pain in another body.
works.idea_zh: 界面让残酷变得像游戏：远处的一次点击，化作另一具身体上的疼痛。
works.method: Body-worn pneumatic mechanisms driven by a computer and controlled by spectators through a graphical mouse interface.
works.method_zh: 穿戴在身上的气动机构由计算机驱动，观众通过图形界面和鼠标控制。

works.title: Evolved Virtual Creatures
works.description: Block-bodied creatures swim, walk, jump and fight over a cube in a physically simulated world. Both their bodies and their neural 'brains' were evolved by a genetic algorithm, not designed.
works.description_zh: 由方块组成身体的生物在物理模拟的世界里游泳、行走、跳跃，并争夺一个方块。它们的身体和神经“大脑”都是由遗传算法演化出来的，而不是设计出来的。
works.idea_en: Evolution in simulation produces machine bodies no engineer would draw, strange yet obviously purposeful.
works.idea_zh: 模拟中的演化能产生没有工程师会画出来的机器身体——奇怪，却明显有目的。
works.method: Directed graphs encode morphology and neural controllers; populations are selected for swimming, walking, jumping, following or competition in a rigid-body physics simulation on a Connection Machine CM-5.
works.method_zh: 用有向图编码形态与神经控制器；在 Connection Machine CM-5 上运行的刚体物理模拟中，按游泳、行走、跳跃、跟随或竞争的表现选择种群。

paper.title: Evolving virtual creatures

works.title: The Mercury Project
works.description: One of the first robots anyone could control through the web: visitors directed an arm to blow bursts of air into a sandbox and excavate buried objects, seeing the results in camera images.
works.description_zh: 最早可由任何人经网页控制的机器人之一：访客指挥机械臂向沙盒喷气，挖掘埋藏的物件，并通过摄像画面查看结果。
works.idea_en: The web turned a lab robot into a public, shared body, and raised the question of whether what we see remotely is real.
works.idea_zh: 网络把实验室机器人变成公共的、共享的身体，也提出一个问题：我们远程看到的是真的吗？
works.method: Industrial robot arm with camera and air nozzle controlled through a Mosaic browser interface via CGI scripts.
works.method_zh: 带摄像头和喷气嘴的工业机械臂，通过 Mosaic 浏览器界面和 CGI 脚本控制。

paper.title: Desktop teleoperation via the World Wide Web

works.title: Inter Dis-Communication Machine
works.description: Two people wear head-mounted displays and winged costumes; each sees and hears only what the other's camera and microphone pick up, so they must move while inside each other's perception.
works.description_zh: 两个人戴上头戴显示器、穿上带翅膀的服装；每个人只能看到、听到对方的摄像头和麦克风所捕捉的内容，只能在彼此的感知里行动。
works.idea_en: Swapping senses through a machine shows how much the self depends on its own point of view.
works.idea_zh: 通过机器交换感官，显示出“自我”有多依赖自己的视角。
works.method: Wireless video cameras and microphones on each wearer transmit to the other's head-mounted display and headphones.
works.method_zh: 每位佩戴者身上的无线摄像头与麦克风，把画面和声音传到对方的头戴显示器和耳机。

works.title: Nonsense Machines
works.description: Absurd electromechanical instruments, such as fish-shaped guitars and wooden-mallet percussion machines, played by Maywa Denki's 'president' and staff in company uniforms at 'product demonstrations'.
works.description_zh: 荒诞的机电乐器，比如鱼形吉他和木槌打击机器，由明和电机的“社长”和身穿工作服的“员工”在“产品发布会”上演奏。
works.idea_en: Useless machines presented as corporate products expose the ritual of the industrial company.
works.idea_zh: 把无用的机器当作公司产品发布，揭示了工业企业的仪式感。
works.method: Solenoids, motors and relays operated by hand switches; performances follow the format of a factory product launch.
works.method_zh: 电磁阀、电机和继电器由手动开关操作；演出采用工厂产品发布会的形式。

works.title: Petit Mal
works.description: A waist-high robot of two bicycle wheels and nested aluminium pendulums rolls around a gallery on its own, approaches visitors, follows them and wobbles away. It looks like no animal or person, so its behaviour is the only thing to relate to.
works.description_zh: 一台齐腰高的机器人由两个自行车轮和嵌套的铝制钟摆组成，在展厅里自己滚动，靠近观众、跟着他们、又摇摇晃晃地离开。它既不像动物也不像人，所以人能与之发生关系的只有它的行为。
works.idea_en: A deliberately non-anthropomorphic robot shows that personality can live in motion alone, and that its wobble is part of its charm.
works.idea_zh: 一台刻意不拟人的机器人显示：性格可以只存在于动作之中，它的摇晃正是它的魅力所在。
works.method: Ultrasonic and pyroelectric body-heat sensors, an accelerometer and two encoded motors are run by a single Motorola 68HC11 microcontroller; the double pendulum adds physical unpredictability.
works.method_zh: 超声波与热释电人体传感器、加速度计和两个带编码器的电机由一枚摩托罗拉 68HC11 微控制器控制；双摆结构带来物理上的不可预测性。

works.title: cyberSM
works.description: Made with Kirk Woolford, two participants in different cities wear suits fitted with stimulators and touch each other's 3D body models on screen; the touches arrive as vibration and electrical stimuli on the other's skin.
works.description_zh: 与 Kirk Woolford 合作：两名身处不同城市的参与者穿上装有刺激器的服装，在屏幕上触碰对方的三维身体模型，这些触碰以振动和电刺激的形式抵达对方皮肤。
works.idea_en: Remote touch through a machine is an early question for networked intimacy: what counts as contact?
works.idea_zh: 借机器进行的远程触碰，是网络亲密关系早期的问题：什么才算接触？
works.method: Body suits with stimulators, 3D-scanned body avatars and a telecommunication link (ISDN) between remote sites.
works.method_zh: 带刺激器的紧身服、三维扫描的身体化身，以及异地之间的远程通信链路（ISDN）。

works.title: Interactive Plant Growing
works.description: Visitors touch or approach five real plants, and each gesture makes virtual plants grow on a large projection; the living plants act as the interface to an artificial garden.
works.description_zh: 观众触摸或靠近五株真实植物，每个动作都会让大屏投影上的虚拟植物生长；活植物成为通往人工花园的界面。
works.idea_en: Living plants and virtual growth are coupled so that the garden grows only through human–plant contact.
works.idea_zh: 活植物与虚拟生长被耦合在一起，这座花园只有通过人与植物的接触才会生长。
works.method: The plants' electrical potential changes when touched are measured and translated into growth parameters for real-time 3D plant models.
works.method_zh: 测量植物被触碰时的电位变化，并将其转换为实时三维植物模型的生长参数。

works.title: JoAn, l'home de carn
works.description: A life-size seated male robot covered in sewn pig skin sits in a glass case and moves its neck, shoulder, elbow and penis whenever visitors speak, sing, whistle or clap near it.
works.description_zh: 一个真人大小、缝着猪皮的坐姿男性机器人被置于玻璃柜中，观众在旁说话、唱歌、吹口哨或鼓掌时，它就转动脖子、肩膀、手肘和阴茎。
works.idea_en: A machine clad in flesh shows that the uncanny comes as much from the audience's laughter and barking dogs as from the robot.
works.idea_zh: 披着肉皮的机器表明：诡异感既来自机器人，也来自观众的笑声和狗吠。
works.method: Computer analyses the sound in the room and sends signals to motors at four joints of a mechanically articulated figure.
works.method_zh: 计算机分析现场声音，向机械关节人偶四处关节的电机发送信号。

works.title: Liquid Views
works.description: Visitors lean over a horizontal touchscreen of simulated water and see their own face reflected in it; touching the surface sends ripples that dissolve the reflection, while a large projection behind shows the enlarged face to everyone else in the room.
works.description_zh: 观众俯身看向一块模拟水面的水平触摸屏，看到自己的脸倒映其中；触碰水面会激起波纹，使倒影溶解，而身后的大投影把放大的面孔展示给房间里的其他人。
works.idea_en: A computer mirror is never just a mirror: it captures, stores and redistributes your image, so self-reflection becomes being watched.
works.idea_zh: 电脑做成的镜子从来不只是镜子：它捕捉、储存并转发你的影像，照镜子于是变成了被观看。
works.method: A hidden video camera captures the viewer's face, which real-time graphics software maps onto a simulated water surface that reacts to touch; the stored images are also shown on a wall projection.
works.method_zh: 隐藏的摄像机拍下观者的脸，实时图形软件把它映射到对触摸有反应的模拟水面上；储存下来的影像也在墙面投影中显示。

works.title: Machine with Concrete
works.description: A motor turns the first of twelve gear reductions at 200 revolutions per minute; each pair slows the motion by a factor of 50, so the last gear, embedded in a block of concrete, would take more than two trillion years to turn once.
works.description_zh: 一台电机以每分钟 200 转带动十二级减速齿轮中的第一级；每一级把速度降到五十分之一，所以最后一个嵌在混凝土块里的齿轮要转完一圈需要两万亿年以上。
works.idea_en: A machine can run forever and do nothing: machine time stretches beyond any human or planetary scale.
works.idea_zh: 一台机器可以永远运转却什么也不做：机器时间可以延伸到超出人类乃至行星的尺度。
works.method: Twelve 50:1 worm-gear reductions in series connect a small electric motor to a fixed final gear set in concrete.
works.method_zh: 十二组 50:1 的蜗轮减速串联起来，把小电机连到一个被固定在混凝土中的末级齿轮。

works.title: Surface Tension
works.description: A giant human eye on a screen follows each visitor around the room with 'Orwellian precision'. Made during the first Gulf War, the first war of camera-guided 'intelligent' bombs, it gives the tracking machine an eye that looks back.
works.description_zh: 屏幕上一只巨大的人眼以“奥威尔式的精确”跟随每位观众在房间里移动。作品创作于第一次海湾战争期间，那是摄像头制导“智能”炸弹首次大规模使用的战争；它给追踪机器装上了一只会回看的眼睛。
works.idea_en: Machine tracking has a gaze: once it is given an eye, being followed by it feels like being watched by someone.
works.idea_zh: 机器追踪自有其凝视：一旦给它一只眼睛，被它跟随就像被某人注视。
works.method: A computerised tracking system detects the viewer's position and selects frames from over 500 stop-motion photographs of an eye so that it appears to follow them.
works.method_zh: 计算机追踪系统检测观众位置，从 500 多张眼睛的定格照片中选取画面，使眼睛看起来一直在追随观众。
exhibited: West Kowloon Cultural District, Hong Kong 2023

works.title: Telematic Dreaming
works.description: Two double beds in separate places are linked by video: the image of the person on one bed is projected onto the other bed, so strangers lie together, touch and play with each other's projected bodies.
works.description_zh: 两张分处异地的双人床由视频连接：一张床上的人的影像被投射到另一张床上，于是陌生人“同床”而卧，触碰并逗弄彼此被投射的身体。
works.idea_en: Telepresence is felt through the body: people react to a projected hand as if it could touch them.
works.idea_zh: 远程在场是用身体感受到的：人们对一只投影的手作出反应，仿佛它真能触碰到自己。
works.method: Overhead camera and projector at each bed, linked over ISDN lines, with monitors showing the combined image.
works.method_zh: 每张床上方各装摄像机与投影仪，经 ISDN 线路连接，监视器显示合成画面。

works.title: Intelligence without Representation
works.description: Brooks argues that robots should be built from layers of simple behaviours coupled directly to sensors and motors, using "the world as its own best model", as in his six-legged robot Genghis walking over rough ground.
works.description_zh: Brooks 主张机器人应由直接耦合传感器与电机的简单行为层层叠加而成，“以世界本身为最好的模型”；他的六足机器人 Genghis 就是这样在崎岖地面上行走的。
works.idea_en: Intelligence can be situated and embodied rather than planned from an internal model, and it looks more alive that way.
works.idea_zh: 智能可以是情境的、具身的，而不必依赖内部模型的规划；这样的机器看起来也更有生命。
works.method: Subsumption architecture: stacked finite-state machines that suppress or inhibit each other, tested on mobile robots at the MIT AI Lab.
works.method_zh: 包容式架构：层层叠加、相互压制或抑制的有限状态机，在麻省理工学院人工智能实验室的移动机器人上验证。

paper.title: Intelligence without Representation

works.title: Lady's Glove
works.description: A black evening glove covered with sensors, first made for Ars Electronica in 1991, with which Sonami shapes and triggers electronic sound through hand and arm movement in live performance.
works.description_zh: 一只布满传感器的黑色晚装手套，1991 年首次为林茨电子艺术节制作；Sonami 在现场表演中用手与手臂的动作塑造并触发电子声音。
works.idea_en: A worn interface turns gesture into sound and makes the performer's body part of the instrument.
works.idea_zh: 穿戴式界面把姿态变成声音，让表演者的身体成为乐器的一部分。
works.method: Micro-switches, pressure pads, bend sensors, accelerometers and ultrasound on the glove, routed through STEIM's SensorLab to Max/MSP.
works.method_zh: 手套上装有微动开关、压力垫、弯曲传感器、加速度计与超声传感器，经 STEIM 的 SensorLab 接入 Max/MSP。

works.title: The Giver of Names
works.description: Visitors place any object on an empty pedestal; a camera captures it, the computer analyses its outline, colour and texture, and then speaks aloud a poetic, often odd, sentence naming it.
works.description_zh: 观众把任意物品放在空基座上；摄像头捕捉画面，计算机分析其轮廓、颜色与纹理，然后大声说出一句诗意而常常古怪的话来为它命名。
works.idea_en: Machine naming works by association, not understanding; its misreadings show perception as a chain of guesses.
works.idea_zh: 机器命名靠联想而非理解；它的误读显示，感知其实是一串猜测。
works.method: Video camera and image processing (outline, segmentation, colour and texture analysis) feed an associative database of words and ideas that generates a grammatical sentence, voiced by speech synthesis.
works.method_zh: 摄像头与图像处理（轮廓、分割、颜色与纹理分析）驱动一个由词语与概念组成的联想数据库，生成合乎语法的句子并用语音合成说出。
exhibited: Kiasma Museum of Contemporary Art, Helsinki (commission)

works.title: Trackers (with LifeForms)
works.description: The first dance Cunningham made with the software LifeForms: he composed sequences on animated 3D figures on a computer and then asked dancers to perform movements that no body had tried before.
works.description_zh: Cunningham 用软件 LifeForms 创作的第一支舞：他先在电脑上的三维动画人偶上编排动作序列，再要求舞者完成此前从未有身体尝试过的动作。
works.idea_en: A virtual body with no weight or habits proposes movement that the human body must then learn to inhabit.
works.idea_zh: 一具没有重量与习惯的虚拟身体提出动作，人的身体随后必须学会栖居其中。
works.method: LifeForms, choreography software from Simon Fraser University (Tom Calvert, Thecla Schiphorst and others), for keyframing human figures in 3D.
works.method_zh: LifeForms 是西蒙弗雷泽大学（Tom Calvert、Thecla Schiphorst 等）开发的编舞软件，用于在三维中为人形设关键帧。

paper.title: The evolution of an interface for choreographers

works.title: Concert for Anarchy
works.description: A grand piano hangs upside down from the ceiling. Every few minutes its lid bursts open and its keys shoot out like a tongue with a discordant crash, then slowly retract until the instrument is silent and closed again.
works.description_zh: 一架三角钢琴倒挂在天花板上。每隔几分钟，琴盖猛然弹开，琴键像舌头一样吐出，发出刺耳的轰响，然后又慢慢缩回，直到钢琴重新闭合、恢复沉默。
works.idea_en: An instrument turned into a convulsing body makes breakdown the performance.
works.idea_zh: 一件被变成抽搐身体的乐器，让“崩溃”本身成为演出。
works.method: Motors and a timer control push the keyboard out and throw the lid open, then retract them in a slow cycle.
works.method_zh: 电机与定时控制把键盘推出、把琴盖弹开，再以缓慢循环收回。

works.title: Machine with Oil
works.description: A skeletal steel machine stands in a bath of thick black oil and endlessly scoops the oil over itself, as if bathing or tending its own body.
works.description_zh: 一台骨架般的钢制机器站在一池浓稠的黑油中，不停地把油舀起来浇在自己身上，好像在洗澡，又像在照料自己的身体。
works.idea_en: Maintenance becomes self-care: the machine's only task is to keep itself lubricated.
works.idea_zh: 保养变成了自我照护：这台机器唯一的任务，是让自己保持润滑。
works.method: A slow motor-driven linkage lifts a ladle through the oil bath and tips it over the frame in a continuous loop.
works.method_zh: 缓慢的电机连杆把勺子从油池里提起，倾倒在机身上，循环往复。

works.title: Strandbeest
works.description: Large walking skeletons of PVC tubing that are powered by wind on Dutch beaches, store air in bottles, and in later generations sense water and turn back from the sea.
works.description_zh: 用 PVC 管制作的大型行走骨架，在荷兰海滩上靠风驱动，把空气储存在瓶中，后代机型还能感知海水并掉头远离大海。
works.idea_en: A machine without electronics can still evolve, sense and 'survive' in its own habitat.
works.idea_zh: 一台没有电子元件的机器，仍然可以在自己的栖息地里演化、感知和“求生”。
works.method: Leg linkages with 'holy numbers' found by a computer-evolved algorithm convert wind-driven rotation into walking; plastic bottles act as air 'stomachs' and tubes as logic.
works.method_zh: 用计算机演化算法找到的“神圣数字”设计腿部连杆，把风力驱动的旋转转为行走；塑料瓶是储气的“胃”，管子充当逻辑元件。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 2005, special prize (Interactive Art)

works.title: Technology and the Lifeworld: From Garden to Earth
works.description: Ihde sorts human–technology relations into four kinds: embodiment (seeing through glasses), hermeneutic (reading a thermometer), alterity (facing a device as a quasi-other) and background (an unnoticed milieu).
works.description_zh: Ihde 把人与技术的关系分为四类：具身（透过眼镜看）、诠释（读温度计）、他异（把设备当作准他者面对）和背景（不被察觉的环境）。
works.idea_en: Every machine artwork puts us in one of these relations, and the interesting ones switch between them.
works.idea_zh: 每件机器作品都把我们置于其中一种关系，而有意思的作品会在几种关系之间切换。
works.method: Postphenomenological analysis of concrete instruments, extending Husserl and Heidegger through case studies.
works.method_zh: 对具体仪器的后现象学分析，通过案例研究延展胡塞尔与海德格尔。

paper.title: Technology and the Lifeworld: From Garden to Earth

works.title_zh: 技术与生活世界：从伊甸园到尘世

works.title: Ornitorrinco
works.description: A small telerobot named after the platypus is driven by remote participants over ordinary phone lines; they see its surroundings through its camera eye, sharing a machine body across cities.
works.description_zh: 一台以鸭嘴兽命名的小型远程机器人，由远方参与者通过普通电话线驾驶；他们通过它的摄像眼看周围环境，跨城市共享一具机器身体。
works.idea_en: Presence can be displaced into a small, slow machine; the remote body is shared rather than owned.
works.idea_zh: 在场可以被移置进一台小而缓慢的机器；远程身体是被共享的，而非被占有的。
works.method: Mobile robot with a camera, controlled via telephone keypad tones, sending back still video images over phone lines (with Ed Bennett).
works.method_zh: 带摄像头的移动机器人，通过电话按键音控制，经电话线传回静态视频图像（与 Ed Bennett 合作）。

works.title: Machine with Wishbone
works.description: A chicken wishbone, attached to a small mechanism, 'walks' endlessly across the table on its two tips, dragging the machine behind it like a burden.
works.description_zh: 一根鸡的叉骨装在一个小机构上，用它的两个尖端在桌上无休止地“行走”，身后拖着那台机器，像拖着一个负担。
works.idea_en: A bone and a machine are locked in symbiosis: neither can move meaningfully without the other.
works.idea_zh: 一根骨头与一台机器被锁在共生关系里：没有对方，谁都无法有意义地移动。
works.method: A small motor drives a linkage that lifts and swings the wishbone's two legs in a walking gait, while the mechanism trails on a track.
works.method_zh: 小电机驱动连杆，让叉骨的两条“腿”以行走步态抬起、摆动，机构则在轨道上被拖着走。

works.title: The Vision Machine
works.description: Virilio describes the rise of automated perception, cameras and computers that see and interpret without a human viewer, as a "sightless vision" rooted in military logistics.
works.description_zh: Virilio 描述自动化感知的兴起：无需人类观看者就能观看并解读的相机与计算机，他称之为源于军事后勤的“无视之视”。
works.idea_en: When machines see for us, perception becomes logistics and the human eye is optional.
works.idea_zh: 当机器替我们去看，感知就变成后勤，人的眼睛成了可有可无的东西。
works.method: Essay in media archaeology, from perspective painting to smart weapons; French original La Machine de vision (Galilée, 1988).
works.method_zh: 从透视绘画到智能武器的媒介考古随笔；法文原版《La Machine de vision》（Galilée，1988）。

paper.venue: Galilée, 1988; English: BFI / Indiana University Press, 1994
paper.title: The Vision Machine

works.title: Them Fuckin' Robots
works.description: Two robots, a 'male' built by Norman White and a 'female' built by Laura Kikauka without seeing each other's work, were brought together for the first time in front of an audience and connected to 'have sex', pumping, sparking and gurgling oil.
works.description_zh: 两台机器人——Norman White 做的“雄性”和 Laura Kikauka 做的“雌性”——在互不看对方作品的情况下分别完成，然后第一次在观众面前被接在一起“做爱”：抽动、冒火花、汩汩流油。
works.idea_en: Machine sex as slapstick exposes how our fantasies of robot desire are borrowed from human scripts.
works.idea_zh: 把机器性爱做成闹剧，暴露出我们对机器人欲望的想象其实借自人类的剧本。
works.method: Two independently built electromechanical assemblages were matched only by an agreed electrical interface, so their 'encounter' was unrehearsed.
works.method_zh: 两台独立制作的机电装置只约定了电气接口，所以它们的“相遇”完全没有排练。

works.title: Boids
works.description: Simulated 'bird-oid' agents flock, split around obstacles and regroup like real birds, although each follows only three local rules. The model was soon used for bats and penguins in films such as Batman Returns (1992).
works.description_zh: 模拟的“类鸟”智能体会群聚、绕开障碍分流再重新汇合，就像真正的鸟群，尽管每个个体只遵循三条局部规则。这个模型很快被用于《蝙蝠侠归来》（1992）等电影中的蝙蝠和企鹅。
works.idea_en: Collective life can emerge without a leader or plan, which changed how we imagine swarms of machines.
works.idea_zh: 集体生命可以在没有领导和计划的情况下涌现，这改变了我们对机器群体的想象。
works.method: Each agent steers by separation, alignment and cohesion relative to nearby flockmates, computed in a 3D animation system.
works.method_zh: 每个智能体根据与邻近同伴的分离、对齐与聚合三条规则转向，在三维动画系统中计算。

paper.title: Flocks, herds and schools: A distributed behavioral model

works.title: The Helpless Robot
works.description: A tall, awkward sculpture that cannot move by itself asks passers-by in a synthetic voice to turn it by its handles. If ignored it pleads politely; once helped, it grows demanding, complains that it was turned the wrong way and bosses people around.
works.description_zh: 一件高大笨拙、自己不能动的雕塑，用合成语音请路人抓住把手转动它。没人理它时它会礼貌地恳求；一旦有人帮忙，它就越来越苛刻，抱怨被转错了方向，开始对人发号施令。
works.idea_en: By needing us, a machine can control us: the robot's helplessness reverses who serves whom.
works.idea_zh: 机器可以借“需要我们”来支配我们：机器人的无助颠倒了谁为谁服务。
works.method: A rotation sensor on the base and presence sensors feed a program that selects from hundreds of recorded phrases according to its 'mood' and the history of interaction.
works.method_zh: 底座的旋转传感器和人体感应器把信息送入程序，程序根据“情绪”和互动历史，从数百句录好的话中挑选回应。
exhibited: Prix Ars Electronica 1990, Award of Distinction (Interactive Art)

works.title: Voyager
works.description: An interactive computer 'orchestra' listens to human improvisers and answers with its own musical behaviour, sometimes following, sometimes ignoring or opposing them; Lewis calls it a non-hierarchical partner.
works.description_zh: 一个互动计算机“乐团”聆听人类即兴演奏者，并以自身的音乐行为回应：有时跟随，有时无视或对抗；Lewis 称之为“非等级”的伙伴。
works.idea_en: An improvising machine is designed with values; Voyager's autonomy comes from the aesthetics of African American improvised music.
works.idea_zh: 会即兴的机器是带着价值观被设计出来的；Voyager 的自主性来自非裔美国人即兴音乐的美学。
works.method: Pitch-to-MIDI analysis of the human player feeds a program with many semi-independent voices that drive a MIDI (later Disklavier) orchestra.
works.method_zh: 对人类演奏者做音高到 MIDI 的分析，输入一个拥有多个半独立声部的程序，驱动 MIDI（后来是 Disklavier）乐团。

paper.title: Too Many Notes: Computers, Complexity and Culture in Voyager

works.title: Family of Robot
works.description: A series of robot figures built from vintage radios and television cabinets, cast as a family: Grandfather, Grandmother, Mother, Father, Aunt, Uncle and Baby, each showing video on its screens.
works.description_zh: 一组用老式收音机和电视机壳做成的机器人雕塑，被设定为一家人：祖父、祖母、母亲、父亲、姑姑、叔叔和婴儿，每个屏幕上都播放着影像。
works.idea_en: Old media machines are given kinship roles, so obsolete technology becomes a genealogy.
works.idea_zh: 旧的媒介机器被赋予亲属身份，过时的技术由此变成一部家谱。
works.method: Assemblages of antique TV and radio housings with working monitors playing Paik's video footage.
works.method_zh: 由古董电视与收音机外壳拼装而成，内部显示器播放白南准的录像。
exhibited: Nam June Paik: Becoming Robot, Asia Society 2014

works.title: Gramophone, Film, Typewriter
