orgs.description: American designer-researcher whose Feminist Data Set interrogates every step of making AI, from collecting data to paying the labellers, as a feminist practice.
orgs.description_zh: 美国设计师与研究者，其 Feminist Data Set 以女性主义方法审视 AI 生产的每一步，从采集数据到给标注者付酬。
orgs.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 纽约，美国

orgs.name: Catherine D'Ignazio
orgs.description: American scholar and artist whose Data Feminism, written with Lauren F. Klein, sets out how power shapes who is counted, classified and seen by data systems.
orgs.description_zh: 美国学者与艺术家，与 Lauren F. Klein 合著《数据女性主义》，阐述权力如何决定谁被数据系统计数、分类与看见。
known_for: Data Feminism (2020, with Lauren F. Klein)

orgs.name: Catie Cuan
orgs.description: American dancer-roboticist who choreographs with industrial and mobile robots; in Output she and an ABB arm trade movement captured from each other.
orgs.description_zh: 美国舞者兼机器人学家，与工业和移动机器人共同编舞；Output 中她与 ABB 机械臂互相交换彼此被捕捉的动作。

orgs.name: Centre Pompidou
orgs.description: Paris's national modern art centre. Its Mutations/Créations series staged Neurones, les intelligences simulées (2020), a history of neural and simulated intelligence across art, design and science.
orgs.description_zh: 法国国家现代艺术中心。其 Mutations/Créations 系列举办了《Neurones, les intelligences simulées》（2020），跨越艺术、设计与科学梳理神经网络与模拟智能的历史。

orgs.name: Chen Qiufan
orgs.description: Chinese science-fiction writer whose The Waste Tide imagines e-waste workers and cyborgs in southern China, and who has written fiction together with language models.
orgs.description_zh: 中国科幻作家，《荒潮》想象华南电子垃圾工人与赛博格的命运，他也曾与语言模型合作写作小说。
known_for: AI 2041: Ten Visions for Our Future (2021, with Kai-Fu Lee)

orgs.name: Chico MacMurtrie
orgs.description: American artist whose Amorphic Robot Works builds pneumatic and inflatable robotic bodies that breathe, drum and climb, machines that behave like primal organisms.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，其 Amorphic Robot Works 制作会呼吸、击鼓、攀爬的气动与充气机器身体，让机器表现得像原始生物。

orgs.name: China Academy of Art – School of Inter-Media Art
orgs.name_zh: 中国美术学院跨媒体艺术学院
orgs.description: China's leading school for new media, installation and network art at the China Academy of Art, a training ground for Chinese artists working with machines and AI.
orgs.description_zh: 中国美术学院的跨媒体艺术学院，是中国新媒体、装置与网络艺术教育的重镇，也是中国机器与 AI 艺术家的重要培养地。

orgs.name: Choe U-Ram
orgs.description: South Korean sculptor of 'anima-machines', delicate mechanical creatures with invented scientific names and life cycles; Little Ark is a ship of oars that rise and fall like breathing.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国雕塑家，创作“机械生命体”：拥有虚构学名与生命周期的精致机械生物；《小方舟》是一艘船桨如呼吸般起伏的船。

orgs.name: Choy Ka Fai
orgs.description: Singaporean artist whose Prospectus for a Future Body stimulates dancers' muscles with electrical signals recorded from other dancers, asking whether movement memory can be transferred by machine.
orgs.description_zh: 新加坡艺术家，Prospectus for a Future Body 用记录自其他舞者的电信号刺激舞者肌肉，追问动作记忆能否经由机器传递。

orgs.name: Christa Sommerer & Laurent Mignonneau
orgs.description: Austrian-French duo, pioneers of artificial-life art: in A-Volve visitors draw creatures that then evolve, hunt and mate in a pool of water, living by their own rules.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利–法国二人组，人工生命艺术先驱：在 A-Volve 中观众画出的生物会在水池中自行演化、捕食与交配。

orgs.name: Christiane Paul
orgs.description: German-American curator of digital art at the Whitney Museum and author of the standard survey Digital Art; she curated the 2024 Whitney show of Harold Cohen's AARON.
orgs.description_zh: 德裔美国策展人，惠特尼美术馆数字艺术策展人，著有经典综述《数字艺术》，并策划了 2024 年惠特尼的 Harold Cohen: AARON 展。
known_for: Programmed: Rules, Codes, and Choreographies in Art (Whitney, 2018)

orgs.name: Christoph Bartneck
orgs.description: German HRI researcher who studied whether people hesitate to switch off a pleading robot, robot abuse, and whether robots are racialised by their colour.
orgs.description_zh: 德国人机交互研究者，研究人们是否会迟疑关掉一台哀求的机器人、虐待机器人的行为，以及机器人是否会因颜色被种族化。
known_for: Daisy, Daisy, Give Me Your Answer Do! (2007)

orgs.name: Chronus Art Center
orgs.description: Shanghai's first nonprofit art centre dedicated to media art, with exhibitions, research and a lab. A main venue in China for machine, algorithmic and kinetic work, including the Chinese tour of ZKM's Open Codes.
orgs.description_zh: 上海首家专注媒体艺术的非营利艺术中心，设有展览、研究与实验室。它是中国展出机器、算法与动态作品的主要机构之一，也曾承接 ZKM《Open Codes》的中国巡展。

orgs.name: Claude Shannon
orgs.description: American mathematician who founded information theory and built Theseus, a mechanical mouse that learned a maze, as well as the 'useless machine' that only switches itself off.
orgs.description_zh: 美国数学家，创立信息论，并制作了会学习走迷宫的机械老鼠 Theseus，以及只会把自己关掉的“无用机器”。

orgs.name: Claudia Schmuckli
orgs.description: Curator of contemporary art at the Fine Arts Museums of San Francisco whose Uncanny Valley: Being Human in the Age of AI brought critical AI art to a major US museum.
orgs.description_zh: 旧金山美术博物馆当代艺术策展人，其“恐怖谷：AI 时代的为人之道”把批判性 AI 艺术带进了美国大型美术馆。
known_for: Uncanny Valley: Being Human in the Age of AI (de Young, 2020)

orgs.name: Clement Valla
orgs.description: French-American artist whose Postcards from Google Earth collects melted bridges and warped roads, not errors but the logic of a machine-made 3D world.
orgs.description_zh: 法裔美国艺术家，Postcards from Google Earth 收集“融化”的桥梁与扭曲的道路：它们不是错误，而是机器生成的三维世界的逻辑。

orgs.name: Clifford Nass
orgs.description: American social scientist whose experiments showed that people are polite to computers and apply gender stereotypes to synthetic voices, treating media 'like real people'.
orgs.description_zh: 美国社会科学家，他的实验显示人们会对电脑讲礼貌，也会把性别刻板印象套用到合成语音上，把媒介当作“真人”对待。
known_for: The Media Equation (1996, with Byron Reeves)

orgs.name: Cod.Act (André & Michel Décosterd)
orgs.description: Swiss brothers whose sound-machine performances fuse bodies and mechanics: in Pendulum Choir nine singers tilt on hydraulic jacks, their voices shaped by the machine's movement.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士兄弟组合，其声音-机器表演融合身体与机械：Pendulum Choir 中九名歌手站在液压支架上倾斜摆动，歌声随机器运动而变化。

orgs.name: Coding Rights
orgs.description: Brazilian feminist organisation on technology and human rights, whose Not My A.I. project maps AI deployed against marginalised people in Latin America.
orgs.description_zh: 巴西的女性主义技术与人权组织，其《Not My A.I.》项目梳理拉丁美洲针对边缘群体部署的 AI 系统。

orgs.name: Computational Culture
orgs.description: Open-access journal of software studies, publishing research on algorithms, machine learning and the cultural life of code.
orgs.description_zh: 软件研究领域的开放获取期刊，发表关于算法、机器学习与代码文化生命的研究。

orgs.name: Computer Arts Society (CAS)
orgs.description: British society founded in 1968, the year of Cybernetic Serendipity, to support computer use in the arts; publisher of the bulletin PAGE and a specialist group of the BCS.
orgs.description_zh: 1968 年（《控制论的意外发现》同年）成立的英国学会，推动计算机在艺术中的应用，出版通讯 PAGE，现为英国计算机学会的专业小组。

orgs.name: Computer History Museum
orgs.description: Silicon Valley museum and archive of computing. Its collection and exhibition Revolution include AI and robotics milestones such as Shakey the robot, with oral histories of the engineers.
orgs.description_zh: 位于硅谷的计算机历史博物馆与档案馆。其收藏与展览《Revolution》包括 Shakey 机器人等 AI 与机器人里程碑，并收录工程师口述史。

orgs.name: Constant
orgs.description: Brussels artist-run association for art, media and technology, home to Algolit, which explores machine learning through literature and code.
orgs.description_zh: 布鲁塞尔由艺术家运营的艺术、媒体与技术协会，旗下 Algolit 小组以文学与代码探索机器学习。

orgs.name: Creative AI Lab
orgs.description: Collaboration between Serpentine Arts Technologies and King's College London's Department of Digital Humanities. It studies AI as an artistic medium and keeps a database of tools and resources for artists.
orgs.description_zh: 蛇形画廊艺术与技术部与伦敦国王学院数字人文系的合作项目，研究 AI 作为艺术媒介，并维护面向艺术家的工具与资源数据库。

orgs.name: Creative Machines Lab (Columbia University)
orgs.name_zh: 哥伦比亚大学创意机器实验室
orgs.description: Hod Lipson's robotics lab, known for self-modelling robots that learn their own body image, robots that paint and machines that design machines.
orgs.description_zh: Hod Lipson 的机器人实验室，以能学习自身身体图式的自建模机器人、会画画的机器人和设计机器的机器闻名。

orgs.name: Critical AI (Duke University Press)
orgs.description: Interdisciplinary journal and Rutgers-based initiative that brings humanities methods to AI, from large language models to data labour.
orgs.description_zh: 以罗格斯大学为基地的跨学科期刊与计划，以人文学科方法研究 AI，从大语言模型到数据劳动。

orgs.name: Critical Algorithm Studies: a Reading List
orgs.description: Reading list by Tarleton Gillespie and Nick Seaver of the Microsoft Research Social Media Collective on algorithms as social concern, a standard entry point for critical algorithm studies.
orgs.description_zh: 由微软研究院社交媒体小组的 Tarleton Gillespie 与 Nick Seaver 编制的书单，关注作为社会议题的算法，是批判算法研究的标准入门。

orgs.name: Critical Engineering Working Group
orgs.description: Group behind The Critical Engineering Manifesto (2011), which asks engineers and artists to expose the inner workings of the technologies we depend on.
orgs.description_zh: 《批判工程宣言》（2011）的发起团体，呼吁工程师与艺术家揭示我们所依赖的技术的内部运作。

orgs.name: CVPR AI Art Gallery
orgs.description: Online and on-site gallery of the CVPR computer vision conference, showing artworks that use or question computer vision; its archive documents each year's selection.
orgs.description_zh: 计算机视觉会议 CVPR 的线上与现场画廊，展出使用或质疑计算机视觉的艺术作品，档案保存了历年入选作品。

orgs.name: Cybernetic Forests
orgs.description: Eryk Salvaggio's newsletter on AI, art and cybernetics, reading generated images as infographics of their datasets and arguing against AI hype.
orgs.description_zh: Eryk Salvaggio 关于 AI、艺术与控制论的通讯，把生成图像当作其数据集的“信息图”来解读，并批判 AI 炒作。

orgs.name: Cybernetic Serendipity archive
orgs.name_zh: 控制论的意外发现档案
orgs.description: Online archive of Jasia Reichardt's 1968 ICA exhibition Cybernetic Serendipity, the founding show of computer and cybernetic art, with Gordon Pask's Colloquy of Mobiles and Edward Ihnatowicz's SAM.
orgs.description_zh: Jasia Reichardt 1968 年在伦敦当代艺术学院策划的《控制论的意外发现》的线上档案。该展是计算机与控制论艺术的开山展览，展出 Gordon Pask《Colloquy of Mobiles》与 Edward Ihnatowicz《SAM》等作品。

orgs.name: cyberneticzoo.com
orgs.description: Illustrated history of cybernetic animals and early robots, from Grey Walter's tortoises to forgotten walking machines, compiled from period sources.
orgs.description_zh: 图文并茂的控制论动物与早期机器人史，从 Grey Walter 的机器龟到被遗忘的步行机器，均取材于当时文献。

orgs.name: Cynthia Breazeal
orgs.description: American roboticist who founded social robotics with Kismet, an expressive robot head that responded to people's emotions, and later Jibo, one of the first social robots for the home.
orgs.description_zh: 美国机器人学家，以能回应人类情绪的表情机器人头 Kismet 开创社交机器人学，之后又推出最早的家用社交机器人之一 Jibo。

orgs.name: Daito Manabe
orgs.description: Japanese artist and Rhizomatiks co-founder whose Electric Stimulus to Face let a computer drive his facial muscles, later extending to drones, dancers and brain-decoding works.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家、Rhizomatiks 联合创始人，Electric Stimulus to Face 让电脑以电流驱动他的面部肌肉，之后延伸到无人机、舞者与脑解码作品。

orgs.name: Dan Chen
orgs.description: Designer whose RISD-era robotic intimacy series built machines that caress and comfort people; his Last Moment Robot strokes a dying patient's arm and speaks words of comfort, questioning machine care at the end of life.
orgs.description_zh: 设计师，他在罗德岛设计学院期间创作的“机器亲密”系列让机器抚摸、安慰人；其中 Last Moment Robot 在临终病人身边抚摸其手臂并说出安慰的话语，追问生命尽头的机器照护。

orgs.name: Daniel Langlois Foundation for Art, Science and Technology
orgs.name_zh: 丹尼尔·朗格卢瓦艺术、科学与技术基金会
orgs.description: Foundation whose online archive documents Experiments in Art and Technology (E.A.T.) and early media art, including essays on artists who worked with machines and cybernetics.
orgs.description_zh: 其在线档案记录了“艺术与技术实验”（E.A.T.）与早期媒体艺术，并收录关于机器与控制论艺术家的论文。

orgs.name: Data & Society
orgs.description: Independent research institute founded by danah boyd that studies the social implications of data-centric and automated technologies, from platform labour to algorithmic accountability.
orgs.description_zh: 由 danah boyd 创立的独立研究机构，研究数据驱动与自动化技术的社会影响，从平台劳动到算法问责。

orgs.name: Data for Black Lives
orgs.description: Movement of activists and scientists using data to improve Black lives and fighting algorithmic discrimination.
orgs.description_zh: 由活动者与科学家组成的运动，用数据改善黑人生活，并对抗算法歧视。

orgs.name: Data Workers' Inquiry
orgs.description: Community research project of DAIR and the Weizenbaum Institute in which data workers who label and moderate for AI document their own conditions in reports, films and zines.
orgs.description_zh: DAIR 与魏岑鲍姆研究所的社区研究项目，由为 AI 做标注与审核的数据劳工以报告、影片与小册子记录自身的劳动处境。

orgs.name: Database of Digital Art (compArt daDA)
orgs.description: Database from the compArt centre at the University of Bremen on the pioneers of computer art and their exhibitions, including Cybernetic Serendipity (1968).
orgs.description_zh: 不来梅大学 compArt 中心建立的数据库，收录计算机艺术先驱及其展览，包括《Cybernetic Serendipity》（1968）。

orgs.name: David Bowen
orgs.description: American artist whose machines let non-humans and data drive them: a houseplant wields a machete, and houseflies control a revolver, making other perceptual worlds act through robots.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，让非人类与数据驱动他的机器：盆栽挥舞砍刀，苍蝇操控手枪，让其他感知世界通过机器人行动。

orgs.name: David Chalmers
orgs.description: Australian philosopher who named the 'hard problem' of consciousness and now asks, carefully, whether language models or their successors could be conscious.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚哲学家，提出意识的“困难问题”，如今审慎地追问语言模型或其后继者是否可能具有意识。
known_for: The Extended Mind (1998, with Andy Clark)
Could a Large Language Model Be Conscious? (2023)

orgs.name: David Hanson
orgs.description: American robot designer and founder of Hanson Robotics, maker of lifelike humanoid heads such as Bina48 and Sophia, a robot granted Saudi citizenship in 2017.
orgs.description_zh: 美国机器人设计师、汉森机器人公司创始人，制作 Bina48、Sophia 等逼真人形头部；Sophia 于 2017 年获得沙特公民身份。

orgs.name: David Harris Smith & Frauke Zeller
orgs.description: Canadian researchers who made hitchBOT, a hitchhiking robot that crossed Canada and parts of Europe on strangers' goodwill before being destroyed in Philadelphia in 2015.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大研究者，创造了搭便车机器人 hitchBOT：它靠陌生人的善意横穿加拿大和欧洲部分地区，2015 年在费城被毁。
orgs.based_zh: 汉密尔顿 / 多伦多，加拿大

orgs.name: David J. Gunkel
orgs.description: American media philosopher whose The Machine Question and Robot Rights take seriously whether machines can be moral patients, drawing on Levinas and Derrida.
orgs.description_zh: 美国媒介哲学家，《机器问题》与《机器人权利》借列维纳斯与德里达，认真追问机器能否成为道德受体。

orgs.name: David Rokeby
orgs.description: Canadian pioneer of interactive installation; The Giver of Names looks at objects visitors place before it and generates associative sentences about them, an early portrait of machine interpretation.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大互动装置先驱；The Giver of Names 观察观众放在面前的物品并生成联想式句子，是对机器“解读”的早期描绘。

orgs.name: de Young Museum (FAMSF)
orgs.description: San Francisco fine arts museum that staged Uncanny Valley: Being Human in the Age of AI (2020), which read the uncanny valley politically as the gap between AI's promises and its effects on data, labour and bias.
orgs.description_zh: 旧金山美术馆，曾举办《Uncanny Valley: Being Human in the Age of AI》（2020），把“恐怖谷”解读为 AI 承诺与其在数据、劳动和偏见上实际后果之间的政治落差。

orgs.name: Desmond Paul Henry
orgs.description: British artist who built drawing machines from bombsight analogue computers in the early 1960s, among the first machine-made artworks exhibited in the UK.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，1960 年代初用轰炸瞄准器模拟计算机改装成绘图机器，其作品是英国最早展出的机器绘画之一。

orgs.name: Diemut Strebe
orgs.description: German artist working with MIT scientists; The Prayer is a robotic mouth that composes and speaks its own prayers from a language model, asking whether a machine can pray.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，与 MIT 科学家合作；The Prayer 是一张机器人嘴，用语言模型生成并念出自己的祷词，追问机器能否祈祷。

orgs.name: Distributed AI Research Institute (DAIR)
orgs.name_zh: 分布式 AI 研究所
orgs.description: Independent, community-rooted AI research institute founded by Timnit Gebru after her dismissal from Google. It centres the people harmed by AI, including data workers.
orgs.description_zh: Timnit Gebru 在被谷歌解雇后创立的独立 AI 研究机构，扎根社区，以包括数据劳工在内的受 AI 伤害者为中心。

orgs.name: Don Ihde
orgs.description: American philosopher of postphenomenology whose four human–technology relations (embodiment, hermeneutic, alterity, background) are a basic map for how we live with machines.
orgs.description_zh: 美国后现象学哲学家，提出人与技术的四种关系（具身、诠释、他异、背景），是理解人与机器共处的基本地图。

orgs.name: Donna Haraway
orgs.description: American feminist scholar whose Cyborg Manifesto made the human–machine hybrid a figure for dismantling the boundaries between organism and machine, nature and culture.
orgs.description_zh: 美国女性主义学者，《赛博格宣言》把人机混合体变成拆解有机体与机器、自然与文化边界的形象。

orgs.name: Dries Depoorter
orgs.description: Belgian artist whose The Follower matched Instagram photos with open webcam footage of the moment they were taken, revealing how easily AI links public cameras to private images.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时艺术家，The Follower 把 Instagram 照片与拍摄当时的公开网络摄像头画面相匹配，揭示 AI 多么轻易地把公共摄像头与私人影像连在一起。

orgs.name: Dunne & Raby (Anthony Dunne & Fiona Raby)
orgs.description: British designers who defined critical and speculative design; Technological Dreams: Robots imagines domestic robots that are needy, neurotic or dependent rather than servile.
orgs.description_zh: 英国设计师，确立了批判设计与思辨设计；Technological Dreams: Robots 想象了一批需要照顾、神经质或依赖人的家用机器人，而非顺从的仆人。

orgs.name: e-flux journal
orgs.description: Online art journal that published key texts on machine vision and AI, such as Hito Steyerl's 'A Sea of Data: Apophenia and Pattern (Mis-)Recognition' (2016).
orgs.description_zh: 在线艺术期刊，刊登了关于机器视觉与 AI 的关键文本，如 Hito Steyerl 的《A Sea of Data：幻想性错觉与模式（误）识别》（2016）。

orgs.name: Eduardo Kac
orgs.description: Brazilian-American artist of telepresence robotics and bio art; in Rara Avis visitors saw an aviary through the eyes of a robotic macaw, inhabiting a machine body.
orgs.description_zh: 巴西裔美国艺术家，远程临场机器人与生物艺术先驱；在 Rara Avis 中，观众透过一只机器鹦鹉的眼睛观看鸟舍，暂时栖居于机器身体。

orgs.name: Edward Ihnatowicz
orgs.description: Polish-born British sculptor who made the first computer-controlled robotic sculptures: The Senster, a 4.5-metre hydraulic creature at Philips' Evoluon, turned towards quiet voices and shied away from loud ones.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰出生的英国雕塑家，创作了最早的计算机控制机器人雕塑：飞利浦 Evoluon 中心 4.5 米高的液压生物 The Senster 会转向轻柔的人声、躲开喧闹。

orgs.name: Ei Wada
orgs.description: Japanese artist who turns obsolete appliances, such as CRT televisions and electric fans, into musical instruments, giving discarded machines a second life as a community orchestra.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家，把显像管电视、电风扇等淘汰电器改造成乐器，让被遗弃的机器以社区乐团的形式获得第二次生命。

orgs.name: Elektra / International Digital Art Biennial (BIAN)
orgs.description: Montréal festival and biennial for digital art, which often features robotic and machine installations; BIAN editions include the robotics-themed Automata (2016).
orgs.description_zh: 蒙特利尔的数字艺术节与双年展，常展出机器人与机器装置；BIAN 双年展包括以机器人为主题的《Automata》（2016）。

orgs.name: Elisa Giaccardi
orgs.description: Italian design researcher who develops 'more-than-human' design, studying everyday life from the perspective of connected things, such as by fitting cameras to kettles and cups.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利设计研究者，发展“超越人类”的设计，从联网物品的视角研究日常生活，例如给水壶与杯子装上摄像头。
orgs.based_zh: 米兰，意大利 / 代尔夫特，荷兰

orgs.name: Elisa Giardina Papa
orgs.description: Italian artist whose Cleaning Emotional Data documents her own gig work labelling facial expressions for emotion-recognition AI, and whose Technologies of Care portrays online care workers.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利艺术家，Cleaning Emotional Data 记录她自己为情绪识别 AI 标注面部表情的零工劳动，Technologies of Care 描绘线上照护工作者。
orgs.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 西西里，意大利

orgs.name: Emily M. Bender
orgs.description: American linguist who coined 'stochastic parrots' for language models that produce form without meaning, a key term for thinking about machine speech.
orgs.description_zh: 美国语言学家，用“随机鹦鹉”形容只产生形式而不理解意义的语言模型，是思考机器言语的关键概念。
known_for: Climbing towards NLU (2020, with Alexander Koller)
On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots (2021)
The AI Con (2025, with Alex Hanna)

orgs.name: Erkki Huhtamo
orgs.description: Finnish media archaeologist whose essays on the history of robots, automata and interactive art trace the long cultural life of machines as performers.
orgs.description_zh: 芬兰媒介考古学者，他关于机器人、自动机与互动艺术史的研究，追溯机器作为表演者的漫长文化生命。
known_for: Media Archaeology (2011, ed. with Jussi Parikka)

orgs.name: Eryk Salvaggio
orgs.description: American artist-researcher behind the newsletter Cybernetic Forests, who reads AI images as 'infographics about the dataset' and works with noise and glitch to expose how diffusion models see.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家与研究者，Cybernetic Forests 通讯作者，把 AI 图像读作“关于数据集的信息图”，并用噪声与故障揭示扩散模型如何“看”。
known_for: How to Read an AI Image (2022)

orgs.name: Esther Hovers
orgs.description: Dutch artist whose False Positives stages the eight 'anomalous behaviours' that intelligent surveillance systems are trained to flag, from standing still to walking against the flow.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰艺术家，False Positives 在街头重现智能监控系统被训练去标记的八种“异常行为”，从静止不动到逆流而行。

orgs.name: Eugenia Kuyda
orgs.description: Russian-born founder of Replika, which began as a chatbot built from the messages of her late friend Roman Mazurenko and became a companion app used by millions.
orgs.description_zh: 俄罗斯出生的 Replika 创始人，Replika 起源于她用已故好友 Roman Mazurenko 的聊天记录制作的聊天机器人，后来成为数百万人使用的陪伴应用。

orgs.name: Eva & Franco Mattes
orgs.description: Italian artist duo whose Dark Content gives anonymised voices to the content moderators who filter violent and obscene images for platforms, the human layer behind 'automatic' moderation.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利艺术家二人组，Dark Content 让为平台过滤暴力与淫秽图片的内容审核员以匿名身份发声，揭示“自动”审核背后的人类层。

orgs.name: Eva Jäger
orgs.description: Curator at Serpentine Arts Technologies and co-founder of the Creative AI Lab with King's College London, which studies how artists work with AI as a medium and an institution.
orgs.description_zh: 蛇形画廊艺术科技部门策展人，与伦敦国王学院共同创立创意 AI 实验室，研究艺术家如何把 AI 作为媒介与制度来工作。
known_for: Creative AI Lab (co-founded with Mercedes Bunz, 2019)

orgs.name: EVA London – Electronic Visualisation and the Arts
orgs.description: Annual London conference on electronic visualisation and the arts, run with the BCS Computer Arts Society, spanning early computer art history to AI.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦年度电子可视化与艺术会议，与 BCS 计算机艺术学会合办，议题从早期计算机艺术史延伸到 AI。

orgs.name: Everest Pipkin
orgs.description: American artist and game developer whose Lacework slowly reanimates every video in the MIT Moments in Time dataset, and whose essay on it documents the violence hidden in training data.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家与游戏开发者，Lacework 把 MIT Moments in Time 数据集的每段视频缓慢重构，其配套文章记录了训练数据中隐藏的暴力。

orgs.name: Excavating AI
orgs.description: Essay by Kate Crawford and Trevor Paglen on the politics of images in machine learning training sets, which examined ImageNet's 'person' categories and fed into ImageNet Roulette.
orgs.description_zh: Kate Crawford 与 Trevor Paglen 关于机器学习训练集中图像政治的论文，剖析 ImageNet 的“人”类别，并催生了《ImageNet Roulette》。

orgs.name: Experiments in Art and Technology (E.A.T.)
orgs.description: Nonprofit founded by Bell Labs engineers and artists after 9 Evenings (1966), which paired artists with engineers and set the model for art-technology collaboration.
orgs.description_zh: 由贝尔实验室工程师与艺术家在《九夜》（1966）之后创立的非营利组织，为艺术家与工程师配对，奠定了艺术–技术合作的模式。

orgs.name: Exposing.ai
orgs.description: Adam Harvey and Jules LaPlace's research project (successor to MegaPixels) that traces how face and biometric datasets were built from scraped photos and lets people search whether theirs were used.
orgs.description_zh: Adam Harvey 与 Jules LaPlace 的研究项目（MegaPixels 的延续），追溯人脸与生物识别数据集如何由抓取的照片构成，并让公众查询自己的照片是否被使用。

orgs.name: Eyebeam
orgs.description: Nonprofit that supports artists working with technology through residencies and fellowships, with a strong line of alumni projects on surveillance, bias and algorithmic justice.
orgs.description_zh: 以驻留与奖学金支持技术艺术家的非营利机构，校友作品中有大量关于监控、偏见与算法正义的项目。

orgs.name: FACT Liverpool
orgs.name_zh: 利物浦艺术与创意技术基金会
orgs.description: The UK's leading centre for art and creative technology (Foundation for Art and Creative Technology). It commissions and shows work on data, surveillance and AI, often with community co-production.
orgs.description_zh: 英国重要的艺术与创意技术中心（Foundation for Art and Creative Technology），委托并展出关于数据、监控与 AI 的作品，常与社区共同制作。

orgs.name: Feminist.AI
orgs.description: Community research group that co-designs AI prototypes and datasets with communities, making feminist and critical AI by hand.
orgs.description_zh: 与社区共同设计 AI 原型与数据集的社区研究团体，以亲手实践的方式创造女性主义与批判性 AI。

orgs.name: FILE – Electronic Language International Festival
orgs.description: Latin America's largest electronic art festival, held in São Paulo, with robotic, interactive and AI art and an extensive online archive.
orgs.description_zh: 拉丁美洲最大的电子艺术节，在圣保罗举办，展出机器人、互动与 AI 艺术，并拥有丰富的在线档案。

orgs.name: Fondazione Prada
orgs.description: Milan art foundation whose Osservatorio hosted Training Humans (2019), conceived by Kate Crawford and Trevor Paglen: the first major exhibition of the training images that teach machines to see people.
orgs.description_zh: 米兰的艺术基金会。其 Osservatorio 空间举办了 Kate Crawford 与 Trevor Paglen 策划的《Training Humans》（2019），这是首个以“教机器看人”的训练图像为主题的大型展览。

orgs.name: Forensic Architecture
orgs.description: Research agency at Goldsmiths that investigates state and corporate violence with spatial, media and machine-vision analysis. It trains classifiers on synthetic data and won the 2021 Golden Nica for Cloud Studies.
orgs.description_zh: 设于伦敦大学金史密斯学院的研究机构，以空间、媒体与机器视觉分析调查国家与企业暴力；它用合成数据训练分类器，并以《Cloud Studies》获 2021 年金尼卡奖。

orgs.name: Francisco Varela
orgs.description: Chilean biologist and philosopher who co-developed autopoiesis and enactivism, the view that cognition is embodied action, a basis for embodied AI and robot art.
orgs.description_zh: 智利生物学家与哲学家，共同提出自创生与生成主义：认知即具身行动，这为具身 AI 与机器人艺术提供了基础。
known_for: Autopoiesis and Cognition (1980, with Humberto Maturana)
The Embodied Mind (1991, with Evan Thompson and Eleanor Rosch)
orgs.based_zh: 巴黎，法国 / 圣地亚哥，智利

orgs.name: Franziska Nori
orgs.description: Director of the Frankfurter Kunstverein who co-curated I Am Here to Learn (2018), one of the first exhibitions devoted to how machines interpret the world.
orgs.description_zh: 法兰克福艺术协会总监，共同策划“我在这里学习：机器对世界的诠释”（2018），这是最早专门讨论机器如何诠释世界的展览之一。
known_for: I Am Here to Learn: On Machinic Interpretations of the World (Frankfurter Kunstverein, 2018, with Mattis Kuhn)

orgs.name: Friedrich Kittler
orgs.description: German media theorist who argued that media determine our situation, tracing how gramophone, film and typewriter turned human senses and writing into machine operations.
orgs.description_zh: 德国媒介理论家，主张“媒介决定我们的处境”，追溯留声机、电影与打字机如何把人的感官与书写变成机器操作。

orgs.name: Fritz Heider
orgs.description: Austrian psychologist whose 1944 animation with Marianne Simmel showed that people read intentions and emotions into moving triangles, the root of why we see life in machines.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利心理学家，1944 年他与 Marianne Simmel 的动画实验显示，人会把意图与情绪读进移动的三角形，这正是我们在机器中看见生命的根源。
known_for: An Experimental Study of Apparent Behavior (1944, with Marianne Simmel)

orgs.name: Furtherfield
orgs.description: London's longest-running art-and-technology organisation, with a gallery and lab in Finsbury Park. It stages critical exhibitions and games on AI, data, blockchain and more-than-human futures.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦历史最悠久的艺术与技术机构，在芬斯伯里公园设有画廊与实验室，举办关于 AI、数据、区块链与超越人类未来的批判性展览和游戏。

orgs.name: Félix Guattari
orgs.description: French psychoanalyst and philosopher who gave the word 'machinic' its theoretical sense: processes that assemble humans, technologies and signs beyond the mechanical.
orgs.description_zh: 法国精神分析学家与哲学家，赋予“机器的”（machinic）一词理论意义：超越机械、把人、技术与符号组装在一起的过程。

orgs.name: Garnet Hertz
orgs.description: Canadian artist and scholar of critical making whose robot is steered by a live Madagascar hissing cockroach riding on a trackball.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家与“批判制作”学者，他的机器人由一只站在轨迹球上的活马达加斯加发声蟑螂驾驶。

orgs.name: Genevieve Bell
orgs.description: Australian anthropologist, long at Intel, who founded the School of Cybernetics at ANU to build a new applied cybernetics for AI-era systems.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚人类学家，长期任职英特尔，创立澳大利亚国立大学控制论学院，为 AI 时代的系统发展新的应用控制论。
known_for: Divining a Digital Future (2011, with Paul Dourish)

orgs.name: George E. Lewis
orgs.description: American composer, trombonist and AACM member whose Voyager is an improvising computer 'orchestra' that listens and answers, framed as a partner shaped by African American musical culture.
orgs.description_zh: 美国作曲家、长号手、AACM 成员，Voyager 是会聆听并回应的即兴计算机“乐团”，被视为受非裔美国音乐文化塑造的合作者。
known_for: Why Do We Want Our Computers to Improvise? (2018)

orgs.name: Gerfried Stocker
orgs.description: Austrian media artist and artistic director of Ars Electronica since 1995, where the festival and Prix have been a main stage for robot and AI art.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利媒体艺术家，1995 年起担任林茨电子艺术节艺术总监，该艺术节与大奖是机器人与 AI 艺术的主要舞台。

orgs.name: Gil Weinberg
orgs.description: Israeli-American music technologist at Georgia Tech whose robotic musicians Haile and Shimon listen and improvise with human players.
orgs.description_zh: 以色列裔美国音乐科技学者，任教于佐治亚理工学院，他的机器人音乐家 Haile 与 Shimon 会聆听并与人类乐手即兴合奏。

orgs.name: Gilbert Simondon
orgs.description: French philosopher who argued that technical objects have their own mode of existence and evolution, and that alienation comes from failing to understand machines, not from machines themselves.
orgs.description_zh: 法国哲学家，主张技术物有自身的存在方式与演化，异化源于人们不理解机器，而非机器本身。
known_for: On the Mode of Existence of Technical Objects (1958)
Individuation in Light of Notions of Form and Information (1958)

orgs.name: Gilberto Esparza
orgs.description: Mexican artist whose Plantas Nómadas is a robot that feeds its plants from polluted rivers using microbial fuel cells, a machine-organism for damaged ecologies (Golden Nica 2015).
orgs.description_zh: 墨西哥艺术家，Plantas Nómadas 是一台机器人，借微生物燃料电池从污染河流中为身上的植物获取养分，是为受损生态而生的“机器-生物”（2015 年金尼卡奖）。

orgs.name: Goldsmiths Computational Arts
orgs.name_zh: 伦敦大学金史密斯学院计算艺术
orgs.description: Goldsmiths' computational art programmes and embodied interaction research (EAVI), which trained many artists who work with machine learning, bodies and sound.
orgs.description_zh: 金史密斯学院的计算艺术课程与具身交互研究（EAVI），培养了许多以机器学习、身体与声音创作的艺术家。

orgs.name: Gordon Pask
orgs.description: British cybernetician who built responsive, learning machines as art: Musicolour grew bored of a musician who repeated himself, and Colloquy of Mobiles let hanging machines court each other and visitors at Cybernetic Serendipity.
orgs.description_zh: 英国控制论学者，把会学习、会回应的机器做成艺术：Musicolour 会对重复自己的乐手“感到厌倦”，Colloquy of Mobiles 让悬挂的机器在“控制论的意外发现”展上彼此求偶，也与观众互动。

orgs.name: Gramazio Kohler Research (ETH Zurich)
orgs.description: ETH Zurich chair for architecture and digital fabrication, which put industrial robots to work building walls and structures and made robotic construction a design subject.
orgs.description_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院建筑与数字建造教席，让工业机器人砌墙、建造结构，使机器人建造成为设计议题。

orgs.name: Gray Area
orgs.description: San Francisco nonprofit arts centre for creative technology, with an incubator, education programmes and the Gray Area Festival on art, AI and society.
orgs.description_zh: 旧金山的创意技术非营利艺术中心，设有孵化器、教育项目以及关注艺术、AI 与社会的 Gray Area Festival。

orgs.name: Guo Cheng
orgs.description: Chinese artist of science-fictional machines; his gif tutorial shows how to twist your face to escape detection, and The Net Wanderer tours the physical handshakes of the Chinese internet.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，创作科幻气质的机器装置；他以动图教程示范如何扭曲面部躲避人脸识别，《网络漫游者》则探访中国互联网物理层面的“握手”。
known_for: A Technique of Evading Face Detection (2020)
The Net Wanderer – A Tour of Suspended Handshakes (2020)

orgs.name: Guy Ben-Ary
orgs.description: Argentine-born Australian bio-artist whose works wire living neurons to machines: MEART drew with a robot arm, and cellF is a synthesizer played by neurons grown from his own cells.
orgs.description_zh: 阿根廷出生的澳大利亚生物艺术家，把活体神经元接入机器：MEART 通过机械臂作画，cellF 是由他自身细胞培养的神经元演奏的合成器。

orgs.name: Guy Hoffman
orgs.description: Israeli roboticist who draws on acting and animation to design non-humanoid social robots, from a robotic desk lamp to the soft, handcrafted Blossom.
orgs.description_zh: 以色列机器人学家，借鉴表演与动画设计非人形社交机器人，从机器人台灯到柔软手工的 Blossom。

orgs.name: Hans Moravec
orgs.description: Austrian-Canadian roboticist behind Moravec's paradox, the observation that what is easy for humans, like walking and seeing, is hardest for machines.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利裔加拿大机器人学家，提出“莫拉维克悖论”：对人类来说容易的事（如行走和观看），对机器来说却最难。

orgs.name: Harold Cohen
orgs.description: British painter who spent four decades developing AARON, a drawing program and robot that raised the question of whether a machine can make art, and of what the artist's role becomes.
orgs.description_zh: 英国画家，用四十余年开发绘画程序与机器人 AARON，追问机器能否创作艺术、艺术家的角色又会变成什么。

orgs.name: Harpreet Sareen
orgs.description: Indian-born designer-researcher of 'cyborg botany' whose Elowan is a plant that drives its robotic base towards light using its own electrical signals.
orgs.description_zh: 印度出生的设计师与研究者，提出“赛博植物学”；Elowan 是一株用自身电信号驱动机器人底座向光移动的植物。

orgs.name: Harun Farocki
orgs.description: German filmmaker who coined 'operative images', pictures made by machines for machines; the Eye/Machine trilogy examines smart-bomb cameras and industrial vision, founding the art of machine seeing.
orgs.description_zh: 德国电影人，提出“操作图像”（由机器生成、供机器使用的图像）；《眼睛/机器》三部曲审视智能炸弹摄像头与工业视觉，奠定了“机器之眼”艺术的基础。
known_for: Images of the World and the Inscription of War (1988)

orgs.name: Hasan Elahi
orgs.description: Bangladeshi-American artist who, after being wrongly placed on a US terrorist watch list, began publishing tens of thousands of images of his whereabouts, over-feeding the surveillance machine.
orgs.description_zh: 孟加拉裔美国艺术家，在被误列入美国恐怖分子观察名单后，开始公开发布数以万计记录自己行踪的图片，用过量信息“喂饱”监控机器。

orgs.name: Haus der Kulturen der Welt (HKW)
orgs.description: Berlin centre for contemporary arts and discourse. Long-term projects such as Technosphere (2015–19) examined computation, infrastructure and planetary technology.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林的当代艺术与思想中心。长期项目如《Technosphere》（2015–19）探讨计算、基础设施与行星尺度的技术。

orgs.name: Heather Dewey-Hagborg
orgs.description: American artist who 3D-prints portraits of strangers from DNA found in the street, exposing the fictions and biases of forensic phenotyping algorithms.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，从街头捡到的 DNA 推算并 3D 打印陌生人肖像，揭示法医表型推测算法中的虚构与偏见。

orgs.name: Heather Knight
orgs.description: American roboticist who studies charisma and social intelligence through robot performance, including a NAO robot doing stand-up comedy that adapts to audience laughter.
orgs.description_zh: 美国机器人学家，通过机器人表演研究魅力与社会智能，例如一台根据观众笑声调整段子的脱口秀 NAO 机器人。

orgs.name: HEK (House of Electronic Arts) Basel
orgs.description: Swiss centre for digital culture and new art forms. Its 2019 show Entangled Realities: Living with Artificial Intelligence brought together LAUREN, Tay's resurrection and Autonomous Trap 001.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士的数字文化与新艺术形式中心。2019 年的展览《Entangled Realities: Living with Artificial Intelligence》汇集了 LAUREN、被“复活”的 Tay 以及 Autonomous Trap 001 等作品。

orgs.name: Hiroshi Ishiguro
orgs.description: Japanese roboticist who builds lifelike androids, including a copy of himself, to study what 'human presence' is; his androids act in theatre, museums and films.
orgs.description_zh: 日本机器人学家，制造高度逼真的仿人机器人（包括他自己的复制品），以研究何为“人的存在感”；他的仿人机器人出现在剧场、博物馆与电影中。

orgs.name: Hiroshi Ishiguro Laboratories (ATR / Osaka University)
orgs.description: Hiroshi Ishiguro's android labs, which built the Geminoid copies, Erica and, with Kōdai-ji temple, the android Kannon Mindar. They are the main testbed for questions of presence and the uncanny valley.
orgs.description_zh: 石黑浩的仿真人实验室，制作了 Geminoid 系列复制人、Erica，并与高台寺合作打造仿真观音 Mindar，是“存在感”与恐怖谷问题的主要试验场。

orgs.name: Hito Steyerl
orgs.description: German artist and writer whose essay films and texts on poor images, robots and 'artificial stupidity' shaped how art thinks about computation, visibility and power.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家与作家，她关于“贫乏图像”、机器人与“人工愚蠢”的论文电影和文字，塑造了艺术界思考计算、可见性与权力的方式。
known_for: Medium Hot: Images in the Age of Heat (2025)

orgs.name: Ho Tzu Nyen
orgs.description: Singaporean artist whose CDOSEA is an algorithmically edited, infinitely recombining 'dictionary' of Southeast Asia, handing the ordering of history to a machine.
orgs.description_zh: 新加坡艺术家，《东南亚批判辞典》由算法无限重组剪辑，把历史的编排交给机器。
known_for: The Critical Dictionary of Southeast Asia (CDOSEA) (2017–)

orgs.name: Hod Lipson
orgs.description: Israeli-American roboticist at Columbia whose robots build models of their own bodies, an experimental approach to machine self-awareness.
orgs.description_zh: 哥伦比亚大学以色列裔美国机器人学家，他的机器人会为自己的身体建模，这是对机器自我意识的实验性探索。
known_for: Resilient Machines Through Continuous Self-Modeling (2006, with Josh Bongard and Victor Zykov)

orgs.name: Holly Herndon & Mat Dryhurst
orgs.description: American artist-musicians who raised the AI 'baby' Spawn with a vocal ensemble and released Holly+, a voice model anyone can sing through, raising questions of voice ownership and consent.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家与音乐人，与人声合唱团一起“养育” AI 宝宝 Spawn，并推出人人都能借用的声音模型 Holly+，引出声音归属与同意的问题。

orgs.name: Hsin-Chien Huang
orgs.description: Taiwanese new-media artist whose VR work The Eye and I, made with Jean-Michel Jarre, immerses viewers in a world of surveillance and watching machines.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾新媒体艺术家，与 Jean-Michel Jarre 合作的 VR 作品 The Eye and I 让观众沉浸于充满监控与“观看机器”的世界。
known_for: The Eye and I (2019, with Jean-Michel Jarre)
To the Moon (2018, with Laurie Anderson)

orgs.name: Hu Jieming
orgs.description: Shanghai pioneer of Chinese media art whose installations such as 100 Years in 1 Minute, a matrix of 1,440 boxes, compress history into machine-scaled time.
orgs.description_zh: 上海中国新媒体艺术先驱，其装置如由 1440 个盒子组成的《一分钟一百年》，把历史压缩进机器尺度的时间。

orgs.name: Huang Yi
orgs.description: Taiwanese choreographer who programs an industrial KUKA arm as his duet partner; Huang Yi & KUKA opened Ars Electronica 2013, toured widely and made a factory robot move with tenderness.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾编舞家，亲自为 KUKA 工业机械臂编程并与之共舞；《黄翊与库卡》曾为 2013 年林茨电子艺术节开幕并在各地巡演，让工厂机器人动得温柔。

orgs.name: Hubert Dreyfus
orgs.description: American philosopher who used Heidegger and Merleau-Ponty to argue that symbolic AI fails because intelligence depends on an embodied, situated way of being in the world.
orgs.description_zh: 美国哲学家，借海德格尔与梅洛-庞蒂论证符号 AI 注定失败，因为智能依赖具身、处境化的在世方式。

orgs.name: Hugh Herr
orgs.description: American engineer and climber, a double amputee, who leads MIT's Biomechatronics group and builds bionic limbs that the body feels as its own.
orgs.description_zh: 美国工程师与攀岩者，双腿截肢者，领导麻省理工学院生物机电一体化小组，研发能被身体感知为“自己的”仿生肢体。

orgs.name: Human AI Art Award
orgs.description: Annual award by the Art Collection Deutsche Telekom and Kunstmuseum Bonn for art that reflects on AI: Lauren Lee McCarthy's LAUREN (2024) and Nicolas Gourault's Unknown Label (2025).
orgs.description_zh: 德国电信艺术收藏与波恩艺术博物馆设立的年度奖，表彰反思 AI 的艺术：Lauren Lee McCarthy 的《LAUREN》（2024）与 Nicolas Gourault 的《Unknown Label》（2025）。

orgs.name: Humanoid Robotics Institute (Waseda University)
orgs.name_zh: 早稻田大学人形机器人研究所
orgs.description: Successor to Ichiro Kato's lab, which built WABOT-1 (1973), the first full-scale humanoid robot, and later emotional and musical humanoids such as the flute-playing WF series.
orgs.description_zh: 延续加藤一郎研究室的研究所，其前身制造了第一台全尺寸人形机器人 WABOT-1（1973），后来又开发了会表达情绪、会吹长笛的人形机器人。

orgs.name: IAMAS – Institute of Advanced Media Arts and Sciences
orgs.name_zh: 情报科学艺术大学院大学
orgs.description: Japanese graduate school for media arts and sciences in Gifu, whose alumni include many Japanese device, sensor and machine artists.
orgs.description_zh: 位于日本岐阜县的媒体艺术与科学研究生院，校友中有许多日本装置、传感与机器艺术家。

orgs.name: Ian Bogost
orgs.description: American philosopher and game designer whose Alien Phenomenology asks what it is like to be a thing, including a computer chip, a method close to machine phenomenology.
orgs.description_zh: 美国哲学家与游戏设计师，《异形现象学》追问作为一个物（包括一块计算机芯片）是什么感觉，这一方法接近机器现象学。
known_for: Alien Phenomenology, or What It's Like to Be a Thing (2012)

orgs.name: Ian Cheng
orgs.description: American artist of 'live simulations', AI-driven worlds that play themselves without end; BOB is an artificial lifeform with a personality that changes through its encounters.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，创作“实时模拟”：由 AI 驱动、永不重复的自演世界；BOB 是一个性格会随经历变化的人工生命体。

orgs.name: Ichiro Kato
orgs.description: Japanese engineer at Waseda University who built WABOT-1, the first full-scale humanoid robot, and WABOT-2, which read sheet music and played the organ.
orgs.description_zh: 早稻田大学日本工程师，研制了第一台全尺寸人形机器人 WABOT-1，以及能读谱弹奏风琴的 WABOT-2。

orgs.name: Ikegami Lab (University of Tokyo)
orgs.description: Takashi Ikegami's artificial life lab, which built the android Alter with Ishiguro's team to test whether spontaneous, life-like movement can emerge from neural networks.
orgs.description_zh: 池上高志的人工生命实验室，与石黑浩团队合作开发仿真人 Alter，探索神经网络能否产生自发的类生命运动。

orgs.name: iMAL
orgs.description: Brussels centre for digital cultures and technology with an exhibition space and fablab. It shows and produces work on algorithms, sensing and automation.
orgs.description_zh: 布鲁塞尔的数字文化与技术中心，设有展览空间和 fablab，展示并制作关于算法、感知与自动化的作品。

orgs.name: Impakt
orgs.description: Utrecht organisation for critical media culture, with a yearly festival, residencies and a centre for media culture. Its themes often address algorithms, surveillance and machine perception.
orgs.description_zh: 乌得勒支的批判性媒体文化机构，举办年度艺术节、驻留和媒体文化中心，主题常涉及算法、监控与机器感知。

orgs.name: Indigenous Protocol and AI Working Group
orgs.name_zh: 原住民协议与 AI 工作组
orgs.description: Working group whose 2020 position paper asked how Indigenous epistemologies can guide the design of AI and our relations with non-human kin, including machines.
orgs.description_zh: 该工作组 2020 年发表的立场文件探讨原住民认识论如何指导 AI 设计，以及我们与包括机器在内的非人亲属的关系。

orgs.name: Ine Gevers
orgs.description: Dutch curator whose large exhibition Robot Love (2018) asked whether robots can love and whether people can learn love from robots.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰策展人，其大型展览“机器人之爱”（2018）追问机器人能否去爱、人能否向机器人学习爱。

orgs.name: Institute of Network Cultures
orgs.description: Research centre at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences founded by Geert Lovink, publishing open-access books and readers on platforms, internet critique and AI.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Geert Lovink 在阿姆斯特丹应用科技大学创办的研究中心，出版关于平台、互联网批判与 AI 的开放获取书籍与读本。

orgs.name: Intelligent Instruments Lab
orgs.description: ERC-funded lab at the University of Iceland studying musical instruments that embed AI as creative partners and what such instruments mean for musicianship. Distinction in the Prix Ars Electronica AI in ART Award.
orgs.description_zh: 冰岛大学的 ERC 资助实验室，研究以 AI 为创作伙伴的乐器；曾获电子艺术大奖 AI in ART 类荣誉奖。

orgs.name: International Conference on Computational Creativity (ICCC)
orgs.description: Annual conference of the Association for Computational Creativity on whether and how machines can be creative, from art-making systems to evaluation.
orgs.description_zh: 计算创造力协会的年度会议，研究机器能否以及如何具有创造力，从创作系统到评估方法。

orgs.name: IRCAM
orgs.name_zh: 法国声学与音乐研究协调所
orgs.description: Paris institute for music and acoustic research founded by Pierre Boulez at the Centre Pompidou. Its research on machine listening, voice synthesis and AI co-improvisation (OMax, Somax) shapes human-machine music.
orgs.description_zh: 由皮埃尔·布列兹在蓬皮杜中心创办的音乐与声学研究所，其机器聆听、声音合成与 AI 共同即兴（OMax、Somax）研究塑造了人机音乐。

orgs.name: Irini Papadimitriou
orgs.description: Greek-British curator and creative director of FutureEverything, previously head of digital programmes at the V&A, whose programmes examine AI, data and the ethics of technology.
orgs.description_zh: 希腊裔英国策展人，FutureEverything 创意总监，曾任 V&A 数字项目负责人，她的项目审视 AI、数据与技术伦理。

orgs.name: Isaac Asimov
orgs.description: American writer whose Three Laws of Robotics became the popular template for machine ethics, and whose robot stories explore machines that reason their way into paradox and personhood.
orgs.description_zh: 美国作家，“机器人三定律”成为大众想象中机器伦理的模板，他的机器人故事探讨机器如何推理出悖论并走向人格。

orgs.name: ISEA International (International Symposium on Electronic Art)
orgs.description: The main academic symposium and exhibition for electronic art, held in a different city each year since 1988. Its online archive holds decades of papers on robot art, A-life and AI.
orgs.description_zh: 电子艺术领域最主要的学术研讨会与展览，自 1988 年起每年在不同城市举办，在线档案收录了数十年关于机器人艺术、人工生命与 AI 的论文。

orgs.name: J. C. R. Licklider
orgs.description: American psychologist and computer scientist whose Man-Computer Symbiosis imagined humans and computers thinking together, a founding vision of interactive computing.
orgs.description_zh: 美国心理学家与计算机科学家，《人机共生》设想人与计算机共同思考，是交互式计算的奠基性构想。
known_for: The Computer as a Communication Device (1968, with Robert Taylor)

orgs.name: Jack Burnham
orgs.description: American theorist and curator who predicted that sculpture would become intelligent, responsive systems, and curated Software (1970), a landmark exhibition of information technology.
orgs.description_zh: 美国理论家与策展人，预言雕塑将变成智能、响应式的系统，并策划了信息技术的里程碑展览“Software”（1970）。

orgs.name: Jacques de Vaucanson
orgs.description: French inventor (1709–1782) whose automata, a flute player that really blew into its flute and a duck that appeared to eat and digest, made the body itself a machine question.
orgs.description_zh: 法国发明家（1709–1782），他的自动机（真正吹奏长笛的吹笛人、看似会进食与消化的鸭子）把身体本身变成了机器问题。

orgs.name: Jaha Koo
orgs.description: South Korean theatre-maker whose Cuckoo shares the stage with three talking rice cookers, telling a story of loneliness and economic crisis in South Korea through household machines.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国剧场创作者，Cuckoo 与三台会说话的电饭煲同台，借家用机器讲述韩国经济危机中的孤独。

orgs.name: Jake Elwes
orgs.description: British artist who queers AI by retraining face models on drag performers; The Zizi Show is a deepfake cabaret where bodies break down at the edge of the dataset.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，用变装表演者的图像重新训练人脸模型来“酷儿化” AI；The Zizi Show 是一场深度伪造卡巴莱，身体在数据集的边缘崩解。

orgs.name: Jakob von Uexküll
orgs.description: Baltic-German biologist whose concept of the umwelt, the perceptual world each organism lives in, has become a key tool for imagining what the world is like for a machine.
orgs.description_zh: 波罗的海德裔生物学家，提出“环世界”：每个生物所栖居的知觉世界；这一概念已成为想象机器眼中世界的重要工具。
known_for: A Foray into the Worlds of Animals and Humans (1934)

orgs.name: James Bridle
orgs.description: British artist and writer whose Autonomous Trap 001 caught a self-driving car inside a circle of road markings, and whose books New Dark Age and Ways of Being rethink computation and non-human intelligence.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家与作家，Autonomous Trap 001 用一圈道路标线把自动驾驶汽车“困”在其中；著作《新黑暗时代》与《存在之道》重新思考计算与非人类智能。

orgs.name: James Seawright
orgs.description: American sculptor who built early responsive electronic sculptures in the 1960s, machines that scanned the room, sensed visitors and answered with light and movement.
orgs.description_zh: 美国雕塑家，1960 年代制作了早期的响应式电子雕塑：它们扫视空间、感知观众，并以灯光和动作回应。

orgs.name: Janelle Shane
orgs.description: American optics researcher whose blog AI Weirdness catalogues the strange failures of neural networks, making machine errors a way to understand how they learn.
orgs.description_zh: 美国光学研究者，博客 AI Weirdness 收集神经网络的各种怪异失误，把机器的错误变成理解其学习方式的途径。
known_for: You Look Like a Thing and I Love You (2019)

orgs.name: Japan Media Arts Festival
orgs.name_zh: 日本文化厅媒体艺术节
orgs.description: Festival and awards of Japan's Agency for Cultural Affairs (1997–2022) across art, entertainment, animation and manga. Sony's aibo and the robotic opera Pendulum Choir were among its prize-winners.
orgs.description_zh: 日本文化厅主办的艺术节与奖项（1997–2022），涵盖艺术、娱乐、动画与漫画。Sony 的 aibo 与机器人歌剧《Pendulum Choir》都曾获奖。

orgs.name: Jasia Reichardt
orgs.description: Polish-British curator and writer whose Cybernetic Serendipity at the ICA (1968) was the first major exhibition of computer and cybernetic art, with robots, drawing machines and Pask's Colloquy of Mobiles.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰裔英国策展人与作家，她在 ICA 策划的“控制论的意外发现”（1968）是第一场大型计算机与控制论艺术展，展出机器人、绘画机器与 Pask 的 Colloquy of Mobiles。

orgs.name: Jason Edward Lewis
orgs.description: Cherokee, Hawaiian and Samoan digital media scholar who leads the Indigenous Protocol and AI working group, asking how AI could be a relative within Indigenous knowledge systems.
orgs.description_zh: 拥有切罗基、夏威夷与萨摩亚血统的数字媒体学者，主持“原住民协议与 AI”工作组，探讨 AI 如何在原住民知识体系中成为“亲属”。
known_for: Making Kin with the Machines (2018, with Noelani Arista, Archer Pechawis and Suzanne Kite)
Indigenous Protocol and Artificial Intelligence Position Paper (2020)

orgs.name: Jean Tinguely
orgs.description: Swiss kinetic sculptor of absurd, self-destroying machines: Métamatics produced drawings on demand, and Homage to New York shook itself to pieces in the MoMA garden, making breakdown the work.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士动态雕塑家，以荒诞、自毁的机器闻名：Métamatics 可按需作画，Homage to New York 在 MoMA 花园里把自己震散成碎片，让崩坏本身成为作品。
known_for: Study for an End of the World No. 2 (1962)

orgs.name: Jenna Sutela
orgs.description: Finnish artist of more-than-human intelligence; in nimiia cétiï a neural network learns a 'Martian' language from recordings of a medium and the movements of bacteria.
orgs.description_zh: 芬兰艺术家，关注超越人类的智能；nimiia cétiï 中神经网络从灵媒的录音和细菌的运动中学习一种“火星语”。

orgs.name: Jennifer Rhee
orgs.description: American scholar whose The Robotic Imaginary shows how robots and AI are imagined through care and domestic labour, and whose humanity is measured against those it dehumanises.
orgs.description_zh: 美国学者，《机器人想象》揭示机器人与 AI 如何通过照护与家务劳动被想象，而其“人性”又以被非人化的人群为参照。
known_for: The Robotic Imaginary: The Human and the Price of Dehumanized Labor (2018)

orgs.name: Jennifer Walshe
orgs.description: Irish composer and vocalist who improvises with an AI trained on her own face and voice (ULTRACHUNK) and rewrites music history through machine-generated singing.
orgs.description_zh: 爱尔兰作曲家与歌者，与以她自己的面孔和声音训练的 AI 即兴合演（ULTRACHUNK），并借机器生成的歌声改写音乐史。
known_for: A Late Anthology of Early Music Vol. 1 (2020)

orgs.name: Jeu de Paume
orgs.description: Paris centre for photography and the image. The World Through AI (2025) split AI into analytical and generative systems and set artworks beside historical 'time capsules' of machine vision.
orgs.description_zh: 巴黎的摄影与图像艺术中心。展览《The World Through AI》（2025）将 AI 分为分析型与生成型两类，并把艺术作品与机器视觉史的“时间胶囊”并置。

orgs.name: Jiabao Li
orgs.description: Chinese artist-designer and founder of Reality Design Lab (UT Austin) whose works on AI, care and more-than-human perception include AI Mom, a machine that performs motherhood.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家与设计师，Reality Design Lab（德州大学奥斯汀分校）创始人，其作品探讨 AI、照护与超越人类的感知，包括扮演母亲角色的机器 AI Mom。

orgs.name: Jill Magid
orgs.description: American artist who in Evidence Locker asked Liverpool's CCTV operators to film her and wrote them love letters to retrieve the footage, making intimacy with the surveillance system.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，在 Evidence Locker 中请利物浦的监控操作员拍摄她，并以情书的形式申请调取录像，与监控系统建立一种亲密关系。

orgs.name: Jill Walker Rettberg
orgs.description: Norwegian scholar of digital culture who led the ERC Machine Vision project, including a database of art, games and narratives about machine vision.
orgs.description_zh: 挪威数字文化学者，主持 ERC“机器视觉”项目，建立了关于机器视觉的艺术、游戏与叙事数据库。
known_for: Machine Vision: How Algorithms Are Changing the Way We See the World (2023)

orgs.name: Joana Moll
orgs.description: Spanish artist-researcher who measures the material cost of the internet; CO2GLE shows the CO2 emitted every second by visits to google.com.
orgs.description_zh: 西班牙艺术家与研究者，测量互联网的物质成本；CO2GLE 实时显示每秒访问 google.com 所排放的二氧化碳。
known_for: The Hidden Life of an Amazon User (2019)
The Dating Brokers (2018, with Tactical Tech)

orgs.name: Joanna Zylinska
orgs.description: Polish-British media philosopher and artist whose AI Art separates machine-reflexive art from 'AI art' spectacle, and whose The Perception Machine rethinks vision after AI.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰裔英国媒介哲学家与艺术家，《AI 艺术》区分反思机器的艺术与“AI 艺术”奇观，《知觉机器》重新思考 AI 之后的视觉。
known_for: AI Art: Machine Visions and Warped Dreams (2020)

orgs.name: Joasia Krysa
orgs.description: Polish-British curator and scholar of 'exhibitionary AI' whose project The Next Biennial Should Be Curated by a Machine tests what happens when AI curates.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰裔英国策展人与学者，研究“展览性 AI”，其项目“下一届双年展应由机器策划”检验 AI 担任策展人会发生什么。
known_for: The Next Biennial Should Be Curated by a Machine (2021, with Leonardo Impett)

orgs.name: John McCarthy
orgs.description: American computer scientist who coined the term 'artificial intelligence' in the 1955 Dartmouth proposal, naming the field whose promises art keeps testing.
orgs.description_zh: 美国计算机科学家，在 1955 年达特茅斯会议提案中创造了“人工智能”一词，为这个艺术不断检验其承诺的领域命名。

orgs.name: John Searle
orgs.description: American philosopher whose Chinese Room argument claims that manipulating symbols is not understanding, a thought experiment revived by every generation of chatbots.
orgs.description_zh: 美国哲学家，“中文屋”论证主张操作符号并不等于理解，这一思想实验随每一代聊天机器人被重新提起。

orgs.name: Jon Rafman
orgs.description: Canadian artist whose The Nine Eyes of Google Street View collects scenes captured by Street View's indifferent cameras, a portrait of the world seen by a machine that does not care.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家，The Nine Eyes of Google Street View 收集街景车漠然拍下的画面，描绘一个被毫不在意的机器所看见的世界。
known_for: The Nine Eyes of Google Street View (2009–)

orgs.name: Jordan Wolfson
orgs.description: American artist whose animatronic (Female figure) dances before a mirror while tracking viewers' faces, a disturbing study of the gaze and the sexualised robot body.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，其动画机器人 (Female figure) 在镜前跳舞并以面部追踪凝视观众，是对凝视与被性化的机器人身体的不安研究。

orgs.name: Joseph Engelberger
orgs.description: American engineer called the 'father of robotics', whose Unimate arm began work at General Motors in 1961, the industrial robot that later became a material of art.
orgs.description_zh: 美国工程师，被称为“机器人之父”，他的 Unimate 机械臂于 1961 年进入通用汽车工作，这类工业机器人后来成为艺术的材料。

orgs.name: Joseph Weizenbaum
orgs.description: German-American computer scientist who built ELIZA, the first chatbot, then became a critic of AI after seeing people confide in it; the 'ELIZA effect' is named after it.
orgs.description_zh: 德裔美国计算机科学家，编写了第一个聊天机器人 ELIZA，看到人们向它倾诉后转而批判 AI；“ELIZA 效应”即由此得名。
orgs.based_zh: 剑桥，美国 / 柏林，德国

orgs.name: Josh Bongard
orgs.description: Canadian roboticist at the University of Vermont who, with Michael Levin, designed xenobots, living machines assembled from frog cells by an evolutionary algorithm.
orgs.description_zh: 佛蒙特大学加拿大机器人学家，与 Michael Levin 以进化算法设计出由青蛙细胞组装而成的“活机器”——异种机器人（xenobots）。
known_for: How the Body Shapes the Way We Think (2006, with Rolf Pfeifer)

orgs.name: Joy Buolamwini
orgs.description: Ghanaian-American-Canadian 'poet of code' whose white-mask experiment and Gender Shades study exposed face-analysis systems failing on dark-skinned women; founder of the Algorithmic Justice League.
orgs.description_zh: 加纳裔美国–加拿大籍“代码诗人”，她戴白色面具的实验和 Gender Shades 研究揭示了人脸分析系统对深肤色女性的失效；算法正义联盟创始人。

orgs.name: Julian Oliver
orgs.description: New Zealand 'critical engineer' who co-wrote the Critical Engineering Manifesto; his works open up networks and infrastructures, such as a cell tower disguised as an office printer.
orgs.description_zh: 新西兰“批判工程师”，《批判工程宣言》合著者；他的作品拆开网络与基础设施，例如伪装成办公室打印机的手机基站。

orgs.name: Julie Carpenter
orgs.description: American researcher whose study of bomb-disposal soldiers showed them naming, mourning and holding funerals for their robots, a key case of attachment to machines.
orgs.description_zh: 美国研究者，她对排爆士兵的研究显示，士兵们会为机器人取名、哀悼甚至举行葬礼，是人对机器产生依恋的关键案例。
known_for: Culture and Human-Robot Interaction in Militarized Spaces (2016)

orgs.name: Julien Prévieux
orgs.description: French artist whose What Shall We Do Next? has dancers perform gestures patented by tech companies, showing how bodies are measured and scripted by devices; Prix Marcel Duchamp 2014.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，What Shall We Do Next? 让舞者表演被科技公司申请专利的手势，揭示身体如何被设备测量与编写；2014 年马塞尔·杜尚奖得主。

orgs.name: Julius Popp
orgs.description: German artist whose bit.fall writes words scraped from news sites in falling water drops, and whose small self-learning robots explore their own bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，bit.fall 用下落的水滴写出从新闻网站抓取的词语，他的小型自学习机器人则在探索自己的身体。

orgs.name: Justine Emard
orgs.description: French artist whose Co(AI)xistence films dancer Mirai Moriyama learning to communicate with Alter, the learning android by Ikegami and Ishiguro, through gesture and voice.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，Co(AI)xistence 拍摄舞者森山未来与池上高志、石黑浩的学习型仿人机器人 Alter 通过动作与声音相互沟通。

orgs.name: K Allado-McDowell
orgs.description: American writer and founder of Google's Artists + Machine Intelligence programme; Pharmako-AI, co-written with GPT-3, is one of the first books written with a language model.
orgs.description_zh: 美国作家，谷歌“艺术家 + 机器智能”项目创始人；与 GPT-3 合写的《Pharmako-AI》是最早与语言模型共同写成的书之一。

orgs.name: Kacie Kinzer
orgs.description: American designer whose Tweenbots, smiling cardboard robots that could only roll straight ahead, crossed Manhattan parks by relying on strangers' kindness to redirect them.
orgs.description_zh: 美国设计师，她的 Tweenbots 是只会直线前进的微笑纸板机器人，全靠陌生人的善意转向，才穿过了曼哈顿的公园。

orgs.name: KADIST
orgs.description: Nonprofit contemporary art organisation that collects and commissions globally. Its exhibition Apophenia, Interruptions: Artists and Artificial Intelligence at Work (2024) looked at pattern-finding and misrecognition.
orgs.description_zh: 在全球收藏和委托作品的非营利当代艺术机构。展览《Apophenia, Interruptions：工作中的艺术家与人工智能》（2024）关注模式识别与误认。
orgs.based_zh: 巴黎，法国 / 旧金山，美国

orgs.name: Kaname Hayashi
orgs.description: Japanese engineer who led Pepper's development at SoftBank and then founded GROOVE X to make LOVOT, a warm, useless robot designed only to be loved.
orgs.description_zh: 日本工程师，曾主导软银 Pepper 的开发，之后创立 GROOVE X 推出 LOVOT：一台温暖、“无用”、只为被爱而设计的机器人。

orgs.name: Kapelica Gallery / Kersnikova Institute
orgs.description: Ljubljana gallery for 'investigative' art, including robotics, bio art and body-machine performance (Stelarc, Špela Petrič). The Kersnikova Institute also runs the RAMPA and BioTehna labs.
orgs.description_zh: 卢布尔雅那的“探究型”艺术画廊，关注机器人、生物艺术与身体–机器表演（Stelarc、Špela Petrič 等），Kersnikova 研究所还运营 RAMPA 与 BioTehna 实验室。
orgs.based_zh: 卢布尔雅那，斯洛文尼亚

orgs.name: Karel Čapek
orgs.description: Czech writer whose play R.U.R. introduced the word 'robot' (from robota, forced labour), framing the machine from the start as a worker who may revolt.
orgs.description_zh: 捷克作家，剧作《罗素姆万能机器人》引入“robot”一词（源自意为强迫劳动的 robota），从一开始就把机器设想为可能反抗的劳动者。

orgs.name: Karen Palmer
orgs.description: British 'storyteller from the future' whose interactive films read the viewer's facial emotions to steer the plot, so a police encounter plays out differently depending on how calm you look.
orgs.description_zh: 英国“来自未来的叙事者”，她的互动电影通过读取观众表情来推动剧情：与警察的对峙会根据你看起来是否冷静而走向不同结局。

orgs.name: Karl Sims
orgs.description: American computer graphics artist whose Evolved Virtual Creatures evolved their own bodies and gaits in simulation, and whose Galápagos let visitors act as the selection pressure for artificial organisms.
orgs.description_zh: 美国计算机图形艺术家，Evolved Virtual Creatures 让虚拟生物在模拟中演化出自己的身体与步态，Galápagos 则让观众充当人工生物的选择压力。

orgs.name: Katarzyna Nowaczyk-Basińska
orgs.description: Polish researcher of digital immortality at the Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence, studying how cultures imagine and regulate life after death through AI.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰数字永生研究者，任职于剑桥利弗休姆未来智能中心，研究不同文化如何借 AI 想象并规范死后的生命。
known_for: Griefbots, Deadbots, Postmortem Avatars (2024, with Tomasz Hollanek)

orgs.name: Kate Crawford
orgs.description: Australian scholar whose Atlas of AI describes AI as an extractive industry of minerals, labour and data, and whose collaborations with Joler and Paglen became artworks.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚学者，《AI 地图集》把 AI 描述为攫取矿产、劳动与数据的产业，她与 Joler 和 Paglen 的合作本身也成为艺术作品。
known_for: Anatomy of an AI System (2018, with Vladan Joler)
orgs.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 悉尼，澳大利亚

orgs.name: Kate Darling
orgs.description: American researcher at MIT Media Lab who studies why people empathise with robots, and proposes animals rather than humans as the model for our relationships with machines.
orgs.description_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室研究者，研究人为何会对机器人产生同理心，主张以动物而非人类作为我们与机器关系的模型。
known_for: Extending Legal Protection to Social Robots (2012)

orgs.name: Kate Devlin
orgs.description: British scholar at King's College London whose Turned On examines sex robots and intimacy with machines beyond moral panic.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦国王学院英国学者，《开机》超越道德恐慌，审视性爱机器人与人机亲密关系。
known_for: Turned On: Science, Sex and Robots (2018)

orgs.name: Kathleen Richardson
orgs.description: British anthropologist of robotics who studied roboticists at MIT and launched the Campaign Against Sex Robots, arguing that robots mirror human attachment and its failures.
orgs.description_zh: 英国机器人人类学家，曾在 MIT 研究机器人学家，并发起“反对性爱机器人运动”，主张机器人映照着人类依恋及其失败。
known_for: An Anthropology of Robots and AI (2015)

orgs.name: Kathy Rae Huffman
orgs.description: American curator and pioneer of video and net art, and of early cyberfeminist networks, whose work since the 1970s has tracked the arrival of new media machines in art.
orgs.description_zh: 美国策展人、录像与网络艺术先驱，也是早期赛博女性主义网络的推动者，自 1970 年代起追踪新媒介机器进入艺术。
known_for: Video art curator, Long Beach Museum of Art (1978–84)

orgs.name: Kazuhiko Hachiya
orgs.description: Japanese media artist whose Inter Dis-Communication Machine swaps the sight and sound of two people through head-mounted displays, so each lives inside the other's perception.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，Inter Dis-Communication Machine 通过头戴显示器交换两个人的视觉与听觉，让彼此活在对方的知觉之中。

orgs.name: Keiichi Matsuda
orgs.description: British-Japanese designer whose film Hyper-Reality shows a Medellín bus ride in a city saturated by augmented-reality ads, gamification and assistant agents.
orgs.description_zh: 英日混血设计师，短片 Hyper-Reality 呈现麦德林的一段公交旅程，城市被增强现实广告、游戏化与助手智能体全面淹没。

orgs.name: Keiichiro Shibuya
orgs.description: Japanese composer whose android opera Scary Beauty has the android Alter 3 conduct an orchestra and sing, with tempo it decides itself.
orgs.description_zh: 日本作曲家，其仿人机器人歌剧《Scary Beauty》由 Alter 3 自行决定速度来指挥乐团并演唱。

orgs.name: Kelly Dobson
orgs.description: American artist of 'machine therapy': to make Blendie spin, you must growl at a blender in its own pitch, an exercise in empathy with household machines.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，提出“机器疗愈”：要让 Blendie 转起来，你得用它的音高向搅拌机低吼，这是一场与家用机器共情的练习。

orgs.name: Ken Feingold
orgs.description: American artist whose talking animatronic heads converse with each other in synthetic speech; in If/Then two identical heads debate whether they exist.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，他的会说话的动画机器头像以合成语音彼此交谈；If/Then 中两颗相同的头争论自己是否存在。

orgs.name: Ken Goldberg
orgs.description: American roboticist and artist whose Telegarden let thousands of internet users tend a real garden through an industrial robot arm, testing trust and presence at a distance.
orgs.description_zh: 美国机器人学家与艺术家，Telegarden 让成千上万网友通过工业机械臂远程照料一座真实花园，检验远距离的信任与在场感。
known_for: The Robot and the Garden (2000, ed.)

orgs.name: Kenji Yanobe
orgs.description: Japanese artist of survival machines and giant robots, from radiation suits after Chernobyl to post-Fukushima figures of hope.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家，创作生存机器与巨型机器人，从切尔诺贝利之后的防辐射服到福岛核事故之后象征希望的形象。

orgs.name: Kenneth Colby
orgs.description: American psychiatrist who wrote PARRY, a chatbot simulating a paranoid patient, which in 1972 'met' ELIZA for a machine-to-machine therapy session.
orgs.description_zh: 美国精神科医生，编写了模拟偏执症患者的聊天机器人 PARRY，1972 年它与 ELIZA“见面”，进行了一场机器对机器的心理治疗。

orgs.name: Kenneth Rinaldo
orgs.description: American artist of artificial life and interspecies robotics: in Autopoiesis, grapevine-armed robots sense visitors and each other, and in Augmented Fish Reality fish steer their own robotic bowls.
orgs.description_zh: 美国人工生命与跨物种机器人艺术家：Autopoiesis 中葡萄藤般的机械臂能感知观众和彼此，Augmented Fish Reality 让鱼驾驶自己的机器人鱼缸。

orgs.name: Kerstin Dautenhahn
orgs.description: German roboticist whose child-sized, minimally expressive robot KASPAR is used with autistic children, showing that simplified robot faces can support social interaction.
orgs.description_zh: 德国机器人学家，她的儿童大小、表情简化的机器人 KASPAR 被用于自闭症儿童，证明简化的机器人面孔能支持社交互动。

orgs.name: Kevin Warwick
orgs.description: British engineer who implanted an RFID chip (1998) and then a 100-electrode array in his arm (2002), linking his nervous system to a robot hand and to his wife's implant.
orgs.description_zh: 英国工程师，1998 年在手臂植入 RFID 芯片，2002 年又植入 100 电极阵列，把自己的神经系统与机械手以及妻子的植入物相连。

orgs.name: KIKK Festival
orgs.description: International festival of digital and creative cultures in Namur, with talks and installations by designers and artists working on AI, robots and speculative futures.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时那慕尔的国际数字与创意文化节，邀请从事 AI、机器人与推测未来的设计师与艺术家进行讲座和装置展示。

orgs.name: KIM – AI and Media Philosophy (HfG Karlsruhe)
orgs.name_zh: 卡尔斯鲁厄设计学院 AI 与媒体哲学研究组
orgs.description: Research group on artificial intelligence and media philosophy at the Karlsruhe University of Arts and Design, known for its work on the social history of AI and the Nooscope diagram.
orgs.description_zh: 卡尔斯鲁厄设计学院的人工智能与媒体哲学研究组，以 AI 社会史研究和《Nooscope》图谱闻名。

orgs.name: Knowing Machines
orgs.description: Research project tracing the histories, practices and politics of how machine learning systems are trained to interpret the world, including Models All the Way Down, a visual investigation of the LAION-5B dataset.
orgs.description_zh: 研究机器学习系统如何被训练去解释世界的历史、实践与政治，包括对 LAION-5B 数据集的视觉调查《Models All the Way Down》。

orgs.name: Kraftwerk
orgs.description: German electronic band founded in 1970 whose robot doubles and 'man-machine' aesthetic made the fusion of musician and machine a pop image.
orgs.description_zh: 1970 年成立的德国电子乐队，其机器人替身与“人机”美学让音乐人与机器的融合成为流行文化形象。

orgs.name: Kris Verdonck
orgs.description: Belgian director whose machine-theatre works blur actor and object, like the flailing industrial machine of Dancer #1 and the dying performers of END.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时导演，其机器剧场模糊演员与物体的界限，例如 Dancer #1 中疯狂甩动的工业机器和 END 中走向终结的表演者。

orgs.name: Kyle McDonald
orgs.description: American artist of computer vision and code who turns the camera back on its users; Facework is a game where you apply for gig jobs by performing the face a classifier wants to see.
orgs.description_zh: 美国计算机视觉与代码艺术家，把镜头转向使用者；Facework 是一款游戏：你必须摆出分类器想要的表情，才能获得零工工作。

orgs.name: Kyriaki Goni
orgs.description: Greek artist whose Data Garden imagines data stored in plant DNA, and whose Not Allowed For Algorithmic Audiences explores the smart speakers listening in on our homes.
orgs.description_zh: 希腊艺术家，Data Garden 想象把数据储存在植物 DNA 中，Not Allowed For Algorithmic Audiences 探讨在家中“偷听”的智能音箱。

orgs.name: LABoral Centro de Arte y Creación Industrial
orgs.name_zh: LABoral 艺术与工业创造中心
orgs.description: Spanish art centre for art, science, technology and industrial creation, set in a former labour university. Its exhibitions and production labs address automation, labour and machines.
orgs.description_zh: 位于西班牙希洪、由昔日劳工大学改建的艺术中心，聚焦艺术、科学、技术与工业创造，其展览与制作实验室关注自动化、劳动与机器。

orgs.name: LACMA Art + Technology Lab
orgs.name_zh: 洛杉矶郡艺术博物馆艺术与技术实验室
orgs.description: Grant and residency programme that revives LACMA's 1967–71 Art and Technology programme, pairing artists with tech companies on projects about AI, robotics and sensing.
orgs.description_zh: 延续洛杉矶郡艺术博物馆 1967–71 年“艺术与技术”项目的资助与驻留计划，让艺术家与科技公司合作开展 AI、机器人与感知相关项目。

orgs.name: Laetitia Sonami
orgs.description: French-born composer who performed with the Lady's Glove, a sensor glove, and later Spring Spyre, an instrument trained with machine learning (Wekinator) to respond to her gestures.
orgs.description_zh: 法国出生的作曲家，以传感手套 Lady's Glove 演出，后来又创作了借 Wekinator 机器学习训练、会回应她手势的乐器 Spring Spyre。

orgs.name: LAS Art Foundation
orgs.description: Berlin foundation that commissions large works at the edge of art, science and technology, such as Lawrence Lek's NOX (2023), a rehab centre for sentient self-driving cars.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林的艺术基金会，委托位于艺术、科学与技术交界处的大型作品，如 Lawrence Lek 的《NOX》（2023），一个为有感知的自动驾驶汽车设立的康复中心。

orgs.name: Lauren Lee McCarthy
orgs.description: American artist who performs the smart-home assistant herself: in LAUREN she watched over and served people's homes remotely 24/7, exposing the intimacy, labour and control inside 'AI'.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，亲自扮演智能家居助手：在 LAUREN 中她远程全天候观察并服务他人的家，揭示“AI”之中的亲密、劳动与控制。

orgs.name: Laurence Bertrand Dorléac
orgs.description: French art historian who co-curated Artists & Robots at the Grand Palais (2018), a survey of robot and algorithmic art from Schöffer to today.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术史学者，与 Jérôme Neutres 共同策划巴黎大皇宫“艺术家与机器人”（2018），梳理从 Schöffer 至今的机器人与算法艺术。
known_for: Artists & Robots (Grand Palais, 2018, with Jérôme Neutres)

orgs.name: Lawrence Abu Hamdan
orgs.description: Jordanian-British 'private ear' whose works examine accent analysis in asylum cases and the forensics of listening, showing how voices become evidence for machines and states.
orgs.description_zh: 约旦裔英国“私人耳朵”，研究庇护审查中的口音分析与听觉取证，揭示声音如何成为机器与国家的证据。

orgs.name: Lawrence Lek
orgs.description: Malaysian-Chinese British artist of 'Sinofuturism' whose films and games follow AI characters: a satellite that wants to be an artist, a self-driving car in therapy, a retired care robot.
orgs.description_zh: 马来西亚华裔英国艺术家，提出“中华未来主义”；他的影片与游戏讲述 AI 角色：想成为艺术家的卫星、接受心理治疗的自动驾驶汽车、退役的照护机器人。
known_for: Guanyin: Confessions of a Former Care Robot (2024)

orgs.name: Lee Bul
orgs.description: South Korean artist whose headless, limbless Cyborg sculptures fuse the idealised female body with machine armour, questioning technology's fantasies of perfection.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国艺术家，她的无头断肢“赛博格”雕塑把理想化的女性身体与机械盔甲融为一体，质疑技术对完美的幻想。

orgs.name: Legacy Russell
orgs.description: American curator and writer whose Glitch Feminism treats the glitch, the machine error, as a site of refusal for queer and Black bodies online; executive director of The Kitchen.
orgs.description_zh: 美国策展人与作家，《故障女性主义》把机器故障视为网络中酷儿与黑人身体的拒绝场域；现任 The Kitchen 执行总监。

orgs.name: Leonardo (MIT Press) / Leonardo ISAST
orgs.description: Journal of arts, sciences and technology founded by kinetic artist Frank Malina, where artists such as Eduardo Kac and Simon Penny published foundational texts on robotic art. Leonardo also runs a book series and the LASER talks.
orgs.description_zh: 由动态艺术家 Frank Malina 创办的艺术、科学与技术期刊，Eduardo Kac、Simon Penny 等人在此发表了机器人艺术的奠基文本；Leonardo 还出版丛书并举办 LASER 讲座。
orgs.based: Cambridge, MA, US / San Francisco, US
orgs.based_zh: 剑桥（马萨诸塞州） / 旧金山，美国

orgs.name: Leonel Moura
orgs.description: Portuguese artist whose swarms of small robots paint by reacting to each other's marks, a test of emergent, machine-made art without a human composer.
orgs.description_zh: 葡萄牙艺术家，他的小型机器人群体通过回应彼此的笔迹作画，实验无需人类构图的涌现式机器艺术。

orgs.name: Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence
orgs.name_zh: 剑桥大学利弗休姆未来智能中心
orgs.description: Cambridge research centre on the long-term impact of AI. Its AI Narratives and Global AI Narratives projects study how stories shape what we expect of machines, and it has researched griefbots and 'digital afterlife' ethics.
orgs.description_zh: 剑桥大学研究 AI 长期影响的中心。其“AI 叙事”与“全球 AI 叙事”项目研究故事如何塑造我们对机器的期待，也研究了哀悼机器人与“数字来世”的伦理。

orgs.name: LG Guggenheim Award
orgs.description: US$100,000 award for technology-based art from the LG Guggenheim Art & Technology Initiative. Winners: Stephanie Dinkins (2023), Shu Lea Cheang (2024), Ayoung Kim (2025) and Trevor Paglen (2026).
orgs.description_zh: LG 古根海姆艺术与技术计划设立的 10 万美元技术艺术奖。获奖者：Stephanie Dinkins（2023）、郑淑丽（2024）、Ayoung Kim（2025）与 Trevor Paglen（2026）。

orgs.name: Li Liao
orgs.description: Chinese performance artist who worked 45 days on a Foxconn assembly line to earn the iPad Mini he then exhibited, embodying the human labour inside consumer machines.
orgs.description_zh: 中国行为艺术家，在富士康流水线工作 45 天，用工资买下自己组装的 iPad Mini 并展出，亲身体现消费电子机器中的人类劳动。

orgs.name: Liam Young
orgs.description: Australian speculative architect and filmmaker whose Where the City Can't See is shot entirely through laser scanners, showing a city as a self-driving car perceives it.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚思辨建筑师与电影人，Where the City Can't See 全片以激光扫描仪拍摄，呈现自动驾驶汽车眼中的城市。

orgs.name: Lilly Irani
orgs.description: American scholar and co-creator of Turkopticon, a tool that let Amazon Mechanical Turk workers rate employers, making the labour behind AI visible and organised.
orgs.description_zh: 美国学者，Turkopticon 共同创建者：让亚马逊 Mechanical Turk 工人为雇主评分，使 AI 背后的劳动变得可见并组织起来。

orgs.name: Liu Chuang
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose films trace the material and human underside of digital economies, from bitcoin mines in Inner Mongolia to lithium lakes and the linguistic data of minority voices.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，他的影片追踪数字经济物质与人的另一面：从内蒙古的比特币矿场到锂湖，再到少数民族声音被采集成语言数据。
known_for: Bitcoin Mining and Field Recordings of Ethnic Minorities (2018)

orgs.name: Logic(s)
orgs.description: Magazine about technology and its politics, relaunched as Logic(s) with a focus on Black, Asian and Indigenous perspectives; issues on intelligence, bodies and supply chains.
orgs.description_zh: 关于技术及其政治的杂志，后改版为 Logic(s)，聚焦黑人、亚裔与原住民视角，出版过“智能”“身体”“供应链”等专刊。

orgs.name: Louis-Philippe Demers
orgs.description: Canadian maker of machine performers whose The Blind Robot gently touches a visitor's face to 'see' them, and whose Inferno straps audiences into exoskeletons that move them.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大机器表演者创作者：The Blind Robot 轻抚观众的脸来“看见”对方，Inferno 则让观众穿上外骨骼、被机器驱动。
known_for: La Cour des Miracles (1997, with Bill Vorn)
The Multiple Bodies of the Machine (book)
orgs.based_zh: 魁北克，加拿大 / 新加坡

orgs.name: Louise Amoore
orgs.description: British political geographer whose Cloud Ethics argues that algorithms make ethical and political decisions through their attributes and thresholds, and must be held accountable as such.
orgs.description_zh: 英国政治地理学者，《云伦理》主张算法通过其属性与阈值做出伦理与政治决定，因此必须为此负责。
known_for: Cloud Ethics: Algorithms and the Attributes of Ourselves and Others (2020)

orgs.name: Lu Yang
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose genderless digital avatar DOKU, motion-captured from the artist, is reincarnated across six realms, blending neuroscience, Buddhism and game engines.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，以自身动作捕捉生成的无性别数字化身 DOKU 在六道中轮回，融合神经科学、佛学与游戏引擎。

orgs.name: Luciana Parisi
orgs.description: Italian-British philosopher of computation who argues that algorithms think in their own, alien way, through incomputable and indeterminate processes.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利裔英国计算哲学家，主张算法以其自身陌异的方式思考，依靠不可计算与不确定的过程。

orgs.name: Lucy Suchman
orgs.description: American anthropologist of technology who showed at Xerox PARC that action is situated rather than planned, and later critiqued humanlike robots and autonomous weapons.
orgs.description_zh: 美国技术人类学家，在施乐帕克研究中心揭示人的行动是情境性的而非按计划执行，之后批判类人机器人与自主武器。

orgs.name: Lumen Prize
orgs.description: International prize for art made with technology, with an AI award since 2018 (e.g. Lichtsuchende, a light-seeking robot society). Much of it is generative, so its winners need case-by-case selection.
orgs.description_zh: 面向技术艺术的国际奖项，2018 年起设 AI 奖（如光敏机器人群落《Lichtsuchende》）。获奖作品多为生成式，需逐一甄选。

orgs.name: Lydia H. Liu
orgs.description: Chinese-American theorist of media and translation whose The Freudian Robot reads cybernetics, information theory and the uncanny as a shared history of the human–machine unconscious.
orgs.description_zh: 华裔美国媒介与翻译理论家，《弗洛伊德机器人》把控制论、信息论与“怪怖”读作人机无意识的共同历史。
known_for: The Freudian Robot: Digital Media and the Future of the Unconscious (2010)

orgs.name: Lynn Hershman Leeson
orgs.description: American artist who, after inventing the fictional persona Roberta Breitmore, built Agent Ruby, a web chatbot that learned from visitors, anticipating today's conversational AI and its identities.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，在虚构人格 Roberta Breitmore 之后创作了会向访客学习的网页聊天机器人 Agent Ruby，预见了今天的对话式 AI 及其身份问题。

orgs.name: M. Beatrice Fazi
orgs.description: Italian philosopher at Sussex whose work on computational aesthetics and explainability asks what it means that deep learning represents the world in ways humans cannot follow.
orgs.description_zh: 萨塞克斯大学的意大利哲学家，研究计算美学与可解释性，追问深度学习以人类无法追随的方式表征世界意味着什么。
known_for: Beyond Human: Deep Learning, Explainability and Representation (2021)

orgs.name: Machine Listening
orgs.description: Platform for research and artistic practice on the politics of machine listening, voice assistants and audio surveillance, with an open curriculum.
orgs.description_zh: 关于机器聆听、语音助手与音频监控政治的研究与艺术实践平台，并提供开放课程。

orgs.name: Machine Vision in Art, Games and Narratives (database)
orgs.name_zh: 艺术、游戏与叙事中的机器视觉数据库
orgs.description: ERC project at the University of Bergen whose open database codes about 500 artworks, games and stories as 'situations' of who does what to whom with which machine-vision technology.
orgs.description_zh: 卑尔根大学的 ERC 项目，其开放数据库将约 500 件艺术作品、游戏与叙事编码为“情境”：谁借助何种机器视觉技术对谁做了什么。

orgs.name: Madeline Gannon
orgs.description: American 'robot tamer' whose studio ATONATON turns industrial robots into curious creatures: Mimus, a 1,200 kg ABB arm at the London Design Museum, tracked and approached visitors like an animal.
orgs.description_zh: 美国“机器人驯兽师”，工作室 ATONATON 把工业机器人变成好奇的生物：伦敦设计博物馆中 1200 公斤的 ABB 机械臂 Mimus 会像动物一样追踪、靠近观众。

orgs.name: Maholo Uchida
orgs.description: Japanese curator at Miraikan (National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation, Tokyo), where she worked on android exhibitions with Hiroshi Ishiguro, and co-curator of AI: More than Human.
orgs.description_zh: 日本国立科学未来馆（东京）策展人，曾与石黑浩合作仿人机器人展项，也是“AI：超越人类”的联合策展人。
known_for: AI: More than Human (Barbican, 2019, with Suzanne Livingston)

orgs.name: Mahwish Chishty
orgs.description: Pakistani-American artist who paints US military drones in the ornate style of Pakistani truck art, confronting the machine gaze over the Afghanistan–Pakistan border.
orgs.description_zh: 巴基斯坦裔美国艺术家，用巴基斯坦卡车装饰艺术的华丽风格描绘美军无人机，直面阿富汗—巴基斯坦边境上空的机器凝视。

orgs.name: Maja Matarić
orgs.description: Serbian-American roboticist at USC who defined socially assistive robotics, robots that help people through social rather than physical interaction, in stroke rehabilitation, autism and elder care.
orgs.description_zh: 南加州大学塞尔维亚裔美国机器人学家，定义了“社会辅助机器人”：通过社交而非身体接触帮助中风康复、自闭症与老年照护中的人们。
known_for: Socially assistive robotics (2005, with David Feil-Seifer)

orgs.name: MAK – Museum of Applied Arts, Vienna
orgs.name_zh: 维也纳应用艺术博物馆
orgs.description: Design museum that hosts the Vienna Biennale for Change. It co-produced Hello, Robot (2017) and staged Uncanny Values: Artificial Intelligence & You (2019), linking design and critical AI.
orgs.description_zh: 维也纳的设计博物馆，维也纳变革双年展的主办方。它参与制作《Hello, Robot》（2017），并举办《Uncanny Values: Artificial Intelligence & You》（2019），将设计与批判性 AI 联系起来。

orgs.name: Manu Luksch
orgs.description: Austrian-born artist whose film Faceless is made entirely of her own CCTV footage obtained under data-protection law, in which the faces of others are erased.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利出生的艺术家，影片 Faceless 完全由她依据数据保护法调取的自己的监控录像组成，画面中其他人的脸均被抹去。

orgs.name: Marc Böhlen
orgs.description: German-American artist-engineer whose machines test the limits of machine perception, such as Amy and Klara, two robotic boxes that read magazines and argue with each other in synthetic speech.
orgs.description_zh: 德裔美国艺术家与工程师，他的机器检验机器感知的边界，例如 Amy and Klara：两个会读杂志、用合成语音互相争吵的机器盒子。

orgs.name: Marc Raibert
orgs.description: American roboticist who founded Boston Dynamics, whose legged robots and viral videos of them being kicked and dancing shaped public feelings about robot bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 美国机器人学家，创立波士顿动力；其腿足机器人以及它们被踢、跳舞的爆红视频，塑造了公众对机器人身体的感受。

orgs.name: Marcel·lí Antúnez Roca
orgs.description: Catalan performer who in Epizoo let audiences move his nose, mouth and buttocks via a pneumatic exoskeleton controlled by a mouse, an early work on the body under machine control.
orgs.description_zh: 加泰罗尼亚表演艺术家，在 Epizoo 中让观众用鼠标通过气动外骨骼操控他的鼻子、嘴和臀部，是关于身体被机器控制的早期作品。

orgs.name: Marco Donnarumma
