orgs.description: Italian performer and researcher who fuses bodies with AI-driven prosthetics; his robot Amygdala learns to move by 'feeling' human skin and ritually cuts its own membrane.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利表演者与研究者，把身体与 AI 驱动的义体融合；他的机器人 Amygdala 通过“感受”人类皮肤学习动作，并仪式性地割开自己的外皮。

orgs.name: Mari Velonaki
orgs.description: Greek-Australian artist and founder of UNSW's Creative Robotics Lab; in Fish-Bird two wheelchairs 'in love' write handwritten notes to visitors, building intimacy through printed letters and movement.
orgs.description_zh: 希腊裔澳大利亚艺术家，新南威尔士大学创意机器人实验室创始人；Fish-Bird 中两把“相爱”的轮椅给观众打印手写体小字条，用动作与文字建立亲密。

orgs.name: Mariela Yeregui
orgs.description: Argentine artist whose small robots in Proxemia approach and retreat from each other and from visitors, making distance and touch the subject of machine behaviour.
orgs.description_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，Proxemia 中的小机器人彼此靠近又后退，也与观众保持距离，让距离与触碰成为机器行为的主题。
orgs.based_zh: 布宜诺斯艾利斯，阿根廷

orgs.name: Mark Coeckelbergh
orgs.description: Belgian philosopher of technology who argues that the moral status of robots emerges from relations and appearances rather than from inner properties.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时技术哲学家，主张机器人的道德地位来自关系与显现，而非其内在属性。

orgs.name: Mark Pauline
orgs.description: Founder of Survival Research Laboratories, whose spectacles set salvaged, remote-controlled war machines and robots against each other, staging machine violence as industrial culture.
orgs.description_zh: Survival Research Laboratories 创始人，用回收拼装的遥控战斗机器与机器人互相攻击，把机器暴力搬上舞台，映照工业文明。
known_for: A Calculated Forecast of Ultimate Doom (1988)

orgs.name: Martine Syms
orgs.description: American artist whose Mythiccbeing is a chatbot avatar of a self-absorbed Black woman, 'Teeny', turning AI personas into a critique of how Black women are scripted.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，Mythiccbeing 是一个自我中心的黑人女性聊天化身“Teeny”，借 AI 人格批判黑人女性如何被编写。

orgs.name: Marvin Minsky
orgs.description: American AI pioneer and co-founder of the MIT AI Lab whose The Society of Mind and The Emotion Machine model minds as societies of simple agents.
orgs.description_zh: 美国人工智能先驱、MIT 人工智能实验室联合创始人，《心智社会》与《情感机器》把心智描述为由简单智能体组成的社会。

orgs.name: Mary L. Gray
orgs.description: American anthropologist whose Ghost Work, with Siddharth Suri, documents the hidden on-demand workers who label, moderate and correct the output of 'automated' systems.
orgs.description_zh: 美国人类学家，与 Siddharth Suri 合著《幽灵工作》，记录为“自动化”系统做标注、审核与纠错的隐形按需工人。

orgs.name: Masahiro Mori
orgs.description: Japanese roboticist whose 1970 essay on the 'uncanny valley' described the unease caused by almost-human machines, and whose The Buddha in the Robot finds Buddha-nature in machines.
orgs.description_zh: 日本机器人学家，1970 年提出“恐怖谷”，描述近乎人类的机器引发的不安；其《机器人中的佛陀》认为机器也具有佛性。

orgs.name: Masakhane
orgs.description: Grassroots research community building natural language processing for African languages, by Africans, against the English-centred machine ear.
orgs.description_zh: 由非洲人为非洲语言建设自然语言处理的草根研究社群，回应以英语为中心的“机器之耳”。

orgs.name: Matteo Pasquinelli
orgs.description: Italian philosopher whose The Eye of the Master argues that AI grew from the division and automation of labour, and that algorithms encode the pattern of work itself.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利哲学家，《主人之眼》主张 AI 源于劳动分工与自动化，算法编码的正是劳动本身的模式。
known_for: The Nooscope Manifested (2020, with Vladan Joler)
The Eye of the Master: A Social History of Artificial Intelligence (2023)

orgs.name: Max Dean
orgs.description: Canadian artist whose robot arm in As Yet Untitled offers family photographs for rescue, shredding them unless a visitor intervenes, putting responsibility for loss on the viewer.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家，As Yet Untitled 中的机械臂把家庭照片递给观众，若无人接过就把它们碎掉，把遗失的责任交给观众。
known_for: The Table: Childhood (2001, with Raffaello D'Andrea)

orgs.name: Maywa Denki
orgs.description: Japanese art unit led by Nobumichi Tosa that presents absurd 'nonsense machines' and instruments as company products, performed by staff in blue work uniforms.
orgs.description_zh: 由土佐信道领导的日本艺术组合，以“公司产品”形式发布荒诞的“无用机器”和乐器，并由身穿蓝色工作服的“员工”表演。

orgs.name: Media Art Net
orgs.description: Bilingual (German/English) online platform by ZKM and the Goethe-Institut with works, artists and essays on media art history, including robotics and cybernetic art.
orgs.description_zh: ZKM 与歌德学院合作的德英双语在线平台，收录媒体艺术史的作品、艺术家与论文，包括机器人与控制论艺术。

orgs.name: Media Arts Database (Japan)
orgs.description: National database of Japanese media arts, including records of media art exhibitions, festivals and works, useful for tracing Japanese machine and device art.
orgs.description_zh: 日本国家级媒体艺术数据库，收录媒体艺术展览、艺术节与作品记录，便于追溯日本的机器与装置艺术。

orgs.name: Memo Akten
orgs.description: Turkish artist and researcher whose Learning to See shows a neural network interpreting live camera images of cables and cloth as waves, fire or flowers, a metaphor for how any mind sees what it already knows.
orgs.description_zh: 土耳其艺术家与研究者，Learning to See 让神经网络把摄像头拍到的电线和布料实时“看成”海浪、火焰或花朵，隐喻任何心智都只能看见它已知的东西。

orgs.name: Mercedes Bunz
orgs.description: German-British scholar at King's College London who co-founded the Creative AI Lab with the Serpentine and writes about how machines now calculate meaning.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦国王学院的德裔英国学者，与蛇形画廊共同创立创意 AI 实验室，研究机器如何“计算意义”。
known_for: Creative AI Lab (with Eva Jäger, Serpentine × King's College London)

orgs.name: Meredith Whittaker
orgs.description: American researcher who co-founded the AI Now Institute and helped organise the 2018 Google walkout; now president of Signal and a critic of AI's concentration of power.
orgs.description_zh: 美国研究者，AI Now 研究所联合创始人，参与组织 2018 年谷歌员工罢工；现任 Signal 总裁，批判 AI 的权力集中。

orgs.name: Merritt Moore
orgs.description: American ballet dancer and quantum physicist (DPhil, Oxford) who programs and dances duets with an industrial robot arm.
orgs.description_zh: 美国芭蕾舞者、量子物理学家（牛津大学博士），亲自为工业机械臂编程并与之跳双人舞。

orgs.name: meson press
orgs.description: Open-access publisher of media theory, with titles on machine learning, pattern discrimination and the history of computing.
orgs.description_zh: 开放获取的媒体理论出版社，出版关于机器学习、模式辨别与计算史的著作。

orgs.name: metaLAB (at) Harvard
orgs.description: Creative research group at Harvard's Berkman Klein Center, whose projects include the AI Pedagogy Project and artworks on machine classification and moral decisions.
orgs.description_zh: 哈佛大学伯克曼·克莱因中心的创意研究团队，项目包括 AI Pedagogy Project 以及关于机器分类与道德决策的艺术作品。

orgs.name: Miao Ying
orgs.description: Chinese artist of the 'Chinternet' whose works on censorship, filtered search results and platform culture show how machines shape what can be seen online in China.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，以“中国互联网”为题，关注审查、被过滤的搜索结果与平台文化，展示机器如何塑造网上可见之物。
orgs.based_zh: 上海，中国 / 纽约，美国

orgs.name: Michael Levin
orgs.description: American developmental biologist whose xenobots and anthrobots blur the line between organism and machine and who proposes a framework for recognising minds in unconventional bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 美国发育生物学家，其异种机器人与人源机器人模糊了生物与机器的界限，并提出在非常规身体中识别心智的框架。
known_for: Xenobots (2020, with Josh Bongard and Sam Kriegman)

orgs.name: Michio Okada
orgs.description: Japanese researcher of 'weak robots', machines that cannot finish their tasks alone, such as a trash-can robot that needs passers-by to pick up litter, making dependence the basis of care.
orgs.description_zh: 日本“弱机器人”研究者：这些机器无法独立完成任务，例如需要路人帮忙捡垃圾的垃圾桶机器人，把依赖变成照护的基础。

orgs.name: Microwave International New Media Arts Festival
orgs.name_zh: 微波国际新媒体艺术节
orgs.description: Hong Kong's long-running new media arts festival, with themed exhibitions and forums that have included machine and AI art from Asia.
orgs.description_zh: 香港历史悠久的新媒体艺术节，以主题展和论坛呈现包括亚洲机器与 AI 艺术在内的作品。

orgs.name: Milagros Miceli
orgs.description: Argentine sociologist at the Weizenbaum Institute who studies the data annotators and content moderators of the Global South, and co-leads the Data Workers' Inquiry written by the workers themselves.
orgs.description_zh: 魏岑鲍姆研究所的阿根廷社会学家，研究全球南方的数据标注员与内容审核员，并共同主持由工人亲自书写的 Data Workers' Inquiry。

orgs.name: Mimi Onuoha
orgs.description: Nigerian-American artist whose Library of Missing Datasets is a filing cabinet of empty folders for data that is never collected, showing that what machines cannot see is a choice.
orgs.description_zh: 尼日利亚裔美国艺术家，《缺失数据集图书馆》是一只装满空文件夹的档案柜，收纳从未被采集的数据，揭示机器看不见的东西同样是被选择的。

orgs.name: Minne Atairu
orgs.description: Nigerian-American artist who uses generative models to imagine the Benin bronzes that were never made after the 1897 British raid, confronting the gaps in the data of looted histories.
orgs.description_zh: 尼日利亚裔美国艺术家，用生成模型想象 1897 年英军洗劫之后未能诞生的贝宁青铜器，直面被掠夺历史在数据中的空白。

orgs.name: Miraikan – National Museum of Emerging Science and Innovation
orgs.description: Tokyo science museum where the public meets humanoid and android robots, from ASIMO demonstrations to Hiroshi Ishiguro's androids Otonaroid and Kodomoroid (2014).
orgs.description_zh: 东京的科学博物馆，公众在此与人形和仿真机器人相遇，从 ASIMO 演示到石黑浩的仿真人 Otonaroid 与 Kodomoroid（2014）。

orgs.name: MIT Center for Advanced Visual Studies (CAVS)
orgs.name_zh: MIT 高级视觉研究中心
orgs.description: Fellowship centre founded by György Kepes at MIT (1967–2009) where artists worked with engineers on light, kinetic and cybernetic art; a model for later art-and-technology labs.
orgs.description_zh: György Kepes 在 MIT 创立的研究中心（1967–2009），艺术家与工程师在此合作光、动态与控制论艺术，是后来艺术与技术实验室的范本。

orgs.name: MIT Media Lab – Affective Computing Group
orgs.name_zh: MIT 媒体实验室情感计算组
orgs.description: Rosalind Picard's group, which founded affective computing: machines that sense and respond to emotion. Its work underlies both care technologies and the emotion recognition that artists critique.
orgs.description_zh: Rosalind Picard 领导的研究组，开创了“情感计算”：能感知并回应情绪的机器。其研究既支撑照护技术，也是艺术家批判的情绪识别技术的源头。

orgs.name: MIT Media Lab – Personal Robots Group
orgs.name_zh: MIT 媒体实验室个人机器人组
orgs.description: Cynthia Breazeal's group, which grew out of her sociable robot Kismet (1990s) and went on to build Leonardo and the social robot Jibo. It is the reference lab for robots designed as companions, tutors and carers.
orgs.description_zh: Cynthia Breazeal 领导的研究组，源于她 1990 年代的社交机器人 Kismet，后来开发了 Leonardo 与社交机器人 Jibo，是陪伴、教学与照护型机器人设计的标杆实验室。

orgs.name: Mixed Reality Laboratory (University of Nottingham)
orgs.name_zh: 诺丁汉大学混合现实实验室
orgs.description: HCI lab with a long collaboration with Blast Theory. Its Cat Royale (2023) let a robot arm play with three cats for twelve days to test the ethics of robots caring for animals.
orgs.description_zh: 与 Blast Theory 长期合作的人机交互实验室。其《Cat Royale》（2023）让机械臂与三只猫共处十二天，检验机器人照料动物的伦理。

orgs.name: Monoskop
orgs.description: Wiki and digital library for art, media and the humanities founded by Dušan Barok, with rich pages and scans on cybernetic art, media art festivals and machine theory.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Dušan Barok 创建的艺术、媒体与人文维基与数字图书馆，收录大量关于控制论艺术、媒体艺术节与机器理论的页面和扫描文献。

orgs.name: Mori Art Museum
orgs.description: Contemporary art museum in Roppongi Hills. Its survey Future and the Arts: AI, Robotics, Cities, Life (2019–20) presented over 100 projects on how humans will live with machines.
orgs.description_zh: 位于六本木新城的当代美术馆。展览《未来与艺术：AI、机器人、城市、生命》（2019–20）以 100 多个项目探讨人类将如何与机器共同生活。

orgs.name: Mozilla Creative Media Awards
orgs.description: Mozilla Foundation grants for art, games and media that make the harms of AI tangible to the public, especially bias, surveillance and platform power.
orgs.description_zh: Mozilla 基金会资助的艺术、游戏与媒体项目，让公众切身感受 AI 的危害，尤其是偏见、监控与平台权力。

orgs.name: Mute
orgs.description: London magazine on culture and politics after the net, with long-running critical writing on automation, labour and digital capitalism.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦的“网络之后的文化与政治”杂志，长期发表关于自动化、劳动与数字资本主义的批判性文章。

orgs.name: Myron Krueger
orgs.description: American computer artist who coined 'artificial reality'; in Videoplace a camera turned visitors' silhouettes into live partners for graphic creatures, an early case of a body read by a machine.
orgs.description_zh: 美国计算机艺术家，提出“人工现实”；在 Videoplace 中摄像机把观众剪影变成与图形生物互动的实时身体，是早期被机器“读取”的身体。

orgs.name: Mystery AI Hype Theater 3000
orgs.description: DAIR podcast and stream in which linguist Emily M. Bender and sociologist Alex Hanna take apart claims of machine intelligence and AI hype.
orgs.description_zh: DAIR 出品的播客与直播，语言学家 Emily M. Bender 与社会学家 Alex Hanna 在节目中逐条拆解“机器智能”与 AI 炒作。

orgs.name: N. Katherine Hayles
orgs.description: American literary theorist of the posthuman who insists on embodiment against disembodied information, and describes machines as 'nonconscious cognizers'.
orgs.description_zh: 美国后人类文学理论家，反对“去身体化的信息”观念而强调具身，并把机器描述为“非意识认知者”。
known_for: Unthought: The Power of the Cognitive Nonconscious (2017)

orgs.name: Nam June Paik
orgs.description: Korean-American founder of video art who built Robot K-456 with Shuya Abe, a remote-controlled 'anti-robot' that walked the streets, spoke and defecated beans; in 1982 he staged its 'first catastrophe of the 21st century', a collision with a car.
orgs.description_zh: 韩裔美国录像艺术奠基人，与阿部修也合作的 Robot K-456 是一台会上街行走、播放演讲、“排泄”豆子的遥控“反机器人”；1982 年他又让它被汽车撞倒，称之为“21 世纪的第一场灾难”。
orgs.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 首尔，韩国

orgs.name: Nam June Paik Art Center
orgs.description: Museum and archive of Nam June Paik, whose Robot K-456 (1964) was an early robot performer. It shows and researches media art that continues Paik's play with machines, broadcast and the body.
orgs.description_zh: 白南准的美术馆与档案馆。白南准的《Robot K-456》（1964）是最早的表演机器人之一，艺术中心展出并研究延续他对机器、广播与身体探索的媒体艺术。

orgs.name: Naoko Tosa
orgs.description: Japanese media artist whose Neurobaby, an early emotion-recognising computer baby that reacts to the tone of your voice, pioneered artificial emotion in art.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术家，早期作品《Neurobaby》是一个会根据你的语调作出反应的计算机婴儿，是情感识别艺术的先驱。

orgs.name: Neil Harbisson
orgs.description: Catalan-British artist, often called the first legally recognised cyborg; an implanted antenna lets him hear colour as sound, a machine sense grafted onto a human body.
orgs.description_zh: 英国–加泰罗尼亚艺术家，常被称为首位获法律认可的赛博格；植入颅骨的天线让他以声音“听见”颜色，把机器感官嫁接到人体。

orgs.name: nettime
orgs.description: Mailing list for net criticism founded in 1995, where the net.art and tactical media generations debated networks, software and machines.
orgs.description_zh: 1995 年创立的网络批评邮件列表，网络艺术与战术媒体几代人在此讨论网络、软件与机器。

orgs.name: Neural
orgs.description: Bilingual (Italian/English) magazine on new media art, electronic music and hacktivism, founded by Alessandro Ludovico and long a chronicle of critical machine art.
orgs.description_zh: Alessandro Ludovico 创办的意英双语杂志，关注新媒体艺术、电子音乐与黑客行动主义，长期记录批判性机器艺术。

orgs.name: NeurIPS Creative AI Track
orgs.name_zh: NeurIPS 创意 AI 单元
orgs.description: Juried track of the NeurIPS machine learning conference for art and design work with and about AI, following the Machine Learning for Creativity and Design workshops (2017–22). It puts artists in the room with ML researchers.
orgs.description_zh: 机器学习顶会 NeurIPS 的评审制创意 AI 单元，承接 2017–22 年的“机器学习与创意设计”研讨会，面向与 AI 相关的艺术与设计作品，让艺术家与机器学习研究者同场对话。

orgs.name: NEW INC
orgs.description: The New Museum's cultural incubator for art, design and technology, whose members have developed many projects on AI and its social effects.
orgs.description_zh: 新美术馆的艺术、设计与技术文化孵化器，成员开发了许多关于 AI 及其社会影响的项目。

orgs.name: Nicolas Gourault
orgs.description: French filmmaker whose VO reconstructs the 2018 Uber self-driving crash through test drivers' accounts, and whose Unknown Label follows data labellers training autonomous cars.
orgs.description_zh: 法国电影人，VO 通过测试司机的讲述重构 2018 年 Uber 自动驾驶致死事故，Unknown Label 追踪为自动驾驶汽车标注数据的工人。

orgs.name: Nicolas Schöffer
orgs.description: Hungarian-French artist who made CYSP 1 (1956), often called the first cybernetic sculpture: an electronic brain let it move and react to light, sound and colour, and it danced with Maurice Béjart's company.
orgs.description_zh: 匈牙利裔法国艺术家，1956 年的 CYSP 1 常被称为第一件控制论雕塑：电子“大脑”让它对光、声与颜色作出反应并移动，还曾与莫里斯·贝雅舞团同台。

orgs.name: NIME – New Interfaces for Musical Expression
orgs.description: International conference on new musical instruments and interfaces, including robotic instruments, AI co-performers and machine listening.
orgs.description_zh: 关于新型乐器与界面的国际会议，涵盖机器人乐器、AI 共演者与机器聆听。

orgs.name: Noema Magazine
orgs.description: Magazine of the Berggruen Institute that publishes long essays on AI, minds and planetary computation by writers such as Benjamin Bratton, Blaise Agüera y Arcas and Tobias Rees.
orgs.description_zh: 博古睿研究院出版的杂志，刊登 Benjamin Bratton、Blaise Agüera y Arcas、Tobias Rees 等人关于 AI、心智与行星计算的长文。

orgs.name: Nora N. Khan
orgs.description: American writer and curator whose Seeing, Naming, Knowing examines how machine vision names and judges, and whose criticism shaped how the art world writes about AI.
orgs.description_zh: 美国作家与策展人，《看见、命名、认知》审视机器视觉如何命名与判断，她的评论塑造了艺术界书写 AI 的方式。
known_for: Refiguring the Future (2019, co-curator with Lola Kramer)

orgs.name: Norbert Wiener
orgs.description: American mathematician who founded cybernetics, the science of control and communication in animals and machines, and warned early about automation and labour.
orgs.description_zh: 美国数学家，创立控制论：关于动物与机器中控制与通信的科学，并很早就警示自动化对劳动的冲击。
known_for: The Human Use of Human Beings (1950)

orgs.name: Norman White
orgs.description: Canadian pioneer of robotic art whose The Helpless Robot asks passers-by to turn it, then grows demanding and ungrateful, reversing who serves whom.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大机器人艺术先驱，The Helpless Robot 请路人帮它转动身体，随后变得颐指气使、毫不领情，颠倒了谁为谁服务。
known_for: Them Fuckin' Robots (1988, with Laura Kikauka)

orgs.name: Nouf Aljowaysir
orgs.description: Saudi-born artist whose Salaf asks an AI to reconstruct her ancestors from colonial photographs of Arabia; the models erase and mislabel them, revealing a Western gaze in the data.
orgs.description_zh: 沙特出生的艺术家，Salaf 请 AI 从殖民时期的阿拉伯照片中重建她的祖先，模型却抹去并误标了他们，暴露出数据中的西方凝视。
known_for: Ana Min Wein (Where Am I From?) (2021)

orgs.name: NTT InterCommunication Center [ICC]
orgs.description: Tokyo's media art centre, run by NTT East, devoted to communication technology and art. Its exhibitions and archive are a key reference for Japanese machine, sensor and interactive art.
orgs.description_zh: 由 NTT 东日本运营的东京媒体艺术中心，关注通信技术与艺术的关系。其展览与档案是日本机器、传感与互动艺术的重要参照。

orgs.name: NYU ITP / IMA
orgs.name_zh: 纽约大学互动电信项目
orgs.description: NYU Tisch's Interactive Telecommunications Program and Interactive Media Arts, a hub for physical computing, creative machine learning (ml5.js) and artists building with technology.
orgs.description_zh: 纽约大学 Tisch 艺术学院的互动电信项目与互动媒体艺术系，是物理计算、创意机器学习（ml5.js）与技术艺术创作的重镇。

orgs.name: Oliver Grau
orgs.description: German art historian who founded the Archive of Digital Art (formerly Database of Virtual Art), a key record of media and machine art.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术史学者，创立“数字艺术档案”（前身为虚拟艺术数据库），是记录媒体与机器艺术的重要档案。
known_for: Virtual Art: From Illusion to Immersion (2003)

orgs.name: Onassis Stegi
orgs.description: Athens cultural centre of the Onassis Foundation with a strong digital culture programme. Its exhibition You and AI: Through the Algorithmic Lens (2021) examined how AI sees and sorts people.
orgs.description_zh: 奥纳西斯基金会在雅典的文化中心，数字文化项目活跃。展览《You and AI: Through the Algorithmic Lens》（2021）探讨 AI 如何观看和分类人。

orgs.name: Open Humanities Press
orgs.description: Open-access academic publisher whose books include Joanna Zylinska's AI Art: Machine Visions and Warped Dreams (2020).
orgs.description_zh: 开放获取学术出版社，出版了 Joanna Zylinska 的《AI 艺术：机器视觉与扭曲的梦》（2020）等著作。

orgs.name: Orit Halpern
orgs.description: Historian of cybernetics and design whose Beautiful Data traces how postwar cybernetics reshaped vision and reason into data, and whose The Smartness Mandate critiques 'smart' everything.
orgs.description_zh: 控制论与设计史学者，《美丽的数据》追溯战后控制论如何把视觉与理性重塑为数据，《智慧命令》批判无处不在的“智能”。
known_for: The Smartness Mandate (2022, with Robert Mitchell)

orgs.name: Oriza Hirata
orgs.description: Japanese playwright who co-created android and robot theatre with Hiroshi Ishiguro; in Sayonara an android recites poetry to a dying young woman.
orgs.description_zh: 日本剧作家，与石黑浩共同开创仿人机器人与机器人戏剧；《再见》中仿人机器人为一位垂死的年轻女子朗诵诗歌。

orgs.name: Ory Laboratory
orgs.description: Kentaro Yoshifuji's company behind the avatar robot OriHime and the Avatar Robot Café DAWN, where people with ALS and other disabilities work as waiters through robots.
orgs.description_zh: 吉藤健太朗创办的公司，开发了分身机器人 OriHime 与“分身机器人咖啡馆 DAWN”，让渐冻症等残障人士通过机器人担任服务员。

orgs.name: Osamu Tezuka
orgs.description: Japanese manga artist (1928–1989) whose Astro Boy, a robot boy with a heart, shaped Japan's friendly image of robots and inspired generations of Japanese roboticists.
orgs.description_zh: 日本漫画家（1928–1989），其《铁臂阿童木》中有心的机器人男孩塑造了日本人对机器人的友善想象，并启发了几代日本机器人学家。

orgs.name: Paola Torres Núñez del Prado
orgs.description: Peruvian-Swedish artist who weaves textiles and sound with AI, showing how machine vision misreads Andean and Amazonian visual cultures.
orgs.description_zh: 秘鲁裔瑞典艺术家，用纺织、声音与 AI 创作，展示机器视觉如何误读安第斯与亚马孙地区的视觉文化。

orgs.name: Paolo Cirio
orgs.description: Italian artist whose Capture posted face-recognised images of 4,000 French police officers in the street, turning surveillance tools on the police; the work was censored.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利艺术家，Capture 把经人脸识别处理的 4000 名法国警察照片贴在街头，将监控工具转向警察，作品遭到审查。
known_for: Face to Facebook (2011, with Alessandro Ludovico)

orgs.name: Patrick Tresset
orgs.description: French artist whose robots named Paul sit at school desks and draw portraits of sitters with nervous, hesitating lines, turning the sitter into the one being observed by machines.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，名为 Paul 的机器人坐在课桌前，以紧张迟疑的线条为模特画像，让被画的人反过来成为被机器观察的对象。

orgs.name: Paul Sermon
orgs.description: British artist whose Telematic Dreaming projected a remote partner onto a bed via video link, an early and intimate experiment with telepresence.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，Telematic Dreaming 通过视频连线把远方的伙伴投影在床上，是远程临场的早期亲密实验。

orgs.name: Paul Virilio
orgs.description: French theorist whose The Vision Machine imagined 'sightless vision', cameras and computers that see and interpret without any human looking.
orgs.description_zh: 法国理论家，《视觉机器》设想了“无目之视”：无需人类观看、由摄像机与计算机自行看见并解读的视觉。

orgs.name: Paula Gaetano Adi
orgs.description: Argentine artist whose robot Alexitimia, a skin-like blob that sweats when touched, won VIDA 9.0 and asks what a machine body without face or limbs can feel.
orgs.description_zh: 阿根廷艺术家，她的机器人 Alexitimia 像一团皮肤，被触摸时会“出汗”，获 VIDA 9.0 奖，追问一个没有脸和四肢的机器身体能感受什么。
orgs.based_zh: 普罗维登斯，美国 / 阿根廷

orgs.name: Peter Weibel
orgs.description: Austrian artist, theorist and long-time director of ZKM Karlsruhe, whose exhibitions such as Open Codes placed algorithms, AI and machine agency at the centre of art.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利艺术家、理论家，长期担任卡尔斯鲁厄 ZKM 艺术与媒体中心馆长，其“开放代码”等展览把算法、AI 与机器能动性置于艺术中心。

orgs.name: Peter-Paul Verbeek
orgs.description: Dutch philosopher of technology who extends postphenomenology to show how artefacts mediate perception and moral action; his 'composite intentionality' opens space for machine perception.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰技术哲学家，发展后现象学，揭示人工物如何中介知觉与道德行动；他的“复合意向性”为机器知觉留出空间。

orgs.name: Petra Gemeinboeck
orgs.description: Austrian-Australian artist-researcher who works with dancers to give non-humanlike robots expressive movement, a practice she calls 'bodying-thinging'.
orgs.description_zh: 奥地利裔澳大利亚艺术家与研究者，与舞者合作为非类人机器人赋予表现性动作，她称之为“bodying-thinging”。

orgs.name: Phil Agre
orgs.description: American AI researcher who proposed 'critical technical practice', building AI while reflecting on its assumptions, an approach later adopted by artists and designers.
orgs.description_zh: 美国 AI 研究者，提出“批判技术实践”：在构建 AI 的同时反思其假设，这一方法后来被艺术家与设计师采用。

orgs.name: Philip Beesley
orgs.description: Canadian architect and artist whose 'living architecture' environments of fronds, sensors and chemistry breathe and ripple in response to visitors.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大建筑师与艺术家，他的“活体建筑”由叶片、传感器与化学装置构成，会随观众靠近而呼吸、起伏。

orgs.name: Philipp Schmitt
orgs.description: German designer whose Declassifier overlays each object a vision model detects with the training images it learned from, showing that a model's 'seeing' is remembering its dataset.
orgs.description_zh: 德国设计师，Declassifier 在视觉模型识别出的每个物体上叠加它学习过的训练图片，揭示模型的“看见”其实是在回忆它的数据集。
known_for: Humans of AI (2019, with Sebastian Schmieg)

orgs.name: Philosophy & Technology (Springer)
orgs.description: Philosophy journal on technology, including postphenomenology, machine agency and AI ethics.
orgs.description_zh: 关于技术的哲学期刊，涵盖后现象学、机器能动性与 AI 伦理。

orgs.name: Phoebe Sengers
orgs.description: American HCI researcher who built 'schizophrenic' agents to expose how AI design splits behaviour, and founded reflective design as critical technical practice.
orgs.description_zh: 美国人机交互研究者，构建“精神分裂”的智能体以揭示 AI 设计如何割裂行为，并提出作为批判技术实践的“反思性设计”。
known_for: Anti-Boxology: Agent Design in Cultural Context (1998)

orgs.name: Pierre Huyghe
orgs.description: French artist of living, self-running situations; UUmwelt displays images a neural network reconstructed from human brain scans, flickering with flies in the gallery.
orgs.description_zh: 法国艺术家，创造有生命、自我运行的情境；UUmwelt 展出神经网络依据人脑扫描重建的图像，画面在满屋苍蝇中闪烁。
orgs.based_zh: 圣地亚哥，智利 / 巴黎，法国

orgs.name: Pierre Jaquet-Droz
orgs.description: Swiss watchmaker (1721–1790) whose android automata, including The Writer, which can be programmed to write any text of 40 characters, are ancestors of programmable robots.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士钟表匠（1721–1790），他的仿人自动机（包括可编程写出任意 40 字符文本的“书写者”）是可编程机器人的先祖。

orgs.name: Pontus Hultén
orgs.description: Swedish curator and founding director of the Centre Pompidou's museum whose MoMA exhibition The Machine as Seen at the End of the Mechanical Age surveyed art's relation to machines at the dawn of computing.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞典策展人、蓬皮杜中心美术馆首任馆长，他在 MoMA 策划的“机械时代末期所见的机器”梳理了计算时代开端时艺术与机器的关系。
known_for: The Machine as Seen at the End of the Mechanical Age (MoMA, 1968)
orgs.based_zh: 斯德哥尔摩，瑞典 / 巴黎，法国

orgs.name: Posthumanities (University of Minnesota Press)
orgs.description: Book series edited by Cary Wolfe, including Ian Bogost's Alien Phenomenology (2012), a core shelf for thinking about nonhuman and machine experience.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Cary Wolfe 主编的丛书，包括 Ian Bogost 的《异形现象学》（2012），是思考非人与机器经验的核心书架。

orgs.name: Primavera De Filippi
orgs.description: Italian legal scholar and artist whose Plantoids are blockchain-based robotic 'plants' that own themselves, collect money and pay artists to make copies of them, a self-reproducing machine lifeform.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利法学学者与艺术家，Plantoid 是基于区块链、自我拥有的机器人“植物”：它们收集资金并雇佣艺术家复制自己，是一种自我繁殖的机器生命。
known_for: Blockchain and the Law (2018, with Aaron Wright)

orgs.name: Prix Ars Electronica
orgs.description: The leading prize for media art. Its Artificial Life & Intelligence category honours work on what AI and life science mean for being human, with Golden Nicas for Paul Vanouse's Labor (2019) and Forensic Architecture's Cloud Studies (2021).
orgs.description_zh: 媒体艺术最重要的奖项。其“人工生命与智能”类别表彰关于 AI 与生命科学对人之意义的作品，金尼卡奖得主包括 Paul Vanouse 的《Labor》（2019）与法证建筑的《Cloud Studies》（2021）。

orgs.name: Processing Foundation
orgs.description: Nonprofit behind Processing and p5.js that promotes software literacy in the arts, with fellowships supporting artists working critically with code and machine learning.
orgs.description_zh: Processing 与 p5.js 背后的非营利组织，推广艺术领域的软件素养，并以奖学金支持以批判方式使用代码与机器学习的艺术家。

orgs.name: Queer in AI
orgs.description: Grassroots organisation of queer researchers and practitioners in AI that raises awareness of how AI misclassifies and harms queer people.
orgs.description_zh: AI 领域酷儿研究者与从业者的草根组织，揭示 AI 如何误分类并伤害酷儿群体。

orgs.name: Radhika Nagpal
orgs.description: Indian-American roboticist whose thousand-robot Kilobot swarm and termite-like builders show collective behaviour emerging from simple machines.
orgs.description_zh: 印度裔美国机器人学家，她的千台 Kilobot 群体与仿白蚁建造机器人显示，集体行为可以从简单机器中涌现。

orgs.name: Rafael Lozano-Hemmer
orgs.description: Mexican-Canadian artist of interactive surveillance installations; Level of Confidence uses face recognition to match visitors with the 43 disappeared students of Ayotzinapa, turning a police tool into a memorial.
orgs.description_zh: 墨西哥裔加拿大互动艺术家，常以监控技术为材料；Level of Confidence 用人脸识别把观众与阿约齐纳帕失踪的 43 名学生相匹配，让警察工具变成纪念碑。

orgs.name: Raffaello D'Andrea
orgs.description: Canadian-Italian-Swiss engineer who co-created The Table, a robot table that chooses a visitor to follow, co-founded Kiva Systems (now Amazon Robotics) and choreographed drones.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大–意大利–瑞士工程师，共同创作会选择一位观众并跟随的机器人桌子 The Table，联合创立 Kiva Systems（今亚马逊机器人），并为无人机编舞。

orgs.name: Ralf Baecker
orgs.description: German artist who builds physical computers out of sticks, strings and crystals, making the inner operations of computation visible and strange.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，用木棍、绳线与晶体搭建物理计算机，让计算的内部运作变得可见而陌生。

orgs.name: Random International
orgs.description: Art studio founded by Hannes Koch and Florian Ortkrass whose minimal robotic figures and swarms test how little movement we need to perceive something as alive.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Hannes Koch 与 Florian Ortkrass 创立的艺术工作室，其极简的机器人形体与群体装置检验：我们需要多少运动，才会把某物感知为活物。
orgs.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国

orgs.name: Rashaad Newsome
orgs.description: American artist whose AI 'Being', a vogue-dancing, bell hooks-reading avatar, leads workshops and performances as a decolonial, queer machine persona.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，他的 AI“Being”是一个会跳 voguing、阅读贝尔·胡克斯的化身，以去殖民的酷儿机器人格主持工作坊与表演。

orgs.name: Real Life
orgs.description: Online magazine (2016–2022) about living with technology, whose essays on smart speakers, algorithms and machine intimacy remain an archive of everyday machine phenomenology.
orgs.description_zh: 关于与技术共同生活的在线杂志（2016–2022），其关于智能音箱、算法与机器亲密的文章构成了日常机器现象学的档案。

orgs.name: Reality Design Lab
orgs.description: Design research lab led by Botao Amber Hu that makes mixed-reality and speculative works on other minds and machines, such as EchoVision (what is it like to be a bat?), City of Sparkles (how might an AI perceive our city?) and AI Mom™. It also builds the open HoloKit toolkit and runs the Machinic Reality Inspire gallery.
orgs.description_zh: 由胡博涛（Botao Amber Hu）领导的设计研究实验室，创作关于他者心智与机器的混合现实与推测性作品，如《EchoVision》（做一只蝙蝠是什么感觉？）、《City of Sparkles》（AI 会如何感知我们的城市？）与《AI Mom™》；实验室还开发开源 HoloKit 工具包，并运营 Machinic Reality Inspire 图库。

orgs.name: Rebecca Fiebrink
orgs.description: American researcher at UAL Creative Computing Institute whose Wekinator lets artists train machine-learning models by demonstration, treating ML as a creative, embodied instrument.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术大学创意计算研究所美国研究者，Wekinator 让艺术家通过示范训练机器学习模型，把机器学习当作具身的创作乐器。
known_for: Machine Learning for Musicians and Artists (Kadenze, 2016)

orgs.name: Rebecca Horn
orgs.description: German artist whose body extensions and later kinetic machines, such as a hanging piano that bursts open, give machines moods, fragility and something like feeling.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，从身体延伸装置到后来的动态机器（如倒悬后猛然炸开的钢琴），赋予机器情绪、脆弱和近似感受的东西。

orgs.name: Revital Cohen & Tuur Van Balen
orgs.description: Artist duo whose The Immortal connects life-support machines to each other in a closed loop that circulates fluids and air without a human body, a machine that only keeps itself alive.
orgs.description_zh: 艺术家二人组，The Immortal 把多台生命支持机器首尾相连，在没有人体的情况下循环液体与空气，成为只为维持自身而运转的机器。

orgs.name: Rhizome
orgs.description: Born-digital art organisation affiliated with the New Museum, which commissions, preserves and writes about art engaged with technology, including the ArtBase and the Webrecorder tools.
orgs.description_zh: 隶属新美术馆的原生数字艺术机构，委托、保存并评论与技术相关的艺术，运营 ArtBase 与 Webrecorder 工具。

orgs.name: Rimini Protokoll
orgs.description: German theatre collective; in Stefan Kaegi's Uncanny Valley an animatronic double of writer Thomas Melle delivers a lecture in his place, asking what remains of a person who can be replaced.
orgs.description_zh: 德国剧场团体；Stefan Kaegi 的 Uncanny Valley 中，作家 Thomas Melle 的仿真机器人替身代他讲演，追问可被替代的人还剩下什么。
known_for: Uncanny Valley (2018, Stefan Kaegi with Thomas Melle)

orgs.name: Robert Breer
orgs.description: American filmmaker and sculptor whose slow, self-propelled 'Floats' crept across floors and reversed when they touched an obstacle, giving simple machines an odd, animal presence.
orgs.description_zh: 美国电影人与雕塑家，他的自走式“漂浮物”在地面上缓慢爬行，碰到障碍就掉头，让简单机器带上了奇异的动物感。

orgs.name: Robert Sparrow
orgs.description: Australian philosopher who argued early that robot pets for older people depend on deception, and that autonomous weapons create a gap in responsibility.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚哲学家，很早就指出为老人提供的机器人宠物依赖欺骗，而自主武器会造成责任的空缺。
known_for: The March of the Robot Dogs (2002)
In the Hands of Machines? The Future of Aged Care (2006, with Linda Sparrow)

orgs.name: RobotArt Competition
orgs.description: Annual competition (2016–18) for robots that paint with physical brushes, which gathered university and artist teams and made robot painting visible as a craft.
orgs.description_zh: 年度机器人绘画竞赛（2016–18），参赛机器人用真实画笔作画，汇集大学与艺术家团队，让机器人绘画作为一门手艺被看见。

orgs.name: Robotic Musicianship Group (Georgia Tech)
orgs.name_zh: 佐治亚理工机器人音乐组
orgs.description: Gil Weinberg's group at the Georgia Tech Center for Music Technology, which built the improvising marimba robot Shimon, a machine that listens and plays with humans.
orgs.description_zh: 佐治亚理工音乐技术中心 Gil Weinberg 领导的研究组，开发了会即兴演奏的马林巴机器人 Shimon，一台与人一同聆听和演奏的机器。

orgs.name: robotlab
orgs.description: German group founded at ZKM in 2000 that takes industrial robots into art; in bios [bible] a robot arm writes out the entire Bible by pen, a monk's labour done by a machine.
orgs.description_zh: 2000 年于 ZKM 成立的德国团体，把工业机器人带入艺术；在 bios [bible] 中机械臂用笔抄写整部《圣经》，以机器完成修士的劳作。

orgs.name: ROBOTS Guide (IEEE Spectrum)
orgs.description: IEEE's illustrated catalogue of real robots, with photos, videos and specifications for hundreds of humanoids, companion robots and industrial arms.
orgs.description_zh: IEEE 编制的真实机器人图录，为数百款人形、陪伴与工业机器人提供照片、视频与参数。

orgs.name: Rodney Brooks
orgs.description: Australian roboticist whose behaviour-based robotics replaced central planning with layered, embodied reflexes, from the six-legged Genghis to the Roomba vacuum cleaner.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚机器人学家，他的基于行为的机器人学以分层的具身反射取代中央规划，从六足机器人 Genghis 到扫地机器人 Roomba。

orgs.name: Rolf Pfeifer
orgs.description: Swiss AI researcher who championed embodied intelligence, showing that a robot's body and materials do part of its thinking ('morphological computation').
orgs.description_zh: 瑞士 AI 研究者，倡导具身智能，指出机器人的身体与材料本身承担了部分“思考”（形态计算）。
known_for: How the Body Shapes the Way We Think (2006, with Josh Bongard)

orgs.name: Ron Wakkary
orgs.description: Canadian design researcher whose Morse Things, ceramic bowls that talk to each other in Morse code over the network, were lived with in homes to study a world of things with their own lives.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大设计研究者，Morse Things 是通过网络以摩尔斯电码彼此“交谈”的陶瓷碗，被放进家庭中共同生活，以研究物有自身生命的世界。
known_for: Things We Could Design: For More Than Human-Centered Worlds (2021)

orgs.name: Rosa Menkman
orgs.description: Dutch artist and theorist of glitch and resolution whose work shows how compression standards and imaging machines decide what can be seen, including the forgotten women in test images.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰艺术家与故障、分辨率理论家，她的作品揭示压缩标准与成像机器如何决定什么可以被看见，包括测试图像中被遗忘的女性。

orgs.name: Roy Ascott
orgs.description: British artist and theorist of cybernetic and telematic art whose teaching and writings made feedback, interaction and networks central to art, including later in China.
orgs.description_zh: 英国控制论与远程通讯艺术理论家与艺术家，他的教学与写作使反馈、互动与网络成为艺术核心，晚年也在中国任教。
known_for: Behaviourist Art and the Cybernetic Vision (1966–67)
orgs.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 上海，中国

orgs.name: Ruha Benjamin
orgs.description: American sociologist whose Race After Technology names the 'New Jim Code', the way seemingly neutral systems reproduce racial hierarchies.
orgs.description_zh: 美国社会学家，《技术之后的种族》提出“新吉姆代码”，指出看似中立的系统如何再生产种族等级。

orgs.name: S+T+ARTS Prize
orgs.description: European Commission prize for innovation at the nexus of science, technology and the arts, run by Ars Electronica. Winners include Project Alias (2019), Holly+ (2022), Calculating Empires (2024) and the AI War Cloud Database (2025).
orgs.description_zh: 欧盟委员会设立、由电子艺术节运营的科学、技术与艺术交叉创新奖。获奖作品包括《Project Alias》（2019）、《Holly+》（2022）、《Calculating Empires》（2024）与《AI War Cloud Database》（2025）。

orgs.name: S+T+ARTS Residencies
orgs.description: European Commission initiative that funds artist residencies inside technology and research projects, many on AI, robotics and sustainability.
orgs.description_zh: 欧盟委员会资助艺术家进入技术与科研项目驻留的计划，许多项目涉及 AI、机器人与可持续发展。

orgs.name: Sabine Himmelsbach
orgs.description: German curator and director of HEK (House of Electronic Arts) in Basel, whose exhibitions such as Entangled Realities look at how we live with AI and machines.
orgs.description_zh: 德国策展人，巴塞尔电子艺术之家（HEK）馆长，其“纠缠的现实：与人工智能共处”等展览关注我们如何与 AI 和机器共同生活。
known_for: Entangled Realities: Living with Artificial Intelligence (HEK, 2019)

orgs.name: Safiya Umoja Noble
orgs.description: American scholar whose Algorithms of Oppression showed how search engines represent Black women through racist and sexist results.
orgs.description_zh: 美国学者，《压迫的算法》揭示搜索引擎如何以种族主义与性别歧视的结果呈现黑人女性。

orgs.name: SAIC Art and Technology Studies
orgs.name_zh: 芝加哥艺术学院艺术与技术系
orgs.description: School of the Art Institute of Chicago department, rooted in Sonia Sheridan's Generative Systems programme (1970), that teaches robotics, kinetics and electronics as art.
orgs.description_zh: 芝加哥艺术学院的院系，源自 Sonia Sheridan 的“生成系统”项目（1970），将机器人、动态与电子技术作为艺术来教授。

orgs.name: Sam Lavigne
orgs.description: American artist of data and scraping whose White Collar Crime Risk Zones applies predictive policing to financial crime, turning the classifier against the powerful.
orgs.description_zh: 美国数据与爬虫艺术家，White Collar Crime Risk Zones 把预测警务用于白领犯罪，让分类器转而对准有权者。
known_for: White Collar Crime Risk Zones (2017, with Brian Clifton and Francis Tseng)

orgs.name: School for Poetic Computation (SFPC)
orgs.description: Artist-run school in New York for art, code, hardware and critical theory, with classes on the poetics and politics of machines.
orgs.description_zh: 纽约由艺术家运营的学校，教授艺术、代码、硬件与批判理论，开设关于机器诗学与政治的课程。

orgs.name: School of Creative Media, City University of Hong Kong
orgs.name_zh: 香港城市大学创意媒体学院
orgs.description: Hong Kong media art school that hosts the Art Machines symposium on computational media art, and a centre for robotic and AI art in Asia.
orgs.description_zh: 香港的媒体艺术学院，主办“Art Machines”计算媒体艺术研讨会，是亚洲机器人与 AI 艺术的中心之一。

orgs.name: Science Gallery
orgs.description: University-based network of galleries where art meets science for young audiences. Its AI shows, from Science Gallery Dublin's early exhibitions to London's AI: Who's Looking After Me? (2023), moved from automation to bias to care.
orgs.description_zh: 以大学为依托、面向年轻观众的艺术与科学画廊网络。其 AI 系列展从都柏林早期展览到伦敦的《AI: Who's Looking After Me?》（2023），主题从自动化转向偏见，再到照护。
orgs.based_zh: 都柏林 / 伦敦 / 班加罗尔 / 墨尔本

orgs.name: Science Museum, London
orgs.description: UK national science museum. Its exhibition Robots (2017) showed more than 100 robots across 500 years, from mechanical automata to humanoids, and still anchors the popular history of the robot.
orgs.description_zh: 英国国家科学博物馆。展览《Robots》（2017）展出跨越 500 年的 100 多台机器人，从机械自动人偶到人形机器人，是机器人大众史的重要参照。

orgs.name: Sebastian Schmieg
orgs.description: German artist who works on the hidden human labour inside AI; Decision Space and Segmentation.Network replay the clickwork of crowdworkers who trace and label images for training.
orgs.description_zh: 德国艺术家，关注 AI 内部被隐藏的人类劳动；Decision Space 与 Segmentation.Network 重演众包工人为训练描边和标注图片的点击劳动。
known_for: Humans of AI (2019, with Philipp Schmitt)

orgs.name: Seiko Mikami
orgs.description: Japanese media-art pioneer (1961–2015) whose Desire of Codes (YCAM) fills a wall with insect-like camera arms that track visitors, making the audience's bodies the material of surveillance.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术先驱（1961–2015），在 YCAM 发表的《Desire of Codes》中，墙上如昆虫般的摄像机臂追踪观众，使观众身体成为监控的材料。
known_for: World, Membrane and the Dismembered Body (1997)

orgs.name: Selma Šabanović
orgs.description: Bosnian-American researcher of social robotics who studies how robots such as PARO are designed and lived with across cultures, especially in Japan and the US.
orgs.description_zh: 波斯尼亚裔美国社交机器人研究者，研究 PARO 等机器人如何在不同文化（尤其日本与美国）中被设计与共处。
known_for: Robots in Society, Society in Robots (2010)

orgs.name: Serpentine Arts Technologies
orgs.name_zh: 蛇形画廊艺术与技术部
orgs.description: Serpentine's programme for art made with AI, blockchain and game engines, with commissions such as Holly Herndon & Mat Dryhurst's The Call (2024). It co-runs the Creative AI Lab and publishes the Future Art Ecosystems reports.
orgs.description_zh: 蛇形画廊面向 AI、区块链和游戏引擎艺术的项目，委托了 Holly Herndon 与 Mat Dryhurst 的《The Call》（2024）等作品。它与伦敦国王学院共同运营 Creative AI Lab，并发布《Future Art Ecosystems》系列报告。

orgs.name: SHARE Lab / SHARE Foundation
orgs.description: Research and data investigation lab of the SHARE Foundation, led by Vladan Joler, which maps the invisible infrastructures of networks and AI. It is the home of the maps behind Anatomy of an AI System.
orgs.description_zh: SHARE 基金会下由 Vladan Joler 领导的研究与数据调查实验室，绘制网络与 AI 不可见的基础设施地图，《Anatomy of an AI System》的地图工作即源于此。

orgs.name: Sherry Turkle
orgs.description: American psychologist at MIT whose studies of children and elders with Furby, AIBO and PARO describe 'the robotic moment', when we accept machine companionship as enough.
orgs.description_zh: 麻省理工学院的美国心理学家，研究儿童与老人如何对待 Furby、AIBO 和 PARO，提出“机器人时刻”：我们开始把机器陪伴视为足够。

orgs.name: Shinseungback Kimyonghun
orgs.description: Seoul duo (Shin Seung Back and Kim Yong Hun) whose Cloud Face collects clouds that face detection mistakes for faces, making machine pareidolia visible.
orgs.description_zh: 首尔二人组（申承伯与金容勋），Cloud Face 收集被人脸检测误认成人脸的云，让机器的“空想性错视”显形。

orgs.name: Shoshana Zuboff
orgs.description: American scholar who described 'surveillance capitalism', the extraction of human experience as behavioural data for prediction products.
orgs.description_zh: 美国学者，提出“监控资本主义”：把人类经验作为行为数据攫取，用于制造预测产品。
known_for: In the Age of the Smart Machine (1988)

orgs.name: Shu Lea Cheang
orgs.description: Taiwanese artist and net-art pioneer whose 3x3x6 at the Venice Biennale turned the surveillance of a panoptic prison onto visitors, through the stories of queer and gender-nonconforming prisoners.
orgs.description_zh: 台湾艺术家、网络艺术先驱，威尼斯双年展作品《3x3x6》借酷儿与性别不从者囚犯的故事，把全景监狱的监控转向观众。

orgs.name: SIGGRAPH Art Gallery & Art Papers
orgs.description: The art programme of ACM SIGGRAPH, the computer graphics conference, and SIGGRAPH Asia. For decades it has shown computational, robotic and AI art beside the research that makes it possible.
orgs.description_zh: 计算机图形学会议 ACM SIGGRAPH 及 SIGGRAPH Asia 的艺术单元，数十年来将计算、机器人与 AI 艺术与支撑它们的研究并置展出。

orgs.name: Simon Denny
orgs.description: New Zealand artist who turns tech-industry documents into objects; he built Amazon's patented cage for warehouse workers, showing how automation encloses human labour.
orgs.description_zh: 新西兰艺术家，把科技公司的文件变成实物；他按专利做出了亚马逊为仓库工人设计的“笼子”，展示自动化如何围困人类劳动。

orgs.name: Simon Penny
orgs.description: Australian artist and theorist of embodied interaction; his autonomous robot Petit Mal wobbled towards and away from visitors with a behaviour that felt neither animal nor machine.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家与具身交互理论家；他的自主机器人 Petit Mal 摇摇晃晃地靠近又远离观众，其行为既不像动物，也不像机器。
known_for: Making Sense: Cognition, Computing, Art, and Embodiment (2017)

orgs.name: Simon Weckert
orgs.description: Berlin artist who pulled a handcart of 99 smartphones through empty streets and made Google Maps report a traffic jam, showing how platforms read the city through devices.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林艺术家，拉着装有 99 部智能手机的手推车走过空荡街道，让谷歌地图显示“交通拥堵”，揭示平台如何通过设备读取城市。

orgs.name: Simone Browne
orgs.description: American scholar whose Dark Matters traces surveillance technologies, including biometrics, back to the policing of Black life under slavery.
orgs.description_zh: 美国学者，《暗物质》把包括生物识别在内的监控技术追溯到奴隶制下对黑人生活的管控。
known_for: Dark Matters: On the Surveillance of Blackness (2015)

orgs.name: Simone Giertz
orgs.description: Swedish inventor and YouTuber known as the 'queen of shitty robots', whose deliberately useless machines (a breakfast robot, a lipstick robot) turn failure into comedy.
orgs.description_zh: 瑞典发明家与 YouTube 创作者，被称为“烂机器人女王”，她刻意无用的机器（早餐机器人、涂口红机器人）把失败变成喜剧。

orgs.name: Simone Rebaudengo
orgs.description: Italian designer whose Addicted Products imagines toasters that want to be used, move to more attentive homes and quietly complain, a view of the IoT from the thing's side.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利设计师，Addicted Products 设想渴望被使用的烤面包机：它们会搬去更常用它们的家并悄悄抱怨，从物的视角看物联网。

orgs.name: So Kanno
orgs.description: Japanese artist whose Senseless Drawing Bot, made with yang02, is a wobbling robot that sprays graffiti with a pendulum, turning mechanical instability into gesture.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家，与 yang02 合作的 Senseless Drawing Bot 是一台摇晃的机器人，靠钟摆喷出涂鸦，把机械的不稳定变成笔触。

orgs.name: Society for Arts and Technology (SAT)
orgs.name_zh: 蒙特利尔艺术与技术协会
orgs.description: Montréal centre for immersive and digital art with a dome, research lab and residencies, developing telepresence and immersive tools used by artists.
orgs.description_zh: 蒙特利尔的沉浸式与数字艺术中心，设有球幕、研究实验室与驻留项目，开发供艺术家使用的远程临场与沉浸式工具。

orgs.name: Sofian Audry
orgs.description: Canadian artist and scholar of machine learning as an artistic medium, with robots that learn in front of the public; author of Art in the Age of Machine Learning (MIT Press).
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大艺术家与学者，研究作为艺术媒介的机器学习，其机器人在观众面前学习；著有 Art in the Age of Machine Learning（MIT 出版社）。
known_for: Art in the Age of Machine Learning (2021)

orgs.name: Somerset House Studios
orgs.description: Experimental workspace for artists and makers inside Somerset House, home to studios working on AI, sound and speculative design, and producer of exhibitions such as 24/7 (2019).
orgs.description_zh: 萨默塞特宫内为艺术家与创作者设立的实验性工作空间，入驻工作室涉及 AI、声音与推测设计，也制作了《24/7》（2019）等展览。

orgs.name: Sougwen Chung
orgs.description: Hong Kong-born Canadian artist who draws live with robotic collaborators (the D.O.U.G. series) trained on her own gestures, exploring authorship shared between human and machine.
orgs.description_zh: 香港出生的加拿大艺术家，与以她自身笔触训练的机器人（D.O.U.G. 系列）现场共同作画，探索人与机器共享的作者身份。

orgs.name: Sputniko! (Hiromi Ozaki)
orgs.description: Japanese-British artist whose Menstruation Machine is a device that lets a man experience menstruation, speculative design about bodies, gender and technology.
orgs.description_zh: 日英混血艺术家，Menstruation Machine 是一台让男性体验月经的装置，以思辨设计探讨身体、性别与技术。

orgs.name: Stanisław Lem
orgs.description: Polish writer and philosopher whose Golem XIV, a superintelligent computer lecturing humans on their limits, remains one of the sharpest imaginings of truly alien machine minds.
orgs.description_zh: 波兰作家与哲学家，其《Golem XIV》中向人类讲授其局限的超级智能计算机，至今仍是对真正陌异的机器心智最锐利的想象之一。

orgs.name: Stelarc
orgs.description: Cypriot-Australian performance artist who treats the body as obsolete hardware to extend with robotics: a third hand, a six-legged exoskeleton, a body moved remotely by internet traffic.
orgs.description_zh: 塞浦路斯裔澳大利亚行为艺术家，把身体视为“过时的硬件”并用机器人技术扩展它：第三只手、六足外骨骼、被网络流量远程驱动的身体。

orgs.name: Stephanie Dinkins
orgs.description: American transmedia artist who asks whether a Black woman's robot can know itself; after years of talking with the social robot Bina48 she trained Not the Only One, an AI memoir of her own family.
orgs.description_zh: 美国跨媒介艺术家，追问一个黑人女性形象的机器人能否认识自己；在与社交机器人 Bina48 多年对话后，她训练了讲述自己家族三代的 AI 作品 Not the Only One。

orgs.name: Steve Mann
orgs.description: Canadian engineer who has lived with wearable computers and head-mounted cameras since the late 1970s and coined 'sousveillance', watching the watchers from below.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大工程师，自 1970 年代末起一直佩戴可穿戴计算机与头戴摄像机生活，并提出“逆向监视”：自下而上地监视监视者。

orgs.name: STRP Festival
orgs.description: Eindhoven festival for creative technology, set in a former Philips industrial complex, whose editions explore living with robots, AI and sensing environments.
orgs.description_zh: 在埃因霍温飞利浦旧工业区举办的创意技术节，历届探讨如何与机器人、AI 和感知环境共处。

orgs.name: STUDIO for Creative Inquiry (CMU)
orgs.name_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学创意探究工作室
orgs.description: Carnegie Mellon's lab for atypical, anti-disciplinary art research, directed by Golan Levin. It hosts residencies and projects on computer vision, robotics and creative coding.
orgs.description_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学的跨学科艺术研究实验室，由 Golan Levin 主持，驻留与项目涉及计算机视觉、机器人与创意编程。

orgs.name: Sun Yuan & Peng Yu
orgs.description: Beijing artist duo whose Can't Help Myself, an industrial robot endlessly sweeping a leaking red fluid back into place, became an emblem of machine labour, futility and exhaustion.
orgs.description_zh: 北京艺术家二人组，其《我无能为力》中工业机器人不停把渗出的红色液体扫回原处，成为机器劳动、徒劳与疲惫的象征。

orgs.name: Superflux (Anab Jain & Jon Ardern)
orgs.description: London design studio whose films and installations imagine living with more-than-human and machine agents; Uninvited Guests shows an elderly man outwitting the smart devices his children bought him.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦设计工作室，以影片和装置想象与超越人类的、机器的行动者共同生活；Uninvited Guests 中一位老人设法骗过子女为他买的智能设备。

orgs.name: Susumu Tachi
orgs.description: Japanese engineer who proposed 'telexistence' in 1980 and built the TELESAR robots that let a person see, hear and feel through a remote robot body.
orgs.description_zh: 日本工程师，1980 年提出“远程存在”，研制 TELESAR 系列机器人，让人通过远端机器人身体去看、听与感受。

orgs.name: Suzanne Kite
orgs.description: Oglála Lakȟóta artist and scholar whose performances and machine-learning works draw on Lakota ontology, where stones and machines can be relatives rather than tools.
orgs.description_zh: 奥格拉拉拉科塔族艺术家与学者，其表演与机器学习作品取自拉科塔本体论：石头与机器可以是亲属，而不仅是工具。
known_for: Making Kin with the Machines (2018, with Jason Edward Lewis et al.)

orgs.name: Suzanne Livingston
orgs.description: British curator and writer who co-curated AI: More than Human at the Barbican (2019), a large survey that toured internationally and mixed art, science and the history of AI.
orgs.description_zh: 英国策展人与作家，与内田真帆罗共同策划巴比肯中心“AI：超越人类”（2019），这场融合艺术、科学与 AI 历史的大型展览在全球巡展。
known_for: AI: More than Human (Barbican, 2019, with Maholo Uchida)

orgs.name: Suzanne Treister
orgs.description: British artist whose HEXEN 2.0 tarot cards and diagrams map the entangled histories of cybernetics, military research, the internet and counterculture.
orgs.description_zh: 英国艺术家，HEXEN 2.0 以塔罗牌与图谱描绘控制论、军事研究、互联网与反文化相互缠绕的历史。
known_for: The Holographic Universe Theory of Art History (2018)

orgs.name: Sónar+D
orgs.description: Creativity and technology congress of the Sónar music festival, with talks and showcases on AI in music, synthetic voices and human-machine performance.
orgs.description_zh: Sónar 音乐节的创意与技术大会，举办关于音乐 AI、合成声音与人机表演的讲座和展示。

orgs.name: Tabita Rezaire
orgs.description: French-Guianese artist whose Deep Down Tidal follows undersea internet cables along the routes of colonial trade, framing digital networks as a continuation of empire.
orgs.description_zh: 法属圭亚那艺术家，Deep Down Tidal 沿殖民贸易航线追踪海底互联网光缆，把数字网络视为帝国的延续。

orgs.name: Tactical Tech
orgs.description: International NGO that helps the public understand how technology shapes society, through exhibitions such as The Glass Room and toolkits on data and influence.
orgs.description_zh: 帮助公众理解技术如何塑造社会的国际非政府组织，通过《The Glass Room》等展览以及数据与影响力工具包开展工作。

orgs.name: Taikang Art Museum
orgs.description: Beijing museum of the Taikang collection. Its exhibition Creative Machine (2024–25) traced sixty years of machine creativity, from early computer art to drawing robots such as Patrick Tresset's Human Study #1.
orgs.description_zh: 泰康收藏体系下的北京美术馆。展览《Creative Machine 跨越六十年：人工智能的创意之火》（2024–25）梳理了六十年的机器创造，从早期计算机艺术到 Patrick Tresset 的绘画机器人《Human Study #1》。

orgs.name: Taiwan Contemporary Culture Lab (C-LAB)
orgs.description: Taipei cultural lab in a former air force base, with a Technology Art Center, a sound lab and the Future Media Arts festival. A key venue for Taiwanese art on AI and machines.
orgs.description_zh: 位于台北原空军基地的文化实验场，设有科技艺术中心、声音实验室和未来媒体艺术节，是台湾 AI 与机器艺术的重要场所。

orgs.name: Takanori Shibata
orgs.description: Japanese engineer at AIST who created PARO, a baby harp seal robot used in dementia care worldwide, and a central case in debates on machine care.
orgs.description_zh: 日本产业技术综合研究所工程师，研发了用于全球失智症照护的竖琴海豹宝宝机器人 PARO，是机器照护争论的核心案例。
known_for: PARO therapeutic seal robot (research from 1993; released 2004)

orgs.name: Takashi Ikegami
orgs.description: Japanese artificial-life scientist at the University of Tokyo who gives machines spontaneous, self-organising behaviour; his android Alter moves by a neural network and central pattern generators.
orgs.description_zh: 东京大学日本人工生命科学家，致力于让机器具有自发、自组织的行为；他的仿人机器人 Alter 由神经网络与中枢模式发生器驱动。

orgs.name: Takayuki Todo
orgs.description: Japanese artist-engineer whose SEER is a small humanoid head that meets your gaze and mirrors your expression with delicate eyebrows, probing the threshold of machine empathy.
orgs.description_zh: 日本艺术家与工程师，SEER 是一颗会与你对视、用细腻眉毛模仿你表情的小型人形头部，探索机器共情的阈值。

orgs.name: Tate Modern
orgs.description: London's national modern art museum. Electric Dreams: Art and Technology Before the Internet (2024–25) traced the pre-internet lineage of machine art, and Anicka Yi's Hyundai Commission (2021) filled the Turbine Hall with floating machine organisms.
orgs.description_zh: 英国国家现代艺术馆。《Electric Dreams：互联网之前的艺术与技术》（2024–25）梳理了机器艺术在互联网之前的谱系，Anicka Yi 的现代汽车委托项目（2021）则让漂浮的“机器生物”充满涡轮大厅。

orgs.name: Tech Won't Save Us (podcast)
orgs.description: Weekly podcast by Paris Marx with critical perspectives on tech, AI hype and the labour and infrastructure behind it.
orgs.description_zh: Paris Marx 主持的每周播客，以批判视角讨论科技、AI 热潮及其背后的劳动与基础设施。

orgs.name: Technophany
orgs.description: Journal of the Research Network for Philosophy and Technology (Yuk Hui and others), publishing philosophy of technology, cosmotechnics and machine thought.
orgs.description_zh: 哲学与技术研究网络（许煜等人发起）的期刊，发表技术哲学、宇宙技术与机器思想相关研究。

orgs.name: Ted Chiang
orgs.description: American science-fiction writer whose The Lifecycle of Software Objects follows digital pets raised for years like children, and whose essays sharply describe what language models are.
orgs.description_zh: 美国科幻作家，《软件体的生命周期》讲述像孩子一样被养育多年的数字宠物，他的评论文章也精准描述了语言模型的本质。
known_for: ChatGPT Is a Blurry JPEG of the Web (2023)

orgs.name: Tega Brain
orgs.description: Australian artist and environmental engineer whose Deep Swamp lets AI agents manage wetlands for 'nature', 'art' and 'attention', and whose Synthetic Messenger botnet clicks climate-news ads.
orgs.description_zh: 澳大利亚艺术家与环境工程师，Deep Swamp 让 AI 智能体分别以“自然”“艺术”“关注度”为目标管理湿地，Synthetic Messenger 则用僵尸网络去点击气候新闻广告。
known_for: Solar Protocol (2021, with Alex Nathanson and Benedetta Piantella)

orgs.name: The Glass Room
orgs.description: Tactical Tech's exhibition about data and surveillance, styled as a tech store, with more than 40 exhibits under themes such as We Know You and Big Mother; now toured in community and online editions.
orgs.description_zh: Tactical Tech 以科技商店形式呈现的数据与监控展览，40 多件展品分为“我们认识你”“大妈妈”等主题，现以社区版与线上版巡展。

orgs.name: The Good Robot (podcast)
orgs.description: Podcast by Eleanor Drage and Kerry McInerney asking feminist thinkers and technologists what good technology is.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Eleanor Drage 与 Kerry McInerney 主持的播客，请女性主义学者与技术从业者探讨什么是“好的技术”。

orgs.name: Theo Jansen
orgs.description: Dutch artist who since 1990 has evolved wind-walking 'beach animals' from PVC tubing, machines that store air, sense water and walk the shore on their own.
orgs.description_zh: 荷兰艺术家，自 1990 年起用 PVC 管“进化”出靠风行走的“海滩生物”：这些机器能储存空气、感知海水，并独自在海岸上行走。

orgs.name: Tierra Común
orgs.description: Network of activists and scholars on data colonialism, bringing Global South perspectives to the extraction behind data and AI.
orgs.description_zh: 关注“数据殖民主义”的活动者与学者网络，以全球南方视角审视数据与 AI 背后的攫取。

orgs.name: Timnit Gebru
orgs.description: Ethiopian-born Eritrean-American computer scientist whose work on face-analysis bias and large language models, and her dismissal from Google in 2020, reshaped debates on AI ethics; founder of DAIR.
orgs.description_zh: 埃塞俄比亚出生的厄立特里亚裔美国计算机科学家，她关于人脸分析偏见与大语言模型的研究，以及 2020 年被谷歌解雇事件，重塑了 AI 伦理讨论；DAIR 研究所创始人。
known_for: On the Dangers of Stochastic Parrots (2021)

orgs.name: Timo Arnall
orgs.description: British-Norwegian designer and filmmaker whose Robot Readable World compiles footage of computer vision at work, and whose Internet Machine films the physical data centres behind the cloud.
orgs.description_zh: 英国–挪威设计师与电影人，Robot Readable World 汇集计算机视觉工作时的画面，Internet Machine 拍摄“云”背后的实体数据中心。

orgs.name: Tod Machover
orgs.description: American composer at MIT Media Lab whose robotic opera Death and the Powers imagines a man who uploads himself into 'the System', with a chorus of robots and a singing set.
orgs.description_zh: 麻省理工学院媒体实验室美国作曲家，机器人歌剧《死亡与力量》设想一个人把自己上传进“系统”，由机器人合唱团和会“唱歌”的舞台共同演出。

orgs.name: Tom White
orgs.description: New Zealand artist whose Perception Engines are abstract prints that neural networks confidently classify as electric fans, hammerhead sharks or measuring cups, art made for machine eyes.
orgs.description_zh: 新西兰艺术家，Perception Engines 是一系列抽象版画，神经网络却能笃定地把它们识别成风扇或鲨鱼等物体，是为机器之眼而做的艺术。

orgs.name: Tomasz Hollanek
orgs.description: Researcher at the Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence whose speculative scenarios of 'deadbots' propose design rules for the AI afterlife industry.
orgs.description_zh: 剑桥大学利弗休姆未来智能中心研究者，以关于“亡者机器人”的思辨情景为 AI 来世产业提出设计原则。
known_for: Griefbots, Deadbots, Postmortem Avatars (2024, with Katarzyna Nowaczyk-Basińska)

orgs.name: Tomo Kihara
orgs.description: Japanese designer based in Amsterdam whose street game challenges players to reach a camera without being detected as a pedestrian, testing the failures of self-driving vision.
orgs.description_zh: 常驻阿姆斯特丹的日本设计师，他的街头游戏要求玩家走到摄像头前而不被识别为行人，检验自动驾驶视觉的失效。
known_for: How (not) to get hit by a self-driving car (2022)

orgs.name: Tomotaka Takahashi
orgs.description: Japanese robot creator whose small humanoids include Kirobo, the first talking robot companion in space, and RoBoHoN, a robot that is also a phone.
orgs.description_zh: 日本机器人创作者，其小型人形机器人包括首个进入太空的会说话的陪伴机器人 Kirobo，以及同时是一部手机的机器人 RoBoHoN。

orgs.name: transmediale
orgs.description: Berlin festival for art and digital culture, known for critical rather than celebratory themes (Capture All 2015, face value 2018, for refusal 2021–22). It co-publishes the APRJA journal.
orgs.description_zh: 柏林的艺术与数字文化节，以批判而非颂扬技术的主题著称（2015《Capture All》、2018《face value》、2021–22《for refusal》），并联合出版 APRJA 期刊。

orgs.name: Trevor Paglen
orgs.description: American artist and geographer who makes the invisible infrastructure of machine vision visible, from training-set taxonomies to images 'hallucinated' by classifiers; ImageNet Roulette led ImageNet to remove 600,000 person images.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家与地理学者，让机器视觉的隐形基础设施显形：从训练集分类体系到分类器“幻觉”出的图像；ImageNet Roulette 促使 ImageNet 删除了 60 万张人物图片。
orgs.based_zh: 纽约，美国 / 柏林，德国

orgs.name: Turkopticon
orgs.description: Tool and organising project by and for Amazon Mechanical Turk workers, started by Lilly Irani and Six Silberman, which made the hidden human labour of AI visible and contestable.
orgs.description_zh: 由 Lilly Irani 与 Six Silberman 发起、为亚马逊 Mechanical Turk 众包工人服务的工具与组织项目，使 AI 背后隐形的人力劳动变得可见、可争。

orgs.name: UAL Creative Computing Institute
orgs.name_zh: 伦敦艺术大学创意计算研究所
orgs.description: University of the Arts London institute for creative computing research and teaching, including interactive machine learning for artists (Wekinator) and critical AI practice.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦艺术大学的创意计算研究与教学机构，涵盖面向艺术家的交互式机器学习（Wekinator）与批判性 AI 实践。

orgs.name: UCCA Center for Contemporary Art
orgs.name_zh: UCCA 尤伦斯当代艺术中心
orgs.description: China's leading contemporary art institution, with venues in Beijing, Beidaihe and Shanghai. It has staged major surveys of artists working with digital bodies and automation, such as Cao Fei: Staging the Era (2021).
orgs.description_zh: 中国重要的当代艺术机构，在北京、北戴河和上海设有场馆。它举办过关注数字身体与自动化的艺术家大展，如《曹斐：时代舞台》（2021）。

orgs.name: UCLA Art|Sci Center
orgs.description: Victoria Vesna's centre at UCLA for collaborations between artists and scientists, a hub of the art-science network behind many machine and bio-art projects.
orgs.description_zh: UCLA 由 Victoria Vesna 主持的艺术与科学合作中心，是众多机器与生物艺术项目背后艺术–科学网络的枢纽。

orgs.name: UCLA Design Media Arts
orgs.description: UCLA department for media art and design whose faculty include Casey Reas (Processing) and Lauren Lee McCarthy (LAUREN).
orgs.description_zh: UCLA 的媒体艺术与设计系，教师包括 Casey Reas（Processing）与 Lauren Lee McCarthy（《LAUREN》）。

orgs.name: V&A – Victoria and Albert Museum (Digital Art)
orgs.name_zh: 维多利亚与阿尔伯特博物馆
orgs.description: London design museum that holds the UK's national collection of computer and digital art, from 1960s plotter drawings to Anatomy of an AI System, which it acquired.
orgs.description_zh: 伦敦的设计博物馆，收藏英国国家级的计算机与数字艺术藏品，从 1960 年代绘图仪作品到其收藏的《Anatomy of an AI System》。

orgs.name: V2_ Lab for the Unstable Media
orgs.name_zh: V2_ 不稳定媒体实验室
orgs.description: Interdisciplinary centre for art and media technology that ran the Dutch Electronic Art Festival (DEAF). Its lab, publications and online archive document decades of work on the body, sensors and machines.
orgs.description_zh: 跨学科的艺术与媒体技术中心，曾主办荷兰电子艺术节（DEAF）。其实验室、出版物和在线档案记录了数十年关于身体、传感器与机器的创作。

orgs.name: Valentino Braitenberg
orgs.description: Italian-Austrian neuroscientist whose thought experiment Vehicles shows how tiny wired machines appear to feel fear, love or curiosity, a founding text of synthetic psychology.
orgs.description_zh: 意大利–奥地利神经科学家，思想实验《车辆》展示简单连线的小机器如何看似感到恐惧、爱或好奇，是“合成心理学”的奠基文本。

orgs.name: Vancouver Art Gallery
orgs.description: Canadian art museum whose exhibition The Imitation Game: Visual Culture in the Age of Artificial Intelligence (2022) traced AI in visual culture from automata to machine vision.
orgs.description_zh: 加拿大美术馆。展览《The Imitation Game: 人工智能时代的视觉文化》（2022）从自动人偶到机器视觉，梳理 AI 在视觉文化中的历史。

orgs.name: VIDA – Art & Artificial Life International Awards
orgs.name_zh: VIDA 艺术与人工生命国际奖
orgs.description: Fundación Telefónica's prize (1999–c.2015), the only award devoted to art and artificial life: robots that sweat, walking tables, autonomous protest agents and virtual ecologies.
orgs.description_zh: 西班牙电信基金会设立的奖项（1999–约 2015），唯一专门面向艺术与人工生命的奖：会出汗的机器人、行走的桌子、自主抗议体与虚拟生态。

orgs.name: Vilém Flusser
orgs.description: Czech-Brazilian philosopher who described the camera as an 'apparatus' whose program the photographer plays within, a theory that anticipates image-making machines.
orgs.description_zh: 捷克裔巴西哲学家，把相机视为“装置”，摄影者只在其程序内部游戏，这一理论预见了今日的图像生成机器。
known_for: Into the Universe of Technical Images (1985)
orgs.based_zh: 圣保罗，巴西 / 罗比昂，法国

orgs.name: Virginia Eubanks
orgs.description: American political scientist whose Automating Inequality shows how algorithmic systems profile, police and punish the poor.
orgs.description_zh: 美国政治学者，《自动化不平等》揭示算法系统如何对穷人进行画像、监管与惩罚。

orgs.name: Vitra Design Museum
orgs.description: Design museum whose touring exhibition Hello, Robot. Design between Human and Machine (2017) sorted robots by culture, work, home and body, and became a reference for how design meets machines.
orgs.description_zh: 德国设计博物馆。巡回展《Hello, Robot. 人与机器之间的设计》（2017）按文化、工作、家庭和身体组织机器人，成为设计与机器议题的重要参照。

orgs.name: Vladan Joler
orgs.description: Serbian artist-researcher (SHARE Lab) whose huge diagrams map the minerals, labour and data behind one Amazon Echo; Anatomy of an AI System entered MoMA's collection.
orgs.description_zh: 塞尔维亚艺术家与研究者（SHARE Lab），用巨幅图谱描绘一台 Amazon Echo 背后的矿产、劳动与数据；《AI 系统解剖》被 MoMA 收藏。
known_for: Anatomy of an AI System (2018, with Kate Crawford)

orgs.name: W. Grey Walter
orgs.description: American-born British neurophysiologist whose light-seeking robot tortoises Elmer and Elsie showed lifelike, unpredictable behaviour from two 'neurons', the first autonomous robots.
orgs.description_zh: 美国出生的英国神经生理学家，他的趋光机器龟 Elmer 与 Elsie 仅凭两个“神经元”就表现出栩栩如生、难以预测的行为，是最早的自主机器人。
known_for: Machina speculatrix tortoises Elmer and Elsie (1948–49)

orgs.name: Waag Futurelab
orgs.description: Amsterdam research institute for technology and society that runs public labs, including critical work on AI, biometrics and the 'public stack'.
orgs.description_zh: 阿姆斯特丹的技术与社会研究机构，运营公共实验室，包括对 AI、生物识别与“公共技术栈”的批判性研究。

orgs.name: Wafaa Bilal
orgs.description: Iraqi-American artist who lived for a month in a gallery facing a paintball gun that internet users could aim and fire remotely, and who later implanted a camera in the back of his head.
orgs.description_zh: 伊拉克裔美国艺术家，曾在画廊中生活一个月，面对一把可由网友远程瞄准射击的彩弹枪；后来又在后脑植入一台摄像机。

orgs.name: Wang Xingxing
orgs.description: Chinese engineer and founder of Unitree Robotics, whose quadruped and humanoid robots danced yangge with handkerchiefs on the 2025 Spring Festival Gala, a landmark for public images of robots in China.
orgs.description_zh: 中国工程师、宇树科技创始人，其四足与人形机器人在 2025 年央视春晚上手持手绢扭秧歌，成为中国公众机器人形象的标志性时刻。
known_for: Unitree H1 humanoids at the CCTV Spring Festival Gala (2025)

orgs.name: Wang Yuyang
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose Breathe series makes silicone replicas of everyday machines, from an ATM to a washing machine, slowly inhale and exhale, turning appliances into living bodies.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，《呼吸》系列让 ATM、洗衣机等日常机器的硅胶复制品缓慢地一呼一吸，把电器变成有生命的身体。

orgs.name: Wen-Ying Tsai
orgs.description: Chinese-American engineer turned artist, a pioneer of cybernetic art: his vibrating steel rods under stroboscopic light respond to sound and clapping, so the sculpture seems to breathe with its audience.
orgs.description_zh: 华裔美国艺术家，工程师出身，控制论艺术先驱：他的不锈钢振动杆在频闪光下随声音和掌声变化，雕塑仿佛与观众一起呼吸。

orgs.name: Wendy Hui Kyong Chun
orgs.description: American-Canadian media theorist whose Discriminating Data shows how machine learning's logic of homophily ('like likes like') builds segregation into networks.
orgs.description_zh: 美国–加拿大媒介理论家，《歧视性数据》揭示机器学习的“同质相吸”逻辑如何把隔离写进网络。

orgs.name: Wendy Ju
orgs.description: American interaction researcher at Cornell Tech whose Ghost Driver hid a driver inside a car seat costume to study how pedestrians react to 'driverless' cars.
orgs.description_zh: 康奈尔科技校区美国交互研究者，Ghost Driver 让司机藏在座椅造型的伪装中，研究行人如何对“无人驾驶”汽车作出反应。

orgs.name: Wesley Goatley
orgs.description: British sound artist whose Newly Forgotten Technologies gathers abandoned smart speakers that hold a séance, remembering the future they were promised.
orgs.description_zh: 英国声音艺术家，Newly Forgotten Technologies 让被遗弃的智能音箱聚在一起举行降神会，回忆它们曾被许诺的未来。

orgs.name: Whitney Museum of American Art (artport)
orgs.name_zh: 惠特尼美国艺术博物馆
orgs.description: New York museum whose online portal artport (since 2001) commissions net and software art. Its 2024 exhibition Harold Cohen: AARON showed the drawing program drawing live in a gallery for the first time.
orgs.description_zh: 纽约的美国艺术博物馆，其网络平台 artport（2001 年起）委托网络与软件艺术。2024 年展览《Harold Cohen: AARON》首次让绘画程序 AARON 在展厅现场作画。

orgs.name: Wim Delvoye
orgs.description: Belgian artist whose Cloaca is a room-sized digestion machine that is fed daily and produces faeces, reducing the organism to a laboratory apparatus.
orgs.description_zh: 比利时艺术家，Cloaca 是一台房间大小的“消化机器”，每天喂食并排出粪便，把有机体还原为实验室装置。

orgs.name: WRO Media Art Biennale
orgs.description: Central Europe's longest-running media art biennale, run by the WRO Art Center in Wrocław, with exhibitions on sound, machines and networked media.
orgs.description_zh: 中欧历史最久的媒体艺术双年展，由弗罗茨瓦夫 WRO 艺术中心主办，展出声音、机器与网络媒体作品。

orgs.name: xCoAx – Computation, Communication, Aesthetics & X
orgs.description: Conference and exhibition on computation, communication and aesthetics, with papers and artworks on algorithms, generative systems and the nature of computing.
orgs.description_zh: 关于计算、传播与美学的会议与展览，收录关于算法、生成系统与计算本质的论文与作品。

orgs.name: Xu Bing
orgs.description: Chinese artist whose feature film Dragonfly Eyes is assembled entirely from public surveillance and livestream footage, telling a love story through the eyes of China's cameras.
orgs.description_zh: 中国艺术家，长片《蜻蜓之眼》完全由公共监控与网络直播画面剪辑而成，借中国摄像头的“眼睛”讲述一个爱情故事。
orgs.based_zh: 北京，中国 / 纽约，美国

orgs.name: Yamaguchi Center for Arts and Media [YCAM]
orgs.description: Japanese media arts centre whose in-house R&D team, YCAM InterLab, co-develops works on dance, sensing and machines with artists, releasing tools and research as open source.
orgs.description_zh: 日本的媒体艺术中心，其内部研发团队 YCAM InterLab 与艺术家共同开发关于舞蹈、感知与机器的作品，并开源发布工具与研究成果。

orgs.name: Yoichi Ochiai
orgs.description: Japanese media artist and researcher who proposes 'digital nature', a world where computation becomes a new nature beyond the human–machine divide.
orgs.description_zh: 日本媒体艺术家与研究者，提出“数字自然”：计算成为一种超越人机二分的新自然。

orgs.name: Yuk Hui
orgs.description: Hong Kong philosopher whose idea of 'cosmotechnics' argues that there is no single universal technology, opening non-Western ways to think about machines and AI.
orgs.description_zh: 香港哲学家，提出“宇宙技术”，主张不存在单一普遍的技术，为以非西方方式思考机器与 AI 打开空间。
known_for: On the Existence of Digital Objects (2016)
The Question Concerning Technology in China (2016)

orgs.name: Yunchul Kim
orgs.description: South Korean artist whose kinetic 'material machines' sense cosmic rays and fluid dynamics; he represented Korea at the 2022 Venice Biennale with Gyre.
orgs.description_zh: 韩国艺术家，他的动态“物质机器”感应宇宙射线与流体运动；2022 年以《Gyre》代表韩国参加威尼斯双年展。

orgs.name: Zach Blas
orgs.description: American artist whose amorphous collective masks, made from aggregated face scans, defeat biometric recognition; his Tay installation resurrects Microsoft's deleted chatbot to reflect on its death.
orgs.description_zh: 美国艺术家，用多人面部扫描合成的无定形集体面具对抗生物识别；他的 Tay 装置让被微软删除的聊天机器人“复活”，反思它的死亡。
known_for: im here to learn so :)))))) (2017, with Jemima Wyman)

orgs.name: Zhang Ga
orgs.description: Chinese curator and artistic director of Chronus Art Center in Shanghai whose triennials of media art at the National Art Museum of China brought robot, AI and bio art to Chinese audiences.
orgs.description_zh: 中国策展人，上海新时线媒体艺术中心艺术总监，他在中国美术馆策划的媒体艺术三年展把机器人、AI 与生物艺术带给中国观众。
known_for: Artistic director of Chronus Art Center

orgs.name: ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe
orgs.name_zh: ZKM 卡尔斯鲁厄艺术与媒体中心
orgs.description: Europe's largest media art museum, with a collection spanning computer art to AI. Exhibitions such as Open Codes (2017) and BioMedia (2021) framed machine learning, algorithmic governance and life-like media systems.
orgs.description_zh: 欧洲最大的媒体艺术美术馆，收藏从早期计算机艺术延伸到 AI。《Open Codes》（2017）与《BioMedia》（2021）等展览讨论了机器学习、算法治理和“类生命”的媒体系统。
